courses.title: 雪山隧道工程
courses.summary: 雪山隧道穿越台灣北部山區，連接北宜高速公路，高公局公開資料列長約12.9公里。本進階課由破碎帶水力連通開始，追蹤開挖、支護及排水的交互作用，再把量測基準和設備資料交給營運端；重點是辨識未知條件如何改變結論，而不重複隧道的入門介紹。
courses.summaryEn: The approximately 12.9 km Hsuehshan Tunnel connects the northern Taiwan expressway with Yilan through mountainous terrain. This advanced course follows fault-zone hydraulic connectivity through excavation, support and drainage, then transfers survey baselines and equipment evidence to operations. Its emphasis is how uncertain conditions change engineering conclusions rather than repeating an introductory description of the tunnel.
courses.focus: 破碎帶水壓、長距離探勘與雙孔道路防災
courses.focusEn: Fault-zone water pressure, long-distance investigation and twin-bore road resilience
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為334.521 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=20 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為124.675 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 334.521 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=20 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 124.675 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

newStages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
newStages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「破碎帶連通與預報更新」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將雪山山區破碎帶視為多條可能連通水路，研究先進孔揭露的新裂隙如何修正主孔前方預測；不能以已排出的水量推定剩餘岩體必然乾燥。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat the mountain fault zone as several potentially connected pathways and examine how a newly intercepted fracture changes the forecast ahead of the main bore. Water already drained does not prove the remaining ground is dry. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2 無因次；通水面積=200 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2 dimensionless; flow area=200 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 將雪山山區破碎帶視為多條可能連通水路，研究先進孔揭露的新裂隙如何修正主孔前方預測；不能以已排出的水量推定剩餘岩體必然乾燥。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the mountain fault zone as several potentially connected pathways and examine how a newly intercepted fracture changes the forecast ahead of the main bore. Water already drained does not prove the remaining ground is dry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
將雪山山區破碎帶視為多條可能連通水路，研究先進孔揭露的新裂隙如何修正主孔前方預測；不能以已排出的水量推定剩餘岩體必然乾燥。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Treat the mountain fault zone as several potentially connected pathways and examine how a newly intercepted fracture changes the forecast ahead of the main bore.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 將雪山山區破碎帶視為多條可能連通水路，研究先進孔揭露的新裂隙如何修正主孔前方預測；不能以已排出的水量推定剩餘岩體必然乾燥。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat the mountain fault zone as several potentially connected pathways and examine how a newly intercepted fracture changes the forecast ahead of the main bore. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2 無因次；通水面積=200 m²。Q=k i A=0.0004 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00044 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2 dimensionless; flow area=200 m². Q=k i A=0.0004 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00044 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2 無因次；通水面積=200 m²。Q=k i A=0.0004 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00044 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2 dimensionless; flow area=200 m². Q=k i A=0.0004 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00044 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2 無因次；通水面積=200 m²。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2 dimensionless; flow area=200 m².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2 無因次；通水面積=200 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=1e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2 dimensionless; flow area=200 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
knowledge.textEn: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以雪山兩孔及探勘坑之間的水頭差建立假想分層模型，分辨局部排水效果與整座山體地下水位下降；永久襯砌還要承受排水失效狀態。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a hypothetical layered head model between the two bores and exploratory gallery, separating local drainage from regional drawdown. Permanent lining must also be assessed when the drainage path is unavailable. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 以雪山兩孔及探勘坑之間的水頭差建立假想分層模型，分辨局部排水效果與整座山體地下水位下降；永久襯砌還要承受排水失效狀態。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Build a hypothetical layered head model between the two bores and exploratory gallery, separating local drainage from regional drawdown. Permanent lining must also be assessed when the drainage path is unavailable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
以雪山兩孔及探勘坑之間的水頭差建立假想分層模型，分辨局部排水效果與整座山體地下水位下降；永久襯砌還要承受排水失效狀態。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Build a hypothetical layered head model between the two bores and exploratory gallery, separating local drainage from regional drawdown.
quiz.explanation: 以雪山兩孔及探勘坑之間的水頭差建立假想分層模型，分辨局部排水效果與整座山體地下水位下降；永久襯砌還要承受排水失效狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a hypothetical layered head model between the two bores and exploratory gallery, separating local drainage from regional drawdown. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為334.521 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 334.521 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為334.521 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 334.521 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=31 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=31 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=304.11 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一孔排水可能讓另一孔水位同步變化，若當作兩次獨立事件會誤估滲透性；需先查共同補注和管路連通。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drainage in one bore may alter the other; treating these as independent events biases permeability estimates, so investigate shared recharge and connections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一孔排水可能讓另一孔水位同步變化，若當作兩次獨立事件會誤估滲透性；需先查共同補注和管路連通。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage in one bore may alter the other; treating these as independent events biases permeability estimates, so investigate shared recharge and connections. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一孔排水可能讓另一孔水位同步變化，若當作兩次獨立事件會誤估滲透性；需先查共同補注和管路連通。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage in one bore may alter the other; treating these as independent events biases permeability estimates, so investigate shared recharge and connections. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
一孔排水可能讓另一孔水位同步變化，若當作兩次獨立事件會誤估滲透性；需先查共同補注和管路連通。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Drainage in one bore may alter the other; treating these as independent events biases permeability estimates, so investigate shared recharge and connections.
quiz.explanation: 一孔排水可能讓另一孔水位同步變化，若當作兩次獨立事件會誤估滲透性；需先查共同補注和管路連通。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage in one bore may alter the other; treating these as independent events biases permeability estimates, so investigate shared recharge and connections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」與「支護啟動與變形容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover stress and wall redistribution" and "Support activation and deformation capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將雪山覆土與破碎帶交界分開，檢查高應力岩塊旁的低剛度帶是否使洞壁變形集中；覆土相近的兩個斷面不一定採相同材料模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate cover effects from the fault transition and examine whether a compliant band beside stressed blocks concentrates wall movement. Two sections with similar cover need not share the same constitutive model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=500 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=500 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配
knowledge.text: 將雪山覆土與破碎帶交界分開，檢查高應力岩塊旁的低剛度帶是否使洞壁變形集中；覆土相近的兩個斷面不一定採相同材料模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。
knowledge.textEn: Separate cover effects from the fault transition and examine whether a compliant band beside stressed blocks concentrates wall movement. Two sections with similar cover need not share the same constitutive model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 將雪山覆土與破碎帶交界分開，檢查高應力岩塊旁的低剛度帶是否使洞壁變形集中；覆土相近的兩個斷面不一定採相同材料模型。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Separate cover effects from the fault transition and examine whether a compliant band beside stressed blocks concentrates wall movement.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 將雪山覆土與破碎帶交界分開，檢查高應力岩塊旁的低剛度帶是否使洞壁變形集中；覆土相近的兩個斷面不一定採相同材料模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate cover effects from the fault transition and examine whether a compliant band beside stressed blocks concentrates wall movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=500 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.9 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=500 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.9 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=500 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.9 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=500 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.9 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：覆土深度=500 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: cover=500 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=500 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=500 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=39 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
knowledge.textEn: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation.
quiz.explanation: 在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以雪山長隧道施工的支護封閉時序為題，分析掌子面前進後尚未形成閉合環的暫時狀態；開挖面距離與支護齡期要與最終尺寸同時保留。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Study the temporary condition before support closes into a ring as the heading advances. Face distance and support age must remain visible alongside final dimensions when interpreting loads and convergence. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=30 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=30 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 以雪山長隧道施工的支護封閉時序為題，分析掌子面前進後尚未形成閉合環的暫時狀態；開挖面距離與支護齡期要與最終尺寸同時保留。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Study the temporary condition before support closes into a ring as the heading advances. Face distance and support age must remain visible alongside final dimensions when interpreting loads and convergence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
以雪山長隧道施工的支護封閉時序為題，分析掌子面前進後尚未形成閉合環的暫時狀態；開挖面距離與支護齡期要與最終尺寸同時保留。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Study the temporary condition before support closes into a ring as the heading advances.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 以雪山長隧道施工的支護封閉時序為題，分析掌子面前進後尚未形成閉合環的暫時狀態；開挖面距離與支護齡期要與最終尺寸同時保留。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Study the temporary condition before support closes into a ring as the heading advances. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=30 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=240 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為264 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=30 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=240 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 264 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=30 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=240 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為264 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=30 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=240 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 264 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
原創教學假設：局部剛度=30 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=30 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=30 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=30 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位移趨緩可能只是量測點移出活躍區，若未記錄掌子面位置會過早認定整段已穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slower movement may mean the point has left the active zone; without face position it can be misread as stability of the whole section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。

Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位移趨緩可能只是量測點移出活躍區，若未記錄掌子面位置會過早認定整段已穩定。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slower movement may mean the point has left the active zone; without face position it can be misread as stability of the whole section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 位移趨緩可能只是量測點移出活躍區，若未記錄掌子面位置會過早認定整段已穩定。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Slower movement may mean the point has left the active zone; without face position it can be misread as stability of the whole section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
位移趨緩可能只是量測點移出活躍區，若未記錄掌子面位置會過早認定整段已穩定。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Slower movement may mean the point has left the active zone; without face position it can be misread as stability of the whole section.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 位移趨緩可能只是量測點移出活躍區，若未記錄掌子面位置會過早認定整段已穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slower movement may mean the point has left the active zone; without face position it can be misread as stability of the whole section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「掘進利用率與設備停時」與「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" and "Shared access and transport bottlenecks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective boring utilisation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雪山案例用來比較受地質限制的掘進循環：刀具切削時間、檢查修理及出渣等待必須分開，才能判定設備瓶頸或破碎帶風險誰先控制進度。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use the Hsuehshan context to separate cutting, inspection and spoil queues in a geologically constrained cycle, determining whether machinery or fault-zone uncertainty controls progress before proposing a production change. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.5 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.5 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效掘進利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective boring utilisation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance.

knowledge.text: 誤解：刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效掘進利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective boring utilisation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.5 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。D=24vu=11.16 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.276 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.5 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.16 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.276 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把停機原因碼對齊刀具檢查和地質里程，另以完整班次的時間收支核對日報，避免只選高產時段評估機器。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align downtime causes with cutter inspection and geological chainage, checking a complete shift time balance rather than selecting high-output intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.5 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。D=24vu=11.16 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.276 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「掘進利用率與設備停時」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.5 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效掘進利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective boring utilisation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把停機原因碼對齊刀具檢查和地質里程，另以完整班次的時間收支核對日報，避免只選高產時段評估機器。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align downtime causes with cutter inspection and geological chainage, checking a complete shift time balance rather than selecting high-output intervals. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：把停機原因碼對齊刀具檢查和地質里程，另以完整班次的時間收支核對日報，避免只選高產時段評估機器。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align downtime causes with cutter inspection and geological chainage, checking a complete shift time balance rather than selecting high-output intervals. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出渣等待若被列為地質停工，會把後勤問題誤判成岩石太硬，導致無效更換刀具或修改推進策略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spoil queues classified as ground delay falsely suggest hard rock and prompt ineffective cutter replacement or advance changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出渣等待若被列為地質停工，會把後勤問題誤判成岩石太硬，導致無效更換刀具或修改推進策略。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
knowledge.textEn: Spoil queues classified as ground delay falsely suggest hard rock and prompt ineffective cutter replacement or advance changes. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Spoil queues classified as ground delay falsely suggest hard rock and prompt ineffective cutter replacement or advance changes.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths

steps.instruction: 雪山山區工址的長距離運輸使裝載、交會與卸料相互制約，假想多工作面同時出渣時需檢查共同通道容量，不能只按各面最佳日進尺配置車隊。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long access distances couple loading, passing and unloading. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=20 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為124.675 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=20 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=137.143 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 124.675 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按車次配對裝載重量和到卸料點時間，找出排隊集中區；比較維修期間與正常時段的有效循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair payloads with arrival times at unloading, locate queue concentration and compare effective cycles during maintenance and ordinary service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
