steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按車次配對裝載重量和到卸料點時間，找出排隊集中區；比較維修期間與正常時段的有效循環。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair payloads with arrival times at unloading, locate queue concentration and compare effective cycles during maintenance and ordinary service. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按車次配對裝載重量和到卸料點時間，找出排隊集中區；比較維修期間與正常時段的有效循環。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Pair payloads with arrival times at unloading, locate queue concentration and compare effective cycles during maintenance and ordinary service. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：增加車輛若堵住單線交會點，總運量反而下降，且材料補給可能與撤離需求競爭同一空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: More vehicles can block passing locations and reduce throughput while material deliveries compete with evacuation access. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: More vehicles can block passing locations and reduce throughput while material deliveries compete with evacuation access. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與貫通誤差」與「通風網路與壓力損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control network and breakthrough error" and "Ventilation network and pressure loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雪山長距離貫通的教學情境著重方向傳遞：將洞口地表基準、導坑及主孔控制網分開覆核，找出共用基準偏差無法靠重複量測自行消除的原因。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For long-distance breakthrough, independently examine surface control, pilot-gallery transfer and the main-bore network. Identify why repeated measurements cannot remove a bias inherited from a shared starting datum. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=3000 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3000 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 雪山長距離貫通的教學情境著重方向傳遞：將洞口地表基準、導坑及主孔控制網分開覆核，找出共用基準偏差無法靠重複量測自行消除的原因。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: For long-distance breakthrough, independently examine surface control, pilot-gallery transfer and the main-bore network. Identify why repeated measurements cannot remove a bias inherited from a shared starting datum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
雪山長距離貫通的教學情境著重方向傳遞：將洞口地表基準、導坑及主孔控制網分開覆核，找出共用基準偏差無法靠重複量測自行消除的原因。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
For long-distance breakthrough, independently examine surface control, pilot-gallery transfer and the main-bore network.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 雪山長距離貫通的教學情境著重方向傳遞：將洞口地表基準、導坑及主孔控制網分開覆核，找出共用基準偏差無法靠重複量測自行消除的原因。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For long-distance breakthrough, independently examine surface control, pilot-gallery transfer and the main-bore network. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=3000 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.041597 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3000 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.041597 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3000 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.041597 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3000 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.041597 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：控制長度=3000 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=3000 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3000 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3000 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0378155 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 從另一地表控制線重新傳遞方向，對照不同溫度時段的角距原始值，再把閉合差拆成水平與高程分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Transfer orientation from another surface control route, compare raw observations across temperature periods and separate horizontal and vertical closure components. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以雪山雙孔道路的一孔維修為情境，分析風門、橫通道及車流邊界如何共同改變網路；不能把施工通風模型直接移作營運控煙模型。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use maintenance in one road bore to examine changes in dampers, passages and traffic boundaries. Construction ventilation cannot be transferred directly into an operational smoke-control model with different occupants and sources. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=500 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=500 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=25.6688 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為31.0592 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=500 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=25.6688 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 31.0592 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：橫通道門位資料若過期，模型可能預測隔離但現場形成短路風流，關鍵區段抽排效果便被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outdated passage-door states may predict isolation while a real airflow shortcut reduces extraction in the critical zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步記錄兩孔風速、壓差與門位，先比正常工況再比核准異常工況，辨認風量減少來自漏風還是阻力增加。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise both-bore flow, pressure and door states, comparing normal and approved degraded cases to distinguish leakage from increased resistance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 橫通道門位資料若過期，模型可能預測隔離但現場形成短路風流，關鍵區段抽排效果便被高估。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outdated passage-door states may predict isolation while a real airflow shortcut reduces extraction in the critical zone. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 橫通道門位資料若過期，模型可能預測隔離但現場形成短路風流，關鍵區段抽排效果便被高估。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Outdated passage-door states may predict isolation while a real airflow shortcut reduces extraction in the critical zone. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
橫通道門位資料若過期，模型可能預測隔離但現場形成短路風流，關鍵區段抽排效果便被高估。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Outdated passage-door states may predict isolation while a real airflow shortcut reduces extraction in the critical zone.
quiz.explanation: 橫通道門位資料若過期，模型可能預測隔離但現場形成短路風流，關鍵區段抽排效果便被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Outdated passage-door states may predict isolation while a real airflow shortcut reduces extraction in the critical zone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘集水容積」如何影響雪山隧道工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining sump volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雪山排水教學把斷層入流和機電故障合併：若雨後淨入流提高同時一台泵維修，剩餘容積與警報延遲要放在同一時間線，不把名義備援當保證。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘集水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Combine fault inflow and equipment state: after rainfall, increased net inflow can coincide with pump maintenance. Place usable volume and alarm delay on one timeline rather than treating nominal redundancy as guaranteed service. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining sump volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 用實測集水坑水位容積曲線核對流量，再將維修隔離狀態和警報傳輸延遲加入緩衝計算，確認淤積已扣除。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=100 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.4 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=100 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.4 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查低點水位告警與風機故障各一例，從控制畫面找到工單及現場標籤，重算設備更換前後是否可直接比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample a low-point alarm and fan fault from screen to work order and physical tag, testing comparability across equipment replacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查低點水位告警與風機故障各一例，從控制畫面找到工單及現場標籤，重算設備更換前後是否可直接比較。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample a low-point alarm and fan fault from screen to work order and physical tag, testing comparability across equipment replacement. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查低點水位告警與風機故障各一例，從控制畫面找到工單及現場標籤，重算設備更換前後是否可直接比較。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample a low-point alarm and fan fault from screen to work order and physical tag, testing comparability across equipment replacement. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若新水位計沿用舊零點卻換了安裝高程，趨勢可能顯示假的水量增加；先核對基準而非立刻擴泵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A replacement level sensor at a new elevation with an old zero creates false rising-water trends; check datum before increasing pumping. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若新水位計沿用舊零點卻換了安裝高程，趨勢可能顯示假的水量增加；先核對基準而非立刻擴泵。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A replacement level sensor at a new elevation with an old zero creates false rising-water trends; check datum before increasing pumping. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若新水位計沿用舊零點卻換了安裝高程，趨勢可能顯示假的水量增加；先核對基準而非立刻擴泵。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A replacement level sensor at a new elevation with an old zero creates false rising-water trends; check datum before increasing pumping.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.

courses.title: 英法海底隧道
courses.summary: 英法海底隧道讓客貨列車與車輛接駁列車通過英吉利海峽，營運商列長約50公里並記錄1994年啟用。本進階課把海底水壓、襯砌接縫、熱量、氣動擾動與維修可用率連成同一系統，特別比較主孔與服務通道的任務差異，避免把各設備單獨合格當整體服務可靠。
courses.summaryEn: The approximately 50 km Channel Tunnel carries passenger, freight and vehicle-shuttle trains beneath the English Channel and opened in 1994. This advanced course links subsea pressure, lining joints, heat, aerodynamic disturbances and maintenance availability. It distinguishes the duties of running bores and service access, showing why individual equipment compliance does not by itself establish a reliable operating system.
courses.focus: 主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性
courses.focusEn: Running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「環向受力與接縫柔度」，再獨立計算「列車壓力波與動壓量級」。原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.11771 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1220.41 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate ring force and joint flexibility, then independently calculate train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale. Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.11771 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1220.41 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

newStages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
newStages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Ring force and joint flexibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 英法海底案例先區分海面水深與岩層測壓水頭，避免把海床幾何直接當襯砌各處水壓；服務通道排水也會影響局部梯度。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish seawater depth from rock piezometric head, including local gradients affected by service-gallery drainage rather than equating seabed geometry with pressure everywhere. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=34 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=34 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 英法海底案例先區分海面水深與岩層測壓水頭，避免把海床幾何直接當襯砌各處水壓；服務通道排水也會影響局部梯度。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish seawater depth from rock piezometric head, including local gradients affected by service-gallery drainage rather than equating seabed geometry with pressure everywhere. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
英法海底案例先區分海面水深與岩層測壓水頭，避免把海床幾何直接當襯砌各處水壓；服務通道排水也會影響局部梯度。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Distinguish seawater depth from rock piezometric head, including local gradients affected by service-gallery drainage rather than equating seabed geometry with pressure everywhere.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.

quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish seawater depth from rock piezometric head, including local gradients affected by service-gallery drainage rather than equating seabed geometry with pressure everywhere. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=34 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為366.894 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=34 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 366.894 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=34 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為366.894 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=34 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 366.894 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=34 m。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=34 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=34 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=34 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=333.54 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Channel Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比較英法主孔及服務通道的襯砌尺度，幾何縮小雖改變膜應力量級，接頭轉角、局部荷載及維修開口仍須獨立評估。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare lining scales in running bores and service access; geometric scaling changes membrane stress but does not preserve joint rotations, local loads or maintenance-opening behaviour. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 比較英法主孔及服務通道的襯砌尺度，幾何縮小雖改變膜應力量級，接頭轉角、局部荷載及維修開口仍須獨立評估。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Compare lining scales in running bores and service access; geometric scaling changes membrane stress but does not preserve joint rotations, local loads or maintenance-opening behaviour. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
比較英法主孔及服務通道的襯砌尺度，幾何縮小雖改變膜應力量級，接頭轉角、局部荷載及維修開口仍須獨立評估。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Compare lining scales in running bores and service access.
quiz.explanation: 比較英法主孔及服務通道的襯砌尺度，幾何縮小雖改變膜應力量級，接頭轉角、局部荷載及維修開口仍須獨立評估。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare lining scales in running bores and service access; geometric scaling changes membrane stress but does not preserve joint rotations, local loads or maintenance-opening behaviour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.11771 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.11771 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.11771 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.11771 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa；半徑=3.1 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa; radius=3.1 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=2.83429 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把小孔的接縫性能按比例套到大孔，可能忽略更大的絕對張開和局部偏心。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scaling small-bore sealing performance to the larger bore can miss increased absolute opening and local eccentricity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
knowledge.textEn: For Channel Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把小孔的接縫性能按比例套到大孔，可能忽略更大的絕對張開和局部偏心。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling small-bore sealing performance to the larger bore can miss increased absolute opening and local eccentricity. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把小孔的接縫性能按比例套到大孔，可能忽略更大的絕對張開和局部偏心。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。
knowledge.textEn: Scaling small-bore sealing performance to the larger bore can miss increased absolute opening and local eccentricity. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
把小孔的接縫性能按比例套到大孔，可能忽略更大的絕對張開和局部偏心。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Scaling small-bore sealing performance to the larger bore can miss increased absolute opening and local eccentricity.
quiz.explanation: 把小孔的接縫性能按比例套到大孔，可能忽略更大的絕對張開和局部偏心。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling small-bore sealing performance to the larger bore can miss increased absolute opening and local eccentricity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」與「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint compression and sealing envelope" and "Shared access and transport bottlenecks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮餘量」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gasket compression reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水壓縮餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gasket compression reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=3.4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13.6 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.26 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=3.4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13.6 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.26 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在接縫轉角及分岔附近保存錯台方向，選全尺寸測試中真正對應的組合，而非只比水壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain offset direction at rotated and branched interfaces and select the matching full-size test combination, not pressure alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水壓縮餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gasket compression reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在接縫轉角及分岔附近保存錯台方向，選全尺寸測試中真正對應的組合，而非只比水壓。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain offset direction at rotated and branched interfaces and select the matching full-size test combination, not pressure alone. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：在接縫轉角及分岔附近保存錯台方向，選全尺寸測試中真正對應的組合，而非只比水壓。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Retain offset direction at rotated and branched interfaces and select the matching full-size test combination, not pressure alone. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同方向錯台可能讓密封接觸區遷移，單一正向試驗合格不能證明反向循環後仍水密。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opposite offsets can shift the sealing contact zone; passing one-direction tests does not prove tightness after reversed cycles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
