steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水壓縮餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gasket compression reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同方向錯台可能讓密封接觸區遷移，單一正向試驗合格不能證明反向循環後仍水密。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opposite offsets can shift the sealing contact zone; passing one-direction tests does not prove tightness after reversed cycles. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同方向錯台可能讓密封接觸區遷移，單一正向試驗合格不能證明反向循環後仍水密。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。
knowledge.textEn: Opposite offsets can shift the sealing contact zone; passing one-direction tests does not prove tightness after reversed cycles. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Opposite offsets can shift the sealing contact zone; passing one-direction tests does not prove tightness after reversed cycles.

Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長海底隧道的維修物流需在列車服務與服務通道使用間協調，備料的距離和返回時間會影響實際工作窗口，不只看工具進入時間。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance logistics must fit railway service and service-access use; material distance and return time constrain the window beyond the time needed to bring tools inside. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=21 t；往返週期=33 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=21 t; cycle=33 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 長海底隧道的維修物流需在列車服務與服務通道使用間協調，備料的距離和返回時間會影響實際工作窗口，不只看工具進入時間。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance logistics must fit railway service and service-access use; material distance and return time constrain the window beyond the time needed to bring tools inside. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
長海底隧道的維修物流需在列車服務與服務通道使用間協調，備料的距離和返回時間會影響實際工作窗口，不只看工具進入時間。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Maintenance logistics must fit railway service and service-access use.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 長海底隧道的維修物流需在列車服務與服務通道使用間協調，備料的距離和返回時間會影響實際工作窗口，不只看工具進入時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance logistics must fit railway service and service-access use; material distance and return time constrain the window beyond the time needed to bring tools inside. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=21 t；往返週期=33 min。C=N payload 60/T=152.727 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為138.843 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=21 t; cycle=33 min. C=N payload 60/T=152.727 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 138.843 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=21 t；往返週期=33 min。C=N payload 60/T=152.727 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為138.843 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=21 t; cycle=33 min. C=N payload 60/T=152.727 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 138.843 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=21 t；往返週期=33 min。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=21 t; cycle=33 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=21 t；往返週期=33 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=21 t; cycle=33 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只安排作業時間而不留撤出驗證，會把未清空的工作面錯報成可恢復列車服務。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scheduling work without verified withdrawal time can incorrectly report an occupied worksite as ready for railway service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Channel Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只安排作業時間而不留撤出驗證，會把未清空的工作面錯報成可恢復列車服務。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scheduling work without verified withdrawal time can incorrectly report an occupied worksite as ready for railway service. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只安排作業時間而不留撤出驗證，會把未清空的工作面錯報成可恢復列車服務。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Scheduling work without verified withdrawal time can incorrectly report an occupied worksite as ready for railway service. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只安排作業時間而不留撤出驗證，會把未清空的工作面錯報成可恢復列車服務。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Scheduling work without verified withdrawal time can incorrectly report an occupied worksite as ready for railway service.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 只安排作業時間而不留撤出驗證，會把未清空的工作面錯報成可恢復列車服務。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scheduling work without verified withdrawal time can incorrectly report an occupied worksite as ready for railway service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱源分配與空氣顯熱」與「列車壓力波與動壓量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Heat sources and sensible-air removal" and "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Heat sources and sensible-air removal: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風顯熱量」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation sensible heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 英法列車與設備熱源會隨服務密度改變，分析正常高峰和一條冷卻路徑維修時的空氣及水側熱帳，避免把裝置容量直接視為可移除熱量。深部岩體、列車和機械會向空氣持續放熱，空氣帶走的顯熱由質量流量與溫升決定。相同體積風量在不同密度下不具有相同散熱能力；濕度、岩體瞬變及水冷系統還需分開記帳，單一穩態熱平衡不能預測全部溫度尖峰。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風顯熱量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traffic-dependent heat must be reconciled across air and water during peaks and cooling-path maintenance rather than equating installed capacity with removable heat. Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise. Equal volumetric flow at different density does not provide equal cooling. Moisture, transient rock heat and water cooling need separate accounts; a steady balance cannot predict every temperature peak or local worker exposure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation sensible heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=82 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=12 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; volume flow=82 m³/s; specific heat=1.005 kJ/(kg·K); temperature rise=12 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風顯熱量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation sensible heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱
knowledge.text: 英法列車與設備熱源會隨服務密度改變，分析正常高峰和一條冷卻路徑維修時的空氣及水側熱帳，避免把裝置容量直接視為可移除熱量。深部岩體、列車和機械會向空氣持續放熱，空氣帶走的顯熱由質量流量與溫升決定。
knowledge.textEn: Traffic-dependent heat must be reconciled across air and water during peaks and cooling-path maintenance rather than equating installed capacity with removable heat. Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱源分配與空氣顯熱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風顯熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation sensible heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=82 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=12 K。Q=ρVcpΔT=1186.7 kW。僅把體積風量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1305.37 kW。邊界：僅空氣顯熱，不含濕度潛熱及岩體瞬變；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; volume flow=82 m³/s; specific heat=1.005 kJ/(kg·K); temperature rise=12 K. Q=ρVcpΔT=1186.7 kW. Increasing only volume flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1305.37 kW. Boundary: Sensible air heat only, excluding latent heat and rock transients. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair train passages, equipment power, temperature rise and flow, checking whether energy residuals cluster during peak service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heat sources and sensible-air removal: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風顯熱量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation sensible heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對列車通過時段、設備功率、進出口溫差和流量，檢查熱量殘差是否集中在服務高峰。同步量測進出口溫濕度、風量及設備負載，分開平均與尖峰時段，用能量收支殘差檢查漏列熱源。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair train passages, equipment power, temperature rise and flow, checking whether energy residuals cluster during peak service. Synchronise inlet/outlet temperature, humidity, flow and equipment load, separate average and peak periods, and use energy residuals to identify missing sources. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風顯熱量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation sensible heat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均日溫度正常可能遮住列車連續通過的局部熱峰，需保留時間解析度再判斷冷卻不足。把低密度空氣視為海平面空氣會高估散熱，局部熱點也可能被斷面平均溫度掩蓋，導致設備或工作環境超限。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal daily mean can conceal local peaks during successive train passages; retain time resolution before judging cooling adequacy. Assuming sea-level density overstates cooling at low density, while cross-sectional averages hide hot spots affecting equipment and the work environment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moisture, transient rock heat and water cooling need separate accounts; a steady balance cannot predict every temperature peak or local worker exposure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Portal pressure disturbance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 英法主孔的列車種類與速度不同，阻塞比和交會情境應分案；服務通道門位又會改變壓力反射邊界，不能用單一動壓替代波動歷程。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口壓力擾動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different train types, speeds and encounter cases change blockage and wave behaviour; service-access door states also alter reflections beyond a single dynamic-pressure estimate. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Portal pressure disturbance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口壓力擾動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Portal pressure disturbance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1220.41 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1220.41 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1220.41 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1220.41 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車壓力波與動壓量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale", which statement holds?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=41 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=41 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1008.6 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口壓力擾動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Portal pressure disturbance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只存最大壓力不存升壓時間，可能漏掉設備密封與乘客感受所受的快速變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Saving only peak pressure loses rapid changes relevant to seals and passenger comfort. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
knowledge.textEn: For Channel Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival.
quiz.explanation: 在列車通過前後同步量測門兩側壓力，將列車編組與門位一起保存，檢查反射峰抵達時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise pressure across doors before and after passage, retaining formation and door state to check reflected-wave arrival. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口壓力擾動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Portal pressure disturbance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只存最大壓力不存升壓時間，可能漏掉設備密封與乘客感受所受的快速變化。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Saving only peak pressure loses rapid changes relevant to seals and passenger comfort. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只存最大壓力不存升壓時間，可能漏掉設備密封與乘客感受所受的快速變化。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Saving only peak pressure loses rapid changes relevant to seals and passenger comfort. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「列車壓力波與動壓量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只存最大壓力不存升壓時間，可能漏掉設備密封與乘客感受所受的快速變化。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Saving only peak pressure loses rapid changes relevant to seals and passenger comfort.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 只存最大壓力不存升壓時間，可能漏掉設備密封與乘客感受所受的快速變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Saving only peak pressure loses rapid changes relevant to seals and passenger comfort. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Outage buffer and effective sump volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 英法服務通道提供不同於運行孔的接收空間，疏散模型需確認到達之後的人流容量與可用狀態，不能在越過第一道門時就結束計時。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Service access provides a receiving space distinct from the running bore; evacuation modelling must include capacity and availability after the first doorway, not stop its clock there. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=82 s；行走距離=320 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=82 s; travel distance=320 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 英法服務通道提供不同於運行孔的接收空間，疏散模型需確認到達之後的人流容量與可用狀態，不能在越過第一道門時就結束計時。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Service access provides a receiving space distinct from the running bore; evacuation modelling must include capacity and availability after the first doorway, not stop its clock there. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
英法服務通道提供不同於運行孔的接收空間，疏散模型需確認到達之後的人流容量與可用狀態，不能在越過第一道門時就結束計時。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Service access provides a receiving space distinct from the running bore.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 英法服務通道提供不同於運行孔的接收空間，疏散模型需確認到達之後的人流容量與可用狀態，不能在越過第一道門時就結束計時。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Service access provides a receiving space distinct from the running bore; evacuation modelling must include capacity and availability after the first doorway, not stop its clock there. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=82 s；行走距離=320 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=482 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為522 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=82 s; travel distance=320 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=482 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 522 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：演練或模擬分開通過橫通道門與後續移動時間，核對接收區人數及通訊延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate doorway crossing from onward movement in drills or models, checking receiving-zone occupancy and communication delays.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=82 s；行走距離=320 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=482 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為522 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=82 s; travel distance=320 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=482 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 522 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 演練或模擬分開通過橫通道門與後續移動時間，核對接收區人數及通訊延遲。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate doorway crossing from onward movement in drills or models, checking receiving-zone occupancy and communication delays. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：演練或模擬分開通過橫通道門與後續移動時間，核對接收區人數及通訊延遲。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Separate doorway crossing from onward movement in drills or models, checking receiving-zone occupancy and communication delays. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Separate doorway crossing from onward movement in drills or models, checking receiving-zone occupancy and communication delays. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘集水容積」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining sump volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海底排水的可靠性需連結低點集水、供電與維修隔離，假想兩台泵中一台退出時，分析淨入流與警報延遲而不把原容量沿用。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘集水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link low-point sumps, power and maintenance isolation; when one hypothetical pump is unavailable, recalculate net inflow and alarm delay rather than retaining the original capacity. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining sump volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=320 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=320 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘集水容積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Remaining sump volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積
knowledge.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume
knowledge.text: 海底排水的可靠性需連結低點集水、供電與維修隔離，假想兩台泵中一台退出時，分析淨入流與警報延遲而不把原容量沿用。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。
knowledge.textEn: Link low-point sumps, power and maintenance isolation; when one hypothetical pump is unavailable, recalculate net inflow and alarm delay rather than retaining the original capacity. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" is correct?
options: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
海底排水的可靠性需連結低點集水、供電與維修隔離，假想兩台泵中一台退出時，分析淨入流與警報延遲而不把原容量沿用。
optionsEn: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Link low-point sumps, power and maintenance isolation.
quiz.explanation: 海底排水的可靠性需連結低點集水、供電與維修隔離，假想兩台泵中一台退出時，分析淨入流與警報延遲而不把原容量沿用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Link low-point sumps, power and maintenance isolation; when one hypothetical pump is unavailable, recalculate net inflow and alarm delay rather than retaining the original capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘集水容積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining sump volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=320 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為25.5183 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=320 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 25.5183 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outage buffer and effective sump volume", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=320 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=320 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=320 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=320 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=28.0702 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘集水容積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining sump volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名義備泵若共用堵塞出口，切換成功但水位仍升；應查管路而非反覆切換泵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A spare sharing a blocked outlet can transfer successfully while water keeps rising; diagnose the route instead of repeatedly switching pumps. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outage buffer and effective sump volume"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 將水位上升曲線與當時泵啟停、閥位及出水流量同步，區分閥路阻塞和機械輸出不足。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise level rise with pump state, valves and discharge, distinguishing blocked routing from deficient mechanical output. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘集水容積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining sump volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義備泵若共用堵塞出口，切換成功但水位仍升；應查管路而非反覆切換泵。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A spare sharing a blocked outlet can transfer successfully while water keeps rising; diagnose the route instead of repeatedly switching pumps. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名義備泵若共用堵塞出口，切換成功但水位仍升；應查管路而非反覆切換泵。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。
knowledge.textEn: A spare sharing a blocked outlet can transfer successfully while water keeps rising; diagnose the route instead of repeatedly switching pumps. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
名義備泵若共用堵塞出口，切換成功但水位仍升；應查管路而非反覆切換泵。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
A spare sharing a blocked outlet can transfer successfully while water keeps rising; diagnose the route instead of repeatedly switching pumps.
quiz.explanation: 名義備泵若共用堵塞出口，切換成功但水位仍升；應查管路而非反覆切換泵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A spare sharing a blocked outlet can transfer successfully while water keeps rising; diagnose the route instead of repeatedly switching pumps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備備援與共同失效」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment redundancy and common failure" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 英法跨境服務把電力、控制、冷卻與維修責任放在多個介面，設備重複不能消除共用軟體或配電故障，需以功能可用性定義頂事件。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-border service couples power, controls, cooling and maintenance responsibilities; duplicated equipment does not eliminate shared software or distribution faults, so define top events by lost function. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.011 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.011 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 英法跨境服務把電力、控制、冷卻與維修責任放在多個介面，設備重複不能消除共用軟體或配電故障，需以功能可用性定義頂事件。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-border service couples power, controls, cooling and maintenance responsibilities; duplicated equipment does not eliminate shared software or distribution faults, so define top events by lost function. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 英法跨境服務把電力、控制、冷卻與維修責任放在多個介面，設備重複不能消除共用軟體或配電故障，需以功能可用性定義頂事件。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Cross-border service couples power, controls, cooling and maintenance responsibilities.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 英法跨境服務把電力、控制、冷卻與維修責任放在多個介面，設備重複不能消除共用軟體或配電故障，需以功能可用性定義頂事件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-border service couples power, controls, cooling and maintenance responsibilities; duplicated equipment does not eliminate shared software or distribution faults, so define top events by lost function. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.011 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000121 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00014641 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.011 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000121 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00014641 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從一項失去服務的事件反向追到共用電源和控制版本，再比對維修時設備是否真的獨立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace one loss-of-service event back to common supply and control revisions and test independence during maintenance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.011 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000121 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00014641 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.011 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000121 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00014641 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.011 無因次。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.011 dimensionless.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.011 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.011 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統不可用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從一項失去服務的事件反向追到共用電源和控制版本，再比對維修時設備是否真的獨立。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace one loss-of-service event back to common supply and control revisions and test independence during maintenance. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment redundancy and common failure"?

動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
