steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統不可用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System unavailability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把同一次共同電源故障拆成兩個獨立事件會嚴重低估並聯不可用率，且掩蓋責任介面。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Splitting one common-supply fault into independent events understates parallel unavailability and hides interface responsibility. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把同一次共同電源故障拆成兩個獨立事件會嚴重低估並聯不可用率，且掩蓋責任介面。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。
knowledge.textEn: Splitting one common-supply fault into independent events understates parallel unavailability and hides interface responsibility. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設備備援與共同失效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equipment redundancy and common failure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把同一次共同電源故障拆成兩個獨立事件會嚴重低估並聯不可用率，且掩蓋責任介面。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Splitting one common-supply fault into independent events understates parallel unavailability and hides interface responsibility.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 把同一次共同電源故障拆成兩個獨立事件會嚴重低估並聯不可用率，且掩蓋責任介面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Splitting one common-supply fault into independent events understates parallel unavailability and hides interface responsibility. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響英法海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Channel Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 英法長期營運需要把更新設備與原設施共同管理，資料交接必須保留新舊版本適用里程及日期，不能讓歷史趨勢因供應商更換而中斷。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term renewal requires old and new systems to coexist in records, with chainage and dates defining each revision rather than losing historical trends when suppliers change. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=101 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=101 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 英法長期營運需要把更新設備與原設施共同管理，資料交接必須保留新舊版本適用里程及日期，不能讓歷史趨勢因供應商更換而中斷。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term renewal requires old and new systems to coexist in records, with chainage and dates defining each revision rather than losing historical trends when suppliers change. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
英法長期營運需要把更新設備與原設施共同管理，資料交接必須保留新舊版本適用里程及日期，不能讓歷史趨勢因供應商更換而中斷。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Long-term renewal requires old and new systems to coexist in records, with chainage and dates defining each revision rather than losing historical trends when suppliers change.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 英法長期營運需要把更新設備與原設施共同管理，資料交接必須保留新舊版本適用里程及日期，不能讓歷史趨勢因供應商更換而中斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term renewal requires old and new systems to coexist in records, with chainage and dates defining each revision rather than losing historical trends when suppliers change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=101 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.5743 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=101 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.5743 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=101 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.5743 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=101 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.5743 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
原創教學假設：設備總數=101 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=101 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=101 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=101 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.1584 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Channel Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設備ID重用但未保留更換日期，會把新感測器的偏移解讀成隧道結構突然改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing an asset ID without replacement dates can turn a new-sensor offset into a false sudden structural change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Channel Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 抽查更換過的感測器，從現行標籤追到舊型號校正與工單，驗證量程和零點是否可比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample a replaced sensor from its current tag back to previous calibration and work orders, checking range and zero comparability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 設備ID重用但未保留更換日期，會把新感測器的偏移解讀成隧道結構突然改變。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing an asset ID without replacement dates can turn a new-sensor offset into a false sudden structural change. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 設備ID重用但未保留更換日期，會把新感測器的偏移解讀成隧道結構突然改變。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing an asset ID without replacement dates can turn a new-sensor offset into a false sudden structural change. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
設備ID重用但未保留更換日期，會把新感測器的偏移解讀成隧道結構突然改變。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reusing an asset ID without replacement dates can turn a new-sensor offset into a false sudden structural change.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 設備ID重用但未保留更換日期，會把新感測器的偏移解讀成隧道結構突然改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing an asset ID without replacement dates can turn a new-sensor offset into a false sudden structural change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 哥達基線隧道
courses.summary: 哥達基線隧道長57公里，瑞士官方記錄2016年投入營運，服務平緩跨阿爾卑斯鐵路。本進階課由牽引效益及覆土應力出發，連接支護時序、襯砌接頭、多工作面物流及精密貫通；最後比較岩體熱與列車壓力擾動，說明土建完成仍須完成系統介面驗證。
courses.summaryEn: The 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entered service in 2016 as part of Switzerland’s low-gradient transalpine railway. This advanced course connects traction benefits and cover stress to support timing, lining joints, multiple-heading logistics and precision breakthrough. It then compares rock heat and train pressure disturbances, explaining why civil completion still requires verification of operating-system interfaces.
courses.focus: 深覆土地應力、基線牽引與多工作面整合
courses.focusEn: Deep-cover stress, base-railway traction and multiple-heading integration
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.048 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=22 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為137.143 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.048 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=22 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 137.143 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 公開工程尺度約為 57 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
2016 年事件：哥達基線隧道投入營運，成為瑞士平緩跨阿爾卑斯鐵路核心。
教學「坡度阻力功率」：列車質量=1.24e+06 kg，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1216.44 kW；不是實測或允收值。
教學「洞壁切向應力」：覆土深度=560 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=43.68 MPa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「有效掘進利用率」：切削速率=1.56 m/h，其餘輸入依單元，結果=11.6064 m/day；不是實測或允收值。
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=150.857 t/h；不是實測或允收值。
factsEn: The public scale is about 57 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2016 event: Gotthard Base Tunnel enters service as a core of the Swiss low-gradient transalpine railway.
Teaching grade-resistance power: train mass=1.24e+06 kg, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1216.44 kW; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching tangential wall stress: cover=560 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 43.68 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching effective boring utilisation: active penetration=1.56 m/h, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 11.6064 m/day; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 150.857 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.

newStages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
newStages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線縱坡與牽引需求」與「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" and "Cover stress and wall redistribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達基線的低坡度目標必須和重載列車情境一起評估，減少坡度阻力不表示通風氣動與加速功率可忽略。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Assess Gotthard’s low-gradient purpose with heavy-train scenarios; reduced gravity resistance does not eliminate aerodynamic, acceleration or ventilation demands. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.24e+06 kg；縱坡=0.005 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.24e+06 kg; grade=0.005 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 哥達基線的低坡度目標必須和重載列車情境一起評估，減少坡度阻力不表示通風氣動與加速功率可忽略。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。
knowledge.textEn: Assess Gotthard’s low-gradient purpose with heavy-train scenarios; reduced gravity resistance does not eliminate aerodynamic, acceleration or ventilation demands. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?
options: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
哥達基線的低坡度目標必須和重載列車情境一起評估，減少坡度阻力不表示通風氣動與加速功率可忽略。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Assess Gotthard’s low-gradient purpose with heavy-train scenarios.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 哥達基線的低坡度目標必須和重載列車情境一起評估，減少坡度阻力不表示通風氣動與加速功率可忽略。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Assess Gotthard’s low-gradient purpose with heavy-train scenarios; reduced gravity resistance does not eliminate aerodynamic, acceleration or ventilation demands. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.24e+06 kg；縱坡=0.005 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1216.44 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1338.08 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.24e+06 kg; grade=0.005 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1216.44 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1338.08 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將同一列車在基線與假想山線上的逐段坡度功率比較，再分開制動和牽引需求。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare local grade power for one train on base and hypothetical mountain alignments, separating braking from traction. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：將同一列車在基線與假想山線上的逐段坡度功率比較，再分開制動和牽引需求。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Compare local grade power for one train on base and hypothetical mountain alignments, separating braking from traction. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只比較最高坡度而忽略長度和速度歷程，節能結論可能偏離整段旅程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing maximum grade without length and speed history can misstate whole-journey energy benefit. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只比較最高坡度而忽略長度和速度歷程，節能結論可能偏離整段旅程。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing maximum grade without length and speed history can misstate whole-journey energy benefit. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只比較最高坡度而忽略長度和速度歷程，節能結論可能偏離整段旅程。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing maximum grade without length and speed history can misstate whole-journey energy benefit. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線縱坡與牽引需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只比較最高坡度而忽略長度和速度歷程，節能結論可能偏離整段旅程。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing maximum grade without length and speed history can misstate whole-journey energy benefit.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 若只比較最高坡度而忽略長度和速度歷程，節能結論可能偏離整段旅程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing maximum grade without length and speed history can misstate whole-journey energy benefit. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達深覆土的教學模型先分開遠場應力與洞壁集中，研究同一覆土下不同水平應力比對破壞方向的影響。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate remote stress from wall concentration in deep cover and examine how different horizontal stress ratios change damage orientation at the same depth. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配
knowledge.text: 哥達深覆土的教學模型先分開遠場應力與洞壁集中，研究同一覆土下不同水平應力比對破壞方向的影響。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。
knowledge.textEn: Separate remote stress from wall concentration in deep cover and examine how different horizontal stress ratios change damage orientation at the same depth. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
哥達深覆土的教學模型先分開遠場應力與洞壁集中，研究同一覆土下不同水平應力比對破壞方向的影響。
optionsEn: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Separate remote stress from wall concentration in deep cover and examine how different horizontal stress ratios change damage orientation at the same depth.
quiz.explanation: 哥達深覆土的教學模型先分開遠場應力與洞壁集中，研究同一覆土下不同水平應力比對破壞方向的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate remote stress from wall concentration in deep cover and examine how different horizontal stress ratios change damage orientation at the same depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.048 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.048 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=560 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=560 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=43.68 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以覆土唯一決定應力會錯估側壁或拱頂哪處先受損，進而誤置觀測點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using cover alone can misidentify whether walls or crown govern and place monitoring at the wrong location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
knowledge.textEn: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 把洞壁破壞方位與原位應力及節理方向比對，測試各模型是否預測同一高需求區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare wall-damage orientation with stress and joints, testing whether alternative models predict the same critical zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以覆土唯一決定應力會錯估側壁或拱頂哪處先受損，進而誤置觀測點。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using cover alone can misidentify whether walls or crown govern and place monitoring at the wrong location. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以覆土唯一決定應力會錯估側壁或拱頂哪處先受損，進而誤置觀測點。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Using cover alone can misidentify whether walls or crown govern and place monitoring at the wrong location. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
以覆土唯一決定應力會錯估側壁或拱頂哪處先受損，進而誤置觀測點。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Using cover alone can misidentify whether walls or crown govern and place monitoring at the wrong location.
quiz.explanation: 以覆土唯一決定應力會錯估側壁或拱頂哪處先受損，進而誤置觀測點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using cover alone can misidentify whether walls or crown govern and place monitoring at the wrong location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Ring force and joint flexibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達多地質區段的支護不能只以最終厚度比較，需把安裝距離和可容許變形納入，理解何時剛性過高反而增加局部需求。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare support across ground domains using activation distance and deformation allowance, not final thickness alone, and identify when excess stiffness increases local demand. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=32 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=32 kN/mm; movement=7 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 哥達多地質區段的支護不能只以最終厚度比較，需把安裝距離和可容許變形納入，理解何時剛性過高反而增加局部需求。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Compare support across ground domains using activation distance and deformation allowance, not final thickness alone, and identify when excess stiffness increases local demand. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 哥達多地質區段的支護不能只以最終厚度比較，需把安裝距離和可容許變形納入，理解何時剛性過高反而增加局部需求。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Compare support across ground domains using activation distance and deformation allowance, not final thickness alone, and identify when excess stiffness increases local demand.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 哥達多地質區段的支護不能只以最終厚度比較，需把安裝距離和可容許變形納入，理解何時剛性過高反而增加局部需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare support across ground domains using activation distance and deformation allowance, not final thickness alone, and identify when excess stiffness increases local demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=32 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=224 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為246.4 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=32 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=224 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 246.4 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=32 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=224 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為246.4 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=32 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=224 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 246.4 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：局部剛度=32 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=32 kN/mm; movement=7 mm.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=32 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=32 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同安裝時點的讀值混合會誤判材料剛度，可能把施工順序問題當材料缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing activation times biases inferred stiffness and can misclassify a sequence problem as a material defect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections.
quiz.explanation: 按掌子面距離重排收斂與荷重資料，檢查不同區段能否用同一支護曲線解釋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replot convergence and load against face distance, testing whether one support curve explains different sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把不同安裝時點的讀值混合會誤判材料剛度，可能把施工順序問題當材料缺陷。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing activation times biases inferred stiffness and can misclassify a sequence problem as a material defect. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同安裝時點的讀值混合會誤判材料剛度，可能把施工順序問題當材料缺陷。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing activation times biases inferred stiffness and can misclassify a sequence problem as a material defect. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把不同安裝時點的讀值混合會誤判材料剛度，可能把施工順序問題當材料缺陷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Mixing activation times biases inferred stiffness and can misclassify a sequence problem as a material defect.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 把不同安裝時點的讀值混合會誤判材料剛度，可能把施工順序問題當材料缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing activation times biases inferred stiffness and can misclassify a sequence problem as a material defect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長基線隧道的襯砌須接收地盤、水壓及施工頂推等不同作用，哥達情境比較均勻外壓估算與接頭局部彎曲，避免只用厚度判斷可靠性。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For the long base-tunnel context, compare uniform-pressure lining estimates with local joint bending under ground, water and construction actions rather than judging reliability by thickness alone. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.34 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.34 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 長基線隧道的襯砌須接收地盤、水壓及施工頂推等不同作用，哥達情境比較均勻外壓估算與接頭局部彎曲，避免只用厚度判斷可靠性。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: For the long base-tunnel context, compare uniform-pressure lining estimates with local joint bending under ground, water and construction actions rather than judging reliability by thickness alone. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
長基線隧道的襯砌須接收地盤、水壓及施工頂推等不同作用，哥達情境比較均勻外壓估算與接頭局部彎曲，避免只用厚度判斷可靠性。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
For the long base-tunnel context, compare uniform-pressure lining estimates with local joint bending under ground, water and construction actions rather than judging reliability by thickness alone.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 長基線隧道的襯砌須接收地盤、水壓及施工頂推等不同作用，哥達情境比較均勻外壓估算與接頭局部彎曲，避免只用厚度判斷可靠性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For the long base-tunnel context, compare uniform-pressure lining estimates with local joint bending under ground, water and construction actions rather than judging reliability by thickness alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.34 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.52629 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.34 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.52629 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.34 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.52629 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.34 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.52629 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。

optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.34 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=3.20571 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.34 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同平均應變可能掩蓋一處接縫轉動集中，局部防水需求會比整環平均更不利。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Identical mean strain can hide concentrated rotation at one joint with worse local sealing demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
