quiz.question: 要驗證「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 量測環向變形及接縫開口，將背填和水頭回升階段分開，再對照接頭剛度敏感度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure ring distortion and joint gaps by grouting and head-recovery stage, comparing joint-stiffness sensitivity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同平均應變可能掩蓋一處接縫轉動集中，局部防水需求會比整環平均更不利。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Identical mean strain can hide concentrated rotation at one joint with worse local sealing demand. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相同平均應變可能掩蓋一處接縫轉動集中，局部防水需求會比整環平均更不利。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。
knowledge.textEn: Identical mean strain can hide concentrated rotation at one joint with worse local sealing demand. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
相同平均應變可能掩蓋一處接縫轉動集中，局部防水需求會比整環平均更不利。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Identical mean strain can hide concentrated rotation at one joint with worse local sealing demand.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 相同平均應變可能掩蓋一處接縫轉動集中，局部防水需求會比整環平均更不利。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Identical mean strain can hide concentrated rotation at one joint with worse local sealing demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「掘進利用率與設備停時」與「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" and "Shared access and transport bottlenecks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective boring utilisation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達施工循環可用來分離切削速率與多工作面的有效利用率，並追問刀具維修時間是否隨地質而改變，不能用最佳單班外推整段工期。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate cutting rate from multi-heading utilisation and test whether cutter maintenance changes with geology; a best shift cannot be extrapolated to the whole drive. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.56 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.56 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效掘進利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective boring utilisation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時
knowledge.text: 哥達施工循環可用來分離切削速率與多工作面的有效利用率，並追問刀具維修時間是否隨地質而改變，不能用最佳單班外推整段工期。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。
knowledge.textEn: Separate cutting rate from multi-heading utilisation and test whether cutter maintenance changes with geology; a best shift cannot be extrapolated to the whole drive. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「掘進利用率與設備停時」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" is correct?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
哥達施工循環可用來分離切削速率與多工作面的有效利用率，並追問刀具維修時間是否隨地質而改變，不能用最佳單班外推整段工期。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Separate cutting rate from multi-heading utilisation and test whether cutter maintenance changes with geology.
quiz.explanation: 哥達施工循環可用來分離切削速率與多工作面的有效利用率，並追問刀具維修時間是否隨地質而改變，不能用最佳單班外推整段工期。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate cutting rate from multi-heading utilisation and test whether cutter maintenance changes with geology; a best shift cannot be extrapolated to the whole drive. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效掘進利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective boring utilisation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.56 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。D=24vu=11.6064 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.767 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.56 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.6064 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.767 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.56 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。D=24vu=11.6064 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.767 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.56 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.6064 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.767 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「掘進利用率與設備停時」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.56 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.56 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.56 m/h；有效利用率=0.31 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.56 m/h; utilisation=0.31 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效掘進利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective boring utilisation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把換刀和出渣重疊時間加兩次會低估利用率，錯誤地支持增購機械的決策。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counting overlapping cutter and spoil delays understates utilisation and can falsely justify more machinery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：以完整停時分類配對地質及刀具檢查，另用班次時間閉合檢查有無重複計時。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
knowledge.textEn: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Pair downtime classes with geology and cutter inspections, closing shift time to detect double-counting. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掘進利用率與設備停時」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime"?

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把換刀和出渣重疊時間加兩次會低估利用率，錯誤地支持增購機械的決策。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counting overlapping cutter and spoil delays understates utilisation and can falsely justify more machinery. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把換刀和出渣重疊時間加兩次會低估利用率，錯誤地支持增購機械的決策。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counting overlapping cutter and spoil delays understates utilisation and can falsely justify more machinery. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
把換刀和出渣重疊時間加兩次會低估利用率，錯誤地支持增購機械的決策。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Double-counting overlapping cutter and spoil delays understates utilisation and can falsely justify more machinery.
quiz.explanation: 把換刀和出渣重疊時間加兩次會低估利用率，錯誤地支持增購機械的決策。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counting overlapping cutter and spoil delays understates utilisation and can falsely justify more machinery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達多工作面共用後勤的教學重點是串聯瓶頸，豎井、連絡通道和卸料區的能力不能在不同時間假設下相加。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The multiple-heading context highlights serial logistics bottlenecks: shafts, connecting galleries and unloading areas cannot be combined using inconsistent time assumptions. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=22 t；往返週期=35 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=22 t; cycle=35 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 哥達多工作面共用後勤的教學重點是串聯瓶頸，豎井、連絡通道和卸料區的能力不能在不同時間假設下相加。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: The multiple-heading context highlights serial logistics bottlenecks: shafts, connecting galleries and unloading areas cannot be combined using inconsistent time assumptions. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 哥達多工作面共用後勤的教學重點是串聯瓶頸，豎井、連絡通道和卸料區的能力不能在不同時間假設下相加。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: The multiple-heading context highlights serial logistics bottlenecks: shafts, connecting galleries and unloading areas cannot be combined using inconsistent time assumptions.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 哥達多工作面共用後勤的教學重點是串聯瓶頸，豎井、連絡通道和卸料區的能力不能在不同時間假設下相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The multiple-heading context highlights serial logistics bottlenecks: shafts, connecting galleries and unloading areas cannot be combined using inconsistent time assumptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=22 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為137.143 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=22 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=150.857 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 137.143 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對同一日逐小時建立材料和出渣需求表，核對維修時段是否同步占用共用運輸節點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build hourly material and spoil demand for the same day and identify maintenance overlap at shared transport nodes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 137.143 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對同一日逐小時建立材料和出渣需求表，核對維修時段是否同步占用共用運輸節點。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build hourly material and spoil demand for the same day and identify maintenance overlap at shared transport nodes. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：對同一日逐小時建立材料和出渣需求表，核對維修時段是否同步占用共用運輸節點。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Build hourly material and spoil demand for the same day and identify maintenance overlap at shared transport nodes. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各面個別達成計畫但共同卸料區壅塞時，整體進度仍可能失守，應由網路而非單面診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Faces may meet local plans while shared unloading congestion defeats overall progress, requiring a network-level diagnosis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 各面個別達成計畫但共同卸料區壅塞時，整體進度仍可能失守，應由網路而非單面診斷。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Faces may meet local plans while shared unloading congestion defeats overall progress, requiring a network-level diagnosis. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 各面個別達成計畫但共同卸料區壅塞時，整體進度仍可能失守，應由網路而非單面診斷。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Faces may meet local plans while shared unloading congestion defeats overall progress, requiring a network-level diagnosis. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 各面個別達成計畫但共同卸料區壅塞時，整體進度仍可能失守，應由網路而非單面診斷。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Faces may meet local plans while shared unloading congestion defeats overall progress, requiring a network-level diagnosis.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 各面個別達成計畫但共同卸料區壅塞時，整體進度仍可能失守，應由網路而非單面診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Faces may meet local plans while shared unloading congestion defeats overall progress, requiring a network-level diagnosis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與貫通誤差」與「熱源分配與空氣顯熱」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control network and breakthrough error" and "Heat sources and sensible-air removal": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達長距離貫通要區分方向傳遞、尺度及高程三類誤差，地下兩組控制網即使互相閉合，也可能共用同一錯誤地表基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish orientation, scale and elevation errors over long breakthrough distances; two underground networks can close while sharing a wrong surface datum. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=3240 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3240 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 哥達長距離貫通要區分方向傳遞、尺度及高程三類誤差，地下兩組控制網即使互相閉合，也可能共用同一錯誤地表基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish orientation, scale and elevation errors over long breakthrough distances; two underground networks can close while sharing a wrong surface datum. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
哥達長距離貫通要區分方向傳遞、尺度及高程三類誤差，地下兩組控制網即使互相閉合，也可能共用同一錯誤地表基準。
只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Distinguish orientation, scale and elevation errors over long breakthrough distances; two underground networks can close while sharing a wrong surface datum.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 哥達長距離貫通要區分方向傳遞、尺度及高程三類誤差，地下兩組控制網即使互相閉合，也可能共用同一錯誤地表基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish orientation, scale and elevation errors over long breakthrough distances; two underground networks can close while sharing a wrong surface datum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=3240 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0449248 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3240 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0449248 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3240 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0449248 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3240 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0449248 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
原創教學假設：控制長度=3240 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=3240 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3240 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3240 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0408407 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報一個三維閉合量會掩蓋高程方向的系統偏差，使軌道銜接問題延後暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One three-dimensional closure magnitude can hide a systematic height bias until track connection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 獨立重算地表至各工作面的轉換，對照原始角距和不同環境條件量測，保留誤差相關性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Independently recompute transformations to each heading using raw observations under different conditions, retaining error correlations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報一個三維閉合量會掩蓋高程方向的系統偏差，使軌道銜接問題延後暴露。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One three-dimensional closure magnitude can hide a systematic height bias until track connection. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報一個三維閉合量會掩蓋高程方向的系統偏差，使軌道銜接問題延後暴露。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: One three-dimensional closure magnitude can hide a systematic height bias until track connection. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One three-dimensional closure magnitude can hide a systematic height bias until track connection.
Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude.
quiz.explanation: 只報一個三維閉合量會掩蓋高程方向的系統偏差，使軌道銜接問題延後暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One three-dimensional closure magnitude can hide a systematic height bias until track connection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Heat sources and sensible-air removal: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風顯熱量」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation sensible heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達深部岩體放熱與列車或施工機械熱源時間尺度不同，需比較穩態空氣熱帳與長期岩體溫度演化，避免把短時試驗當全年能力。深部岩體、列車和機械會向空氣持續放熱，空氣帶走的顯熱由質量流量與溫升決定。相同體積風量在不同密度下不具有相同散熱能力；濕度、岩體瞬變及水冷系統還需分開記帳，單一穩態熱平衡不能預測全部溫度尖峰。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風顯熱量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deep-rock heat evolves on a different timescale from trains or machinery; compare air balances with longer rock-temperature evolution rather than treating short trials as year-round capability. Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise. Equal volumetric flow at different density does not provide equal cooling. Moisture, transient rock heat and water cooling need separate accounts; a steady balance cannot predict every temperature peak or local worker exposure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation sensible heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=84 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=15 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; volume flow=84 m³/s; specific heat=1.005 kJ/(kg·K); temperature rise=15 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal volumetric airflow provides identical cooling at every altitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風顯熱量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要體積風量相同，不同海拔的空氣散熱量一定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heat sources and sensible-air removal: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風顯熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation sensible heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=84 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=15 K。Q=ρVcpΔT=1519.56 kW。僅把體積風量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1671.52 kW。邊界：僅空氣顯熱，不含濕度潛熱及岩體瞬變；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; volume flow=84 m³/s; specific heat=1.005 kJ/(kg·K); temperature rise=15 K. Q=ρVcpΔT=1519.56 kW. Increasing only volume flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1671.52 kW. Boundary: Sensible air heat only, excluding latent heat and rock transients. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將岩壁溫度、風量及機械負載分別保存，檢查停工降溫是否真的代表岩體熱源已消失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain wall temperature, airflow and machine load separately and test whether shutdown cooling truly indicates reduced rock heat.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；體積風量=84 m³/s；定壓比熱=1.005 kJ/(kg·K)；溫升=15 K。Q=ρVcpΔT=1519.56 kW。僅把體積風量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1671.52 kW。邊界：僅空氣顯熱，不含濕度潛熱及岩體瞬變；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only volume flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1671.52 kW. Boundary: Sensible air heat only, excluding latent heat and rock transients. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「熱源分配與空氣顯熱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 熱源分配與空氣顯熱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heat sources and sensible-air removal: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風顯熱量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation sensible heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將岩壁溫度、風量及機械負載分別保存，檢查停工降溫是否真的代表岩體熱源已消失。同步量測進出口溫濕度、風量及設備負載，分開平均與尖峰時段，用能量收支殘差檢查漏列熱源。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain wall temperature, airflow and machine load separately and test whether shutdown cooling truly indicates reduced rock heat. Synchronise inlet/outlet temperature, humidity, flow and equipment load, separate average and peak periods, and use energy residuals to identify missing sources. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「通風顯熱量」的交付需回答：將岩壁溫度、風量及機械負載分別保存，檢查停工降溫是否真的代表岩體熱源已消失。熱帳分別列岩體、交通、機械與水冷路徑，交接時保存季節和負載範圍，設備增設前須重新核對可用散熱能力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the ventilation sensible heat handover must address the following evidence: Retain wall temperature, airflow and machine load separately and test whether shutdown cooling truly indicates reduced rock heat. Keep rock, traffic, machinery and water-cooling paths separate; retain seasonal and load ranges and reassess cooling capacity before adding equipment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：停機後空氣迅速降溫但岩體仍持續放熱，重新載入時可能很快回到高溫，需辨認熱儲存。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Air cools quickly after shutdown while rock retains heat, so renewed loading can rapidly restore high temperatures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風顯熱量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 停機後空氣迅速降溫但岩體仍持續放熱，重新載入時可能很快回到高溫，需辨認熱儲存。把低密度空氣視為海平面空氣會高估散熱，局部熱點也可能被斷面平均溫度掩蓋，導致設備或工作環境超限。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

newStages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車壓力波與動壓量級」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口壓力擾動」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Portal pressure disturbance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達高速鐵路的氣動檢核需配對列車編組、速度及隧道斷面，對向交會與門位改變會產生不同壓力歷程，不能只看動壓比例。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口壓力擾動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pair formation, speed and cross-section for aerodynamic assessment; encounters and door states produce different pressure histories beyond simple dynamic-pressure scaling. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Portal pressure disturbance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=42 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=42 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口壓力擾動」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Portal pressure disturbance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口壓力擾動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Portal pressure disturbance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=42 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1280.66 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=42 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1280.66 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=42 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1280.66 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=42 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1058.4 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1280.66 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車壓力波與動壓量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale", which statement holds?

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口壓力擾動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Portal pressure disturbance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯誤邊界可能碰巧擬合最大值卻錯估升壓速率，設備承受的循環需求仍會不正確。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect boundary may match the peak accidentally while misrepresenting rise rate and cyclic equipment demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。

Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Record wave arrival at multiple chainages and use propagation and reflection timing to test boundaries rather than fitting peaks alone.
quiz.explanation: 在不同里程同步記錄壓力波抵達時間，以傳播時間和反射時刻檢查模型邊界，而非只擬合峰值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口壓力擾動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Portal pressure disturbance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯誤邊界可能碰巧擬合最大值卻錯估升壓速率，設備承受的循環需求仍會不正確。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect boundary may match the peak accidentally while misrepresenting rise rate and cyclic equipment demand. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錯誤邊界可能碰巧擬合最大值卻錯估升壓速率，設備承受的循環需求仍會不正確。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。
knowledge.textEn: An incorrect boundary may match the peak accidentally while misrepresenting rise rate and cyclic equipment demand. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「列車壓力波與動壓量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
