steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響哥達基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Gotthard Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 哥達交付從多個施工面整併成一個鐵路資產系統，需把不同承包界面、材料批次及試運轉版本連到同一里程，避免資料在土建與機電間斷裂。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate multiple construction fronts into one railway asset system, linking contract interfaces, batches and commissioning revisions to chainage so civil and systems evidence remain connected. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=102 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=102 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 哥達交付從多個施工面整併成一個鐵路資產系統，需把不同承包界面、材料批次及試運轉版本連到同一里程，避免資料在土建與機電間斷裂。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate multiple construction fronts into one railway asset system, linking contract interfaces, batches and commissioning revisions to chainage so civil and systems evidence remain connected. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
哥達交付從多個施工面整併成一個鐵路資產系統，需把不同承包界面、材料批次及試運轉版本連到同一里程，避免資料在土建與機電間斷裂。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Integrate multiple construction fronts into one railway asset system, linking contract interfaces, batches and commissioning revisions to chainage so civil and systems evidence remain connected.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 哥達交付從多個施工面整併成一個鐵路資產系統，需把不同承包界面、材料批次及試運轉版本連到同一里程，避免資料在土建與機電間斷裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate multiple construction fronts into one railway asset system, linking contract interfaces, batches and commissioning revisions to chainage so civil and systems evidence remain connected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=102 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.7451 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=102 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.7451 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=102 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.7451 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=102 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.7451 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
原創教學假設：設備總數=102 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=102 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=102 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=102 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.3137 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各標段檔案各自完整但里程原點不同，會讓相鄰設備對不上圖面，維修隔離可能定位錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Complete contract files with inconsistent chainage origins can mislocate adjacent assets and maintenance isolation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Gotthard Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 抽查一段軌道附近設備，將竣工位置、供電路徑和控制版本追至對應施工及試驗紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample equipment near one track section and trace position, supply and control revision to construction and commissioning records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 各標段檔案各自完整但里程原點不同，會讓相鄰設備對不上圖面，維修隔離可能定位錯誤。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Complete contract files with inconsistent chainage origins can mislocate adjacent assets and maintenance isolation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 各標段檔案各自完整但里程原點不同，會讓相鄰設備對不上圖面，維修隔離可能定位錯誤。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Complete contract files with inconsistent chainage origins can mislocate adjacent assets and maintenance isolation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
各標段檔案各自完整但里程原點不同，會讓相鄰設備對不上圖面，維修隔離可能定位錯誤。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Complete contract files with inconsistent chainage origins can mislocate adjacent assets and maintenance isolation.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 各標段檔案各自完整但里程原點不同，會讓相鄰設備對不上圖面，維修隔離可能定位錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Complete contract files with inconsistent chainage origins can mislocate adjacent assets and maintenance isolation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 勒奇山基線隧道
courses.summary: 勒奇山案例的核心不是單純延長隧道，而是已營運路線如何面對分期建造留下的容量與介面限制。BLS公開資料將其描述為約35公里的基線隧道；本課把未裝設段、單線衝突、維修窗口、出水與施工隔離分開，逐步建立可供營運和擴建共同審查的證據鏈。
courses.summaryEn: The Lotschberg case concerns the capacity and interfaces left by staged construction rather than length alone. BLS describes an approximately 35 km base tunnel. This course separates unfinished bore sections, single-track conflicts, maintenance windows, water conditions and construction isolation, building an evidence chain that operations and expansion teams can review together.
courses.focus: 分期雙孔、混合交通容量與營運中擴建
courses.focusEn: Staged twin bores, mixed-traffic capacity and expansion beside operations
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為143.377 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=157.714 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 143.377 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「單線瓶頸與時距容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。
單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity.
One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
quiz.explanation: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.52 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.52 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.52 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.52 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。
單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities.
One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.

quiz.explanationEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區段占用時間」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section occupation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。一段單線或共用道岔會把連續鐵路變成受時間窗限制的系統，清空時間與衝突進路和列車行走時間同樣重要。單方向理論容量只提供上界比較；雙向交會、延誤傳播及維修封鎖會改變可實現班次，必須在共同時距圖中檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段占用時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. A single-track section or shared turnout creates time-window constraints, making clearance and conflicting routes as important as travel time. One-direction theoretical capacity gives only a comparison bound. Opposing movements, propagated delays and maintenance closures alter achievable service and must be examined together on a common timetable diagram. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section occupation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段占用時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Section occupation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。一段單線或共用道岔會把連續鐵路變成受時間窗限制的系統，清空時間與衝突進路和列車行走時間同樣重要。
knowledge.textEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. A single-track section or shared turnout creates time-window constraints, making clearance and conflicting routes as important as travel time.

knowledge.text: 誤解：單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity" is correct?
options: 單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。
optionsEn: One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic.
quiz.explanation: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區段占用時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section occupation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單線瓶頸與時距容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「區段占用時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section occupation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。從列車通過與路線釋放時間戳重建占用，對照進路衝突表，再測試一班延誤如何影響後續交會而非只看平均準點。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Reconstruct occupation from passage and release timestamps, compare the route-conflict table and test how one delay affects subsequent meets. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the section occupation time handover must address the following evidence: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Capacity reports include conflicting routes, train performance and maintenance windows; operations validates additions with replayable timetables rather than one hourly figure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the section occupation time handover must address the following evidence: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Capacity reports include conflicting routes, train performance and maintenance windows; operations validates additions with replayable timetables rather than one hourly figure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.26e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0054 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1468.44 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.26e+06 kg; grade=0.0054 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1334.94 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1468.44 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對縱斷面坡度符號、列車質量和同速區段的功率。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check gradient sign, train mass and power over equal-speed sections. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下坡回生未計效率時可能被當作全部可回收能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring regenerative efficiency can overstate recoverable downhill energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下坡回生未計效率時可能被當作全部可回收能量。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring regenerative efficiency can overstate recoverable downhill energy. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線縱坡與牽引需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 勒奇山擴建的教學模型保留營運孔排水與新開挖孔之間的水力連通，檢查新排水是否改變既有孔外壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain hydraulic connectivity between the operating bore and a hypothetical new heading, testing whether new drainage changes pressure around the existing bore. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為485.595 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 485.595 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為485.595 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 485.595 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=45 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=45 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=441.45 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 配對兩孔水頭與出流歷線，標示新孔施工事件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair both-bore heads and flows against new-heading construction events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 共同水頭下降不應被誤判為兩套排水設備同時改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared drawdown should not be mistaken for independent improvement of both drainage systems. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Shared access and transport bottlenecks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 在未完成洞段重新進場的情境中，分析舊支護齡期、暴露環境與新開挖釋放的疊加，不直接沿用原施工期參數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For re-entry to an unfinished section, examine aged support, exposure and renewed excavation release rather than reusing original construction parameters unchanged. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=297 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為326.7 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=297 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 326.7 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=33 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=297 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為326.7 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=297 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 326.7 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=33 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將舊裂縫圖與新收斂基線配對，區分既有和新增變形。

Pair legacy crack maps with a new convergence baseline to distinguish old and new movement.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 把舊裂縫全部視為新施工所致會誤導支護判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing all old cracks to new works misdirects support interpretation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 營運旁擴建需要共用入口時，列車、材料與維修人員各自占用時間，不能假設夜間窗口全供出渣。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When expansion shares access with operations, trains, materials and maintainers each occupy time; a night window is not entirely available for spoil transport. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=23 t；往返週期=35 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=23 t; cycle=35 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
