quiz.explanationEn: State hypothetical mass and speed explicitly against the gradient used. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 坡度功率相近不代表不同車種可互換通行條件。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Similar grade power does not make different vehicle operating envelopes interchangeable. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 坡度功率相近不代表不同車種可互換通行條件。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。
knowledge.textEn: Similar grade power does not make different vehicle operating envelopes interchangeable. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線縱坡與牽引需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 坡度功率相近不代表不同車種可互換通行條件。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Similar grade power does not make different vehicle operating envelopes interchangeable.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 坡度功率相近不代表不同車種可互換通行條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Similar grade power does not make different vehicle operating envelopes interchangeable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車壓力波與動壓量級」與「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" and "Outage buffer and effective sump volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口壓力擾動」如何影響青函隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Portal pressure disturbance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seikan Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長海底鐵路的列車氣動需辨認壓力波與通風基線，教學動壓只提供速度平方的尺度。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口壓力擾動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate train pressure waves from baseline ventilation in a long subsea railway; teaching dynamic pressure provides only velocity-squared scaling. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Portal pressure disturbance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=45 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=45 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口壓力擾動」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Portal pressure disturbance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級
knowledge.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
knowledge.text: 長海底鐵路的列車氣動需辨認壓力波與通風基線，教學動壓只提供速度平方的尺度。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。
knowledge.textEn: Separate train pressure waves from baseline ventilation in a long subsea railway; teaching dynamic pressure provides only velocity-squared scaling. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" is correct?
options: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
長海底鐵路的列車氣動需辨認壓力波與通風基線，教學動壓只提供速度平方的尺度。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
Separate train pressure waves from baseline ventilation in a long subsea railway; teaching dynamic pressure provides only velocity-squared scaling.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 長海底鐵路的列車氣動需辨認壓力波與通風基線，教學動壓只提供速度平方的尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate train pressure waves from baseline ventilation in a long subsea railway; teaching dynamic pressure provides only velocity-squared scaling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口壓力擾動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Portal pressure disturbance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=45 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1470.15 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=45 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1470.15 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=45 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1470.15 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=45 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1470.15 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車壓力波與動壓量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=45 m/s。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=45 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=45 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=45 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1215 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口壓力擾動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Portal pressure disturbance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Seikan Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把慢變通風壓差納入波峰會誤判車速對波幅的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including slow ventilation pressure in the peak biases the inferred speed-wave relationship. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
knowledge.textEn: For Seikan Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale"?
options: 比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。
optionsEn: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 比較列車通過前後壓力並扣除緩慢環境漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pressure before and after passage while accounting for slow environmental drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口壓力擾動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Portal pressure disturbance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把慢變通風壓差納入波峰會誤判車速對波幅的影響。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including slow ventilation pressure in the peak biases the inferred speed-wave relationship. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把慢變通風壓差納入波峰會誤判車速對波幅的影響。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Including slow ventilation pressure in the peak biases the inferred speed-wave relationship. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「列車壓力波與動壓量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把慢變通風壓差納入波峰會誤判車速對波幅的影響。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Including slow ventilation pressure in the peak biases the inferred speed-wave relationship.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 把慢變通風壓差納入波峰會誤判車速對波幅的影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Including slow ventilation pressure in the peak biases the inferred speed-wave relationship. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘集水容積」如何影響青函隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining sump volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seikan Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 青函長期抽排情境需同時追蹤集水容量、設備可用與補注持續性，假想停電時間不是操作允許值。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘集水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track sump reserve, availability and continuing recharge in long-term drainage; a hypothetical outage duration is not an operating allowance. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining sump volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=400 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=400 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘集水容積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Remaining sump volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積
knowledge.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume
knowledge.text: 青函長期抽排情境需同時追蹤集水容量、設備可用與補注持續性，假想停電時間不是操作允許值。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。
knowledge.textEn: Track sump reserve, availability and continuing recharge in long-term drainage; a hypothetical outage duration is not an operating allowance. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" is correct?
options: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
青函長期抽排情境需同時追蹤集水容量、設備可用與補注持續性，假想停電時間不是操作允許值。
optionsEn: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Track sump reserve, availability and continuing recharge in long-term drainage; a hypothetical outage duration is not an operating allowance.
quiz.explanation: 青函長期抽排情境需同時追蹤集水容量、設備可用與補注持續性，假想停電時間不是操作允許值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Track sump reserve, availability and continuing recharge in long-term drainage; a hypothetical outage duration is not an operating allowance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘集水容積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining sump volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=400 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為31.8979 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=400 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 31.8979 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=400 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為31.8979 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=400 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 31.8979 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outage buffer and effective sump volume", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=400 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=400 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=400 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=400 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=35.0877 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘集水容積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining sump volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Seikan Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：泵運轉指示不保證實際出流，管阻變化可令流量下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A running indication does not ensure discharge when pipe resistance changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。
knowledge.textEn: For Seikan Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outage buffer and effective sump volume"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 以不同水頭下的實測泵流量核對水位上升率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check level-rise rate against measured pump delivery at different heads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘集水容積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining sump volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 泵運轉指示不保證實際出流，管阻變化可令流量下降。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A running indication does not ensure discharge when pipe resistance changes. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 泵運轉指示不保證實際出流，管阻變化可令流量下降。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。
knowledge.textEn: A running indication does not ensure discharge when pipe resistance changes. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
泵運轉指示不保證實際出流，管阻變化可令流量下降。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
A running indication does not ensure discharge when pipe resistance changes.
quiz.explanation: 泵運轉指示不保證實際出流，管阻變化可令流量下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A running indication does not ensure discharge when pipe resistance changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響青函隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seikan Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海底鐵路救援需要區分步行、列車運送與通訊延遲，青函案例的長距離使起始位置假設特別重要。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish walking, train-assisted movement and communication delay; long subsea distances make initial location assumptions particularly important. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=90 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=90 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 海底鐵路救援需要區分步行、列車運送與通訊延遲，青函案例的長距離使起始位置假設特別重要。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish walking, train-assisted movement and communication delay; long subsea distances make initial location assumptions particularly important. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 海底鐵路救援需要區分步行、列車運送與通訊延遲，青函案例的長距離使起始位置假設特別重要。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Distinguish walking, train-assisted movement and communication delay; long subsea distances make initial location assumptions particularly important.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 海底鐵路救援需要區分步行、列車運送與通訊延遲，青函案例的長距離使起始位置假設特別重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish walking, train-assisted movement and communication delay; long subsea distances make initial location assumptions particularly important. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=90 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=540 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為585 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=90 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=540 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 585 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=90 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=540 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為585 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=90 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=540 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 585 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：前置時間=90 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=90 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=90 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=90 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Seikan Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只選靠近避難點的停車位置會低估不利情境的時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting only stops near refuge points understates adverse-scenario time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
knowledge.textEn: For Seikan Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access.
quiz.explanation: 按不同停車位置重算路徑並核對實際可通行狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate routes for different stopping locations and verify usable access. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只選靠近避難點的停車位置會低估不利情境的時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting only stops near refuge points understates adverse-scenario time. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只選靠近避難點的停車位置會低估不利情境的時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting only stops near refuge points understates adverse-scenario time. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只選靠近避難點的停車位置會低估不利情境的時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Selecting only stops near refuge points understates adverse-scenario time.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 只選靠近避難點的停車位置會低估不利情境的時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Selecting only stops near refuge points understates adverse-scenario time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響青函隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seikan Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 青函長期營運資料用來建立滲漏點到設備工單的關聯，區分季節水量、測器漂移與病害擴張。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link leakage locations to maintenance records, distinguishing seasonal flow, sensor drift and expanding defects in long-term operation. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=105 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=105 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 青函長期營運資料用來建立滲漏點到設備工單的關聯，區分季節水量、測器漂移與病害擴張。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Link leakage locations to maintenance records, distinguishing seasonal flow, sensor drift and expanding defects in long-term operation. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
青函長期營運資料用來建立滲漏點到設備工單的關聯，區分季節水量、測器漂移與病害擴張。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Link leakage locations to maintenance records, distinguishing seasonal flow, sensor drift and expanding defects in long-term operation.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 青函長期營運資料用來建立滲漏點到設備工單的關聯，區分季節水量、測器漂移與病害擴張。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Link leakage locations to maintenance records, distinguishing seasonal flow, sensor drift and expanding defects in long-term operation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=105 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.2381 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=105 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.2381 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=105 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.2381 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=105 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.2381 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
原創教學假設：設備總數=105 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=105 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=105 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=105 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.7619 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Seikan Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位置編碼改版未對照會把同一漏點誤認成多個新缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unmapped identifier changes make one leak appear to be several new defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Seikan Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 抽查同一里程多年照片、流量和修繕前後紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample multi-year photographs, flows and repair histories at one chainage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位置編碼改版未對照會把同一漏點誤認成多個新缺陷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unmapped identifier changes make one leak appear to be several new defects. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 位置編碼改版未對照會把同一漏點誤認成多個新缺陷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Unmapped identifier changes make one leak appear to be several new defects. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
位置編碼改版未對照會把同一漏點誤認成多個新缺陷。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unmapped identifier changes make one leak appear to be several new defects.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 位置編碼改版未對照會把同一漏點誤認成多個新缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unmapped identifier changes make one leak appear to be several new defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 費馬恩海峽沉管隧道
courses.summary: 費馬恩海峽的官方工程頁列18公里沉管隧道，並記載2020年開始施工。本課以跨國道路鐵路共同走廊為背景，逐步檢查箱體量產、重量帳、海床支承、止水接頭和設備交付。未來營運效益與施工進度分開表述，不把建設中的設施描述為已完成營運。
courses.summaryEn: The official Fehmarnbelt project page describes an 18 km immersed tunnel and construction beginning in 2020. Using a cross-border road and rail corridor, this course examines element production, mass balance, seabed support, sealing and equipment handover. Future service benefits remain separate from construction progress; the facility is not described as already operational.
courses.focus: 沉管量產、浮運落底與框架接頭
courses.focusEn: Element production, immersion and frame joints
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「矩形沉管的框架受力」，再獨立計算「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」。原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為39.0202 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate rectangular immersed-box frame action, then independently calculate joint compression and sealing envelope. Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 39.0202 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
