stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「矩形沉管的框架受力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Rectangular immersed-box frame action": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 費馬恩同時服務道路與鐵路，教學比較先固定兩端接線，分開道路車程、列車時間及施工海域範圍。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because Fehmarnbelt carries road and rail, fix approach endpoints and separate road travel, rail travel and the marine construction boundary. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=14.4 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.4 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 費馬恩同時服務道路與鐵路，教學比較先固定兩端接線，分開道路車程、列車時間及施工海域範圍。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Because Fehmarnbelt carries road and rail, fix approach endpoints and separate road travel, rail travel and the marine construction boundary. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
費馬恩同時服務道路與鐵路，教學比較先固定兩端接線，分開道路車程、列車時間及施工海域範圍。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Because Fehmarnbelt carries road and rail, fix approach endpoints and separate road travel, rail travel and the marine construction boundary.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
quiz.explanation: 費馬恩同時服務道路與鐵路，教學比較先固定兩端接線，分開道路車程、列車時間及施工海域範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Because Fehmarnbelt carries road and rail, fix approach endpoints and separate road travel, rail travel and the marine construction boundary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=14.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為15.84 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 15.84 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=14.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為15.84 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 15.84 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
原創教學假設：長度=14.4 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Original teaching assumptions: length=14.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.4 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=14.4 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.4 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把鐵路節時套到道路會混淆接線與停站條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying rail time savings to roads mixes approach and stopping conditions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把鐵路節時套到道路會混淆接線與停站條件。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying rail time savings to roads mixes approach and stopping conditions. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把鐵路節時套到道路會混淆接線與停站條件。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Applying rail time savings to roads mixes approach and stopping conditions. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把鐵路節時套到道路會混淆接線與停站條件。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying rail time savings to roads mixes approach and stopping conditions.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
quiz.explanation: 把鐵路節時套到道路會混淆接線與停站條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying rail time savings to roads mixes approach and stopping conditions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂板跨中彎矩」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof-span bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 費馬恩沉管採矩形箱體的教學剖面，研究中牆將頂板分跨後的框架作用，明確排除圓形薄環替代。矩形沉管的頂板、側牆與中牆透過框架連續性傳遞水土壓力，不能套圓形薄環的膜應力。單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂板跨中彎矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a rectangular immersed-box teaching section and examine how internal walls divide roof spans and create frame action, excluding thin-ring substitution. A rectangular immersed tube transfers water and earth pressure through roof, walls and internal partitions acting as a frame. A circular thin-ring membrane formula is inappropriate. A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof-span bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂板跨中彎矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Roof-span bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力
knowledge.text: 費馬恩沉管採矩形箱體的教學剖面，研究中牆將頂板分跨後的框架作用，明確排除圓形薄環替代。矩形沉管的頂板、側牆與中牆透過框架連續性傳遞水土壓力，不能套圓形薄環的膜應力。
knowledge.textEn: Use a rectangular immersed-box teaching section and examine how internal walls divide roof spans and create frame action, excluding thin-ring substitution. A rectangular immersed tube transfers water and earth pressure through roof, walls and internal partitions acting as a frame.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「矩形沉管的框架受力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rectangular immersed-box frame action" is correct?
options: 矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
費馬恩沉管採矩形箱體的教學剖面，研究中牆將頂板分跨後的框架作用，明確排除圓形薄環替代。
optionsEn: A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Use a rectangular immersed-box teaching section and examine how internal walls divide roof spans and create frame action, excluding thin-ring substitution.
quiz.explanation: 費馬恩沉管採矩形箱體的教學剖面，研究中牆將頂板分跨後的框架作用，明確排除圓形薄環替代。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a rectangular immersed-box teaching section and examine how internal walls divide roof spans and create frame action, excluding thin-ring substitution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂板跨中彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof-span bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為39.0202 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 39.0202 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為39.0202 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 39.0202 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「矩形沉管的框架受力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rectangular immersed-box frame action", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂板跨中彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof-span bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。比對頂板及中牆應變，使用含支承剛度的框架模型核對彎矩分配，將落底前後量測分開。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Compare roof and partition strain with a frame model including support stiffness, keeping measurements before and after bedding separate. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「頂板跨中彎矩」的交付需回答：比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。把單條帶、整體框架及接頭模型分開提交，標註適用施工階段和受力方向，保留裂縫及水密試驗的獨立判定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the roof-span bending handover must address the following evidence: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Submit strip, whole-frame and joint models separately, identifying stage and load direction while retaining independent cracking and watertightness assessments.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列中牆會同時改變跨距、彎矩及接頭反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting a partition changes span, bending and joint reactions together. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。比對頂板及中牆應變，使用含支承剛度的框架模型核對彎矩分配，將落底前後量測分開。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Compare roof and partition strain with a frame model including support stiffness, keeping measurements before and after bedding separate. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「頂板跨中彎矩」的交付需回答：比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。把單條帶、整體框架及接頭模型分開提交，標註適用施工階段和受力方向，保留裂縫及水密試驗的獨立判定。
knowledge.textEn: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the roof-span bending handover must address the following evidence: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Submit strip, whole-frame and joint models separately, identifying stage and load direction while retaining independent cracking and watertightness assessments.

quiz.question: 要驗證「矩形沉管的框架受力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rectangular immersed-box frame action"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板跨中彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof-span bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列中牆會同時改變跨距、彎矩及接頭反力。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting a partition changes span, bending and joint reactions together. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏列中牆會同時改變跨距、彎矩及接頭反力。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting a partition changes span, bending and joint reactions together. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「矩形沉管的框架受力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rectangular immersed-box frame action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
漏列中牆會同時改變跨距、彎矩及接頭反力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Omitting a partition changes span, bending and joint reactions together.
quiz.explanation: 漏列中牆會同時改變跨距、彎矩及接頭反力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting a partition changes span, bending and joint reactions together. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」與「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal restraint and component cracking" and "Tow-out mass balance and stability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拘束溫度應變」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained thermal strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管節量產的混凝土溫度歷程不同於沉放後海水環境，研究早齡拘束與長期降溫的裂縫機制。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拘束溫度應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Production temperature histories differ from immersed seawater conditions; examine early restraint and later cooling as distinct cracking mechanisms. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained thermal strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=26 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=26 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=6.5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拘束溫度應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrained thermal strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫
knowledge.text: 管節量產的混凝土溫度歷程不同於沉放後海水環境，研究早齡拘束與長期降溫的裂縫機制。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。
knowledge.textEn: Production temperature histories differ from immersed seawater conditions; examine early restraint and later cooling as distinct cracking mechanisms. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained thermal strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=26 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=6.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.15 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=26 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=6.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.15 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將內外溫度、養護時間與裂縫出現日期對照。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拘束溫度應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained thermal strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將內外溫度、養護時間與裂縫出現日期對照。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare internal and surface temperatures, curing duration and crack onset. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將內外溫度、養護時間與裂縫出現日期對照。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Compare internal and surface temperatures, curing duration and crack onset. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最高溫忽略溫差及拘束，可能誤判裂縫原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Peak temperature alone misses gradients and restraint and can misdiagnose cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拘束溫度應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained thermal strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最高溫忽略溫差及拘束，可能誤判裂縫原因。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Peak temperature alone misses gradients and restraint and can misdiagnose cracks. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最高溫忽略溫差及拘束，可能誤判裂縫原因。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。
knowledge.textEn: Peak temperature alone misses gradients and restraint and can misdiagnose cracks. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.

quiz.explanationEn: Peak temperature alone misses gradients and restraint and can misdiagnose cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「剩餘浮力」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 費馬恩浮運教學情境把臨時封端、壓載和設備納入重量帳，研究同總質量但不同重心的差異。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Include temporary bulkheads, ballast and equipment in tow-out mass accounting and compare equal masses with different centres of gravity. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents. A mass balance determines net vertical force but does not establish towing stability. Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11200 m³；總質量=1.11356e+07 kg。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11200 m³；總質量=1.11356e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3378.56 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14640.4 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11200 m³; mass=1.11356e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3378.56 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14640.4 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14640.4 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tow-out mass balance and stability", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11200 m³；總質量=1.11356e+07 kg。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11200 m³; mass=1.11356e+07 kg.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11200 m³；總質量=1.11356e+07 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11200 m³; mass=1.11356e+07 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual buoyancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只增壓載而未評估偏心，可能改善重量帳卻惡化橫傾。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Added eccentric ballast can improve mass balance while worsening heel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。

Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tow-out mass balance and stability"?
options: 以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘浮力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual buoyancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只增壓載而未評估偏心，可能改善重量帳卻惡化橫傾。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Added eccentric ballast can improve mass balance while worsening heel. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只增壓載而未評估偏心，可能改善重量帳卻惡化橫傾。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Added eccentric ballast can improve mass balance while worsening heel. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tow-out mass balance and stability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只增壓載而未評估偏心，可能改善重量帳卻惡化橫傾。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Added eccentric ballast can improve mass balance while worsening heel.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 只增壓載而未評估偏心，可能改善重量帳卻惡化橫傾。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Added eccentric ballast can improve mass balance while worsening heel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基床變形與接頭轉角」與「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bedding movement and joint rotation" and "Joint compression and sealing envelope": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷梯度」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海床整平和後續回填決定沉管支承，費馬恩情境須把落底瞬間與長期固結分開。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seabed preparation and backfill determine support; distinguish first contact from long-term consolidation in the Fehmarnbelt setting. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=140 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=140 m. β=Δs/L=0.0428571 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷梯度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角
knowledge.text: 海床整平和後續回填決定沉管支承，費馬恩情境須把落底瞬間與長期固結分開。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。
knowledge.textEn: Seabed preparation and backfill determine support; distinguish first contact from long-term consolidation in the Fehmarnbelt setting. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基床變形與接頭轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bedding movement and joint rotation" is correct?
options: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
海床整平和後續回填決定沉管支承，費馬恩情境須把落底瞬間與長期固結分開。
optionsEn: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Seabed preparation and backfill determine support; distinguish first contact from long-term consolidation in the Fehmarnbelt setting.
quiz.explanation: 海床整平和後續回填決定沉管支承，費馬恩情境須把落底瞬間與長期固結分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seabed preparation and backfill determine support; distinguish first contact from long-term consolidation in the Fehmarnbelt setting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對海床測深、管節高程及回填時序。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair bathymetry, element elevation and backfill chronology. steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Pair bathymetry, element elevation and backfill chronology. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：落底後高程穩定不保證軟弱層固結已結束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stable elevation immediately after placement does not establish completed consolidation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 落底後高程穩定不保證軟弱層固結已結束。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stable elevation immediately after placement does not establish completed consolidation. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基床變形與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bedding movement and joint rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
落底後高程穩定不保證軟弱層固結已結束。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Stable elevation immediately after placement does not establish completed consolidation.
quiz.explanation: 落底後高程穩定不保證軟弱層固結已結束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable elevation immediately after placement does not establish completed consolidation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮餘量」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gasket compression reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續沉放多管節時，接頭累積方向偏差和局部止水壓縮不同，研究幾何誤差如何傳到最末接合。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Across many immersed elements, accumulated alignment error and local gasket compression differ; trace geometry into the final closure. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gasket compression reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水壓縮餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gasket compression reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Across many immersed elements, accumulated alignment error and local gasket compression differ; trace geometry into the final closure. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint compression and sealing envelope" is correct?
options: 連續沉放多管節時，接頭累積方向偏差和局部止水壓縮不同，研究幾何誤差如何傳到最末接合。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Across many immersed elements, accumulated alignment error and local gasket compression differ; trace geometry into the final closure.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 連續沉放多管節時，接頭累積方向偏差和局部止水壓縮不同，研究幾何誤差如何傳到最末接合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水壓縮餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gasket compression reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
