Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：全線位置正確仍可能有局部扭轉造成接頭漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Correct overall alignment can coexist with local twist and joint leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check whole-route coordinates separately from joint offset and compression. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
knowledge.textEn: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Check whole-route coordinates separately from joint offset and compression. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint compression and sealing envelope"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Check whole-route coordinates separately from joint offset and compression.
quiz.explanation: 分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whole-route coordinates separately from joint offset and compression. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水壓縮餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gasket compression reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 全線位置正確仍可能有局部扭轉造成接頭漏水。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Correct overall alignment can coexist with local twist and joint leakage. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 全線位置正確仍可能有局部扭轉造成接頭漏水。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。
knowledge.textEn: Correct overall alignment can coexist with local twist and joint leakage. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint compression and sealing envelope" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 全線位置正確仍可能有局部扭轉造成接頭漏水。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Correct overall alignment can coexist with local twist and joint leakage.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 全線位置正確仍可能有局部扭轉造成接頭漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Correct overall alignment can coexist with local twist and joint leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與貫通誤差」與「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control network and breakthrough error" and "Chloride transport and durability interpretation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海上定位、岸上控制與水下落底量測必須統一基準，教學中辨認潮位改正與姿態的耦合。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Marine positioning, shore control and underwater placement measurements need one reference; distinguish tidal correction from element attitude. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=3720 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3720 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 海上定位、岸上控制與水下落底量測必須統一基準，教學中辨認潮位改正與姿態的耦合。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Marine positioning, shore control and underwater placement measurements need one reference; distinguish tidal correction from element attitude. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
海上定位、岸上控制與水下落底量測必須統一基準，教學中辨認潮位改正與姿態的耦合。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Marine positioning, shore control and underwater placement measurements need one reference; distinguish tidal correction from element attitude.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 海上定位、岸上控制與水下落底量測必須統一基準，教學中辨認潮位改正與姿態的耦合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Marine positioning, shore control and underwater placement measurements need one reference; distinguish tidal correction from element attitude. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=3720 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0515803 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3720 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0515803 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3720 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0515803 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3720 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0515803 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
原創教學假設：控制長度=3720 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=3720 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3720 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3720 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：潮位基準誤差可使多個管節共同偏高而相互吻合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A tidal-datum bias can place several mutually aligned elements at the wrong elevation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 潮位基準誤差可使多個管節共同偏高而相互吻合。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A tidal-datum bias can place several mutually aligned elements at the wrong elevation. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海水環境下的費馬恩箱體耐久課題由材料傳輸和接縫路徑分開討論，不能只以平均混凝土係數代表全體。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate material transport from joint pathways in marine durability rather than representing the entire structure with one concrete coefficient. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「擴散特徵長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffusion characteristic length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Separate material transport from joint pathways in marine durability rather than representing the entire structure with one concrete coefficient. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions.

optionsEn: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「擴散特徵長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffusion characteristic length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.0759 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較未裂區與接縫鄰近區的含水和氯鹽剖面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare moisture and chloride profiles in uncracked zones and near joints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 比較未裂區與接縫鄰近區的含水和氯鹽剖面。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫快速入滲若併入材料平均值，會掩蓋局部維修需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging rapid joint ingress into bulk material hides local repair needs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
接縫快速入滲若併入材料平均值，會掩蓋局部維修需求。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Averaging rapid joint ingress into bulk material hides local repair needs.
quiz.explanation: 接縫快速入滲若併入材料平均值，會掩蓋局部維修需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaging rapid joint ingress into bulk material hides local repair needs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 道路與鐵路同走廊的應變假設不能混用，研究不同使用者、車輛和隔離狀態對通行時間的影響。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Road and rail emergency assumptions are not interchangeable; examine how users, vehicles and isolation states change movement time. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=92 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=92 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 道路與鐵路同走廊的應變假設不能混用，研究不同使用者、車輛和隔離狀態對通行時間的影響。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Road and rail emergency assumptions are not interchangeable; examine how users, vehicles and isolation states change movement time. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 道路與鐵路同走廊的應變假設不能混用，研究不同使用者、車輛和隔離狀態對通行時間的影響。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Road and rail emergency assumptions are not interchangeable; examine how users, vehicles and isolation states change movement time.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 道路與鐵路同走廊的應變假設不能混用，研究不同使用者、車輛和隔離狀態對通行時間的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Road and rail emergency assumptions are not interchangeable; examine how users, vehicles and isolation states change movement time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=92 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=542 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為587 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=92 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=542 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 587 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=92 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=542 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為587 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=92 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=542 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 587 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
原創教學假設：前置時間=92 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
optionsEn: A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=92 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=92 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=92 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用一個步速會漏掉列車下車及道路人群差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One walking speed omits detraining and road-user differences. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
knowledge.textEn: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode.
quiz.explanation: 各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用一個步速會漏掉列車下車及道路人群差異。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One walking speed omits detraining and road-user differences. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共用一個步速會漏掉列車下車及道路人群差異。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: One walking speed omits detraining and road-user differences. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 共用一個步速會漏掉列車下車及道路人群差異。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: One walking speed omits detraining and road-user differences.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 共用一個步速會漏掉列車下車及道路人群差異。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One walking speed omits detraining and road-user differences. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響費馬恩海峽沉管隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量產管節需以編號串起工廠試驗、沉放位置與營運設備，研究修訂後材料紀錄是否仍可追溯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Element identifiers must link factory tests, installed position and operational equipment after revisions to production records. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=106 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=106 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 量產管節需以編號串起工廠試驗、沉放位置與營運設備，研究修訂後材料紀錄是否仍可追溯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Element identifiers must link factory tests, installed position and operational equipment after revisions to production records. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
量產管節需以編號串起工廠試驗、沉放位置與營運設備，研究修訂後材料紀錄是否仍可追溯。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Element identifiers must link factory tests, installed position and operational equipment after revisions to production records.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 量產管節需以編號串起工廠試驗、沉放位置與營運設備，研究修訂後材料紀錄是否仍可追溯。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Element identifiers must link factory tests, installed position and operational equipment after revisions to production records. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=106 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.3962 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=106 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.3962 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=106 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.3962 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=106 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.3962 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
原創教學假設：設備總數=106 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=106 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=106 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=106 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：現場交換管節而未更新資料會使試驗證據指向錯誤位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecorded element substitution assigns test evidence to the wrong location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 現場交換管節而未更新資料會使試驗證據指向錯誤位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded element substitution assigns test evidence to the wrong location. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 現場交換管節而未更新資料會使試驗證據指向錯誤位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Unrecorded element substitution assigns test evidence to the wrong location. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
現場交換管節而未更新資料會使試驗證據指向錯誤位置。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unrecorded element substitution assigns test evidence to the wrong location.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 現場交換管節而未更新資料會使試驗證據指向錯誤位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unrecorded element substitution assigns test evidence to the wrong location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 馬爾馬拉海底隧道
courses.summary: 馬爾馬拉跨越博斯普魯斯海峽，承包商資料列沉管段1387公尺，這不是整個鐵路計畫的長度。2013年的通車背景提供都市交通與海底工程的交會案例。本課從管節浮運、基床與接頭開始，再串接鑽掘段、軌道和救援系統，強調不同結構交界的變形相容。
courses.summaryEn: Marmaray crosses the Bosphorus; contractor records identify a 1387 m immersed section, distinct from the overall railway programme. Its 2013 opening links urban transport and subsea engineering. The course follows flotation, bedding and joints into bored-tunnel transitions, track and rescue systems, emphasising compatible deformation between different structural forms.
courses.focus: 沉管與鑽掘接合、都會鐵路及水密變形
courses.focusEn: Immersed-to-bored transitions, urban rail and watertight deformation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14901.9 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0511963 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate tow-out mass balance and stability, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14901.9 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0511963 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 公開工程尺度約為 1387 m immersed section，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
2013 年事件：馬爾馬拉跨海鐵路隧道開始服務。
