stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Tow-out mass balance and stability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 馬爾馬拉沉管長度與整體通勤鐵路範圍必須分開，學員先辨認海峽段和兩側地下接線。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate the immersed crossing from the commuter-rail programme, identifying the strait section and underground approaches on both sides. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=14.8 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.8 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 馬爾馬拉沉管長度與整體通勤鐵路範圍必須分開，學員先辨認海峽段和兩側地下接線。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Separate the immersed crossing from the commuter-rail programme, identifying the strait section and underground approaches on both sides. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
馬爾馬拉沉管長度與整體通勤鐵路範圍必須分開，學員先辨認海峽段和兩側地下接線。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Separate the immersed crossing from the commuter-rail programme, identifying the strait section and underground approaches on both sides.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
quiz.explanation: 馬爾馬拉沉管長度與整體通勤鐵路範圍必須分開，學員先辨認海峽段和兩側地下接線。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate the immersed crossing from the commuter-rail programme, identifying the strait section and underground approaches on both sides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=14.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.28 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.28 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=14.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為16.28 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 16.28 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
原創教學假設：長度=14.8 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Original teaching assumptions: length=14.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.8 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=14.8 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=14.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.8 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以整線長度報沉管數量會讓造價與風險比較失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using whole-line length for immersed quantities distorts cost and risk comparisons. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 以不同顏色分列沉管、鑽掘和地面段的工程數量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate quantities for immersed, bored and surface sections in the scope register. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以整線長度報沉管數量會讓造價與風險比較失真。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using whole-line length for immersed quantities distorts cost and risk comparisons. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以整線長度報沉管數量會讓造價與風險比較失真。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Using whole-line length for immersed quantities distorts cost and risk comparisons. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以整線長度報沉管數量會讓造價與風險比較失真。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using whole-line length for immersed quantities distorts cost and risk comparisons.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
quiz.explanation: 以整線長度報沉管數量會讓造價與風險比較失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using whole-line length for immersed quantities distorts cost and risk comparisons. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘浮力」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 博斯普魯斯施工情境要求把浮運重量帳和海流作用分開，靜水浮力不足以描述拖航姿態。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate tow-out mass balance from current effects in the Bosphorus setting; still-water buoyancy cannot describe towing attitude alone. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents. A mass balance determines net vertical force but does not establish towing stability. Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘浮力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual buoyancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定
knowledge.text: 博斯普魯斯施工情境要求把浮運重量帳和海流作用分開，靜水浮力不足以描述拖航姿態。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。
knowledge.textEn: Separate tow-out mass balance from current effects in the Bosphorus setting; still-water buoyancy cannot describe towing attitude alone. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tow-out mass balance and stability" is correct?
options: 剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
博斯普魯斯施工情境要求把浮運重量帳和海流作用分開，靜水浮力不足以描述拖航姿態。
optionsEn: Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Separate tow-out mass balance from current effects in the Bosphorus setting; still-water buoyancy cannot describe towing attitude alone.
quiz.explanation: 博斯普魯斯施工情境要求把浮運重量帳和海流作用分開，靜水浮力不足以描述拖航姿態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate tow-out mass balance from current effects in the Bosphorus setting; still-water buoyancy cannot describe towing attitude alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘浮力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual buoyancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14901.9 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14901.9 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14901.9 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3438.9 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14901.9 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tow-out mass balance and stability", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11400 m³；總質量=1.13344e+07 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11400 m³; mass=1.13344e+07 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual buoyancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：靜水計算正確而忽略流向變化仍可造成偏航和接近誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Correct static buoyancy with changing currents omitted still permits yaw and approach error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。
knowledge.textEn: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tow-out mass balance and stability"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Record draught together with current, towline and tank states.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 將吃水觀測與海流、拖纜及液艙狀態同時記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record draught together with current, towline and tank states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘浮力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual buoyancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 靜水計算正確而忽略流向變化仍可造成偏航和接近誤差。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Correct static buoyancy with changing currents omitted still permits yaw and approach error. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 靜水計算正確而忽略流向變化仍可造成偏航和接近誤差。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Correct static buoyancy with changing currents omitted still permits yaw and approach error. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tow-out mass balance and stability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
靜水計算正確而忽略流向變化仍可造成偏航和接近誤差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Correct static buoyancy with changing currents omitted still permits yaw and approach error.
quiz.explanation: 靜水計算正確而忽略流向變化仍可造成偏航和接近誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Correct static buoyancy with changing currents omitted still permits yaw and approach error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「矩形沉管的框架受力」與「基床變形與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rectangular immersed-box frame action" and "Bedding movement and joint rotation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂板跨中彎矩」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof-span bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 馬爾馬拉矩形沉管頂板的分跨由內牆決定，研究鐵路淨空與結構牆位置之間的協調。矩形沉管的頂板、側牆與中牆透過框架連續性傳遞水土壓力，不能套圓形薄環的膜應力。單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂板跨中彎矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal walls define roof spans in a rectangular tube; examine coordination between railway clearance and structural partition positions. A rectangular immersed tube transfers water and earth pressure through roof, walls and internal partitions acting as a frame. A circular thin-ring membrane formula is inappropriate. A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof-span bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位長載重=27 kN/m；跨距=3.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: line load=27 kN/m; span=3.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂板跨中彎矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Roof-span bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位長載重=27 kN/m；跨距=3.3 m。M=qL²/8=36.7537 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.472 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板跨中彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 設備或淨空調整若刪減支承，原條帶彎矩便失去邊界。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A clearance change removing support invalidates the original strip model. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.observation: 如何核對：在轉換兩側設成對高程與接頭位移基線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish paired elevation and joint-movement baselines across the transition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=7 mm；基線長度=130 m。β=Δs/L=0.0538462 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0592308 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷梯度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在轉換兩側設成對高程與接頭位移基線。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish paired elevation and joint-movement baselines across the transition. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：在轉換兩側設成對高程與接頭位移基線。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Establish paired elevation and joint-movement baselines across the transition. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩端剛度不同會把小沉陷差集中成局部轉角。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different end stiffness can concentrate small settlement differences into local rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基床變形與接頭轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bedding movement and joint rotation"?

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.

quiz.explanationEn: Establish paired elevation and joint-movement baselines across the transition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩端剛度不同會把小沉陷差集中成局部轉角。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different end stiffness can concentrate small settlement differences into local rotation. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩端剛度不同會把小沉陷差集中成局部轉角。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。
knowledge.textEn: Different end stiffness can concentrate small settlement differences into local rotation. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基床變形與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bedding movement and joint rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
兩端剛度不同會把小沉陷差集中成局部轉角。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different end stiffness can concentrate small settlement differences into local rotation.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 兩端剛度不同會把小沉陷差集中成局部轉角。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different end stiffness can concentrate small settlement differences into local rotation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint compression and sealing envelope" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮餘量」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gasket compression reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨海接頭要容納施工偏差和假想地震相對位移，研究張開、剪移及止水壓縮不可互相替代。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing joints accommodate construction tolerances and hypothetical seismic relative motion; opening, shear and compression are distinct quantities. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gasket compression reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=21 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=21 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=15.2 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水壓縮餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gasket compression reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint compression and sealing envelope" is correct?

兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水壓縮餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gasket compression reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用組合位移試驗核對止水包絡而非單向壓縮。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the seal envelope with combined displacement rather than compression alone. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：用組合位移試驗核對止水包絡而非單向壓縮。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Check the seal envelope with combined displacement rather than compression alone. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗張開而未驗剪移可能漏掉止水翻轉或局部脫離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing opening without shear can miss gasket roll or local separation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint compression and sealing envelope"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用組合位移試驗核對止水包絡而非單向壓縮。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check the seal envelope with combined displacement rather than compression alone.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
quiz.explanation: 用組合位移試驗核對止水包絡而非單向壓縮。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the seal envelope with combined displacement rather than compression alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水壓縮餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gasket compression reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗張開而未驗剪移可能漏掉止水翻轉或局部脫離。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing opening without shear can miss gasket roll or local separation. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗張開而未驗剪移可能漏掉止水翻轉或局部脫離。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。
knowledge.textEn: Testing opening without shear can miss gasket roll or local separation. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint compression and sealing envelope" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
只驗張開而未驗剪移可能漏掉止水翻轉或局部脫離。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Testing opening without shear can miss gasket roll or local separation.
quiz.explanation: 只驗張開而未驗剪移可能漏掉止水翻轉或局部脫離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing opening without shear can miss gasket roll or local separation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下管節與兩側鑽掘孔的控制網需要共同轉換，分析不同施工隊各自閉合但接合仍偏差的情境。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underwater elements and bored approaches require common transformations even when each construction team reports a closed survey network. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 水下管節與兩側鑽掘孔的控制網需要共同轉換，分析不同施工隊各自閉合但接合仍偏差的情境。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Underwater elements and bored approaches require common transformations even when each construction team reports a closed survey network. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 水下管節與兩側鑽掘孔的控制網需要共同轉換，分析不同施工隊各自閉合但接合仍偏差的情境。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: Underwater elements and bored approaches require common transformations even when each construction team reports a closed survey network.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 水下管節與兩側鑽掘孔的控制網需要共同轉換，分析不同施工隊各自閉合但接合仍偏差的情境。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Underwater elements and bored approaches require common transformations even when each construction team reports a closed survey network. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0511963 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0511963 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0511963 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0511963 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3840 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=3840 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0465421 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用錯誤岸基點會使三段各自看似正確卻整體偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong shore benchmark can make separately consistent sections collectively misplaced. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation.
quiz.explanation: 由第三條獨立控制線核對交界方向與高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a third independent control route to check interface direction and elevation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用錯誤岸基點會使三段各自看似正確卻整體偏移。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong shore benchmark can make separately consistent sections collectively misplaced. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共用錯誤岸基點會使三段各自看似正確卻整體偏移。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong shore benchmark can make separately consistent sections collectively misplaced. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 共用錯誤岸基點會使三段各自看似正確卻整體偏移。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
optionsEn: A wrong shore benchmark can make separately consistent sections collectively misplaced.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
quiz.explanation: 共用錯誤岸基點會使三段各自看似正確卻整體偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong shore benchmark can make separately consistent sections collectively misplaced. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線縱坡與牽引需求」與「列車壓力波與動壓量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" and "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 馬爾馬拉鐵路的坡度功率教材與車站加速分開，研究水下低點兩側坡段的符號和能量方向。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate grade power from station acceleration and examine slope sign and energy direction on either side of the low point. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.34e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0062 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.34e+06 kg; grade=0.0062 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 馬爾馬拉鐵路的坡度功率教材與車站加速分開，研究水下低點兩側坡段的符號和能量方向。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。
knowledge.textEn: Separate grade power from station acceleration and examine slope sign and energy direction on either side of the low point. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?
options: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
馬爾馬拉鐵路的坡度功率教材與車站加速分開，研究水下低點兩側坡段的符號和能量方向。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Separate grade power from station acceleration and examine slope sign and energy direction on either side of the low point.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 馬爾馬拉鐵路的坡度功率教材與車站加速分開，研究水下低點兩側坡段的符號和能量方向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate grade power from station acceleration and examine slope sign and energy direction on either side of the low point. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.34e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0062 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1630.03 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1793.03 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.34e+06 kg; grade=0.0062 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1630.03 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1793.03 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute uphill and downhill terms by travel direction and check mass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.34e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0062 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1630.03 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1793.03 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.34e+06 kg; grade=0.0062 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1630.03 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1793.03 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基線縱坡與牽引需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base-alignment grade and traction demand", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。

optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.34e+06 kg; grade=0.0062 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.34e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0062 無因次；速度=20 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.34e+06 kg; grade=0.0062 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute uphill and downhill terms by travel direction and check mass. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Marmaray immersed tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recompute uphill and downhill terms by travel direction and check mass. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忘記坡度方向會把制動需求錯記成牽引需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring slope sign misclassifies braking demand as traction demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

quiz.question: 要驗證「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base-alignment grade and traction demand"?
options: 按行車方向重算上坡與下坡分量並核對質量。

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「入口壓力擾動」如何影響馬爾馬拉海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Portal pressure disturbance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marmaray immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉管與鑽掘斷面改變可反射列車壓力波，馬爾馬拉教學將動壓尺度和交界波形分開。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口壓力擾動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Changes between immersed and bored sections can reflect train pressure waves; separate dynamic-pressure scaling from interface wave shape. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Portal pressure disturbance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=47 m/s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口壓力擾動」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Portal pressure disturbance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口壓力擾動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Portal pressure disturbance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=47 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1325.4 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1603.73 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=47 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1325.4 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1603.73 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較交界前後時間對齊的壓力訊號與車速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare time-aligned pressure signals and train speed across the transition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：試驗與驗證
