quiz.explanationEn: Compare strain and joint movement near and away from deck supports. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 均勻壓力模型可能漏掉支承處局部彎矩及裂縫。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A uniform-pressure model misses local bending and cracking at supports. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 均勻壓力模型可能漏掉支承處局部彎矩及裂縫。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。
knowledge.textEn: A uniform-pressure model misses local bending and cracking at supports. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
均勻壓力模型可能漏掉支承處局部彎矩及裂縫。
只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A uniform-pressure model misses local bending and cracking at supports.
Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
quiz.explanation: 均勻壓力模型可能漏掉支承處局部彎矩及裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A uniform-pressure model misses local bending and cracking at supports. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「內部樓板與荷載路徑」與「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Internal decks and load paths" and "Joint compression and sealing envelope": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal decks and load paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樓板條帶受彎」如何影響歐亞海底公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck-strip bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Eurasia Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 歐亞雙層道路中間樓板是實際行車荷載路徑，教材條帶只示範均載彎矩，另列集中輪載需求。雙層公路的樓板、或隧道內設備隔板，都把局部荷載傳給支承，但兩者功能與設計作用並不相同。簡支條帶可估計均載彎矩，集中輪載、剪力、疲勞與火災降強度必須另驗；幾何空間分層不能取代結構邊界的確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樓板條帶受彎」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The intermediate roadway deck is a traffic-load path; the teaching strip illustrates distributed bending while concentrated wheel loads remain separate. A double-deck road slab and an equipment partition both transfer local loads to supports but serve different functions and design actions. A simply supported strip estimates uniform-load bending. Concentrated wheel loads, shear, fatigue and fire-reduced strength require separate checks; dividing space geometrically does not establish the actual structural restraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deck-strip bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位長載重=28 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: line load=28 kN/m; span=3.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樓板條帶受彎」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deck-strip bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑
knowledge.text: 歐亞雙層道路中間樓板是實際行車荷載路徑，教材條帶只示範均載彎矩，另列集中輪載需求。雙層公路的樓板、或隧道內設備隔板，都把局部荷載傳給支承，但兩者功能與設計作用並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: The intermediate roadway deck is a traffic-load path; the teaching strip illustrates distributed bending while concentrated wheel loads remain separate. A double-deck road slab and an equipment partition both transfer local loads to supports but serve different functions and design actions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「內部樓板與荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal decks and load paths" is correct?
options: 只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
歐亞雙層道路中間樓板是實際行車荷載路徑，教材條帶只示範均載彎矩，另列集中輪載需求。
optionsEn: Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
The intermediate roadway deck is a traffic-load path; the teaching strip illustrates distributed bending while concentrated wheel loads remain separate.
quiz.explanation: 歐亞雙層道路中間樓板是實際行車荷載路徑，教材條帶只示範均載彎矩，另列集中輪載需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The intermediate roadway deck is a traffic-load path; the teaching strip illustrates distributed bending while concentrated wheel loads remain separate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal decks and load paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板條帶受彎」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck-strip bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位長載重=28 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。M=qL²/8=45.36 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為54.8856 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: line load=28 kN/m; span=3.6 m. M=qL²/8=45.36 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 54.8856 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對行車面、支承和施工階段，不與設備隔板混用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check roadway surface, supports and stages without substituting equipment-partition assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=28 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。M=qL²/8=45.36 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為54.8856 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=28 kN/m; span=3.6 m. M=qL²/8=45.36 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 54.8856 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「內部樓板與荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal decks and load paths", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=28 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=28 kN/m; span=3.6 m.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=28 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=28 kN/m; span=3.6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Eurasia Tunnel, the deck-strip bending handover must address the following evidence: Check roadway surface, supports and stages without substituting equipment-partition assumptions. State deck function, supports and construction stages at handover so clearance, equipment layout and structural assumptions can be reconciled in one revision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把樓板當非承重分隔會漏掉交通彎剪和疲勞作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板條帶受彎」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把樓板當非承重分隔會漏掉交通彎剪和疲勞作用。把隔板誤當行車樓板會使用錯誤荷載，反之漏掉交通集中荷載則低估局部彎剪與疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the deck as nonstructural separation omits traffic bending, shear and fatigue. Mistaking a partition for a roadway deck applies the wrong actions, while omitting concentrated traffic load underestimates local bending, shear and fatigue. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concentrated wheel loads, shear, fatigue and fire-reduced strength require separate checks; dividing space geometrically does not establish the actual structural restraints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮餘量」如何影響歐亞海底公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gasket compression reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Eurasia Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓孔接頭與變形介面的止水能力需對應不同位移形式，研究平均壓縮合格但局部錯台的情境。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Match sealing performance to different displacement modes at ring joints and movement interfaces, including local offsets despite acceptable average compression. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gasket compression reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=18 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=18 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水壓縮餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gasket compression reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水壓縮餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gasket compression reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=18 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為11.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=18 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=12 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 11.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將最不利角點的壓縮和剪移一起送入接頭試驗。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只取平均縫寬會掩蓋局部止水脫離。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。
knowledge.textEn: Mean joint width can conceal local gasket separation. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint compression and sealing envelope" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只取平均縫寬會掩蓋局部止水脫離。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Mean joint width can conceal local gasket separation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 只取平均縫寬會掩蓋局部止水脫離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean joint width can conceal local gasket separation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「視覺適應與路面亮度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響歐亞海底公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Eurasia Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙層道路的通風支路與樓板隔離相互作用，研究一層門位變化是否改變另一層的風量。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ventilation branches interact with deck separation; test whether changing doors on one level redistributes air on the other. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=820 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.6 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=820 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.6 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 雙層道路的通風支路與樓板隔離相互作用，研究一層門位變化是否改變另一層的風量。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Ventilation branches interact with deck separation; test whether changing doors on one level redistributes air on the other. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
雙層道路的通風支路與樓板隔離相互作用，研究一層門位變化是否改變另一層的風量。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Ventilation branches interact with deck separation; test whether changing doors on one level redistributes air on the other.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 雙層道路的通風支路與樓板隔離相互作用，研究一層門位變化是否改變另一層的風量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ventilation branches interact with deck separation; test whether changing doors on one level redistributes air on the other. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=820 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.6 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.2209 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=820 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.6 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.2209 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=820 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.6 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為48.2209 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=820 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.6 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 48.2209 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=820 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.6 m/s。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=820 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.6 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=820 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.6 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.852 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Eurasia Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩層風機額定量相加不能代表各層實際有效換氣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Summed fan ratings do not establish effective airflow on each level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。

Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測兩層壓差與風量，保留車流狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure pressure and flow on both levels simultaneously and record traffic state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩層風機額定量相加不能代表各層實際有效換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Summed fan ratings do not establish effective airflow on each level. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
