quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
兩層風機額定量相加不能代表各層實際有效換氣。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Summed fan ratings do not establish effective airflow on each level.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 兩層風機額定量相加不能代表各層實際有效換氣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Summed fan ratings do not establish effective airflow on each level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漫反射亮度」如何影響歐亞海底公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffuse luminance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Eurasia Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙層道路入口與轉接段的視角不同，歐亞教材區分照度、路面反射及駕駛看到的亮度。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漫反射亮度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different viewing geometries at entrances and transitions require illuminance, pavement reflection and driver-view luminance to be distinguished. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffuse luminance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：照度=96 lx；反射率=0.27 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=96 lx; reflectance=0.27 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漫反射亮度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffuse luminance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度
knowledge.text: 雙層道路入口與轉接段的視角不同，歐亞教材區分照度、路面反射及駕駛看到的亮度。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Different viewing geometries at entrances and transitions require illuminance, pavement reflection and driver-view luminance to be distinguished. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" is correct?
options: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
雙層道路入口與轉接段的視角不同，歐亞教材區分照度、路面反射及駕駛看到的亮度。
optionsEn: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Different viewing geometries at entrances and transitions require illuminance, pavement reflection and driver-view luminance to be distinguished.
quiz.explanation: 雙層道路入口與轉接段的視角不同，歐亞教材區分照度、路面反射及駕駛看到的亮度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different viewing geometries at entrances and transitions require illuminance, pavement reflection and driver-view luminance to be distinguished. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漫反射亮度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffuse luminance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：照度=96 lx；反射率=0.27 無因次。L=ρE/π=8.25059 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為9.07565 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=96 lx; reflectance=0.27 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=8.25059 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 9.07565 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：照度=96 lx；反射率=0.27 無因次。L=ρE/π=8.25059 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為9.07565 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=96 lx; reflectance=0.27 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=8.25059 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 9.07565 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「視覺適應與路面亮度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：照度=96 lx；反射率=0.27 無因次。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=96 lx; reflectance=0.27 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：照度=96 lx；反射率=0.27 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=96 lx; reflectance=0.27 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漫反射亮度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffuse luminance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Eurasia Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩層照度相同不保證障礙物對比相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal illuminance on two levels does not ensure equal obstacle contrast. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
knowledge.textEn: For Eurasia Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。
只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone.
Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
quiz.explanation: 從各層駕駛視高核對亮度而非只量地面照度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure luminance from each driving eye height rather than ground illuminance alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漫反射亮度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffuse luminance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩層照度相同不保證障礙物對比相同。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal illuminance on two levels does not ensure equal obstacle contrast. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩層照度相同不保證障礙物對比相同。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Equal illuminance on two levels does not ensure equal obstacle contrast. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視覺適應與路面亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
兩層照度相同不保證障礙物對比相同。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Equal illuminance on two levels does not ensure equal obstacle contrast.
quiz.explanation: 兩層照度相同不保證障礙物對比相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal illuminance on two levels does not ensure equal obstacle contrast. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響歐亞海底公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Eurasia Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從雙層道路轉入安全通道時存在垂直及水平移動，教學時間帳要保留找門與下車延遲。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moving from a double-deck roadway to safety combines vertical and horizontal travel with door-finding and vehicle-exit delay. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=96 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=96 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 從雙層道路轉入安全通道時存在垂直及水平移動，教學時間帳要保留找門與下車延遲。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Moving from a double-deck roadway to safety combines vertical and horizontal travel with door-finding and vehicle-exit delay. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 從雙層道路轉入安全通道時存在垂直及水平移動，教學時間帳要保留找門與下車延遲。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Moving from a double-deck roadway to safety combines vertical and horizontal travel with door-finding and vehicle-exit delay.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 從雙層道路轉入安全通道時存在垂直及水平移動，教學時間帳要保留找門與下車延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving from a double-deck roadway to safety combines vertical and horizontal travel with door-finding and vehicle-exit delay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=96 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=546 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為591 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=96 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=546 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 591 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=96 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=546 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為591 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=96 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=546 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 591 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：前置時間=96 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=96 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=96 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=96 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Eurasia Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量平面最短線會漏掉樓層轉換和排隊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A plan-view shortest line omits level changes and queues. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
knowledge.textEn: For Eurasia Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage.
quiz.explanation: 分階段記錄從車內到安全通道的實際路徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record the staged route from vehicle interior to the safe passage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量平面最短線會漏掉樓層轉換和排隊。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A plan-view shortest line omits level changes and queues. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量平面最短線會漏掉樓層轉換和排隊。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A plan-view shortest line omits level changes and queues. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只量平面最短線會漏掉樓層轉換和排隊。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: A plan-view shortest line omits level changes and queues.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 只量平面最短線會漏掉樓層轉換和排隊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A plan-view shortest line omits level changes and queues. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響歐亞海底公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Eurasia Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 道路系統資料需保留樓層與方向，研究相同里程上下層設備被錯配時如何影響維修和告警定位。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asset records must retain level and direction to prevent upper- and lower-deck equipment at one chainage being confused. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=108 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=108 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 道路系統資料需保留樓層與方向，研究相同里程上下層設備被錯配時如何影響維修和告警定位。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Asset records must retain level and direction to prevent upper- and lower-deck equipment at one chainage being confused. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
道路系統資料需保留樓層與方向，研究相同里程上下層設備被錯配時如何影響維修和告警定位。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Asset records must retain level and direction to prevent upper- and lower-deck equipment at one chainage being confused.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 道路系統資料需保留樓層與方向，研究相同里程上下層設備被錯配時如何影響維修和告警定位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Asset records must retain level and direction to prevent upper- and lower-deck equipment at one chainage being confused. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=108 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.7037 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=108 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.7037 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=108 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.7037 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=108 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.7037 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
原創教學假設：設備總數=108 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=108 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=108 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=108 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.1852 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Eurasia Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺樓層欄位會把修繕隊送到同里程的錯誤位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing level data sends maintainers to the wrong location at the correct chainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Eurasia Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 抽查告警座標能否唯一定位到樓層、方向和裝置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test whether alarm coordinates uniquely identify level, direction and asset. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺樓層欄位會把修繕隊送到同里程的錯誤位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing level data sends maintainers to the wrong location at the correct chainage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 缺樓層欄位會把修繕隊送到同里程的錯誤位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Missing level data sends maintainers to the wrong location at the correct chainage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
缺樓層欄位會把修繕隊送到同里程的錯誤位置。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Missing level data sends maintainers to the wrong location at the correct chainage.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 缺樓層欄位會把修繕隊送到同里程的錯誤位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Missing level data sends maintainers to the wrong location at the correct chainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 東京灣跨海公路隧道
courses.summary: 東京灣跨海公路結合海底隧道、人工島與橋梁，大林組工程史列整體道路15.1公里及1997年施工標竣工。本課把整體走廊與承包商施工範圍分開，聚焦人工島支承、地下接合、環片與止水、通風和鹽害；不把某一標段紀錄泛化為整個工程所有部位的參數。
courses.summaryEn: The Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line combines a subsea tunnel, artificial islands and a bridge. Obayashi records a 15.1 km road corridor and completion of its contract in 1997. The course separates corridor and contract scope, focusing on island support, underground connections, segments, sealing, ventilation and marine deterioration without generalising one contract to every structure.
courses.focus: 人工島接合、海底盾構與長期鹽害
courses.focusEn: Island interfaces, subsea shield drives and marine durability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate joint compression and sealing envelope. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 公開工程尺度約為 15.1 km whole road corridor，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
1997 年事件：東京灣跨海公路的隧道施工標於12月竣工。
教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=15.6 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=15.6 min；不是實測或允收值。
教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=657.27 kPa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=4.66286 MPa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「止水壓縮餘量」：初始壓縮=19 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=13 mm；不是實測或允收值。
factsEn: The public scale is about 15.1 km whole road corridor; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1997 event: The documented Aqua-Line tunnel construction contract is completed in December.
Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=15.6 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 15.6 min; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 657.27 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 4.66286 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching gasket compression reserve: initial compression=19 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 13 mm; not measured or accepted project data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.16 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.16 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed.
quiz.explanation: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掘進利用率與設備停時」與「背填連續性與體積帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" and "Backfill continuity and volume balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective boring utilisation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大直徑海底盾構的切削與環片物流互相制約，教材以Aqua-Line背景區分單次高進尺與整班利用率。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-diameter cutting and segment logistics interact; distinguish high short-duration advance from whole-shift utilisation in the Aqua-Line setting. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.77 m/h；有效利用率=0.28 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.77 m/h; utilisation=0.28 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效掘進利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective boring utilisation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時
knowledge.text: 大直徑海底盾構的切削與環片物流互相制約，教材以Aqua-Line背景區分單次高進尺與整班利用率。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。

Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance.

knowledge.text: 誤解：刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「掘進利用率與設備停時」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" is correct?
options: 大直徑海底盾構的切削與環片物流互相制約，教材以Aqua-Line背景區分單次高進尺與整班利用率。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
optionsEn: Large-diameter cutting and segment logistics interact; distinguish high short-duration advance from whole-shift utilisation in the Aqua-Line setting.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.

quiz.explanation: 大直徑海底盾構的切削與環片物流互相制約，教材以Aqua-Line背景區分單次高進尺與整班利用率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large-diameter cutting and segment logistics interact; distinguish high short-duration advance from whole-shift utilisation in the Aqua-Line setting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.77 m/h；有效利用率=0.28 無因次。D=24vu=11.8944 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.0838 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效掘進利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective boring utilisation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把環片到場、拼裝和切削時間對齊，找真正瓶頸。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align segment delivery, erection and cutting times to identify the bottleneck. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align segment delivery, erection and cutting times to identify the bottleneck. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：提高切削速度但環片供應不足只會增加等待。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Faster cutting with inadequate segment supply merely increases waiting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 提高切削速度但環片供應不足只會增加等待。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Faster cutting with inadequate segment supply merely increases waiting. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.

quiz.explanationEn: Faster cutting with inadequate segment supply merely increases waiting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌背後幾何空隙」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric lining annulus” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海底環片背填需填補幾何空隙，教學體積不能當實際灌漿完成量，因為地層吸收和超挖仍未知。盾尾空隙須由背填恢復襯砌與地層的接觸，但幾何空隙不是必然注入量。超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌背後幾何空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill fills geometric voids, but teaching volume cannot prove completion because ground take and overbreak remain uncertain. Backfill restores contact across the shield-tail gap, but geometric void is not the required injected volume. Overbreak, absorption, return and material volume change alter the balance. Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric lining annulus” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.36 m；襯砌外徑=8.06 m；環長=1.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric lining annulus”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 海底環片背填需填補幾何空隙，教學體積不能當實際灌漿完成量，因為地層吸收和超挖仍未知。盾尾空隙須由背填恢復襯砌與地層的接觸，但幾何空隙不是必然注入量。

knowledge.text: 誤解：灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背填連續性與體積帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backfill continuity and volume balance" is correct?
options: 灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
海底環片背填需填補幾何空隙，教學體積不能當實際灌漿完成量，因為地層吸收和超挖仍未知。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
Backfill fills geometric voids, but teaching volume cannot prove completion because ground take and overbreak remain uncertain.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 海底環片背填需填補幾何空隙，教學體積不能當實際灌漿完成量，因為地層吸收和超挖仍未知。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
