steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric lining annulus” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.36 m；襯砌外徑=8.06 m；環長=1.5 m。V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³。僅把環長增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.38364 m³。邊界：同心幾何空隙，不等於實際灌漿需求或完成證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.38364 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。用環片及開挖尺寸計算幾何空隙，核對注入回流質量與時間戳，再以適當無損檢測及變形資料查局部缺填。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背填連續性與體積帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill continuity and volume balance"?
options: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric lining annulus” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。
knowledge.textEn: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背填連續性與體積帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backfill continuity and volume balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Joint compression and sealing envelope": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions.
quiz.explanation: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.12914 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.12914 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.12914 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.12914 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 大林組記載接合與防水措施，本課以假想接縫研究幾何容許與實際水密試驗的差別。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using documented connection and waterproofing context, a hypothetical joint distinguishes geometric allowance from actual pressure-test performance. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gasket compression reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 在「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint compression and sealing envelope" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只查止水材料證明未必涵蓋現場接合位移組合。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Material certification alone may not cover the installed displacement combination.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 只查止水材料證明未必涵蓋現場接合位移組合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Material certification alone may not cover the installed displacement combination. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與貫通誤差」與「基床變形與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control network and breakthrough error" and "Bedding movement and joint rotation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從不同人工島相向掘進的控制網需獨立覆核，研究水下接合前方向和高程不確定性。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Opposing drives from separate islands need independent control checks before underwater connection, including direction and height uncertainty. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=4080 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4080 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 從不同人工島相向掘進的控制網需獨立覆核，研究水下接合前方向和高程不確定性。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Opposing drives from separate islands need independent control checks before underwater connection, including direction and height uncertainty. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
從不同人工島相向掘進的控制網需獨立覆核，研究水下接合前方向和高程不確定性。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Opposing drives from separate islands need independent control checks before underwater connection, including direction and height uncertainty.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 從不同人工島相向掘進的控制網需獨立覆核，研究水下接合前方向和高程不確定性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Opposing drives from separate islands need independent control checks before underwater connection, including direction and height uncertainty. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=4080 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0565719 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4080 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0565719 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4080 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0565719 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4080 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0565719 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：控制長度=4080 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
optionsEn: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=4080 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4080 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4080 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.051429 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩端共用尺度錯誤可能在長距離累積而未被局部閉合發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared scale error accumulates over long drives without appearing in local closure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
optionsEn: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
quiz.explanation: 以原始角距重算兩端網絡，交叉核對獨立接合探測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recompute both networks from raw observations and cross-check independent connection surveys. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩端共用尺度錯誤可能在長距離累積而未被局部閉合發現。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared scale error accumulates over long drives without appearing in local closure. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩端共用尺度錯誤可能在長距離累積而未被局部閉合發現。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: Shared scale error accumulates over long drives without appearing in local closure. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
兩端共用尺度錯誤可能在長距離累積而未被局部閉合發現。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Shared scale error accumulates over long drives without appearing in local closure.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 兩端共用尺度錯誤可能在長距離累積而未被局部閉合發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared scale error accumulates over long drives without appearing in local closure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷梯度」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島填築地盤與海底孔連接形成差異沉陷課題，研究工後固結如何傳到柔性接合。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reclaimed island ground creates differential settlement at the tunnel connection; examine how postconstruction consolidation reaches flexible interfaces. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：差異沉陷=5 mm；基線長度=170 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=5 mm; baseline=170 m. β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷梯度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角
knowledge.text: 人工島填築地盤與海底孔連接形成差異沉陷課題，研究工後固結如何傳到柔性接合。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。
knowledge.textEn: Reclaimed island ground creates differential settlement at the tunnel connection; examine how postconstruction consolidation reaches flexible interfaces. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基床變形與接頭轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bedding movement and joint rotation" is correct?
options: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
人工島填築地盤與海底孔連接形成差異沉陷課題，研究工後固結如何傳到柔性接合。
optionsEn: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Reclaimed island ground creates differential settlement at the tunnel connection; examine how postconstruction consolidation reaches flexible interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 人工島填築地盤與海底孔連接形成差異沉陷課題，研究工後固結如何傳到柔性接合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reclaimed island ground creates differential settlement at the tunnel connection; examine how postconstruction consolidation reaches flexible interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷梯度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：差異沉陷=5 mm；基線長度=170 m。β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0323529 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=5 mm; baseline=170 m. β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0323529 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基床變形與接頭轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bedding movement and joint rotation", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=5 mm；基線長度=170 m。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=5 mm; baseline=170 m. β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m.

A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=5 mm; baseline=170 m. β=Δs/L=0.0294118 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷梯度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只追蹤隧道中心高程會漏掉島體一側持續下沉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tunnel-centre elevation alone misses continuing settlement on the island side. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基床變形與接頭轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bedding movement and joint rotation"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 將島體沉陷、孔壓及接頭轉角按同一時序比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare island settlement, pore pressure and joint rotation on one timeline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只追蹤隧道中心高程會漏掉島體一側持續下沉。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tunnel-centre elevation alone misses continuing settlement on the island side. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只追蹤隧道中心高程會漏掉島體一側持續下沉。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。
knowledge.textEn: Tunnel-centre elevation alone misses continuing settlement on the island side. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基床變形與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bedding movement and joint rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
只追蹤隧道中心高程會漏掉島體一側持續下沉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Tunnel-centre elevation alone misses continuing settlement on the island side.
quiz.explanation: 只追蹤隧道中心高程會漏掉島體一側持續下沉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tunnel-centre elevation alone misses continuing settlement on the island side. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Chloride transport and durability interpretation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海上通風設施與隧道內阻力構成共同網路，研究外風改變時風機工況點的移動。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Offshore ventilation structures and tunnel resistance form one network; examine operating-point changes under external wind. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=860 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=860 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=46.569 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 海上通風設施與隧道內阻力構成共同網路，研究外風改變時風機工況點的移動。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=860 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=46.569 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為56.3485 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=860 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=46.569 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 56.3485 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄外風、風機狀態與孔內壓差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise external wind, fan state and tunnel pressure difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄外風、風機狀態與孔內壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise external wind, fan state and tunnel pressure difference. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步記錄外風、風機狀態與孔內壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise external wind, fan state and tunnel pressure difference. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「擴散特徵長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffusion characteristic length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。

Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions.

knowledge.text: 誤解：擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" is correct?
options: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為36.3195 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 36.3195 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chloride transport and durability interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擴散特徵長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffusion characteristic length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chloride transport and durability interpretation"?
options: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擴散特徵長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffusion characteristic length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 拉爾達隧道
courses.summary: 拉爾達隧道官方列長24.5公里，於2000年11月開通；同一官方頁也說明後續更新工程。本課將原始營運與更新情境分開，從長距離行車視覺、岩體應力、通風及水量出發，追蹤夜間工程窗口和恢復營運的證據需求，避免以景觀照明取代完整系統評估。
courses.summaryEn: The road authority reports Laerdal as 24.5 km long and opened in November 2000, while also describing later upgrades. This course separates original service from renewal scenarios, following driver vision, rock stress, ventilation and water into night-work windows and evidence for restoring service. Decorative lighting is not treated as a substitute for system assessment.
courses.focus: 長公路的人因、通風與更新介面
courses.focusEn: Human factors, ventilation and renewal in a long road tunnel
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為68.64 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=75 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為809.325 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate piezometric head and lining pressure. Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 68.64 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=75 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 809.325 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 公開工程尺度約為 24.5 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
2000 年事件：拉爾達公路隧道於11月正式開通營運。

教學「風道摩擦壓損」：達西因子=0.025 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=39.015 Pa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=735.75 kPa；不是實測或允收值。
factsEn: The public scale is about 24.5 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2000 event: Laerdal road tunnel formally opens to traffic in November.
Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=16 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 16 min; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching tangential wall stress: cover=800 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 62.4 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching duct friction loss: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 39.015 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 735.75 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
