knowledge.text: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視覺適應與路面亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拘束溫度應變」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained thermal strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拘束溫度應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained thermal strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拘束溫度應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrained thermal strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫
knowledge.text: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。
knowledge.textEn: Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal restraint and component cracking" is correct?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拘束溫度應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained thermal strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.05 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.05 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.05 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.05 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal restraint and component cracking", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拘束溫度應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained thermal strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal restraint and component cracking"?
options: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拘束溫度應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained thermal strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal restraint and component cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Chloride transport and durability interpretation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山融雪補注和道路帶入水需分流判讀，研究聖伯納山背景下排水增量是否跟隨季節或車流。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate snowmelt recharge and road-carried water, checking whether drainage changes follow season or traffic. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=82 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
高山融雪補注和道路帶入水需分流判讀，研究聖伯納山背景下排水增量是否跟隨季節或車流。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為884.862 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=82 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 884.862 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為884.862 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=82 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 884.862 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。

Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment.
quiz.explanation: 車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 除冰鹽帶入的暴露可能集中於路側低區，不能以高處乾燥取樣代表整個斷面。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deicing-salt exposure can concentrate near low roadside zones, so dry high-level samples do not represent the section. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「擴散特徵長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffusion characteristic length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" is correct?
options: 除冰鹽帶入的暴露可能集中於路側低區，不能以高處乾燥取樣代表整個斷面。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Deicing-salt exposure can concentrate near low roadside zones, so dry high-level samples do not represent the section.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 除冰鹽帶入的暴露可能集中於路側低區，不能以高處乾燥取樣代表整個斷面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Deicing-salt exposure can concentrate near low roadside zones, so dry high-level samples do not represent the section. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「擴散特徵長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffusion characteristic length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.8189 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chloride transport and durability interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擴散特徵長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffusion characteristic length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chloride transport and durability interpretation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic.
quiz.explanation: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擴散特徵長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffusion characteristic length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Evacuation time and zone availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.54 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.54 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.54 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.10971 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.54 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.10971 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.instructionEn: Compare crack orientation and seasonal opening against external head changes. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙向交通中事故兩側使用者位置不同，教學路徑分別處理回頭、停車與前方阻隔情境。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Users lie on different sides of an incident in bidirectional traffic; distinguish turnaround, stopped queues and blocked-forward-path cases. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=104 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=104 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
