Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：同步比較三孔壓力、流量與補注事件。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。

Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把三孔出流相加而未查連通可能重複估計獨立補注。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Summing flows without connectivity checks can double-count supposedly independent recharge. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把三孔出流相加而未查連通可能重複估計獨立補注。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把三孔出流相加而未查連通可能重複估計獨立補注。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Summing flows without connectivity checks can double-count supposedly independent recharge.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 把三孔出流相加而未查連通可能重複估計獨立補注。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Summing flows without connectivity checks can double-count supposedly independent recharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長基線隧道穿越不同覆土和構造，教材把彈性洞壁應力與節理控制破壞分開選模。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A long base tunnel crosses varying cover and structure; distinguish elastic wall stress from joint-controlled failure when selecting models. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=950 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=950 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

options: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
長基線隧道穿越不同覆土和構造，教材把彈性洞壁應力與節理控制破壞分開選模。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
A long base tunnel crosses varying cover and structure; distinguish elastic wall stress from joint-controlled failure when selecting models.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 長基線隧道穿越不同覆土和構造，教材把彈性洞壁應力與節理控制破壞分開選模。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A long base tunnel crosses varying cover and structure; distinguish elastic wall stress from joint-controlled failure when selecting models. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=950 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為81.51 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=950 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 81.51 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=950 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為81.51 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=950 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 81.51 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
原創教學假設：覆土深度=950 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Original teaching assumptions: cover=950 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=950 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=950 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=74.1 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單用覆土排序危險程度會漏掉低覆土弱帶的變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ranking hazard by cover alone misses deformation in weak shallow zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
knowledge.textEn: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 比較原位應力方向、破壞方位和分段收斂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare in-situ stress directions, damage orientation and segment convergence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單用覆土排序危險程度會漏掉低覆土弱帶的變形。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ranking hazard by cover alone misses deformation in weak shallow zones. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單用覆土排序危險程度會漏掉低覆土弱帶的變形。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Ranking hazard by cover alone misses deformation in weak shallow zones. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
單用覆土排序危險程度會漏掉低覆土弱帶的變形。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ranking hazard by cover alone misses deformation in weak shallow zones.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 單用覆土排序危險程度會漏掉低覆土弱帶的變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ranking hazard by cover alone misses deformation in weak shallow zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「掘進利用率與設備停時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多標段支護設計需要一致證據格式但不必相同參數，布倫納教材研究地質分區與封閉時序。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different lots need consistent evidence formats without identical parameters; examine ground domains and closure timing. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=45 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=45 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 多標段支護設計需要一致證據格式但不必相同參數，布倫納教材研究地質分區與封閉時序。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Different lots need consistent evidence formats without identical parameters; examine ground domains and closure timing. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
多標段支護設計需要一致證據格式但不必相同參數，布倫納教材研究地質分區與封閉時序。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Different lots need consistent evidence formats without identical parameters; examine ground domains and closure timing.
quiz.explanation: 多標段支護設計需要一致證據格式但不必相同參數，布倫納教材研究地質分區與封閉時序。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different lots need consistent evidence formats without identical parameters; examine ground domains and closure timing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=45 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=405 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為445.5 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 445.5 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare loads and convergence at equal excavation age within one ground domain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=45 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=405 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 445.5 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將相同開挖齡期的荷重及收斂放在同地質組比較。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare loads and convergence at equal excavation age within one ground domain. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將相同開挖齡期的荷重及收斂放在同地質組比較。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Compare loads and convergence at equal excavation age within one ground domain. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：跨地質平均參數會把真正局部擠壓訊號稀釋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging across geology dilutes genuine local squeezing signals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 跨地質平均參數會把真正局部擠壓訊號稀釋。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging across geology dilutes genuine local squeezing signals. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
跨地質平均參數會把真正局部擠壓訊號稀釋。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Averaging across geology dilutes genuine local squeezing signals.
quiz.explanation: 跨地質平均參數會把真正局部擠壓訊號稀釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaging across geology dilutes genuine local squeezing signals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective boring utilisation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 布倫納多機多工作面背景適合比較利用率，教材按岩性和停時原因校正後才比較日進尺。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple machines and headings require comparisons normalised by ground and downtime cause before daily advance is ranked. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.95 m/h；有效利用率=0.325 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.95 m/h; utilisation=0.325 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效掘進利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：以完整班次重建切削、拼裝、保養和運輸時間帳。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掘進利用率與設備停時」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
以完整班次重建切削、拼裝、保養和運輸時間帳。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts.
quiz.explanation: 以完整班次重建切削、拼裝、保養和運輸時間帳。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
knowledge.textEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為212.121 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 212.121 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為212.121 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 212.121 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth.
quiz.explanation: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.069115 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.069115 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.069115 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.069115 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch.
quiz.explanation: 同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線縱坡與牽引需求」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低坡度是布倫納運輸目的之一，教材計算坡度功率後另外列出加速、氣動與列車間距需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low gradient supports the transport purpose; calculate grade power while separately listing acceleration, aerodynamics and spacing demands. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.5e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.5e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 低坡度是布倫納運輸目的之一，教材計算坡度功率後另外列出加速、氣動與列車間距需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。

A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?

基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Low gradient supports the transport purpose; calculate grade power while separately listing acceleration, aerodynamics and spacing demands.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.

quiz.explanationEn: Low gradient supports the transport purpose; calculate grade power while separately listing acceleration, aerodynamics and spacing demands. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「坡度阻力功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grade-resistance power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.5e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1942.38 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2136.62 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.5e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1942.38 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2136.62 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對坡度無因次換算及列車質量，再比同速方案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check dimensionless grade conversion and mass before equal-speed comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.5e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1942.38 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2136.62 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.5e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1942.38 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2136.62 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基線縱坡與牽引需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base-alignment grade and traction demand", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：列車質量=1.5e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對坡度無因次換算及列車質量，再比同速方案。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check dimensionless grade conversion and mass before equal-speed comparison. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：核對坡度無因次換算及列車質量，再比同速方案。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Check dimensionless grade conversion and mass before equal-speed comparison. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把千分比當百分比會使坡度功率放大十倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing per mille with percent multiplies grade power by ten. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把千分比當百分比會使坡度功率放大十倍。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
