steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先進坑由調查轉為維護用途時，資料需保留地質與設備兩種索引，避免施工資料在營運期失聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: As the exploratory gallery gains a maintenance role, preserve both geological and equipment indexing through handover. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=115 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=115 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 先進坑由調查轉為維護用途時，資料需保留地質與設備兩種索引，避免施工資料在營運期失聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: As the exploratory gallery gains a maintenance role, preserve both geological and equipment indexing through handover. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
先進坑由調查轉為維護用途時，資料需保留地質與設備兩種索引，避免施工資料在營運期失聯。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
As the exploratory gallery gains a maintenance role, preserve both geological and equipment indexing through handover.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 先進坑由調查轉為維護用途時，資料需保留地質與設備兩種索引，避免施工資料在營運期失聯。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: As the exploratory gallery gains a maintenance role, preserve both geological and equipment indexing through handover. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=115 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.6957 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=115 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.6957 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=115 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.6957 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=115 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.6957 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
原創教學假設：設備總數=115 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=115 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=115 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=115 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.087 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 新武界引水隧道
courses.summary: 台電典藏說明新武界及栗栖溪引水工程的規劃與施工，列16.5公里引水範圍及其中6.5公里TBM中段，記錄2002年該掘進段貫通。本課把土木、地質與水力目的串接，研究水路能量、探查代表性、支護和施工物流；這些尺度不被混寫成單一孔全長或發電容量。
courses.summaryEn: Taipower describes planning and construction for New Wujie and Lixi conveyance, including a 16.5 km scope and a 6.5 km TBM middle section that broke through in 2002. This course connects civil, geological and hydraulic purposes through energy, investigation, support and logistics, without confusing those scopes with one bore length or generating capacity.
courses.focus: 引水能量、水文地質與TBM規劃整合
courses.focusEn: Conveyance energy, hydrogeology and TBM planning integration
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate conveyance friction and transient boundaries. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平流時間」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平流時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water advection time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水體平流時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water advection time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間
knowledge.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time
knowledge.text: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。
knowledge.textEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Underground water routes and travel time" is correct?
options: 水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平流時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 24.4444 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 24.4444 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水路與傳遞時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Underground water routes and travel time", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水體平流時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Underground water routes and travel time"?
options: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水體平流時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water advection time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水路與傳遞時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Underground water routes and travel time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it.
quiz.explanation: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m².
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage.
quiz.explanation: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「掘進利用率與設備停時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.

quiz.explanationEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1035.94 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1035.94 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。

Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective boring utilisation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 公開資料的最高日進尺與月平均是不同統計量，本課以新武界背景重建班次利用率而非追逐紀錄。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published peak daily and mean monthly advance are different statistics; reconstruct shift utilisation rather than treating a production record as normal. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.98 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.98 m/h; utilisation=0.295 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效掘進利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective boring utilisation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將最高日、完整月份與停機日納入同一時間帳。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Include peak day, full month and stoppage days in one time balance. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：將最高日、完整月份與停機日納入同一時間帳。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Include peak day, full month and stoppage days in one time balance. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：最高日乘整月會系統性高估施工進度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying the peak day by a month systematically overstates progress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 最高日乘整月會系統性高估施工進度。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying the peak day by a month systematically overstates progress. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 最高日乘整月會系統性高估施工進度。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying the peak day by a month systematically overstates progress. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
最高日乘整月會系統性高估施工進度。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Multiplying the peak day by a month systematically overstates progress.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 最高日乘整月會系統性高估施工進度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying the peak day by a month systematically overstates progress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial support stabilises excavation while permanent lining also serves hydraulics and durability; verify these functions separately. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.

steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
