quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section.
quiz.explanation: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滿管沿程損失」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-pipe friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滿管沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-pipe friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滿管沿程損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Full-pipe friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界
knowledge.text: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。
knowledge.textEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" is correct?
options: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滿管沿程損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-pipe friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。

Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Keep units when recalculating.

knowledge.text: 用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded.
quiz.explanation: 用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滿管沿程損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-pipe friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.01486 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.01486 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.01486 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.01486 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
optionsEn: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均直徑合格仍可能有局部縮頸造成額外損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Acceptable mean diameter can conceal local constrictions and excess loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均直徑合格仍可能有局部縮頸造成額外損失。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Acceptable mean diameter can conceal local constrictions and excess loss. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水坡度微小時高程誤差可改變排水與淨空判讀，新武界教材強調共同高程基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With small conveyance gradients, height errors alter drainage and clearance interpretation; maintain a common elevation reference. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=4920 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4920 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 引水坡度微小時高程誤差可改變排水與淨空判讀，新武界教材強調共同高程基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: With small conveyance gradients, height errors alter drainage and clearance interpretation; maintain a common elevation reference. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?

增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
引水坡度微小時高程誤差可改變排水與淨空判讀，新武界教材強調共同高程基準。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
With small conveyance gradients, height errors alter drainage and clearance interpretation; maintain a common elevation reference.
quiz.explanation: 引水坡度微小時高程誤差可改變排水與淨空判讀，新武界教材強調共同高程基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: With small conveyance gradients, height errors alter drainage and clearance interpretation; maintain a common elevation reference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=4920 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0708429 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4920 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0708429 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4920 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0708429 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4920 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0708429 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4920 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4920 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4920 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0644026 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「水量帳與環境受體」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Water balance and environmental receptors": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil.
quiz.explanation: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊界水量差」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary water-balance residual” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界水量差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary water-balance residual” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界水量差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundary water-balance residual”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水量帳與環境受體
knowledge.text: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。
knowledge.textEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water balance and environmental receptors" is correct?
options: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界水量差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary water-balance residual” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為63.8 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 63.8 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為63.8 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 63.8 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水量帳與環境受體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water balance and environmental receptors", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界水量差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary water-balance residual” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water balance and environmental receptors"?
options: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界水量差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary water-balance residual” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。
knowledge.textEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水量帳與環境受體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water balance and environmental receptors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 蘇花改觀音隧道
courses.summary: 公路機關列觀音隧道約7.9公里、雙孔單向配置，並記錄利用舊北迴隧道增加施工工作面。本課從這項既有設施再利用出發，分析地質弱帶、地下水、控制網、施工交通與通風設備介面；貫通和2020年蘇花改全線通車是不同事件，課程不把兩者混為一談。
courses.summaryEn: The highway authority describes Guanyin as approximately 7.9 km with twin directional bores and reuse of an old railway tunnel to create working faces. This course follows weak ground, groundwater, survey, construction traffic and ventilation interfaces. Breakthrough and the 2020 opening of the full Suhua improvement corridor remain distinct events.
courses.focus: 弱帶、多工作面與長隧道系統聯動
courses.focusEn: Weak zones, multiple headings and linked tunnel systems
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0025641 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=5040 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0671952 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0025641 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=5040 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0671952 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 公開工程尺度約為 approximately 7.9 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
2016 年事件：公路機關記錄觀音隧道貫通里程碑。
教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=18.8 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=18.8 min；不是實測或允收值。
教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.002331 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=261.176 t/h；不是實測或允收值。
教學「方向角誤差」：控制長度=5040 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0610865 m；不是實測或允收值。
factsEn: The public scale is about approximately 7.9 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2016 event: The highway authority records a Guanyin Tunnel breakthrough milestone.
Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=18.8 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 18.8 min; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=3e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.002331 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 261.176 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching orientation error: control length=5040 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0610865 m; not measured or accepted project data.
