steps.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rectangular immersed-box frame action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板跨中彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof-span bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略內牆連續性可能錯估支點負彎矩與裂縫位置。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring wall continuity misstates support hogging and crack location. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略內牆連續性可能錯估支點負彎矩與裂縫位置。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring wall continuity misstates support hogging and crack location. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「矩形沉管的框架受力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rectangular immersed-box frame action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
忽略內牆連續性可能錯估支點負彎矩與裂縫位置。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
Ignoring wall continuity misstates support hogging and crack location.
quiz.explanation: 忽略內牆連續性可能錯估支點負彎矩與裂縫位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring wall continuity misstates support hogging and crack location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」與「基床變形與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tow-out mass balance and stability" and "Bedding movement and joint rotation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘浮力」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外海管節浮運需將重量、波浪和流場分開，教材的剩餘浮力只能說明靜態垂直力。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open-sea towing needs separate mass, wave and current assessments; residual buoyancy describes only static vertical force. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents. A mass balance determines net vertical force but does not establish towing stability. Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=13600 m³；總質量=1.35218e+07 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=13600 m³; mass=1.35218e+07 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘浮力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual buoyancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定
knowledge.text: 外海管節浮運需將重量、波浪和流場分開，教材的剩餘浮力只能說明靜態垂直力。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。
knowledge.textEn: Open-sea towing needs separate mass, wave and current assessments; residual buoyancy describes only static vertical force. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tow-out mass balance and stability" is correct?
options: 外海管節浮運需將重量、波浪和流場分開，教材的剩餘浮力只能說明靜態垂直力。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘浮力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual buoyancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=13600 m³；總質量=1.35218e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=4102.54 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17777.7 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17777.7 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual buoyancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同剩餘浮力的兩個壓載配置可能有不同傾斜穩性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two ballast arrangements with equal residual buoyancy can have different heel stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tow-out mass balance and stability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately.
quiz.explanation: 以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tow-out mass balance and stability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘浮力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual buoyancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同剩餘浮力的兩個壓載配置可能有不同傾斜穩性。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two ballast arrangements with equal residual buoyancy can have different heel stability. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相同剩餘浮力的兩個壓載配置可能有不同傾斜穩性。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Two ballast arrangements with equal residual buoyancy can have different heel stability. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮運重量帳與姿態穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tow-out mass balance and stability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 相同剩餘浮力的兩個壓載配置可能有不同傾斜穩性。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Two ballast arrangements with equal residual buoyancy can have different heel stability.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 相同剩餘浮力的兩個壓載配置可能有不同傾斜穩性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two ballast arrangements with equal residual buoyancy can have different heel stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷梯度」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島附近與中央沉管的地層支承不同，教材追蹤差異固結對接頭轉角的影響。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Island approaches and central tubes have different support conditions; trace differential consolidation into joint rotation. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=130 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷梯度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角
knowledge.text: 人工島附近與中央沉管的地層支承不同，教材追蹤差異固結對接頭轉角的影響。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。
knowledge.textEn: Island approaches and central tubes have different support conditions; trace differential consolidation into joint rotation. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基床變形與接頭轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bedding movement and joint rotation" is correct?
options: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
人工島附近與中央沉管的地層支承不同，教材追蹤差異固結對接頭轉角的影響。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
optionsEn: Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
Island approaches and central tubes have different support conditions; trace differential consolidation into joint rotation.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 人工島附近與中央沉管的地層支承不同，教材追蹤差異固結對接頭轉角的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Island approaches and central tubes have different support conditions; trace differential consolidation into joint rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷梯度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=130 m。β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0507692 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0507692 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=130 m。β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0507692 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0507692 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基床變形與接頭轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bedding movement and joint rotation", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=130 m。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=130 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷梯度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只核總沉陷可能漏掉島隧轉換處的局部折角。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Total settlement alone misses local angular distortion at island transitions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。
knowledge.textEn: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基床變形與接頭轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bedding movement and joint rotation"?
options: 按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding movement and joint rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只核總沉陷可能漏掉島隧轉換處的局部折角。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Total settlement alone misses local angular distortion at island transitions. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只核總沉陷可能漏掉島隧轉換處的局部折角。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。
knowledge.textEn: Total settlement alone misses local angular distortion at island transitions. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基床變形與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bedding movement and joint rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只核總沉陷可能漏掉島隧轉換處的局部折角。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Total settlement alone misses local angular distortion at island transitions.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 只核總沉陷可能漏掉島隧轉換處的局部折角。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Total settlement alone misses local angular distortion at island transitions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint compression and sealing envelope" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮餘量」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gasket compression reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長管列的接頭壓縮與閉合段幾何相互限制，教材分開局部水密包絡與全線累積誤差。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint compression and closure geometry interact across the long element chain; separate local seal envelopes from accumulated alignment error. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gasket compression reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水壓縮餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gasket compression reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡
knowledge.text: 長管列的接頭壓縮與閉合段幾何相互限制，教材分開局部水密包絡與全線累積誤差。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。
knowledge.textEn: Joint compression and closure geometry interact across the long element chain; separate local seal envelopes from accumulated alignment error. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint compression and sealing envelope" is correct?
options: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
長管列的接頭壓縮與閉合段幾何相互限制，教材分開局部水密包絡與全線累積誤差。
optionsEn: An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Joint compression and closure geometry interact across the long element chain; separate local seal envelopes from accumulated alignment error.
quiz.explanation: 長管列的接頭壓縮與閉合段幾何相互限制，教材分開局部水密包絡與全線累積誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint compression and closure geometry interact across the long element chain; separate local seal envelopes from accumulated alignment error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水壓縮餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gasket compression reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.82 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.82 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.82 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.82 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint compression and sealing envelope", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水壓縮餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gasket compression reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：全線貫通不證明每個接頭都在水密試驗包絡內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Geometric closure does not prove every joint lies within the tested seal envelope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
knowledge.textEn: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint compression and sealing envelope"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
quiz.explanation: 各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水壓縮餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gasket compression reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 全線貫通不證明每個接頭都在水密試驗包絡內。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Geometric closure does not prove every joint lies within the tested seal envelope. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 全線貫通不證明每個接頭都在水密試驗包絡內。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。
knowledge.textEn: Geometric closure does not prove every joint lies within the tested seal envelope. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint compression and sealing envelope" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
全線貫通不證明每個接頭都在水密試驗包絡內。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Geometric closure does not prove every joint lies within the tested seal envelope.
quiz.explanation: 全線貫通不證明每個接頭都在水密試驗包絡內。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometric closure does not prove every joint lies within the tested seal envelope. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海上沉放量測須處理潮位、姿態和控制網版本，教材研究偏差如何沿管列累積。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Immersion surveying must handle tide, attitude and control revisions; examine accumulated bias along the element chain. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=5160 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 海上沉放量測須處理潮位、姿態和控制網版本，教材研究偏差如何沿管列累積。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Immersion surveying must handle tide, attitude and control revisions; examine accumulated bias along the element chain. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 海上沉放量測須處理潮位、姿態和控制網版本，教材研究偏差如何沿管列累積。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。

optionsEn: Immersion surveying must handle tide, attitude and control revisions; examine accumulated bias along the element chain.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.

quiz.explanationEn: Immersion surveying must handle tide, attitude and control revisions; examine accumulated bias along the element chain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=5160 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0687951 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0687951 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立岸基觀測覆核定位及落底後高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0687951 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。

最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m.

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5160 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立岸基觀測覆核定位及落底後高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：多次觀測若共用錯誤潮位基準，不會自行消除高程偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated observations sharing a wrong tidal datum do not remove elevation bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拘束溫度應變」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 大型預製箱體受早期水化熱與後續降溫，教材把熱應力量級和裂縫水密要求分開。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拘束溫度應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large precast boxes experience hydration heat and later cooling; distinguish thermal-stress scale from crack-watertightness requirements. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained thermal strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拘束溫度應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained thermal strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.7 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.7 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拘束溫度應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained thermal strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。

Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拘束溫度應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained thermal strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。
knowledge.textEn: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal restraint and component cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Box surfaces and joints transport chloride differently; distinguish characteristic diffusion length from reinforcement corrosion initiation. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「擴散特徵長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffusion characteristic length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀
knowledge.text: 外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。
knowledge.textEn: Box surfaces and joints transport chloride differently; distinguish characteristic diffusion length from reinforcement corrosion initiation. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。
optionsEn: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Box surfaces and joints transport chloride differently; distinguish characteristic diffusion length from reinforcement corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Box surfaces and joints transport chloride differently; distinguish characteristic diffusion length from reinforcement corrosion initiation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「擴散特徵長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffusion characteristic length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.0759 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.0759 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。

The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擴散特徵長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffusion characteristic length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高滲透接頭可能控制局部病害，平均擴散值會掩蓋它。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A permeable joint can govern local deterioration concealed by mean diffusivity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
knowledge.textEn: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chloride transport and durability interpretation"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擴散特徵長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffusion characteristic length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高滲透接頭可能控制局部病害，平均擴散值會掩蓋它。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A permeable joint can govern local deterioration concealed by mean diffusivity. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高滲透接頭可能控制局部病害，平均擴散值會掩蓋它。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A permeable joint can govern local deterioration concealed by mean diffusivity. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
高滲透接頭可能控制局部病害，平均擴散值會掩蓋它。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
A permeable joint can govern local deterioration concealed by mean diffusivity.
quiz.explanation: 高滲透接頭可能控制局部病害，平均擴散值會掩蓋它。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A permeable joint can govern local deterioration concealed by mean diffusivity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1220 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
