quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘集水容積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining sump volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system.
quiz.explanation: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00123904 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00123904 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00123904 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00123904 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment redundancy and common failure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統不可用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System unavailability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用出口堵塞會讓兩台正常泵都無法排水。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked common outlet prevents both healthy pumps from discharging. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共用出口堵塞會讓兩台正常泵都無法排水。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。
knowledge.textEn: A blocked common outlet prevents both healthy pumps from discharging. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設備備援與共同失效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equipment redundancy and common failure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
共用出口堵塞會讓兩台正常泵都無法排水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
A blocked common outlet prevents both healthy pumps from discharging.
quiz.explanation: 共用出口堵塞會讓兩台正常泵都無法排水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A blocked common outlet prevents both healthy pumps from discharging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Evacuation time and zone availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為90.4197 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 90.4197 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為90.4197 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 90.4197 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為646.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 646.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為646.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 646.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 首都圈外郭放水路
courses.titleEn: Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel
courses.summary: 首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。
courses.summaryEn: The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing.
courses.focus: 洪水調蓄、跌水豎井與水位控制
courses.focusEn: Flood storage, drop shafts and level control
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，再獨立計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」。原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1370.46 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate flood hydrographs and storage reserve, then independently calculate piezometric head and lining pressure. Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1370.46 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 公開工程尺度約為 6.3 km underground waterway，保留所列來源的計量邊界。

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1245.87 kPa；不是實測或允收值。

Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1245.87 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平流時間」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平流時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water advection time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水體平流時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water advection time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間
knowledge.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time
knowledge.text: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。
knowledge.textEn: The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Underground water routes and travel time" is correct?
options: 水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。
泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
optionsEn: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay.
Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
quiz.explanation: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The channel receives several rivers; use material advection to identify a route while distinguishing flood-wave celerity and control delay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平流時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=26.1111 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為28.7222 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 28.7222 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=26.1111 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為28.7222 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 28.7222 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水路與傳遞時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Underground water routes and travel time", which statement holds?
options: 跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
optionsEn: Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2350 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水體平流時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Underground water routes and travel time"?
options: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。
optionsEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
quiz.explanation: 對齊各支路和出口的流量水位時序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align branch and outlet flow-level histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水體平流時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water advection time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

用交通速度或單一平流時間預測洪峰都會失去水理意義。

Vehicle speed or one advection time cannot predict flood-peak routing.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淨入流調蓄量」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net-inflow storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。調蓄設施以流入減流出的時間積分決定蓄水變化，最大入流量並不單獨決定所需庫容。下游高水位可能限制排水，水位與可用庫容也不是固定比例；需同時檢查初始蓄水、泵站可用性與洪水歷線的時序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨入流調蓄量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow, so peak inflow alone cannot determine required capacity. High downstream levels can restrict discharge, and level is not always proportional to volume. Initial occupancy, pump availability and hydrograph timing must be assessed together rather than assuming the facility starts empty with unrestricted outflow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net-inflow storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淨入流調蓄量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Net-inflow storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量
knowledge.text: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。調蓄設施以流入減流出的時間積分決定蓄水變化，最大入流量並不單獨決定所需庫容。
knowledge.textEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow, so peak inflow alone cannot determine required capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve" is correct?
options: 泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。
optionsEn: Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge.
quiz.explanation: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淨入流調蓄量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net-inflow storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。
頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淨入流調蓄量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Net-inflow storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。將入出流歷線與水位庫容曲線閉合，測試不同初始水位和下游回水，檢查流量資料的時間間隔。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Close inflow-outflow hydrographs against the level-volume curve, test initial levels and downstream backwater and check sampling intervals. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「淨入流調蓄量」的交付需回答：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。交付可重算的逐時水量帳，標記起始水位、泵狀態與邊界洪水；控制決策依核准模型和即時量測而非單段算式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the net-inflow storage handover must address the following evidence: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Deliver a reproducible time-step balance with initial level, pump state and boundary flood; control decisions use approved models and observations, not one interval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
