quiz.explanationEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」與「豎井跌水與能量消散」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" and "Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滿管沿程損失」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-pipe friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滿管沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-pipe friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滿管沿程損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Full-pipe friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界
knowledge.text: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。
knowledge.textEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" is correct?
options: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
optionsEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
quiz.explanation: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滿管沿程損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-pipe friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.65189 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.65189 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.65189 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.65189 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m.
Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滿管沿程損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-pipe friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states.
quiz.explanation: 以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滿管沿程損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-pipe friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
optionsEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
quiz.explanation: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跌水位能通量」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop potential-energy flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 入流豎井把高程能轉成紊流和壓力，教材算位能通量而不是提升機功率或井壁均壓。水流進入豎井時把高程能轉成速度、紊流與壓力波動，空氣捲入和排氣路徑會改變流況。位能通量只能估計需處理的能量量級，不能由此直接求井壁衝擊壓；進流偏心、淹沒與下游回水需實體或數值水理驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跌水位能通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inlet shafts convert elevation energy into turbulence and pressure; calculate potential-energy flux rather than hoist power or uniform wall pressure. Flow entering a shaft converts elevation energy into velocity, turbulence and fluctuating pressure, while entrainment and ventilation change the regime. Potential-energy flux estimates the scale to be dissipated but cannot directly give wall impact pressure. Eccentric entry, submergence and downstream backwater require physical or numerical hydraulic validation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop potential-energy flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；流量=20 m³/s；跌水高度=30 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; flow=20 m³/s; drop=30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跌水位能通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散
knowledge.text: 入流豎井把高程能轉成紊流和壓力，教材算位能通量而不是提升機功率或井壁均壓。水流進入豎井時把高程能轉成速度、紊流與壓力波動，空氣捲入和排氣路徑會改變流況。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop potential-energy flux” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；流量=20 m³/s；跌水高度=30 m。P=ρgQH/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=5886 kW。僅把流量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6474.6 kW。邊界：位能通量，不是井壁壓力或發電輸出；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; flow=20 m³/s; drop=30 m. P=ρgQH/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=5886 kW. Increasing only flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6474.6 kW. Boundary: Potential-energy flux, not shaft-wall pressure or electrical output. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise drop flow, air pressure and local pressure fluctuations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跌水位能通量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drop potential-energy flux” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。同步量測進出流、水位、井內氣壓和局部壓力脈動，比較淹沒前後工況並檢查取樣頻率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise drop flow, air pressure and local pressure fluctuations. Synchronise flow, levels, internal air pressure and local pressure fluctuations, comparing submerged and free discharge with adequate sampling frequency. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「跌水位能通量」的交付需回答：同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。分開交付能量帳、局部壓力和通氣模型，任何流況切換都核對上下游與氣相邊界，不以提升機功率代替水理分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the drop potential-energy flux handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise drop flow, air pressure and local pressure fluctuations. Deliver energy balance, local-pressure and ventilation models separately; check liquid and air boundaries at regime changes rather than substituting hoist-power calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「豎井跌水與能量消散」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跌水位能通量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop potential-energy flux” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。忽略氣路阻塞會低估水位及壓力波動，僅用平均能量可能掩蓋局部衝擊和間歇流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Ignoring a blocked air path underestimates level and pressure fluctuations; average energy can conceal local impact and intermittent flow. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：位能通量只能估計需處理的能量量級，不能由此直接求井壁衝擊壓；進流偏心、淹沒與下游回水需實體或數值水理驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Eccentric entry, submergence and downstream backwater require physical or numerical hydraulic validation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。忽略氣路阻塞會低估水位及壓力波動，僅用平均能量可能掩蓋局部衝擊和間歇流。
knowledge.textEn: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Ignoring a blocked air path underestimates level and pressure fluctuations; average energy can conceal local impact and intermittent flow.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「豎井跌水與能量消散」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。
頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
quiz.explanation: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof load transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調壓大廳頂板經柱網傳力，教材條帶彎矩不取代整體框架、柱頭沖切和底板抗浮。大型地下調壓或蓄水大廳的頂板把覆土和自身重量傳到柱牆，再傳給基礎；水壓改變時底板與頂板的作用也不同。單向條帶只是局部彎矩示例，柱網、沖切、框架拘束、基礎變形及施工回填順序都需要整體模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂板荷載傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pressure-control hall roof transfers load through columns; strip bending does not replace global, punching or flotation checks. A one-way strip illustrates local bending only; column layout, punching, frame restraint, foundation movement and backfilling sequence require a global structural model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof load transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂板荷載傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roof load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對柱網、回填、板撓度與柱軸力。核對柱網、板厚及回填紀錄，將柱軸力、板撓度與裂縫位置聯合判讀，不把單一應變點視為整體反應。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check column layout, backfill, slab deflection and column force. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Label the strip calculation as local and list global frame, punching and flotation evidence separately, reconciling loads for each construction and water-level stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A uniformly loaded roof model cannot establish flotation stability of the hall. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 地下大廳頂板與支承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Underground hall roofs and supports: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板荷載傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。漏掉局部柱頭作用會在平均彎矩不大時仍低估沖切風險，差異沉陷則可能把荷載重新分配到少數支承。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A uniformly loaded roof model cannot establish flotation stability of the hall. Missing column-head effects underestimates punching despite modest mean bending, while differential settlement redistributes load to fewer supports. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單向條帶只是局部彎矩示例，柱網、沖切、框架拘束、基礎變形及施工回填順序都需要整體模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A one-way strip illustrates local bending only; column layout, punching, frame restraint, foundation movement and backfilling sequence require a global structural model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。漏掉局部柱頭作用會在平均彎矩不大時仍低估沖切風險，差異沉陷則可能把荷載重新分配到少數支承。
knowledge.textEn: A uniformly loaded roof model cannot establish flotation stability of the hall. Missing column-head effects underestimates punching despite modest mean bending, while differential settlement redistributes load to fewer supports.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下大廳頂板與支承」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Underground hall roofs and supports" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A uniformly loaded roof model cannot establish flotation stability of the hall.
quiz.explanation: 頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A uniformly loaded roof model cannot establish flotation stability of the hall. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下水位與內部洪水位可分別變動，教材將放空時外壓和充水時淨內壓分開。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Groundwater and internal flood level vary independently; distinguish external pressure when empty from net internal pressure when filled. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Groundwater and internal flood level vary independently; distinguish external pressure when empty from net internal pressure when filled.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看內水位會漏掉空槽時外部地下水控制作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal level alone misses groundwater control when the tank is empty. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison.
quiz.explanation: 將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看內水位會漏掉空槽時外部地下水控制作用。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal level alone misses groundwater control when the tank is empty. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看內水位會漏掉空槽時外部地下水控制作用。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Internal level alone misses groundwater control when the tank is empty. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只看內水位會漏掉空槽時外部地下水控制作用。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Internal level alone misses groundwater control when the tank is empty.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 只看內水位會漏掉空槽時外部地下水控制作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal level alone misses groundwater control when the tank is empty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「水位基準與庫容誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Level datum and volume uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。
多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage.
Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
quiz.explanation: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.59886 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.59886 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.59886 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.59886 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

steps.instruction: 多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。多支感測器共用錯誤高程可互相比對一致，卻一致高估剩餘庫容，使控制系統遲判水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. Several sensors sharing a wrong datum can agree while overestimating remaining volume and delaying recognition of rising water. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水位誤差乘局部面積可估計一階庫容偏差；若斷面變寬或分艙逐次連通，必須使用完整水位庫容曲線，而非假設全程固定面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Widening sections and sequentially connected compartments require the full level-volume relation rather than a constant area across the operating range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. Several sensors sharing a wrong datum can agree while overestimating remaining volume and delaying recognition of rising water.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水位基準與庫容誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level datum and volume uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement.
quiz.explanation: 多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備備援與共同失效」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment redundancy and common failure" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪泵組可用性還取決於供電、出口水頭和共用設備，教材獨立並聯式只作下限模型。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flood-pump availability also depends on power, discharge head and shared assets; the independent-parallel equation is only a restricted model. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.033 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.033 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 防洪泵組可用性還取決於供電、出口水頭和共用設備，教材獨立並聯式只作下限模型。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Flood-pump availability also depends on power, discharge head and shared assets; the independent-parallel equation is only a restricted model. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 防洪泵組可用性還取決於供電、出口水頭和共用設備，教材獨立並聯式只作下限模型。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Flood-pump availability also depends on power, discharge head and shared assets; the independent-parallel equation is only a restricted model.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 防洪泵組可用性還取決於供電、出口水頭和共用設備，教材獨立並聯式只作下限模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flood-pump availability also depends on power, discharge head and shared assets; the independent-parallel equation is only a restricted model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.033 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001089 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00131769 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.033 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001089 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00131769 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.033 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001089 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00131769 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.033 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001089 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00131769 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.033 無因次。
跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
optionsEn: Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.033 dimensionless.
Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.033 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.033 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統不可用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩泵正常仍可能因同一高下游水位無法達名目出流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two healthy pumps may fail to achieve rated flow against the same high tailwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment redundancy and common failure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
