steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪水事件紀錄需連接雨量、閘門、水位和泵站狀態，教材以事件時間軸檢查資料完整與可追溯性。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flood records must link rainfall, gates, levels and pump state; use an event timeline to check completeness and traceability. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 洪水事件紀錄需連接雨量、閘門、水位和泵站狀態，教材以事件時間軸檢查資料完整與可追溯性。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Flood records must link rainfall, gates, levels and pump state; use an event timeline to check completeness and traceability. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
洪水事件紀錄需連接雨量、閘門、水位和泵站狀態，教材以事件時間軸檢查資料完整與可追溯性。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Flood records must link rainfall, gates, levels and pump state; use an event timeline to check completeness and traceability.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 洪水事件紀錄需連接雨量、閘門、水位和泵站狀態，教材以事件時間軸檢查資料完整與可追溯性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flood records must link rainfall, gates, levels and pump state; use an event timeline to check completeness and traceability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.6911 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.6911 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.6911 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.6911 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 新加坡裕廊岩洞
courses.summary: JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。
courses.summaryEn: JTC describes 1.47 million cubic metres of liquid-hydrocarbon storage and distinguishes depth below ground from depth beneath the seabed; the PMO records the 2014 opening. The course moves from land interfaces and jointed rock to support, hydraulic containment, inventory and monitoring. Geometric area, local pressure difference and hypothetical inventory are not actual land savings or operating limits.
courses.focus: 岩洞楔體、水力封存與產品庫存
courses.focusEn: Cavern wedges, hydraulic containment and product inventory
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，再獨立計算「水力封存與共同高程」。原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate cavern wedges and anchorage, then independently calculate hydraulic containment at a common datum. Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下儲存與地面介面」與「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" and "Cavern wedges and anchorage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何等效面積」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric equivalent area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何等效面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released. Access, firefighting, product pipelines, surface processing and maintenance still require space. Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric equivalent area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何等效面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric equivalent area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下儲存與地面介面
knowledge.text: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。
knowledge.textEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下儲存與地面介面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" is correct?
options: 地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何等效面積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric equivalent area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下儲存與地面介面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「幾何等效面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometric equivalent area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。把洞室、豎井與地面設施分層繪圖，核對容積與占地邊界，分別列幾何面積和實際可使用土地。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Map caverns, shafts and surface facilities separately, reconcile volume and footprint boundaries and distinguish geometric area from usable land. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「幾何等效面積」的交付需回答：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。比較方案時固定功能與配套範圍，將幾何指標標為假設，土地效益由完整總配置與營運需求判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the geometric equivalent area handover must address the following evidence: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Fix function and auxiliary scope when comparing options, label geometric metrics as assumptions and assess land benefit from the full layout and operational requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。把洞室、豎井與地面設施分層繪圖，核對容積與占地邊界，分別列幾何面積和實際可使用土地。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Map caverns, shafts and surface facilities separately, reconcile volume and footprint boundaries and distinguish geometric area from usable land. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「幾何等效面積」的交付需回答：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。比較方案時固定功能與配套範圍，將幾何指標標為假設，土地效益由完整總配置與營運需求判讀。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the geometric equivalent area handover must address the following evidence: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Fix function and auxiliary scope when comparing options, label geometric metrics as assumptions and assess land benefit from the full layout and operational requirements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下儲存與地面介面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces"?
options: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何等效面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric equivalent area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。只用容積除高度宣稱節省土地會漏掉必要配套，可能低估地面通道、維修和消防的空間需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。只用容積除高度宣稱節省土地會漏掉必要配套，可能低估地面通道、維修和消防的空間需求。
knowledge.textEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下儲存與地面介面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「楔體重力分擔」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge self-weight sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「楔體重力分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong. Equal weight sharing estimates anchorage force scale only. Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wedge self-weight sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「楔體重力分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wedge self-weight sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固
knowledge.text: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。
knowledge.textEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cavern wedges and anchorage" is correct?
options: 錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。
optionsEn: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「楔體重力分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge self-weight sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cavern wedges and anchorage", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「楔體重力分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge self-weight sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。由掌子面和洞頂節理測繪重建三維塊體，配合錨桿試驗與伸長量檢查受力方向和有效錨固區。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Reconstruct three-dimensional blocks from face and roof mapping, combining anchor tests and extension measurements to check force direction and effective bonded zones. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「楔體重力分擔」的交付需回答：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。錨固圖與三維節理模型連結，標示試驗代表性及未知延伸，幾何改變後由岩力設計者重驗失穩模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。由掌子面和洞頂節理測繪重建三維塊體，配合錨桿試驗與伸長量檢查受力方向和有效錨固區。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Reconstruct three-dimensional blocks from face and roof mapping, combining anchor tests and extension measurements to check force direction and effective bonded zones. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「楔體重力分擔」的交付需回答：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。錨固圖與三維節理模型連結，標示試驗代表性及未知延伸，幾何改變後由岩力設計者重驗失穩模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cavern wedges and anchorage"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「楔體重力分擔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge self-weight sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。
knowledge.textEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cavern wedges and anchorage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint.
quiz.explanation: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」與「支護啟動與變形容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover stress and wall redistribution" and "Support activation and deformation capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配
knowledge.text: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。
knowledge.textEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.296 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.296 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.296 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.296 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio.
quiz.explanation: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=432 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為475.2 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=432 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 475.2 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「水力封存與共同高程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Hydraulic containment at a common datum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage.
quiz.explanation: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。
