全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment.
quiz.explanation: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部向內壓差」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local inward pressure difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。岩洞液體儲存可利用周圍地下水壓維持向洞內的水力梯度，但產品液柱、氣相壓力和不同高程都影響壓差。單一測點正壓差不證明整座岩洞封存；裂隙連通、操作水位、瞬變及水幕補注的空間分布須共同驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部向內壓差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. Liquid storage in rock can use surrounding groundwater pressure to maintain an inward hydraulic gradient, but product head, gas pressure and elevation affect the difference. A positive value at one point does not prove containment of the entire cavern. Fracture connectivity, operating levels, transients and the spatial distribution of water replenishment require joint assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local inward pressure difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部向內壓差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local inward pressure difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力封存與共同高程
knowledge.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum
knowledge.text: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。岩洞液體儲存可利用周圍地下水壓維持向洞內的水力梯度，但產品液柱、氣相壓力和不同高程都影響壓差。
knowledge.textEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. Liquid storage in rock can use surrounding groundwater pressure to maintain an inward hydraulic gradient, but product head, gas pressure and elevation affect the difference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力封存與共同高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic containment at a common datum" is correct?
options: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部向內壓差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local inward pressure difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水力封存與共同高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic containment at a common datum", which statement holds?
options: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。
地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
optionsEn: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部向內壓差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local inward pressure difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。將外側測壓、產品液位與氣壓換到同一高程和壓力基準，沿洞頂與側牆多點比較並觀察時間變化。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Convert external head, product level and gas pressure to one elevation and pressure reference, comparing multiple roof and wall locations over time. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「局部向內壓差」的交付需回答：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。封存評估交付共同高程壓力圖、裂隙模型與操作範圍，監測和水力試驗互驗，不能以單一靜壓式核准操作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the local inward pressure difference handover must address the following evidence: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Containment assessment includes common-datum pressure maps, fracture models and operating bounds; monitoring and hydraulic tests corroborate each other beyond one static equation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。將外側測壓、產品液位與氣壓換到同一高程和壓力基準，沿洞頂與側牆多點比較並觀察時間變化。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Convert external head, product level and gas pressure to one elevation and pressure reference, comparing multiple roof and wall locations over time. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「局部向內壓差」的交付需回答：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。封存評估交付共同高程壓力圖、裂隙模型與操作範圍，監測和水力試驗互驗，不能以單一靜壓式核准操作。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the local inward pressure difference handover must address the following evidence: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Containment assessment includes common-datum pressure maps, fracture models and operating bounds; monitoring and hydraulic tests corroborate each other beyond one static equation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水力封存與共同高程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic containment at a common datum"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部向內壓差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local inward pressure difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。漏計氣相表壓會高估向內梯度，低水頭裂隙即使離主要測點不遠也可能形成局部向外路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Omitting gas gauge pressure overstates inward gradient; a low-head fracture near a main sensor can still create a local outward path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一測點正壓差不證明整座岩洞封存；裂隙連通、操作水位、瞬變及水幕補注的空間分布須共同驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fracture connectivity, operating levels, transients and the spatial distribution of water replenishment require joint assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。漏計氣相表壓會高估向內梯度，低水頭裂隙即使離主要測點不遠也可能形成局部向外路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Omitting gas gauge pressure overstates inward gradient; a low-head fracture near a main sensor can still create a local outward path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水力封存與共同高程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic containment at a common datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storage capacity and product inventory" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用庫存空間」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Available inventory space” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。岩洞總幾何容積不等於可裝產品量，既有庫存、保留氣相及不可使用區域都需扣除。液體熱膨脹與密度使體積帳和質量帳不同，轉運時還要處理管線存量；簡單差額只適用同一溫度、同一邊界與明確保留空間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用庫存空間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. Gross cavern volume is not the amount available for product: existing stock, vapour reserve and unusable regions must be deducted. Thermal expansion and density distinguish volume from mass balances, while transfers involve pipeline inventory. A simple difference applies only at the same temperature, within one boundary and with explicitly reserved space. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Available inventory space” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用庫存空間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Available inventory space”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳
knowledge.text: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。岩洞總幾何容積不等於可裝產品量，既有庫存、保留氣相及不可使用區域都需扣除。
knowledge.textEn: Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. Gross cavern volume is not the amount available for product: existing stock, vapour reserve and unusable regions must be deducted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storage capacity and product inventory" is correct?
options: 總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用庫存空間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Available inventory space” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³。僅把既有庫存增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20860 m³。邊界：假想同溫單室庫存帳，不是裕廊實際操作上限；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³. Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³. Increasing only existing stock by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20860 m³. Boundary: Hypothetical same-temperature cavern balance, not Jurong operating limits. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³。僅把既有庫存增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20860 m³。邊界：假想同溫單室庫存帳，不是裕廊實際操作上限；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³. Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³. Increasing only existing stock by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20860 m³. Boundary: Hypothetical same-temperature cavern balance, not Jurong operating limits. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storage capacity and product inventory", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用庫存空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Available inventory space” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。以液位容積表、溫度與密度重建庫存，將管線轉運量和洞室量分開，再閉合進出質量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Reconstruct inventory from calibrated level-volume tables, temperature and density, separate pipeline and cavern volumes and close the inlet-outlet mass balance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「可用庫存空間」的交付需回答：配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。庫存交付明列溫度基準、保留空間和管線邊界，操作上限以核准設計與程序為準，教材差額僅供帳目理解。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the available inventory space handover must address the following evidence: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Inventory records state temperature reference, reserved space and pipeline boundary; approved design and procedures determine operating limits, while the classroom difference illustrates accounting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。以液位容積表、溫度與密度重建庫存，將管線轉運量和洞室量分開，再閉合進出質量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Reconstruct inventory from calibrated level-volume tables, temperature and density, separate pipeline and cavern volumes and close the inlet-outlet mass balance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「可用庫存空間」的交付需回答：配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。庫存交付明列溫度基準、保留空間和管線邊界，操作上限以核准設計與程序為準，教材差額僅供帳目理解。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the available inventory space handover must address the following evidence: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Inventory records state temperature reference, reserved space and pipeline boundary; approved design and procedures determine operating limits, while the classroom difference illustrates accounting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storage capacity and product inventory"?
options: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用庫存空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Available inventory space” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。不同溫度的體積直接相減會產生假性損失，漏列氣相保留量則高估可用空間並扭曲排程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. Subtracting volumes at different temperatures creates apparent losses, while omitted vapour reserve overstates available space and distorts scheduling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：液體熱膨脹與密度使體積帳和質量帳不同，轉運時還要處理管線存量；簡單差額只適用同一溫度、同一邊界與明確保留空間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A simple difference applies only at the same temperature, within one boundary and with explicitly reserved space.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞室與地面設備的共同高程直接影響靜壓比較，教材研究深部水準基準偏移的封存後果。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A shared elevation datum between cavern and surface equipment directly affects pressure comparison; examine consequences of deep benchmark bias. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=5880 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
A shared elevation datum between cavern and surface equipment directly affects pressure comparison; examine consequences of deep benchmark bias.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=5880 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0846659 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5880 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0846659 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0846659 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5880 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。

Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5880 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong.
quiz.explanation: 同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水量帳與環境受體」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water balance and environmental receptors" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊界水量差」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary water-balance residual” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界水量差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary water-balance residual” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界水量差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundary water-balance residual”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水量帳與環境受體
knowledge.text: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。
knowledge.textEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water balance and environmental receptors" is correct?
options: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界水量差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary water-balance residual” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為91.2 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 91.2 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為91.2 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 91.2 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水量帳與環境受體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water balance and environmental receptors", which statement holds?
options: 錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界水量差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary water-balance residual” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water balance and environmental receptors"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps.
quiz.explanation: 以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界水量差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary water-balance residual” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。
knowledge.textEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水量帳與環境受體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water balance and environmental receptors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 產品儲存設備與岩體監測必須連接位置及狀態，教材把產品庫存表、測壓和支護檢查放在同一可追溯鏈。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link product-system records and rock monitoring by location and state, connecting inventory, pressure and support inspections traceably. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 產品儲存設備與岩體監測必須連接位置及狀態，教材把產品庫存表、測壓和支護檢查放在同一可追溯鏈。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Link product-system records and rock monitoring by location and state, connecting inventory, pressure and support inspections traceably. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
產品儲存設備與岩體監測必須連接位置及狀態，教材把產品庫存表、測壓和支護檢查放在同一可追溯鏈。
地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Link product-system records and rock monitoring by location and state, connecting inventory, pressure and support inspections traceably.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
quiz.explanation: 產品儲存設備與岩體監測必須連接位置及狀態，教材把產品庫存表、測壓和支護檢查放在同一可追溯鏈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Link product-system records and rock monitoring by location and state, connecting inventory, pressure and support inspections traceably. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.8065 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.8065 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.8065 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.8065 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。
地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
quiz.explanation: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 隧道超前探測鑽孔
courses.titleEn: Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型
courses.focusEn: Build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。
教學量化備忘：假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。
教學量化備忘：假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。
教學量化備忘：假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。
教學量化備忘：假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。
教學量化備忘：假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work.
Teaching quantitative note: With assumed return volume 0.15 m³ and flow 0.003 m³/s, mean delay is 50 s; advancement at 0.01 m/s shifts assigned depth by 0.50 m.
Teaching quantitative note: Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head.
