stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「探測目標與盲區」與「孔跡與角度誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Targets and blind zones" and "Trajectory and angular error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「探測目標與盲區」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Targets and blind zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。 假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「探測目標與盲區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long. Separate the questions of lithological boundaries, water-bearing zones and voids, then check whether the planned trajectories actually intersect each target. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Targets and blind zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「探測目標與盲區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Targets and blind zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 探測目標與盲區
knowledge.text: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「探測目標與盲區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Targets and blind zones" is correct?
options: 鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。
超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
quiz.explanation: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「探測目標與盲區」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Targets and blind zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「探測目標與盲區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Targets and blind zones", which statement holds?
options: 岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。
兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth.
Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「探測目標與盲區」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Targets and blind zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。
knowledge.textEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。
knowledge.textEn: Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.

quiz.question: 要驗證「探測目標與盲區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Targets and blind zones"?
options: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
optionsEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
quiz.explanation: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「探測目標與盲區」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Targets and blind zones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
knowledge.textEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「探測目標與盲區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Targets and blind zones" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
quiz.explanation: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔跡與角度誤差」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trajectory and angular error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。 假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔跡與角度誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction. A small angular bias produces a substantial positional difference over a long hole, so an interpreted contact needs trajectory quality as well as rod length. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trajectory and angular error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

knowledge.title: 孔跡與角度誤差
knowledge.text: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。
knowledge.textEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔跡與角度誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trajectory and angular error" is correct?

比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。

optionsEn: A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling.
quiz.explanation: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔跡與角度誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔跡與角度誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trajectory and angular error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。把正反向讀值和已知控制段比較，釐清系統偏差；地層位置的允收精度須由調查目的訂定，不能只引用儀器型錄精度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey. Retain station spacing and compare reverse readings with a known control interval. Specify acceptable contact-location uncertainty from the investigation purpose rather than the instrument brochure alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接孔跡時提供原始角度、坐標基準、修正方法及誤差範圍，讓設計者重建地層位置；大於目的精度的偏差由測量主管核准處置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Deliver raw angles, coordinate datum, correction method and uncertainty so the designer can reconstruct contacts; the survey lead must resolve deviations exceeding the purpose-specific positional requirement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔跡與角度誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Trajectory and angular error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drilling specific energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 扭矩與轉速提供破岩功率，除以切削體積速率得到旋轉比能。比能上升可能來自硬岩，也可能是磨鈍鑽頭、孔壁摩擦或堵塞；只有在鑽具與操作條件可比時，才可把趨勢視為地質線索。 假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鑽進比能辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Torque and rotation give cutting power, which divided by excavated volume rate gives rotational specific energy. Rising energy may indicate harder rock, but also a worn bit, wall friction or blockage. Geological interpretation therefore requires comparable tooling and operating conditions. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work. Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drilling specific energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 岩屑到達孔口時已落後鑽頭位置，且不同粒徑在回流中速度不同。若依回收時間直接指定地層深度，薄弱夾層會被向深處平移並混合；回流路徑、流量與沉積需要共同解釋。 假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩屑輸送延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cuttings transport lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Synchronize flow metering, drilling records and sample clocks, checking estimated delay against identifiable lithological transitions. Record a mixing interval rather than a single depth and compare an adjacent core hole. Reassess a constant lag correction when returns become intermittent or downhole settling increases. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：取樣標籤同時保留回收時間、估計來源深度區間和回流狀態；無法校正的混樣交由地質師判定用途，不作精確界面定位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Sample labels must retain recovery time, estimated source interval and return condition; the geologist decides uses for unresolved mixed samples, which cannot locate a precise contact.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩屑輸送延遲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cuttings transport lag"?
options: 把流量計、鑽進記錄與取樣時鐘同步，利用可辨識岩性轉換核對延遲估算。

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize flow metering, drilling records and sample clocks, checking estimated delay against identifiable lithological transitions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩屑輸送延遲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cuttings transport lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩屑輸送延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cuttings transport lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. Thin layers can be averaged away, producing a precise-looking warning chainage after the critical interval has passed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thin layers can be averaged away, producing a precise-looking warning chainage after the critical interval has passed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。
knowledge.textEn: Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. Thin layers can be averaged away, producing a precise-looking warning chainage after the critical interval has passed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩屑輸送延遲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cuttings transport lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。
返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones.
Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow.
quiz.explanation: 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「返水流量收支」與「水頭與壓力換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Return-flow balance" and "Head and pressure conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 返水流量收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Return-flow balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「返水流量收支」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return-flow balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 進水與返水差額反映孔內儲存、裂隙吸水或外部湧入的合成效應，並不是裂隙滲透係數本身。鑽進速度與孔內容積變化會使短時間收支失衡，應先閉合水量帳再提出水文假說。 假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。 流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「返水流量收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The difference between supply and return reflects changing storage, fracture losses and external inflow, not permeability alone. Advancement and changing hole volume disturb short-term balance. Close the water account before proposing a hydrogeological interpretation. Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow. Meter zero drift can create false inflow, while missed returns conceal real inflow. Extrapolating an unclosed water balance into tunnel-wide inflow gives a misleading treatment-capacity estimate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Return-flow balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「返水流量收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Return-flow balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 返水流量收支
knowledge.text: 進水與返水差額反映孔內儲存、裂隙吸水或外部湧入的合成效應，並不是裂隙滲透係數本身。鑽進速度與孔內容積變化會使短時間收支失衡，應先閉合水量帳再提出水文假說。
knowledge.textEn: The difference between supply and return reflects changing storage, fracture losses and external inflow, not permeability alone. Advancement and changing hole volume disturb short-term balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「返水流量收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Return-flow balance" is correct?
options: 返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。
兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。
進水與返水差額反映孔內儲存、裂隙吸水或外部湧入的合成效應，並不是裂隙滲透係數本身。
optionsEn: Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow.
Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
The difference between supply and return reflects changing storage, fracture losses and external inflow, not permeability alone.
quiz.explanation: 進水與返水差額反映孔內儲存、裂隙吸水或外部湧入的合成效應，並不是裂隙滲透係數本身。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The difference between supply and return reflects changing storage, fracture losses and external inflow, not permeability alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 返水流量收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Return-flow balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「返水流量收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Return-flow balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校準容積槽或流量計核對供回水兩側，註記接桿、停機及沖洗時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check both supply and return using calibrated tanks or meters and mark rod changes, stoppages and flushing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設穩態供水20 L/min、返水27 L/min，淨流入7 L/min=0.117 L/s；未扣孔內儲存時不能稱穩態湧水量。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed steady supply of 20 L/min and return of 27 L/min imply net inflow 7 L/min=0.117 L/s; without a storage correction it is not steady groundwater inflow.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「返水流量收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Return-flow balance", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。

optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
Delivering the entire investigation report means all geological risk has disappeared.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以校準容積槽或流量計核對供回水兩側，註記接桿、停機及沖洗時段。比較同長時間窗的累積量並估計孔內儲存變化；水文工程師只有在穩態條件及漏失路徑獲得確認後，才接受該差額作為外來水證據。
knowledge.textEn: Check both supply and return using calibrated tanks or meters and mark rod changes, stoppages and flushing. Compare cumulative quantities over matching windows and estimate storage changes. The hydrogeologist accepts the difference as external inflow evidence only after confirming steady conditions and accounting for losses.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把水量平衡與地層里程分開保留原始檔，異常先查儀器與儲存再查地質；新增水文風險由主管工程師審查後調整預案。
knowledge.textEn: Keep original water balances and geology chainage separately; investigate instruments and storage before attributing anomalies to geology, and obtain engineering review before changing the water-risk response.

quiz.question: 要驗證「返水流量收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Return-flow balance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以校準容積槽或流量計核對供回水兩側，註記接桿、停機及沖洗時段。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check both supply and return using calibrated tanks or meters and mark rod changes, stoppages and flushing.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
quiz.explanation: 以校準容積槽或流量計核對供回水兩側，註記接桿、停機及沖洗時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check both supply and return using calibrated tanks or meters and mark rod changes, stoppages and flushing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 返水流量收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Return-flow balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「返水流量收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Return-flow balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Meter zero drift can create false inflow, while missed returns conceal real inflow. Extrapolating an unclosed water balance into tunnel-wide inflow gives a misleading treatment-capacity estimate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extrapolating an unclosed water balance into tunnel-wide inflow gives a misleading treatment-capacity estimate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「返水流量收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Return-flow balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。
流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
Meter zero drift can create false inflow, while missed returns conceal real inflow.
quiz.explanation: 流量感測器零點漂移可能製造假湧水，漏接返水則會掩蓋真流入；把未閉合水量直接外推成隧道總湧水量，會造成處理容量判斷失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Meter zero drift can create false inflow, while missed returns conceal real inflow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭與壓力換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head and pressure conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭與壓力換算」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head and pressure conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的孔口壓力須配合高程基準才能形成水頭；壓力水頭與高程水頭不能任選其一。停流壓力也會受管路損失與等待時間影響，故量測系統和地下水系統必須分開建模。 假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。 只比較不同高程的表壓可能把同一水頭誤判成壓力異常；殘留氣泡或管路堵塞又會拖慢響應，使停流後的短暫值被當成原位水壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭與壓力換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collar pressure requires a common elevation datum to become hydraulic head; pressure head and elevation head are complementary. Shut-in readings depend on line losses and equilibration time, so distinguish the measuring system from the groundwater system. For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head. Comparing gauge pressures at different elevations can falsely indicate anomalous groundwater. Air bubbles or blocked lines delay response and make a transient shut-in value appear to be in-situ pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head and pressure conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭與壓力換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head and pressure conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭與壓力換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head and pressure conversion" is correct?

單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。
optionsEn: Collar pressure requires a common elevation datum to become hydraulic head; pressure head and elevation head are complementary.
Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel.

steps.title: 水頭與壓力換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head and pressure conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭與壓力換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head and pressure conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水ρ=1000 kg/m³、壓力490 kPa，壓力水頭p/(ρg)=49.95 m；總水頭另加測點高程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用有校準紀錄的壓力感測器並測定其高程，圖示觀測時間與壓力變化是否趨平。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a calibrated pressure sensor with surveyed elevation and plot stabilization over time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed fresh water with ρ=1000 kg/m³ and p=490 kPa, pressure head p/(ρg)=49.95 m; add sensor elevation to obtain total head.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭與壓力換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 回收率高就能證明岩體沒有節理或軟弱夾層。

Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 水頭與壓力換算：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭與壓力換算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head and pressure conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用有校準紀錄的壓力感測器並測定其高程，圖示觀測時間與壓力變化是否趨平。以第二量程或獨立水位觀測查核，將淡水密度及溫度假設列入誤差表；量到穩定數值仍需工程師確認測點與目標含水層的連通性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a calibrated pressure sensor with surveyed elevation and plot stabilization over time. A stable number still requires engineering confirmation that the observation communicates with the intended water-bearing zone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing gauge pressures at different elevations can falsely indicate anomalous groundwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂隙導水與尺度」與「多證據更新機率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fracture flow and scale" and "Updating with multiple evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂隙導水與尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fracture flow and scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂隙導水與尺度」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fracture flow and scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單孔試驗只感受到與孔壁連通的裂隙網路，遠方未連通的高導水帶不一定被看見。等效滲透係數把複雜通道平均化，流速與邊界條件改變後，該平均值未必仍可直接移用。 假設Darcy條件k=10⁻⁶ m/s、面積2 m²、梯度5，Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s；裂隙慣性流不適用。 若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂隙導水與尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single-hole test senses fractures connected to its wall and may miss a distant conductive zone. Equivalent permeability averages a complex channel network. Changing velocity or boundaries can invalidate transfer of that average to a different scale. Assume Darcy conditions with k=10⁻⁶ m/s, area 2 m² and gradient 5. Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s; inertial fracture flow falls outside this model. A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. Conversely, disturbance at the borehole wall may exaggerate connectivity that is absent in the undisturbed rock mass. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fracture flow and scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂隙導水與尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fracture flow and scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂隙導水與尺度
knowledge.text: 單孔試驗只感受到與孔壁連通的裂隙網路，遠方未連通的高導水帶不一定被看見。等效滲透係數把複雜通道平均化，流速與邊界條件改變後，該平均值未必仍可直接移用。
knowledge.textEn: A single-hole test senses fractures connected to its wall and may miss a distant conductive zone. Equivalent permeability averages a complex channel network.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂隙導水與尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fracture flow and scale" is correct?
options: 單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。
單孔試驗只感受到與孔壁連通的裂隙網路，遠方未連通的高導水帶不一定被看見。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
optionsEn: A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel.
A single-hole test senses fractures connected to its wall and may miss a distant conductive zone.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
quiz.explanation: 單孔試驗只感受到與孔壁連通的裂隙網路，遠方未連通的高導水帶不一定被看見。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-hole test senses fractures connected to its wall and may miss a distant conductive zone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂隙導水與尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fracture flow and scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂隙導水與尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fracture flow and scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Darcy條件k=10⁻⁶ m/s、面積2 m²、梯度5，Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s；裂隙慣性流不適用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Darcy conditions with k=10⁻⁶ m/s, area 2 m² and gradient 5. Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s; inertial fracture flow falls outside this model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把試驗區間、壓差與流量同圖呈現，檢查升降階段是否可逆並與孔內影像的裂隙位置比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot test interval, differential pressure and flow together, checking reversibility and comparing imaged fractures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Darcy條件k=10⁻⁶ m/s、面積2 m²、梯度5，Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s；裂隙慣性流不適用。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Darcy conditions with k=10⁻⁶ m/s, area 2 m² and gradient 5. Q=kAi=10⁻⁵ m³/s=0.01 L/s; inertial fracture flow falls outside this model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂隙導水與尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fracture flow and scale", which statement holds?
options: 調查報告交付百分之百就等於所有地質風險已消失。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Delivering the entire investigation report means all geological risk has disappeared.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂隙導水與尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture flow and scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂隙導水與尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fracture flow and scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把試驗區間、壓差與流量同圖呈現，檢查升降階段是否可逆並與孔內影像的裂隙位置比較。量測結果應附模型、觀測尺度及邊界條件；若關係非線性或出現滯後，不以單一斜率當成可外推的材料常數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot test interval, differential pressure and flow together, checking reversibility and comparing imaged fractures. Report model, scale and boundary conditions with the result. Nonlinearity or hysteresis prevents one fitted slope from being accepted as a transferable material constant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：報告同時交付原始流量壓力曲線與可替代模型，要求水文工程師說明尺度轉換依據；不把本課的假設梯度當作試驗壓力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Deliver raw pressure-flow curves with alternative interpretations and require a hydrogeologist to justify scale transfer; the assumed gradient in this exercise is not a test-pressure instruction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把試驗區間、壓差與流量同圖呈現，檢查升降階段是否可逆並與孔內影像的裂隙位置比較。量測結果應附模型、觀測尺度及邊界條件；若關係非線性或出現滯後，不以單一斜率當成可外推的材料常數。
knowledge.textEn: Plot test interval, differential pressure and flow together, checking reversibility and comparing imaged fractures. Report model, scale and boundary conditions with the result. Nonlinearity or hysteresis prevents one fitted slope from being accepted as a transferable material constant.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 報告同時交付原始流量壓力曲線與可替代模型，要求水文工程師說明尺度轉換依據；不把本課的假設梯度當作試驗壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Deliver raw pressure-flow curves with alternative interpretations and require a hydrogeologist to justify scale transfer; the assumed gradient in this exercise is not a test-pressure instruction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂隙導水與尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fracture flow and scale"?
options: 把試驗區間、壓差與流量同圖呈現，檢查升降階段是否可逆並與孔內影像的裂隙位置比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。
optionsEn: Plot test interval, differential pressure and flow together, checking reversibility and comparing imaged fractures.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth.
quiz.explanation: 把試驗區間、壓差與流量同圖呈現，檢查升降階段是否可逆並與孔內影像的裂隙位置比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot test interval, differential pressure and flow together, checking reversibility and comparing imaged fractures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂隙導水與尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture flow and scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙導水與尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fracture flow and scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. Conversely, disturbance at the borehole wall may exaggerate connectivity that is absent in the undisturbed rock mass. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conversely, disturbance at the borehole wall may exaggerate connectivity that is absent in the undisturbed rock mass.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。
knowledge.textEn: A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. Conversely, disturbance at the borehole wall may exaggerate connectivity that is absent in the undisturbed rock mass.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂隙導水與尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fracture flow and scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
quiz.explanation: 若局部高導水裂隙被大量低透水岩體平均，整體係數看似小卻仍可能有集中出水；反之孔壁擾動也可能使局部試驗誇大天然連通性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low average coefficient can conceal concentrated flow through one conductive fracture. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多證據更新機率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Updating with multiple evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多證據更新機率」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Updating with multiple evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 異常訊號可能是假陽性，無異常也可能是假陰性，解釋價值取決於先驗地質風險。震波與鑽孔若共享同一位置模型，兩者誤差可能相關，不能因資料來自兩種儀器就當成獨立證據。 假設危險帶先驗0.2、靈敏度0.8、假陽性0.1，陽性後機率=0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667。 只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多證據更新機率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Anomalies can be false positives and quiet records false negatives, so evidence depends on prior geological risk. Seismic and drilling interpretations may share a location model and correlated errors; different instruments do not automatically provide independent evidence. Assume prior hazard probability 0.2, sensitivity 0.8 and false-positive rate 0.1. Probability after a positive is 0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667. Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. Multiplying correlated evidence compounds overconfidence and can remove additional investigation that the unresolved ground conditions still require. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Updating with multiple evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多證據更新機率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Updating with multiple evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多證據更新機率
knowledge.text: 異常訊號可能是假陽性，無異常也可能是假陰性，解釋價值取決於先驗地質風險。震波與鑽孔若共享同一位置模型，兩者誤差可能相關，不能因資料來自兩種儀器就當成獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Anomalies can be false positives and quiet records false negatives, so evidence depends on prior geological risk. Seismic and drilling interpretations may share a location model and correlated errors; different instruments do not automatically provide independent evidence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多證據更新機率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Updating with multiple evidence" is correct?
options: 兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
回收率高就能證明岩體沒有節理或軟弱夾層。
異常訊號可能是假陽性，無異常也可能是假陰性，解釋價值取決於先驗地質風險。
optionsEn: No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
High core recovery proves that the rock mass has no joints or weak interbeds.
Anomalies can be false positives and quiet records false negatives, so evidence depends on prior geological risk.
quiz.explanation: 異常訊號可能是假陽性，無異常也可能是假陰性，解釋價值取決於先驗地質風險。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Anomalies can be false positives and quiet records false negatives, so evidence depends on prior geological risk. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多證據更新機率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Updating with multiple evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多證據更新機率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Updating with multiple evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設危險帶先驗0.2、靈敏度0.8、假陽性0.1，陽性後機率=0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume prior hazard probability 0.2, sensitivity 0.8 and false-positive rate 0.1. Probability after a positive is 0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用事前凍結的判釋準則對照後續揭露的地質，分別記錄命中、漏判與假警報。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare a predeclared interpretation rule with subsequently exposed geology, counting hits, misses and false alarms separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設危險帶先驗0.2、靈敏度0.8、假陽性0.1，陽性後機率=0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume prior hazard probability 0.2, sensitivity 0.8 and false-positive rate 0.1. Probability after a positive is 0.16/(0.16+0.08)=0.667.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多證據更新機率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Updating with multiple evidence", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。
比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多證據更新機率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Updating with multiple evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多證據更新機率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Updating with multiple evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用事前凍結的判釋準則對照後續揭露的地質，分別記錄命中、漏判與假警報。審查樣本是否只收集已知異常區，並列出各證據共同依賴的資料；未有場址驗證前，機率數字只用於教學敏感度比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare a predeclared interpretation rule with subsequently exposed geology, counting hits, misses and false alarms separately. Check whether samples include only known anomalies and list shared dependencies. Before site validation, probability values serve teaching sensitivity analysis rather than calibrated operational prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預先保存判讀時間與版本，以開挖揭露結果做盲對照；風險降低的結論須由負責地質與施工的工程師共同審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preserve interpretation timestamps and versions for blind comparison with later exposure; any conclusion that risk has reduced requires joint review by the responsible geology and construction engineers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多證據更新機率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Updating with multiple evidence"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用事前凍結的判釋準則對照後續揭露的地質，分別記錄命中、漏判與假警報。
返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare a predeclared interpretation rule with subsequently exposed geology, counting hits, misses and false alarms separately.
Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow.
quiz.explanation: 用事前凍結的判釋準則對照後續揭露的地質，分別記錄命中、漏判與假警報。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare a predeclared interpretation rule with subsequently exposed geology, counting hits, misses and false alarms separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多證據更新機率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Updating with multiple evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多證據更新機率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Updating with multiple evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. Multiplying correlated evidence compounds overconfidence and can remove additional investigation that the unresolved ground conditions still require. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Multiplying correlated evidence compounds overconfidence and can remove additional investigation that the unresolved ground conditions still require.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。
knowledge.textEn: Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. Multiplying correlated evidence compounds overconfidence and can remove additional investigation that the unresolved ground conditions still require.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多證據更新機率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Updating with multiple evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
回收率高就能證明岩體沒有節理或軟弱夾層。
只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High core recovery proves that the rock mass has no joints or weak interbeds.
Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability.
quiz.explanation: 只統計成功預測而漏掉無異常區，會誇大探測可信度；再把相關證據連乘，可能形成過度自信的安全判斷，反而取消本應保留的調查。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting successful predictions without quiet areas inflates apparent reliability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling quality and recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.instructionEn: Core recovery measures material retrieved, not in-situ integrity. Weak layers preferentially wash out, leaving a biased sample of stronger pieces. Missing intervals are evidence gaps and must not be filled automatically with the properties of the remaining rock. For an assumed 2.0 m run with 1.6 m recovered, recovery is 80%; the missing 0.4 m retains positional uncertainty. Testing only intact recovered pieces biases the strength distribution upward. Misplacing lost material can hide a weak plane in another run and produce an unjustifiably favorable support classification. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling quality and recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回收率高就能證明岩體沒有節理或軟弱夾層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High core recovery proves that the rock mass has no joints or weak interbeds." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣品質與回收」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling quality and recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instructionEn: Reconcile advance, recovered length, broken ends and flushing records, photographing scale and run markers. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Core boxes and digital logs must share hole and run identifiers; never replace lost intervals with inferred material, and require the geologist to flag unrepresentative tests before design handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測試取回的完整岩心會得到偏高強度分布，且缺失區若位置放錯，薄弱面可能被藏入別的回次；支護分類因而過度樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 取樣品質與回收：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Testing only intact recovered pieces biases the strength distribution upward. steps.title: 調查到開挖交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Investigation-to-excavation handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「調查到開挖交接」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Investigation-to-excavation handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調查價值在於改變可追溯的工程判斷，而非累積孔數。把預測界面、信心範圍與後續揭露逐段對照，可辨別地質模型是否隨開挖失效；觀測條件變化時，應保留舊版本以解釋當時決策。 假設10項待回答地質問題中有8項獲獨立證據，證據完成率80%；其餘2項不能按平均分數判成通過。 缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調查到開挖交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Investigation matters when it changes a traceable engineering decision. Comparing predicted contacts, uncertainty intervals and later exposure reveals when a ground model stops being adequate. Retain previous versions so changing observations do not erase the evidence available at each decision. If independent evidence addresses 8 of 10 assumed geological questions, evidence completion is 80%; the remaining 2 cannot be accepted through an average score. Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location. Burying unresolved risks inside a completion percentage can imply that all adverse conditions have been excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Investigation-to-excavation handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
