steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項核對問題清單、孔號、原始觀測與設計影響，抽一筆資料從圖面追溯到感測器或岩心箱。以後續掌子面記錄驗證預測，將未解決項列成責任與期限；主管工程師依具體風險而非整體完成率核准進入下一審查節點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit each question against hole identifiers, raw observations and design consequences, tracing a sample drawing back to sensor records or the core box. Check predictions against later face logs and assign owners and deadlines to unresolved items. Approval depends on the specific remaining risk, not overall completion percentage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接表分列已證實、推論及未解決項目，附適用里程與失效條件；地質、設計及施工負責人共同確認控制措施的更新責任。
knowledge.textEn: The handover separates observations, interpretations and unresolved items with chainage and invalidation conditions; geology, design and construction leads jointly confirm responsibility for updating the controls.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調查到開挖交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Investigation-to-excavation handover"?
options: 逐項核對問題清單、孔號、原始觀測與設計影響，抽一筆資料從圖面追溯到感測器或岩心箱。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。
optionsEn: Audit each question against hole identifiers, raw observations and design consequences, tracing a sample drawing back to sensor records or the core box.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 逐項核對問題清單、孔號、原始觀測與設計影響，抽一筆資料從圖面追溯到感測器或岩心箱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit each question against hole identifiers, raw observations and design consequences, tracing a sample drawing back to sensor records or the core box. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 調查到開挖交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Investigation-to-excavation handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調查到開挖交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Investigation-to-excavation handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location. Burying unresolved risks inside a completion percentage can imply that all adverse conditions have been excluded. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Burying unresolved risks inside a completion percentage can imply that all adverse conditions have been excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「調查報告交付百分之百就等於所有地質風險已消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delivering the entire investigation report means all geological risk has disappeared." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。
knowledge.textEn: Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location. Burying unresolved risks inside a completion percentage can imply that all adverse conditions have been excluded.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調查到開挖交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Investigation-to-excavation handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。
鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location.
Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
quiz.explanation: 缺少孔號或版本會使正確量測也無法對應到開挖位置；若未解決風險被埋在完成率內，施工團隊可能誤以為調查已排除所有不利情況。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Missing identifiers or versions make even accurate measurements unusable at the excavation location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 隧道震波地質探測
courses.titleEn: Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation
courses.summary: 本課聚焦分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證
courses.focusEn: Distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。
教學量化備忘：假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。
教學量化備忘：假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。
教學量化備忘：假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。
教學量化備忘：假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。
教學量化備忘：假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m.
Teaching quantitative note: With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee.
Teaching quantitative note: At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary.
Teaching quantitative note: Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「阻抗反差與反射」與「走時與距離反演」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Impedance contrast and reflection" and "Travel time and distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 阻抗反差與反射：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Impedance contrast and reflection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「阻抗反差與反射」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impedance contrast and reflection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射源是密度與波速形成的阻抗差，並非岩性名稱本身。含水、裂隙和風化皆能改變波速，故同一振幅異常可以有不同地質成因，應保留極性與入射幾何。 假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。 若把反相一律當成含水斷層，低密度乾燥帶也會觸發誤判；若增益設定遺失，前後測次的振幅比較將無法支持地質變化結論。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「阻抗反差與反射」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reflection arises from acoustic impedance contrast, not a rock name. Water, fractures and weathering can alter velocity, so an amplitude anomaly admits several geological explanations and must retain polarity and incidence geometry. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy. Calling every polarity reversal a water-bearing fault misclassifies dry low-density zones. Missing gain settings also invalidate amplitude comparisons between surveys and any inferred geological change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impedance contrast and reflection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反射振幅只由岩石名稱決定，與密度及波速無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reflection amplitude depends only on rock names, regardless of density and velocity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「阻抗反差與反射」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Impedance contrast and reflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 阻抗反差與反射
knowledge.text: 反射源是密度與波速形成的阻抗差，並非岩性名稱本身。含水、裂隙和風化皆能改變波速，故同一振幅異常可以有不同地質成因，應保留極性與入射幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Reflection arises from acoustic impedance contrast, not a rock name. Water, fractures and weathering can alter velocity, so an amplitude anomaly admits several geological explanations and must retain polarity and incidence geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反射振幅只由岩石名稱決定，與密度及波速無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reflection amplitude depends only on rock names, regardless of density and velocity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「阻抗反差與反射」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Impedance contrast and reflection" is correct?
options: 反射振幅只由岩石名稱決定，與密度及波速無關。
反射源是密度與波速形成的阻抗差，並非岩性名稱本身。
反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。
optionsEn: Reflection amplitude depends only on rock names, regardless of density and velocity.
Reflection arises from acoustic impedance contrast, not a rock name.
Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path.
quiz.explanation: 反射源是密度與波速形成的阻抗差，並非岩性名稱本身。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reflection arises from acoustic impedance contrast, not a rock name. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 阻抗反差與反射：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Impedance contrast and reflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻抗反差與反射」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Impedance contrast and reflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對已知界面的波形極性、感測器方向及密度波速資料，並用探孔確認異常帶；振幅須先扣除幾何擴散與儀器增益，不能直接當成破碎程度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare polarity at a known interface, receiver orientation and density-velocity information, then verify anomalies with probing; remove geometric spreading and instrument gain before interpreting amplitude as damage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩側阻抗15與9 MRayl，正入射R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25；負號表示反相，非負能量。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed impedances of 15 and 9 MRayl, normal-incidence R=(9−15)/(9+15)=−0.25; the sign indicates phase reversal, not negative energy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「阻抗反差與反射」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Impedance contrast and reflection", which statement holds?
options: 取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。

steps.title: 阻抗反差與反射：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Impedance contrast and reflection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對已知界面的波形極性、感測器方向及密度波速資料，並用探孔確認異常帶；振幅須先扣除幾何擴散與儀器增益，不能直接當成破碎程度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若把反相一律當成含水斷層，低密度乾燥帶也會觸發誤判；若增益設定遺失，前後測次的振幅比較將無法支持地質變化結論。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare polarity at a known interface, receiver orientation and density-velocity information, then verify anomalies with probing; remove geometric spreading and instrument gain before interpreting amplitude as damage. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Calling every polarity reversal a water-bearing fault misclassifies dry low-density zones. Missing gain settings also invalidate amplitude comparisons between surveys and any inferred geological change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instructionEn: Calling every polarity reversal a water-bearing fault misclassifies dry low-density zones. Missing gain settings also invalidate amplitude comparisons between surveys and any inferred geological change. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path.

steps.title: 走時與距離反演：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Travel time and distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「走時與距離反演」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Travel time and distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回波走時包含去程和回程，距離估算先依賴速度模型，再依賴反射方向。掌子面附近的低速擾動區可能加長走時，若全路徑仍採完整岩速度，異常距離會被高估。 假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。 錯把雙程走時當成單程會把距離放大兩倍；另一常見症狀是反射位置隨速度設定大量移動，卻在報告中仍只標出一條精確界線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「走時與距離反演」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Echo time includes outward and return travel. Distance therefore depends on velocity and reflector direction. A damaged low-velocity zone near the face lengthens travel time, potentially overestimating distance when intact-rock velocity is used throughout. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m. Treating two-way time as one-way doubles distance. Another warning is a reflector moving substantially with velocity assumptions while the report still draws a single apparently precise boundary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Travel time and distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「走時與距離反演」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Travel time and distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 走時與距離反演
knowledge.text: 回波走時包含去程和回程，距離估算先依賴速度模型，再依賴反射方向。掌子面附近的低速擾動區可能加長走時，若全路徑仍採完整岩速度，異常距離會被高估。
knowledge.textEn: Echo time includes outward and return travel. Distance therefore depends on velocity and reflector direction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「走時與距離反演」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Travel time and distance" is correct?
options: 反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。
把顯示像素縮小就能提高地下薄層的實際分辨率。
回波走時包含去程和回程，距離估算先依賴速度模型，再依賴反射方向。
optionsEn: Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path.
Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers.
Echo time includes outward and return travel.
quiz.explanation: 回波走時包含去程和回程，距離估算先依賴速度模型，再依賴反射方向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Echo time includes outward and return travel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 走時與距離反演：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Travel time and distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「走時與距離反演」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設正向反射v=4000 m/s、雙程t=0.040 s，d=vt/2=80 m；速度提高10%時距離為88 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用已知源收距離的直達波估速，將不同速度假說的反射位置畫成區間；再對照探孔截交里程，確認不是斜側方界面被投影到正前方。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate velocity from direct arrivals at surveyed offsets and plot reflector positions for alternative velocity hypotheses; compare probe intersections to exclude an oblique side reflector projected directly ahead.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a frontal reflection with v=4000 m/s and two-way t=0.040 s. d=vt/2=80 m; increasing velocity by 10% gives 88 m.

steps.title: 走時與距離反演：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Travel time and distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「走時與距離反演」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Travel time and distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把雙程走時當成單程會把距離放大兩倍；另一常見症狀是反射位置隨速度設定大量移動，卻在報告中仍只標出一條精確界線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating two-way time as one-way doubles distance. Another warning is a reflector moving substantially with velocity assumptions while the report still draws a single apparently precise boundary. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「走時與距離反演」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把顯示像素縮小就能提高地下薄層的實際分辨率。
錯把雙程走時當成單程會把距離放大兩倍；另一常見症狀是反射位置隨速度設定大量移動，卻在報告中仍只標出一條精確界線。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers.
Treating two-way time as one-way doubles distance.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頻率與分辨能力」與「取樣與時間混疊」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Frequency and resolution" and "Sampling and time aliasing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頻率與分辨能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Frequency and resolution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頻率與分辨能力」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency and resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高頻提供較短波長，能分開更靠近的界面，但在破碎岩中也更快衰減。可探測距離與分辨率因此互相制約，取樣間距很密並不能補回地層已濾掉的高頻資訊。 假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。 過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻率與分辨能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Higher frequency shortens wavelength and separates closer interfaces, but attenuates more strongly in fractured ground. Reach and resolution trade off, and dense sampling cannot restore high-frequency information already filtered by the rock mass. With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee. Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces. Estimating layer thickness from image appearance alone gives support design unjustified precision. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frequency and resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把顯示像素縮小就能提高地下薄層的實際分辨率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻率與分辨能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Frequency and resolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 高頻提供較短波長，能分開更靠近的界面，但在破碎岩中也更快衰減。可探測距離與分辨率因此互相制約，取樣間距很密並不能補回地層已濾掉的高頻資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Higher frequency shortens wavelength and separates closer interfaces, but attenuates more strongly in fractured ground. Reach and resolution trade off, and dense sampling cannot restore high-frequency information already filtered by the rock mass.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把顯示像素縮小就能提高地下薄層的實際分辨率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻率與分辨能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frequency and resolution" is correct?
options: 高頻提供較短波長，能分開更靠近的界面，但在破碎岩中也更快衰減。

取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。
optionsEn: Higher frequency shortens wavelength and separates closer interfaces, but attenuates more strongly in fractured ground.
Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers.
Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing.

steps.title: 頻率與分辨能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency and resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率與分辨能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設v=4000 m/s、f=1000 Hz，波長λ=4 m，四分之一波長尺度約1 m；它是簡化分辨尺度非保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed v=4000 m/s and f=1000 Hz, wavelength λ=4 m and a quarter-wavelength scale is about 1 m; this simplified scale is not a guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只統計成功預警案例就能完整評估探測可靠度。
檢視原始與處理後頻譜，分列可用頻帶和處理濾波器；以已知厚度的模型或合成波形檢查雙界面可辨性，避免把色階像素大小誤當地質分辨率。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Counting successful warning examples alone fully evaluates prediction reliability.
Inspect raw and processed spectra and document bandwidth and filters.
quiz.explanation: 檢視原始與處理後頻譜，分列可用頻帶和處理濾波器；以已知厚度的模型或合成波形檢查雙界面可辨性，避免把色階像素大小誤當地質分辨率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect raw and processed spectra and document bandwidth and filters; test separation of two interfaces with a known model or synthetic waveform rather than equating display pixel size with geological resolution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頻率與分辨能力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frequency and resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率與分辨能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frequency and resolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces. Estimating layer thickness from image appearance alone gives support design unjustified precision. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimating layer thickness from image appearance alone gives support design unjustified precision.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把顯示像素縮小就能提高地下薄層的實際分辨率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller display pixels increase the actual resolution of thin underground layers." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。

optionsEn: Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing.
quiz.explanation: 過度平滑會把兩條薄弱面合成一條厚帶，過度銳化則可能製造假界面；僅靠漂亮成像判定薄層厚度，會給支護設計虛假的精度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Smoothing can merge two weak planes into one thick zone, while sharpening may manufacture interfaces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 取樣與時間混疊：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling and time aliasing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣與時間混疊」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling and time aliasing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位取樣須能追蹤欲保留的最高頻率，否則高頻會折回成假低頻。抗混疊濾波作用在取樣之前，事後再增加顯示點數只能插值，不能恢復已混疊的原始資訊。 假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。 取樣不足造成的假頻率可能被誤判成岩體衰減，重取樣後曲線雖平順卻仍錯；若原始檔被覆寫，就無法判斷異常是地質還是記錄器產生。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣與時間混疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling must resolve the highest retained frequency or high-frequency energy folds into a false lower frequency. Anti-alias filtering acts before sampling; adding display points afterward only interpolates and cannot recover aliased information. At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary. Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it. Overwritten raw files prevent distinguishing ground behavior from an acquisition artifact. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling and time aliasing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣與時間混疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling and time aliasing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 取樣與時間混疊
knowledge.text: 數位取樣須能追蹤欲保留的最高頻率，否則高頻會折回成假低頻。抗混疊濾波作用在取樣之前，事後再增加顯示點數只能插值，不能恢復已混疊的原始資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling must resolve the highest retained frequency or high-frequency energy folds into a false lower frequency. Anti-alias filtering acts before sampling; adding display points afterward only interpolates and cannot recover aliased information.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「取樣與時間混疊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sampling and time aliasing" is correct?
options: 取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。
數位取樣須能追蹤欲保留的最高頻率，否則高頻會折回成假低頻。
任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。
optionsEn: Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing.
Sampling must resolve the highest retained frequency or high-frequency energy folds into a false lower frequency.
Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule.
quiz.explanation: 數位取樣須能追蹤欲保留的最高頻率，否則高頻會折回成假低頻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling must resolve the highest retained frequency or high-frequency energy folds into a false lower frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 取樣與時間混疊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling and time aliasing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣與時間混疊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling and time aliasing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設取樣頻率8000 Hz，Nyquist頻率4000 Hz，時間間隔0.125 ms；保留頻帶仍須低於理想上界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed sampling frequency 8000 Hz, the Nyquist frequency is 4000 Hz and interval 0.125 ms; the retained band must remain below the ideal boundary. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對記錄器原始取樣率、前置濾波與時鐘設定，用已知頻率訊號查核頻譜；處理者需保留未重取樣檔，並證明走時拾取在合理頻帶變更下仍穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check native sample rate, front-end filters and clocks using a known-frequency signal; retain files before resampling and demonstrate that picked arrivals remain stable under reasonable changes of processing bandwidth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 取樣與時間混疊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling and time aliasing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「取樣與時間混疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling and time aliasing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對記錄器原始取樣率、前置濾波與時鐘設定，用已知頻率訊號查核頻譜；處理者需保留未重取樣檔，並證明走時拾取在合理頻帶變更下仍穩定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：取樣不足造成的假頻率可能被誤判成岩體衰減，重取樣後曲線雖平順卻仍錯；若原始檔被覆寫，就無法判斷異常是地質還是記錄器產生。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check native sample rate, front-end filters and clocks using a known-frequency signal; retain files before resampling and demonstrate that picked arrivals remain stable under reasonable changes of processing bandwidth. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it. Overwritten raw files prevent distinguishing ground behavior from an acquisition artifact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：取樣不足造成的假頻率可能被誤判成岩體衰減，重取樣後曲線雖平順卻仍錯；若原始檔被覆寫，就無法判斷異常是地質還是記錄器產生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「取樣與時間混疊」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it.
Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疊加與相關雜訊」與「測線幾何與偏移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 疊加與相關雜訊：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stacking and correlated noise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「疊加與相關雜訊」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stacking and correlated noise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。持續機械振動若與測次同步，卻也會相干累積，不能用測次數保證品質。 假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。 把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「疊加與相關雜訊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated signals add coherently while independent zero-mean noise grows only with the square root of count. Synchronous mechanical vibration also adds coherently, so record count alone cannot guarantee improved quality. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB. Coherent machine noise can become a clearer false reflector after stacking while superficial quality indicators improve. Selecting only attractive records conceals instability and biases the final interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stacking and correlated noise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「疊加與相關雜訊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stacking and correlated noise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「疊加與相關雜訊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stacking and correlated noise" is correct?

側壁量到的所有反射都必定來自掌子面正前方。
重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。
optionsEn: Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule.
All reflections measured at a sidewall must originate directly ahead of the face.
Repeated signals add coherently while independent zero-mean noise grows only with the square root of count.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同子集合的疊加結果及背景振動時段，量測噪音是否隨平方根縮減；若異常只在特定機具運轉時存在，需以獨立時段或替代量測驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare stacks from different subsets and background-vibration periods, testing whether noise follows square-root reduction; an anomaly tied to one operating machine requires an independent time window or alternative measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 疊加與相關雜訊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stacking and correlated noise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「疊加與相關雜訊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 比較不同子集合的疊加結果及背景振動時段，量測噪音是否隨平方根縮減；若異常只在特定機具運轉時存在，需以獨立時段或替代量測驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Selecting only attractive records conceals instability and biases the final interpretation. quiz.explanation: 把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coherent machine noise can become a clearer false reflector after stacking while superficial quality indicators improve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測線幾何與偏移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey geometry and migration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測線幾何與偏移」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey geometry and migration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 源收座標決定射線路徑與反射點，側壁布置的量測不一定正對前方。偏移成像把走時轉成空間位置時必須使用正確孔位和速度，否則側向地質可能被移到開挖軸線。 假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。 使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測線幾何與偏移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Source and receiver coordinates govern ray paths and reflection points. Sidewall arrays do not necessarily look straight ahead. Migration needs correct geometry and velocity or lateral features may be moved onto the excavation axis. For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient. Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey geometry and migration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側壁量到的所有反射都必定來自掌子面正前方。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All reflections measured at a sidewall must originate directly ahead of the face." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測線幾何與偏移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Survey geometry and migration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測線幾何與偏移
knowledge.text: 源收座標決定射線路徑與反射點，側壁布置的量測不一定正對前方。偏移成像把走時轉成空間位置時必須使用正確孔位和速度，否則側向地質可能被移到開挖軸線。
knowledge.textEn: Source and receiver coordinates govern ray paths and reflection points. Sidewall arrays do not necessarily look straight ahead.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側壁量到的所有反射都必定來自掌子面正前方。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All reflections measured at a sidewall must originate directly ahead of the face. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測線幾何與偏移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey geometry and migration" is correct?
options: 源收座標決定射線路徑與反射點，側壁布置的量測不一定正對前方。
側壁量到的所有反射都必定來自掌子面正前方。
波速推得的動態模數可以直接代表長期靜態變形。
optionsEn: Source and receiver coordinates govern ray paths and reflection points.
All reflections measured at a sidewall must originate directly ahead of the face.
A velocity-derived dynamic modulus directly represents long-term static deformation.
quiz.explanation: 源收座標決定射線路徑與反射點，側壁布置的量測不一定正對前方。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Source and receiver coordinates govern ray paths and reflection points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測線幾何與偏移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey geometry and migration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測線幾何與偏移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Survey geometry and migration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用測量控制點核對源收三維位置，分別處理正前方與斜向的合成反射測試；將定位橢球與隧道斷面重疊，只有與開挖影響區相交的解釋才進入風險審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey three-dimensional source-receiver positions and test both frontal and oblique synthetic reflectors; overlay positional uncertainty on the tunnel section and review interpretations that intersect the excavation influence zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反射距離80 m、方位不確定5°，橫向位置尺度80sin5°=6.97 m；不能只報里程誤差。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測線幾何與偏移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 測線幾何與偏移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey geometry and migration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測線幾何與偏移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Survey geometry and migration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用測量控制點核對源收三維位置，分別處理正前方與斜向的合成反射測試；將定位橢球與隧道斷面重疊，只有與開挖影響區相交的解釋才進入風險審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey three-dimensional source-receiver positions and test both frontal and oblique synthetic reflectors; overlay positional uncertainty on the tunnel section and review interpretations that intersect the excavation influence zone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Survey three-dimensional source-receiver positions and test both frontal and oblique synthetic reflectors; overlay positional uncertainty on the tunnel section and review interpretations that intersect the excavation influence zone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology.

Survey three-dimensional source-receiver positions and test both frontal and oblique synthetic reflectors; overlay positional uncertainty on the tunnel section and review interpretations that intersect the excavation influence zone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測線幾何與偏移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 測線幾何與偏移：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 使用舊掌子面里程或錯誤側壁座標會使成像整體偏移；施工團隊可能提前或延後處理異常區，並錯把後來揭露的不一致歸因於地質不可預測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Velocity and elastic assumptions" and "Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波速與彈性假設：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity and elastic assumptions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波速與彈性假設」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity and elastic assumptions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動態波速對應小應變快速載入，不能直接當成長時間靜態變形模數。裂隙閉合、飽和與各向異性使兩者差異更大，任何由波速推算的模數都必須保留密度和均質等向假設。 假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波速與彈性假設」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic velocities describe small-strain rapid loading rather than long-term static stiffness. Crack closure, saturation and anisotropy increase the distinction. Moduli inferred from waves must retain density and homogeneous isotropic assumptions. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%. Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity and elastic assumptions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanation: 振幅沿路徑受材料吸收、散射和幾何擴散共同減弱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Amplitude decays through absorption, scattering and geometric spreading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 衰減與振幅混淆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「衰減與振幅混淆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純指數衰減A/A0=e^(−αx)，α=0.01 m⁻¹、x=50 m，比例e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607；未計擴散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume purely exponential decay A/A0=e^(−αx), α=0.01 m⁻¹ and x=50 m. The ratio is e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607, excluding geometric spreading. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查同一接收器的重複耦合測次並使用參考源強，分頻段比較衰減模型；將無法分離的吸收與散射列為聯合效應，只有附校準紀錄的振幅才參與地質對比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat coupling checks for the same receiver with a reference source, comparing attenuation by frequency band; report inseparable absorption and scattering jointly and use only calibrated amplitudes in geological comparisons.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 檢查同一接收器的重複耦合測次並使用參考源強，分頻段比較衰減模型；將無法分離的吸收與散射列為聯合效應，只有附校準紀錄的振幅才參與地質對比。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：鬆動感測器可讓完好岩體看似強衰減帶，若再由此推測地下水會放大誤判；反之自動增益補償也可能掩蓋真實的遠距訊號衰減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat coupling checks for the same receiver with a reference source, comparing attenuation by frequency band; report inseparable absorption and scattering jointly and use only calibrated amplitudes in geological comparisons. steps.title: 衰減與振幅混淆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「衰減與振幅混淆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 鬆動感測器可讓完好岩體看似強衰減帶，若再由此推測地下水會放大誤判；反之自動增益補償也可能掩蓋真實的遠距訊號衰減。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A loose receiver can make intact rock resemble a strongly attenuating zone and encourage false groundwater inference; automatic gain correction can conversely conceal genuine attenuation at distance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要遠處振幅較小就能證明前方存在含水破碎帶。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smaller distant amplitude proves a water-bearing fractured zone lies ahead." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「衰減與振幅混淆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Very precise arrival picking makes velocity-model uncertainty irrelevant to location.
A loose receiver can make intact rock resemble a strongly attenuating zone and encourage false groundwater inference.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「走時誤差傳播」與「預測與揭露對照」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Travel-time uncertainty propagation" and "Prediction and exposure comparison": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 走時誤差傳播：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Travel-time uncertainty propagation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「走時誤差傳播」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Travel-time uncertainty propagation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 速度與走時各有不確定性，定位可信度由兩者共同控制。若速度來自同一批到時資料，誤差可能相關；平方和公式只適用獨立小誤差，不能把未知系統偏差包裝成高精度標準差。 假設d=80 m、速度標準不確定5%、走時2%，獨立時ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m。 忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「走時誤差傳播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity and time jointly control location uncertainty. If velocity is estimated from the same arrivals, errors may correlate. Root-sum-square propagation applies only to small independent errors, not unidentified systematic bias. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m. Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Travel-time uncertainty propagation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「走時拾取非常準確時，就可以忽略波速模型誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Very precise arrival picking makes velocity-model uncertainty irrelevant to location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「走時誤差傳播」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Travel-time uncertainty propagation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Velocity and time jointly control location uncertainty. If velocity is estimated from the same arrivals, errors may correlate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：走時拾取非常準確時，就可以忽略波速模型誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Very precise arrival picking makes velocity-model uncertainty irrelevant to location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「走時誤差傳播」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Travel-time uncertainty propagation" is correct?
options: 速度與走時各有不確定性，定位可信度由兩者共同控制。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 走時誤差傳播：失效診斷

steps.title: 預測與揭露對照：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Prediction and exposure comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預測與揭露對照」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prediction and exposure comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預測須在開挖揭露前固定版本，否則事後調整解釋會掩蓋漏判。判斷品質同時看成功預警與無異常區的錯警報，並把不可見範圍列出，不能讓彩色影像代替可核對的假說。 假設已知10個異常中預測8個，靈敏度80%；另有20個正常區錯報3個，假陽性率15%，兩指標分列。 僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預測與揭露對照」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Freeze predictions before excavation exposes the ground, or retrospective interpretation hides misses. Assess both successful warnings and false alarms in quiet zones and state blind areas; a colored image is not a testable hypothesis. If 8 of an assumed 10 anomalies are predicted, sensitivity is 80%; 3 false alarms among 20 normal intervals give 15% false-positive rate, reported separately. Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Prediction and exposure comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Counting successful warning examples alone fully evaluates prediction reliability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 預測與揭露對照：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prediction and exposure comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預測與揭露對照」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prediction and exposure comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用原始預測里程區間對照後續面誌與鑽孔，設定同一命中距離規則並保留未判定區；地質主管審查誤判原因是否來自覆蓋、處理或地質模型，才更新下一輪調查計畫。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare original prediction intervals with later face logs and boreholes using one predefined matching rule and retaining unclassified zones; the geology lead separates coverage, processing and model errors before updating investigation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄預測與揭露對照的資料來源與適用條件。用原始預測里程區間對照後續面誌與鑽孔，設定同一命中距離規則並保留未判定區；地質主管審查誤判原因是否來自覆蓋、處理或地質模型，才更新下一輪調查計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for prediction and exposure comparison. Compare original prediction intervals with later face logs and boreholes using one predefined matching rule and retaining unclassified zones; the geology lead separates coverage, processing and model errors before updating investigation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 預測與揭露對照：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prediction and exposure comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預測與揭露對照」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prediction and exposure comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只統計成功預警案例就能完整評估探測可靠度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Counting successful warning examples alone fully evaluates prediction reliability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「預測與揭露對照」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

反射振幅只由岩石名稱決定，與密度及波速無關。

courses.title: 鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類
courses.summary: 本課聚焦從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界
courses.focusEn: Derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。
教學量化備忘：假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。
教學量化備忘：假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。
教學量化備忘：假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。
教學量化備忘：假設直徑50 mm試體破壞荷重200 kN，σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa；不等於岩體強度。
教學量化備忘：假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique.
Teaching quantitative note: If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength.
Teaching quantitative note: Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回次與深度閉合」與「岩石品質指標」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Runs and depth closure" and "Rock quality designation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回次與深度閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Runs and depth closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回次與深度閉合」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Runs and depth closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩心箱的順序建立地下空間的索引，鑽進回次與回收長度不閉合時，後續試驗再精準也會失去位置。接桿量測、殘留岩心與鑽具長度須分開記錄，不能把深度誤差藏入某個破碎段。 假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。 把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回次與深度閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core-box order indexes subsurface space. If advance and recovery do not close, even precise tests lose their location. Record rod measurements, retained core and tooling lengths separately instead of hiding a depth discrepancy inside a broken interval. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Runs and depth closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回次與深度閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Runs and depth closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回次與深度閉合
knowledge.text: 岩心箱的順序建立地下空間的索引，鑽進回次與回收長度不閉合時，後續試驗再精準也會失去位置。接桿量測、殘留岩心與鑽具長度須分開記錄，不能把深度誤差藏入某個破碎段。
knowledge.textEn: Core-box order indexes subsurface space. If advance and recovery do not close, even precise tests lose their location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回次與深度閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 回次與深度閉合：定量估算
