knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分類到模型交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Classification-to-model handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。
岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening.
Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run.
quiz.explanation: 若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 孔內電視與裂隙判釋
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙
courses.focusEn: Interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。
教學量化備忘：假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。
教學量化備忘：假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。
教學量化備忘：假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。
教學量化備忘：假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。
教學量化備忘：假設像素尺度0.2 mm、暗帶3像素，表觀寬0.6 mm；若邊界各有1像素誤差，寬度誤差可達0.4 mm。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method.
Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°.
Teaching quantitative note: At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct.
Teaching quantitative note: Assumed orthogonal diameters 110 and 100 mm give ovality (110−100)/100=10%; this is a geometric index, not a stress ratio.
Teaching quantitative note: At an assumed pixel scale 0.2 mm, a 3-pixel band is 0.6 mm wide; one-pixel error at each boundary can change width by 0.4 mm.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光學與聲學互補」與「展開影像與傾角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Optical and acoustic complementarity" and "Unwrapped images and dip": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「光學與聲學互補」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Optical and acoustic complementarity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。互補資料可區分影像消失與真正的構造中斷，不能把看不清的區段當成無裂隙。 假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「光學與聲學互補」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. Turbid water and coatings affect them differently, so combined evidence separates lost visibility from a real structural termination. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Optical and acoustic complementarity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「光學與聲學互補」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Optical and acoustic complementarity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光學與聲學互補
knowledge.text: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。互補資料可區分影像消失與真正的構造中斷，不能把看不清的區段當成無裂隙。
knowledge.textEn: Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. Turbid water and coatings affect them differently, so combined evidence separates lost visibility from a real structural termination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光學與聲學互補」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Optical and acoustic complementarity" is correct?
options: 孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。
光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。
展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。
optionsEn: Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry.
The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude.
quiz.explanation: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光學與聲學互補」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Optical and acoustic complementarity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「光學與聲學互補」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Optical and acoustic complementarity", which statement holds?
options: 影像正北標記必定等於地理北，鋼套管不會影響。
影像暗帶寬度可直接當成裂隙的水力開度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Image north always equals geographic north and is unaffected by steel casing.
The width of a dark image band directly equals hydraulic fracture aperture.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「光學與聲學互補」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Optical and acoustic complementarity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄光學與聲學互補的資料來源與適用條件。逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for optical and acoustic complementarity. Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。
knowledge.textEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄光學與聲學互補的資料來源與適用條件。逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for optical and acoustic complementarity. Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光學與聲學互補」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Optical and acoustic complementarity"?
options: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。
optionsEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.
quiz.explanation: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光學與聲學互補」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Optical and acoustic complementarity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 平面裂隙切穿圓孔時在展開圖上形成正弦曲線；波幅與孔徑共同決定相對孔軸的傾角。只有孔軸近鉛直且坐標已校正時，簡單幾何傾角才可直接視為地質傾角。 假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。 把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「展開影像與傾角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A planar fracture intersecting a circular hole becomes a sinusoid when unwrapped. Its amplitude and hole diameter determine dip relative to the axis. This simple dip represents geological dip directly only for a properly oriented near-vertical hole. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry. stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深度與速度校準」與「磁方位與鋼材影響」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Depth and speed calibration" and "Magnetic azimuth and steel effects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深度與速度校準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Depth and speed calibration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「深度與速度校準」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Depth and speed calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。垂直像素間距依賴移動速度及掃描頻率，只有固定時間間隔並不保證固定深度間距，必須使用校正後的深度編碼。 假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深度與速度校準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log. Vertical pixel spacing depends on travel speed and scan frequency; fixed time intervals do not guarantee fixed depth spacing without corrected depth encoding. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm. Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Depth and speed calibration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「深度與速度校準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Depth and speed calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深度與速度校準
knowledge.text: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。垂直像素間距依賴移動速度及掃描頻率，只有固定時間間隔並不保證固定深度間距，必須使用校正後的深度編碼。
knowledge.textEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log. Vertical pixel spacing depends on travel speed and scan frequency; fixed time intervals do not guarantee fixed depth spacing without corrected depth encoding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深度與速度校準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Depth and speed calibration" is correct?
options: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。
掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。
影像正北標記必定等於地理北，鋼套管不會影響。
optionsEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log.
A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth.
Image north always equals geographic north and is unaffected by steel casing.
quiz.explanation: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深度與速度校準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Depth and speed calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深度與速度校準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Depth and speed calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深度與速度校準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Depth and speed calibration", which statement holds?
options: 影像暗帶寬度可直接當成裂隙的水力開度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。
optionsEn: The width of a dark image band directly equals hydraulic fracture aperture.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 深度與速度校準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Depth and speed calibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「深度與速度校準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Depth and speed calibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄深度與速度校準的資料來源與適用條件。利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for depth and speed calibration. Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄深度與速度校準的資料來源與適用條件。利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for depth and speed calibration. Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「深度與速度校準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Depth and speed calibration"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。
利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.
Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs.
quiz.explanation: 利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 深度與速度校準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Depth and speed calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深度與速度校準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Depth and speed calibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。
knowledge.textEn: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「深度與速度校準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Depth and speed calibration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
影像正北標記必定等於地理北，鋼套管不會影響。
optionsEn: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Image north always equals geographic north and is unaffected by steel casing.
quiz.explanation: 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 磁方位與鋼材影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Magnetic azimuth and steel effects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「磁方位與鋼材影響」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Magnetic azimuth and steel effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 磁羅盤在鋼套管附近或含磁性礦物岩層會失真，圖像正北標記因此不一定是地理北。方位偏差不改變正弦形狀，故肉眼難以發現，必須以獨立定向資料檢查。 假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。 把磁北當真北會讓所有節理組一致旋轉，統計仍集中卻整體錯誤；若再與隧道軸線比較，可能錯判某組是否會朝開挖空間出露。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磁方位與鋼材影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel casing and magnetic minerals disturb a compass, so the image north marker may differ from geographic north. Azimuth bias leaves sinusoidal shape unchanged and is hard to spot visually, requiring independent orientation evidence. For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct. Treating magnetic north as true north rotates every joint set coherently, preserving a tight but wrong distribution. Comparison with the tunnel axis can then misidentify whether a set daylights into the opening. knowledge.title: 磁方位與鋼材影響
knowledge.text: 磁羅盤在鋼套管附近或含磁性礦物岩層會失真，圖像正北標記因此不一定是地理北。方位偏差不改變正弦形狀，故肉眼難以發現，必須以獨立定向資料檢查。

quiz.question: 關於「磁方位與鋼材影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caliper and tool eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工具偏離孔中心會讓不同方位的聲程不對稱，孔徑擴大又改變影像的幾何比例。橢圓孔壁可能是原位應力破壞，也可能來自鑽進磨損，不能只憑一張孔徑圖指定成因。 假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。 偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔徑與工具偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

An elliptical wall may reflect stress-induced damage or drilling wear; one caliper image cannot establish the cause. Eccentricity bands may be mistaken for paired breakouts, while excessive correction can erase genuine damage. Either error seriously misdirects stress orientation and subsequent support interpretations. knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔壁橢圓化一定由原位應力造成，不可能是鑽進效應。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Borehole ovality always comes from in-situ stress rather than drilling effects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔徑與工具偏心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caliper and tool eccentricity" is correct?
options: 孔壁橢圓化一定由原位應力造成，不可能是鑽進效應。
影像暗帶寬度可直接當成裂隙的水力開度。
工具偏離孔中心會讓不同方位的聲程不對稱，孔徑擴大又改變影像的幾何比例。
optionsEn: Borehole ovality always comes from in-situ stress rather than drilling effects.
The width of a dark image band directly equals hydraulic fracture aperture.
Tool eccentricity makes acoustic paths unequal around the hole, while enlargement changes image scale.
quiz.explanation: 工具偏離孔中心會讓不同方位的聲程不對稱，孔徑擴大又改變影像的幾何比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tool eccentricity makes acoustic paths unequal around the hole, while enlargement changes image scale. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔徑與工具偏心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caliper and tool eccentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔徑與工具偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caliper and tool eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩向孔徑110與100 mm，橢圓度(110−100)/100=10%；這是幾何指標而非應力比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed orthogonal diameters 110 and 100 mm give ovality (110−100)/100=10%; this is a geometric index, not a stress ratio. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較多臂孔徑、工具居中狀態及兩次影像，檢查異常是否固定在地理方向；若形狀跟工具旋轉而變，優先查量測偏心，只有重複且有岩壁證據的特徵才供應力判釋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare multi-arm caliper, centralization and repeat images, checking whether anomalies remain fixed geographically; if shape follows tool rotation investigate eccentricity first, reserving stress interpretation for repeatable wall-supported features.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 孔徑與工具偏心：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 比較多臂孔徑、工具居中狀態及兩次影像，檢查異常是否固定在地理方向；若形狀跟工具旋轉而變，優先查量測偏心，只有重複且有岩壁證據的特徵才供應力判釋。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare multi-arm caliper, centralization and repeat images, checking whether anomalies remain fixed geographically; if shape follows tool rotation investigate eccentricity first, reserving stress interpretation for repeatable wall-supported features. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Eccentricity bands may be mistaken for paired breakouts, while excessive correction can erase genuine damage. Either error seriously misdirects stress orientation and subsequent support interpretations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.observation: 連結機制：偏心造成的亮暗帶可能被當成兩側崩落，過度校正又會抹去真實孔壁破壞；誤判將使應力方向與支護推論都偏離實際。

steps.title: 表觀裂隙開度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Apparent fracture aperture: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「表觀裂隙開度」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Apparent fracture aperture” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 影像中的暗帶寬度同時受真實開度、斜交幾何、像素尺寸與覆膜影響。聲學反射缺失也可能因粗糙度造成，所以影像開度是觀測描述，不能未校準就代入裂隙流公式。 假設像素尺度0.2 mm、暗帶3像素，表觀寬0.6 mm；若邊界各有1像素誤差，寬度誤差可達0.4 mm。 將暗帶寬直接當水力開度會因立方關係放大流量誤差，岩壁染色更可能使封閉裂隙看似很寬；錯誤導水判斷會誤導後續調查位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「表觀裂隙開度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dark band width reflects true aperture, intersection angle, pixel size and coatings. Missing acoustic returns may also result from roughness. Image aperture is therefore an observation, not an uncalibrated input to fracture-flow equations. At an assumed pixel scale 0.2 mm, a 3-pixel band is 0.6 mm wide; one-pixel error at each boundary can change width by 0.4 mm. Using band width as hydraulic aperture amplifies flow errors through the cubic relation, and staining can make a closed crack look wide, misdirecting subsequent investigation of conductive zones. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Apparent fracture aperture” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint sets and sampling bias” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以球面圖標示每條裂隙及其深度，和不同方向孔的組群比較；保留人工挑點、擬合殘差及可讀性遮罩，只有可解釋的測量錯誤可排除，地質離群則另列。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot each fracture with depth on a stereonet and compare differently oriented holes; retain manual picks, fit residuals and readability masks, excluding only justified measurement errors while retaining geological outliers separately. Including unreadable intervals in the denominator also underestimates fracture intensity and creates artificial improvement in rock quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint sets and sampling bias: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙組與取樣偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint sets and sampling bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge. Including unreadable intervals in the denominator also underestimates fracture intensity and creates artificial improvement in rock quality. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一種節理方向被單一鑽孔取樣的機率都相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂隙組與取樣偏差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。
看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge.
The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.
quiz.explanation: 若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 導水裂隙交叉證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cross-evidence for conductive fractures: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導水裂隙交叉證據」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross-evidence for conductive fractures” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 影像辨識開放構造，流量測井辨識水的實際交換，兩者回答不同問題。多條裂隙可能只有一條連通遠方含水層，水力邊界改變時導水角色也可能改變，不能只依外觀排序。 假設某裂隙上下流量由0.20增至0.35 L/s，局部增量0.15 L/s；只有深度與穩態條件一致時可歸因。 缺少深度校準會把流量躍變配到鄰近裂隙，非穩態儲存也能製造假交換；結果可能在錯誤位置安排封堵，留下真正的導水通道。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導水裂隙交叉證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Images identify visible structures while flow logs identify actual water exchange. Among many fractures only one may connect to a distant aquifer. Hydraulic boundary changes can alter their roles, so appearance alone cannot rank conductivity. An assumed flow increase from 0.20 to 0.35 L/s across a fracture gives 0.15 L/s locally, attributable only with aligned depth and steady conditions. Depth mismatch assigns a flow change to the wrong fracture, and transient storage can mimic exchange. Treatment may then target the wrong location while the true conductive path remains unresolved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cross-evidence for conductive fractures” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導水裂隙交叉證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cross-evidence for conductive fractures”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Images identify visible structures while flow logs identify actual water exchange. Among many fractures only one may connect to a distant aquifer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導水裂隙交叉證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cross-evidence for conductive fractures" is correct?
options: 看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。
使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。
影像辨識開放構造，流量測井辨識水的實際交換，兩者回答不同問題。
optionsEn: The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.
Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation.
Images identify visible structures while flow logs identify actual water exchange.
quiz.explanation: 影像辨識開放構造，流量測井辨識水的實際交換，兩者回答不同問題。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Images identify visible structures while flow logs identify actual water exchange. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導水裂隙交叉證據：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導水裂隙交叉證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross-evidence for conductive fractures” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設某裂隙上下流量由0.20增至0.35 L/s，局部增量0.15 L/s；只有深度與穩態條件一致時可歸因。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed flow increase from 0.20 to 0.35 L/s across a fracture gives 0.15 L/s locally, attributable only with aligned depth and steady conditions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔內流量、溫度與影像裂隙標記對齊，核對抽水或自然狀態及時間；以隔離區間試驗確認連通，報告將可見裂隙與證實導水裂隙分開，避免外觀推論充當試驗結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align flow, temperature and image picks, documenting pumping or ambient state and time; confirm connectivity with interval testing and distinguish visible fractures from hydraulically demonstrated ones in the report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed flow increase from 0.20 to 0.35 L/s across a fracture gives 0.15 L/s locally, attributable only with aligned depth and steady conditions.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自動判讀與盲查」與「影像資料工程交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Automated interpretation and blind checks" and "Image-data engineering handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自動判讀與盲查：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Automated interpretation and blind checks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自動判讀與盲查」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Automated interpretation and blind checks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 演算法擅長找連續曲線，但電纜陰影、層理和鑽痕也可形成規律圖樣。訓練資料的岩性與水況限制模型外推，須以獨立人工盲查估計漏判和誤判，而非只看輸出數量。 假設人工確認20條裂隙，模型找到16條且另誤報4條，召回率16/20=80%，精確率16/(16+4)=80%。 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自動判讀與盲查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Algorithms find continuous curves, but cable shadows, bedding and drill marks can also form regular patterns. Training lithology and water conditions limit transfer, requiring independent blind checks of misses and false detections rather than output counts alone. For an assumed 20 confirmed fractures, 16 detections plus 4 false positives give recall 80% and precision 16/(16+4)=80%. Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Automated interpretation and blind checks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自動判讀與盲查」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Automated interpretation and blind checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for automated interpretation and blind checks. Preselect blind intervals covering lithology and readability, match manual and model detections and retain reasons for misses; preserve deployed version and training domain, never calling tuning images independent validation.

steps.title: 自動判讀與盲查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Automated interpretation and blind checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自動判讀與盲查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 影像資料工程交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Image-data engineering handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「影像資料工程交接」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Image-data engineering handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。深度、方位、孔徑與採集條件必須形成版本一致的資料組，否則漂亮三維模型不能支援可追溯的工程審查。 假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「影像資料工程交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. Depth, azimuth, diameter and acquisition conditions must form a version-consistent dataset; an attractive three-dimensional model alone cannot support an auditable engineering review. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps. Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Image-data engineering handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「影像資料工程交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Image-data engineering handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. Depth, azimuth, diameter and acquisition conditions must form a version-consistent dataset; an attractive three-dimensional model alone cannot support an auditable engineering review.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「影像資料工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。
孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。
optionsEn: Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.
Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction.
Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
quiz.explanation: 成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 影像資料工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image-data engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「影像資料工程交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Image-data engineering handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability.
quiz.explanation: 隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 影像資料工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Image-data engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「影像資料工程交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Image-data engineering handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。
knowledge.textEn: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影像資料工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Image-data engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。
孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation.
Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
quiz.explanation: 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 原位岩體應力量測
courses.summary: 本課聚焦區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型
courses.focusEn: Separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。
教學量化備忘：假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。
教學量化備忘：假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。
教學量化備忘：假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。
教學量化備忘：假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。
教學量化備忘：假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa.
Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses.

Teaching quantitative note: Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa.

2016 — The Gotthard Base Tunnel enters operation, providing a long-tunnel comparison context
