stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土重量基準」與「應力張量與主值」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Overburden stress baseline" and "Stress tensor and principal values": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「覆土重量基準」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overburden stress baseline” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。覆土估值提供量級檢查，不能取代現地量測，更不能據此假設水平應力必然相同。 假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「覆土重量基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The estimate is a scale check rather than a replacement for measurement, and does not imply equal horizontal stress. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Overburden stress baseline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「覆土重量基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Overburden stress baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土重量基準
knowledge.text: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。覆土估值提供量級檢查，不能取代現地量測，更不能據此假設水平應力必然相同。
knowledge.textEn: Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The estimate is a scale check rather than a replacement for measurement, and does not imply equal horizontal stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土重量基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Overburden stress baseline" is correct?
options: 隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。
垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。
只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。
optionsEn: Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions.
Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「覆土重量基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Overburden stress baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土重量基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Overburden stress baseline", which statement holds?
options: 套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。
任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief.
Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「覆土重量基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Overburden stress baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄覆土重量基準的資料來源與適用條件。用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for overburden stress baseline. Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「覆土重量基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Overburden stress baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土重量基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Overburden stress baseline" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。
只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement.
Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 應力張量與主值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress tensor and principal values: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力張量與主值」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress tensor and principal values” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應力是具有方向的張量，單一法向讀值不能描述岩體三維受力。主應力由張量特徵值求得，旋轉坐標只改變分量表達，不改變主值；壓縮正負號與剪應力定義需一致。 假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。 交換剪應力符號會旋轉主方向，單位或坐標軸混淆又可能保持合理主值卻方向錯誤；支護與岩爆評估因此可能針對錯誤方位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力張量與主值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading. Principal stresses are its eigenvalues; rotating coordinates changes components but not the principal values. Compression sign convention and shear definitions must remain consistent throughout the analysis. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation. Support and rockburst assessments may consequently focus on the wrong direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stress tensor and principal values” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力張量與主值」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stress tensor and principal values”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應力張量與主值
knowledge.text: 應力是具有方向的張量，單一法向讀值不能描述岩體三維受力。主應力由張量特徵值求得，旋轉坐標只改變分量表達，不改變主值；壓縮正負號與剪應力定義需一致。
knowledge.textEn: Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading. Principal stresses are its eigenvalues; rotating coordinates changes components but not the principal values.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力張量與主值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stress tensor and principal values" is correct?
options: 只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。
所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。
應力是具有方向的張量，單一法向讀值不能描述岩體三維受力。
optionsEn: Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.
Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure.
Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading.
quiz.explanation: 應力是具有方向的張量，單一法向讀值不能描述岩體三維受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力張量與主值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress tensor and principal values: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應力張量與主值」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stress tensor and principal values” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：獨立計算特徵值並檢查跡與行列式在旋轉前後不變，對照儀器座標到地理座標的旋轉矩陣；報告列出量測分量、符號和未辨識方向，避免用二維結果假裝完整三維狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently calculate eigenvalues and verify invariant trace and determinant, checking the instrument-to-geographic rotation matrix; report measured components, signs and unresolved directions rather than presenting a plane result as complete three-dimensional stress.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力與孔壓」與「套鑽應變回復」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress and pore pressure" and "Overcoring strain relief": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力與孔壓」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。減壓或開挖同時改變邊界與排水條件，不能用同一孔壓直接扣所有已受擾動測點。 假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力與孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. Depressurization and excavation change boundaries and drainage, so one pressure value cannot be subtracted indiscriminately at disturbed locations. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa. Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力與孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力與孔壓
knowledge.text: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。減壓或開挖同時改變邊界與排水條件，不能用同一孔壓直接扣所有已受擾動測點。
knowledge.textEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. Depressurization and excavation change boundaries and drainage, so one pressure value cannot be subtracted indiscriminately at disturbed locations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力與孔壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress and pore pressure" is correct?
options: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。
所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。
套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。
optionsEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one.
Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure.
All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief.
quiz.explanation: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力與孔壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress and pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力與孔壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄有效應力與孔壓的資料來源與適用條件。將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for effective stress and pore pressure. Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力與孔壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress and pore pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin.
quiz.explanation: 將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力與孔壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress and pore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent.

steps.title: 套鑽應變回復：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overcoring strain relief: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「套鑽應變回復」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overcoring strain relief” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 套鑽釋放局部約束後的應變，需配合彈性常數反演原始應力。岩石若有裂隙、塑性或溫度變化，回復量不再只來自彈性卸載，感測器黏結和方向也會控制可辨識性。 假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。 套鑽過程新裂縫會產生突然應變跳動，若照線彈性式解讀便可能得到虛假的高應力；量規脫黏也可能呈現平順但偏低的回復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「套鑽應變回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overcoring measures strain released by local unloading and requires elastic constants for stress inversion. Fractures, plasticity and temperature add nonelastic changes, while gauge bonding and orientation control what components can be identified. For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix. A new crack during overcoring produces a strain jump that linear inversion can misread as high stress; debonded gauges may instead show smooth but falsely low relief. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Overcoring strain relief” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「套鑽應變回復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Overcoring strain relief”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「套鑽應變回復」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Overcoring measures strain released by local unloading and requires elastic constants for stress inversion.
The first pressure spike after pump shutdown is the fracture closure pressure.

steps.titleEn: Overcoring strain relief: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「套鑽應變回復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Overcoring strain relief” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查各量規卸載歷程及溫度補償，試後保存岩心確認破裂與黏結狀態；以同方向試件測彈性常數，反演殘差及異常通道需逐項說明，不以平均值掩蓋失效量規。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect each gauge relief history and temperature correction, preserving recovered core for fracture and bond checks; measure directional elastic properties and explain inversion residuals and faulty channels individually rather than averaging them away.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: A new crack during overcoring produces a strain jump that linear inversion can misread as high stress; debonded gauges may instead show smooth but falsely low relief. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation" and "Borehole breakouts and orientation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水力破裂壓力判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力破裂壓力判讀」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力歷程包含管路儲能、裂縫起裂、延伸與閉合，不同轉折對應不同物理事件。閉合壓力可提供特定法向應力線索，但既有節理重開與滲漏會讓簡化理論不適用。 假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。 把泵停止時的瞬間尖峰當閉合壓力會混入管路效應，隔離失效又可能使壓力下降看似裂縫延伸；兩者均可導致應力量值失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力破裂壓力判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure history combines line storage, initiation, propagation and closure, with different transitions representing different processes. Closure informs a specific normal stress, but reopening existing joints and leakage can invalidate simple interpretations. Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses. Treating the immediate pump-stop spike as closure pressure includes line effects, while failed isolation may make leakage resemble fracture extension. Both distort the inferred stress magnitude. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵浦停止後的第一個壓力尖峰就是裂縫閉合壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The first pressure spike after pump shutdown is the fracture closure pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水力破裂壓力判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
壓力歷程包含管路儲能、裂縫起裂、延伸與閉合，不同轉折對應不同物理事件。
optionsEn: The first pressure spike after pump shutdown is the fracture closure pressure.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由合格試驗團隊記錄完整壓力流量時間曲線與隔離狀態，交叉使用不同閉合判讀方法並保存分歧；井下壓力須校正高程與管路效應，判讀由岩工工程師核准，教學值不是加壓指令。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: A qualified team records complete pressure-flow-time history and isolation state; compare closure interpretations and retain disagreement, correcting elevation and line effects before rock-engineering approval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 孔壁崩落與方位：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「孔壁崩落與方位」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Borehole breakouts and orientation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壁應力集中可造成成對崩落，但鑽具磨損、節理剝落也可能留下近似形狀。方向推論需符合孔軸、岩性與應力集中模型，裂縫影像和孔徑資料應相互支持而不是互相替代。 假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壁崩落與方位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stress concentration can form paired breakouts, but drilling wear and joint spalling produce similar shapes. Orientation inference must fit the hole axis, lithology and concentration model, with images and calipers providing complementary evidence. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa. Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Borehole breakouts and orientation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對成對特徵是否沿深度穩定、與已知鑽具方向無關，並查核孔壁裂縫與岩性轉換；方向估計附可用區間及不確定度，僅在模型假設成立時才供主應力方位推論。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether paired features persist with depth independently of drilling orientation and compare wall cracks and lithology; report usable intervals and angular uncertainty, inferring stress direction only when the mechanical assumptions are justified.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.questionEn: When "Borehole breakouts and orientation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。
optionsEn: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.
quiz.explanation: 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性各向異性」與「開挖擾動與距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic anisotropy" and "Excavation disturbance and distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性各向異性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic anisotropy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性各向異性」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic anisotropy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。以等向性反演各向異性岩石會把材料方向性錯配成應力方向性，因此取樣方向與彈性矩陣須同步交接。 假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性各向異性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress. Isotropic inversion can misattribute material anisotropy to stress anisotropy, requiring specimen orientation and elastic matrices to accompany the measurements. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution. Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic anisotropy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性各向異性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic anisotropy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彈性各向異性
knowledge.text: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。以等向性反演各向異性岩石會把材料方向性錯配成應力方向性，因此取樣方向與彈性矩陣須同步交接。
knowledge.textEn: Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress. Isotropic inversion can misattribute material anisotropy to stress anisotropy, requiring specimen orientation and elastic matrices to accompany the measurements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彈性各向異性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic anisotropy" is correct?
options: 層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。
層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。
洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。
optionsEn: Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.
Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress.
A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
quiz.explanation: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彈性各向異性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic anisotropy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性各向異性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic anisotropy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「彈性各向異性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elastic anisotropy", which statement holds?
options: 不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 彈性各向異性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elastic anisotropy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性各向異性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic anisotropy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄彈性各向異性的資料來源與適用條件。以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for elastic anisotropy. Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。
knowledge.textEn: Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄彈性各向異性的資料來源與適用條件。以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for elastic anisotropy. Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant.

quiz.question: 要驗證「彈性各向異性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elastic anisotropy"?
options: 以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。

optionsEn: Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant. steps.title: 彈性各向異性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elastic anisotropy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性各向異性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic anisotropy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 開挖擾動與距離：機制與系統路徑

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反演殘差與不確定」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。系統性溫度偏差會同時污染多個通道，須以獨立方法與重複測點辨識。 假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反演殘差與不確定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. A systematic thermal bias can contaminate all channels together and requires independent methods and repeated locations to identify. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset. Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反演殘差與不確定」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 反演殘差與不確定
knowledge.text: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。系統性溫度偏差會同時污染多個通道，須以獨立方法與重複測點辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. A systematic thermal bias can contaminate all channels together and requires independent methods and repeated locations to identify.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反演殘差與不確定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inversion residuals and uncertainty" is correct?
options: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。
反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。
不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
optionsEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions.
Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent.
Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
quiz.explanation: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反演殘差與不確定」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「反演殘差與不確定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反演殘差與不確定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for inversion residuals and uncertainty. Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反演殘差與不確定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inversion residuals and uncertainty"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability.
quiz.explanation: 檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反演殘差與不確定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。

quiz.question: 在「反演殘差與不確定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
optionsEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable.

Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.

quiz.explanationEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力模型工程移交」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Engineering stress-model handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。模型應提供應力張量隨位置的範圍，而非只有三個代表值；施工揭露新資訊時才能合理更新邊界條件。 假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力模型工程移交」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. Spatial tensor ranges, rather than only three representative numbers, allow excavation evidence to update boundary conditions rationally. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution. Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Engineering stress-model handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力模型工程移交」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. Spatial tensor ranges, rather than only three representative numbers, allow excavation evidence to update boundary conditions rationally.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力模型工程移交」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Engineering stress-model handover" is correct?
options: 不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。

Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應力模型工程移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Engineering stress-model handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「應力模型工程移交」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應力模型工程移交」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Engineering stress-model handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄應力模型工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for engineering stress-model handover. Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應力模型工程移交」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Engineering stress-model handover"?
options: 交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。
optionsEn: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
