steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「應力模型工程移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Engineering stress-model handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
knowledge.textEn: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「應力模型工程移交」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Engineering stress-model handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse.
Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 岩體節理剪力試驗
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪
courses.focusEn: Separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。
教學量化備忘：假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。
教學量化備忘：假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。
教學量化備忘：假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。
教學量化備忘：假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。
教學量化備忘：假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa.
Teaching quantitative note: With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval.
Teaching quantitative note: Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「法向應力與摩擦」與「孔壓與有效法向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Normal stress and friction" and "Pore pressure and effective normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「法向應力與摩擦」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Normal stress and friction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。線性摩擦包絡是指定應力範圍的近似，外推到低應力可能虛構黏聚力，高應力又可能壓碎粗糙峰。 假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「法向應力與摩擦」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. A linear envelope approximates a specified stress range; extrapolation can invent low-stress cohesion or miss asperity crushing under high confinement. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Normal stress and friction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「法向應力與摩擦」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Normal stress and friction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 法向應力與摩擦
knowledge.text: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。線性摩擦包絡是指定應力範圍的近似，外推到低應力可能虛構黏聚力，高應力又可能壓碎粗糙峰。
knowledge.textEn: Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. A linear envelope approximates a specified stress range; extrapolation can invent low-stress cohesion or miss asperity crushing under high confinement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「法向應力與摩擦」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Normal stress and friction" is correct?
options: 兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。
外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
optionsEn: A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone.
Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
quiz.explanation: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「法向應力與摩擦」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Normal stress and friction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「法向應力與摩擦」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Normal stress and friction", which statement holds?
options: 只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。
剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.
Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「法向應力與摩擦」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Normal stress and friction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄法向應力與摩擦的資料來源與適用條件。以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for normal stress and friction. Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
knowledge.textEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄法向應力與摩擦的資料來源與適用條件。以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for normal stress and friction. Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal.

quiz.question: 要驗證「法向應力與摩擦」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Normal stress and friction"?
options: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
一條高解析表面剖面足以代表所有方向和尺度的粗糙度。
optionsEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale.
quiz.explanation: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「法向應力與摩擦」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Normal stress and friction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「法向應力與摩擦」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Normal stress and friction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
quiz.explanation: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓與有效法向力」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure and effective normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。名義外加法向荷重不等於節理有效法向力，局部未排水反應也不能用遠處水位直接代替。 假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓與有效法向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. Applied normal force is not effective normal force, and a distant water level cannot represent local undrained response. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface. knowledge.title: 孔壓與有效法向力
knowledge.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force
knowledge.text: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。名義外加法向荷重不等於節理有效法向力，局部未排水反應也不能用遠處水位直接代替。
knowledge.textEn: Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. Applied normal force is not effective normal force, and a distant water level cannot represent local undrained response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓與有效法向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore pressure and effective normal force" is correct?
options: 外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。
水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。
optionsEn: Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate.
quiz.explanation: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓與有效法向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore pressure and effective normal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓、法向力及剪力以相同時鐘記錄，檢查排水管線與試體飽和狀態；比較不同速率試驗能否達到同一有效應力路徑，未量到界面孔壓時需明列推估限制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation; compare whether different rates achieve the same effective stress path, explicitly limiting results when interface pore pressure is inferred rather than measured.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓與有效法向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure and effective normal force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔壓、法向力及剪力以相同時鐘記錄，檢查排水管線與試體飽和狀態；比較不同速率試驗能否達到同一有效應力路徑，未量到界面孔壓時需明列推估限制。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation; compare whether different rates achieve the same effective stress path, explicitly limiting results when interface pore pressure is inferred rather than measured. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pore pressure and effective normal force. Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation; compare whether different rates achieve the same effective stress path, explicitly limiting results when interface pore pressure is inferred rather than measured.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓與有效法向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore pressure and effective normal force"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將孔壓、法向力及剪力以相同時鐘記錄，檢查排水管線與試體飽和狀態；比較不同速率試驗能否達到同一有效應力路徑，未量到界面孔壓時需明列推估限制。
力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓與有效法向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure and effective normal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓與有效法向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore pressure and effective normal force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。
把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks.
quiz.explanation: 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「定力與定剛度邊界」與「剪脹與幾何攀升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Constant-load and stiffness boundaries" and "Dilation and geometric climbing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 定力與定剛度邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Constant-load and stiffness boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「定力與定剛度邊界」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。實際圍岩介於不同約束情境，兩種試驗曲線不能直接混成同一材料定律。 假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。 把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定力與定剛度邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary. Constant-normal-load testing permits movement at fixed load, while constant-normal-stiffness testing increases stress as dilation develops. Actual surrounding rock imposes a specific constraint, so the curves are not interchangeable material laws. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance. Interpreting high machine confinement as intrinsic joint strength overestimates resistance under low field restraint. Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「定力與定剛度邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。實際圍岩介於不同約束情境，兩種試驗曲線不能直接混成同一材料定律。
knowledge.textEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary. Constant-normal-load testing permits movement at fixed load, while constant-normal-stiffness testing increases stress as dilation develops.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「定力與定剛度邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Constant-load and stiffness boundaries" is correct?
options: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。
定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。
只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。
optionsEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary.
Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.
quiz.explanation: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 定力與定剛度邊界：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定力與定剛度邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以標準件校準設備柔度，核對控制器維持的是力、位移還是剛度；將實際法向應力歷程與目標比較，並由設計者說明試驗邊界如何代表隧道周圍岩體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate machine compliance with a reference block and verify whether control maintains force, displacement or stiffness; compare actual normal histories with targets and require the designer to justify their representation of surrounding ground.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 定力與定剛度邊界：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 以標準件校準設備柔度，核對控制器維持的是力、位移還是剛度；將實際法向應力歷程與目標比較，並由設計者說明試驗邊界如何代表隧道周圍岩體。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate machine compliance with a reference block and verify whether control maintains force, displacement or stiffness; compare actual normal histories with targets and require the designer to justify their representation of surrounding ground. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Interpreting high machine confinement as intrinsic joint strength overestimates resistance under low field restraint. Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Calibrate machine compliance with a reference block and verify whether control maintains force, displacement or stiffness; compare actual normal histories with targets and require the designer to justify their representation of surrounding ground.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 定力與定剛度邊界：失效診斷

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 剪脹與幾何攀升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dilation and geometric climbing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剪脹與幾何攀升」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dilation and geometric climbing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 粗糙峰互相攀升造成剪脹，同時提高切向阻力；隨法向應力增加，峰體可能剪斷而減少幾何攀升。剪脹角是位移路徑斜率，不能當成所有位移階段固定的摩擦增量。 假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪脹與幾何攀升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asperities climb over one another, generating dilation and additional resistance. Greater confinement may shear them off and reduce climbing. Dilation angle is a displacement-path slope, not a constant friction increment throughout the test. Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval. Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dilation and geometric climbing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 剪脹與幾何攀升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dilation and geometric climbing: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dilation and geometric climbing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪脹與幾何攀升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance.
The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
quiz.explanation: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「峰值與殘餘強度」與「剪切面積修正」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Peak and residual resistance" and "Shearing-area correction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「峰值與殘餘強度」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Peak and residual resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 峰值需要原有咬合或膠結尚未破壞，殘餘強度則對應較大位移後形成的滑動面。隧道附近若已有位移歷史，直接採首次峰值可能不適當，應先辨識設計機制需要哪一段。 假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「峰值與殘餘強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Peak resistance depends on surviving interlock or bonding, while residual resistance follows development of a sliding surface. Previously displaced ground may not mobilize a first-cycle peak, so the required part of the curve depends on the design mechanism. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety. Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Peak and residual resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「峰值與殘餘強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「峰值與殘餘強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

quiz.question: 依「峰值與殘餘強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Peak and residual resistance", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
一條高解析表面剖面足以代表所有方向和尺度的粗糙度。
剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale.
All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「峰值與殘餘強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Peak and residual resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄峰值與殘餘強度的資料來源與適用條件。保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for peak and residual resistance. Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Peak and residual resistance"?

外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「峰值與殘餘強度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Peak and residual resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「峰值與殘餘強度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Peak and residual resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。
試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases.
Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak.
quiz.explanation: 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 剪切面積修正：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shearing-area correction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剪切面積修正」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shearing-area correction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剪切位移增加會減少上下試件的重疊面積，若仍以初始面積換算應力，就把幾何變化混入材料軟化。對不規則天然節理還需考慮實際接觸區，名義重疊不等於真實接觸。 假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。 忽略面積縮小會把實際穩定阻力誤判為軟化，重複做面積修正又會高估強度；兩者在大位移段尤為嚴重並影響殘餘值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪切面積修正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shear movement reduces specimen overlap, so initial-area stress mixes geometry with material softening. Irregular natural joints also have evolving contact patches; nominal overlap is not the true contact area resisting shear. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area. Ignoring reduced area can make stable resistance appear to soften, while applying correction twice overestimates strength. Both errors become pronounced at large displacement and bias residual values. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shearing-area correction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剪切面積修正」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shearing-area correction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪切面積修正
knowledge.text: 剪切位移增加會減少上下試件的重疊面積，若仍以初始面積換算應力，就把幾何變化混入材料軟化。對不規則天然節理還需考慮實際接觸區，名義重疊不等於真實接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Shear movement reduces specimen overlap, so initial-area stress mixes geometry with material softening. Irregular natural joints also have evolving contact patches; nominal overlap is not the true contact area resisting shear.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪切面積修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shearing-area correction" is correct?
options: 剪切位移增加會減少上下試件的重疊面積，若仍以初始面積換算應力，就把幾何變化混入材料軟化。
剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。
只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。
optionsEn: Shear movement reduces specimen overlap, so initial-area stress mixes geometry with material softening.
Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases.
A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks.
quiz.explanation: 剪切位移增加會減少上下試件的重疊面積，若仍以初始面積換算應力，就把幾何變化混入材料軟化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shear movement reduces specimen overlap, so initial-area stress mixes geometry with material softening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪切面積修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shearing-area correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪切面積修正」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shearing-area correction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從試件幾何與實測位移逐點重算名義面積，並保存未修正與修正應力曲線；若天然表面接觸範圍未知，說明名義面積定義，不用影像猜出的接觸率任意再放大應力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate nominal area at each measured displacement and retain corrected and uncorrected curves; if natural contact area is unknown, state the nominal definition rather than arbitrarily amplifying stress through a guessed contact fraction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shearing-area correction", which statement holds?
options: 力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。

兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
optionsEn: Load-cell accuracy equals the complete uncertainty of a joint shear-stress test.

A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.

steps.title: 剪切面積修正：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 忽略面積縮小會把實際穩定阻力誤判為軟化，重複做面積修正又會高估強度；兩者在大位移段尤為嚴重並影響殘餘值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring reduced area can make stable resistance appear to soften, while applying correction twice overestimates strength. Both errors become pronounced at large displacement and bias residual values. quiz.question: 在「剪切面積修正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速率與排水時間」與「粗糙度與尺度差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rate and drainage time" and "Roughness and scale dependence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 速率與排水時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rate and drainage time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速率與排水時間」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rate and drainage time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細粒充填的排水時間取決於排水距離和固結係數，剪切太快會改變孔壓而非只改變摩擦。岩石接觸面也可能有速率效應，所以速度比較必須維持相同水文與正向約束。 假設特徵排水距離5 mm、cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s，t=L²/cv=2500 s約41.7 min；此為尺度估算。 將未排水弱化歸因於表面磨耗會選錯殘餘參數，反之緩慢試驗的高阻力也不能代表快速卸荷；缺少孔壓資料時兩種機制很難分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速率與排水時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fine infill drainage depends on path length and consolidation coefficient; rapid shearing changes pore pressure as well as friction. Rock contacts may themselves be rate sensitive, so rate comparisons need matched hydraulic and normal boundaries. For assumed drainage length 5 mm and cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s, t=L²/cv=2500 s, about 41.7 min; this is a scaling estimate. Attributing undrained weakening to surface wear selects the wrong residual parameter, while slow-test resistance does not represent rapid unloading. Without pore-pressure records the mechanisms are difficult to distinguish. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rate and drainage time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速率與排水時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rate and drainage time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 速率與排水時間
knowledge.text: 細粒充填的排水時間取決於排水距離和固結係數，剪切太快會改變孔壓而非只改變摩擦。岩石接觸面也可能有速率效應，所以速度比較必須維持相同水文與正向約束。
knowledge.textEn: Fine infill drainage depends on path length and consolidation coefficient; rapid shearing changes pore pressure as well as friction. Rock contacts may themselves be rate sensitive, so rate comparisons need matched hydraulic and normal boundaries.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「速率與排水時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rate and drainage time" is correct?
options: 只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。

optionsEn: A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks.
Fine infill drainage depends on path length and consolidation coefficient; rapid shearing changes pore pressure as well as friction.
One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale.
quiz.explanation: 細粒充填的排水時間取決於排水距離和固結係數，剪切太快會改變孔壓而非只改變摩擦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 速率與排水時間：定量估算

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed drainage length 5 mm and cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s, t=L²/cv=2500 s, about 41.7 min; this is a scaling estimate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 小試件可被單一粗糙峰主導，大節理面則包含多種波長與接觸區。量測粗糙度要標明剖面方向和解析度，因為順層與橫層剪切可能呈現不同咬合，不能用一條剖面代表所有方向。 假設同高程差2 mm在10與100 mm基長上，平均坡度分別0.2與0.02；尺度改變使表觀坡度差10倍。 低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粗糙度與尺度差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: One asperity may dominate a small specimen, while a large joint contains multiple wavelengths and contacts. Roughness profiles require direction and resolution because interlock differs by shearing direction; one trace cannot represent the entire surface. An assumed 2 mm height change over 10 and 100 mm baselines gives slopes 0.2 and 0.02, a tenfold apparent difference caused by scale. Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roughness and scale dependence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An assumed 2 mm height change over 10 and 100 mm baselines gives slopes 0.2 and 0.02, a tenfold apparent difference caused by scale. quiz.explanation: 沿預期剪切方向量測多條表面剖面，另以三維掃描查空間差異；報告點距、濾波與試件尺寸，使用經驗粗糙度模型時需明列其適用尺度和法向應力範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure multiple profiles along expected shear direction and compare three-dimensional scans; report spacing, filtering and specimen size, explicitly bounding the scale and normal-stress range of any empirical roughness model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 粗糙度與尺度差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Roughness and scale dependence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粗糙度與尺度差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roughness and scale dependence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一條高解析表面剖面足以代表所有方向和尺度的粗糙度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。
knowledge.textEn: Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Combining differently filtered indices can make a processing difference appear to be a genuine difference in shear resistance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「粗糙度與尺度差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Roughness and scale dependence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。
低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Load-cell accuracy equals the complete uncertainty of a joint shear-stress test.
Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness.
quiz.explanation: 低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coarse scanning removes fine asperities while high-resolution noise exaggerates roughness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「量測誤差與強度」與「剪切功與試後證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measurement error and strength" and "Shear work and post-test evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 量測誤差與強度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Measurement error and strength: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「量測誤差與強度」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measurement error and strength” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 力與面積的不確定性共同控制換算應力，摩擦角又透過非線性反正切求得。只報設備力計精度會漏掉天然表面尺寸、傾斜與法向控制誤差，須以完整誤差鏈說明結果。 假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。 只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「量測誤差與強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Force and area uncertainty jointly control stress, while friction angle follows a nonlinear inverse tangent. Load-cell accuracy alone omits natural-surface dimensions, rocking and normal-control error, requiring the complete measurement chain. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%. Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Measurement error and strength” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Load-cell accuracy equals the complete uncertainty of a joint shear-stress test." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「量測誤差與強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Measurement error and strength”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 量測誤差與強度
knowledge.text: 力與面積的不確定性共同控制換算應力，摩擦角又透過非線性反正切求得。只報設備力計精度會漏掉天然表面尺寸、傾斜與法向控制誤差，須以完整誤差鏈說明結果。
knowledge.textEn: Force and area uncertainty jointly control stress, while friction angle follows a nonlinear inverse tangent. Load-cell accuracy alone omits natural-surface dimensions, rocking and normal-control error, requiring the complete measurement chain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Load-cell accuracy equals the complete uncertainty of a joint shear-stress test. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「量測誤差與強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measurement error and strength" is correct?
options: 力與面積的不確定性共同控制換算應力，摩擦角又透過非線性反正切求得。
力計精度就是整個節理抗剪應力試驗的不確定度。
剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。
optionsEn: Force and area uncertainty jointly control stress, while friction angle follows a nonlinear inverse tangent.
Load-cell accuracy equals the complete uncertainty of a joint shear-stress test.
All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.
quiz.explanation: 力與面積的不確定性共同控制換算應力，摩擦角又透過非線性反正切求得。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Force and area uncertainty jointly control stress, while friction angle follows a nonlinear inverse tangent. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 量測誤差與強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measurement error and strength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「量測誤差與強度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Measurement error and strength” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用校準紀錄與重複尺寸量測估計不確定度，檢查面積和位移是否共享同一誤差來源；對關鍵強度參數做上下限分析，只有差異大於量測與試件散布時才主張材料確有變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate uncertainty from calibration and repeated dimensions, checking shared error sources in area and displacement; bracket strength parameters and claim material differences only when they exceed measurement uncertainty and specimen variability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「量測誤差與強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measurement error and strength", which statement holds?
options: 外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。

One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.

steps.title: 量測誤差與強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measurement error and strength: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「量測誤差與強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Measurement error and strength” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用校準紀錄與重複尺寸量測估計不確定度，檢查面積和位移是否共享同一誤差來源；對關鍵強度參數做上下限分析，只有差異大於量測與試件散布時才主張材料確有變化。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate uncertainty from calibration and repeated dimensions, checking shared error sources in area and displacement; bracket strength parameters and claim material differences only when they exceed measurement uncertainty and specimen variability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄量測誤差與強度的資料來源與適用條件。用校準紀錄與重複尺寸量測估計不確定度，檢查面積和位移是否共享同一誤差來源；對關鍵強度參數做上下限分析，只有差異大於量測與試件散布時才主張材料確有變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for measurement error and strength. Estimate uncertainty from calibration and repeated dimensions, checking shared error sources in area and displacement; bracket strength parameters and claim material differences only when they exceed measurement uncertainty and specimen variability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「量測誤差與強度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measurement error and strength"?
