steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。
knowledge.textEn: Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements.

quiz.question: 在「量測誤差與強度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。

All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.

quiz.explanationEn: Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 剪切功與試後證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shear work and post-test evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剪切功與試後證據」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear work and post-test evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。試後表面和碎屑讓能量解釋有物理依據，也揭露試體是否走錯破壞面。 假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪切功與試後證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat. Post-test surfaces and debris test that interpretation and identify unintended failure planes. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy. Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shear work and post-test evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剪切功與試後證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shear work and post-test evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 剪切功與試後證據
knowledge.text: 剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。試後表面和碎屑讓能量解釋有物理依據，也揭露試體是否走錯破壞面。
knowledge.textEn: Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat. Post-test surfaces and debris test that interpretation and identify unintended failure planes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「剪切功與試後證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shear work and post-test evidence" is correct?
options: 剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。
剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。
兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
optionsEn: All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.
Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat.
A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
quiz.explanation: 剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪切功與試後證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear work and post-test evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪切功與試後證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear work and post-test evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 剪切功與試後證據：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪切功與試後證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear work and post-test evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for shear work and post-test evidence. quiz.question: 在「剪切功與試後證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shear work and post-test evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。
兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint.
A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
quiz.explanation: 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 隧道地表沉陷監測
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響
courses.focusEn: Separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。
教學量化備忘：假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。
教學量化備忘：假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。
教學量化備忘：假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。
教學量化備忘：假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。
教學量化備忘：假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%.
Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h.
Teaching quantitative note: Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉陷槽形與參數」與「體積損失換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Settlement-trough geometry" and "Volume-loss conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷槽形與參數」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settlement-trough geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。斷面不足時兩參數互相補償，應以完整測點而非只看中線峰值。 假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷槽形與參數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. Sparse observations allow parameters to compensate for each other, requiring a full profile rather than only the centerline. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settlement-trough geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷槽形與參數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Settlement-trough geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉陷槽形與參數
knowledge.text: 高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。斷面不足時兩參數互相補償，應以完整測點而非只看中線峰值。
knowledge.textEn: A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. Sparse observations allow parameters to compensate for each other, requiring a full profile rather than only the centerline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷槽形與參數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Settlement-trough geometry" is correct?
options: 量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。
高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。
地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。
optionsEn: The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width.
A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it.
Surface volume-loss percentage is a directly measured overexcavation percentage.
quiz.explanation: 高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷槽形與參數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settlement-trough geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷槽形與參數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Settlement-trough geometry", which statement holds?
options: 建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。
儀器顯示到十分之一毫米就具有同等實際準確度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage.
An instrument displaying tenths of a millimetre has the same actual accuracy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷槽形與參數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Settlement-trough geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄沉陷槽形與參數的資料來源與適用條件。以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for settlement-trough geometry. Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄沉陷槽形與參數的資料來源與適用條件。以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Settlement-trough geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 體積損失換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Volume-loss conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「體積損失換算」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Volume-loss conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地表沉陷面積代表每單位隧道長度的地表體積變化，與開挖面積比得到表觀體積損失。排水固結、隆起與橫向位移會改變對應關係，不能把它視為直接秤出的超挖土量。 假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「體積損失換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surface settlement area gives volume change per unit tunnel length, and its ratio to excavation area is apparent volume loss. Consolidation, heave and lateral movement alter the correspondence, so it is not directly weighed overexcavated soil. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Volume-loss conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surface volume-loss percentage is a directly measured overexcavation percentage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「體積損失換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Volume-loss conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Surface settlement area gives volume change per unit tunnel length, and its ratio to excavation area is apparent volume loss. Consolidation, heave and lateral movement alter the correspondence, so it is not directly weighed overexcavated soil.

quiz.question: 關於「體積損失換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Volume-loss conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量測斷面數值積分和高斯積分互相核對，統一沉陷單位與開挖直徑；比較施工後不同時段的面積變化，若有地下水降低，將延時固結與即時開挖損失分別討論。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 以量測斷面數值積分和高斯積分互相核對，統一沉陷單位與開挖直徑；比較施工後不同時段的面積變化，若有地下水降低，將延時固結與即時開挖損失分別討論。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 體積損失換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Volume-loss conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「體積損失換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Volume-loss conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surface volume-loss percentage is a directly measured overexcavation percentage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體積損失換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Volume-loss conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。
把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark.
Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it.
quiz.explanation: 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穩定基準與閉合」與「差異沉陷與傾斜」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stable benchmarks and closure" and "Differential movement and tilt": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穩定基準與閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stable benchmarks and closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩定基準與閉合」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stable benchmarks and closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉陷是相對基準的高程變化，基準點自己移動時整個監測網會出現共同假訊號。基準需位於影響區外且有冗餘連接，水準路線閉合只能檢查內部一致，不能證明全網絕對穩定。 假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。 全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩定基準與閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement is elevation change relative to a benchmark. A moving reference creates a common false signal. Redundant external references are required; leveling closure tests internal consistency but does not prove absolute network stability. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm. Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stable benchmarks and closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩定基準與閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stable benchmarks and closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩定基準與閉合
knowledge.text: 沉陷是相對基準的高程變化，基準點自己移動時整個監測網會出現共同假訊號。基準需位於影響區外且有冗餘連接，水準路線閉合只能檢查內部一致，不能證明全網絕對穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Settlement is elevation change relative to a benchmark. A moving reference creates a common false signal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩定基準與閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stable benchmarks and closure" is correct?
options: 沉陷是相對基準的高程變化，基準點自己移動時整個監測網會出現共同假訊號。
水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。
建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。
optionsEn: Settlement is elevation change relative to a benchmark.
A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark.
The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage.
quiz.explanation: 沉陷是相對基準的高程變化，基準點自己移動時整個監測網會出現共同假訊號。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Settlement is elevation change relative to a benchmark. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穩定基準與閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stable benchmarks and closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩定基準與閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stable benchmarks and closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close the leveling network to multiple external controls and compare common movement with independent GNSS or deep benchmarks; preserve raw readings when a reference is suspect and reconstruct elevations traceably under survey-lead review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穩定基準與閉合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stable benchmarks and closure", which statement holds?
options: 儀器顯示到十分之一毫米就具有同等實際準確度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。
optionsEn: An instrument displaying tenths of a millimetre has the same actual accuracy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 穩定基準與閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stable benchmarks and closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩定基準與閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stable benchmarks and closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close the leveling network to multiple external controls and compare common movement with independent GNSS or deep benchmarks; preserve raw readings when a reference is suspect and reconstruct elevations traceably under survey-lead review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄穩定基準與閉合的資料來源與適用條件。閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stable benchmarks and closure. Close the leveling network to multiple external controls and compare common movement with independent GNSS or deep benchmarks; preserve raw readings when a reference is suspect and reconstruct elevations traceably under survey-lead review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩定基準與閉合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stable benchmarks and closure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
掌子面通過後就可以立刻認定延時沉陷已經結束。
閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended.
Close the leveling network to multiple external controls and compare common movement with independent GNSS or deep benchmarks.
quiz.explanation: 閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穩定基準與閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。
optionsEn: Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage.
quiz.explanation: 全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and tilt: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與傾斜」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential movement and tilt” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 建物受影響不只看總沉陷，支承間的差異與曲率會誘發結構變形。剛體傾斜與彎曲須分開，因為相同兩點高差可能代表整棟轉動或局部損傷，單一角度不能自動判定損害。 假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。 只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與傾斜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structural effects depend on differential movement and curvature as well as total settlement. Rigid tilt differs from bending: the same two-point difference may describe whole-building rotation or local distortion, so one angle cannot directly diagnose damage. For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold. Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential movement and tilt” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與傾斜」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Structural effects depend on differential movement and curvature as well as total settlement. Rigid tilt differs from bending: the same two-point difference may describe whole-building rotation or local distortion, so one angle cannot directly diagnose damage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷與傾斜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。
建物受影響不只看總沉陷，支承間的差異與曲率會誘發結構變形。
任何時間窗算出的平均沉陷速率都有相同工程意義。
optionsEn: The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage.
Structural effects depend on differential movement and curvature as well as total settlement.
Average settlement rates from any time window have the same engineering meaning.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and tilt: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷與傾斜」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold.

quiz.question: 依「差異沉陷與傾斜」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Normal readings at most points justify canceling an exceedance at a sensitive building.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and tilt: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與傾斜」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 兩次高程相減會累積各測次不確定性，若共享同一儀器校準，誤差還可能相關。解析度只是最小顯示增量，不等於可辨識沉陷；判斷微小變化時需有重複測量與環境補償。 假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「精度與差值不確定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Small changes require repeat observations and environmental checks before interpretation. Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm. Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement. steps.title: 精度與差值不確定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Precision of displacement differences: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「精度與差值不確定」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Precision of displacement differences” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions; flag unresolved small changes instead of forcing a smooth trend, with quality flags approved by the survey lead.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 精度與差值不確定：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「精度與差值不確定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水下降與固結」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drawdown and consolidation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。必須分開孔壓下降與總應力變化，水位穿越土層改變單位重時，簡單γwΔh換算不能直接完整代表。 假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水下降與固結」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough. Separate pore-pressure reduction from changing total stress; when a water table crosses layers and changes unit weight, γwΔh alone is incomplete. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes. Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drawdown and consolidation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。
optionsEn: Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally.
Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough.
Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
quiz.explanation: 水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地下水下降與固結」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown and consolidation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drawdown and consolidation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水下降與固結」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown and consolidation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「地下水下降與固結」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。

steps.title: 施工里程與多源事件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chainage and multiple events: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工里程與多源事件」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 同一監測點可能受雙線隧道、車站開挖、灌漿與外部施工影響，位移對時間曲線需要連到各事件位置。將所有變化歸給最近掌子面會忽略延時與重疊，應建立可比較的事件索引。 假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。 錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工里程與多源事件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A point may respond to twin drives, station excavation, grouting and unrelated works. Time histories must connect to each event location. Assigning every change to the nearest face ignores delay and overlap, requiring a comparable event index. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention. Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Chainage and multiple events” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 施工里程與多源事件：失效診斷

steps.title: 長期追蹤與結案：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term tracking and closeout: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期追蹤與結案」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term tracking and closeout” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工通過不代表所有沉陷立即停止，黏土固結及地下水恢復可能延續。結案需有基準穩定、速率趨勢和建物狀況的共同證據，並保留後續營運期能銜接的坐標與時間基準。 假設連續四週增量0.8、0.4、0.2、0.1 mm，總增量1.5 mm；遞減趨勢不等於未來必定為零。 過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期追蹤與結案」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passage does not end settlement immediately; clay consolidation and groundwater recovery can continue. Closeout needs stable references, rate trends and asset condition together, preserving coordinates and time datums for operational monitoring. Assumed weekly increments 0.8,0.4,0.2 and 0.1 mm total 1.5 mm; a decreasing trend does not prove zero future movement. Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term tracking and closeout” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 關於「長期追蹤與結案」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended.

steps.instruction: 以固定方法檢查長期讀值、孔壓恢復和既有裂縫，說明監測停止或降頻的個案依據；交付原始資料、校正歷程與未解決項，由業主及工程負責人共同確認接管條件。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review long-term levels, pressure recovery and existing cracks consistently, justifying any reduced frequency or cessation; deliver raw data, corrections and unresolved issues for joint owner and engineering approval of handover conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄長期追蹤與結案的資料來源與適用條件。以固定方法檢查長期讀值、孔壓恢復和既有裂縫，說明監測停止或降頻的個案依據；交付原始資料、校正歷程與未解決項，由業主及工程負責人共同確認接管條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for long-term tracking and closeout. Review long-term levels, pressure recovery and existing cracks consistently, justifying any reduced frequency or cessation; deliver raw data, corrections and unresolved issues for joint owner and engineering approval of handover conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期追蹤與結案」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term tracking and closeout"?
options: 以固定方法檢查長期讀值、孔壓恢復和既有裂縫，說明監測停止或降頻的個案依據；交付原始資料、校正歷程與未解決項，由業主及工程負責人共同確認接管條件。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。
optionsEn: Review long-term levels, pressure recovery and existing cracks consistently, justifying any reduced frequency or cessation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally.
quiz.explanation: 以固定方法檢查長期讀值、孔壓恢復和既有裂縫，說明監測停止或降頻的個案依據；交付原始資料、校正歷程與未解決項，由業主及工程負責人共同確認接管條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review long-term levels, pressure recovery and existing cracks consistently, justifying any reduced frequency or cessation; deliver raw data, corrections and unresolved issues for joint owner and engineering approval of handover conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期追蹤與結案：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term tracking and closeout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期追蹤與結案」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term tracking and closeout” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「掌子面通過後就可以立刻認定延時沉陷已經結束。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期追蹤與結案」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term tracking and closeout" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。
量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history.
The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width.
quiz.explanation: 過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 隧道收斂量測
courses.summary: 本課聚焦用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制
courses.focusEn: Identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。
教學量化備忘：假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。
教學量化備忘：假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。
教學量化備忘：假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。
教學量化備忘：假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。
教學量化備忘：假設收斂由8增至11 mm歷時6 h，平均0.5 mm/h；同期面進3 m，空間增率1 mm/m。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag.
Teaching quantitative note: If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed convergence increase from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h gives 0.5 mm/h; with 3 m advance, the spatial increment is 1 mm/m.
