steps.title: 收斂反分析與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence back-analysis and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂反分析與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence back-analysis and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄收斂反分析與交接的資料來源與適用條件。保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for convergence back-analysis and handover. Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。
knowledge.textEn: Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.

Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收斂反分析與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence back-analysis and handover"?
options: 保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。
optionsEn: Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes.

quiz.explanationEn: Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits. steps.title: 收斂反分析與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence back-analysis and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂反分析與交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence back-analysis and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂反分析與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence back-analysis and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。
兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability.
An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved.
quiz.explanation: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 掌子面攝影測量
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型
courses.focusEn: Reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

教學量化備忘：假設掌子面50 m²中實際重建42 m²，可見重建率84%；餘8 m²不能按平均表面直接補成穩定。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping.
Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements.
Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed 50 m² face with 42 m² reconstructed, coverage is 84%; the remaining 8 m² cannot be filled with an average surface and declared stable.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「像素尺度與可見細節」與「立體基線與深度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pixel scale and visible detail" and "Stereo baseline and depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「像素尺度與可見細節」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pixel scale and visible detail” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。鏡頭模糊、影像雜訊及岩面紋理會限制可辨特徵，裂隙寬度低於有效分辨率時只能記為未解析。 假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「像素尺度與可見細節」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. Blur, noise and rock texture limit discernible features, and subresolution cracks must remain unresolved. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pixel scale and visible detail” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「像素尺度與可見細節」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pixel scale and visible detail”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 像素尺度與可見細節
knowledge.text: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。鏡頭模糊、影像雜訊及岩面紋理會限制可辨特徵，裂隙寬度低於有效分辨率時只能記為未解析。
knowledge.textEn: Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. Blur, noise and rock texture limit discernible features, and subresolution cracks must remain unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「像素尺度與可見細節」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pixel scale and visible detail" is correct?
options: 增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。
地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。
所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
optionsEn: Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs.
Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry.
Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「像素尺度與可見細節」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pixel scale and visible detail” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「像素尺度與可見細節」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pixel scale and visible detail", which statement holds?
options: 一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。
自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.
Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「像素尺度與可見細節」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pixel scale and visible detail” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄像素尺度與可見細節的資料來源與適用條件。用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pixel scale and visible detail. Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄像素尺度與可見細節的資料來源與適用條件。用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pixel scale and visible detail. Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.

quiz.question: 要驗證「像素尺度與可見細節」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pixel scale and visible detail"?
options: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
跨越兩個節理面擬合的平均平面就是現場的真實節理。
optionsEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The average plane fitted across two joints is a real joint surface in the ground.
quiz.explanation: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「像素尺度與可見細節」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pixel scale and visible detail” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「像素尺度與可見細節」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pixel scale and visible detail" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Enlargement and denser output do not create source information.
Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「立體基線與深度」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stereo baseline and depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。拍攝幾何需要兼顧角度交會與遮擋，單純增加照片數不能補救全部來自同一位置。 假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「立體基線與深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth. A short baseline amplifies image error, while a long one loses common texture. Geometry must balance intersection angle and occlusion; many photographs from one position do not solve the problem. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stereo baseline and depth” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「立體基線與深度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stereo baseline and depth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 立體基線與深度
knowledge.text: 不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。拍攝幾何需要兼顧角度交會與遮擋，單純增加照片數不能補救全部來自同一位置。
knowledge.textEn: Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth. A short baseline amplifies image error, while a long one loses common texture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「立體基線與深度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stereo baseline and depth" is correct?
options: 所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。
不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。
optionsEn: Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature.
Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth.
quiz.explanation: 不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「立體基線與深度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stereo baseline and depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「立體基線與深度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stereo baseline and depth", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
濕壁上的反光亮點在所有視角都可以當固定紋理。
控制點也可以同時當作獨立精度檢核點。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction.
Control points can simultaneously serve as independent accuracy checkpoints.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「立體基線與深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stereo baseline and depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄立體基線與深度的資料來源與適用條件。繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stereo baseline and depth. Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄立體基線與深度的資料來源與適用條件。繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stereo baseline and depth. Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「立體基線與深度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stereo baseline and depth"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。
把兩期全部點雲最佳配準就不會消除任何真實位移。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features.
Best-fitting all points across two epochs cannot remove genuine movement.
quiz.explanation: 繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「立體基線與深度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stereo baseline and depth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「立體基線與深度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stereo baseline and depth" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。
低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature.
Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth.
quiz.explanation: 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相機校準與畸變」與「尺度與控制點布置」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Camera calibration and distortion" and "Scale and control distribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相機校準與畸變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Camera calibration and distortion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相機校準與畸變」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Camera calibration and distortion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焦距、主點與鏡頭畸變共同控制射線方向，自校準需要足夠幾何多樣性才能辨識。全部照片近似共面或相機變焦，容易讓畸變與地表彎曲互相補償，形成看似低殘差的錯誤模型。 假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。 將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相機校準與畸變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Focal length, principal point and distortion govern rays. Self-calibration needs geometric diversity; near-planar views or changing zoom can trade lens distortion against surface curvature, producing a wrong model with low residuals. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent. Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Camera calibration and distortion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

knowledge.title: 相機校準與畸變
knowledge.text: 焦距、主點與鏡頭畸變共同控制射線方向，自校準需要足夠幾何多樣性才能辨識。全部照片近似共面或相機變焦，容易讓畸變與地表彎曲互相補償，形成看似低殘差的錯誤模型。
knowledge.textEn: Focal length, principal point and distortion govern rays. Self-calibration needs geometric diversity; near-planar views or changing zoom can trade lens distortion against surface curvature, producing a wrong model with low residuals.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 相機校準與畸變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Camera calibration and distortion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相機校準與畸變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：固定焦距與對焦狀態並保留原始EXIF，對照校準板及不同方位影像；檢查像面殘差是否呈徑向系統圖樣，獨立檢核仍有曲面偏差時，不以低重投影誤差直接驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix and document focal and focus state with original EXIF, comparing calibration targets and varied views; inspect radial residual patterns and do not accept low reprojection error when independent checks retain systematic surface curvature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 相機校準與畸變：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Camera calibration and distortion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 固定焦距與對焦狀態並保留原始EXIF，對照校準板及不同方位影像；檢查像面殘差是否呈徑向系統圖樣，獨立檢核仍有曲面偏差時，不以低重投影誤差直接驗收。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix and document focal and focus state with original EXIF, comparing calibration targets and varied views; inspect radial residual patterns and do not accept low reprojection error when independent checks retain systematic surface curvature. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 尺度與控制點布置：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale and control distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。控制點若全擠在一角，模型其他區域仍可能傾斜或彎曲，應分布於可觀測範圍並保留獨立檢核點。 假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尺度與控制點布置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Image matching determines relative geometry; reliable control establishes dimensions and orientation. Controls clustered in one corner leave other areas free to tilt or warp, so distribute them across the observable region and reserve independent checks. An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping. One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale and control distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanation: 影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Image matching determines relative geometry; reliable control establishes dimensions and orientation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 尺度與控制點布置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scale and control distribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「尺度與控制點布置」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scale and control distribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立測量取得控制坐標與不確定度，將控制及檢核分組並畫分布圖；驗收不只看控制殘差，也檢查遠離控制區的檢核點，缺乏覆蓋的區域須標示較低可信度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey control coordinates and uncertainties independently and map separate control and check groups; acceptance includes checkpoints away from controls, with lower confidence explicitly marked where spatial coverage is inadequate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 尺度與控制點布置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale and control distribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「尺度與控制點布置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale and control distribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立測量取得控制坐標與不確定度，將控制及檢核分組並畫分布圖；驗收不只看控制殘差，也檢查遠離控制區的檢核點，缺乏覆蓋的區域須標示較低可信度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey control coordinates and uncertainties independently and map separate control and check groups; acceptance includes checkpoints away from controls, with lower confidence explicitly marked where spatial coverage is inadequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄尺度與控制點布置的資料來源與適用條件。以獨立測量取得控制坐標與不確定度，將控制及檢核分組並畫分布圖；驗收不只看控制殘差，也檢查遠離控制區的檢核點，缺乏覆蓋的區域須標示較低可信度。

Survey control coordinates and uncertainties independently and map separate control and check groups; acceptance includes checkpoints away from controls, with lower confidence explicitly marked where spatial coverage is inadequate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 尺度與控制點布置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scale and control distribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「尺度與控制點布置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale and control distribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「尺度與控制點布置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。
濕壁上的反光亮點在所有視角都可以當固定紋理。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model.
Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction.
quiz.explanation: 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「照明與濕壁反光」與「遮擋與可見範圍」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lighting and wet-wall reflections" and "Occlusion and visible coverage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 照明與濕壁反光：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lighting and wet-wall reflections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「照明與濕壁反光」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lighting and wet-wall reflections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 攝影匹配假設同一紋理在不同視角仍可辨識，濕岩反光會隨視點移動而違反此假設。陰影、粉塵及過曝也會抹去特徵，需先評估影像品質再談高密度重建。 假設影像有200萬有效岩面像素，其中20萬過曝，過曝率10%；不能將其插值面視為直接量測。 反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「照明與濕壁反光」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Matching assumes recognizable texture across viewpoints. Wet-rock highlights move with viewpoint and violate that assumption, while shadows, dust and saturation erase features. Assess source-image quality before requesting dense reconstruction. If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements. Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures. Smoothing before export can hide both artifacts behind a visually convincing surface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lighting and wet-wall reflections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濕壁上的反光亮點在所有視角都可以當固定紋理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「照明與濕壁反光」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lighting and wet-wall reflections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濕壁上的反光亮點在所有視角都可以當固定紋理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「照明與濕壁反光」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lighting and wet-wall reflections" is correct?

自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。

Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed.

steps.title: 照明與濕壁反光：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「照明與濕壁反光」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設影像有200萬有效岩面像素，其中20萬過曝，過曝率10%；不能將其插值面視為直接量測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 2000000 face pixels include 200000 saturated pixels, saturation is 10%; interpolated surfaces there are not direct measurements. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 照明與濕壁反光：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「照明與濕壁反光」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lighting and wet-wall reflections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures. Smoothing before export can hide both artifacts behind a visually convincing surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「照明與濕壁反光」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。
反光亮點被當成固定特徵會產生漂浮點，濕壁暗帶也可能被誤判為裂隙；若平滑後直接匯出，錯誤來源會被漂亮表面掩蓋。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed.
Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures.

quiz.explanationEn: Highlights treated as fixed features produce floating points, while wet dark bands mimic fractures. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 遮擋與可見範圍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Occlusion and visible coverage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「遮擋與可見範圍」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Occlusion and visible coverage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩塊凸出會遮住其後凹面，多視點可改善卻不能保證全部可見。點雲孔洞應區分不可見、低紋理和處理失敗，因為缺測背面可能恰好控制塊體厚度與可動方向。 假設掌子面50 m²中實際重建42 m²，可見重建率84%；餘8 m²不能按平均表面直接補成穩定。 自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「遮擋與可見範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Protruding blocks hide recesses; additional viewpoints help without guaranteeing complete coverage. Distinguish occlusion, poor texture and processing failure because an unseen back surface may control block thickness and movement direction. For an assumed 50 m² face with 42 m² reconstructed, coverage is 84%; the remaining 8 m² cannot be filled with an average surface and declared stable. Automatic mesh closure fills recesses and underestimates overbreak or invents block backs. A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Occlusion and visible coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 遮擋與可見範圍：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「遮擋與可見範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以原始照片及視線圖查核點雲空洞，對不易看見的頂拱區單列覆蓋；只有在核准安全觀測位置取得補充資料，不能因追求模型完整而接近未支護掌子面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review gaps against original images and visibility rays, reporting crown coverage separately; supplementary observations must use approved safe locations, never approaching an unsupported face merely to complete a model. A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Review gaps against original images and visibility rays, reporting crown coverage separately; supplementary observations must use approved safe locations, never approaching an unsupported face merely to complete a model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Automatic mesh closure fills recesses and underestimates overbreak or invents block backs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。

Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature.
Review gaps against original images and visibility rays, reporting crown coverage separately.

steps.title: 遮擋與可見範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Occlusion and visible coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遮擋與可見範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Occlusion and visible coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic mesh closure fills recesses and underestimates overbreak or invents block backs. A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：自動封閉網格可能把凹穴填平而低估超挖，也可能虛構塊體背面；模型封閉並不代表已取得完整幾何，現場判斷仍須知道不可見處。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A closed model therefore does not mean complete observed geometry, and engineering interpretation must retain visibility limits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「遮擋與可見範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
控制點也可以同時當作獨立精度檢核點。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Control points can simultaneously serve as independent accuracy checkpoints.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重投影與獨立精度」與「節理平面與法向」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reprojection versus independent accuracy" and "Joint planes and normals": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重投影與獨立精度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reprojection versus independent accuracy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重投影與獨立精度」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reprojection versus independent accuracy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重投影殘差衡量影像方程內部一致，不能單獨代表物件坐標精度。錯誤尺度或共同控制偏差仍可有很小殘差，必須使用未參與最佳化的檢核資料評估外部準確性。 假設三個檢核誤差1、2、2 mm，RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm；不等於最大誤差。 把控制點同時當檢核點會誇大精度，模型又可能在少數點附近過擬合；若只報平均誤差，邊緣失真會被良好中心區大量資料沖淡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重投影與獨立精度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reprojection residual measures internal image consistency, not object-space accuracy. Wrong scale or common control bias can coexist with small residuals, requiring independent observations excluded from optimization to assess external accuracy. For assumed checkpoint errors 1,2 and 2 mm, RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm; this is not the maximum error. Reusing controls as checkpoints exaggerates accuracy and can hide local overfitting. Reporting only an average also dilutes distorted edges with numerous good observations from the center of the model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reprojection versus independent accuracy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「控制點也可以同時當作獨立精度檢核點。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Control points can simultaneously serve as independent accuracy checkpoints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重投影與獨立精度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reprojection versus independent accuracy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重投影與獨立精度
knowledge.text: 重投影殘差衡量影像方程內部一致，不能單獨代表物件坐標精度。錯誤尺度或共同控制偏差仍可有很小殘差，必須使用未參與最佳化的檢核資料評估外部準確性。
knowledge.textEn: Reprojection residual measures internal image consistency, not object-space accuracy. Wrong scale or common control bias can coexist with small residuals, requiring independent observations excluded from optimization to assess external accuracy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：控制點也可以同時當作獨立精度檢核點。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Control points can simultaneously serve as independent accuracy checkpoints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重投影與獨立精度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reprojection versus independent accuracy" is correct?
options: 控制點也可以同時當作獨立精度檢核點。
重投影殘差衡量影像方程內部一致，不能單獨代表物件坐標精度。
跨越兩個節理面擬合的平均平面就是現場的真實節理。
optionsEn: Control points can simultaneously serve as independent accuracy checkpoints.
Reprojection residual measures internal image consistency, not object-space accuracy.
The average plane fitted across two joints is a real joint surface in the ground.
quiz.explanation: 重投影殘差衡量影像方程內部一致，不能單獨代表物件坐標精度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reprojection residual measures internal image consistency, not object-space accuracy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重投影與獨立精度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reprojection versus independent accuracy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重投影與獨立精度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reprojection versus independent accuracy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個檢核誤差1、2、2 mm，RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm；不等於最大誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed checkpoint errors 1,2 and 2 mm, RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm; this is not the maximum error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別報告像素殘差、三維檢核誤差與最大局部偏差，註明檢核點是否獨立；將模型與全測站或雷射掃描在同一坐標比較，系統性方向誤差需先查基準再談平均精度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Report pixel residual, three-dimensional checkpoint error and maximum local discrepancy separately with checkpoint independence; compare surveying or laser scanning in a common frame and investigate systematic directional error before claiming average accuracy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個檢核誤差1、2、2 mm，RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm；不等於最大誤差。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed checkpoint errors 1,2 and 2 mm, RMSE=√((1+4+4)/3)=1.73 mm; this is not the maximum error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重投影與獨立精度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reprojection versus independent accuracy", which statement holds?
options: 彩色模型看起來逼真，就足以代替原始照片與坐標紀錄。
所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: A realistic colored model adequately replaces original photographs and coordinate records.
Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.instructionEn: A fitted plane yields joint orientation, but combining several surfaces produces a least-squares compromise.
