options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
改變選面範圍與抽樣密度檢查法向是否穩定，並以人工地質描線核對是否同一節理；法向需轉到工程坐標且保留正反向約定，不能將表面法向誤作傾向方位。
濕壁上的反光亮點在所有視角都可以當固定紋理。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Vary selection extent and sampling density to test normal stability and compare geological traces.
Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction.
quiz.explanation: 改變選面範圍與抽樣密度檢查法向是否穩定，並以人工地質描線核對是否同一節理；法向需轉到工程坐標且保留正反向約定，不能將表面法向誤作傾向方位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Vary selection extent and sampling density to test normal stability and compare geological traces; transform to engineering coordinates with a stated sign convention, avoiding confusion between the normal vector and dip-direction azimuth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節理平面與法向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint planes and normals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理平面與法向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint planes and normals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result. Wedge analysis may then miss the true intersection or manufacture a nonexistent block. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wedge analysis may then miss the true intersection or manufacture a nonexistent block.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨越兩個節理面擬合的平均平面就是現場的真實節理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The average plane fitted across two joints is a real joint surface in the ground." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。
knowledge.textEn: Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result. Wedge analysis may then miss the true intersection or manufacture a nonexistent block.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節理平面與法向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint planes and normals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
把兩期全部點雲最佳配準就不會消除任何真實位移。
跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Best-fitting all points across two epochs cannot remove genuine movement.
Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result.
quiz.explanation: 跨越兩面擬合會生成現場不存在的中間傾角，細密點群偏重一側又會支配結果；由此做楔體分析可能漏掉真正交線或創造假楔體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fitting across two planes invents an intermediate dip, and dense points on one side bias the result. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重複測量與變化偵測」與「模型證據與安全交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Repeat surveys and change detection" and "Model evidence and safe handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重複測量與變化偵測：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeat surveys and change detection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複測量與變化偵測」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeat surveys and change detection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩次點雲差值同時包含真實變化與配準誤差，不能把每個非零距離當作岩塊移動。表面法向方向的比較與共同穩定區很重要，配準若包含變形面會把真位移吸收。 假設兩期表面標準不確定各2 mm且獨立，差值u=2.83 mm；約95%正態尺度1.96u=5.54 mm。 使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複測量與變化偵測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cloud differences combine real change and registration error, so nonzero distance alone does not prove movement. Compare along suitable surface normals using stable areas; registration against deforming surfaces can absorb the true displacement. Assume independent surface uncertainties of 2 mm per epoch; difference u=2.83 mm and an approximate 95% normal scale is 1.96u=5.54 mm. Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeat surveys and change detection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把兩期全部點雲最佳配準就不會消除任何真實位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Best-fitting all points across two epochs cannot remove genuine movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複測量與變化偵測」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeat surveys and change detection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複測量與變化偵測
knowledge.text: 兩次點雲差值同時包含真實變化與配準誤差，不能把每個非零距離當作岩塊移動。表面法向方向的比較與共同穩定區很重要，配準若包含變形面會把真位移吸收。
knowledge.textEn: Cloud differences combine real change and registration error, so nonzero distance alone does not prove movement. Compare along suitable surface normals using stable areas; registration against deforming surfaces can absorb the true displacement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把兩期全部點雲最佳配準就不會消除任何真實位移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Best-fitting all points across two epochs cannot remove genuine movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複測量與變化偵測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeat surveys and change detection" is correct?
options: 兩次點雲差值同時包含真實變化與配準誤差，不能把每個非零距離當作岩塊移動。
把兩期全部點雲最佳配準就不會消除任何真實位移。
彩色模型看起來逼真，就足以代替原始照片與坐標紀錄。
optionsEn: Cloud differences combine real change and registration error, so nonzero distance alone does not prove movement.
Best-fitting all points across two epochs cannot remove genuine movement.
A realistic colored model adequately replaces original photographs and coordinate records.
quiz.explanation: 兩次點雲差值同時包含真實變化與配準誤差，不能把每個非零距離當作岩塊移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cloud differences combine real change and registration error, so nonzero distance alone does not prove movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複測量與變化偵測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeat surveys and change detection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複測量與變化偵測」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeat surveys and change detection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩期表面標準不確定各2 mm且獨立，差值u=2.83 mm；約95%正態尺度1.96u=5.54 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent surface uncertainties of 2 mm per epoch; difference u=2.83 mm and an approximate 95% normal scale is 1.96u=5.54 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩期表面標準不確定各2 mm且獨立，差值u=2.83 mm；約95%正態尺度1.96u=5.54 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent surface uncertainties of 2 mm per epoch; difference u=2.83 mm and an approximate 95% normal scale is 1.96u=5.54 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複測量與變化偵測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repeat surveys and change detection", which statement holds?
options: 所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。
optionsEn: Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複測量與變化偵測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeat surveys and change detection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複測量與變化偵測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeat surveys and change detection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄重複測量與變化偵測的資料來源與適用條件。以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for repeat surveys and change detection. Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。
knowledge.textEn: Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄重複測量與變化偵測的資料來源與適用條件。以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for repeat surveys and change detection. Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複測量與變化偵測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeat surveys and change detection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。
以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed.
Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas.
quiz.explanation: 以外部穩定控制配準並保存變換參數，對相同可見區比較法向距離；結合局部粗糙度與誤差界線標示可辨變化，非正態或相關誤差時不得直接沿用本課95%係數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Register using stable external controls and retain transformations, comparing normal distances over shared visible areas; combine roughness with uncertainty to flag detectable change, avoiding the illustrative 95% factor under correlated or nonnormal errors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複測量與變化偵測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeat surveys and change detection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複測量與變化偵測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeat surveys and change detection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用全部面點最佳擬合會把整片岩面移動抵消，照明造成的重建差異又可能假裝剝落；沒有共視遮罩時缺測區會產生巨大的假變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Best-fitting all face points can cancel whole-surface movement, while lighting-driven reconstruction differences mimic spalling. Missing common-visibility masks create large false changes where one epoch has no observations. steps.title: 模型證據與安全交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Model evidence and safe handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模型證據與安全交接」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Model evidence and safe handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掌子面模型是地質記錄工具，不能替代現場支護與穩定判斷。交接須包含影像、坐標、檢核、可見範圍和拍攝時刻，讓後續設計知道模型對應哪次開挖及哪些部分只是插值。 假設10項交接資料有9項齊備，完整率90%；缺少坐標基準這1項仍可使整個模型不可整合。 只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模型證據與安全交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A face model documents geology rather than replacing support or stability decisions. Handover includes images, datum, checks, visibility and capture time so designers know the excavation round represented and which surfaces are interpolated. If 9 of an assumed 10 handover items are complete, completeness is 90%; one missing coordinate datum can still make the entire model unusable for integration. A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Mismatched chainage may direct support interpretation to the previous excavation round, and visual realism cannot compensate for the missing evidence chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Model evidence and safe handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「彩色模型看起來逼真，就足以代替原始照片與坐標紀錄。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A realistic colored model adequately replaces original photographs and coordinate records." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模型證據與安全交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Model evidence and safe handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 模型證據與安全交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model evidence and safe handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模型證據與安全交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Model evidence and safe handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項交接資料有9項齊備，完整率90%；缺少坐標基準這1項仍可使整個模型不可整合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 handover items are complete, completeness is 90%; one missing coordinate datum can still make the entire model unusable for integration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從報告中的一條節理追查至原照片與選點，抽驗坐標及拍攝里程；測量與地質主管共同確認可用範圍，影像可取得不代表允許接近掌子面，所有補拍遵守核准現場觀測程序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a reported joint to original images and picks and audit coordinates and capture chainage; survey and geology leads jointly approve use limits, while supplementary photography remains subject to approved site observation procedures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 模型證據與安全交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model evidence and safe handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模型證據與安全交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Model evidence and safe handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從報告中的一條節理追查至原照片與選點，抽驗坐標及拍攝里程；測量與地質主管共同確認可用範圍，影像可取得不代表允許接近掌子面，所有補拍遵守核准現場觀測程序。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a reported joint to original images and picks and audit coordinates and capture chainage; survey and geology leads jointly approve use limits, while supplementary photography remains subject to approved site observation procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Mismatched chainage may direct support interpretation to the previous excavation round, and visual realism cannot compensate for the missing evidence chain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。
knowledge.textEn: A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Mismatched chainage may direct support interpretation to the previous excavation round, and visual realism cannot compensate for the missing evidence chain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型證據與安全交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model evidence and safe handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。
增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability.
Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs.
quiz.explanation: 只交付彩色網格會失去重算與查錯能力，模型與施工里程錯配又會讓支護判讀針對前一回合岩面；視覺逼真並不能彌補證據鏈缺失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A colored mesh alone loses reconstruction and auditability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以土水作用、支護壓力梯度與失土證據界定軟土開挖面模型
courses.focusEn: Bound soft-ground face models using soil-water interaction, pressure gradients and ground-loss evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。
教學量化備忘：假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。
教學量化備忘：假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。
教學量化備忘：假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。
教學量化備忘：假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。
教學量化備忘：假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range.
Teaching quantitative note: Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first.

timelineEn: 2009 — FHWA publishes its civil-elements manual for road tunnels
2016 — The Gotthard Base Tunnel enters operation, providing a long-tunnel comparison context
2017 — Crossrail publishes its updated geological section and interpretation limitations
codes: 美國聯邦公路管理局公路隧道設計施工技術手冊，2009
香港岩土指南二：場地勘察，2017更新
codesEn: FHWA Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels, 2009
Hong Kong Geoguide 2: Guide to Site Investigation, 2017 update
landmarks: 倫敦Crossrail：公開調查與建設背景
聖哥達基線隧道：深埋岩體對照
landmarksEn: London Crossrail: public investigation and construction context

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總應力與有效應力」與「壓力梯度與高度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total and effective stress" and "Pressure gradient with height": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總應力與有效應力」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。把土水壓力合併成單一數值再任意扣減，容易重複計入或遺漏孔壓。 假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總應力與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. Short-term undrained clay and drained sand require different strength descriptions; merging everything into one pressure and then subtracting arbitrarily can double-count or omit water effects. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總應力與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總應力與有效應力
knowledge.text: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。把土水壓力合併成單一數值再任意扣減，容易重複計入或遺漏孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. Short-term undrained clay and drained sand require different strength descriptions; merging everything into one pressure and then subtracting arbitrarily can double-count or omit water effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「總應力與有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total and effective stress" is correct?
options: 不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。
軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。
一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
optionsEn: Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model.
Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water.
A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 軟土開挖面受骨架應力與孔隙水共同作用，短期不排水黏土和排水砂土需要不同強度描述。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Face loading combines skeleton stress and pore water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總應力與有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總法向應力300 kPa、孔壓180 kPa，有效應力120 kPa；這只是應力分解，不是支護壓力設定。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed total normal stress 300 kPa and pore pressure 180 kPa give effective stress 120 kPa; this is decomposition, not a support-pressure setting.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總應力與有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total and effective stress", which statement holds?
options: 某工程的臨界穩定指標可以不看幾何直接搬到另一工程。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總應力與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄總應力與有效應力的資料來源與適用條件。以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for total and effective stress. Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄總應力與有效應力的資料來源與適用條件。以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for total and effective stress. Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總應力與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total and effective stress"?
options: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。

高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。
optionsEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.

quiz.explanationEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總應力與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總應力與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency.
A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure gradient with height: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力梯度與高度」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure gradient with height” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。只控制單一感測器讀值不能保證全掌子面均衡，必須把所有讀值換算到共同高度再比較分布。 假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力梯度與高度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. One sensor does not prove full-face balance; readings need a common elevation and a distribution comparison. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure gradient with height” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力梯度與高度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure gradient with height”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力梯度與高度
knowledge.text: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。只控制單一感測器讀值不能保證全掌子面均衡，必須把所有讀值換算到共同高度再比較分布。
knowledge.textEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. One sensor does not prove full-face balance; readings need a common elevation and a distribution comparison.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力梯度與高度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure gradient with height" is correct?
options: 一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。
optionsEn: A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ.
quiz.explanation: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure gradient with height: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力梯度與高度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure gradient with height” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient.
A percentage from sensitivity analysis is the actual probability of failure.
quiz.explanation: 核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure gradient with height: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力梯度與高度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure gradient with height” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。
knowledge.textEn: Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力梯度與高度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure gradient with height" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion.
quiz.explanation: 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土與上舉邊界」與「不排水穩定比值」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover and uplift boundaries" and "Undrained stability index": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土與上舉邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover and uplift boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「覆土與上舉邊界」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover and uplift boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。穩定分析需要上下兩側機制而不是只求最低值，鄰近地面荷載與弱層會改變可行範圍。 假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。 只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「覆土與上舉邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths. Analysis needs both lower and upper mechanisms, with surface loads and weak layers affecting the feasible interval. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water. Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cover and uplift boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「覆土與上舉邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cover and uplift boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土與上舉邊界
knowledge.text: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。穩定分析需要上下兩側機制而不是只求最低值，鄰近地面荷載與弱層會改變可行範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths. Analysis needs both lower and upper mechanisms, with surface loads and weak layers affecting the feasible interval.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土與上舉邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover and uplift boundaries" is correct?
options: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。
支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
某工程的臨界穩定指標可以不看幾何直接搬到另一工程。
optionsEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.
quiz.explanation: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土與上舉邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover and uplift boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「覆土與上舉邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cover and uplift boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地形、建物載重與地下管線資料檢查淺覆土區，並列坍入及上舉情境；設計者須給出場址專屬模型和審查界線，課程自重值不得當機器壓力目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately; designers provide site-specific models and review boundaries, and the teaching overburden value is not a machine target.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土與上舉邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover and uplift boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。
optionsEn: Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土與上舉邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover and uplift boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「覆土與上舉邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cover and uplift boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地形、建物載重與地下管線資料檢查淺覆土區，並列坍入及上舉情境；設計者須給出場址專屬模型和審查界線，課程自重值不得當機器壓力目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately; designers provide site-specific models and review boundaries, and the teaching overburden value is not a machine target. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cover and uplift boundaries. Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately; designers provide site-specific models and review boundaries, and the teaching overburden value is not a machine target.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄覆土與上舉邊界的資料來源與適用條件。用地形、建物載重與地下管線資料檢查淺覆土區，並列坍入及上舉情境；設計者須給出場址專屬模型和審查界線，課程自重值不得當機器壓力目標。

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土與上舉邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers.
Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately.

steps.instruction: 砂土中支護壓力需透過介質與土體界面傳遞，滲透太深時壓力作用範圍和有效應力路徑會改變。泥膜不是抽象的完美邊界，粒徑、滲透性和介質特性共同控制壓力傳遞。 假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。 若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「砂土滲流與濾膜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface. Deep infiltration changes the loaded region and effective-stress path. A filter cake is not a perfect abstract boundary; grading, permeability and medium behavior govern transfer. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold. Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sand seepage and filter cake” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface. Deep infiltration changes the loaded region and effective-stress path.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要土倉壓力正常，就可假設泥膜永遠完整不透水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「砂土滲流與濾膜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sand seepage and filter cake" is correct?
options: 只要土倉壓力正常，就可假設泥膜永遠完整不透水。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
砂土中支護壓力需透過介質與土體界面傳遞，滲透太深時壓力作用範圍和有效應力路徑會改變。
optionsEn: Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface.
quiz.explanation: 砂土中支護壓力需透過介質與土體界面傳遞，滲透太深時壓力作用範圍和有效應力路徑會改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 砂土滲流與濾膜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sand seepage and filter cake: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「砂土滲流與濾膜」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sand seepage and filter cake” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以代表性砂樣做合格試驗比較滲透與濾膜形成，記錄壓差、滲流及顆粒流失；工程師需確認試驗方向、尺度與現場相符，不把一維向上滲流公式直接套到三維掌子面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test representative sand for infiltration and filter formation with pressure, flow and particle-loss records; engineers verify direction and scale, avoiding direct transfer of a one-dimensional upward-flow relation to a three-dimensional face.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 砂土滲流與濾膜：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「砂土滲流與濾膜」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sand seepage and filter cake” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以代表性砂樣做合格試驗比較滲透與濾膜形成，記錄壓差、滲流及顆粒流失；工程師需確認試驗方向、尺度與現場相符，不把一維向上滲流公式直接套到三維掌子面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test representative sand for infiltration and filter formation with pressure, flow and particle-loss records; engineers verify direction and scale, avoiding direct transfer of a one-dimensional upward-flow relation to a three-dimensional face. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Test representative sand for infiltration and filter formation with pressure, flow and particle-loss records; engineers verify direction and scale, avoiding direct transfer of a one-dimensional upward-flow relation to a three-dimensional face.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sand seepage and filter cake"?

steps.title: 砂土滲流與濾膜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sand seepage and filter cake: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「砂土滲流與濾膜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sand seepage and filter cake” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「體積平衡與失土」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Volume balance and ground loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。短暫收支差可能是儲量變化，持續差異才需結合沉陷與壓力評估失土。 假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。 把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「體積平衡與失土」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. Temporary imbalance can reflect storage; persistent discrepancies require pressure and settlement evidence before interpreting ground loss. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first. Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event. knowledge.title: 體積平衡與失土
knowledge.text: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。短暫收支差可能是儲量變化，持續差異才需結合沉陷與壓力評估失土。
knowledge.textEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. Temporary imbalance can reflect storage; persistent discrepancies require pressure and settlement evidence before interpreting ground loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「體積平衡與失土」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Volume balance and ground loss" is correct?
options: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。
optionsEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops.
quiz.explanation: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「體積平衡與失土」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Volume balance and ground loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「體積平衡與失土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Volume balance and ground loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone. quiz.question: 要驗證「體積平衡與失土」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Volume balance and ground loss"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis.
