stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環系統與控制邊界」與「流速與顆粒輸送」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circuit and control boundaries" and "Velocity and solids transport": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環系統與控制邊界」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circuit and control boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。 假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環系統與控制邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circuit and control boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環系統與控制邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circuit and control boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環系統與控制邊界
knowledge.text: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。
knowledge.textEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環系統與控制邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circuit and control boundaries" is correct?
options: 送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。
泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。
單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
optionsEn: The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.
A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation.
Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
quiz.explanation: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環系統與控制邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circuit and control boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「循環系統與控制邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circuit and control boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「循環系統與控制邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circuit and control boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「循環系統與控制邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Circuit and control boundaries"?
options: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環系統與控制邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circuit and control boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。

steps.title: 流速與顆粒輸送：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity and solids transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。平均速度只是起點，彎頭和停流區可局部沉積，不能由一個管段速度保證整線暢通。 假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流速與顆粒輸送」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. Mean speed is only a starting point because bends and stagnant regions can deposit solids even when one pipe section appears adequate. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity and solids transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流速與顆粒輸送」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. Mean speed is only a starting point because bends and stagnant regions can deposit solids even when one pipe section appears adequate.

knowledge.text: 誤解：單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear.
quiz.explanation: 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓差與泵浦功率」與「固體質量濃度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure loss and pump power" and "Solids mass concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓差與泵浦功率」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure loss and pump power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。泥水密度與黏度改變會移動工作點，不能只用清水泵曲線推定實際效率或最大可輸送量。 假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓差與泵浦功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure loss and pump power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓差與泵浦功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure loss and pump power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓差與泵浦功率
knowledge.text: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。泥水密度與黏度改變會移動工作點，不能只用清水泵曲線推定實際效率或最大可輸送量。
knowledge.textEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓差與泵浦功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure loss and pump power" is correct?
options: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。
馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。
泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
optionsEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power.
Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
quiz.explanation: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓差與泵浦功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure loss and pump power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓差與泵浦功率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure loss and pump power", which statement holds?
options: 槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓差與泵浦功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure loss and pump power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄壓差與泵浦功率的資料來源與適用條件。同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pressure loss and pump power. Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄壓差與泵浦功率的資料來源與適用條件。同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。

Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓差與泵浦功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure loss and pump power"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data.
quiz.explanation: 同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓差與泵浦功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure loss and pump power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。

泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
optionsEn: Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport.

steps.title: 固體質量濃度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Solids mass concentration: mechanism and system paths

steps.title: 旋流分離與分級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cyclone separation and grading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋流分離與分級」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclone separation and grading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 旋流器利用顆粒慣性與流場分級，切割粒徑不是一道所有顆粒都服從的硬邊界。細顆粒仍可能隨底流走，粗粒也可能旁通，需用完整粒徑分配和質量收支描述效率。 假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。 進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋流分離與分級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cyclones classify through particle inertia and flow, but cut size is not a perfect boundary. Fines can report to underflow and coarse particles can bypass, requiring size distributions and mass balance rather than one headline efficiency. For assumed dry-solids feed 100 t/h and underflow recovery 80 t/h, overall recovery is 80%; this does not mean 80% capture at every size. Unsynchronized samples during feed changes create impossible efficiency estimates, while recirculating fines progressively alter rheology. Coarse recovery alone can miss a circuit medium drifting away from its required behavior. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cyclone separation and grading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

knowledge.title: 旋流分離與分級
knowledge.text: 旋流器利用顆粒慣性與流場分級，切割粒徑不是一道所有顆粒都服從的硬邊界。細顆粒仍可能隨底流走，粗粒也可能旁通，需用完整粒徑分配和質量收支描述效率。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tank levels and residence time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「槽位與停留時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tank levels and residence time", which statement holds?
options: 兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。
optionsEn: Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 槽位與停留時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tank levels and residence time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「槽位與停留時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tank levels and residence time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄槽位與停留時間的資料來源與適用條件。用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tank levels and residence time. Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality.

quiz.question: 要驗證「槽位與停留時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tank levels and residence time"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。
用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays.
quiz.explanation: 用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 槽位與停留時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tank levels and residence time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「槽位與停留時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tank levels and residence time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。
knowledge.textEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「槽位與停留時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tank levels and residence time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。
optionsEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.
quiz.explanation: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓力暫態與管路彈性」與「磨耗與剩餘厚度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure transients and pipe elasticity" and "Wear and remaining thickness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure transients and pipe elasticity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力暫態與管路彈性」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。含氣、非牛頓介質和支管使簡化水擊關係偏離實際，需分析整個系統而非單一閥前讀值。 假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。 低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力暫態與管路彈性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. Entrained gas, non-Newtonian behavior and branches complicate a simple water-hammer relation, requiring a system analysis rather than one valve-side reading. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation. Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力暫態與管路彈性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性
knowledge.text: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。含氣、非牛頓介質和支管使簡化水擊關係偏離實際，需分析整個系統而非單一閥前讀值。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. Entrained gas, non-Newtonian behavior and branches complicate a simple water-hammer relation, requiring a system analysis rather than one valve-side reading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力暫態與管路彈性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure transients and pipe elasticity" is correct?
options: 不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。
快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.
Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure transients and pipe elasticity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力暫態與管路彈性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以足夠頻率壓力紀錄對照流量事件，將實際管材、支承、含氣及閥件時序帶入專業暫態分析；任何控制變更由設備工程師核准，本課算式不得用來自行操作閥件。

steps.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure transients and pipe elasticity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力暫態與管路彈性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 磨耗與剩餘厚度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wear and remaining thickness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「磨耗與剩餘厚度」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wear and remaining thickness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固體顆粒撞擊與滑磨使管壁損失，彎頭外側和局部高速區可能先變薄。平均厚度不能代表最低剩餘壁厚，磨耗速率又隨粒徑與流況變化，必須把位置與歷程一起記錄。 假設某點厚度由12降10 mm歷時1000 h，平均磨耗0.002 mm/h；線性外推只在同工況下作情境比較。 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磨耗與剩餘厚度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Particle impact and abrasion remove wall material, often fastest on outer bends or local high-speed zones. Mean thickness does not represent minimum wall, and changing grading and flow make wear rates time dependent. An assumed point thinning from 12 to 10 mm over 1000 h averages 0.002 mm/h; linear extrapolation is only a same-condition scenario. Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wear and remaining thickness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「磨耗與剩餘厚度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磨耗與剩餘厚度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.

steps.title: 磨耗與剩餘厚度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wear and remaining thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「磨耗與剩餘厚度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wear and remaining thickness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄磨耗與剩餘厚度的資料來源與適用條件。在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for wear and remaining thickness. Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wear and remaining thickness"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。
旋流器總回收率就是每個粒徑完全相同的分離率。

Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima.
Overall cyclone recovery equals the separation efficiency at every particle size.

quiz.explanationEn: Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 磨耗與剩餘厚度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wear and remaining thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磨耗與剩餘厚度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wear and remaining thickness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。
knowledge.textEn: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磨耗與剩餘厚度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wear and remaining thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。
量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.
Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid.
quiz.explanation: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環可靠度與備援」與「泥水資料與工程結案」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circuit availability and redundancy" and "Slurry-data engineering closeout": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circuit availability and redundancy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環可靠度與備援」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circuit availability and redundancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。可靠度需考慮共用電力、閥件和分離容量，時間利用率則受預防維護與故障停機共同影響。 假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環可靠度與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery. Shared power, valves and separation capacity limit redundancy, while planned and unplanned downtime both affect availability. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability. Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circuit availability and redundancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環可靠度與備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circuit availability and redundancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環可靠度與備援
knowledge.text: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。可靠度需考慮共用電力、閥件和分離容量，時間利用率則受預防維護與故障停機共同影響。
knowledge.textEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery. Shared power, valves and separation capacity limit redundancy, while planned and unplanned downtime both affect availability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環可靠度與備援」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circuit availability and redundancy" is correct?
options: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。
兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。
每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
optionsEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery.
Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.
Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
quiz.explanation: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circuit availability and redundancy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環可靠度與備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circuit availability and redundancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以故障樹或系統圖檢查共因失效，測試核准的備援切換與資料紀錄，統計停機原因而不只總時數；維護與施工團隊共同確認失去循環時的既定回應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review common-cause failure through a system diagram and test approved backup transitions and logging; classify downtime causes rather than only total duration, with maintenance and construction teams confirming the response to lost circulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circuit availability and redundancy", which statement holds?
options: 單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。

泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
optionsEn: Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.

The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circuit availability and redundancy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「循環可靠度與備援」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circuit availability and redundancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以故障樹或系統圖檢查共因失效，測試核准的備援切換與資料紀錄，統計停機原因而不只總時數；維護與施工團隊共同確認失去循環時的既定回應。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review common-cause failure through a system diagram and test approved backup transitions and logging; classify downtime causes rather than only total duration, with maintenance and construction teams confirming the response to lost circulation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Review common-cause failure through a system diagram and test approved backup transitions and logging; classify downtime causes rather than only total duration, with maintenance and construction teams confirming the response to lost circulation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Circuit availability and redundancy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環可靠度與備援」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circuit availability and redundancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。
knowledge.textEn: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環可靠度與備援」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
optionsEn: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
quiz.explanation: 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 泥水資料與工程結案：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slurry-data engineering closeout: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泥水資料與工程結案」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slurry-data engineering closeout” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整循環帳目讓地層變化、設備退化與處理效能可以回溯，資料只有單位一致並附感測器位置才可整合。結案須保留原始時間序列及校準，不以每班平均取代可能控制風險的暫態。 假設10個流量感測器中9個具完整校準鏈，追溯率90%；關鍵回流計缺失仍須個別處理。 只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥水資料與工程結案」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Complete circuit accounting supports retrospective separation of geology, equipment degradation and treatment behavior. Integration requires consistent units and sensor locations. Retain raw time series and calibration rather than replacing important transients with shift averages. If 9 of an assumed 10 flowmeters have complete calibration chains, traceability is 90%; a missing critical return meter still requires individual resolution. Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slurry-data engineering closeout” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泥水資料與工程結案」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slurry-data engineering closeout”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泥水資料與工程結案
knowledge.text: 完整循環帳目讓地層變化、設備退化與處理效能可以回溯，資料只有單位一致並附感測器位置才可整合。結案須保留原始時間序列及校準，不以每班平均取代可能控制風險的暫態。
knowledge.textEn: Complete circuit accounting supports retrospective separation of geology, equipment degradation and treatment behavior. Integration requires consistent units and sensor locations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泥水資料與工程結案」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Slurry-data engineering closeout" is correct?
options: 每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
完整循環帳目讓地層變化、設備退化與處理效能可以回溯，資料只有單位一致並附感測器位置才可整合。
送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。
optionsEn: Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
Complete circuit accounting supports retrospective separation of geology, equipment degradation and treatment behavior.
The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.
quiz.explanation: 完整循環帳目讓地層變化、設備退化與處理效能可以回溯，資料只有單位一致並附感測器位置才可整合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Complete circuit accounting supports retrospective separation of geology, equipment degradation and treatment behavior. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Slurry-data engineering closeout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泥水資料與工程結案」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slurry-data engineering closeout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10個流量感測器中9個具完整校準鏈，追溯率90%；關鍵回流計缺失仍須個別處理。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 flowmeters have complete calibration chains, traceability is 90%; a missing critical return meter still requires individual resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從一段出土體積追查送回流、密度、槽位與校準原檔，核對時鐘和取樣間隔；業主及設備負責人確認缺漏與剩餘限制後接管，不能用高整體完成率掩蓋關鍵通道缺資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace one excavation-volume interval to flow, density, levels and calibration, checking clocks and sample intervals; owner and equipment leads accept remaining gaps explicitly rather than allowing a high completion percentage to conceal missing critical channels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 泥水資料與工程結案：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slurry-data engineering closeout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥水資料與工程結案」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry-data engineering closeout” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Report images alone cannot support recalculating solids balances, and an unversioned sensor replacement can create an artificial trend. Both maintenance and geological interpretation then inherit the corrupted history. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只保留報表圖片會失去重算固體收支的能力，感測器更換後若未換版本則可能拼接出假趨勢；維護和地質分析都會受錯誤歷程影響。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
