courses.title: 盾尾刷與密封脂系統
courses.titleEn: Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑
courses.focusEn: Diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。
教學量化備忘：假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。
教學量化備忘：假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。
教學量化備忘：假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。
教學量化備忘：假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。
教學量化備忘：假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure.
Teaching quantitative note: Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill.
Teaching quantitative note: If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%.
Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多道刷列的阻水機制」與「尾隙與偏心分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multiple brush-row sealing" and "Tail clearance and eccentricity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多道刷列的阻水機制」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiple brush-row sealing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。多道密封提供分段阻力，但共用供應失效或同一幾何缺陷可能同時破壞多列。 假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多道刷列的阻水機制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. Multiple rows add barriers, but shared supply failure or a common geometric defect can defeat them together. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Multiple brush-row sealing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多道刷列的阻水機制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Multiple brush-row sealing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制
knowledge.text: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。多道密封提供分段阻力，但共用供應失效或同一幾何缺陷可能同時破壞多列。
knowledge.textEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. Multiple rows add barriers, but shared supply failure or a common geometric defect can defeat them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多道刷列的阻水機制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multiple brush-row sealing" is correct?
options: 多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。
盾尾平均間隙正常就保證整圈刷毛接觸都正常。
optionsEn: Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane.
Normal mean tail clearance guarantees adequate brush contact around the entire circumference.
quiz.explanation: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多道刷列的阻水機制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiple brush-row sealing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. steps.title: 尾隙與偏心分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tail clearance and eccentricity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「尾隙與偏心分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tail clearance and eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima; review against approved equipment and lining geometry rather than accepting only an average or one measurement. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄尾隙與偏心分布的資料來源與適用條件。將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for tail clearance and eccentricity. Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima; review against approved equipment and lining geometry rather than accepting only an average or one measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄尾隙與偏心分布的資料來源與適用條件。將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「尾隙與偏心分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tail clearance and eccentricity"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。
停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima.
No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.
quiz.explanation: 將實測尾隙、環片姿態與盾體姿態以同一方位繪圖，重點查局部最大最小值；依設備及環片設計核准的幾何界線審查，不能只看平均間隙或單點量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima; review against approved equipment and lining geometry rather than accepting only an average or one measurement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 尾隙與偏心分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tail clearance and eccentricity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「尾隙與偏心分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tail clearance and eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「盾尾平均間隙正常就保證整圈刷毛接觸都正常。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal mean tail clearance guarantees adequate brush contact around the entire circumference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。
knowledge.textEn: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「尾隙與偏心分布」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tail clearance and eccentricity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。
偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row.
Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean.
quiz.explanation: 偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密封壓差與高程」與「密封消耗與有效補充」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seal differential pressure and elevation" and "Consumption and effective replenishment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密封壓差與高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seal differential pressure and elevation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密封壓差與高程」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal differential pressure and elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密封面承受外部水與灌漿壓力，內部感測值需修正高程和管線損失才可比較。量到供應端高壓不表示刷列間實際壓力足夠，因為堵塞或黏性損失可消耗大部分壓差。 假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。 供應管堵塞可呈現高壓但沒有材料到達刷列，若把儀表高值當成功密封，外部水土可能逐步侵入；漏水初期未必伴隨供應壓力降低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密封壓差與高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The seal resists external water and grout, while internal readings require elevation and line-loss correction. High supply-end pressure does not establish cavity pressure because blockage and viscous losses can consume much of the differential. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure. A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium. Mistaking that reading for successful sealing permits progressive ingress, which need not initially reduce measured supply pressure at all. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal differential pressure and elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密封壓差與高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seal differential pressure and elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密封壓差與高程
knowledge.text: 密封面承受外部水與灌漿壓力，內部感測值需修正高程和管線損失才可比較。量到供應端高壓不表示刷列間實際壓力足夠，因為堵塞或黏性損失可消耗大部分壓差。
knowledge.textEn: The seal resists external water and grout, while internal readings require elevation and line-loss correction. High supply-end pressure does not establish cavity pressure because blockage and viscous losses can consume much of the differential.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密封壓差與高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seal differential pressure and elevation" is correct?
options: 密封面承受外部水與灌漿壓力，內部感測值需修正高程和管線損失才可比較。
供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。
密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。
optionsEn: The seal resists external water and grout, while internal readings require elevation and line-loss correction.
High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row.
Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance.
quiz.explanation: 密封面承受外部水與灌漿壓力，內部感測值需修正高程和管線損失才可比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The seal resists external water and grout, while internal readings require elevation and line-loss correction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密封壓差與高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seal differential pressure and elevation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密封壓差與高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seal differential pressure and elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對壓力計位置、零點與介質狀態，對照供應端和靠近密封區的紀錄；設備工程師需判別高壓低流量是否阻塞，任何調整依核准程序，算例只幫助壓力基準換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sensor position, zero and medium state and compare supply with near-seal records; equipment engineers distinguish blockage indicated by high pressure and low flow, with changes only under approved procedures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密封壓差與高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seal differential pressure and elevation", which statement holds?
options: 環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。

steps.title: 密封壓差與高程：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 供應管堵塞可呈現高壓但沒有材料到達刷列，若把儀表高值當成功密封，外部水土可能逐步侵入；漏水初期未必伴隨供應壓力降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium. Mistaking that reading for successful sealing permits progressive ingress, which need not initially reduce measured supply pressure at all. steps.title: 密封消耗與有效補充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Consumption and effective replenishment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密封消耗與有效補充」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consumption and effective replenishment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。停機期間的消耗與推進期間意義不同，應區分時間基準與距離基準。 假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密封消耗與有效補充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids. Consumption per advance supports trending without proving performance. Standstill consumption differs physically from advancing consumption, requiring both time and distance references. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill. Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consumption and effective replenishment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密封消耗與有效補充」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Consumption and effective replenishment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密封消耗與有效補充
knowledge.text: 密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。停機期間的消耗與推進期間意義不同，應區分時間基準與距離基準。
knowledge.textEn: Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids. Consumption per advance supports trending without proving performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密封消耗與有效補充」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Consumption and effective replenishment" is correct?
options: 密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。
密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。
常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。
optionsEn: Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance.
Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids.
Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄密封消耗與有效補充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for consumption and effective replenishment. Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密封消耗與有效補充」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Consumption and effective replenishment"?
options: 以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
optionsEn: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密封消耗與有效補充：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Consumption and effective replenishment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密封消耗與有效補充」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Consumption and effective replenishment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。
knowledge.textEn: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密封消耗與有效補充」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Consumption and effective replenishment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。
常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use.
Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「流變與輸送相容」與「環片表面與接觸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rheology and delivery compatibility" and "Segment surface and contact": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 流變與輸送相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rheology and delivery compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「流變與輸送相容」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rheology and delivery compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密封介質需兼顧可泵送、黏附及抗水沖，溫度改變會同時影響輸送阻力與保持能力。只以黏度高低排序忽略剪切與時間效應，產品相容性及設備適用範圍需由正式試驗確認。 假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流變與輸送相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sealing medium balances pumpability, adhesion and washout resistance. Temperature affects both transport and retention, so viscosity alone misses shear and time effects; compatibility and equipment suitability require qualified testing. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%. Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rheology and delivery compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流變與輸送相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rheology and delivery compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 流變與輸送相容
knowledge.text: 密封介質需兼顧可泵送、黏附及抗水沖，溫度改變會同時影響輸送阻力與保持能力。只以黏度高低排序忽略剪切與時間效應，產品相容性及設備適用範圍需由正式試驗確認。
knowledge.textEn: Sealing medium balances pumpability, adhesion and washout resistance. Temperature affects both transport and retention, so viscosity alone misses shear and time effects; compatibility and equipment suitability require qualified testing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「流變與輸送相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rheology and delivery compatibility" is correct?
options: 常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。
環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。
密封介質需兼顧可泵送、黏附及抗水沖，溫度改變會同時影響輸送阻力與保持能力。
optionsEn: Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.
A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows.
Sealing medium balances pumpability, adhesion and washout resistance.
quiz.explanation: 密封介質需兼顧可泵送、黏附及抗水沖，溫度改變會同時影響輸送阻力與保持能力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sealing medium balances pumpability, adhesion and washout resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 流變與輸送相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rheology and delivery compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流變與輸送相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rheology and delivery compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較代表溫度下的供應資料和合格流變試驗，記錄材料批號與停留時間；將泵送壓損和抗水試驗分別評估，設備工程師核准相容材料，課程不提供配方或加壓方法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare qualified rheology and supplier evidence at representative temperatures with batch and residence records; assess delivery loss separately from water resistance, leaving material approval to equipment engineers without recipes or pressurization instructions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「流變與輸送相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rheology and delivery compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
排水泵總量可以全部直接歸因於盾尾密封漏水。
監測資料覆蓋比例高，就可以忽略相鄰缺測區的風險。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
All sump-pump discharge can be attributed directly to tail-seal leakage.
High overall monitoring coverage permits ignoring risk in adjacent unmeasured zones.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 流變與輸送相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rheology and delivery compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流變與輸送相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rheology and delivery compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較代表溫度下的供應資料和合格流變試驗，記錄材料批號與停留時間；將泵送壓損和抗水試驗分別評估，設備工程師核准相容材料，課程不提供配方或加壓方法。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare qualified rheology and supplier evidence at representative temperatures with batch and residence records; assess delivery loss separately from water resistance, leaving material approval to equipment engineers without recipes or pressurization instructions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄流變與輸送相容的資料來源與適用條件。比較代表溫度下的供應資料和合格流變試驗，記錄材料批號與停留時間；將泵送壓損和抗水試驗分別評估，設備工程師核准相容材料，課程不提供配方或加壓方法。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rheology and delivery compatibility. Compare qualified rheology and supplier evidence at representative temperatures with batch and residence records; assess delivery loss separately from water resistance, leaving material approval to equipment engineers without recipes or pressurization instructions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation.

steps.title: 流變與輸送相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rheology and delivery compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流變與輸送相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rheology and delivery compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。
knowledge.textEn: Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. One ambient test cannot represent both limiting conditions across actual operation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「流變與輸送相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rheology and delivery compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。
低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows.
Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout.
quiz.explanation: 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環片表面與接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Segment surface and contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環片表面與接觸」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment surface and contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。防水問題因此不僅是密封材料，也包含環片製造與組裝品質，缺陷位置要能追到環號方位。 假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。 未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環片表面與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. Sealing therefore depends on manufacturing and assembly quality as well as medium, requiring defects to be traceable by ring and angle. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction. A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Segment surface and contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環片表面與接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Segment surface and contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環片表面與接觸
knowledge.text: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。防水問題因此不僅是密封材料，也包含環片製造與組裝品質，缺陷位置要能追到環號方位。
knowledge.textEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. Sealing therefore depends on manufacturing and assembly quality as well as medium, requiring defects to be traceable by ring and angle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環片表面與接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segment surface and contact" is correct?
options: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。
環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。
灌漿和密封各自儀表正常就不必檢查彼此介面。
optionsEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear.
A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows.
Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.
quiz.explanation: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環片表面與接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment surface and contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環片表面與接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment surface and contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環片表面與接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Segment surface and contact", which statement holds?
options: 停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
optionsEn: No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環片表面與接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment surface and contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環片表面與接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Segment surface and contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄環片表面與接觸的資料來源與適用條件。在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for segment surface and contact. Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄環片表面與接觸的資料來源與適用條件。在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for segment surface and contact. Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環片表面與接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Segment surface and contact"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。
在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row.
Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption.
quiz.explanation: 在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證

steps.title: 灌漿與密封交互作用：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grouting and seal interaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾尾外的灌漿填補環隙，也可能對密封施加暫態壓力或讓硬化材料侵入刷列。灌漿與密封系統應協調時間、位置與壓力證據，不能各自看儀表正常就假定介面無問題。 假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。 灌漿倒入刷列後硬化會降低柔順接觸，表面暫時止漏卻可能造成後續破壞；不同系統時鐘不一致又會掩蓋兩者的因果關聯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「灌漿與密封交互作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill outside the tail closes the annulus but can load seals transiently or introduce hardening material into brushes. Grout and seal systems need coordinated time, location and pressure evidence rather than isolated normal readings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary. Grout hardening in brushes reduces compliant contact; temporary apparent sealing can precede later damage. Unsynchronized system clocks further conceal the causal link between grout events and seal deterioration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grouting and seal interaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌漿和密封各自儀表正常就不必檢查彼此介面。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「灌漿與密封交互作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 灌漿與密封交互作用：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步灌漿口與密封分區資料，核對高程與感測位置並追蹤材料硬化時間；漏水或消耗變化需查是否與特定灌漿事件重合，由灌漿及設備負責人共同審查介面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize grout-port and seal-zone records with elevation, sensor location and setting time; investigate whether leakage or consumption changes coincide with specific grouting events, with joint grout and equipment review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設專用收集槽5 min增加30 L，平均漏量6 L/min=0.1 L/s；未分流總排水不適用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed dedicated tank gaining 30 L in 5 min indicates 6 L/min=0.1 L/s; mixed drainage cannot support the same attribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 漏水量與趨勢判讀：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 採核准安全方式辨識收集來源，使用計量槽或流量計並記錄濁度與壓差；比對分區密封和施工事件，任何異常依既定應變計畫由負責人處理，不能靠學徒自行追入受壓區。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 停機保存與劣化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Standstill preservation and deterioration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機保存與劣化」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Standstill preservation and deterioration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停機時盾尾仍承受外壓，介質可能被沖失、沉降或隨溫度變化，刷毛也可能被硬化漿體固定。停止前正常不能保證重啟前正常，狀態確認需要看整段停機歷程。 假設停機24 h消耗36 kg，平均1.5 kg/h；此觀測不能轉成通用補充週期或允許停機時限。 供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機保存與劣化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External loading persists during stoppage while medium washes out, settles or changes with temperature, and grout may immobilize brushes. A normal pre-stop state does not guarantee a normal restart state; the complete standstill history matters. Assumed 36 kg consumption during a 24 h standstill averages 1.5 kg/h; it does not prescribe a universal replenishment interval or allowable stop duration. Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. Leakage on restart then reveals damage whose earlier evidence was missed. knowledge.title: 停機保存與劣化
knowledge.text: 停機時盾尾仍承受外壓，介質可能被沖失、沉降或隨溫度變化，刷毛也可能被硬化漿體固定。停止前正常不能保證重啟前正常，狀態確認需要看整段停機歷程。

Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis. 密封系統的剩餘性能不能由道數或使用時間單獨判斷，需結合幾何、消耗、漏水與材料歷程。
多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
optionsEn: High overall monitoring coverage permits ignoring risk in adjacent unmeasured zones.
Remaining seal capability cannot be inferred from row count or age alone; geometry, consumption, leakage and material history must agree.
Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 密封系統的剩餘性能不能由道數或使用時間單獨判斷，需結合幾何、消耗、漏水與材料歷程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Remaining seal capability cannot be inferred from row count or age alone; geometry, consumption, leakage and material history must agree. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密封狀態工程移交：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seal-condition engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密封狀態工程移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seal-condition engineering handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設12個監測分區有9個完整資料，覆蓋75%；缺失3區若相鄰，不能視為均勻隨機缺測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 12 zones have complete records, coverage is 75%; 3 adjacent missing zones are not uniformly random omissions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 12 zones have complete records, coverage is 75%; 3 adjacent missing zones are not uniformly random omissions.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密封狀態工程移交」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seal-condition engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。
常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 密封狀態工程移交：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seal-condition engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密封狀態工程移交」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seal-condition engineering handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄密封狀態工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for seal-condition engineering handover. Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密封狀態工程移交」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seal-condition engineering handover"?
options: 逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
灌漿和密封各自儀表正常就不必檢查彼此介面。
optionsEn: Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.
quiz.explanation: 逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密封狀態工程移交：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seal-condition engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密封狀態工程移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seal-condition engineering handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測資料覆蓋比例高，就可以忽略相鄰缺測區的風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High overall monitoring coverage permits ignoring risk in adjacent unmeasured zones." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。
knowledge.textEn: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密封狀態工程移交」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seal-condition engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。
多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement.
Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 潛盾機刀具磨耗管理
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命
courses.focusEn: Explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。
教學量化備忘：假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。
教學量化備忘：假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。
教學量化備忘：假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。
教學量化備忘：假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。
教學量化備忘：假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm.
