steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 局部裂縫與連接錨定：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local cracks and connector anchorage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete. steps.observation: 連結機制：孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「足尺試驗與邊界」與「接縫驗證與工程簽認」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Full-scale tests and boundaries" and "Joint verification and engineering signoff": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-scale tests and boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「足尺試驗與邊界」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-scale tests and boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。足尺不代表所有邊界都正確，須區分試體變形、設備柔度與局部就位，才能用於模型校準。 假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。 設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「足尺試驗與邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. Full size does not guarantee correct boundaries; separate specimen deformation, machine compliance and seating before calibrating a model. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence. Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-scale tests and boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

knowledge.title: 足尺試驗與邊界
knowledge.text: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。足尺不代表所有邊界都正確，須區分試體變形、設備柔度與局部就位，才能用於模型校準。
knowledge.textEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. Full size does not guarantee correct boundaries; separate specimen deformation, machine compliance and seating before calibrating a model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「足尺試驗與邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-scale tests and boundaries" is correct?
options: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。
足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。
結構和水密報告各自通過就無須統一張開幾何定義。
optionsEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation.
Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects.
Separate structural and sealing approvals eliminate the need for a common opening definition.
quiz.explanation: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-scale tests and boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「足尺試驗與邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-scale tests and boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-scale tests and boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「足尺試驗與邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-scale tests and boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for full-scale tests and boundaries. Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「足尺試驗與邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full-scale tests and boundaries"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。
使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure.
Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact.

quiz.explanationEn: Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：失效診斷

steps.title: 接縫驗證與工程簽認：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint verification and engineering signoff” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫驗收需要連結結構、水密與組裝幾何，而不是三份互不對照的合格表。交接保存最不利組合、試驗覆蓋與剩餘假設，確保營運期檢查知道哪些裂縫或開合屬模型失效訊號。 假設10種設計組合中8種經直接試驗、2種靠分析外推，直接覆蓋80%；外推2種需明列限制。 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫驗證與工程簽認」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint acceptance links structural, waterproofing and assembly evidence rather than three unrelated pass sheets. Handover retains adverse combinations, test coverage and assumptions so operational inspections recognize signs invalidating the model. If 8 of an assumed 10 design combinations have direct testing and 2 rely on analysis, direct coverage is 80%; limits of the other 2 remain explicit. Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint verification and engineering signoff” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint verification and engineering signoff" is correct?

接縫驗收需要連結結構、水密與組裝幾何，而不是三份互不對照的合格表。
接縫軸力不大時就不必考慮偏心彎矩與局部接觸。
optionsEn: Separate structural and sealing approvals eliminate the need for a common opening definition.
Joint acceptance links structural, waterproofing and assembly evidence rather than three unrelated pass sheets.
Modest joint axial force eliminates the need to consider eccentric bending and local contact.
quiz.explanation: 接縫驗收需要連結結構、水密與組裝幾何，而不是三份互不對照的合格表。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint acceptance links structural, waterproofing and assembly evidence rather than three unrelated pass sheets. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫驗證與工程簽認：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint verification and engineering signoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫驗證與工程簽認」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint verification and engineering signoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10種設計組合中8種經直接試驗、2種靠分析外推，直接覆蓋80%；外推2種需明列限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 design combinations have direct testing and 2 rely on analysis, direct coverage is 80%; limits of the other 2 remain explicit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從一組最不利N-M與錯台條件追查到試驗、產品和現地紀錄，檢查各自坐標及版本；結構、防水及品質負責人共同確認外推依據，不以整體通過率替代單一關鍵組合的審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace one adverse N-M-offset combination through tests, products and field records with consistent coordinates and versions; structural, sealing and quality leads jointly approve extrapolation rather than using an overall pass rate to waive a critical combination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 接縫驗證與工程簽認：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint verification and engineering signoff: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫驗證與工程簽認」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint verification and engineering signoff” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從一組最不利N-M與錯台條件追查到試驗、產品和現地紀錄，檢查各自坐標及版本；結構、防水及品質負責人共同確認外推依據，不以整體通過率替代單一關鍵組合的審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace one adverse N-M-offset combination through tests, products and field records with consistent coordinates and versions; structural, sealing and quality leads jointly approve extrapolation rather than using an overall pass rate to waive a critical combination. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄接縫驗證與工程簽認的資料來源與適用條件。從一組最不利N-M與錯台條件追查到試驗、產品和現地紀錄，檢查各自坐標及版本；結構、防水及品質負責人共同確認外推依據，不以整體通過率替代單一關鍵組合的審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint verification and engineering signoff. Trace one adverse N-M-offset combination through tests, products and field records with consistent coordinates and versions; structural, sealing and quality leads jointly approve extrapolation rather than using an overall pass rate to waive a critical combination.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接縫驗證與工程簽認」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint verification and engineering signoff"?
options: 從一組最不利N-M與錯台條件追查到試驗、產品和現地紀錄，檢查各自坐標及版本；結構、防水及品質負責人共同確認外推依據，不以整體通過率替代單一關鍵組合的審查。

optionsEn: Trace one adverse N-M-offset combination through tests, products and field records with consistent coordinates and versions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A large cycle count determines remaining fatigue life without considering amplitudes.

steps.title: 接縫驗證與工程簽認：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint verification and engineering signoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫驗證與工程簽認」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint verification and engineering signoff” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「結構和水密報告各自通過就無須統一張開幾何定義。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Separate structural and sealing approvals eliminate the need for a common opening definition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Missing extrapolation limits also allows later changes to exceed the original verification unnoticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫驗證與工程簽認」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint verification and engineering signoff" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。
接縫軸力不大時就不必考慮偏心彎矩與局部接觸。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals.
Modest joint axial force eliminates the need to consider eccentric bending and local contact.
quiz.explanation: 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 盾尾空隙同步灌漿
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填
courses.focusEn: Verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

Teaching quantitative note: Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume grout density 1800 kg/m³ and elevation difference 6 m; static difference ρgΔz=105.95 kPa, with additional losses during flow.
Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume effective line volume 0.12 m³ and flow 0.004 m³/s; nominal residence is 30 s, excluding stoppages and nonideal mixing.

Teaching quantitative note: Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「理論環隙與超挖」與「輸送收支與有效填充」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" and "Delivery balance and effective filling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理論環隙與超挖」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。 假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理論環隙與超挖」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理論環隙與超挖」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Theoretical annulus and overbreak”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理論環隙與超挖
knowledge.text: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理論環隙與超挖」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" is correct?
options: 注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。
盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。
泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
optionsEn: Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield.
The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
quiz.explanation: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理論環隙與超挖」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理論環隙與超挖」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Theoretical annulus and overbreak", which statement holds?
options: 流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。
計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation.
Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理論環隙與超挖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理論環隙與超挖」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Theoretical annulus and overbreak"?
options: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。
optionsEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.
quiz.explanation: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理論環隙與超挖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「理論環隙與超挖」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space.
The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
quiz.explanation: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輸送收支與有效填充」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delivery balance and effective filling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。每環收支需追蹤時間延遲，否則計量器在本環記錄的材料可能到下一環才排出。 假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輸送收支與有效填充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delivery balance and effective filling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輸送收支與有效填充」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delivery balance and effective filling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輸送收支與有效填充
knowledge.text: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。每環收支需追蹤時間延遲，否則計量器在本環記錄的材料可能到下一環才排出。
knowledge.textEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輸送收支與有效填充」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delivery balance and effective filling" is correct?
options: 泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。
optionsEn: The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there.
quiz.explanation: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輸送收支與有效填充」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delivery balance and effective filling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輸送收支與有效填充」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Delivery balance and effective filling", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。
最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.
Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輸送收支與有效填充」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delivery balance and effective filling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄輸送收支與有效填充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for delivery balance and effective filling. Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄輸送收支與有效填充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for delivery balance and effective filling. Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸送收支與有效填充」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delivery balance and effective filling"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing.
Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void.
quiz.explanation: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸送收支與有效填充」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Delivery balance and effective filling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
knowledge.textEn: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸送收支與有效填充」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Delivery balance and effective filling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery.
quiz.explanation: 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高程壓差與傳遞」與「流變與泌水分離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elevation pressure and transmission" and "Rheology and bleed separation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高程壓差與傳遞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevation pressure and transmission: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高程壓差與傳遞」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation pressure and transmission” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漿體自重使不同高程注入口壓力不同，管線損失又使泵端壓力高於環隙。環片和地層實際承受的是局部外壓，必須以相同高程及量測位置比較，避免將泵壓直接套到結構。 假設漿密度1800 kg/m³、高差6 m，靜壓差ρgΔz=105.95 kPa；流動時另有管損。 把低處壓力當頂部壓力會高估頂部填充或錯估結構載重，堵塞管線又可形成高壓假象；若只記單一泵表，難以定位問題所在。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程壓差與傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout weight changes pressure with elevation while line loss separates pump and annulus readings. Ground and lining respond to local pressure, requiring common elevation and sensor-location references rather than direct use of pump pressure as structural loading. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rheology and bleed separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漿體需流入狹窄環隙又保持均勻，屈服阻力過高限制擴散，泌水則使初始體積在硬化前縮小。流動度、泌水及凝結時間必須一起評估，不能用最容易泵送作唯一品質目標。 假設1 L試樣析水30 mL，泌水比例3%；不等於現地空隙必定增加3%。 高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流變與泌水分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout must enter narrow voids while remaining uniform. Excess yield resistance limits spread, whereas bleeding reduces effective volume before hardening. Flow, bleed and set time require joint assessment rather than easiest pumping as the sole quality target. If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%. High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice. Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus. Reducing delivery on that interpretation turns a line blockage into an unfilled support void. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Setting time and delivery delay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 凝結時間與輸送延遲：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus. Reducing delivery on that interpretation turns a line blockage into an unfilled support void. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「凝結時間與輸送延遲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。
只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus.
quiz.explanation: 只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環片浮力與抬升」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining buoyancy and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新鮮漿體對環片產生浮力，未形成硬化支承前的環片重量、連接與約束共同抵抗抬升。局部非均勻壓力還會造成轉動，不能只用總注入量推定環片位置穩定。 假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環片浮力與抬升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh grout creates buoyancy resisted by lining weight, connections and restraints before hard support forms. Uneven local pressures also cause rotation, so total delivery cannot establish positional stability of the ring. Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints. Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining buoyancy and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環片浮力與抬升」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 關於「環片浮力與抬升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 新鮮漿體對環片產生浮力，未形成硬化支承前的環片重量、連接與約束共同抵抗抬升。

optionsEn: Fresh grout creates buoyancy resisted by lining weight, connections and restraints before hard support forms.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環片浮力與抬升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環片浮力與抬升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining buoyancy and uplift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄環片浮力與抬升的資料來源與適用條件。同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for lining buoyancy and uplift. Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環片浮力與抬升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lining buoyancy and uplift"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time.
quiz.explanation: 同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環片浮力與抬升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining buoyancy and uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。
knowledge.textEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環片浮力與抬升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lining buoyancy and uplift" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。
optionsEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
quiz.explanation: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「早齡剛度與荷載接替」與「收縮與失水容積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Early stiffness and load transfer" and "Shrinkage and volume loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early stiffness and load transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡剛度與荷載接替」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early stiffness and load transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 背填從流體逐漸變成可傳遞剪力與壓縮的固體，這段轉換控制地層和襯砌何時互相支承。早期抗壓強度與剛度不是同一性質，支承模型需使用相應時間的材料狀態。 假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。 以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡剛度與荷載接替」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill changes from fluid to a solid carrying compression and shear, governing when ground and lining support one another. Early compressive strength differs from stiffness, so support models must use the material state at the relevant age. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength. Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early stiffness and load transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡剛度與荷載接替」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early stiffness and load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替
knowledge.text: 背填從流體逐漸變成可傳遞剪力與壓縮的固體，這段轉換控制地層和襯砌何時互相支承。早期抗壓強度與剛度不是同一性質，支承模型需使用相應時間的材料狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill changes from fluid to a solid carrying compression and shear, governing when ground and lining support one another. Early compressive strength differs from stiffness, so support models must use the material state at the relevant age.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡剛度與荷載接替」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early stiffness and load transfer" is correct?
options: 最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。
背填從流體逐漸變成可傳遞剪力與壓縮的固體，這段轉換控制地層和襯砌何時互相支承。
自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。
optionsEn: Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
Backfill changes from fluid to a solid carrying compression and shear, governing when ground and lining support one another.
Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.
quiz.explanation: 背填從流體逐漸變成可傳遞剪力與壓縮的固體，這段轉換控制地層和襯砌何時互相支承。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill changes from fluid to a solid carrying compression and shear, governing when ground and lining support one another. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early stiffness and load transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡剛度與荷載接替」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Early stiffness and load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以代表齡期試驗取得強度和變形資料，對照盾尾通過、灌漿與地層變形時間；模型需分列未凝、過渡和硬化狀態，不能只用最終試體結果推回剛完成一環的支承。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test strength and deformation at representative ages and align tail passage, injection and ground movement; distinguish fluid, transitional and hardened states instead of projecting final specimen performance back to a newly completed ring.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「早齡剛度與荷載接替」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Early stiffness and load transfer", which statement holds?
options: 整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。

steps.titleEn: Early stiffness and load transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「早齡剛度與荷載接替」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Early stiffness and load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以代表齡期試驗取得強度和變形資料，對照盾尾通過、灌漿與地層變形時間；模型需分列未凝、過渡和硬化狀態，不能只用最終試體結果推回剛完成一環的支承。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test strength and deformation at representative ages and align tail passage, injection and ground movement; distinguish fluid, transitional and hardened states instead of projecting final specimen performance back to a newly completed ring. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
