steps.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Early stiffness and load transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「早齡剛度與荷載接替」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Early stiffness and load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。
自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。

Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments.
Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.

quiz.explanationEn: Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 收縮與失水容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage and volume loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收縮與失水容積」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shrinkage and volume loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泌水、化學收縮與地層吸水會改變背填硬化後容積，各機制發生時間和位置不同。試樣自由收縮不等於現場受約束空洞，但可提示需要核對密實度與長期接觸，不能只看初期注滿。 假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。 地層吸水可能使注入口附近迅速增稠而遠端未填，後期收縮又加大接觸缺口；若只在早期量一次漿體強度，便看不到這些容積機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收縮與失水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bleeding, chemical shrinkage and ground absorption alter hardened volume at different times and locations. Free specimen shrinkage is not directly a restrained field void, but signals a need to examine density and lasting contact beyond initial filling. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint. Ground absorption can thicken grout near ports before distant voids fill, and later shrinkage enlarges contact gaps. A single early strength measurement does not reveal either of these volume-related processes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shrinkage and volume loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收縮與失水容積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shrinkage and volume loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收縮與失水容積
knowledge.text: 泌水、化學收縮與地層吸水會改變背填硬化後容積，各機制發生時間和位置不同。試樣自由收縮不等於現場受約束空洞，但可提示需要核對密實度與長期接觸，不能只看初期注滿。
knowledge.textEn: Bleeding, chemical shrinkage and ground absorption alter hardened volume at different times and locations. Free specimen shrinkage is not directly a restrained field void, but signals a need to examine density and lasting contact beyond initial filling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收縮與失水容積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shrinkage and volume loss" is correct?
options: 自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。
非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。
泌水、化學收縮與地層吸水會改變背填硬化後容積，各機制發生時間和位置不同。
optionsEn: Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.
Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void.
Bleeding, chemical shrinkage and ground absorption alter hardened volume at different times and locations.
quiz.explanation: 泌水、化學收縮與地層吸水會改變背填硬化後容積，各機制發生時間和位置不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bleeding, chemical shrinkage and ground absorption alter hardened volume at different times and locations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收縮與失水容積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage and volume loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收縮與失水容積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shrinkage and volume loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測材料體積穩定性、泌水與吸水情境，對照現地壓力和後期檢查；灌漿及地工工程師需區分材料本身縮減和外部流失，不把自由試樣百分比直接當空洞率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure volume stability, bleeding and absorption scenarios against field pressure and later inspections; grout and geotechnical engineers distinguish material reduction from external loss rather than equating free-sample percentage with field void ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空洞檢測與非唯一性」與「背填證據工程移交」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Void detection and nonuniqueness" and "Backfill evidence and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空洞檢測與非唯一性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Void detection and nonuniqueness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空洞檢測與非唯一性」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void detection and nonuniqueness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌背後缺陷可由聲學、雷達或其他核准方法提供線索，但反射異常也可能來自含水、材料界面或鋼筋。檢測須校準到現場構造並有獨立查證，不能把色圖每個異常直接當空洞。 假設100 m²檢查面中10 m²無有效資料，可評估覆蓋90%；未量區不能併入無缺陷面積。 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空洞檢測與非唯一性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Approved acoustic, radar or other methods can indicate defects behind lining, but reflections also arise from water, interfaces and steel. Calibrate to actual construction and verify independently rather than labeling every colored anomaly a void. If an assumed 100 m² inspection area includes 10 m² without valid data, coverage is 90%; unmeasured areas cannot count as defect-free. Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void detection and nonuniqueness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空洞檢測與非唯一性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Void detection and nonuniqueness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。
knowledge.textEn: Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement; engineers select confirmation methods, with any intrusive investigation separately approved rather than instructed by this course. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄空洞檢測與非唯一性的資料來源與適用條件。用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for void detection and nonuniqueness. Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement; engineers select confirmation methods, with any intrusive investigation separately approved rather than instructed by this course.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空洞檢測與非唯一性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Void detection and nonuniqueness"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。
用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement.
quiz.explanation: 用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement; engineers select confirmation methods, with any intrusive investigation separately approved rather than instructed by this course. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 空洞檢測與非唯一性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Void detection and nonuniqueness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空洞檢測與非唯一性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void detection and nonuniqueness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空洞檢測與非唯一性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Void detection and nonuniqueness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。
optionsEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution.
quiz.explanation: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backfill evidence and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「背填證據工程移交」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backfill evidence and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。交接應把每環分區資料與環片位置、地層和檢測相連，讓後續發現滲漏或沉陷時可追查原始成因。 假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「背填證據工程移交」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. Link each ring and zone to lining location, geology and inspection so later leakage or settlement remains diagnosable. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions. Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backfill evidence and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「背填證據工程移交」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backfill evidence and handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背填證據工程移交
knowledge.text: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。交接應把每環分區資料與環片位置、地層和檢測相連，讓後續發現滲漏或沉陷時可追查原始成因。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. Link each ring and zone to lining location, geology and inspection so later leakage or settlement remains diagnosable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背填證據工程移交」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backfill evidence and handover" is correct?
options: 整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。
背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。
注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。
optionsEn: A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution.
Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record.
Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
quiz.explanation: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backfill evidence and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背填證據工程移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backfill evidence and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背填證據工程移交」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backfill evidence and handover", which statement holds?
options: 泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backfill evidence and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背填證據工程移交」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backfill evidence and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄背填證據工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for backfill evidence and handover. Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄背填證據工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。

quiz.question: 要驗證「背填證據工程移交」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill evidence and handover"?
options: 抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。
optionsEn: Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
quiz.explanation: 抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backfill evidence and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背填證據工程移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backfill evidence and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背填證據工程移交」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backfill evidence and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。
注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences.
Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
quiz.explanation: 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 潛盾發進與到達端止水
courses.titleEn: Water sealing at shield launch and reception
courses.summary: 本課聚焦以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
courses.focus: 以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換
courses.focusEn: Verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學量化備忘：假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。
教學量化備忘：假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。
教學量化備忘：假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。
教學量化備忘：假設水頭差10 m、有效路徑5 m，i=2；若裂縫路徑僅1 m則i=10，未計三維流場。
教學量化備忘：假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。
教學量化備忘：假設穿越長10 m、角偏0.2°，側向偏差10tan0.2°=34.91 mm；非允許偏角。
factsEn: Teaching quantitative note: For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects.
Teaching quantitative note: Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing.
Teaching quantitative note: For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「始發到達控制體」與「水頭基準與外水力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Launch and reception control volumes" and "Head datum and external water force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「始發到達控制體」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Launch and reception control volumes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。應按位置畫出每個階段仍存在的屏障和力流，特別辨識暫時只剩單一道防護的區間。 假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「始發到達控制體」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. Checking only final breakthrough misses transitions; map barriers and load paths by position, identifying intervals with only one remaining barrier. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Launch and reception control volumes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「始發到達控制體」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Launch and reception control volumes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 始發到達控制體
knowledge.text: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。應按位置畫出每個階段仍存在的屏障和力流，特別辨識暫時只剩單一道防護的區間。
knowledge.textEn: Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. Checking only final breakthrough misses transitions; map barriers and load paths by position, identifying intervals with only one remaining barrier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「始發到達控制體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Launch and reception control volumes" is correct?
options: 最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。
井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
optionsEn: Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
quiz.explanation: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「始發到達控制體」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Launch and reception control volumes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「始發到達控制體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Launch and reception control volumes", which statement holds?
options: 處理體總厚度永遠就是地下水能走過的最短路徑。
機器中心點對準就不需要再檢查俯仰偏航和穿越長度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: The full treated-block thickness always equals the shortest possible groundwater path.
A correctly positioned machine center removes the need to check pitch, yaw and crossing length.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「始發到達控制體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Launch and reception control volumes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄始發到達控制體的資料來源與適用條件。用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for launch and reception control volumes. Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「始發到達控制體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Launch and reception control volumes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「始發到達控制體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。

A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.

steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭基準與外水力」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head datum and external water force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。 假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭基準與外水力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head datum and external water force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭基準與外水力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head datum and external water force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭基準與外水力
knowledge.titleEn: Head datum and external water force
knowledge.text: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。
knowledge.textEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭基準與外水力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head datum and external water force" is correct?
options: 井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。
井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。
optionsEn: Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ.
quiz.explanation: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭基準與外水力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head datum and external water force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build head ranges from multilevel observations with a common elevation datum and pumping timeline; geotechnical and structural engineers confirm adverse water conditions and uniform-load assumptions rather than treating the example as a test pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭基準與外水力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.

Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」與「滲流梯度與尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Treated-ground continuity and weak paths" and "Seepage gradient and scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 處理體連續性與薄弱通道：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground continuity and weak paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Treated-ground continuity and weak paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地層處理體的作用取決於連續性和與井壁的接合，平均強度或滲透性不能排除細小貫通通道。幾何覆蓋、施工偏差和天然透水夾層須一起審查，避免把處理體當成理想均質方塊。 假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。 高強度區樣本容易取得，弱通道卻可能被漏採；串聯低透水公式若實際有旁通便失效，開口後集中滲流可能遠高於平均材料估算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A treated block depends on continuity and its interface with the wall. Average strength or permeability does not exclude a narrow connected path, requiring geometry, construction deviations and permeable interbeds to be assessed together. Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths. Strong areas are easier to sample while weak paths may be missed. A series-layer calculation fails in the presence of bypass, and concentrated inflow can greatly exceed the average-material estimate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Treated-ground continuity and weak paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Treated-ground continuity and weak paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A treated block depends on continuity and its interface with the wall. Average strength or permeability does not exclude a narrow connected path, requiring geometry, construction deviations and permeable interbeds to be assessed together.

optionsEn: A treated block depends on continuity and its interface with the wall.

Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 水頭差除路徑長形成平均梯度，真正最短路徑可能沿井壁界面或裂縫。提高處理厚度不一定同比降低局部梯度，若缺陷使路徑縮短，流失風險需用連通幾何與土性共同評估。 假設水頭差10 m、有效路徑5 m，i=2；若裂縫路徑僅1 m則i=10，未計三維流場。 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滲流梯度與尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Head difference over path length gives a mean gradient, but the shortest route may follow a wall interface or crack. Greater treatment thickness does not proportionally reduce local gradients if a defect shortens the actual flow path. Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects. Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition. quiz.explanationEn: Construct plausible paths from geology, interfaces and pressure observations and compare intact and defective scenarios; geotechnical engineers validate test scale, and the gradient exercise does not authorize injection or opening work. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 滲流梯度與尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seepage gradient and scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滲流梯度與尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seepage gradient and scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「處理體總厚度永遠就是地下水能走過的最短路徑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The full treated-block thickness always equals the shortest possible groundwater path." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。
knowledge.textEn: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滲流梯度與尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seepage gradient and scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。
平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients.
Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
quiz.explanation: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「止水環壓縮與偏心」與「角度誤差與穿越長度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity" and "Angular error through the opening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水環壓縮與偏心」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。機器姿態與井口幾何是共同介面，不能只由止水材料單方證書判定整體可用。 假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。 機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水環壓縮與偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. Uneven annular contact leaves locally undercompressed zones, making machine pose and opening geometry a shared interface beyond what a material certificate alone can establish. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing. Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水環壓縮與偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心
knowledge.text: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。機器姿態與井口幾何是共同介面，不能只由止水材料單方證書判定整體可用。
knowledge.textEn: Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. Uneven annular contact leaves locally undercompressed zones, making machine pose and opening geometry a shared interface beyond what a material certificate alone can establish.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「止水環壓縮與偏心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity" is correct?
options: 平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
機器中心點對準就不需要再檢查俯仰偏航和穿越長度。
始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。
optionsEn: Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
A correctly positioned machine center removes the need to check pitch, yaw and crossing length.
Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity.
quiz.explanation: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水環壓縮與偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「止水環壓縮與偏心」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。
始發到達成功就代表拆除臨時密封後永久止水也已合格。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
Successful launch or reception proves permanent sealing after temporary barriers are removed.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水環壓縮與偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for sealing-ring compression and eccentricity. Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
