只做平移而漏掉旋轉會使長桿臂偏差放大，目標支架鬆動又可能被控制系統當成機器偏離；追逐錯誤導航訊號會造成真實線形修正過度。
平面里程和斜距可以不加說明直接用在同一環號表。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Applying translation without rotation amplifies long-lever errors, while a loose target bracket can mimic machine deviation.
Horizontal chainage and slope distance can be interchanged within one ring table without explanation.
quiz.explanation: 只做平移而漏掉旋轉會使長桿臂偏差放大，目標支架鬆動又可能被控制系統當成機器偏離；追逐錯誤導航訊號會造成真實線形修正過度。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計線形與里程投影」與「曲線組環與楔形量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 設計線形與里程投影：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Design alignment and chainage projection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設計線形與里程投影」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design alignment and chainage projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機器位置要投影到三維設計線形才能得到里程及橫縱偏差，曲線與縱坡使最近點不等同平面直線投影。線形版本和里程起算點需鎖定，否則各系統可能用不同名義位置討論同一環。 假設水平前進100 m、縱坡2%，高程變化2 m，斜長√(100²+2²)=100.020 m；里程定義須明示。 平面里程與斜距混用會逐步累積環號錯配，曲線左右符號用反又會顛倒修正方向；坐標數字合理仍不能保證工程定義一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設計線形與里程投影」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Machine coordinates must project onto the three-dimensional design alignment to give chainage and offsets. Curvature and grade invalidate a simple planar projection, requiring a locked alignment version and station origin across systems. Assume 100 m horizontal advance on a 2% grade; elevation changes 2 m and slope length is 100.020 m, requiring an explicit chainage convention. Mixing horizontal chainage with slope distance progressively misassigns rings, while reversed left-right signs invert correction direction. Numerically plausible coordinates do not establish consistent engineering definitions across the workflow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Design alignment and chainage projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面里程和斜距可以不加說明直接用在同一環號表。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Horizontal chainage and slope distance can be interchanged within one ring table without explanation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設計線形與里程投影」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 尾隙與機器環片相對位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Relative machine-ring clearance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative machine-ring clearance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刀盤中心在設計線上不代表盾尾與環片同心，機身轉動、環片抬升及變形會改變相對間隙。導航應同時看機器和已裝環的位置，把線形控制與防水、結構介面連起來。 假設機器中心右偏12 mm、環中心右偏5 mm，相對偏心7 mm；不能用12 mm直接當尾隙偏差。 忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cutterhead on alignment does not ensure concentric shield tail and lining. Machine rotation, ring uplift and deformation alter relative clearance, requiring both machine and installed-ring positions to connect guidance with sealing and structural interfaces. Assume machine center 12 mm right and ring center 5 mm right; relative eccentricity is 7 mm, not the full 12 mm machine offset. Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Relative machine-ring clearance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cutterhead on the design alignment guarantees concentric shield tail and installed rings." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 尾隙與機器環片相對位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative machine-ring clearance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative machine-ring clearance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測尾隙、機身姿態與最新環片中心，使用同一坐標和時刻比較；將局部最大間隙與核准設備包絡核對，偏差原因由測量、設備和組環負責人共同辨識。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure clearance, pose and latest ring center at a common time and datum; compare local extreme gaps with the approved equipment envelope and jointly identify causes through survey, equipment and ring-building leads. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄尾隙與機器環片相對位移的資料來源與適用條件。同時量測尾隙、機身姿態與最新環片中心，使用同一坐標和時刻比較；將局部最大間隙與核准設備包絡核對，偏差原因由測量、設備和組環負責人共同辨識。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for relative machine-ring clearance. Measure clearance, pose and latest ring center at a common time and datum; compare local extreme gaps with the approved equipment envelope and jointly identify causes through survey, equipment and ring-building leads.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Relative machine-ring clearance"?
options: 同時量測尾隙、機身姿態與最新環片中心，使用同一坐標和時刻比較；將局部最大間隙與核准設備包絡核對，偏差原因由測量、設備和組環負責人共同辨識。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
從目標點算刀盤中心只需平移，不必考慮機身旋轉。
optionsEn: Measure clearance, pose and latest ring center at a common time and datum.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Transforming a target to cutterhead center requires translation only, without machine rotation.
quiz.explanation: 同時量測尾隙、機身姿態與最新環片中心，使用同一坐標和時刻比較；將局部最大間隙與核准設備包絡核對，偏差原因由測量、設備和組環負責人共同辨識。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure clearance, pose and latest ring center at a common time and datum; compare local extreme gaps with the approved equipment envelope and jointly identify causes through survey, equipment and ring-building leads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 尾隙與機器環片相對位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative machine-ring clearance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative machine-ring clearance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤在設計線上就代表盾尾與已安裝環片必定同心。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A cutterhead on the design alignment guarantees concentric shield tail and installed rings." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Mean center difference also misses local contact loss caused by ring ovalization.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Relative machine-ring clearance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。
把受折射影響的讀值平滑後就能恢復真實機器姿態。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction.
Smoothing refracted observations restores the true machine attitude automatically.
quiz.explanation: 忽略環片浮起會把尾隙變化全歸機器偏航，錯誤修正可能進一步壓傷密封；只看平均中心差又會漏掉橢圓化造成的局部接觸不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring ring uplift attributes every gap change to machine yaw and can worsen seal loading through incorrect correction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 折射環境與品質旗標：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Refraction environment and quality flags: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「折射環境與品質旗標」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Refraction environment and quality flags” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道熱流和粉塵影響光學測量，量測仍有數字不代表品質正常。環境造成的偏差可能具有方向性，應利用多基準或不同時段交叉檢查，並讓品質旗標隨導航結果一同傳遞。 假設兩次同點讀值相差6 mm、各標準不確定2 mm且獨立，差值標準不確定2.83 mm，差約2.12倍。 熱折射可能使多點一致偏移，濾波後曲線更平順卻更像真實轉向；若品質旗標未傳到決策端，系統會對低可信度數值給出過度確定的判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折射環境與品質旗標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heat flow and dust affect optical observations, and a numeric output does not ensure good quality. Directional environmental bias requires multiple references or time-separated checks, with quality flags traveling alongside the navigation result. Two assumed observations differ by 6 mm with independent 2 mm standard uncertainties each; difference uncertainty is 2.83 mm and the discrepancy is about 2.12 times it. Thermal refraction can shift many points together, and filtering makes the false trend resemble genuine steering. Missing quality flags cause the decision layer to treat low-confidence observations as definite positions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Refraction environment and quality flags” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把受折射影響的讀值平滑後就能恢復真實機器姿態。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smoothing refracted observations restores the true machine attitude automatically." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「折射環境與品質旗標」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Refraction environment and quality flags”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折射環境與品質旗標
knowledge.text: 隧道熱流和粉塵影響光學測量，量測仍有數字不代表品質正常。環境造成的偏差可能具有方向性，應利用多基準或不同時段交叉檢查，並讓品質旗標隨導航結果一同傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Heat flow and dust affect optical observations, and a numeric output does not ensure good quality. Directional environmental bias requires multiple references or time-separated checks, with quality flags traveling alongside the navigation result.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把受折射影響的讀值平滑後就能恢復真實機器姿態。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Smoothing refracted observations restores the true machine attitude automatically. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「折射環境與品質旗標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Refraction environment and quality flags" is correct?
options: 把受折射影響的讀值平滑後就能恢復真實機器姿態。
兩個共用錯誤基準的感測器融合後可以消除共同偏差。
隧道熱流和粉塵影響光學測量，量測仍有數字不代表品質正常。
optionsEn: Smoothing refracted observations restores the true machine attitude automatically.
Fusing two sensors sharing an incorrect datum eliminates their common bias.
Heat flow and dust affect optical observations, and a numeric output does not ensure good quality.
quiz.explanation: 隧道熱流和粉塵影響光學測量，量測仍有數字不代表品質正常。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Heat flow and dust affect optical observations, and a numeric output does not ensure good quality. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 折射環境與品質旗標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Refraction environment and quality flags: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折射環境與品質旗標」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Refraction environment and quality flags” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次同點讀值相差6 mm、各標準不確定2 mm且獨立，差值標準不確定2.83 mm，差約2.12倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Two assumed observations differ by 6 mm with independent 2 mm standard uncertainties each; difference uncertainty is 2.83 mm and the discrepancy is about 2.12 times it. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄可視、溫度與儀器追蹤狀態，對照穩定參考點及備援量測，判斷共模偏差；不佳品質時由測量主管依核准程序確認資料用途，不能平滑後隱藏環境事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record visibility, temperature and tracking status and compare stable references and backup observations for common bias; survey leads determine acceptable use under approved procedures rather than smoothing environmental events out of the record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次同點讀值相差6 mm、各標準不確定2 mm且獨立，差值標準不確定2.83 mm，差約2.12倍。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Two assumed observations differ by 6 mm with independent 2 mm standard uncertainties each; difference uncertainty is 2.83 mm and the discrepancy is about 2.12 times it.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「折射環境與品質旗標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Refraction environment and quality flags", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。
陀螺方向是自動真值，不需再校準或考慮溫度漂移。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel.
Gyro orientation is automatic truth needing no calibration or thermal-drift consideration.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「資料融合與共同偏差」與「貫通檢核與竣工交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Data fusion and common bias" and "Breakthrough checks and as-built handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 資料融合與共同偏差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Data fusion and common bias: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資料融合與共同偏差」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Data fusion and common bias” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個獨立無偏量測可按不確定度加權降低隨機誤差，但共享控制點或相機模型時並不獨立。融合前需列出共同來源，否則算出的精度提升只是重複計算同一證據。 假設獨立標準不確定2與3 mm，融合u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm；有共同偏差時不適用。 兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資料融合與共同偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent unbiased measurements can be weighted to reduce random error, but shared controls or geometry create dependence. Identify common sources before fusion or the apparent improvement simply counts the same evidence more than once. For assumed independent standard uncertainties 2 and 3 mm, fused u=1/√(1/2²+1/3²)=1.664 mm, inapplicable to a shared bias. Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Combining different epochs additionally mistakes genuine machine movement for disagreement between observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Data fusion and common bias” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「資料融合與共同偏差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Data fusion and common bias”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: Independent unbiased measurements can be weighted to reduce random error, but shared controls or geometry create dependence.
Fusing two sensors sharing an incorrect datum eliminates their common bias.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 繪製各感測器到坐標基準的依賴圖，檢查共同校準和時間戳，使用未參與融合的控制點驗證；演算法負責人保留權重與異常剔除紀錄，不以多感測器數量宣稱獨立性。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。
knowledge.textEn: Map dependencies from sensors to datum, checking shared calibration and clocks and validating against unused controls; algorithm owners retain weights and rejection records rather than asserting independence from sensor count alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Combining different epochs additionally mistakes genuine machine movement for disagreement between observations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄資料融合與共同偏差的資料來源與適用條件。繪製各感測器到坐標基準的依賴圖，檢查共同校準和時間戳，使用未參與融合的控制點驗證；演算法負責人保留權重與異常剔除紀錄，不以多感測器數量宣稱獨立性。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for data fusion and common bias. Map dependencies from sensors to datum, checking shared calibration and clocks and validating against unused controls; algorithm owners retain weights and rejection records rather than asserting independence from sensor count alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資料融合與共同偏差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Data fusion and common bias"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要能回到設計中心線，就不必檢查組環曲率與止水限制。
繪製各感測器到坐標基準的依賴圖，檢查共同校準和時間戳，使用未參與融合的控制點驗證；演算法負責人保留權重與異常剔除紀錄，不以多感測器數量宣稱獨立性。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Returning to the design centerline removes the need to check ring curvature and seal limits.
Map dependencies from sensors to datum, checking shared calibration and clocks and validating against unused controls.
quiz.explanation: 繪製各感測器到坐標基準的依賴圖，檢查共同校準和時間戳，使用未參與融合的控制點驗證；演算法負責人保留權重與異常剔除紀錄，不以多感測器數量宣稱獨立性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map dependencies from sensors to datum, checking shared calibration and clocks and validating against unused controls; algorithm owners retain weights and rejection records rather than asserting independence from sensor count alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資料融合與共同偏差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Data fusion and common bias: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資料融合與共同偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Data fusion and common bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Combining different epochs additionally mistakes genuine machine movement for disagreement between observations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個共用錯誤基準的感測器融合後可以消除共同偏差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fusing two sensors sharing an incorrect datum eliminates their common bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資料融合與共同偏差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Data fusion and common bias" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩套系統共用錯誤基準可精密地同意一個錯位置，融合後不確定度卻更小；將不同時刻的機位合併又會把真實運動當成量測分歧。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
事後強制閉合差歸零，就不需要再保存原始貫通誤差。
optionsEn: Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Forcing closure to zero afterward removes any need to retain the original breakthrough discrepancy.

quiz.explanationEn: Two systems sharing a wrong datum can agree precisely on the wrong position while fusion reports smaller uncertainty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 貫通檢核與竣工交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Breakthrough checks and as-built handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「貫通檢核與竣工交接」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Breakthrough checks and as-built handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導航完整性最後需由獨立控制和竣工幾何驗證，閉合差是整條量測鏈的結果而非某台儀器單獨績效。交接保存設計線、實際環片和機器歷程，讓誤差來源可分辨並供後續淨空與維護使用。 假設獨立零均值橫向隨機誤差的標準不確定度分量10、12、9 mm，RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm；系統偏差另列。 事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貫通檢核與竣工交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent control and as-built geometry ultimately verify navigation. Closure reflects the whole measurement chain, not one instrument's performance. Preserve design, installed rings and machine history for error diagnosis, clearance assessment and future maintenance. Assume standard-uncertainty components of independent zero-mean lateral errors of 10,12 and 9 mm; RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm, with systematic biases reported separately. Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Breakthrough checks and as-built handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「事後強制閉合差歸零，就不需要再保存原始貫通誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Forcing closure to zero afterward removes any need to retain the original breakthrough discrepancy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「貫通檢核與竣工交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Breakthrough checks and as-built handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 貫通檢核與竣工交接
knowledge.text: 導航完整性最後需由獨立控制和竣工幾何驗證，閉合差是整條量測鏈的結果而非某台儀器單獨績效。交接保存設計線、實際環片和機器歷程，讓誤差來源可分辨並供後續淨空與維護使用。
knowledge.textEn: Independent control and as-built geometry ultimately verify navigation. Closure reflects the whole measurement chain, not one instrument's performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：事後強制閉合差歸零，就不需要再保存原始貫通誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Forcing closure to zero afterward removes any need to retain the original breakthrough discrepancy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「貫通檢核與竣工交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

導航完整性最後需由獨立控制和竣工幾何驗證，閉合差是整條量測鏈的結果而非某台儀器單獨績效。
坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。
optionsEn: Forcing closure to zero afterward removes any need to retain the original breakthrough discrepancy.
Independent control and as-built geometry ultimately verify navigation.
Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel.

steps.title: 貫通檢核與竣工交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Breakthrough checks and as-built handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「貫通檢核與竣工交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設獨立零均值橫向隨機誤差的標準不確定度分量10、12、9 mm，RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm；系統偏差另列。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume standard-uncertainty components of independent zero-mean lateral errors of 10,12 and 9 mm; RSS=√(100+144+81)=18.03 mm, with systematic biases reported separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄貫通檢核與竣工交接的資料來源與適用條件。以不共享全部基準的獨立測網檢查貫通與竣工線形，追查閉合差的方向及沿程分布；測量、設計及業主共同確認未解決偏差、資料版本與適用精度，不能只交單一最終座標。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for breakthrough checks and as-built handover. Check breakthrough and as-built alignment with an independently constrained network and examine closure direction and distribution; survey, design and owner leads accept remaining deviations, versions and accuracy limits rather than receiving only one final coordinate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「貫通檢核與竣工交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Breakthrough checks and as-built handover"?
options: 以不共享全部基準的獨立測網檢查貫通與竣工線形，追查閉合差的方向及沿程分布；測量、設計及業主共同確認未解決偏差、資料版本與適用精度，不能只交單一最終座標。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
刀盤在設計線上就代表盾尾與已安裝環片必定同心。
optionsEn: Check breakthrough and as-built alignment with an independently constrained network and examine closure direction and distribution.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A cutterhead on the design alignment guarantees concentric shield tail and installed rings.
quiz.explanation: 以不共享全部基準的獨立測網檢查貫通與竣工線形，追查閉合差的方向及沿程分布；測量、設計及業主共同確認未解決偏差、資料版本與適用精度，不能只交單一最終座標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check breakthrough and as-built alignment with an independently constrained network and examine closure direction and distribution; survey, design and owner leads accept remaining deviations, versions and accuracy limits rather than receiving only one final coordinate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 貫通檢核與竣工交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Breakthrough checks and as-built handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「貫通檢核與竣工交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Breakthrough checks and as-built handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「事後強制閉合差歸零，就不需要再保存原始貫通誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Forcing closure to zero afterward removes any need to retain the original breakthrough discrepancy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Missing installed-ring geometry also undermines operational clearance assessment after handover.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「貫通檢核與竣工交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Breakthrough checks and as-built handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。
坐標原點重合就保證整條長隧道的尺度與旋轉都正確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error.
Coincident coordinate origins guarantee correct scale and rotation along the entire long tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 事後強制平差到零會抹去真實閉合證據，若不保留原始值就無法辨識施工偏差與測量偏差；未交環片實際幾何也會影響營運淨空判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing closure to zero afterward erases evidence unless raw observations are retained, preventing separation of construction and survey error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工
courses.summary: 雙護盾可讓切削與管片組裝在不同機構上進行，但並行能力依賴岩壁提供可靠反力、伸縮行程和後勤同步。本課由接觸承壓、軸向推力、循環時間進到擠壓岩與偏轉判讀，將設備能力、地層限制及觀測證據分開列帳。所有數字為教學假設，結論是辨識需要停點審查的條件，不是掘進機操作參數。
courses.summaryEn: A double shield can separate excavation from segment assembly, but concurrent work depends on a reliable rock reaction, available telescopic travel and synchronized logistics. This course follows contact stress, axial thrust and cycle time into squeezing-ground and steering interpretations. Machine capability, ground limitations and observed evidence are recorded separately. All numerical inputs are teaching assumptions; the outcome identifies conditions requiring engineering review rather than machine operating parameters.
courses.focus: 雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度
courses.focusEn: Double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「伸縮行程與循環約束」與「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" and "Gripper contact and local rock wall": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮行程與循環約束」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。 假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「伸縮行程與循環約束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. Telescoping separates cutting travel from work behind it, but usable travel still depends on geometric reserve and end limits. Nominal maximum extension is not entirely available for production. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「伸縮行程與循環約束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束
knowledge.text: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。
knowledge.textEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. Telescoping separates cutting travel from work behind it, but usable travel still depends on geometric reserve and end limits.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「伸縮行程與循環約束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" is correct?
options: 伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。
前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。
完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。
optionsEn: Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located.
High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.
quiz.explanation: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮行程與循環約束」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「伸縮行程與循環約束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint", which statement holds?
options: 只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮行程與循環約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position. Plot ring boundaries and regripping on a shared clock. If end reserve differs from the design assumption, review the cycle before treating additional thrust as a remedy for insufficient travel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep travel zero, reserve and positioning events under the same ring identifier each shift. The mechanical engineer verifies instrumentation and end protection; the construction lead confirms cycle feasibility before accepting a revised time budget.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「伸縮行程與循環約束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮行程與循環約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「伸縮行程與循環約束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。
完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance.
High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.
quiz.explanation: 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 撐靴接觸與局部岩壁：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gripper contact and local rock wall: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gripper contact and local rock wall” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 撐靴把推進反力傳入有限的岩壁接觸區，平均接觸壓力與局部節理幾何共同影響反力可靠度。總力相同時，真實接觸面積變小會放大局部壓力，完整試體強度不能直接代表破碎岩壁。 假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grippers transmit reaction through a finite rock-wall contact. Average pressure and local discontinuity geometry jointly affect reliability. At fixed force, a smaller effective contact increases local pressure; intact specimen strength does not directly characterize a fractured wall. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gripper contact and local rock wall” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gripper contact and local rock wall”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Grippers transmit reaction through a finite rock-wall contact. Average pressure and local discontinuity geometry jointly affect reliability.

knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。

optionsEn: High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 撐靴接觸與局部岩壁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gripper contact and local rock wall: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gripper contact and local rock wall” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將撐靴壓力與經校正有效缸面積換算的力，和可接近區域的岩壁裂隙記錄對照；比較左右側滑移與壓力波形，不從單一壓力尖峰推定承載力，接觸區狀況須由地質與機械人員共同判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare force derived from calibrated cylinder pressure and effective area with accessible wall discontinuity records. Examine left-right slip and pressure histories together. A single pressure peak does not establish capacity; geological and mechanical reviewers must interpret contact conditions jointly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接觸面積只採有證據的估計值，記錄被遮蔽區域的不確定性；地質工程師審查節理與剝落後，由設備負責人依核准程序判斷反力路徑是否可用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use evidence-based contact-area estimates and record uncertainty in hidden zones. After the geologist reviews joints and spalling, the equipment lead assesses the reaction path using the approved procedure rather than the classroom pressure estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將撐靴壓力與經校正有效缸面積換算的力，和可接近區域的岩壁裂隙記錄對照；比較左右側滑移與壓力波形，不從單一壓力尖峰推定承載力，接觸區狀況須由地質與機械人員共同判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare force derived from calibrated cylinder pressure and effective area with accessible wall discontinuity records. Examine left-right slip and pressure histories together. A single pressure peak does not establish capacity; geological and mechanical reviewers must interpret contact conditions jointly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接觸面積只採有證據的估計值，記錄被遮蔽區域的不確定性；地質工程師審查節理與剝落後，由設備負責人依核准程序判斷反力路徑是否可用。
knowledge.textEn: Use evidence-based contact-area estimates and record uncertainty in hidden zones. After the geologist reviews joints and spalling, the equipment lead assesses the reaction path using the approved procedure rather than the classroom pressure estimate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gripper contact and local rock wall"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將撐靴壓力與經校正有效缸面積換算的力，和可接近區域的岩壁裂隙記錄對照。
只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare force derived from calibrated cylinder pressure and effective area with accessible wall discontinuity records.
Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
quiz.explanation: 將撐靴壓力與經校正有效缸面積換算的力，和可接近區域的岩壁裂隙記錄對照；比較左右側滑移與壓力波形，不從單一壓力尖峰推定承載力，接觸區狀況須由地質與機械人員共同判讀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare force derived from calibrated cylinder pressure and effective area with accessible wall discontinuity records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 撐靴接觸與局部岩壁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gripper contact and local rock wall: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gripper contact and local rock wall” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。
knowledge.textEn: Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gripper contact and local rock wall" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。
沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact.
quiz.explanation: 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反力摩擦與需求分離」與「襯砌反力與局部承壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reaction friction versus demand" and "Lining reaction and local bearing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反力摩擦與需求分離」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reaction friction versus demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。應先把需求與能力放在同一方向再比較。 假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反力摩擦與需求分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. It represents only one component, excluding joint shear, shoe indentation and machine torque. Demand and resistance must first be resolved in the same direction. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor. Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reaction friction versus demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反力摩擦與需求分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reaction friction versus demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離
knowledge.text: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。應先把需求與能力放在同一方向再比較。
knowledge.textEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. It represents only one component, excluding joint shear, shoe indentation and machine torque.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反力摩擦與需求分離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reaction friction versus demand" is correct?
options: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。
摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。
只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
optionsEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance.
A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反力摩擦與需求分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reaction friction versus demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反力摩擦與需求分離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reaction friction versus demand", which statement holds?
options: 停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。
optionsEn: Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反力摩擦與需求分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reaction friction versus demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset. Annotate torque changes, contact condition and wall observations. If the ratio changes materially with a small coefficient variation, provide a sensitivity table for designer review. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把μ的來源和替代範圍列為模型輸入，不允許用觀察到的最大值當永久保證；任何操作模式變更均須設備與地工主管共同審核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record the source and alternative range of μ as model inputs. An observed maximum is not a permanent guarantee. Equipment and geotechnical leads must jointly review any proposed operating-mode change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset. Annotate torque changes, contact condition and wall observations. If the ratio changes materially with a small coefficient variation, provide a sensitivity table for designer review.
