stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「力位移曲線的能量積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" and "Energy integration of force-displacement curves": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂後承載與纖維橋接」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂後承載與纖維橋接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance. Inspect the complete postpeak curve rather than comparing maximum loads alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接
knowledge.text: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。
knowledge.textEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂後承載與纖維橋接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" is correct?
options: 抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高
首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。
荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
optionsEn: High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward.
Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured
quiz.explanation: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging", which statement holds?
options: 把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數
平均纖維用量符合就不需要檢查分散均勻度
原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。
optionsEn: Multiplying total fibre count by a cosine gives the number crossing cracks
Passing mean fibre dosage removes the need to assess dispersion
Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂後承載與纖維橋接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂後承載與纖維橋接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging"?
options: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差
optionsEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error
quiz.explanation: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂後承載與纖維橋接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。
荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force.
Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured

steps.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy integration of force-displacement curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「力位移曲線的能量積分」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。使用橫樑行程會混入機架與接觸變形，積分面積因而可能偏大；位移量測應明確指向試板中央或規定位置，並保存積分區間與離散方法。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積；若出現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「力位移曲線的能量積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. Crosshead travel includes machine and contact compliance and can inflate the area. Define displacement at the panel centre or specified location, and preserve the integration interval and discretization method. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「力位移曲線的能量積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy integration of force-displacement curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。使用橫樑行程會混入機架與接觸變形，積分面積因而可能偏大；位移量測應明確指向試板中央或規定位置，並保存積分區間與離散方法。
knowledge.textEn: Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. Crosshead travel includes machine and contact compliance and can inflate the area.

knowledge.text: 誤解：荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy integration of force-displacement curves: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「力位移曲線的能量積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「力位移曲線的能量積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy integration of force-displacement curves: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「力位移曲線的能量積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.text: 將以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「力位移曲線的能量積分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy integration of force-displacement curves"?

Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life

steps.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy integration of force-displacement curves: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「力位移曲線的能量積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積；若出現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣

Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」與「纖維方向與法向力分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel thickness and bending scale" and "Fibre orientation and normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel thickness and bending scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel thickness and bending scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同材料配比的面板，厚度改變會改變彎曲剛度、裂縫分布與纖維總數。梁條彎矩尺度對厚度平方敏感，但完整面板仍有雙向裂縫及膜效應；試驗比較必須先鎖定幾何，不可把厚板能量直接當成薄噴層的材料指標。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較；若出現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. A strip moment scale varies with thickness squared, while full panels add two-way cracking and membrane action. Fix geometry before treating energy as a material comparison. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Panel thickness and bending scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm.

knowledge.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度
knowledge.text: 相同材料配比的面板，厚度改變會改變彎曲剛度、裂縫分布與纖維總數。梁條彎矩尺度對厚度平方敏感，但完整面板仍有雙向裂縫及膜效應；試驗比較必須先鎖定幾何，不可把厚板能量直接當成薄噴層的材料指標。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. A strip moment scale varies with thickness squared, while full panels add two-way cracking and membrane action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.explanationEn: Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel thickness and bending scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Panel thickness and bending scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Panel thickness and bending scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Panel thickness and bending scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods
Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries.

steps.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Panel thickness and bending scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Panel thickness and bending scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較；若出現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

steps.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fibre orientation and normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「纖維方向與法向力分量」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fibre orientation and normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纖維沿噴射方向及流動方向重新排列，跨越裂縫的角度影響法向傳力。餘弦可用來投影單根已知纖維的力，卻不能直接計算跨縫根數；根數還受位置、長度及三維取向分布控制，必須透過切面或影像取樣描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載；若出現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纖維方向與法向力分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer. A cosine projects a known fibre force but does not directly count crossings. Counts also depend on position, length and three-dimensional orientation, requiring section or image sampling rather than a force-projection shortcut. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fibre orientation and normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fibre orientation and normal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pullout work and interface slip” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。拔出功屬單根纖維與試件的組合，不能不考慮互相干擾便乘上所有纖維數；嵌入長度及端部形狀要隨試驗一起報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拔出功與界面滑移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture. Single-fibre work belongs to that specimen system and cannot be multiplied by every fibre without interaction assumptions. Report embedment length and end shape with the result. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pullout work and interface slip” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「拔出功與界面滑移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 拔出功與界面滑移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pullout work and interface slip: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拔出功與界面滑移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pullout work and interface slip” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 拔出功與界面滑移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pullout work and interface slip: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拔出功與界面滑移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pullout work and interface slip” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 取樣批次與纖維分散：機制與系統路徑

steps.instructionEn: Equal mean fibre mass can coexist with local clusters and weak zones. Convenient small samples can miss spray shadows or high-rebound areas. If clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling batches and fibre dispersion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 取樣批次與纖維分散：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling batches and fibre dispersion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「取樣批次與纖維分散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling batches and fibre dispersion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「取樣批次與纖維分散」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling batches and fibre dispersion"?

Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality
Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 取樣批次與纖維分散：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling batches and fibre dispersion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「取樣批次與纖維分散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling batches and fibre dispersion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散；若出現團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均纖維用量符合就不需要檢查分散均勻度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing mean fibre dosage removes the need to assess dispersion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「取樣批次與纖維分散」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling batches and fibre dispersion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。

optionsEn: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Accurate force and displacement channels do not need synchronized sampling

quiz.explanationEn: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「荷重位移同步與零點」與「重複試驗與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force-displacement synchronization and zero" and "Repeated tests and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 荷重位移同步與零點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Force-displacement synchronization and zero: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「荷重位移同步與零點」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量積分需要同一時刻的荷重與位移，資料流延遲會把峰值配到錯誤開口。試件接觸前的行程不應列入試板變形，接觸壓密又須與真正裂後位移區分；儀器零點、取樣率及濾波設定都會影響曲線形狀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點；若出現時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「荷重位移同步與零點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy integration requires synchronized force and displacement; stream delay pairs a peak with the wrong opening. Precontact motion is not panel deflection, and seating differs from postcrack displacement. Zero, sampling rate and filters therefore influence the interpreted curve. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event. If timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「荷重與位移各自準確就不需要同步取樣」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate force and displacement channels do not need synchronized sampling" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「荷重位移同步與零點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Force-displacement synchronization and zero”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 荷重位移同步與零點
knowledge.text: 能量積分需要同一時刻的荷重與位移，資料流延遲會把峰值配到錯誤開口。試件接觸前的行程不應列入試板變形，接觸壓密又須與真正裂後位移區分；儀器零點、取樣率及濾波設定都會影響曲線形狀。
knowledge.textEn: Energy integration requires synchronized force and displacement; stream delay pairs a peak with the wrong opening. Precontact motion is not panel deflection, and seating differs from postcrack displacement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：荷重與位移各自準確就不需要同步取樣 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Accurate force and displacement channels do not need synchronized sampling Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷重位移同步與零點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Force-displacement synchronization and zero" is correct?
options: 荷重與位移各自準確就不需要同步取樣
能量積分需要同一時刻的荷重與位移，資料流延遲會把峰值配到錯誤開口。
重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差
optionsEn: Accurate force and displacement channels do not need synchronized sampling
Energy integration requires synchronized force and displacement; stream delay pairs a peak with the wrong opening.
Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error
quiz.explanation: 能量積分需要同一時刻的荷重與位移，資料流延遲會把峰值配到錯誤開口。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy integration requires synchronized force and displacement; stream delay pairs a peak with the wrong opening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 荷重位移同步與零點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force-displacement synchronization and zero: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「荷重位移同步與零點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「荷重位移同步與零點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Force-displacement synchronization and zero", which statement holds?
options: 只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較
荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。
optionsEn: Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods

Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複試驗與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeated tests and uncertainty"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。
鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels.
Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy
quiz.explanation: 比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複試驗與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated tests and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複試驗與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated tests and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散；若出現只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複試驗與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repeated tests and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退
只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life
A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias.
quiz.explanation: 只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環境老化與殘餘能力」與「性能規格與試法交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Environmental ageing and residual resistance" and "Performance specifications and method handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環境老化與殘餘能力」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫開放後纖維及界面暴露於水與化學環境，長期表現不能只由初期能量推定。加速試驗的溫度或溶液可能改變失效機制，因此老化前後必須採同幾何及同位移定義，並檢查裂縫處的實際腐蝕或脆化證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀；若出現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環境老化與殘餘能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance. Accelerated temperature or solution may change the failure mechanism. Compare identical geometry and displacement definitions and inspect actual corrosion or embrittlement at cracks. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環境老化與殘餘能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Environmental ageing and residual resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力
knowledge.text: 裂縫開放後纖維及界面暴露於水與化學環境，長期表現不能只由初期能量推定。加速試驗的溫度或溶液可能改變失效機制，因此老化前後必須採同幾何及同位移定義，並檢查裂縫處的實際腐蝕或脆化證據。
knowledge.textEn: Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance. Accelerated temperature or solution may change the failure mechanism.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環境老化與殘餘能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Environmental ageing and residual resistance" is correct?
options: 裂縫開放後纖維及界面暴露於水與化學環境，長期表現不能只由初期能量推定。
初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退
只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較
optionsEn: Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance.
Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life
Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods
quiz.explanation: 裂縫開放後纖維及界面暴露於水與化學環境，長期表現不能只由初期能量推定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環境老化與殘餘能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環境老化與殘餘能力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Environmental ageing and residual resistance", which statement holds?
options: 荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
原創教學假設：retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent。
把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數
optionsEn: Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured
Original teaching assumptions: retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent.
Multiplying total fibre count by a cosine gives the number crossing cracks

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環境老化與殘餘能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境老化與殘餘能力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Environmental ageing and residual resistance"?

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀；若出現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「性能規格與試法交接」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Performance specifications and method handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。梁試驗和板試驗有不同裂縫路徑，不能直接換算；交接應保留版本、曲線和取樣方向，讓維修材料採用同一性能語言。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移；若出現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「性能規格與試法交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。
