steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Performance specifications and method handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

steps.instructionEn: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. courses.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
courses.summary: 本課以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為主線，從岩楔荷重與岩栓方向與鋼材屈服與有效面積建立系統邊界，再把自由段伸長與系統柔度、持載位移與時間效應連到試驗代表性與補強決策。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer. It begins with Wedge weight and bolt direction and Steel yielding and effective area, links Free-length extension and system compliance and Hold movement and time effects, and ends with Representativeness and reinforcement decisions. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力
courses.focusEn: Distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each；再獨立檢查鋼材屈服與有效面積：Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN。假想岩楔由 4 增為 5 m3，單位重 26 kN/m3 不變，重量由 104 增為 130 kN；兩支垂直岩栓只有在理想對稱下才各分擔 65 kN。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Wedge weight and bolt direction: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. Independently check Steel yielding and effective area: Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN. Increasing assumed wedge volume from 4 to 5 m3 at 26 kN/m3 raises weight from 104 to 130 kN; two vertical bolts share 65 kN each only under ideal symmetry. The two results are not a complete design because a single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Use compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」與「鋼材屈服與有效面積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wedge weight and bolt direction" and "Steel yielding and effective area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge weight and bolt direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩栓能否穩住岩楔取決於節理幾何、摩擦以及力的方向，而非單看根數。垂直分量必須平衡重力，水平分量可能改變節理正向力；將所有岩栓當成平均分擔會忽略偏心與先後受力，需先畫出可移動岩塊的自由體圖。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖；若出現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wedge restraint depends on joint geometry, friction and bolt orientation rather than count alone. Vertical components balance gravity while horizontal components can modify joint normal force. Equal sharing ignores eccentricity and sequential engagement, so first isolate the movable block in a free-body diagram. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. If a bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wedge weight and bolt direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wedge weight and bolt direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向
knowledge.text: 岩栓能否穩住岩楔取決於節理幾何、摩擦以及力的方向，而非單看根數。垂直分量必須平衡重力，水平分量可能改變節理正向力；將所有岩栓當成平均分擔會忽略偏心與先後受力，需先畫出可移動岩塊的自由體圖。
knowledge.textEn: Wedge restraint depends on joint geometry, friction and bolt orientation rather than count alone. Vertical components balance gravity while horizontal components can modify joint normal force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wedge weight and bolt direction" is correct?
options: 岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
岩栓能否穩住岩楔取決於節理幾何、摩擦以及力的方向，而非單看根數。
岩栓公稱直徑足以代表所有承載截面
optionsEn: Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
Wedge restraint depends on joint geometry, friction and bolt orientation rather than count alone.
Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section
quiz.explanation: 岩栓能否穩住岩楔取決於節理幾何、摩擦以及力的方向，而非單看根數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wedge restraint depends on joint geometry, friction and bolt orientation rather than count alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge weight and bolt direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wedge weight and bolt direction", which statement holds?
options: 鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常
反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。
optionsEn: An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing
The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge weight and bolt direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. steps.instruction: 以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長；若出現以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩栓公稱直徑足以代表所有承載截面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼材屈服與有效面積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel yielding and effective area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection.
quiz.explanation: 以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漿體黏結與有效長度」與「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grout bond and effective length" and "Plate bearing and rock roughness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漿體黏結與有效長度」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grout bond and effective length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。均勻黏結公式只能作平均量級，裂隙、灌漿空洞與孔壁擾動會減少有效長度；提高漿體抗壓也不一定改善岩漿界面的剪力傳遞。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像；若出現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿體黏結與有效長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. A uniform-bond formula provides an average scale only. Fractures, grout voids and disturbed bore walls reduce effective length, while greater grout compression strength need not improve rock-grout shear transfer. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grout bond and effective length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漿體黏結與有效長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grout bond and effective length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度
knowledge.text: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。均勻黏結公式只能作平均量級，裂隙、灌漿空洞與孔壁擾動會減少有效長度；提高漿體抗壓也不一定改善岩漿界面的剪力傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. A uniform-bond formula provides an average scale only.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漿體黏結與有效長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grout bond and effective length" is correct?
options: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。
灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常
optionsEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections.
Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing
quiz.explanation: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漿體黏結與有效長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grout bond and effective length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漿體黏結與有效長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout bond and effective length", which statement holds?
options: 反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。
油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確
optionsEn: The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN.
An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漿體黏結與有效長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout bond and effective length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.instruction: 托盤把軸力傳給局部岩面，實際接觸面積受凹凸、薄片和墊層影響。整片鋼板面積不等於受壓面積，局部壓碎可使預力流失而鋼栓仍完好；托盤轉角與岩面裂紋因此是傳力判讀的重要證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋；若出現托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A plate transfers axial force to local rock contact controlled by roughness, flakes and bedding. Gross plate area is not necessarily bearing area. If crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。
千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation.
Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
quiz.explanation: 托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由段伸長與系統柔度」與「反力位置與局部約束」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-length extension and system compliance" and "Reaction location and local restraint": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由段伸長與系統柔度」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-length extension and system compliance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。用全長代入純鋼伸長公式會錯把黏結段當成自由段；比較載卸曲線可辨認可回復彈性與不可回復滑移，但仍需要獨立基準才能分離支承移動。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動；若出現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由段伸長與系統柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. Full-length elastic calculation wrongly treats bonded length as free. Loading-unloading response distinguishes recoverable extension from slip, but independent references are still needed to separate support movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-length extension and system compliance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由段伸長與系統柔度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free-length extension and system compliance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度
knowledge.text: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。用全長代入純鋼伸長公式會錯把黏結段當成自由段；比較載卸曲線可辨認可回復彈性與不可回復滑移，但仍需要獨立基準才能分離支承移動。
knowledge.textEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. Full-length elastic calculation wrongly treats bonded length as free.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由段伸長與系統柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free-length extension and system compliance" is correct?
options: 千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。
optionsEn: Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement.
quiz.explanation: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由段伸長與系統柔度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free-length extension and system compliance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由段伸長與系統柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free-length extension and system compliance", which statement holds?
options: 油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確
抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm.
An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force
A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由段伸長與系統柔度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-length extension and system compliance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由段伸長與系統柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free-length extension and system compliance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動。
岩栓公稱直徑足以代表所有承載截面
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges.
Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section
quiz.explanation: 用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由段伸長與系統柔度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-length extension and system compliance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動；若出現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由段伸長與系統柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free-length extension and system compliance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反力位置與局部約束」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reaction location and local restraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拉拔反力若直接壓在受測錨固區附近，會提高局部圍壓並改變岩體破壞路徑。測試看似只是向外拉，實際同時向內壓縮周邊岩面；反力支點尺寸與間距必須記錄，才可知道結果代表何種約束條件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區；若出現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反力位置與局部約束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction close to the anchorage increases confinement and alters rock failure paths. Pulling outward simultaneously compresses nearby ground inward. Record reaction footprint and spacing so the result can be interpreted under its actual restraint rather than as an unconstrained rock capacity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reaction location and local restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反力位置與局部約束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reaction location and local restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反力位置與局部約束
knowledge.text: 拉拔反力若直接壓在受測錨固區附近，會提高局部圍壓並改變岩體破壞路徑。測試看似只是向外拉，實際同時向內壓縮周邊岩面；反力支點尺寸與間距必須記錄，才可知道結果代表何種約束條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction close to the anchorage increases confinement and alters rock failure paths. Pulling outward simultaneously compresses nearby ground inward.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反力位置與局部約束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reaction location and local restraint" is correct?
options: 拉拔反力若直接壓在受測錨固區附近，會提高局部圍壓並改變岩體破壞路徑。
反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變
optionsEn: Reaction close to the anchorage increases confinement and alters rock failure paths.
The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
quiz.explanation: 拉拔反力若直接壓在受測錨固區附近，會提高局部圍壓並改變岩體破壞路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction close to the anchorage increases confinement and alters rock failure paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反力位置與局部約束」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reaction location and local restraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反力位置與局部約束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reaction location and local restraint", which statement holds?
options: 平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。
岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
optionsEn: Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa.
Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反力位置與局部約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reaction location and local restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反力位置與局部約束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reaction location and local restraint"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone.
quiz.explanation: 記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反力位置與局部約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reaction location and local restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區；若出現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反力位置與局部約束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reaction location and local restraint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變
optionsEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
quiz.explanation: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「持載位移與時間效應」與「荷重校正與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hold movement and time effects" and "Load calibration and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 持載位移與時間效應：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hold movement and time effects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「持載位移與時間效應」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hold movement and time effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 恆定荷重下位移增加可能來自黏結蠕變，也可能是油壓漂移或支承沉陷。必須同時記錄實際荷重，才能區分持載滑移與荷重仍在增加；單一時間點的位移不能代表速率，更不能直接外推長期壽命。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準；若出現油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「持載位移與時間效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Movement under constant load can reflect bond creep, pressure drift or support settlement. Record actual force simultaneously to distinguish hold slip from continued loading. One displacement point establishes neither a rate nor a reliable extrapolation of long-term service behaviour. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold. If a slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hold movement and time effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hold movement and time effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 持載位移與時間效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hold movement and time effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「持載位移與時間效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hold movement and time effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 持載位移與時間效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hold movement and time effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「持載位移與時間效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hold movement and time effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 壓力乘活塞面積只是理想液壓力，密封摩擦、有效面積與回程方向會造成偏差。荷重元可提供獨立比較，但也需校正與對中；不確定度應和試體離散分開報告，避免把設備偏差歸因於地質變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向；若出現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「荷重校正與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 荷重校正與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load calibration and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「荷重校正與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load calibration and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「荷重校正與不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load calibration and uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。
岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent.
Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 荷重校正與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load calibration and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「荷重校正與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load calibration and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
