Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「荷重校正與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load calibration and uncertainty"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。
千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions.
Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
quiz.explanation: 用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 荷重校正與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load calibration and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「荷重校正與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load calibration and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向；若出現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷重校正與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load calibration and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」與「試驗代表性與補強決策」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion loss and local weak sections" and "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。直徑減少對面積有平方影響，局部坑蝕又會加劇應力集中；用平均重量損失推估剩餘承載，需要確認最小截面及腐蝕分布是否已被量到。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化；若出現局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. Diameter loss changes area quadratically, and pits add stress concentration. Inferring capacity from mean mass loss requires evidence that the minimum section and corrosion distribution have actually been characterized. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrosion loss and local weak sections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面
knowledge.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections
knowledge.text: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。直徑減少對面積有平方影響，局部坑蝕又會加劇應力集中；用平均重量損失推估剩餘承載，需要確認最小截面及腐蝕分布是否已被量到。
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. Diameter loss changes area quadratically, and pits add stress concentration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion loss and local weak sections" is correct?
options: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。
平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
optionsEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform.
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
quiz.explanation: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長

Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Representativeness and reinforcement decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗代表性與補強決策」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗代表性與補強決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions"?
options: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變
optionsEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
quiz.explanation: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Representativeness and reinforcement decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗代表性與補強決策」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表；若出現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗代表性與補強決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。
岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented.
Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
quiz.explanation: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架
courses.summary: 本課以把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統為主線，從榀距與分擔寬度與軸力偏心與彎矩建立系統邊界，再把接頭滑移與力線連續、複合噴層與變形相容連到隱蔽工程與交接追溯。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system. It begins with Rib spacing and tributary width and Axial eccentricity and bending, links Joint slip and force continuity and Composite shotcrete and compatibility, and ends with Concealed works and handover traceability. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統
courses.focusEn: Combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查榀距與分擔寬度：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN；再獨立檢查軸力偏心與彎矩：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。間距由 0.75 增為 1.0 m，在壓力 0.08 MPa、半徑 4 m 的理想環模型下，單榀環力由 240 增為 320 kN；噴層跨距效應另算。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 將用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Rib spacing and tributary width: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. Independently check Axial eccentricity and bending: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. Increasing spacing from 0.75 to 1.0 m at pressure 0.08 MPa and radius 4 m raises ideal rib thrust from 240 to 320 kN; shotcrete span effects require separate assessment. The two results are not a complete design because a rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Use compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「榀距與分擔寬度」與「軸力偏心與彎矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rib spacing and tributary width" and "Axial eccentricity and bending": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「榀距與分擔寬度」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib spacing and tributary width” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。完整圓環均壓可估環向軸力，但局部鬆動塊會引入彎矩；應分開平均地層壓力與集中作用，不能只以環力判斷全部構件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度；若出現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「榀距與分擔寬度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. Uniform pressure on an intact ring estimates hoop thrust, but loose blocks introduce bending. Separate average ground pressure from concentrated actions rather than treating ring thrust as the complete member demand. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rib spacing and tributary width” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「榀距與分擔寬度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rib spacing and tributary width”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 榀距與分擔寬度
knowledge.text: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。完整圓環均壓可估環向軸力，但局部鬆動塊會引入彎矩；應分開平均地層壓力與集中作用，不能只以環力判斷全部構件。
knowledge.textEn: Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. Uniform pressure on an intact ring estimates hoop thrust, but loose blocks introduce bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「榀距與分擔寬度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rib spacing and tributary width" is correct?
options: 只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距
相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。
拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩
optionsEn: Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete.
A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments
quiz.explanation: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「榀距與分擔寬度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib spacing and tributary width” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「榀距與分擔寬度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「榀距與分擔寬度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib spacing and tributary width” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「榀距與分擔寬度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rib spacing and tributary width"?
options: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
位移只有幾毫米就可以永遠忽略二階效應
optionsEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A few millimetres of movement always makes second-order effects negligible
quiz.explanation: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「榀距與分擔寬度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib spacing and tributary width” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度；若出現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「榀距與分擔寬度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rib spacing and tributary width" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。
拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩

steps.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial eccentricity and bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸力偏心與彎矩」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axial eccentricity and bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼拱與岩面接觸不均會使壓力偏離截面中心，名義壓縮構件因而同時彎曲。接頭與基腳的旋轉也會移動作用線，不能用截面積增加掩蓋偏心；應先辨識接觸點及變形後幾何，再決定是否需二階分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差；若出現只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸力偏心與彎矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven ground contact moves force away from the section centre and bends a nominal compression member. Joint and foot rotation also move the load line. Increasing area does not resolve eccentricity; identify contact locations and deformed geometry before deciding on second-order analysis. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Axial eccentricity and bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸力偏心與彎矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Axial eccentricity and bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Uneven ground contact moves force away from the section centre and bends a nominal compression member. Joint and foot rotation also move the load line.

knowledge.text: 誤解：拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸力偏心與彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Axial eccentricity and bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軸力偏心與彎矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Axial eccentricity and bending", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。
螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接
噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm.
Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial eccentricity and bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸力偏心與彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Axial eccentricity and bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軸力偏心與彎矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Axial eccentricity and bending"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。
外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains.
Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas
quiz.explanation: 對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Axial eccentricity and bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軸力偏心與彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Axial eccentricity and bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差；若出現只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軸力偏心與彎矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Axial eccentricity and bending" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐
只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction
Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling.
quiz.explanation: 只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」與「格柵桁架與節點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weak-axis buckling and effective length" and "Lattice trusses and nodes": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weak-axis buckling and effective length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weak-axis buckling and effective length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱面內有支承不代表拱面外也被約束，縱向連繫的位置決定弱軸有效長度。Euler 公式只適用理想彈性直柱，彎曲拱架還有初始缺陷和非均勻受力；它適合揭示連繫缺失的敏感度，不應當成實際承載保證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察查核連繫間距、接頭固定度及拱面外偏移量；若出現缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In-plane restraint does not establish out-of-plane restraint; longitudinal ties control weak-axis effective length. Euler's ideal straight-column model omits curved geometry, imperfections and nonuniform force. It reveals sensitivity to missing ties rather than guaranteeing actual rib resistance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check tie spacing, connection restraint and out-of-plane offsets. If one missing tie bay doubles effective length and quarters ideal buckling force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weak-axis buckling and effective length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weak-axis buckling and effective length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度
knowledge.text: 拱面內有支承不代表拱面外也被約束，縱向連繫的位置決定弱軸有效長度。Euler 公式只適用理想彈性直柱，彎曲拱架還有初始缺陷和非均勻受力；它適合揭示連繫缺失的敏感度，不應當成實際承載保證。
knowledge.textEn: In-plane restraint does not establish out-of-plane restraint; longitudinal ties control weak-axis effective length. Euler's ideal straight-column model omits curved geometry, imperfections and nonuniform force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weak-axis buckling and effective length" is correct?
options: 拱面內有支承不代表拱面外也被約束，縱向連繫的位置決定弱軸有效長度。
有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐
主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同
optionsEn: In-plane restraint does not establish out-of-plane restraint; longitudinal ties control weak-axis effective length.
Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction
Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry
quiz.explanation: 拱面內有支承不代表拱面外也被約束，縱向連繫的位置決定弱軸有效長度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In-plane restraint does not establish out-of-plane restraint; longitudinal ties control weak-axis effective length. The other options are common misconceptions.

Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas
Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 格柵桁架與節點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lattice trusses and nodes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「格柵桁架與節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lattice trusses and nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「格柵桁架與節點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lattice trusses and nodes"?
options: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距
optionsEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
quiz.explanation: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 格柵桁架與節點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lattice trusses and nodes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「格柵桁架與節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lattice trusses and nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性；若出現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「格柵桁架與節點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lattice trusses and nodes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。
螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption.
Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
quiz.explanation: 節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭滑移與力線連續」與「基腳承載與沉陷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint slip and force continuity" and "Foot bearing and settlement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭滑移與力線連續」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint slip and force continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。螺栓鎖緊不是連續剛接的證明，滑移後作用線還會偏移；應把接頭剛度與允許變形列入整榀模型，而非把接頭當成無長度連線。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變；若出現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭滑移與力線連續」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. Tight bolts do not prove rigid continuity, and slip moves the load line. Include joint stiffness and deformation in the rib model rather than an ideal zero-length connection. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint slip and force continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭滑移與力線連續」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint slip and force continuity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續
knowledge.text: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。螺栓鎖緊不是連續剛接的證明，滑移後作用線還會偏移；應把接頭剛度與允許變形列入整榀模型，而非把接頭當成無長度連線。
knowledge.textEn: Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. Tight bolts do not prove rigid continuity, and slip moves the load line.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭滑移與力線連續」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint slip and force continuity" is correct?
options: 螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接
鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳
分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。
optionsEn: Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet
Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times.
quiz.explanation: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭滑移與力線連續」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint slip and force continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭滑移與力線連續」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint slip and force continuity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。
位移只有幾毫米就可以永遠忽略二階效應
材料證書齊全就等於現地鋼拱系統已驗證
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm.
A few millimetres of movement always makes second-order effects negligible
Complete material certificates prove the installed rib system has been verified
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭滑移與力線連續」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint slip and force continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭滑移與力線連續」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint slip and force continuity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。
拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides.
A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments
quiz.explanation: 量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接頭滑移與力線連續」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint slip and force continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變；若出現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
