quiz.explanation: 累積超進尺吃掉搭接，造成兩輪之間的局部弱帶。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulated excess advance consumes overlap and leaves a weak band between umbrellas. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」與「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bore inclination and end offset" and "Annular grout volume and voids": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鑽孔傾角與端部偏位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bore inclination and end offset: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bore inclination and end offset” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微小角度偏差在長孔末端會形成顯著位移，角度與坡度百分比混用更會造成系統錯誤。管棚需要符合空間扇形幾何而非只控制單一平面，端部高低和左右偏差都會改變拱頂覆蓋及與下一輪的交接。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸；若出現同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small angular errors create substantial distal offsets, while confusing angle with percent grade creates systematic bias. An umbrella is a three-dimensional fan rather than a single-plane alignment. Both vertical and lateral offsets alter crown coverage and the next overlap interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records. If small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bore inclination and end offset” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一度角度誤差在長管棚中永遠可以忽略」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bore inclination and end offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鑽孔傾角與端部偏位
knowledge.text: 微小角度偏差在長孔末端會形成顯著位移，角度與坡度百分比混用更會造成系統錯誤。管棚需要符合空間扇形幾何而非只控制單一平面，端部高低和左右偏差都會改變拱頂覆蓋及與下一輪的交接。
knowledge.textEn: Small angular errors create substantial distal offsets, while confusing angle with percent grade creates systematic bias. An umbrella is a three-dimensional fan rather than a single-plane alignment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一度角度誤差在長管棚中永遠可以忽略 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bore inclination and end offset" is correct?
options: 一度角度誤差在長管棚中永遠可以忽略
實際注量越大就一定代表管周填充越完整
微小角度偏差在長孔末端會形成顯著位移，角度與坡度百分比混用更會造成系統錯誤。
optionsEn: A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella
Greater delivered grout volume always means more complete annular filling
Small angular errors create substantial distal offsets, while confusing angle with percent grade creates systematic bias.
quiz.explanation: 微小角度偏差在長孔末端會形成顯著位移，角度與坡度百分比混用更會造成系統錯誤。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small angular errors create substantial distal offsets, while confusing angle with percent grade creates systematic bias. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鑽孔傾角與端部偏位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bore inclination and end offset: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bore inclination and end offset” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bore inclination and end offset", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m。
感測器讀值沒變就能證明管棚位置完全沒變
新襯砌完成外觀就代表管棚全部荷載已轉移
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m.
Unchanged sensor readings prove that the umbrella position has not moved
A completed lining appearance proves every umbrella load has transferred
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: endOffset=L*tan(error)=12 m*tan(1 deg)=0.209 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鑽孔傾角與端部偏位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bore inclination and end offset: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bore inclination and end offset” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bore inclination and end offset"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸。
鋼管每米重量相同就代表抗彎剛度相同
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records.
Equal steel-pipe mass per metre guarantees equal bending stiffness
quiz.explanation: 以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鑽孔傾角與端部偏位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bore inclination and end offset: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bore inclination and end offset” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸；若出現同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一度角度誤差在長管棚中永遠可以忽略」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以孔內測斜或核准導向資料重建三維孔軸，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconstruct three-dimensional bore axes from inclinometry or approved guidance records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鑽孔傾角與端部偏位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bore inclination and end offset" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
實際注量越大就一定代表管周填充越完整
同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Greater delivered grout volume always means more complete annular filling
Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone.
quiz.explanation: 同方向小偏差累積，使遠端管棚整體偏離需要支護區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Small consistent errors move the entire distal umbrella outside the support zone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環狀灌漿體積與空隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Annular grout volume and voids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annular grout volume and voids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壁和鋼管間的環隙需要足夠接觸傳力，注入量卻可能流入裂隙而非填滿環空。幾何體積只能作收支基線，土體擾動、孔徑擴大及漏失都會改變實際需要；過量和不足都應先辨認來源，不能直接當作品質好壞。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據；若出現漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The annulus must transfer contact forces, yet delivered grout may enter fractures instead of filling it. Geometric volume is a baseline altered by disturbance, enlargement and loss. Diagnose both excess and shortage rather than interpreting either directly as good or poor quality. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence. If grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Annular grout volume and voids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs boreDiameter=0.17 m, pipeDiameter=0.114 m, length=12 m; Vann=pi*(0.17^2-0.114^2)/4*12=0.150 m3。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Annular grout volume and voids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環狀灌漿體積與空隙
knowledge.text: 孔壁和鋼管間的環隙需要足夠接觸傳力，注入量卻可能流入裂隙而非填滿環空。幾何體積只能作收支基線，土體擾動、孔徑擴大及漏失都會改變實際需要；過量和不足都應先辨認來源，不能直接當作品質好壞。
knowledge.textEn: The annulus must transfer contact forces, yet delivered grout may enter fractures instead of filling it. Geometric volume is a baseline altered by disturbance, enlargement and loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：實際注量越大就一定代表管周填充越完整 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater delivered grout volume always means more complete annular filling Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Annular grout volume and voids" is correct?
options: 孔壁和鋼管間的環隙需要足夠接觸傳力，注入量卻可能流入裂隙而非填滿環空。
實際注量越大就一定代表管周填充越完整
土體彈簧可以在管件離開地層時繼續拉住它
optionsEn: The annulus must transfer contact forces, yet delivered grout may enter fractures instead of filling it.
Greater delivered grout volume always means more complete annular filling
Ground springs continue pulling a pipe after it separates from the soil
quiz.explanation: 孔壁和鋼管間的環隙需要足夠接觸傳力，注入量卻可能流入裂隙而非填滿環空。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The annulus must transfer contact forces, yet delivered grout may enter fractures instead of filling it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環狀灌漿體積與空隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annular grout volume and voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Annular grout volume and voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs boreDiameter=0.17 m, pipeDiameter=0.114 m, length=12 m; Vann=pi*(0.17^2-0.114^2)/4*12=0.150 m3。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs boreDiameter=0.17 m, pipeDiameter=0.114 m, length=12 m; Vann=pi*(0.17^2-0.114^2)/4*12=0.150 m3. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inputs boreDiameter=0.17 m, pipeDiameter=0.114 m, length=12 m; Vann=pi*(0.17^2-0.114^2)/4*12=0.150 m3。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 環狀灌漿體積與空隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Annular grout volume and voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Annular grout volume and voids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Annular grout volume and voids"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
孔口間距合格便能證明整段管棚連續
比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Passing collar spacing proves continuity throughout the umbrella length
Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence.
quiz.explanation: 比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環狀灌漿體積與空隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Annular grout volume and voids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Annular grout volume and voids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據；若出現漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實際注量越大就一定代表管周填充越完整」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater delivered grout volume always means more complete annular filling" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較幾何環空、實際注入量及可用回流或影像證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare geometric annulus, delivered volume and available return or imaging evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環狀灌漿體積與空隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Annular grout volume and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漿液流向裂隙但管周仍空，名義注量合格卻缺乏接觸。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
土體彈簧可以在管件離開地層時繼續拉住它
optionsEn: Grout escapes into fractures while a hollow annulus remains despite adequate nominal volume.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Ground springs continue pulling a pipe after it separates from the soil

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地層彈簧與支承剛度」與「撓度量測與儀器基準」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground springs and restraint stiffness" and "Deflection measurements and references": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地層彈簧與支承剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground springs and restraint stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地層彈簧與支承剛度」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground springs and restraint stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土管接觸可用分布彈簧作初步理想化，但土體只能在接觸時提供壓縮反力。若模型容許土體承拉，會在人為懸空區產生不存在的支承；彈簧係數還須配合單位長度或面積定義，否則量綱正確的數字也會套錯位置。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用管件撓度形狀與接觸證據比較壓縮限定彈簧模型；若出現假想拉力彈簧支住空腔，低估鋼管彎矩與位移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地層彈簧與支承剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distributed springs can approximate soil-pipe contact, but ground supplies compression only when contact exists. Tension-capable springs invent support across gaps. Spring coefficients must also match their per-length or per-area definition; otherwise apparently valid units conceal a wrongly assigned restraint. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare deflection profiles and contact evidence with compression-only spring models. If artificial tensile springs support voids and underpredict pipe moments and movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ground springs and restraint stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：reactionPerLength=k*deflection=10000 kN/m2*0.005 m=50 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPerLength=k*deflection=10000 kN/m2*0.005 m=50 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土體彈簧可以在管件離開地層時繼續拉住它」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ground springs continue pulling a pipe after it separates from the soil" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地層彈簧與支承剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 地層彈簧與支承剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground springs and restraint stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地層彈簧與支承剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground springs and restraint stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：reactionPerLength=k*deflection=10000 kN/m2*0.005 m=50 kN/m。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPerLength=k*deflection=10000 kN/m2*0.005 m=50 kN/m. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用管件撓度形狀與接觸證據比較壓縮限定彈簧模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare deflection profiles and contact evidence with compression-only spring models.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 地層彈簧與支承剛度：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground springs and restraint stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用管件撓度形狀與接觸證據比較壓縮限定彈簧模型。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「假想拉力彈簧支住空腔，低估鋼管彎矩與位移」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare deflection profiles and contact evidence with compression-only spring models. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Artificial tensile springs support voids and underpredict pipe moments and movement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare deflection profiles and contact evidence with compression-only spring models. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If artificial tensile springs support voids and underpredict pipe moments and movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假想拉力彈簧支住空腔，低估鋼管彎矩與位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 地層彈簧與支承剛度：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地層彈簧與支承剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground springs and restraint stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假想拉力彈簧支住空腔，低估鋼管彎矩與位移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用管件撓度形狀與接觸證據比較壓縮限定彈簧模型，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Artificial tensile springs support voids and underpredict pipe moments and movement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare deflection profiles and contact evidence with compression-only spring models to discriminate the cause. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If artificial tensile springs support voids and underpredict pipe moments and movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「土體彈簧可以在管件離開地層時繼續拉住它」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deflection measurements and references” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測到的管棚位移包含整體沉陷、局部彎曲和儀器支點移動，不應直接當作梁的純撓度。多點曲線比單一端點更能辨認跨距與反力改變，控制點須位於可證明穩定的位置，並保留開挖前原始讀值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線；若出現隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「撓度量測與儀器基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured movement includes global settlement, local bending and instrument-support motion rather than pure beam deflection. Multipoint profiles better distinguish span and reaction changes than one endpoint. Use demonstrably stable references and preserve readings taken before excavation begins. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles. If a datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deflection measurements and references” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 撓度量測與儀器基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deflection measurements and references: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「撓度量測與儀器基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deflection measurements and references” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「撓度量測與儀器基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deflection measurements and references", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm。
管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力
孔口間距合格便能證明整段管棚連續
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm.
A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support
Passing collar spacing proves continuity throughout the umbrella length
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: relativeDeflection=midpointMovement-supportMean=12 mm-4 mm=8 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 撓度量測與儀器基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deflection measurements and references: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「撓度量測與儀器基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deflection measurements and references” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「撓度量測與儀器基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deflection measurements and references"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線。
一度角度誤差在長管棚中永遠可以忽略
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles.
A one-degree error can always be ignored in a long umbrella
quiz.explanation: 以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 撓度量測與儀器基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deflection measurements and references: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「撓度量測與儀器基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deflection measurements and references” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線；若出現隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器讀值沒變就能證明管棚位置完全沒變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged sensor readings prove that the umbrella position has not moved" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「撓度量測與儀器基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deflection measurements and references" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接頭外徑相同就代表剛度與完整母管一致
隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal outside diameter makes a connection as stiff as the parent pipe
A datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement.
quiz.explanation: 隨支護一起移動的基準讓曲線看似穩定而漏掉沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A datum moving with support produces a calm curve while concealing settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭轉角與局部弱段」與「支護界面與撤除判斷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint rotation and local weak segments" and "Support interfaces and transfer decisions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭轉角與局部弱段：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint rotation and local weak segments: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭轉角與局部弱段」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint rotation and local weak segments” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管件接頭的彎曲剛度可能小於連續鋼管，轉角會集中在螺紋或套管附近。用完整截面慣性矩跨過接頭可能低估位移，注漿後也不必然恢復母材連續性；應把接頭位置和最大彎矩區域一起檢查，避免薄弱段重疊。單一測段的位移差除測距僅為弦傾角，接頭相對轉角須比較兩側斜率並扣除共同剛體轉動。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接頭兩側相對轉角並記錄接頭所處支承區段；若出現接頭落在最大彎曲區產生集中轉角並破壞周邊接觸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭轉角與局部弱段」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connections can be more flexible than continuous pipe, concentrating rotation near threads or sleeves. Extending parent-section inertia through a joint can underpredict movement, and grouting need not restore full continuity. Compare connection positions with high-moment regions to identify coincident weaknesses. Displacement difference over one gauge gives chord rotation only; joint rotation requires the difference of slopes on both sides with common rigid-body rotation removed. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure relative rotation across joints and record their supporting ground zones. If a joint in the peak-bending zone concentrates rotation and damages surrounding contact, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint rotation and local weak segments” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：apparentChordRotation=offsetDifference/gaugeLength=2 mm/500 mm=0.004 rad; one gauge only, not relative joint rotation。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: apparentChordRotation=offsetDifference/gaugeLength=2 mm/500 mm=0.004 rad; one gauge only, not relative joint rotation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭外徑相同就代表剛度與完整母管一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal outside diameter makes a connection as stiff as the parent pipe" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭轉角與局部弱段」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint rotation and local weak segments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭轉角與局部弱段
knowledge.titleEn: Joint rotation and local weak segments
knowledge.text: 管件接頭的彎曲剛度可能小於連續鋼管，轉角會集中在螺紋或套管附近。用完整截面慣性矩跨過接頭可能低估位移，注漿後也不必然恢復母材連續性；應把接頭位置和最大彎矩區域一起檢查，避免薄弱段重疊。
knowledge.textEn: Connections can be more flexible than continuous pipe, concentrating rotation near threads or sleeves. Extending parent-section inertia through a joint can underpredict movement, and grouting need not restore full continuity.

knowledge.text: 誤解：接頭外徑相同就代表剛度與完整母管一致 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal outside diameter makes a connection as stiff as the parent pipe Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭轉角與局部弱段」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint rotation and local weak segments" is correct?
options: 管件接頭的彎曲剛度可能小於連續鋼管，轉角會集中在螺紋或套管附近。
接頭外徑相同就代表剛度與完整母管一致
新襯砌完成外觀就代表管棚全部荷載已轉移

Equal outside diameter makes a connection as stiff as the parent pipe
A completed lining appearance proves every umbrella load has transferred

steps.title: 接頭轉角與局部弱段：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 量測接頭兩側相對轉角並記錄接頭所處支承區段。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭落在最大彎曲區產生集中轉角並破壞周邊接觸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure relative rotation across joints and record their supporting ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A joint in the peak-bending zone concentrates rotation and damages surrounding contact. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure relative rotation across joints and record their supporting ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a joint in the peak-bending zone concentrates rotation and damages surrounding contact, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭落在最大彎曲區產生集中轉角並破壞周邊接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 接頭落在最大彎曲區產生集中轉角並破壞周邊接觸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測接頭兩側相對轉角並記錄接頭所處支承區段，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A joint in the peak-bending zone concentrates rotation and damages surrounding contact. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure relative rotation across joints and record their supporting ground zones to discriminate the cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal outside diameter makes a connection as stiff as the parent pipe" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 支護界面與撤除判斷：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「支護界面與撤除判斷」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support interfaces and transfer decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管棚通常是施工階段系統的一部分，後續初支與閉合環接替荷載時仍有變形歷史。把新襯砌加入模型並不能自動清除管棚受力，未達接觸或硬化條件便假定轉移完成，會低估臨時構件持續承載與周圍鬆動。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查；若出現新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護界面與撤除判斷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An umbrella belongs to a staged system whose load is progressively shared with initial support and a closed ring. Adding lining to a model does not erase existing pipe force. Assuming transfer before contact or hardening understates continued temporary-member demand and surrounding loosening. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together. If assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support interfaces and transfer decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：transferRatio=measuredNewSupportLoad/assumedTotal=180 kN/300 kN=0.60。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: transferRatio=measuredNewSupportLoad/assumedTotal=180 kN/300 kN=0.60.

steps.title: 支護界面與撤除判斷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support interfaces and transfer decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護界面與撤除判斷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support interfaces and transfer decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support interfaces and transfer decisions"?

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Ground springs continue pulling a pipe after it separates from the soil

steps.title: 支護界面與撤除判斷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support interfaces and transfer decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護界面與撤除判斷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support interfaces and transfer decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查；若出現新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新襯砌完成外觀就代表管棚全部荷載已轉移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A completed lining appearance proves every umbrella load has transferred" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把初支齡期、接觸完成、管棚應變與閉合位置共同審查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to review support age, completed contact, umbrella strain and ring-closure position together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護界面與撤除判斷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support interfaces and transfer decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口。
管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Assumed unloading before new support engages creates an unrecognized staged-load gap.
A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support
quiz.explanation: 新支護尚未參與就假定卸載，造成施工階段荷載缺口。 需以量測區分可能原因。

courses.title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿
courses.summary: 本課以以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強為主線，從掌子面擠出與地層核心與補強密度與非均勻分擔建立系統邊界，再把開挖進尺與保留長度、施工時間與黏結成熟連到面補強與周邊支護協調。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length. It begins with Face extrusion and ground core and Reinforcement density and unequal sharing, links Advance and retained reinforcement and Construction time and bond maturity, and ends with Face reinforcement and peripheral support. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強
courses.focusEn: Control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查掌子面擠出與地層核心：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent；再獨立檢查補強密度與非均勻分擔：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。同一 6000 mm 參考長度內，假想擠出由 12 增為 18 mm，平均變形比由 0.2% 增為 0.3%；不是每支筋的相同應變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 將比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face extrusion and ground core: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Independently check Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Over a 6000 mm reference length, extrusion rising from 12 to 18 mm changes the mean deformation ratio from 0.2% to 0.3%; this is not identical strain in every bar. The two results are not a complete design because fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Use compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掌子面擠出與地層核心」與「補強密度與非均勻分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Face extrusion and ground core" and "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face extrusion and ground core” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「掌子面擠出與地層核心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. Face movement includes unloading and time effects rather than each bar's extension. Define reference length and an undisturbed datum before comparing extrusion increments at different excavation advances. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face extrusion and ground core” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face extrusion and ground core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心
knowledge.text: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「補強密度與非均勻分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

quiz.question: 要驗證「補強密度與非均勻分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing"?
