quiz.explanation: 泥膜讓摩擦與黏結降低，仰拱形成局部滑移縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mud film reduces friction and bond and creates a localized sliding joint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基底擾動與承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base disturbance and bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基底擾動與承壓」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base disturbance and bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖底部可能因積水、車輛或卸載而擾動，名義岩盤不一定仍有原來剛度。仰拱與基底需保持預期接觸，空隙會把連續反力變成局部支點；以平均壓力檢核時仍須另查最小接觸面積及可壓縮夾層。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據；若出現軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基底擾動與承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water, traffic and unloading disturb the base, so nominal rock need not retain its original stiffness. Gaps convert distributed support into local bearings. Mean-pressure checks therefore need separate evidence for minimum contact and compressible seams rather than assuming an undisturbed continuous foundation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. If a compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base disturbance and bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基底擾動與承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base disturbance and bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基底擾動與承壓
knowledge.text: 開挖底部可能因積水、車輛或卸載而擾動，名義岩盤不一定仍有原來剛度。仰拱與基底需保持預期接觸，空隙會把連續反力變成局部支點；以平均壓力檢核時仍須另查最小接觸面積及可壓縮夾層。
knowledge.textEn: Water, traffic and unloading disturb the base, so nominal rock need not retain its original stiffness. Gaps convert distributed support into local bearings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基底擾動與承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base disturbance and bearing" is correct?
options: 基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷
開挖底部可能因積水、車輛或卸載而擾動，名義岩盤不一定仍有原來剛度。
閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同
optionsEn: A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement
Water, traffic and unloading disturb the base, so nominal rock need not retain its original stiffness.
Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects
quiz.explanation: 開挖底部可能因積水、車輛或卸載而擾動，名義岩盤不一定仍有原來剛度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water, traffic and unloading disturb the base, so nominal rock need not retain its original stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基底擾動與承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base disturbance and bearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基底擾動與承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base disturbance and bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基底擾動與承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base disturbance and bearing", which statement holds?
options: 隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓
接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
原創教學假設：q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa。
optionsEn: A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert
Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
Original teaching assumptions: q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: q=load/contactArea=1200 kN/6 m2=200 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基底擾動與承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base disturbance and bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基底擾動與承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base disturbance and bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基底擾動與承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base disturbance and bearing"?
options: 核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合
optionsEn: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
quiz.explanation: 核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基底擾動與承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base disturbance and bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基底擾動與承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base disturbance and bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據；若出現軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對基底地質、水軟化區及仰拱下接觸證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check base geology, water-softened zones and evidence of invert contact to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基底擾動與承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base disturbance and bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭。
閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints.
Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects
quiz.explanation: 軟弱夾層壓密使仰拱差異沉陷並拉開接頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A compressible seam settles unevenly and opens invert joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合距離與時間效應」與「施工車輛與早齡載入」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closure distance and time effects" and "Construction traffic and early loading": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合距離與時間效應：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure distance and time effects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合距離與時間效應」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure distance and time effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掌子面到閉合位置的距離控制地層處於開口環狀態的長度，但相同距離在不同進尺速度下代表不同等待時間。地層有時效時，距離與時間都影響收斂；不能將一個工程的閉合距離直接當作所有地層的通用標準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸；若出現進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合距離與時間效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Face-to-closure distance controls the length remaining as an open ring, but equal distances imply different waiting times at different advance rates. Time-dependent ground requires both measures. A closure distance from one project is not a universal criterion for every ground condition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. If slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure distance and time effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合距離與時間效應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closure distance and time effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉合距離與時間效應
knowledge.text: 掌子面到閉合位置的距離控制地層處於開口環狀態的長度，但相同距離在不同進尺速度下代表不同等待時間。地層有時效時，距離與時間都影響收斂；不能將一個工程的閉合距離直接當作所有地層的通用標準。
knowledge.textEn: Face-to-closure distance controls the length remaining as an open ring, but equal distances imply different waiting times at different advance rates. Time-dependent ground requires both measures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閉合距離與時間效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure distance and time effects" is correct?
options: 閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同
仰拱外觀已硬化就能承受任何施工車輛
掌子面到閉合位置的距離控制地層處於開口環狀態的長度，但相同距離在不同進尺速度下代表不同等待時間。
optionsEn: Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects
An apparently hard invert can carry any construction vehicle
Face-to-closure distance controls the length remaining as an open ring, but equal distances imply different waiting times at different advance rates.
quiz.explanation: 掌子面到閉合位置的距離控制地層處於開口環狀態的長度，但相同距離在不同進尺速度下代表不同等待時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Face-to-closure distance controls the length remaining as an open ring, but equal distances imply different waiting times at different advance rates. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閉合距離與時間效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure distance and time effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合距離與時間效應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure distance and time effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閉合距離與時間效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure distance and time effects", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day。
閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定
隧道路面以下的混凝土都可以視為非結構填充
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day.
A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability
All concrete beneath a tunnel pavement can be treated as nonstructural fill
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: waitingTime=distance/rate=12 m/(3 m/day)=4 day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閉合距離與時間效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure distance and time effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合距離與時間效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure distance and time effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閉合距離與時間效應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure distance and time effects"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸。
仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline.
Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
quiz.explanation: 將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 閉合距離與時間效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure distance and time effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合距離與時間效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure distance and time effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸；若出現進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將閉合位置、進尺速度及收斂速率放在共同時間軸，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align closure location, advance rate and convergence rate on a common timeline to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閉合距離與時間效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure distance and time effects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
仰拱外觀已硬化就能承受任何施工車輛
進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An apparently hard invert can carry any construction vehicle
Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance.
quiz.explanation: 進尺變慢但距離不變，等待時間增加而收斂持續累積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slower advance increases waiting time and accumulated convergence at unchanged distance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工車輛與早齡載入：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction traffic and early loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工車輛與早齡載入」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction traffic and early loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 仰拱完成後可能很快承受施工車輛，輪載屬局部作用而非均勻環壓。早齡混凝土、回填保護層與基底一起決定應力分散，單靠成熟混凝土強度不能代表當天狀態；應將短期交通荷載列入獨立階段。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據；若出現保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工車輛與早齡載入」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Construction traffic may reach an invert soon after casting, applying local wheel actions rather than uniform ring pressure. Young concrete, cover fill and ground control load spread. Mature strength does not represent the day of loading, so treat traffic as a separate temporary stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day. If insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction traffic and early loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「仰拱外觀已硬化就能承受任何施工車輛」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An apparently hard invert can carry any construction vehicle" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工車輛與早齡載入」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction traffic and early loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Construction traffic may reach an invert soon after casting, applying local wheel actions rather than uniform ring pressure. Young concrete, cover fill and ground control load spread.

steps.title: 施工車輛與早齡載入：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction traffic and early loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工車輛與早齡載入」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction traffic and early loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工車輛與早齡載入」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction traffic and early loading", which statement holds?
options: 接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
原創教學假設：contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa。
混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合
optionsEn: Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
Original teaching assumptions: contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa.
Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: contactPressure=wheelLoad/contactArea=60 kN/0.12 m2=500 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工車輛與早齡載入：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction traffic and early loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工車輛與早齡載入」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction traffic and early loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工車輛與早齡載入」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction traffic and early loading"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
接頭面積夠大就可以忽略界面污染
比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Large joint area permits interface contamination to be ignored
Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day.
quiz.explanation: 比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工車輛與早齡載入：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction traffic and early loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工車輛與早齡載入」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction traffic and early loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據；若出現保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「仰拱外觀已硬化就能承受任何施工車輛」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An apparently hard invert can carry any construction vehicle" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較車輛荷載、保護層厚度與當日混凝土成熟證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare vehicle loads and cover depth with concrete maturity on the loading day to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工車輛與早齡載入」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction traffic and early loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓
optionsEn: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert
quiz.explanation: 保護層不足使局部早齡裂損被後續回填遮住。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient cover creates early local cracks that later fill conceals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水浮力與排水狀態」與「收斂閉合與儀器對時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Groundwater uplift and drainage state" and "Convergence closure and synchronization": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水浮力與排水狀態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater uplift and drainage state: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水浮力與排水狀態」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater uplift and drainage state” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底部水頭可向上作用，排水可靠性決定是否能維持設計假設。自重、結構連接與地層反力必須在同一自由體中比較，不能把同一份摩擦或覆重重複計入；排水堵塞情境通常需要另建荷載組合。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移；若出現排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水浮力與排水狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water head acts upward and drainage reliability determines whether the assumed condition persists. Compare weight, connections and ground reactions in one free body without double-counting friction or overburden. A blocked-drain state generally needs its own loading combination and contact assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare base pressure, collection flow and vertical invert movement simultaneously. If blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater uplift and drainage state” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=5 m, A=10 m2; uplift=rho*g*h*A=1000*9.81*5*10=490500 N=490.5 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=5 m, A=10 m2; uplift=rho*g*h*A=1000*9.81*5*10=490500 N=490.5 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水浮力與排水狀態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater uplift and drainage state”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水浮力與排水狀態
knowledge.text: 底部水頭可向上作用，排水可靠性決定是否能維持設計假設。自重、結構連接與地層反力必須在同一自由體中比較，不能把同一份摩擦或覆重重複計入；排水堵塞情境通常需要另建荷載組合。
knowledge.textEn: Water head acts upward and drainage reliability determines whether the assumed condition persists. Compare weight, connections and ground reactions in one free body without double-counting friction or overburden.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水浮力與排水狀態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Groundwater uplift and drainage state" is correct?
options: 隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓
底部水頭可向上作用，排水可靠性決定是否能維持設計假設。
閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定
optionsEn: A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert
Water head acts upward and drainage reliability determines whether the assumed condition persists.
A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability
quiz.explanation: 底部水頭可向上作用，排水可靠性決定是否能維持設計假設。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water head acts upward and drainage reliability determines whether the assumed condition persists. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水浮力與排水狀態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater uplift and drainage state: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地下水浮力與排水狀態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater uplift and drainage state” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare base pressure, collection flow and vertical invert movement simultaneously. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare base pressure, collection flow and vertical invert movement simultaneously. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 地下水浮力與排水狀態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater uplift and drainage state: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水浮力與排水狀態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater uplift and drainage state” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare base pressure, collection flow and vertical invert movement simultaneously to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移；若出現排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If blocked drainage raises base pressure and lifts an otherwise stable invert, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水堵塞讓底壓升高，原先穩定仰拱出現抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步查看底部水壓、集水流量及仰拱垂直位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare base pressure, collection flow and vertical invert movement simultaneously to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 收斂閉合與儀器對時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence closure and synchronization: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂閉合與儀器對時」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence closure and synchronization” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閉合前後的監測差異同時受開挖位置、溫度與儀器基準影響，不能只把曲線轉折歸因於仰拱生效。多方向收斂可分辨拱腳靠近、底部抬升和整體沉陷；讀值須保留量測弦長與基準更換歷史。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準；若出現更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂閉合與儀器對時」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Changes across closure also reflect face position, temperature and datums, not just invert engagement. Multidirectional convergence distinguishes foot movement, base heave and overall settlement. Preserve chord lengths and reference changes so a curve break is not automatically interpreted as structural improvement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time. If a reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence closure and synchronization” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: closureStrain=chordChange/originalChord=4 mm/8000 mm=0.0005.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂閉合與儀器對時」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Large joint area permits interface contamination to be ignored

steps.title: 收斂閉合與儀器對時：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence closure and synchronization: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂閉合與儀器對時」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence closure and synchronization” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收斂閉合與儀器對時」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence closure and synchronization"?

把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準。
閉合距離相同就代表所有施工時間效應相同
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time.
Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects
quiz.explanation: 把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收斂閉合與儀器對時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence closure and synchronization: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂閉合與儀器對時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence closure and synchronization” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準；若出現更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂閉合與儀器對時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence closure and synchronization" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability.
quiz.explanation: 更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接縫漏水與耐久」與「永久環與維護交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint leakage and durability" and "Permanent ring and maintenance handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接縫漏水與耐久：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫漏水與耐久」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint leakage and durability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。水量增加不一定表示裂縫擴大，也可能是水頭上升或排水改道；維修前應把接縫開口、化學環境與排水歷史配對，避免堵住唯一的洩壓通路。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄；若出現只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫漏水與耐久」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. Increasing flow may reflect head rise or rerouting rather than wider cracks. Pair opening, chemistry and drainage history before repair to avoid sealing the only pressure-relief path. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. If sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint leakage and durability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫漏水與耐久」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint leakage and durability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接縫漏水與耐久
knowledge.text: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。水量增加不一定表示裂縫擴大，也可能是水頭上升或排水改道；維修前應把接縫開口、化學環境與排水歷史配對，避免堵住唯一的洩壓通路。
knowledge.textEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. Increasing flow may reflect head rise or rerouting rather than wider cracks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫漏水與耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint leakage and durability" is correct?
options: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。
接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
隧道路面以下的混凝土都可以視為非結構填充
optionsEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces.
Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
All concrete beneath a tunnel pavement can be treated as nonstructural fill
quiz.explanation: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫漏水與耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫漏水與耐久」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint leakage and durability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接縫漏水與耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint leakage and durability", which statement holds?
options: 仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。
基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷
optionsEn: Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis.
A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接縫漏水與耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫漏水與耐久」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint leakage and durability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 永久環與維護交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.instructionEn: Structural invert, fill and pavement have different loading and drainage roles despite sharing the same section. Maintenance cuts into the structural invert interrupt ring transfer, particularly where layer levels are unclear. Handover must preserve layered geometry and identify structural interfaces requiring engineering review. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings. If treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permanent ring and maintenance handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「永久環與維護交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「永久環與維護交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Permanent ring and maintenance handover"?
options: 將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
隧道內沒有積水就代表仰拱底部沒有水壓
optionsEn: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A dry tunnel interior proves there is no water pressure below the invert
quiz.explanation: 將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 永久環與維護交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permanent ring and maintenance handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「永久環與維護交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permanent ring and maintenance handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖；若出現把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道路面以下的混凝土都可以視為非結構填充」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All concrete beneath a tunnel pavement can be treated as nonstructural fill" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「永久環與維護交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Permanent ring and maintenance handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環。
混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path.
Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
quiz.explanation: 把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 岩爆監測與卸壓支護
courses.summary: 本課以用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求為主線，從彈性能與釋放比例與拋出物動能與速度建立系統邊界，再把動態載入速率與試驗邊界、串聯力鏈與容量區分連到事件後剩餘行程與復核。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty. It begins with Elastic energy and releasable fraction and Ejected-rock energy and velocity, links Dynamic rate and test boundaries and Serial force paths and capacity distinctions, and ends with Post-event remaining stroke and requalification. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求
courses.focusEn: Assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
