workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查彈性能與釋放比例：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3；再獨立檢查拋出物動能與速度：Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ。線彈性應力由 100 增為 110 MPa、模數仍為 50 GPa，能量密度由 100 增為 121 kJ/m3；可釋放比例未知，不能全部當成拋石動能。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 將對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Elastic energy and releasable fraction: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Independently check Ejected-rock energy and velocity: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ. At a fixed 50 GPa modulus, stress rising from 100 to 110 MPa increases elastic energy density from 100 to 121 kJ/m3; an unknown releasable fraction prevents treating all of it as ejection energy. The two results are not a complete design because static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Use compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性能與釋放比例」與「拋出物動能與速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic energy and releasable fraction" and "Ejected-rock energy and velocity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic energy and releasable fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性能與釋放比例」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。線彈性能密度只是儲存量的理想估計，還需區分裂縫生成、摩擦、波動和拋出物能量；把全部體積乘能量密度直接當支護需求會忽略真正耦合路徑。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據；若出現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性能與釋放比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. Elastic density estimates storage rather than its partition into fracture, friction, waves and ejection. Multiplying volume by density does not establish support demand without the coupling pathway and releasable fraction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性能與釋放比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic energy and releasable fraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彈性能與釋放比例
knowledge.text: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。線彈性能密度只是儲存量的理想估計，還需區分裂縫生成、摩擦、波動和拋出物能量；把全部體積乘能量密度直接當支護需求會忽略真正耦合路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. Elastic density estimates storage rather than its partition into fracture, friction, waves and ejection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彈性能與釋放比例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic energy and releasable fraction" is correct?
options: 所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。
拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同
optionsEn: All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy
Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress.
Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event
quiz.explanation: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic energy and releasable fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性能與釋放比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性能與釋放比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性能與釋放比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據；若出現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「彈性能與釋放比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elastic energy and releasable fraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用。
拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同

Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action.
Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event

quiz.explanationEn: Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 拋出物動能與速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ejected-rock energy and velocity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拋出物動能與速度」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ejected-rock energy and velocity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。表面落塊不一定由同一動態機制造成，需區分重力落下與應力驅動拋出；單塊估算也不能代表整個事件作用在支護的時間和空間分布。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍；若出現僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拋出物動能與速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently. Surface falls need not share the same dynamic mechanism; distinguish gravity fall from stress-driven ejection. A single-block estimate does not establish the event's spatial or temporal loading of support. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence. If demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ejected-rock energy and velocity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拋出物動能與速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ejected-rock energy and velocity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拋出物動能與速度
knowledge.text: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。表面落塊不一定由同一動態機制造成，需區分重力落下與應力驅動拋出；單塊估算也不能代表整個事件作用在支護的時間和空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently. Surface falls need not share the same dynamic mechanism; distinguish gravity fall from stress-driven ejection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拋出物動能與速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。
optionsEn: Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently.
quiz.explanation: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.observation: 如何核對：用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

If demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.title: 拋出物動能與速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ejected-rock energy and velocity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拋出物動能與速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ejected-rock energy and velocity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍；若出現僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拋出物動能與速度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ejected-rock energy and velocity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity.
quiz.explanation: 僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讓壓行程與吸能積分」與「岩栓板網與共同變形」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Yielding stroke and energy integration" and "Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Yielding stroke and energy integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「讓壓行程與吸能積分」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Yielding stroke and energy integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。高峰值力不一定有足夠行程，低剛度也不等於穩定吸能；必須看完整載入曲線及卸載後損傷，並區分元件試驗邊界與安裝系統邊界。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化；若出現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「讓壓行程與吸能積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. A high peak may lack travel, and low stiffness does not establish stable absorption. Review the full loading curve and damage while distinguishing component-test restraint from the installed support system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. If a component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Yielding stroke and energy integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Yielding stroke and energy integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分
knowledge.text: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。高峰值力不一定有足夠行程，低剛度也不等於穩定吸能；必須看完整載入曲線及卸載後損傷，並區分元件試驗邊界與安裝系統邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. A high peak may lack travel, and low stiffness does not establish stable absorption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「讓壓行程與吸能積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Yielding stroke and energy integration" is correct?
options: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量
optionsEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke.
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity
quiz.explanation: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Yielding stroke and energy integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Yielding stroke and energy integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Yielding stroke and energy integration", which statement holds?
options: 單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置
原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。
微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全
optionsEn: One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst
Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ.
Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化；若出現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩栓板網與共同變形」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 吸能岩栓需要托盤與表面網把岩塊作用傳給它，任一連接先失效都會中斷路徑。各元件可能有不同位移和載入速率，不能只把產品額定能量相加；系統驗證必須確認網的變形、板的穿破和岩栓行程能相容。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序；若出現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩栓板網與共同變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An energy-absorbing bolt needs plates and mesh to deliver rock actions; premature connection failure interrupts that path. Components undergo different displacements and rates, preventing simple addition of product energy ratings. Verify compatible mesh deformation, plate punching and bolt travel as a system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. If a plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩栓板網與共同變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 將同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. steps.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.instructionEn: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dynamic rate and test boundaries" and "Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dynamic rate and test boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動態事件的慣性和載入速率與慢速拉拔不同，錨固界面及金屬變形也可能隨速率改變。落錘試驗能量包含設備和試件的共同反應，不能只依落高推定材料實際吸收量；應量測反彈、裝置變形與力位移歷程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支；若出現把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inertia and loading rate differ from slow pull tests and may change anchorage and metal response. A drop test contains both apparatus and specimen behaviour, so drop height alone does not establish absorbed material energy. Measure rebound, fixture deformation and force-displacement history. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work. If energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Einput=m*g*h=1000 kg*9.81 m/s2*1 m=9.81 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Einput=m*g*h=1000 kg*9.81 m/s2*1 m=9.81 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dynamic rate and test boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Inertia and loading rate differ from slow pull tests and may change anchorage and metal response.

steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Einput=m*g*h=1000 kg*9.81 m/s2*1 m=9.81 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Einput=m*g*h=1000 kg*9.81 m/s2*1 m=9.81 kJ. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支；若出現把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「微震到時與位置不確定度」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微震定位使用多站到時差與波速模型，單站訊號不能唯一決定位置。岩層非均質、耦合品質和時鐘偏差會移動估計震源；到時殘差小也可能只是錯誤波速模型被擬合，必須用可驗證參考事件檢查定位誤差。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差；若出現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「微震到時與位置不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Location uses multistation arrival differences and a velocity model; one station cannot uniquely locate a source. Heterogeneity, coupling and clocks shift estimates. Small residuals may merely fit an incorrect velocity model, requiring reference events with independently constrained positions to assess error. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「微震到時與位置不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.instruction: 以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量
optionsEn: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating

quiz.explanationEn: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「串聯力鏈與容量區分」與「事件計數與偵測完整度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Serial force paths and capacity distinctions" and "Event counts and detection completeness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 串聯力鏈與容量區分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Serial force paths and capacity distinctions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「串聯力鏈與容量區分」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想同軸串聯元件承受相同靜態拉力，因此最小力容量限制該理想力鏈。動態吸能卻是每一元件力位移積分，不存在一般性的最小能量法則；同一系統可能因連接位移限制而無法動員某元件的試驗吸能。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐段核對傳力方向、靜態容量及各元件可用位移；若出現以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「串聯力鏈與容量區分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal collinear serial components carry the same static force, making the smallest force capacity a limit for that ideal chain. Dynamic energy depends on each force-displacement integral, without a general minimum-energy rule. Connection travel may prevent engagement of a component's tested absorption capacity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit force directions, static limits and available displacement for each component. If using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「串聯力鏈與容量區分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 串聯力鏈與容量區分
knowledge.titleEn: Serial force paths and capacity distinctions

knowledge.textEn: Ideal collinear serial components carry the same static force, making the smallest force capacity a limit for that ideal chain. Dynamic energy depends on each force-displacement integral, without a general minimum-energy rule.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「串聯力鏈與容量區分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量

steps.title: 串聯力鏈與容量區分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Serial force paths and capacity distinctions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「串聯力鏈與容量區分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段核對傳力方向、靜態容量及各元件可用位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit force directions, static limits and available displacement for each component.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event

steps.title: 串聯力鏈與容量區分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Serial force paths and capacity distinctions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「串聯力鏈與容量區分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐段核對傳力方向、靜態容量及各元件可用位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit force directions, static limits and available displacement for each component. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐段核對傳力方向、靜態容量及各元件可用位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit force directions, static limits and available displacement for each component. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanation: 以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Event counts and detection completeness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「事件計數與偵測完整度」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Event counts and detection completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 事件數增加可能反映真實活動，也可能是感測器靈敏度、噪音或網路覆蓋改變。比較前後資料須先固定可偵測尺度與品質篩選，否則更換設備後會產生假趨勢；計數、位置和能量估計應一起判讀，不能由單一門檻自動判定安全。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布；若出現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「事件計數與偵測完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: More detected events may reflect activity or changed sensitivity, noise and coverage. Fix detection completeness and quality filtering before comparison, otherwise equipment changes create artificial trends. Interpret count, location and energy estimates together rather than declaring safety from a single threshold. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Event counts and detection completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「事件計數與偵測完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Event counts and detection completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度
knowledge.text: 事件數增加可能反映真實活動，也可能是感測器靈敏度、噪音或網路覆蓋改變。比較前後資料須先固定可偵測尺度與品質篩選，否則更換設備後會產生假趨勢；計數、位置和能量估計應一起判讀，不能由單一門檻自動判定安全。
knowledge.textEn: More detected events may reflect activity or changed sensitivity, noise and coverage. Fix detection completeness and quality filtering before comparison, otherwise equipment changes create artificial trends.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「事件計數與偵測完整度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Event counts and detection completeness" is correct?
options: 微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全
預警準確率很高就可取代現場工程判斷
事件數增加可能反映真實活動，也可能是感測器靈敏度、噪音或網路覆蓋改變。
optionsEn: Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer
High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field
More detected events may reflect activity or changed sensitivity, noise and coverage.
quiz.explanation: 事件數增加可能反映真實活動，也可能是感測器靈敏度、噪音或網路覆蓋改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: More detected events may reflect activity or changed sensitivity, noise and coverage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Event counts and detection completeness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「事件計數與偵測完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Event counts and detection completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「事件計數與偵測完整度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Event counts and detection completeness", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h。
所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h.
All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: observedRate=events/time=24 events/6 h=4 events/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Event counts and detection completeness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「事件計數與偵測完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Event counts and detection completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「事件計數與偵測完整度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Event counts and detection completeness"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布。
落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range.
Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt
quiz.explanation: 對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Event counts and detection completeness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件計數與偵測完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Event counts and detection completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布；若出現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「事件計數與偵測完整度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Event counts and detection completeness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
預警準確率很高就可取代現場工程判斷
感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field
Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour.
quiz.explanation: 感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「監測融合與決策證據」與「事件後剩餘行程與復核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Monitoring integration and decision evidence" and "Post-event remaining stroke and requalification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring integration and decision evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「監測融合與決策證據」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聲學訊號、收斂、岩片剝落及應力估計各觀察不同物理量，彼此不一致時需要診斷而非多數決。預警模型的誤報和漏報都與資料族群有關，不能用訓練準確率代替現地驗證；責任人必須知道哪些通道失效或尚未校核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件；若出現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「監測融合與決策證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acoustic signals, convergence, spalling and stress estimates measure different phenomena; disagreement needs diagnosis rather than majority voting. False alarms and misses depend on the data population, so training accuracy is not field validation. Decision owners need visibility of failed or unverified channels. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. knowledge.title: 監測融合與決策證據
knowledge.text: 聲學訊號、收斂、岩片剝落及應力估計各觀察不同物理量，彼此不一致時需要診斷而非多數決。預警模型的誤報和漏報都與資料族群有關，不能用訓練準確率代替現地驗證；責任人必須知道哪些通道失效或尚未校核。
knowledge.textEn: Acoustic signals, convergence, spalling and stress estimates measure different phenomena; disagreement needs diagnosis rather than majority voting. False alarms and misses depend on the data population, so training accuracy is not field validation.

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring integration and decision evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測融合與決策證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：falseAlarmFraction=falseAlarms/allAlarms=3/20=15 percent, with separately unknown misses。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: falseAlarmFraction=falseAlarms/allAlarms=3/20=15 percent, with separately unknown misses. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring integration and decision evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測融合與決策證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 將將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測融合與決策證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件；若出現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預警準確率很高就可取代現場工程判斷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「監測融合與決策證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
