Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱架滑移接頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sliding joints in steel ribs"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限
逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel
Measure slip and clamping at every joint together with rib-profile change.
quiz.explanation: 逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure slip and clamping at every joint together with rib-profile change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱架滑移接頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sliding joints in steel ribs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱架滑移接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding joints in steel ribs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure slip and clamping at every joint together with rib-profile change to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化；若出現單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If one jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個接頭名義行程相加就是任何方向可用收斂」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding nominal joint strokes gives available convergence in every direction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐接頭量測滑移、夾緊狀態與拱架輪廓變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure slip and clamping at every joint together with rib-profile change to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱架滑移接頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sliding joints in steel ribs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能
optionsEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance
quiz.explanation: 單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」與「反算參數與可辨識性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shotcrete slots and local crushing" and "Back-analysis and identifiability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete slots and local crushing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。開縫長度也不能簡單視為均勻應變，因為周圍噴層仍有彎曲與接觸；應把間隙閉合過程和鋼拱滑移一同追蹤。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移；若出現砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. Incompatible infill can lock them early. Slot closure is not uniform lining strain because adjacent shotcrete still bends and contacts ground; track it alongside steel-rib sliding rather than as an isolated gap. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shotcrete slots and local crushing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎
knowledge.text: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。開縫長度也不能簡單視為均勻應變，因為周圍噴層仍有彎曲與接觸；應把間隙閉合過程和鋼拱滑移一同追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. Incompatible infill can lock them early.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shotcrete slots and local crushing" is correct?
options: 讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能
讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。
反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定
optionsEn: Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance
Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends.
A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters
quiz.explanation: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete slots and local crushing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shotcrete slots and local crushing", which statement holds?
options: 觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計
把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小
原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。
optionsEn: Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it
The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation
Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.instruction: 砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. steps.instruction: 一條收斂曲線可能由不同地層強度、模數或支護安裝時間組合產生，擬合良好不代表參數唯一。增加支護反力、孔內位移或獨立地質證據才能限制解的範圍；反算應呈現多組可能情境，而非只交一條最漂亮曲線。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力；若出現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反算參數與可辨識性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different ground strengths, moduli and installation times can reproduce one convergence curve, so fit quality does not imply uniqueness. Support reactions, borehole movement and independent geology constrain the solution. Report plausible alternatives rather than only the best-looking fitted curve. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Back-analysis and identifiability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反算參數與可辨識性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Back-analysis and identifiability"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。
掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections.
Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone
quiz.explanation: 用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反算參數與可辨識性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Back-analysis and identifiability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反算參數與可辨識性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Back-analysis and identifiability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力；若出現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反算參數與可辨識性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Back-analysis and identifiability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載
多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase
Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground.
quiz.explanation: 多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期荷載與二次襯砌」與「觀察法與調整證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term load and secondary lining" and "Observational design and adjustment evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term load and secondary lining: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期荷載與二次襯砌」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term load and secondary lining” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。不能因外觀停止變形就假定永久荷載不再增加，儀器解析度也可能掩蓋慢速變化；設計應保留長期監測和可解釋的力學模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢；若出現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期荷載與二次襯砌」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing. Apparently stopped movement does not prove constant permanent demand, and resolution can hide slow trends. Preserve long-term monitoring and an interpretable mechanical model for later comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term load and secondary lining” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長期荷載與二次襯砌」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-term load and secondary lining”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌
knowledge.text: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。不能因外觀停止變形就假定永久荷載不再增加，儀器解析度也可能掩蓋慢速變化；設計應保留長期監測和可解釋的力學模型。
knowledge.textEn: Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing. Apparently stopped movement does not prove constant permanent demand, and resolution can hide slow trends.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期荷載與二次襯砌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term load and secondary lining" is correct?
options: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。
短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載
觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計
optionsEn: Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing.
A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase
Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it
quiz.explanation: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term load and secondary lining: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期荷載與二次襯砌」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term load and secondary lining” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期荷載與二次襯砌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term load and secondary lining", which statement holds?
options: 把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小
原創教學假設：annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only。
平均收斂未超預留值就代表所有位置都不侵限
optionsEn: The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation
Original teaching assumptions: annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only.
Mean convergence within allowance proves no local clearance intrusion
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: annualIncrement=rate*time=0.02 mm/day*365 day=7.3 mm, constant-rate illustration only. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term load and secondary lining: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期荷載與二次襯砌」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term load and secondary lining” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.text: 將比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期荷載與二次襯砌」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term load and secondary lining"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每個接頭名義行程相加就是任何方向可用收斂
比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Adding nominal joint strokes gives available convergence in every direction
Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends.
quiz.explanation: 比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term load and secondary lining: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期荷載與二次襯砌」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term load and secondary lining” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢；若出現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期荷載與二次襯砌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term load and secondary lining" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計
optionsEn: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it
quiz.explanation: 短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 觀察法與調整證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Observational design and adjustment evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「觀察法與調整證據」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Observational design and adjustment evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觀察法需要事前定義可觀察量、可接受範圍及對應備案，並非看到問題後任意修改。讓壓行程、收斂速率和支護損傷反映不同邊界，調整前必須確認量測有效；版本追蹤可避免不同班組使用互相矛盾的支護假設。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任；若出現失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「觀察法與調整證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Observational design requires predefined observables, acceptable ranges and contingency actions rather than arbitrary changes after trouble. Stroke, convergence rate and damage reveal different boundaries; confirm measurement validity before adjustment. Revision control prevents crews from using contradictory support assumptions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Observational design and adjustment evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「觀察法與調整證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Observational design and adjustment evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 觀察法與調整證據
knowledge.text: 觀察法需要事前定義可觀察量、可接受範圍及對應備案，並非看到問題後任意修改。讓壓行程、收斂速率和支護損傷反映不同邊界，調整前必須確認量測有效；版本追蹤可避免不同班組使用互相矛盾的支護假設。
knowledge.textEn: Observational design requires predefined observables, acceptable ranges and contingency actions rather than arbitrary changes after trouble. Stroke, convergence rate and damage reveal different boundaries; confirm measurement validity before adjustment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「觀察法與調整證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Observational design and adjustment evidence" is correct?
options: 觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計
觀察法需要事前定義可觀察量、可接受範圍及對應備案，並非看到問題後任意修改。
應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量
optionsEn: Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it
Observational design requires predefined observables, acceptable ranges and contingency actions rather than arbitrary changes after trouble.
One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation
quiz.explanation: 觀察法需要事前定義可觀察量、可接受範圍及對應備案，並非看到問題後任意修改。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Observational design requires predefined observables, acceptable ranges and contingency actions rather than arbitrary changes after trouble. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 觀察法與調整證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Observational design and adjustment evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「觀察法與調整證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Observational design and adjustment evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「觀察法與調整證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Observational design and adjustment evidence", which statement holds?
options: 元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限
掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止
原創教學假設：verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent。
optionsEn: A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel
Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone
Original teaching assumptions: verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 觀察法與調整證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Observational design and adjustment evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「觀察法與調整證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Observational design and adjustment evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任；若出現失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「觀察法與調整證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Observational design and adjustment evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據。
應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale.
One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation
quiz.explanation: 失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 膨脹性地層隧道設計
courses.summary: 本課以區分膨脹礦物、水源與受限變形的隧道設計為主線，從礦物反應與含水條件與自由膨脹與試體方向建立系統邊界，再把水源路徑與暴露量、仰拱拘束與接觸壓力連到長期維護與反應地圖。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish swelling minerals, water supply and restrained deformation in tunnel design. It begins with Mineral reactions and water conditions and Free swell and specimen direction, links Water pathways and exposure volume and Invert restraint and contact pressure, and ends with Long-term maintenance and reaction maps. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 區分膨脹礦物、水源與受限變形的隧道設計
courses.focusEn: Distinguish swelling minerals, water supply and restrained deformation in tunnel design
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查礦物反應與含水條件：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent；再獨立檢查自由膨脹與試體方向：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。100 mm 試體自由高度增量由 4 增為 6 mm，膨脹率由 4% 增為 6%；不能推論受限壓力也增加 50%，因為邊界和反應非線性。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 將比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Mineral reactions and water conditions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Independently check Free swell and specimen direction: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent. Increasing free height change from 4 to 6 mm in a 100 mm specimen raises swell from 4% to 6%; restrained pressure need not rise by 50% because boundary and response are nonlinear. The two results are not a complete design because free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. Use compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「礦物反應與含水條件」與「自由膨脹與試體方向」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mineral reactions and water conditions" and "Free swell and specimen direction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「礦物反應與含水條件」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mineral reactions and water conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。岩樣外觀不足以判別機制，需把礦物組成和取樣保存狀態一起記錄；遇水變形也可能混有軟化及崩解，不能都用同一膨脹係數描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄；若出現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「礦物反應與含水條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. Appearance alone does not identify the mechanism; document mineralogy and sample preservation. Wetting deformation can also contain softening and slaking rather than a single swelling coefficient. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mineral reactions and water conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「礦物反應與含水條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mineral reactions and water conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 礦物反應與含水條件
knowledge.text: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。岩樣外觀不足以判別機制，需把礦物組成和取樣保存狀態一起記錄；遇水變形也可能混有軟化及崩解，不能都用同一膨脹係數描述。
knowledge.textEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. Appearance alone does not identify the mechanism; document mineralogy and sample preservation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「礦物反應與含水條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mineral reactions and water conditions" is correct?
options: 只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制
膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。
自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力
optionsEn: Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism
Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress.
Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure
quiz.explanation: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「礦物反應與含水條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「礦物反應與含水條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mineral reactions and water conditions", which statement holds?
options: 遇水後產生的任何變形都只能叫做膨脹
地表隆起除以總覆土就能得到唯一膨脹率
原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。
optionsEn: Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling
Surface heave divided by total cover gives the unique swelling strain
Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「礦物反應與含水條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mineral reactions and water conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「礦物反應與含水條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「礦物反應與含水條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 自由膨脹與試體方向：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「自由膨脹與試體方向」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free swell and specimen direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無側限或低荷重試驗可觀察自由變形，但層理方向會造成不同伸長，切樣擾動也會影響結果。自由膨脹不是隧道受限狀態，不能直接乘襯砌模數轉成壓力；應保留試體方向、浸水條件和量測時間。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程；若出現只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由膨脹與試體方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-load tests reveal free deformation, but bedding direction and cutting disturbance affect elongation. Free swell is not the restrained tunnel state and cannot be converted into pressure by multiplying lining modulus. Retain orientation, wetting conditions and observation duration with every result. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding. If testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free swell and specimen direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由膨脹與試體方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free swell and specimen direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.text: 將比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由膨脹與試體方向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free swell and specimen direction"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程。
降低地下水位對所有地下工程都只有正面效果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding.
Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure
quiz.explanation: 比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由膨脹與試體方向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free swell and specimen direction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由膨脹與試體方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free swell and specimen direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程；若出現只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較平行及垂直層理試體的高度變化與吸水歷程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare height change and water uptake parallel and normal to bedding to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由膨脹與試體方向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free swell and specimen direction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響
只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness
Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure.
quiz.explanation: 只測有利方向低估另一方向膨脹，襯砌局部受壓增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only a favourable direction understates transverse swelling and local lining pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「受限膨脹與反力」與「力學軟化與膨脹區分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Restrained swell and reaction" and "Softening versus swelling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Restrained swell and reaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「受限膨脹與反力」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained swell and reaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。完全零變形是理想化，微小試架變形可能降低量得壓力；應將反力和位移一起呈現，不能只保留單一峰值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間；若出現試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「受限膨脹與反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path. Perfect zero displacement is idealized; small frame deformation can reduce measured pressure. Report reaction and movement together rather than a peak alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. If frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained swell and reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「受限膨脹與反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrained swell and reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 受限膨脹與反力
knowledge.text: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。完全零變形是理想化，微小試架變形可能降低量得壓力；應將反力和位移一起呈現，不能只保留單一峰值。
knowledge.textEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path. Perfect zero displacement is idealized; small frame deformation can reduce measured pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「受限膨脹與反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Restrained swell and reaction" is correct?
options: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。
受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響
遇水後產生的任何變形都只能叫做膨脹
optionsEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path.
Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness
Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling
quiz.explanation: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Restrained swell and reaction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「受限膨脹與反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained swell and reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「受限膨脹與反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Restrained swell and reaction", which statement holds?

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
