steps.title: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pump gauge and interval pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump gauge and interval pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pump gauge and interval pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pump gauge and interval pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration.
Initial absence of leakage proves the material will never deteriorate
quiz.explanation: 以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump gauge and interval pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump gauge and interval pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算；若出現只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵表壓力永遠等於灌漿孔段實際壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump-gauge pressure always equals actual pressure in the treated interval" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

淨注入壓差低就能保證任何地層都不會開裂
只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture
Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground.
quiz.explanation: 只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔隙壓與有效作用差」與「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pore pressure and net pressure difference" and "Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 注入端壓力與原地下水壓之差影響流動，但不能單獨決定地層是否會開裂或抬升。最小主應力、既有裂隙與連通路徑同樣重要，局部壓力還可能傳到遠處薄弱面；模型應區分水力驅動差與允許作用上限。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應；若出現把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔隙壓與有效作用差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and net pressure difference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔隙壓與有效作用差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure and net pressure difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. If a small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure and net pressure difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應；若出現把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「淨注入壓差低就能保證任何地層都不會開裂」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想平行板層流的流量對開度立方敏感，微小開合可大幅改變流量。天然裂隙粗糙、分岔且有接觸點，不能從一個流量唯一反算開度；此模型適合解釋為何少數連通裂隙可能主導整體漏水。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據；若出現只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal parallel-plate laminar flow varies with aperture cubed, so small changes can strongly alter discharge. Natural joints are rough, branching and partly contacting, preventing unique aperture inference from one flow. The model explains why a few connected fractures can dominate leakage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare interval flow and fracture connectivity at comparable heads. If sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：flowRatio=(newAperture/oldAperture)^3=(1.1)^3=1.331。

knowledge.title: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度
knowledge.text: 理想平行板層流的流量對開度立方敏感，微小開合可大幅改變流量。天然裂隙粗糙、分岔且有接觸點，不能從一個流量唯一反算開度；此模型適合解釋為何少數連通裂隙可能主導整體漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal parallel-plate laminar flow varies with aperture cubed, so small changes can strongly alter discharge. Natural joints are rough, branching and partly contacting, preventing unique aperture inference from one flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有裂隙對總漏水的貢獻都大致相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every fracture contributes approximately equally to total leakage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：flowRatio=(newAperture/oldAperture)^3=(1.1)^3=1.331。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: flowRatio=(newAperture/oldAperture)^3=(1.1)^3=1.331. steps.title: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare interval flow and fracture connectivity at comparable heads. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare interval flow and fracture connectivity at comparable heads. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare interval flow and fracture connectivity at comparable heads to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據；若出現只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有裂隙對總漏水的貢獻都大致相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every fracture contributes approximately equally to total leakage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Geometric volume and delivered volume" and "Grout penetrability and particle size": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 幾何體積與實際注入量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometric volume and delivered volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何體積與實際注入量」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric volume and delivered volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想處理環體積可作材料帳基準，但地層不是均勻多孔體，注入可能集中在少數通道。超過理論體積並不證明處理半徑增加，可能是外逸或相鄰孔連通；必須把材料去向和地下水反應一起辨認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引；若出現大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何體積與實際注入量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ideal treatment annulus offers a volume baseline, but ground is not a uniform porous medium and delivery may concentrate in a few channels. Excess volume does not prove a larger treatment radius; it may escape or connect to another hole. Interpret material destinations with groundwater response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together. If large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric volume and delivered volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs r=0.5 m, r0=0.05 m, L=3 m, assumedConnectedVoidFraction=0.10; V=pi*(r^2-r0^2)*L*n=pi*(0.5^2-0.05^2)*3*0.10=0.233 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs r=0.5 m, r0=0.05 m, L=3 m, assumedConnectedVoidFraction=0.10; V=pi*(r^2-r0^2)*L*n=pi*(0.5^2-0.05^2)*3*0.10=0.233 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入量達理論體積就能證明處理半徑完全達成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何體積與實際注入量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric volume and delivered volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed
An ideal treatment annulus offers a volume baseline, but ground is not a uniform porous medium and delivery may concentrate in a few channels.
quiz.explanation: 理想處理環體積可作材料帳基準，但地層不是均勻多孔體，注入可能集中在少數通道。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ideal treatment annulus offers a volume baseline, but ground is not a uniform porous medium and delivery may concentrate in a few channels. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 幾何體積與實際注入量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometric volume and delivered volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何體積與實際注入量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric volume and delivered volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs r=0.5 m, r0=0.05 m, L=3 m, assumedConnectedVoidFraction=0.10; V=pi*(r^2-r0^2)*L*n=pi*(0.5^2-0.05^2)*3*0.10=0.233 m3。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs r=0.5 m, r0=0.05 m, L=3 m, assumedConnectedVoidFraction=0.10; V=pi*(r^2-r0^2)*L*n=pi*(0.5^2-0.05^2)*3*0.10=0.233 m3. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 幾何體積與實際注入量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometric volume and delivered volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「幾何體積與實際注入量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometric volume and delivered volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.title: 幾何體積與實際注入量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometric volume and delivered volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何體積與實際注入量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric volume and delivered volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引；若出現大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入量達理論體積就能證明處理半徑完全達成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delivered theoretical volume proves the complete treatment radius has been achieved" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 材料可灌性與粒徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grout penetrability and particle size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料可灌性與粒徑」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grout penetrability and particle size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 材料能否進入裂隙取決於粒徑分布、開度、流變和過濾作用，平均粒徑不能代表最大團聚體。入口堵塞可能讓孔口壓力升高但深部仍未處理，因而壓力與流量變化不能直接解讀為地層已封閉；材料選擇需要相容試驗證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀；若出現孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料可灌性與粒徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Penetrability depends on size distribution, aperture, rheology and filtration, not mean particle size alone. Entrance clogging can raise collar pressure while leaving deeper ground untreated. Pressure-flow changes therefore do not directly establish closure and material selection needs compatibility evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. If an entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grout penetrability and particle size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：geometricRatio=aperture/d95=0.20 mm/0.04 mm=5, not a universal penetrability criterion。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: geometricRatio=aperture/d95=0.20 mm/0.04 mm=5, not a universal penetrability criterion.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入口壓力升高就能證明整個處理區都已封閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料可灌性與粒徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grout penetrability and particle size”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料可灌性與粒徑
knowledge.text: 材料能否進入裂隙取決於粒徑分布、開度、流變和過濾作用，平均粒徑不能代表最大團聚體。入口堵塞可能讓孔口壓力升高但深部仍未處理，因而壓力與流量變化不能直接解讀為地層已封閉；材料選擇需要相容試驗證據。
knowledge.textEn: Penetrability depends on size distribution, aperture, rheology and filtration, not mean particle size alone. Entrance clogging can raise collar pressure while leaving deeper ground untreated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：入口壓力升高就能證明整個處理區都已封閉 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：geometricRatio=aperture/d95=0.20 mm/0.04 mm=5, not a universal penetrability criterion。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: geometricRatio=aperture/d95=0.20 mm/0.04 mm=5, not a universal penetrability criterion. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 材料可灌性與粒徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout penetrability and particle size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料可灌性與粒徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout penetrability and particle size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「材料可灌性與粒徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture
Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes.
quiz.explanation: 比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 材料可灌性與粒徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grout penetrability and particle size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「材料可灌性與粒徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grout penetrability and particle size” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀；若出現孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入口壓力升高就能證明整個處理區都已封閉」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料可灌性與粒徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grout penetrability and particle size" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善
optionsEn: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement
quiz.explanation: 孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「前後透水比較與水頭」與「地層抬升與遠端反應」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Before-after permeability and head" and "Ground uplift and remote response": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 前後透水比較與水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Before-after permeability and head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「前後透水比較與水頭」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Before-after permeability and head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 處理前後流量若在不同水頭下量測，直接百分比可能混入地下水自然變化。線性水力導通度只適用特定範圍，裂隙開合會造成非線性；比較應使用相同孔段、時間尺度及可比邊界，並保留未達穩態的資料註記。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在相同孔段和可比水頭下比較穩態流量及恢復曲線；若出現天然水位下降被錯算成灌漿成效，雨季水頭恢復後再漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「前後透水比較與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before-after flows measured at different heads mix treatment with natural groundwater change. Linear conductance applies only over a specified range because joint opening can be nonlinear. Compare the same intervals and time scales under similar boundaries and identify readings that have not reached steady conditions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare steady flow and recovery curves in matching intervals at comparable heads. If natural head decline is credited to treatment and leakage returns when seasonal head recovers, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Before-after permeability and head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：reduction=(Qbefore-Qafter)/Qbefore=(10-2) L/min/10 L/min=80 percent at equal head。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reduction=(Qbefore-Qafter)/Qbefore=(10-2) L/min/10 L/min=80 percent at equal head.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「前後透水比較與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Before-after permeability and head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 前後透水比較與水頭
knowledge.text: 處理前後流量若在不同水頭下量測，直接百分比可能混入地下水自然變化。線性水力導通度只適用特定範圍，裂隙開合會造成非線性；比較應使用相同孔段、時間尺度及可比邊界，並保留未達穩態的資料註記。
knowledge.textEn: Before-after flows measured at different heads mix treatment with natural groundwater change. Linear conductance applies only over a specified range because joint opening can be nonlinear.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「前後透水比較與水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Before-after permeability and head" is correct?
options: 處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善
處理前後流量若在不同水頭下量測，直接百分比可能混入地下水自然變化。
孔口周圍沒變形就能證明所有遠端地層都沒反應
optionsEn: Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement
Before-after flows measured at different heads mix treatment with natural groundwater change.
No movement near the collar proves all distant ground remains unaffected
quiz.explanation: 處理前後流量若在不同水頭下量測，直接百分比可能混入地下水自然變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before-after flows measured at different heads mix treatment with natural groundwater change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 前後透水比較與水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Before-after permeability and head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「前後透水比較與水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Before-after permeability and head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：reduction=(Qbefore-Qafter)/Qbefore=(10-2) L/min/10 L/min=80 percent at equal head。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reduction=(Qbefore-Qafter)/Qbefore=(10-2) L/min/10 L/min=80 percent at equal head. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同孔段和可比水頭下比較穩態流量及恢復曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare steady flow and recovery curves in matching intervals at comparable heads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 前後透水比較與水頭：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 天然水位下降被錯算成灌漿成效，雨季水頭恢復後再漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在相同孔段和可比水頭下比較穩態流量及恢復曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Natural head decline is credited to treatment and leakage returns when seasonal head recovers. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 壓力傳遞可能超出預期處理半徑，薄弱界面或地表覆土較少處會先變形。孔口附近沒有移動不能排除遠端反應，鄰近結構與水位也可能提供訊息；監測範圍應由地質連通模型決定，而不是固定圍住設備。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸；若出現遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地層抬升與遠端反應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure transmission can extend beyond the assumed treatment radius and deform weak or shallow interfaces first. steps.title: 地層抬升與遠端反應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground uplift and remote response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地層抬升與遠端反應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground uplift and remote response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地層抬升與遠端反應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground uplift and remote response"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸。
注入量達理論體積就能證明處理半徑完全達成
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures.
Delivered theoretical volume proves the complete treatment radius has been achieved
quiz.explanation: 將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地層抬升與遠端反應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground uplift and remote response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地層抬升與遠端反應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground uplift and remote response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸；若出現遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口周圍沒變形就能證明所有遠端地層都沒反應」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No movement near the collar proves all distant ground remains unaffected" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地層抬升與遠端反應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground uplift and remote response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
施工後短期不漏就代表材料永遠不會劣化
遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Initial absence of leakage proves the material will never deteriorate
Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect.
quiz.explanation: 遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水化學與耐久相容」與「驗收範圍與長期水路」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water chemistry and durability compatibility" and "Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水化學與耐久相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water chemistry and durability compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水化學與耐久相容」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water chemistry and durability compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水材料長期接觸地下水，化學侵蝕、溶出或體積變化可能改變密封效果。短期不漏不等於材料與環境相容，溫度和流速也影響暴露；試驗應比較服務環境下的留存性能，而非只採容易得到的室內浸泡結果。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將水質、溫度及老化後滲透與強度資料共同審查；若出現材料溶出留下新通道，短期合格卻長期重新滲漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水化學與耐久相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water-control materials remain exposed to groundwater, where attack, leaching and volume change can alter sealing. Initial tightness does not establish compatibility, and temperature and flow affect exposure. Compare retained performance under representative service conditions rather than convenient immersion results alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Review water chemistry, temperature and post-ageing permeability and strength together. If material leaching creates new pathways despite initially passing leakage checks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water chemistry and durability compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工後短期不漏就代表材料永遠不會劣化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Initial absence of leakage proves the material will never deteriorate" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水化學與耐久相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water chemistry and durability compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水化學與耐久相容
knowledge.text: 止水材料長期接觸地下水，化學侵蝕、溶出或體積變化可能改變密封效果。短期不漏不等於材料與環境相容，溫度和流速也影響暴露；試驗應比較服務環境下的留存性能，而非只採容易得到的室內浸泡結果。
knowledge.textEn: Water-control materials remain exposed to groundwater, where attack, leaching and volume change can alter sealing. Initial tightness does not establish compatibility, and temperature and flow affect exposure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工後短期不漏就代表材料永遠不會劣化 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Initial absence of leakage proves the material will never deteriorate Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水化學與耐久相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water chemistry and durability compatibility" is correct?
options: 止水材料長期接觸地下水，化學侵蝕、溶出或體積變化可能改變密封效果。
施工後短期不漏就代表材料永遠不會劣化
中心驗證孔合格就能代表整個止水範圍連續
optionsEn: Water-control materials remain exposed to groundwater, where attack, leaching and volume change can alter sealing.
Initial absence of leakage proves the material will never deteriorate
A passing central verification hole proves the entire water barrier is continuous
quiz.explanation: 止水材料長期接觸地下水，化學侵蝕、溶出或體積變化可能改變密封效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water-control materials remain exposed to groundwater, where attack, leaching and volume change can alter sealing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水化學與耐久相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water chemistry and durability compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水化學與耐久相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water chemistry and durability compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將水質、溫度及老化後滲透與強度資料共同審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review water chemistry, temperature and post-ageing permeability and strength together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水化學與耐久相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water chemistry and durability compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 泵表壓力永遠等於灌漿孔段實際壓力
原創教學假設：retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent。
所有裂隙對總漏水的貢獻都大致相同
optionsEn: Pump-gauge pressure always equals actual pressure in the treated interval
Original teaching assumptions: retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent.
Every fracture contributes approximately equally to total leakage
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水化學與耐久相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water chemistry and durability compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水化學與耐久相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water chemistry and durability compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 材料溶出留下新通道，短期合格卻長期重新滲漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將水質、溫度及老化後滲透與強度資料共同審查，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Material leaching creates new pathways despite initially passing leakage checks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to review water chemistry, temperature and post-ageing permeability and strength together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If material leaching creates new pathways despite initially passing leakage checks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工後短期不漏就代表材料永遠不會劣化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Initial absence of leakage proves the material will never deteriorate" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 驗收範圍與長期水路：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 止水效果需針對設計範圍與地下水邊界驗證，單孔低透水不能代表全部帷幕連續。水可能繞過未處理端部或沿新裂隙改道，交接應保存孔段、材料、量測水頭與未驗證區；維護才能分辨原缺口和後續變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照；若出現帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「驗收範圍與長期水路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the design volume and groundwater boundary rather than treating low permeability in one hole as continuous coverage. Water can bypass ends or take new fractures. Preserve intervals, materials, test heads and unverified zones so maintenance distinguishes original gaps from later changes. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones. If an open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: verificationCoverage=verifiedIntervals/requiredIntervals=36/40=90 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「中心驗證孔合格就能代表整個止水範圍連續」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A passing central verification hole proves the entire water barrier is continuous" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「驗收範圍與長期水路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「驗收範圍與長期水路」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways"?
options: 將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善
optionsEn: Compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement
quiz.explanation: 將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 驗收範圍與長期水路：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「驗收範圍與長期水路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照；若出現帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「中心驗證孔合格就能代表整個止水範圍連續」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A passing central verification hole proves the entire water barrier is continuous" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「驗收範圍與長期水路」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水。
隧道埋得多深就一定有完全相同的地下水頭
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes.
Tunnel burial depth always equals the groundwater head
quiz.explanation: 帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 隧道湧水排導系統
courses.summary: 本課以用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水為主線，從地下水與施工用水收支與支管流速與有效斷面建立系統邊界，再把集水容量與反應時間、堵塞敏感度與維護連到長期水文與維護交接。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. It begins with Groundwater and process-water balance and Branch velocity and effective area, links Sump storage and response time and Blockage sensitivity and maintenance, and ends with Long-term hydrology and handover. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水
courses.focusEn: Manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查地下水與施工用水收支：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage；再獨立檢查支管流速與有效斷面：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。總排水保持 80 L/s，施工用水由 25 增為 35 L/s，推估地層湧水由 55 降為 45 L/s；總量不變可能掩蓋來源改變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 將比對濾層粒徑、濁度、排水量與附近沉陷趨勢作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Groundwater and process-water balance: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Independently check Branch velocity and effective area: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. At a constant total discharge of 80 L/s, process water rising from 25 to 35 L/s reduces inferred groundwater inflow from 55 to 45 L/s; unchanged totals can conceal changing sources. The two results are not a complete design because drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Use compare filter grading, turbidity, discharge and nearby settlement trends as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
