stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水與施工用水收支」與「支管流速與有效斷面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Groundwater and process-water balance" and "Branch velocity and effective area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水與施工用水收支」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater and process-water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。泵站啟停造成出水脈動，應在相同時間窗比較流入與流出；若水槽水位改變，還須加入庫容項才可辨認真正湧水趨勢。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水與施工用水收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows. Include changing sump volume to identify the underlying groundwater trend instead of confusing operational pulses with geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater and process-water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水與施工用水收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater and process-water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水與施工用水收支
knowledge.text: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。泵站啟停造成出水脈動，應在相同時間窗比較流入與流出；若水槽水位改變，還須加入庫容項才可辨認真正湧水趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水與施工用水收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Groundwater and process-water balance" is correct?
options: 泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水
排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。
名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面
optionsEn: All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow
Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone.
Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area
quiz.explanation: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地下水與施工用水收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groundwater and process-water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水與施工用水收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Groundwater and process-water balance", which statement holds?
options: 泵浦銘牌流量就是任何現地管路都能得到的流量
多裝一台備用泵就能排除所有排水失效
原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。
optionsEn: Nameplate pump flow is available in every installed pipeline system
Adding one standby pump eliminates every drainage failure
Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地下水與施工用水收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater and process-water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水與施工用水收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Groundwater and process-water balance"?
options: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水量沒有增加就能保證地層沒有流失
optionsEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Unchanged discharge guarantees that no ground material is being lost
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水與施工用水收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater and process-water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水與施工用水收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater and process-water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水與施工用水收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Groundwater and process-water balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。
名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response.
Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area
quiz.explanation: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支管流速與有效斷面」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Branch velocity and effective area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。用公稱管徑計算可能漏掉積泥，量測高流速也不一定表示容量充足，因為上游可能已積水；應同時看流量、斷面與水頭。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面；若出現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支管流速與有效斷面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. Nominal diameter can miss deposits, and high velocity does not prove spare capacity if water is already backing up. Interpret flow, section geometry and head together rather than velocity alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Branch velocity and effective area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支管流速與有效斷面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Branch velocity and effective area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支管流速與有效斷面
knowledge.text: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。用公稱管徑計算可能漏掉積泥，量測高流速也不一定表示容量充足，因為上游可能已積水；應同時看流量、斷面與水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. Nominal diameter can miss deposits, and high velocity does not prove spare capacity if water is already backing up.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支管流速與有效斷面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Branch velocity and effective area" is correct?
options: 名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面
排水管兩端高程正確就代表中間一定順坡
支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。
optionsEn: Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area
Correct end elevations guarantee a continuously descending drain
Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage.
quiz.explanation: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支管流速與有效斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Branch velocity and effective area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支管流速與有效斷面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Branch velocity and effective area", which statement holds?
options: 集水槽總容積全部都能當作停泵備援容量
管徑減少百分之二十就只會少百分之二十排水能力
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s.
The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage
A twenty-percent diameter loss reduces drainage capacity by only twenty percent
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支管流速與有效斷面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Branch velocity and effective area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支管流速與有效斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Branch velocity and effective area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面；若出現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「支管流速與有效斷面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重力管線與坡度」與「泵站揚程與耗能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gravity pipe and gradient" and "Pump head and power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重力管線與坡度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gravity pipe and gradient: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重力管線與坡度」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gravity pipe and gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力排水依靠水面或能量坡降，管底設計坡度不一定等於實際水力坡降。接頭錯台與局部反坡會形成積泥，端點高程正確也可能漏掉中段低窪；Manning 模型只在定義清楚的均勻流條件下提供基準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積；若出現中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力管線與坡度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity drainage follows a water-surface or energy gradient, which need not equal the designed invert grade. Steps and reverse slopes trap sediment despite correct endpoints. Manning's equation gives a baseline only under a clearly defined uniform-flow condition, not arbitrary backwater or pressurized flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits. If a midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gravity pipe and gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管兩端高程正確就代表中間一定順坡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct end elevations guarantee a continuously descending drain" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重力管線與坡度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gravity pipe and gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重力管線與坡度

knowledge.textEn: Gravity drainage follows a water-surface or energy gradient, which need not equal the designed invert grade. Steps and reverse slopes trap sediment despite correct endpoints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水管兩端高程正確就代表中間一定順坡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct end elevations guarantee a continuously descending drain Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 重力管線與坡度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重力管線與坡度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs n=0.013 s/m^(1/3), A=0.07069 m2, R=0.075 m, S=0.005; Q=(1/n)*A*R^(2/3)*S^0.5=(1/0.013)*0.07069*0.075^(2/3)*0.005^0.5=0.0684 m3/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 重力管線與坡度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gravity pipe and gradient: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重力管線與坡度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gravity pipe and gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積；若出現中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水管兩端高程正確就代表中間一定順坡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct end elevations guarantee a continuously descending drain" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 泵站揚程與耗能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pump head and power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泵站揚程與耗能」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump head and power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵站需要克服靜揚程、沿程損失及局部損失，額定流量只對應特定工作點。效率隨工況改變，不能將馬達功率直接等同水力輸出；並聯泵也不一定讓流量倍增，因為系統曲線會隨流量上升。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點；若出現沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泵站揚程與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumps overcome static lift, friction and local losses, with rated flow tied to a duty point. Efficiency changes with operation, so motor power is not hydraulic output. Parallel pumps need not double discharge because the system curve rises with total flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pump head and power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, Q=0.055 m3/s, H=20 m, eta=0.70; P=rho*g*Q*H/eta=1000*9.81*0.055*20/0.70=15416 W=15.4 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵浦銘牌流量就是任何現地管路都能得到的流量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nameplate pump flow is available in every installed pipeline system" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泵站揚程與耗能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pump head and power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泵站揚程與耗能
knowledge.text: 泵站需要克服靜揚程、沿程損失及局部損失，額定流量只對應特定工作點。效率隨工況改變，不能將馬達功率直接等同水力輸出；並聯泵也不一定讓流量倍增，因為系統曲線會隨流量上升。
knowledge.textEn: Pumps overcome static lift, friction and local losses, with rated flow tied to a duty point. Efficiency changes with operation, so motor power is not hydraulic output.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵浦銘牌流量就是任何現地管路都能得到的流量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nameplate pump flow is available in every installed pipeline system Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泵站揚程與耗能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Nameplate pump flow is available in every installed pipeline system
Pumps overcome static lift, friction and local losses, with rated flow tied to a duty point.
The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage
quiz.explanation: 泵站需要克服靜揚程、沿程損失及局部損失，額定流量只對應特定工作點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 泵站揚程與耗能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pump head and power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵站揚程與耗能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump head and power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, Q=0.055 m3/s, H=20 m, eta=0.70; P=rho*g*Q*H/eta=1000*9.81*0.055*20/0.70=15416 W=15.4 kW。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, Q=0.055 m3/s, H=20 m, eta=0.70; P=rho*g*Q*H/eta=1000*9.81*0.055*20/0.70=15416 W=15.4 kW. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

options: 比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水
optionsEn: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow
quiz.explanation: 比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泵站揚程與耗能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pump head and power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵站揚程與耗能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump head and power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點；若出現沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵浦銘牌流量就是任何現地管路都能得到的流量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nameplate pump flow is available in every installed pipeline system" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵站揚程與耗能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pump head and power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足。
集水槽總容積全部都能當作停泵備援容量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage.
The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage
quiz.explanation: 沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水容量與反應時間」與「備援容量與共同失效」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sump storage and response time" and "Redundancy and common failures": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水容量與反應時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sump storage and response time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水容量與反應時間」如何影響隧道湧水排導系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sump storage and response time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel inflow collection and drainage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。以總幾何容積除湧水量會高估反應時間，泵停機後流入也可能變化；需使用可用容量和明確情境，而非把時間當成工作許可。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄；若出現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水容量與反應時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A sump buffers temporary imbalance, with usable storage reduced by sediment, minimum operating levels and dead space. Gross volume divided by inflow overstates response time, while inflow can change after pump failure. Use available storage under a stated scenario rather than treating the time as permission to act. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. If sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sump storage and response time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集水槽總容積全部都能當作停泵備援容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水容量與反應時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sump storage and response time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水容量與反應時間
knowledge.text: 集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。以總幾何容積除湧水量會高估反應時間，泵停機後流入也可能變化；需使用可用容量和明確情境，而非把時間當成工作許可。
knowledge.textEn: A sump buffers temporary imbalance, with usable storage reduced by sediment, minimum operating levels and dead space. Gross volume divided by inflow overstates response time, while inflow can change after pump failure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集水槽總容積全部都能當作停泵備援容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水容量與反應時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sump storage and response time" is correct?
options: 集水槽總容積全部都能當作停泵備援容量
多裝一台備用泵就能排除所有排水失效
集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。
optionsEn: The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage
Adding one standby pump eliminates every drainage failure
A sump buffers temporary imbalance, with usable storage reduced by sediment, minimum operating levels and dead space.
quiz.explanation: 集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A sump buffers temporary imbalance, with usable storage reduced by sediment, minimum operating levels and dead space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水容量與反應時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sump storage and response time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水容量與反應時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sump storage and response time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水容量與反應時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sump storage and response time", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3。
排水量沒有增加就能保證地層沒有流失
隧道排水變化可以完全不參考周邊水文資料
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3.
Unchanged discharge guarantees that no ground material is being lost
Tunnel discharge changes can be interpreted without surrounding hydrological data
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: storageNeeded=Q*t=0.055 m3/s*600 s=33 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水容量與反應時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sump storage and response time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水容量與反應時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sump storage and response time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集水容量與反應時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sump storage and response time"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄。
名義管徑足夠就不需要檢查有效過水斷面
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests.
Adequate nominal diameter removes the need to check effective flow area
quiz.explanation: 核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集水容量與反應時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sump storage and response time: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 備援容量與共同失效：機制與系統路徑

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: remainingCapacity=2*40 L/s=80 L/s after one of three equal pumps fails. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一核對電源、控制、吸水和排水共用點及切換試驗。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
