steps.title: 地表恢復與地下資產交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface restoration and underground handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地表恢復與地下資產交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Surface restoration and underground handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地表恢復與地下資產交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface restoration and underground handover"?
options: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A freshly cast permanent slab immediately replaces every temporary brace
quiz.explanation: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地表恢復與地下資產交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface restoration and underground handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地表恢復與地下資產交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surface restoration and underground handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點；若出現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth restored road proves all underground works have been verified" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地表恢復與地下資產交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface restoration and underground handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。
土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection.
Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects
quiz.explanation: 維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。 需以量測區分可能原因。

courses.title: 逆打工法地下結構
courses.summary: 本課以追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載為主線，從永久樓板的早期支撐與預置柱軸力與未支撐長度建立系統邊界，再把牆板接頭與剪力交接、地下水卸載與地層回彈連到施工歷程與永久文件。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls. It begins with Permanent slabs as early braces and Plunge-column force and unbraced length, links Wall-slab joints and shear transfer and Groundwater unloading and ground rebound, and ends with Construction history and permanent records. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載
courses.focusEn: Track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查永久樓板的早期支撐：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m；再獨立檢查預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。樓板軸向面積 0.30 m2、模數 30 GPa 固定，跨長由 20 增為 25 m，理想軸向剛度由 450 降為 360 MN/m，降低 20%；開口與接頭另會減弱。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 將把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Permanent slabs as early braces: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Independently check Plunge-column force and unbraced length: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. At area 0.30 m2 and modulus 30 GPa, increasing length from 20 to 25 m lowers ideal axial stiffness from 450 to 360 MN/m, by 20%; openings and joints add further reductions. The two results are not a complete design because permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Use compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Permanent slabs as early braces" and "Plunge-column force and unbraced length": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「永久樓板的早期支撐」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permanent slabs as early braces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 逆打先建立部分永久樓板，讓它們在向下開挖時支撐連續壁。樓板此時承受水平壓力與自身施工荷載，和竣工垂直受彎狀態不同；接頭、開口與混凝土齡期決定可用剛度，不能把全樓完成模型直接套用。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變；若出現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「永久樓板的早期支撐」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Top-down slabs brace diaphragm walls while excavation proceeds below them. They carry lateral compression and construction loads, unlike only their final vertical bending role. Joints, openings and concrete age define available stiffness, preventing direct use of a fully completed-building model. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permanent slabs as early braces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「永久樓板的早期支撐」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Permanent slabs as early braces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐
knowledge.text: 逆打先建立部分永久樓板，讓它們在向下開挖時支撐連續壁。樓板此時承受水平壓力與自身施工荷載，和竣工垂直受彎狀態不同；接頭、開口與混凝土齡期決定可用剛度，不能把全樓完成模型直接套用。
knowledge.textEn: Top-down slabs brace diaphragm walls while excavation proceeds below them. They carry lateral compression and construction loads, unlike only their final vertical bending role.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「永久樓板的早期支撐」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Permanent slabs as early braces" is correct?
options: 永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同
逆打先建立部分永久樓板，讓它們在向下開挖時支撐連續壁。
每層最後都有樓板所以施工柱永遠按一層高度算
optionsEn: Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading
Top-down slabs brace diaphragm walls while excavation proceeds below them.
Final slabs at every level make construction columns always one storey long
quiz.explanation: 逆打先建立部分永久樓板，讓它們在向下開挖時支撐連續壁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Top-down slabs brace diaphragm walls while excavation proceeds below them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「永久樓板的早期支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permanent slabs as early braces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「永久樓板的早期支撐」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Permanent slabs as early braces", which statement holds?
options: 樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置
樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料
原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。
optionsEn: Adequate slab thickness permits muck-opening locations to be ignored
A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile
Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「永久樓板的早期支撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permanent slabs as early braces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「永久樓板的早期支撐」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Permanent slabs as early braces"?
options: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常
optionsEn: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal
quiz.explanation: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「永久樓板的早期支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permanent slabs as early braces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變；若出現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「永久樓板的早期支撐」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Permanent slabs as early braces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。
每層最後都有樓板所以施工柱永遠按一層高度算
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction.
Final slabs at every level make construction columns always one storey long
quiz.explanation: 未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Plunge-column force and unbraced length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plunge-column force and unbraced length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預置柱在土體逐步挖除時暴露更長區段，樓板尚未完成處不能提供側向拘束。柱同時支承上方已建結構，軸力可能增加而有效長度也增加；檢查最不利施工階段比只看竣工樓層高度更重要。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力；若出現誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation exposes longer plunge-column lengths, and unfinished slabs provide no lateral restraint. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. If final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. steps.title: 預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Plunge-column force and unbraced length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plunge-column force and unbraced length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Plunge-column force and unbraced length", which statement holds?

鋼筋數量符合就代表牆板接頭已完全驗證
坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷

Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint
Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Plunge-column force and unbraced length: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plunge-column force and unbraced length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Plunge-column force and unbraced length"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力。
施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage.
Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design
quiz.explanation: 逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Plunge-column force and unbraced length: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plunge-column force and unbraced length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力；若出現誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每層最後都有樓板所以施工柱永遠按一層高度算」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Final slabs at every level make construction columns always one storey long" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Plunge-column force and unbraced length" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
柱頂位置正確就能保證整支預置柱完全垂直
誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column
Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows.
quiz.explanation: 誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」與「樓板開口與壓力繞行」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Column positioning and load eccentricity" and "Slab openings and force detours": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column positioning and load eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預置柱深埋端的偏位難以在後續修正，柱頂和柱底不共線會讓垂直荷載產生彎矩。平面位置合格也不代表垂直度合格，需沿深度量測；局部接頭可能吸收幾何差，但不可因此忽略偏心力和施工容差。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測；若出現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Embedded plunge-column offsets are difficult to correct, and misaligned ends convert vertical force into bending. Correct plan position does not prove verticality; survey through depth. Connections may accommodate geometry, but eccentric force and construction tolerance still require explicit assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column positioning and load eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column positioning and load eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心
knowledge.text: 預置柱深埋端的偏位難以在後續修正，柱頂和柱底不共線會讓垂直荷載產生彎矩。平面位置合格也不代表垂直度合格，需沿深度量測；局部接頭可能吸收幾何差，但不可因此忽略偏心力和施工容差。
knowledge.textEn: Embedded plunge-column offsets are difficult to correct, and misaligned ends convert vertical force into bending. Correct plan position does not prove verticality; survey through depth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：柱頂位置正確就能保證整支預置柱完全垂直 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Column positioning and load eccentricity" is correct?
options: 預置柱深埋端的偏位難以在後續修正，柱頂和柱底不共線會讓垂直荷載產生彎矩。
柱頂位置正確就能保證整支預置柱完全垂直
樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置
optionsEn: Embedded plunge-column offsets are difficult to correct, and misaligned ends convert vertical force into bending.
Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column
Adequate slab thickness permits muck-opening locations to be ignored

quiz.explanationEn: Embedded plunge-column offsets are difficult to correct, and misaligned ends convert vertical force into bending. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column positioning and load eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常

Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm.
A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column positioning and load eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Column positioning and load eccentricity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion
Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements.
quiz.explanation: 比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Column positioning and load eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測；若出現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「柱頂位置正確就能保證整支預置柱完全垂直」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column positioning and load eccentricity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩。

steps.title: 樓板開口與壓力繞行：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slab openings and force detours: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樓板開口與壓力繞行」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab openings and force detours” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 出土孔和機具孔切斷板內壓力路徑，荷載必須經邊梁或剩餘板帶繞行。以總板寬計算軸向剛度會高估支撐，洞角還可能出現應力集中；臨時封板時序也應列入模型，不能假設最終完整板提前存在。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布；若出現出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樓板開口與壓力繞行」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Muck and plant openings interrupt in-plane compression, forcing it through edge beams or remaining strips. Gross slab width overstates restraint and corners concentrate stress. Include temporary closure timing rather than assuming the final continuous slab exists during excavation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. If an enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slab openings and force detours” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：netArea=grossArea-openingLoss=0.60 m2-0.20 m2=0.40 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: netArea=grossArea-openingLoss=0.60 m2-0.20 m2=0.40 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate slab thickness permits muck-opening locations to be ignored" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樓板開口與壓力繞行」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slab openings and force detours”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓板開口與壓力繞行
knowledge.text: 出土孔和機具孔切斷板內壓力路徑，荷載必須經邊梁或剩餘板帶繞行。以總板寬計算軸向剛度會高估支撐，洞角還可能出現應力集中；臨時封板時序也應列入模型，不能假設最終完整板提前存在。
knowledge.textEn: Muck and plant openings interrupt in-plane compression, forcing it through edge beams or remaining strips. Gross slab width overstates restraint and corners concentrate stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「樓板開口與壓力繞行」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置
出土孔和機具孔切斷板內壓力路徑，荷載必須經邊梁或剩餘板帶繞行。
鋼筋數量符合就代表牆板接頭已完全驗證
optionsEn: Adequate slab thickness permits muck-opening locations to be ignored
Muck and plant openings interrupt in-plane compression, forcing it through edge beams or remaining strips.
Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint
quiz.explanation: 出土孔和機具孔切斷板內壓力路徑，荷載必須經邊梁或剩餘板帶繞行。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Muck and plant openings interrupt in-plane compression, forcing it through edge beams or remaining strips. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樓板開口與壓力繞行：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slab openings and force detours: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板開口與壓力繞行」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slab openings and force detours” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：netArea=grossArea-openingLoss=0.60 m2-0.20 m2=0.40 m2。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: netArea=grossArea-openingLoss=0.60 m2-0.20 m2=0.40 m2. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：netArea=grossArea-openingLoss=0.60 m2-0.20 m2=0.40 m2。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓板開口與壓力繞行」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: netArea=grossArea-openingLoss=0.60 m2-0.20 m2=0.40 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樓板開口與壓力繞行：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slab openings and force detours: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板開口與壓力繞行」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab openings and force detours” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樓板開口與壓力繞行」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Slab openings and force detours"?
options: 核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布。

optionsEn: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading
quiz.explanation: 核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樓板開口與壓力繞行：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slab openings and force detours: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板開口與壓力繞行」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab openings and force detours” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布；若出現出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate slab thickness permits muck-opening locations to be ignored" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樓板開口與壓力繞行」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slab openings and force detours" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂。
鋼筋數量符合就代表牆板接頭已完全驗證
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks.
Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint
quiz.explanation: 出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「牆板接頭與剪力交接」與「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wall-slab joints and shear transfer" and "Under-slab excavation and loading history": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wall-slab joints and shear transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牆板接頭與剪力交接」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樓板與連續壁接頭需傳遞施工水平作用及永久荷載，預留筋、接合器和界面品質共同控制。回填或粉塵可能污染隱蔽接面，名義鋼筋量不能證明接頭已動員；需在下一階段開挖前確認完整的力線與品質證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄；若出現接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牆板接頭與剪力交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall-slab joints transfer temporary lateral and permanent actions through bars, couplers and interface quality. Soil or dust can contaminate concealed surfaces, so nominal reinforcement does not prove engagement. Confirm the complete load path and quality evidence before relying on the joint in the next stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records. If local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：averageShear=V/A=900 kN/0.30 m2=3 MPa, before detailed joint checks。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: averageShear=V/A=900 kN/0.30 m2=3 MPa, before detailed joint checks.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼筋數量符合就代表牆板接頭已完全驗證」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「牆板接頭與剪力交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接
knowledge.text: 樓板與連續壁接頭需傳遞施工水平作用及永久荷載，預留筋、接合器和界面品質共同控制。回填或粉塵可能污染隱蔽接面，名義鋼筋量不能證明接頭已動員；需在下一階段開挖前確認完整的力線與品質證據。
knowledge.textEn: Wall-slab joints transfer temporary lateral and permanent actions through bars, couplers and interface quality. Soil or dust can contaminate concealed surfaces, so nominal reinforcement does not prove engagement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼筋數量符合就代表牆板接頭已完全驗證 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「牆板接頭與剪力交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint
A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile

quiz.explanationEn: Wall-slab joints transfer temporary lateral and permanent actions through bars, couplers and interface quality. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wall-slab joints and shear transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牆板接頭與剪力交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：averageShear=V/A=900 kN/0.30 m2=3 MPa, before detailed joint checks。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: averageShear=V/A=900 kN/0.30 m2=3 MPa, before detailed joint checks. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「牆板接頭與剪力交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal
Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion

steps.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wall-slab joints and shear transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牆板接頭與剪力交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
