quiz.question: 要驗證「牆板接頭與剪力交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wall-slab joints and shear transfer"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄。
每層最後都有樓板所以施工柱永遠按一層高度算
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records.
Final slabs at every level make construction columns always one storey long
quiz.explanation: 核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wall-slab joints and shear transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牆板接頭與剪力交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄；若出現接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼筋數量符合就代表牆板接頭已完全驗證」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「牆板接頭與剪力交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wall-slab joints and shear transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料
接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile
Local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength.
quiz.explanation: 接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Under-slab excavation and loading history” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樓板下開挖會移除原先土體支承，永久板和預置柱逐漸接手荷載。施工機具、土堆與運輸動線產生的暫時荷載可能比服務荷載更集中；材料帳和進度圖必須轉成荷載歷程，不能只描述挖了多少土。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍；若出現同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation below slabs removes soil support and transfers action to permanent slabs and plunge columns. Equipment, stockpiles and transport create concentrated temporary loads. Convert logistics and progress into a load history rather than describing only excavated volume or completed floor area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Under-slab excavation and loading history” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Under-slab excavation and loading history”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程
knowledge.text: 樓板下開挖會移除原先土體支承，永久板和預置柱逐漸接手荷載。施工機具、土堆與運輸動線產生的暫時荷載可能比服務荷載更集中；材料帳和進度圖必須轉成荷載歷程，不能只描述挖了多少土。

knowledge.text: 誤解：樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Under-slab excavation and loading history" is correct?
options: 樓板下開挖會移除原先土體支承，永久板和預置柱逐漸接手荷載。
樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料
坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷
optionsEn: Excavation below slabs removes soil support and transfers action to permanent slabs and plunge columns.
A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile
Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle
quiz.explanation: 樓板下開挖會移除原先土體支承，永久板和預置柱逐漸接手荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Under-slab excavation and loading history: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Under-slab excavation and loading history” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Under-slab excavation and loading history"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
柱頂位置正確就能保證整支預置柱完全垂直

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column
Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs.
quiz.explanation: 對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Under-slab excavation and loading history: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Under-slab excavation and loading history” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍；若出現同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Under-slab excavation and loading history" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷
optionsEn: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle
quiz.explanation: 同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水卸載與地層回彈」與「分階段監測與模型校核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound" and "Staged monitoring and model checks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater unloading and ground rebound: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水卸載與地層回彈」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖減少總應力，降水又增加有效應力，兩者可能造成方向相反的變形。底部回彈與鄰地沉陷可以同時發生，不能用一個水位或沉陷點代表整個場域；模型需保留不同土層壓縮性和排水時間尺度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓；若出現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水卸載與地層回彈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation reduces total stress while dewatering increases effective stress, potentially causing opposite movements. Base rebound and neighbouring settlement can occur together, so one level or displacement cannot represent the site. Retain layer compressibility and drainage time scales in the assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈
knowledge.text: 開挖減少總應力，降水又增加有效應力，兩者可能造成方向相反的變形。底部回彈與鄰地沉陷可以同時發生，不能用一個水位或沉陷點代表整個場域；模型需保留不同土層壓縮性和排水時間尺度。
knowledge.textEn: Excavation reduces total stress while dewatering increases effective stress, potentially causing opposite movements. Base rebound and neighbouring settlement can occur together, so one level or displacement cannot represent the site.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水卸載與地層回彈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound" is correct?
options: 坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷
開挖減少總應力，降水又增加有效應力，兩者可能造成方向相反的變形。
最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常
optionsEn: Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle
Excavation reduces total stress while dewatering increases effective stress, potentially causing opposite movements.
A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal
quiz.explanation: 開挖減少總應力，降水又增加有效應力，兩者可能造成方向相反的變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation reduces total stress while dewatering increases effective stress, potentially causing opposite movements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Groundwater unloading and ground rebound: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound", which statement holds?
options: 工程完工後所有施工階段資料都沒有維護價值
每層最後都有樓板所以施工柱永遠按一層高度算

Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater unloading and ground rebound: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地下水卸載與地層回彈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水卸載與地層回彈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound"?
options: 同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
樓板只要厚度足夠就可以忽略出土孔位置
optionsEn: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate slab thickness permits muck-opening locations to be ignored
quiz.explanation: 同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater unloading and ground rebound: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓；若出現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水卸載與地層回彈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷。
最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement.
A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal
quiz.explanation: 只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分階段監測與模型校核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged monitoring and model checks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分階段監測與模型校核」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged monitoring and model checks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 逆打結構每增加樓板或移除土體，邊界都會改變，監測資料必須依工序分段解讀。將所有讀值擬合成一條連續曲線會混淆剛度改變與地層變化；應比較每個階段增量和預測區間，而非只檢查最終最大位移。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照；若出現中間階段異常被最終回復掩蓋，漏掉已發生的接頭損傷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分階段監測與模型校核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every added slab or removed soil layer changes the boundary, requiring stage-based interpretation. Fitting all readings with one smooth curve confuses stiffness changes with ground behaviour. Compare stage increments with prediction ranges rather than checking only the final maximum movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence. If an intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Staged monitoring and model checks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分階段監測與模型校核」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Staged monitoring and model checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分階段監測與模型校核
knowledge.text: 逆打結構每增加樓板或移除土體，邊界都會改變，監測資料必須依工序分段解讀。將所有讀值擬合成一條連續曲線會混淆剛度改變與地層變化；應比較每個階段增量和預測區間，而非只檢查最終最大位移。
knowledge.textEn: Every added slab or removed soil layer changes the boundary, requiring stage-based interpretation. Fitting all readings with one smooth curve confuses stiffness changes with ground behaviour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分階段監測與模型校核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged monitoring and model checks" is correct?
options: 最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常
施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計
逆打結構每增加樓板或移除土體，邊界都會改變，監測資料必須依工序分段解讀。
optionsEn: A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal
Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design
Every added slab or removed soil layer changes the boundary, requiring stage-based interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 逆打結構每增加樓板或移除土體，邊界都會改變，監測資料必須依工序分段解讀。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every added slab or removed soil layer changes the boundary, requiring stage-based interpretation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分階段監測與模型校核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged monitoring and model checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分階段監測與模型校核」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staged monitoring and model checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分階段監測與模型校核」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged monitoring and model checks", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm。
永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同
柱頂位置正確就能保證整支預置柱完全垂直
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm.
Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading
Correct column-top position guarantees a perfectly vertical plunge column
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分階段監測與模型校核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged monitoring and model checks"?

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence.
Correct reinforcement count proves complete verification of the wall-slab joint

quiz.explanationEn: Compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分階段監測與模型校核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged monitoring and model checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分階段監測與模型校核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Staged monitoring and model checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中間階段異常被最終回復掩蓋，漏掉已發生的接頭損傷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照；若出現中間階段異常被最終回復掩蓋，漏掉已發生的接頭損傷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終位移符合就表示所有中間施工階段都正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分階段監測與模型校核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged monitoring and model checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計
中間階段異常被最終回復掩蓋，漏掉已發生的接頭損傷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design
An intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage.

quiz.explanationEn: An intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基礎接手與永久抗浮」與「施工歷程與永久文件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Foundation transfer and permanent uplift" and "Construction history and permanent records": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基礎接手與永久抗浮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Foundation transfer and permanent uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基礎接手與永久抗浮」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foundation transfer and permanent uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底板完成後，預置柱、永久柱、樁和連續壁的荷載分配可能改變，還需承受地下水恢復。施工支承不會自動消失，接頭和剛度決定轉移比例；抗浮評估應避免把同一根樁的承壓和拉拔能力同時當作可任意動員。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查底板接頭、樁荷重與恢復水位時的結構反應；若出現永久抗浮未含水位恢復，底板上抬並拉裂牆板接面，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基礎接手與永久抗浮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Base completion changes load sharing among plunge columns, permanent columns, piles and walls while groundwater recovers. Temporary support does not disappear automatically; joint and stiffness govern transfer. Uplift assessment must not treat a pile's compression and tension capacities as freely simultaneous resources. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check base joints, pile loads and structural response as groundwater recovers. If omitted groundwater recovery lifts the base and cracks its wall interfaces, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foundation transfer and permanent uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基礎接手與永久抗浮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Foundation transfer and permanent uplift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基礎接手與永久抗浮
knowledge.text: 底板完成後，預置柱、永久柱、樁和連續壁的荷載分配可能改變，還需承受地下水恢復。施工支承不會自動消失，接頭和剛度決定轉移比例；抗浮評估應避免把同一根樁的承壓和拉拔能力同時當作可任意動員。
knowledge.textEn: Base completion changes load sharing among plunge columns, permanent columns, piles and walls while groundwater recovers. Temporary support does not disappear automatically; joint and stiffness govern transfer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基礎接手與永久抗浮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Foundation transfer and permanent uplift" is correct?
options: 底板完成後，預置柱、永久柱、樁和連續壁的荷載分配可能改變，還需承受地下水恢復。
施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計
工程完工後所有施工階段資料都沒有維護價值
optionsEn: Base completion changes load sharing among plunge columns, permanent columns, piles and walls while groundwater recovers.
Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design
Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion
quiz.explanation: 底板完成後，預置柱、永久柱、樁和連續壁的荷載分配可能改變，還需承受地下水恢復。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foundation transfer and permanent uplift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查底板接頭、樁荷重與恢復水位時的結構反應。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查底板接頭、樁荷重與恢復水位時的結構反應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「永久抗浮未含水位恢復，底板上抬並拉裂牆板接面」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check base joints, pile loads and structural response as groundwater recovers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Omitted groundwater recovery lifts the base and cracks its wall interfaces. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. steps.title: 基礎接手與永久抗浮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation transfer and permanent uplift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基礎接手與永久抗浮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation transfer and permanent uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 永久抗浮未含水位恢復，底板上抬並拉裂牆板接面。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查底板接頭、樁荷重與恢復水位時的結構反應，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted groundwater recovery lifts the base and cracks its wall interfaces. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check base joints, pile loads and structural response as groundwater recovers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If omitted groundwater recovery lifts the base and cracks its wall interfaces, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工期持續抽水就能永久免除抗浮設計」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Continuous construction dewatering permanently removes the need for uplift design" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check base joints, pile loads and structural response as groundwater recovers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 施工歷程與永久文件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction history and permanent records: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工歷程與永久文件」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction history and permanent records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 逆打交接需要保留曾經發生的荷載與變形，而不只是最後幾何。埋入柱、接頭和臨時開口關閉後不易追查，若缺少版本，未來改造可能破壞仍在工作的傳力路徑；永久管理應知道哪些構件兼具歷史施工角色。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本；若出現改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工歷程與永久文件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handover needs historical loads and movements as well as final geometry. Embedded columns, joints and closed temporary openings become difficult to investigate. Missing revisions can let later alterations interrupt an active load path, so management must understand members with both construction and permanent roles. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier. If renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction history and permanent records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：recordLinkage=stagesWithVerifiedRecords/requiredStages=11/12=91.7 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: recordLinkage=stagesWithVerifiedRecords/requiredStages=11/12=91.7 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「工程完工後所有施工階段資料都沒有維護價值」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工歷程與永久文件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction history and permanent records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Handover needs historical loads and movements as well as final geometry. Embedded columns, joints and closed temporary openings become difficult to investigate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：工程完工後所有施工階段資料都沒有維護價值 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction history and permanent records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：recordLinkage=stagesWithVerifiedRecords/requiredStages=11/12=91.7 percent。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: recordLinkage=stagesWithVerifiedRecords/requiredStages=11/12=91.7 percent. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle
quiz.explanation: 按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工歷程與永久文件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction history and permanent records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工歷程與永久文件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction history and permanent records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本；若出現改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「工程完工後所有施工階段資料都沒有維護價值」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工歷程與永久文件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction history and permanent records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐。
永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support.
Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading
quiz.explanation: 改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運
courses.summary: 本課以整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面為主線，從預製體積與結構質量與排水體積與浮力平衡建立系統邊界，再把吃水變化與水線面、預製溫度與節段變形連到浮運放行與資料一致性。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces. It begins with Fabrication volume and structural mass and Displacement and buoyancy balance, links Draft change and waterplane area and Fabrication temperature and segment deformation, and ends with Flotation release and record consistency. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面
courses.focusEn: Integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查預製體積與結構質量：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t；再獨立檢查排水體積與浮力平衡：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。結構質量由 60000 增為 63000 t，海水密度 1.025 t/m3，平衡排水體積由 58536.6 增為 61463.4 m3；質量增加 5% 不代表穩性也改善 5%。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 將比較流速方向、管節姿態及拖航系統荷重紀錄作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Fabrication volume and structural mass: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Independently check Displacement and buoyancy balance: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3. Mass rising from 60000 to 63000 t at seawater density 1.025 t/m3 increases displacement from 58536.6 to 61463.4 m3; five percent more mass does not imply five percent better stability. The two results are not a complete design because buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Use compare current direction, element attitude and tow-system load records as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製體積與結構質量」與「排水體積與浮力平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fabrication volume and structural mass" and "Displacement and buoyancy balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預製體積與結構質量」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fabrication volume and structural mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。公噸是質量而非力，受力計算還需重力加速度；材料密度與實際幾何誤差應分開追蹤，才可判斷預測吃水差異來源。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預製體積與結構質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity. Track density and geometry errors separately to diagnose differences between predicted and observed draft. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fabrication volume and structural mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預製體積與結構質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fabrication volume and structural mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製體積與結構質量
knowledge.text: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。公噸是質量而非力，受力計算還需重力加速度；材料密度與實際幾何誤差應分開追蹤，才可判斷預測吃水差異來源。
knowledge.textEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製體積與結構質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fabrication volume and structural mass" is correct?
options: 管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。
能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復
optionsEn: Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone.
A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination
quiz.explanation: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預製體積與結構質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製體積與結構質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fabrication volume and structural mass", which statement holds?
options: 加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全
原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。
optionsEn: Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety
Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製體積與結構質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fabrication volume and structural mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event

quiz.explanationEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預製體積與結構質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
