steps.title: 淨重與基床平均壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Submerged weight and mean bed pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淨重與基床平均壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submerged weight and mean bed pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照壓載及水位狀態，核對所用淨重與接觸面積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「重複扣除浮力導致平均壓力偏低，沉陷預測失準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check net force and contact area against ballast and water-level states. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Double-counted buoyancy lowers estimated pressure and mispredicts settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 在「淨重與基床平均壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深部壓縮與總沉陷」與「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「深部壓縮與總沉陷」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deep compression and total settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深部壓縮與總沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress. Drainage time and stress history modify actual response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deep compression and total settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deep compression and total settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷
knowledge.text: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。簡化一維沉陷模型使用應力增量、壓縮性和層厚，需區分有效應力和總應力；排水時間與應力歷史會改變實際反應。
knowledge.textEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. A one-dimensional settlement model uses stress increment, compressibility and thickness, requiring effective rather than indiscriminate total stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「深部壓縮與總沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deep compression and total settlement" is correct?
options: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。
基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮
總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動
optionsEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position.
A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress
Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
quiz.explanation: 平整基床下面的軟弱層仍會壓縮，管節表面施工容差不能代表長期位置穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Weak layers beneath level bedding can compress, so construction tolerance does not establish long-term position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deep compression and total settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deep compression and total settlement", which statement holds?
options: 均勻係數相同就代表兩種基床材料性能完全相同
原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。
把所有誤差平方和開根號就能消除共同基準偏差
optionsEn: Equal uniformity coefficients prove identical performance of two bedding materials
Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm.
Root-sum-square of errors eliminates every shared datum bias
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: s=mv*dSigma*H=0.0002 /kPa*50 kPa*5 m=0.05 m=50 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「深部壓縮與總沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deep compression and total settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「深部壓縮與總沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deep compression and total settlement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地形圖看起來連續就代表每一點都實際量測過
將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A continuous-looking terrain map proves every point was directly measured
Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure.
quiz.explanation: 將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 深部壓縮與總沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deep compression and total settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「深部壓縮與總沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deep compression and total settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較；若出現只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基床表面平整就能證明深部地層不會壓縮」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分層地質壓縮試驗與管節水準、孔隙水壓共同比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare layer compression tests with element levels and pore pressure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「深部壓縮與總沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deep compression and total settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動
optionsEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
quiz.explanation: 只驗收基床表面平整而漏掉深部軟層，長期整體沉降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface-level acceptance misses a deep soft layer and long-term settlement follows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential settlement and joint rotation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。單一管節的端點差除長度是弦傾角；本算例額外假定該管節為剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才可把弦傾角當接頭相對轉角。一般情況須取接頭兩側斜率差，實際還有彎曲及接頭剪力；應沿縱向保留多點量測而不只記兩岸高程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移；若出現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. Endpoint difference divided by element length is chord inclination. Only the additional assumptions of a rigid element and a horizontal neighboring element make it relative joint rotation here; otherwise compare slopes on both sides. Bending and joint shear also occur. Preserve multiple longitudinal observations rather than relying on the shore-end elevations alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential settlement and joint rotation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential settlement and joint rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角
knowledge.text: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。單一管節的端點差除長度是弦傾角；本算例額外假定該管節為剛體且相鄰管節保持水平，才可把弦傾角當接頭相對轉角。
knowledge.textEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. Endpoint difference divided by element length is chord inclination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential settlement and joint rotation" is correct?
options: 總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動
相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。
材料總量足夠就能保證每處基床厚度相同
optionsEn: Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate
Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small.
Adequate total material guarantees equal bedding thickness everywhere
quiz.explanation: 相鄰管節沉陷不同會使接頭旋轉，平均總沉陷小也可能有較大局部角差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different settlement of adjacent elements rotates joints, even when mean settlement is small. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential settlement and joint rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential settlement and joint rotation", which statement holds?
options: 平均基床壓力低就能保證局部不會壓碎
管節落位驗收後基床支承就永遠不會改變
原創教學假設：chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor。

Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: chordInclination=settlementDifference/length=20 mm/200000 mm=0.0001 rad; relativeJointRotation=chordInclination only for this rigid element beside an assumed horizontal neighbor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and joint rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential settlement and joint rotation"?
options: 逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
出土量達到設計值就能保證溝槽形狀正確
optionsEn: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Design dredged volume guarantees the correct trench shape
quiz.explanation: 逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與接頭轉角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and joint rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and joint rotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移；若出現局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總平均沉陷很小就代表接頭不會轉動」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small overall average settlement means joints cannot rotate" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐管節比較端部高程、縱向曲率與接頭位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare end levels, longitudinal curvature and joint movement for every element to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷與接頭轉角」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and joint rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判。
材料總量足夠就能保證每處基床厚度相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand.
Adequate total material guarantees equal bedding thickness everywhere
quiz.explanation: 局部軟區造成端部轉角，密封位移需求被平均沉陷漏判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A soft local zone rotates an end and mean settlement misses the seal demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「墊層厚度與材料收支」與「粒徑分布與水下離析」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bedding thickness and material balance" and "Grading and underwater segregation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 墊層厚度與材料收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bedding thickness and material balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「墊層厚度與材料收支」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bedding thickness and material balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 基床材料厚度需配合原海床起伏，理論鋪料體積不能證明每一位置都達到厚度。水下離析和流失會改變局部級配，鬆鋪與壓實體積也不同；收支帳應與測深和材料性質一起解讀，而非用總噸數取代幾何驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較鋪料前後海床面、材料密度及可追溯批次；若出現局部薄層被其他區域超填平均掉，形成不均勻支承，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墊層厚度與材料收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bedding thickness follows underlying terrain, and theoretical placement volume does not prove every point. Underwater segregation and loss change grading, while loose and compacted volumes differ. Interpret mass balance with bathymetry and material properties rather than replacing geometry with total tonnage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare pre/post-placement surfaces, material density and traceable batches. If local thin bedding is averaged against overfill elsewhere and creates uneven support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bedding thickness and material balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Vbed=area*thickness=4000 m2*0.60 m=2400 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Vbed=area*thickness=4000 m2*0.60 m=2400 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「材料總量足夠就能保證每處基床厚度相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total material guarantees equal bedding thickness everywhere" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「墊層厚度與材料收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bedding thickness and material balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 墊層厚度與材料收支

steps.title: 墊層厚度與材料收支：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bedding thickness and material balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Vbed=area*thickness=4000 m2*0.60 m=2400 m3。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Vbed=area*thickness=4000 m2*0.60 m=2400 m3. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較鋪料前後海床面、材料密度及可追溯批次。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 比較鋪料前後海床面、材料密度及可追溯批次。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部薄層被其他區域超填平均掉，形成不均勻支承」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre/post-placement surfaces, material density and traceable batches. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local thin bedding is averaged against overfill elsewhere and creates uneven support. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare pre/post-placement surfaces, material density and traceable batches. steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部薄層被其他區域超填平均掉，形成不均勻支承。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 墊層厚度與材料收支：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墊層厚度與材料收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bedding thickness and material balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部薄層被其他區域超填平均掉，形成不均勻支承。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較鋪料前後海床面、材料密度及可追溯批次，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local thin bedding is averaged against overfill elsewhere and creates uneven support. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare pre/post-placement surfaces, material density and traceable batches to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較鋪料前後海床面、材料密度及可追溯批次；若出現局部薄層被其他區域超填平均掉，形成不均勻支承，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local thin bedding is averaged against overfill elsewhere and creates uneven support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「材料總量足夠就能保證每處基床厚度相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate total material guarantees equal bedding thickness everywhere" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 粒徑級配影響可整平性、滲透和抗流失能力，但均勻係數只是分布的一個指標。水下放料可能使細料和粗料分離，取樣若只來自岸上料堆便無法反映原位狀態；材料相容要與基底土層和水流一起評估。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線；若出現細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粒徑分布與水下離析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

If washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Cu=d60/d10=4.0 mm/0.5 mm=8, not a complete filter criterion。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Cu=d60/d10=4.0 mm/0.5 mm=8, not a complete filter criterion. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 粒徑分布與水下離析：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grading and underwater segregation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「粒徑分布與水下離析」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grading and underwater segregation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「粒徑分布與水下離析」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

A level bed surface proves deeper ground cannot compress
Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 粒徑分布與水下離析：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grading and underwater segregation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粒徑分布與水下離析」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grading and underwater segregation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線；若出現細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「均勻係數相同就代表兩種基床材料性能完全相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal uniformity coefficients prove identical performance of two bedding materials" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 細料被流走形成粗骨架，局部孔隙與接觸剛度改變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較料源與水下代表樣本的完整粒徑曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare full grading curves from the source and representative submerged samples to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「粒徑分布與水下離析」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grading and underwater segregation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
平均基床壓力低就能保證局部不會壓碎

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Low mean bedding pressure guarantees no local crushing

quiz.explanationEn: Washed-out fines leave a coarse skeleton with changed voids and contact stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高點接觸與局部壓力」與「測深誤差與共同基準」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-point contact and local pressure" and "Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高點接觸與局部壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High-point contact and local pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高點接觸與局部壓力」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-point contact and local pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 少數高點可能先接觸管節，使荷載集中而其他區域仍懸空。總平均壓力因此會低估局部壓碎或管底彎曲，接觸面隨沉放及材料變形逐步改變；應區分設計底面積與已證實的受壓面積。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將高程殘差、接觸證據與管底應變共同比對；若出現基床高點局部壓碎造成突然坐落與接頭姿態變化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高點接觸與局部壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A few high spots engage first and concentrate load while other areas remain unsupported. Mean pressure then understates crushing or underside bending, and contact evolves during settlement and material deformation. Distinguish design base area from verified loaded area rather than assuming full bearing. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare elevation residuals, contact evidence and element-bottom strain. If high spots crush locally and cause abrupt seating and changed joint alignment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High-point contact and local pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：localPressure=20000 kN/200 m2=100 kPa versus 5 kPa over 4000 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: localPressure=20000 kN/200 m2=100 kPa versus 5 kPa over 4000 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均基床壓力低就能保證局部不會壓碎」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean bedding pressure guarantees no local crushing" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高點接觸與局部壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High-point contact and local pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A few high spots engage first and concentrate load while other areas remain unsupported. Mean pressure then understates crushing or underside bending, and contact evolves during settlement and material deformation.

knowledge.text: 誤解：平均基床壓力低就能保證局部不會壓碎 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean bedding pressure guarantees no local crushing Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High-point contact and local pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基床高點局部壓碎造成突然坐落與接頭姿態變化。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將高程殘差、接觸證據與管底應變共同比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High spots crush locally and cause abrupt seating and changed joint alignment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare elevation residuals, contact evidence and element-bottom strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將高程殘差、接觸證據與管底應變共同比對；若出現基床高點局部壓碎造成突然坐落與接頭姿態變化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If high spots crush locally and cause abrupt seating and changed joint alignment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均基床壓力低就能保證局部不會壓碎」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low mean bedding pressure guarantees no local crushing" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 測深誤差與共同基準：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「測深誤差與共同基準」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下測量受水位、聲速、姿態與定位誤差影響，單一漂亮網格不代表垂直精度。獨立隨機分量可平方和合成，但共同基準偏差不能這樣消除；需保存原始校正及不同測期使用的垂直基準，避免將儀器差當成基床變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差；若出現兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測深誤差與共同基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bathymetry depends on water level, sound speed, attitude and position, not just a smooth grid. Independent random terms combine by root-sum-square, while shared datum bias does not disappear that way. Preserve calibration and vertical references across epochs to distinguish instrument differences from bed changes. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals. If inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.02,0.03,0.02 m; sigmaCombined=sqrt(0.02^2+0.03^2+0.02^2)=0.0412 m for independent random components。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.02,0.03,0.02 m; sigmaCombined=sqrt(0.02^2+0.03^2+0.02^2)=0.0412 m for independent random components.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Root-sum-square of errors eliminates every shared datum bias" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.02,0.03,0.02 m; sigmaCombined=sqrt(0.02^2+0.03^2+0.02^2)=0.0412 m for independent random components。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.02,0.03,0.02 m; sigmaCombined=sqrt(0.02^2+0.03^2+0.02^2)=0.0412 m for independent random components. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測深誤差與共同基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測深誤差與共同基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測深誤差與共同基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差。
材料總量足夠就能保證每處基床厚度相同
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals.
Adequate total material guarantees equal bedding thickness everywhere
quiz.explanation: 核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測深誤差與共同基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測深誤差與共同基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差；若出現兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把所有誤差平方和開根號就能消除共同基準偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Root-sum-square of errors eliminates every shared datum bias" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對水位基準、聲速剖面及交叉測線閉合差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check water-level datum, sound-speed profiles and cross-line closure residuals to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測深誤差與共同基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bathymetric uncertainty and shared datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
管節落位驗收後基床支承就永遠不會改變
兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance
Inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment.
quiz.explanation: 兩期水位基準不一致造成假高點，導致錯誤整平判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inconsistent epoch datums create false high spots and misdirect leveling assessment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沖刷與長期基床保護」與「基床交接與長期基線」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scour and long-term bed protection" and "Bedding handover and long-term baseline": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沖刷與長期基床保護：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scour and long-term bed protection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沖刷與長期基床保護」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scour and long-term bed protection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水流可能移動保護層或細粒，使原本接觸良好的基床逐漸失去支承。局部流速受地形、船舶和構造邊緣影響，不等於遠處平均流速；保護設計與監測需確認材料穩定、濾層連續和可觀察的海床變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以重複測深、局部流速及保護層完整性共同追蹤；若出現邊緣細料流失形成空洞，管節初始驗收合格仍逐年變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沖刷與長期基床保護」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Currents can move cover or fines and progressively remove bedding support. Local speed reflects topography, vessels and structural edges rather than distant mean flow. Protection and monitoring need evidence of material stability, filter continuity and observable seabed change instead of a single current reading. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Track repeated bathymetry, local currents and protection-layer continuity together. If edge-fine loss creates voids and gradual movement despite initial acceptance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scour and long-term bed protection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：velocityPressure=0.5*rho*v^2=0.5*1025 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2=2050 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: velocityPressure=0.5*rho*v^2=0.5*1025 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2=2050 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管節落位驗收後基床支承就永遠不會改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沖刷與長期基床保護」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scour and long-term bed protection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沖刷與長期基床保護
knowledge.text: 水流可能移動保護層或細粒，使原本接觸良好的基床逐漸失去支承。局部流速受地形、船舶和構造邊緣影響，不等於遠處平均流速；保護設計與監測需確認材料穩定、濾層連續和可觀察的海床變化。
knowledge.textEn: Currents can move cover or fines and progressively remove bedding support. Local speed reflects topography, vessels and structural edges rather than distant mean flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管節落位驗收後基床支承就永遠不會改變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沖刷與長期基床保護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scour and long-term bed protection" is correct?
options: 水流可能移動保護層或細粒，使原本接觸良好的基床逐漸失去支承。

optionsEn: Currents can move cover or fines and progressively remove bedding support.
Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance
A continuous-looking terrain map proves every point was directly measured

quiz.explanationEn: Currents can move cover or fines and progressively remove bedding support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沖刷與長期基床保護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scour and long-term bed protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沖刷與長期基床保護」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scour and long-term bed protection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：velocityPressure=0.5*rho*v^2=0.5*1025 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2=2050 Pa。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: velocityPressure=0.5*rho*v^2=0.5*1025 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2=2050 Pa. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複測深、局部流速及保護層完整性共同追蹤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track repeated bathymetry, local currents and protection-layer continuity together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：velocityPressure=0.5*rho*v^2=0.5*1025 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2=2050 Pa。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: velocityPressure=0.5*rho*v^2=0.5*1025 kg/m3*(2 m/s)^2=2050 Pa. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沖刷與長期基床保護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scour and long-term bed protection", which statement holds?

steps.title: 沖刷與長期基床保護：試驗與驗證

steps.title: 沖刷與長期基床保護：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沖刷與長期基床保護」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scour and long-term bed protection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 邊緣細料流失形成空洞，管節初始驗收合格仍逐年變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以重複測深、局部流速及保護層完整性共同追蹤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Edge-fine loss creates voids and gradual movement despite initial acceptance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track repeated bathymetry, local currents and protection-layer continuity together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以重複測深、局部流速及保護層完整性共同追蹤；若出現邊緣細料流失形成空洞，管節初始驗收合格仍逐年變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If edge-fine loss creates voids and gradual movement despite initial acceptance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管節落位驗收後基床支承就永遠不會改變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bedding support never changes after placement acceptance" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 基床交接與長期基線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bedding handover and long-term baseline: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基床交接與長期基線」如何影響沉管基床整平的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bedding handover and long-term baseline” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下基床完工後不可直接目視，其數位地形與取樣資料是後續診斷的基準。驗收圖應區分實測、插值及未覆蓋區，還要連到測量時間和水位；把整張彩色圖都當作同精度證據會隱藏關鍵盲區。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標；若出現未測區被平滑插值掩蓋，日後沉陷缺少可追溯基準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基床交接與長期基線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After placement, bedding is no longer directly visible, making digital terrain and sample records diagnostic baselines. Distinguish measured, interpolated and uncovered zones and link time and water level. Treating a coloured map as uniformly accurate conceals critical evidence gaps for later maintenance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Index survey coverage, uncertainty, samples and element position to common coordinates. If smoothing hides an unsurveyed zone and later settlement lacks a traceable baseline, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bedding handover and long-term baseline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：surveyCoverage=measuredArea/requiredArea=3800 m2/4000 m2=95 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: surveyCoverage=measuredArea/requiredArea=3800 m2/4000 m2=95 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地形圖看起來連續就代表每一點都實際量測過」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A continuous-looking terrain map proves every point was directly measured" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基床交接與長期基線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bedding handover and long-term baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：地形圖看起來連續就代表每一點都實際量測過 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bedding handover and long-term baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：surveyCoverage=measuredArea/requiredArea=3800 m2/4000 m2=95 percent。測得平整不代表全部接觸，基床與深部地層的長期變形須分開。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: surveyCoverage=measuredArea/requiredArea=3800 m2/4000 m2=95 percent. Measured levelness does not prove full contact; bedding and deeper-ground deformation require separate assessment. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將測線覆蓋、誤差、取樣及管節位置索引到同一座標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Index survey coverage, uncertainty, samples and element position to common coordinates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
