steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact"?
options: 核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壓力乘密封跨距即可直接得到所有位置的膜張力
optionsEn: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
quiz.explanation: 核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對剪力鍵間隙、接觸痕跡與鄰近混凝土裂縫；若出現鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪力鍵外觀面積全部都會同時均勻承受剪力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check shear-key gaps, contact marks and nearby concrete cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪力鍵承壓與接觸偏心」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shear-key bearing and eccentric contact" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。
接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low.
Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
quiz.explanation: 鍵角先接觸引發混凝土劈裂，平均承壓計算仍顯示偏低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Corner-first contact splits concrete while an average bearing calculation remains low. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compartment leakage and source diagnosis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區滲漏與來源辨識」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭集水量可能來自主密封、次級密封、螺栓穿孔或周邊施工縫，不是單憑出水位置就能定位缺口。比較分區壓力與時間響應可縮小來源，總流量還受外水位影響；低流量不能證明兩重屏障均保持完整。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化；若出現匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區滲漏與來源辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints. Outlet location alone does not locate the breach. Compartment pressure and time response narrow the source, while external water level affects total flow; low flow does not demonstrate two intact barriers. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together. If combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區滲漏與來源辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識
knowledge.text: 接頭集水量可能來自主密封、次級密封、螺栓穿孔或周邊施工縫，不是單憑出水位置就能定位缺口。比較分區壓力與時間響應可縮小來源，總流量還受外水位影響；低流量不能證明兩重屏障均保持完整。
knowledge.textEn: Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints. Outlet location alone does not locate the breach.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區滲漏與來源辨識」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compartment leakage and source diagnosis" is correct?
options: 接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷
壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低
接頭集水量可能來自主密封、次級密封、螺栓穿孔或周邊施工縫，不是單憑出水位置就能定位缺口。
optionsEn: Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free
Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time
Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints.
quiz.explanation: 接頭集水量可能來自主密封、次級密封、螺栓穿孔或周邊施工縫，不是單憑出水位置就能定位缺口。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Collected joint water can originate at primary seals, secondary seals, penetrations or adjacent construction joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: collectedFlow=12 L/30 min=0.40 L/min. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「分區滲漏與來源辨識」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compartment leakage and source diagnosis", which statement holds?

兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸

steps.title: 分區滲漏與來源辨識：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compartment leakage and source diagnosis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區滲漏與來源辨識」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment leakage and source diagnosis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record compartment pressure, collected flow and external water-level changes together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄分區水壓、集水量及外水位變化；若出現匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接頭集水少就能證明主次兩道密封都毫無缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low collected joint flow proves both primary and secondary seals are defect-free" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區滲漏與來源辨識」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

匯集管混接使異處滲水被歸因接頭，修繕後流量不降。

Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time
Combined collection lines misattribute remote seepage to a joint and repairs do not reduce flow.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力鬆弛與長期密封」與「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress relaxation and long-term sealing" and "Barrier independence and handover records": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress relaxation and long-term sealing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力鬆弛與長期密封」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 橡膠在近固定壓縮下仍會應力鬆弛，溫度、老化和化學環境共同改變長期接觸反力。短期保持率只是特定試驗條件的比較，不是現場壽命或剩餘承壓能力；長期評估需保持幾何變形與材料劣化資料之間的對應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移；若出現將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力鬆弛與長期密封」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force. Short-term retention compares specified test conditions, not field lifetime or remaining pressure capacity. Long-term assessment must link material degradation evidence with actual geometric deformation histories. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力鬆弛與長期密封」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封
knowledge.text: 橡膠在近固定壓縮下仍會應力鬆弛，溫度、老化和化學環境共同改變長期接觸反力。短期保持率只是特定試驗條件的比較，不是現場壽命或剩餘承壓能力；長期評估需保持幾何變形與材料劣化資料之間的對應。
knowledge.textEn: Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force. Short-term retention compares specified test conditions, not field lifetime or remaining pressure capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力鬆弛與長期密封」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stress relaxation and long-term sealing" is correct?
options: 橡膠在近固定壓縮下仍會應力鬆弛，溫度、老化和化學環境共同改變長期接觸反力。
壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低
只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障
optionsEn: Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force.
Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time
Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection
quiz.explanation: 橡膠在近固定壓縮下仍會應力鬆弛，溫度、老化和化學環境共同改變長期接觸反力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rubber relaxes under nearly fixed compression, with temperature, aging and chemistry altering long-term contact force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress relaxation and long-term sealing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應力鬆弛與長期密封」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「應力鬆弛與長期密封」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stress relaxation and long-term sealing", which statement holds?
options: 橡膠壓縮率相同就代表任何密封斷面的反力相同

optionsEn: Equal rubber compression ratios imply equal reaction for every seal profile
Original teaching assumptions: forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression.
Pressure times seal span directly gives membrane tension at every location
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: forceRetention=180 kN/240 kN=0.75=75 percent at equal imposed compression. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stress relaxation and long-term sealing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應力鬆弛與長期密封」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應力鬆弛與長期密封」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stress relaxation and long-term sealing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
量測接頭中央一個開度就能代表整圈密封變形
比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
One central opening measurement represents deformation around the entire seal
Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories.
quiz.explanation: 比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 應力鬆弛與長期密封：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stress relaxation and long-term sealing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「應力鬆弛與長期密封」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stress relaxation and long-term sealing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移；若出現將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓縮量固定就表示橡膠密封反力永遠不會降低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fixed compression means rubber sealing reaction never decreases over time" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較相同壓縮與溫度的保載試驗及接頭歷時位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sustained-compression tests at equal temperature with joint movement histories to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「應力鬆弛與長期密封」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stress relaxation and long-term sealing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將加速試驗小時數直接當服役年數，錯估長期密封反力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障
optionsEn: Equating accelerated-test hours directly to service years misestimates long-term seal reaction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection

steps.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Barrier independence and handover records: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」如何影響沉管水下對接與止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Barrier independence and handover records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underwater immersed-tube joining and sealing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主次密封若共用同一失效夾持件或受同一大位移破壞，就不構成完全獨立的備援。交接需對應各屏障試驗、幾何、材料和可檢查部位，完整率僅顯示證據缺口；缺失一項關鍵試驗不能由更多非關鍵紀錄補足。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單；若出現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Primary and secondary seals are not fully independent if they share a failed restraint or suffer the same excessive movement. Handover links separate barrier tests, geometry, materials and accessible locations. Record completeness reveals evidence gaps; many minor records cannot compensate for a missing critical barrier test. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Barrier independence and handover records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Barrier independence and handover records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案
knowledge.text: 主次密封若共用同一失效夾持件或受同一大位移破壞，就不構成完全獨立的備援。交接需對應各屏障試驗、幾何、材料和可檢查部位，完整率僅顯示證據缺口；缺失一項關鍵試驗不能由更多非關鍵紀錄補足。
knowledge.textEn: Primary and secondary seals are not fully independent if they share a failed restraint or suffer the same excessive movement. Handover links separate barrier tests, geometry, materials and accessible locations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Barrier independence and handover records" is correct?
options: 只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障
主次密封若共用同一失效夾持件或受同一大位移破壞，就不構成完全獨立的備援。
兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸
optionsEn: Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection
Primary and secondary seals are not fully independent if they share a failed restraint or suffer the same excessive movement.
Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
quiz.explanation: 主次密封若共用同一失效夾持件或受同一大位移破壞，就不構成完全獨立的備援。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Primary and secondary seals are not fully independent if they share a failed restraint or suffer the same excessive movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Barrier independence and handover records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Barrier independence and handover records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability。接頭算例將剛體位移與橡膠變形分開；實際密封反力需特定斷面、溫度、老化及試驗資料。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability. Joint examples separate rigid-body movement from rubber deformation; actual seal reactions require profile, temperature, aging and test data. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Barrier independence and handover records", which statement holds?
options: 外水壓乘全部濕表面就等於接頭軸向合攏力
長管節的自由熱伸縮必定全部集中在單一接頭
原創教學假設：traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability。
optionsEn: External pressure times every wet surface equals the axial joint-closing force
All free thermal expansion of a long element concentrates at one joint
Original teaching assumptions: traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: traceableTests=18/20=90 percent; completeness is not reliability. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Barrier independence and handover records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Barrier independence and handover records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Barrier independence and handover records"?
options: 逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

The full visible shear-key area always carries shear uniformly

steps.title: 屏障獨立性與交接檔案：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Barrier independence and handover records: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單；若出現雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要安裝兩道密封就必定得到完全獨立的雙重保障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two seals always creates completely independent redundant protection" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項對照兩道屏障試驗與共同失效構件清單，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile individual barrier tests with the inventory of shared failure components to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「屏障獨立性與交接檔案」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Barrier independence and handover records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。
兩管節中心對準就代表周邊密封必定均勻接觸
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy.
Aligned element centers guarantee uniform contact around the entire seal
quiz.explanation: 雙重密封共用的夾具失效，同時破壞被誤認為獨立的備援。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared clamp failure defeats two barriers incorrectly treated as independent redundancy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 箱涵頂進施工
courses.summary: 本課以箱涵頂進的力鏈、地層損失與營運界面為主線，從箱涵自重與滑移界面與油壓推力與後座反力建立系統邊界，再把刃口接觸與局部承壓、姿態修正與曲線相容連到封鎖窗口與恢復證據。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on box-jacking load paths, ground loss and operating interfaces. It begins with Box weight and sliding interfaces and Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force, links Cutting-edge contact and local bearing and Attitude correction and path compatibility, and ends with Possession windows and restoration evidence. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 箱涵頂進的力鏈、地層損失與營運界面
courses.focusEn: Box-jacking load paths, ground loss and operating interfaces
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查箱涵自重與滑移界面：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN；再獨立檢查油壓推力與後座反力：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。假設摩擦係數從 0.15 增至 0.25，自重 5760 kN 對應的底面摩擦由 864 增至 1440 kN；未含側摩阻及切口阻力。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 將將原位換算出土量、周邊間隙及地表沉陷按里程對齊作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Box weight and sliding interfaces: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Independently check Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN. Increasing assumed friction from 0.15 to 0.25 raises base friction for 5760 kN weight from 864 to 1440 kN, excluding side friction and cutting resistance. The two results are not a complete design because rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. Use align in-situ-equivalent spoil, peripheral gaps and surface settlement by chainage as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「箱涵自重與滑移界面」與「油壓推力與後座反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Box weight and sliding interfaces" and "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「箱涵自重與滑移界面」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Box weight and sliding interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。自重決定底面接觸的部分法向力，浮力和地層反力則會改變分布；把外包體積全部視為實心會高估重量並扭曲推力預估。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區；若出現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「箱涵自重與滑移界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. Weight contributes to base normal force, modified by buoyancy and soil reactions. Treating the bounding volume as solid overstates mass and distorts thrust estimates. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Box weight and sliding interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Box weight and sliding interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面
knowledge.text: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。自重決定底面接觸的部分法向力，浮力和地層反力則會改變分布；把外包體積全部視為實心會高估重量並扭曲推力預估。
knowledge.textEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. Weight contributes to base normal force, modified by buoyancy and soil reactions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「箱涵自重與滑移界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Box weight and sliding interfaces" is correct?
options: 箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積
箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
optionsEn: Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume
Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water.
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
quiz.explanation: 箱涵混凝土截面由外框扣除內孔得到，但附屬設備、臨時構件與積水仍需另計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtract the internal void from the outer rectangle to obtain concrete area, while accounting separately for equipment, temporary works and water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Box weight and sliding interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Box weight and sliding interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
optionsEn: A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ac=8 m*5 m-7 m*4 m=12 m2; W=24 kN/m3*12 m2*20 m=5760 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「箱涵自重與滑移界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Box weight and sliding interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 箱涵自重與滑移界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Box weight and sliding interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「箱涵自重與滑移界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Box weight and sliding interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對外內尺寸、附加重量及底面實際接觸區；若出現錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile outer and inner dimensions, additional weight and actual base contact zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「箱涵自重與滑移界面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Box weight and sliding interfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically.
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
quiz.explanation: 錯把中空箱涵當實心，造成重量與摩阻模型系統偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a hollow box as solid biases weight and friction models systematically. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「油壓推力與後座反力」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。油封摩擦、回油壓及不同缸位使表壓總和不是精確合力；推力能力與後座可承力是不同限制，不能因油壓未滿就判斷可繼續增加負載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫；若出現後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「油壓推力與後座反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. Seal friction, return pressure and cylinder states affect the result. Hydraulic capability and reaction-wall capacity are separate constraints; unused pressure capacity does not establish permission to increase load. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks. If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「油壓推力與後座反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 油壓推力與後座反力
knowledge.text: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。油封摩擦、回油壓及不同缸位使表壓總和不是精確合力；推力能力與後座可承力是不同限制，不能因油壓未滿就判斷可繼續增加負載。
knowledge.textEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. Seal friction, return pressure and cylinder states affect the result.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「油壓推力與後座反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force" is correct?
options: 千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段
千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。
optionsEn: Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage
Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂壓力透過有效活塞面積變成力，後座牆和地層必須提供相反反力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jack pressure produces force over effective piston area, requiring equal reaction from the thrust wall and ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「油壓推力與後座反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「油壓推力與後座反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。
刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN.
A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: idealThrust=p*A=25 MPa*0.12 m2=3.0 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 油壓推力與後座反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「油壓推力與後座反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic thrust and reaction-wall force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 後座地層先變形，油壓增加只擴大後退而非有效前進。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對有效缸面積、校正荷重與後座位移及裂縫，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare effective piston area, calibrated load and reaction-wall displacement and cracks to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Reaction ground deforms first and increased pressure causes retreat rather than useful advance.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」與「頂板框架與施工支承」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base friction and lubrication variability" and "Roof-frame action and construction support": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base friction and lubrication variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base friction and lubrication variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滑移界面摩阻隨有效法向力、材料接觸與潤滑狀態改變，啟動阻力可能高於穩定滑移。庫倫模型只表示一個假設狀態，不能把同一係數套到乾濕區、停機時間及側面土壓；推力歷程需按工況分段解讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據；若出現局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion. A Coulomb model describes an assumed state, not one coefficient valid across dry zones, waiting periods and side earth pressure. Interpret thrust histories by operating condition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence. If local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base friction and lubrication variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: baseFriction=mu*W=0.15*5760 kN=864 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「底面摩擦與潤滑變異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base friction and lubrication variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 滑移界面摩阻隨有效法向力、材料接觸與潤滑狀態改變，啟動阻力可能高於穩定滑移。庫倫模型只表示一個假設狀態，不能把同一係數套到乾濕區、停機時間及側面土壓；推力歷程需按工況分段解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion. A Coulomb model describes an assumed state, not one coefficient valid across dry zones, waiting periods and side earth pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One low measured friction coefficient applies to every later jacking stage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段

optionsEn: Sliding friction depends on effective normal force, contact materials and lubrication, with breakaway potentially above steady motion.

A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 底面摩擦與潤滑變異：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base friction and lubrication variability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部失潤滑造成推力尖峰，被誤判成全面硬地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較啟動與穩態推力、停機時長及潤滑覆蓋證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare breakaway and steady thrust, stoppage duration and lubrication coverage evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local lubrication loss creates a thrust spike mistaken for uniformly hard ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到一次低摩擦係數就可套用所有後續頂進階段」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 頂板框架與施工支承：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof-frame action and construction support” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵頂板和側牆形成框架，角部轉動限制使彎矩不同於獨立簡支梁。條帶模型可用來核對量級，但頂進時前緣懸伸、地面交通與覆土拱效應又改變支承；應逐階段標出荷載路徑和拉力側。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對；若出現把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂板框架與施工支承」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The roof and walls form a frame, with corner restraint changing moments from those of an isolated simple beam. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state. If treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof-frame action and construction support” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：idealStripMoment=q*L^2/8=50 kN/m*(7 m)^2/8=306.25 kNm for a 1 m strip。
