Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂板框架與施工支承」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Roof-frame action and construction support"?
options: 將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積
optionsEn: Compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume
quiz.explanation: 將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頂板框架與施工支承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Roof-frame action and construction support: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板框架與施工支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof-frame action and construction support” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對；若出現把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將框架邊界、頂板應變及前緣懸伸狀態共同比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare frame restraints, roof strains and leading-edge overhang state to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂板框架與施工支承」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Roof-frame action and construction support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。
刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand.
A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
quiz.explanation: 把固定角部當鉸接，遺漏角隅負彎矩與裂縫需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating restrained corners as hinges misses negative corner moment and cracking demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「刃口接觸與局部承壓」與「推力偏心與箱身應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing" and "Eccentric thrust and box stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge contact and local bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「刃口接觸與局部承壓」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。平均壓力不能代表刃角峰值，背後混凝土還需承受剪力與劈裂；不均勻切削也可能改變行進方向，應把局部受力和姿態聯合判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化；若出現一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刃口接觸與局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area. Mean pressure misses corner peaks and the backing concrete must resist shear and splitting. Uneven cutting can also steer the box, linking local load evidence with attitude monitoring. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes. If a hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓
knowledge.text: 刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。平均壓力不能代表刃角峰值，背後混凝土還需承受剪力與劈裂；不均勻切削也可能改變行進方向，應把局部受力和姿態聯合判讀。
knowledge.textEn: The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area. Mean pressure misses corner peaks and the backing concrete must resist shear and splitting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「刃口接觸與局部承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing" is correct?
options: 刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area.
quiz.explanation: 刃口將前緣阻力傳入箱涵，局部硬塊和偏斜會縮小實際接觸面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The cutting edge transfers face resistance into the box, while hard inclusions and skew reduce active contact area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge contact and local bearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。
超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比
窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa.
An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage
Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: averageContact=600 kN/2 m2=300 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge contact and local bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「刃口接觸與局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

If a hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「刃口接觸與局部承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化。
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes.
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
quiz.explanation: 比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 刃口接觸與局部承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutting-edge contact and local bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刃口接觸與局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutting-edge contact and local bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化；若出現一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刃口總面積夠大就不會產生任何局部壓碎」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large total edge area prevents every local crushing mechanism" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較刃口磨耗、分區推力與前端姿態變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare edge wear, zonal thrust and leading-end attitude changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「刃口接觸與局部承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutting-edge contact and local bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box.
quiz.explanation: 一側硬塊集中受力使刃口局部損傷並帶偏箱涵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A hard inclusion concentrates force on one side, damaging the edge and steering the box. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric thrust and box stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「推力偏心與箱身應力」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric thrust and box stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 推力中心偏離承壓截面中心會同時引入軸壓與彎曲，局部頂塊接觸也不必均勻。線彈性疊加只適用未開裂及已知截面幾何，不能替代箱涵角部和開孔分析；多缸推力應與實際力臂一起核對。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變；若出現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推力偏心與箱身應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thrust eccentricity combines compression and bending, and thrust-block contact need not be uniform. Linear superposition requires an uncracked section with known properties and cannot replace corner or opening analysis. Reconcile individual jack forces with their actual lever arms rather than summing magnitudes alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric thrust and box stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「推力偏心與箱身應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric thrust and box stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力
knowledge.text: 推力中心偏離承壓截面中心會同時引入軸壓與彎曲，局部頂塊接觸也不必均勻。線彈性疊加只適用未開裂及已知截面幾何，不能替代箱涵角部和開孔分析；多缸推力應與實際力臂一起核對。
knowledge.textEn: Thrust eccentricity combines compression and bending, and thrust-block contact need not be uniform. Linear superposition requires an uncracked section with known properties and cannot replace corner or opening analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「推力偏心與箱身應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric thrust and box stress" is correct?
options: 推力中心偏離承壓截面中心會同時引入軸壓與彎曲，局部頂塊接觸也不必均勻。
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
optionsEn: Thrust eccentricity combines compression and bending, and thrust-block contact need not be uniform.
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
quiz.explanation: 推力中心偏離承壓截面中心會同時引入軸壓與彎曲，局部頂塊接觸也不必均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Thrust eccentricity combines compression and bending, and thrust-block contact need not be uniform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric thrust and box stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「推力偏心與箱身應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric thrust and box stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3)。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3). Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3)。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3). Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「推力偏心與箱身應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentric thrust and box stress", which statement holds?
options: 平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格
箱涵外框長寬高相乘就等於全部混凝土體積

Original teaching assumptions: M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3).
Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=3000 kN*0.05 m=150 kNm; sigmaMax=N/A+M/Z=3000/1+150/0.2=3750 kPa (A=1 m2,Z=0.2 m3). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Eccentric thrust and box stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推力偏心與箱身應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentric thrust and box stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「推力偏心與箱身應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 推力偏心與箱身應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric thrust and box stress: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變；若出現總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對各缸荷重與力臂，對照箱身兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check individual jack loads and arms against opposite-side box strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「推力偏心與箱身應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric thrust and box stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
optionsEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
quiz.explanation: 總推力正常但分配偏心，箱身一側裂縫持續擴大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal total thrust conceals eccentric distribution and growing cracks on one side. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「姿態修正與曲線相容」與「超挖體積與地層損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attitude correction and path compatibility" and "Overbreak volume and ground loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attitude correction and path compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「姿態修正與曲線相容」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attitude correction and path compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。剛體小角度可識別量級，實際修正受地層、導板與框架變形限制；突然集中修正可能增加側壓和摩阻，不能把幾何誤差直接轉為操作命令。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡；若出現單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「姿態修正與曲線相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length. Small-angle geometry estimates scale, while soil, guides and frame deformation constrain correction. Concentrated correction can increase lateral pressure and friction, so geometric error is not an operating command. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. If single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attitude correction and path compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「姿態修正與曲線相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attitude correction and path compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容
knowledge.text: 箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。剛體小角度可識別量級，實際修正受地層、導板與框架變形限制；突然集中修正可能增加側壓和摩阻，不能把幾何誤差直接轉為操作命令。
knowledge.textEn: Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length. Small-angle geometry estimates scale, while soil, guides and frame deformation constrain correction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「姿態修正與曲線相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Attitude correction and path compatibility" is correct?
options: 前端位置回到線上就代表整個箱涵姿態正確
箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。
超挖百分比可以直接當作地表最大沉陷百分比
optionsEn: A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length.
An overbreak percentage directly equals the maximum surface-settlement percentage
quiz.explanation: 箱涵姿態由前後位置共同決定，短距偏移不等於沿全長均勻轉角。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Front and rear positions jointly determine box attitude, and a local offset is not uniform rotation along the whole length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Attitude correction and path compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「姿態修正與曲線相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attitude correction and path compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「姿態修正與曲線相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Attitude correction and path compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證
千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。
optionsEn: Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured
Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: smallAngle=offset/baseline=0.040 m/20 m=0.002 rad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 姿態修正與曲線相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Attitude correction and path compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「姿態修正與曲線相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Attitude correction and path compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以共同基準比較前後測點與導板接觸痕跡列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單點修正造成尾部擠壓，前端改善但全體摩阻上升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare front and rear survey points and guide-contact marks in a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If single-point correction pinches the rear, improving the front while raising overall friction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action

quiz.question: 在「超挖體積與地層損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Overbreak volume and ground loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格
鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable
Comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss.
quiz.explanation: 鬆方出土量未換算就與原位相比，掩蓋實際地層流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing loose spoil directly with in-situ volume conceals real ground loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」與「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail interface and differential settlement" and "Possession windows and restoration evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail interface and differential settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。兩點沉陷差除距離僅為平均沉陷坡度，仍含整體剛體傾斜；不能直接當作已扣除傾斜的角變形或規範軌道扭曲，也不能取代道床支承和營運標準；監測需分開頂進、回填與恢復交通後的再壓密。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢；若出現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone. Settlement difference over distance is a mean settlement slope that still includes rigid-body tilt. It is not automatically tilt-corrected angular distortion or code-defined track twist and does not replace ballast-support or operating criteria. Distinguish jacking, backfill and post-reopening densification when interpreting monitoring histories. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rail interface and differential settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rail interface and differential settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷
knowledge.text: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。兩點沉陷差除距離僅為平均沉陷坡度，仍含整體剛體傾斜；不能直接當作已扣除傾斜的角變形或規範軌道扭曲，也不能取代道床支承和營運標準；監測需分開頂進、回填與恢復交通後的再壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone. Settlement difference over distance is a mean settlement slope that still includes rigid-body tilt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail interface and differential settlement" is correct?
options: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。
平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格
窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證
optionsEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone.
Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable
Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured
quiz.explanation: 跨越營運線時，軌道幾何關心相鄰點的差異及變化速度，而非只有平均沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Operating rail interfaces depend on differential movement and rate, not mean settlement alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail interface and differential settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rail interface and differential settlement", which statement holds?
options: 千斤頂額定推力就是後座地層必然能承受的推力
原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。
頂板當作簡支梁計算就涵蓋所有框架受力
optionsEn: Rated jack thrust is automatically the thrust the reaction ground can sustain
Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist.
A simple-beam roof calculation covers every frame action
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=8 mm/10000 mm=0.0008 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed and this is not track twist. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail interface and differential settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rail interface and differential settlement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要總推力沒超限就不用關心各千斤頂分配
比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If total thrust stays below its limit jack-force distribution does not matter
Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends.
quiz.explanation: 比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鐵路介面與差異沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail interface and differential settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail interface and differential settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢；若出現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均沉陷足夠小就代表所有鐵路幾何必定合格」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sufficiently small average settlement guarantees all railway geometry is acceptable" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較兩軌高程、相鄰測點差及恢復交通後趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare both rail elevations, neighboring differences and post-reopening trends to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鐵路介面與差異沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rail interface and differential settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證
optionsEn: Small mean settlement conceals local differentials that compromise required track geometry.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured
quiz.explanation: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，軌道幾何仍不符合營運需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 封鎖窗口與恢復證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Possession windows and restoration evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」如何影響箱涵頂進施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Possession windows and restoration evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Box-jacking construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工窗口需容納頂進、檢查、回填和系統恢復，工序之間的相依不能以單一速度估算取代。剩餘時間只顯示排程餘裕，並不是遇到異常可壓縮驗證的理由；放行資料必須能追溯到最後實際構形。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認；若出現為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A possession window includes jacking, inspection, backfill and system restoration, with dependencies beyond a single advance rate. Remaining time indicates schedule reserve and does not justify compressing verification after an anomaly. Release evidence must trace to the final actual configuration rather than the planned one. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs. If skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Possession windows and restoration evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：timeReserve=720 min-600 min=120 min; reserveFraction=120/720=16.7 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: timeReserve=720 min-600 min=120 min; reserveFraction=120/720=16.7 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Possession windows and restoration evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 封鎖窗口與恢復證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Possession windows and restoration evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Possession windows and restoration evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：timeReserve=720 min-600 min=120 min; reserveFraction=120/720=16.7 percent。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: timeReserve=720 min-600 min=120 min; reserveFraction=120/720=16.7 percent. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：timeReserve=720 min-600 min=120 min; reserveFraction=120/720=16.7 percent。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 封鎖窗口與恢復證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Possession windows and restoration evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Possession windows and restoration evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Possession windows and restoration evidence"?
options: 核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認。

optionsEn: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A leading end back on line proves the entire box attitude is correct
quiz.explanation: 核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 封鎖窗口與恢復證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Possession windows and restoration evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Possession windows and restoration evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認；若出現為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「窗口還有剩餘時間就代表工程品質已經獲得保證」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Remaining possession time proves construction quality has already been assured" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對相依工序實際時間與恢復後的檢查簽認，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconcile dependent activities with actual times and post-restoration inspection signoffs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「封鎖窗口與恢復證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Possession windows and restoration evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
為追趕窗口跳過恢復檢查，留下未驗證的軌道或回填狀態。

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Multiplying outer box dimensions gives the total concrete volume

quiz.explanationEn: Skipping restoration checks to recover time leaves track or backfill condition unverified. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 微型隧道機頂管
courses.summary: 本課以微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力為主線，從面壓合力與地下水邊界與泥漿濃度與固體平衡建立系統邊界，再把接頭傳力與墊材接觸、泥水管路損失與流變連到成品管線水密與紀錄。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. It begins with Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary and Slurry concentration and solids balance, links Joint load transfer and packer contact and Slurry-line loss and rheology, and ends with Finished-pipeline tightness and records. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
courses.focus: 微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力
courses.focusEn: Microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查面壓合力與地下水邊界：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN；再獨立檢查泥漿濃度與固體平衡：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。假定推力 1200 kN 不變，有效接觸面從 0.30 減到 0.15 m2 時，平均接頭承壓由 4 增至 8 MPa；局部峰值可能更高。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 將用橫向測線殘差與長期基準點穩定性檢驗槽形作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN. Independently check Slurry concentration and solids balance: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. At an assumed 1200 kN thrust, reducing effective contact from 0.30 to 0.15 m2 doubles mean joint bearing from 4 to 8 MPa; local peaks may be higher. The two results are not a complete design because slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Use test the trough fit against transverse residuals and stable long-term benchmarks as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
