steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 掃描各段斷面並核對標高，將原位體積與提升容器計量分列，使用實測鬆方係數比較。物料表須保留井深、掃描輪廓及體積定義，超挖量應交地工設計者判讀後調整支護。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan each lift and check elevations; distinguish in-situ volume from hoisted loose volume and compare them using a measured bulking factor. Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing loose and in-situ volume distorts mucking efficiency and can conceal overbreak or shaft-wall loosening. steps.title: 切削比能的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「切削比能」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutting specific energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 切削比能把破岩所需能量與開挖體積連結，可用來比較同一設備在不同岩層中的反應。刀具磨耗、岩石強度、節理和切入深度都會改變比能；額定電功率另含傳動損失，不能全部當成有效破岩功率。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切削比能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Specific cutting energy links rock-breaking energy to excavated volume and helps compare one machine across strata. Tool wear, rock strength, joints and penetration change the energy demand. Rated electrical power also includes drivetrain losses and therefore cannot all be assigned to useful rock breakage. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutting specific energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：有效比能e=20 MJ/m³、原位切削率Q=0.02 m³/s，P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For useful specific energy e=20 MJ/m³ and in-situ cutting rate Q=0.02 m³/s, P=eQ=0.4 MW=400 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「切削比能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 切削比能的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「切削比能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutting specific energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips. Specific energy is a condition indicator rather than a universal material constant; identify whether measurement is at motor or cutter and document efficiency and idle-power corrections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「切削比能的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

刀具磨鈍仍追求固定進尺會使熱與扭矩升高，造成異常磨損或頻繁跳機。

Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
Maintaining fixed advance with blunt tools increases heat and torque, producing abnormal wear or frequent trips.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「提升循環的機理與驗證」與「工作盤支承的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification" and "Working-platform supports mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「提升循環」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoisting cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。完整循環包含裝載、加速、運送、卸載與回程，容器額定容量若未滿載或受限於重量便不能直接當有效體積。設備之間的等候時間也會消耗可用產能。此處是鬆方提升量，與切削原位量比較時要換算；雙容器或交錯作業會改變循環邏輯，不能直接相加額定值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「提升循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The full cycle includes loading, acceleration, travel, unloading and return. Rated bucket volume is not useful volume when fill is incomplete or weight governs, while waiting between subsystems consumes available capacity. This is loose-volume hoisting capacity and requires conversion before comparison with in-situ cutting; twin-bucket or overlapping operations change cycle logic, so ratings cannot simply be added. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hoisting cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「提升循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hoisting cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。完整循環包含裝載、加速、運送、卸載與回程，容器額定容量若未滿載或受限於重量便不能直接當有效體積。
knowledge.textEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The full cycle includes loading, acceleration, travel, unloading and return.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「提升循環的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。

Four supports necessarily carry one quarter of the load in every condition.

steps.title: 提升循環的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hoisting cycle mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「提升循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hoisting cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設每循環有效鬆方Vb=8 m³、完整循環t=240 s，Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: With useful loose volume Vb=8 m³ and full cycle t=240 s, hoisting rate Qh=Vb×3600/t=120 m³/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用事件紀錄拆解各循環時間，抽核容器重量與密度；將平均及長尾等候時間分別呈現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Break cycles into event times and sample bucket mass and density; report average times and long waiting tails separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 工作盤支承的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「工作盤支承」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Working-platform supports” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工作盤承載人員、機具及材料，反力經支承裝置傳入井壁或懸吊系統。理想對稱分配僅能作初步估算，設備偏心、支點高差與局部剛度不同會使個別支點受力超過平均值；臨時構件的負載也隨施工階段改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「工作盤支承」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The working platform carries personnel, machinery and materials, transferring reactions into the shaft wall or suspension system. Equal sharing is only an initial estimate: equipment eccentricity, support-level errors and stiffness differences can overload one support above the average, and temporary-member loads change with construction stage. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Working-platform supports” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total vertical load W=800 kN and four identical symmetric supports, mean reaction R=W/4=200 kN per support.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 工作盤支承的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Working-platform supports” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設總垂直荷重W=800 kN、4個相同且對稱支點，平均R=W/4=200 kN/支點。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total vertical load W=800 kN and four identical symmetric supports, mean reaction R=W/4=200 kN per support. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對設備重心、支點標高與反力計，將實測反力總和及力矩與荷重清單比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check equipment centres of gravity, support elevations and load cells; compare the measured reaction sum and moment with the load inventory.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。平均反力不是支點設計上限；實際檢核還須含偏心、動態作用與支承局部承壓，並確認井壁有足夠的傳力範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged. The mean reaction is not a design maximum; actual checks include eccentricity, dynamics and local bearing, with adequate shaft-wall area to transfer the force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工作盤支承的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Working-platform supports mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。
導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged.
A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
quiz.explanation: 一個支點失去接觸會使荷重轉移，造成局部壓碎或盤面傾斜，而總重量並未改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of contact at one support redistributes load, causing local crushing or platform tilt even though total weight is unchanged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直導向的機理與驗證」與「支護落後距的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vertical alignment mechanism and verification" and "Support lag mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical alignment mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直導向」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical alignment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。井口控制點若移動，單一雷射可能顯示穩定卻整體偏離，因此導向需要獨立測量網與分段閉合檢核，而非只觀察機械姿態。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直導向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. If a collar control point moves, one laser may appear stable while the entire alignment drifts. Guidance therefore needs an independent survey network and staged closure checks, not machinery attitude alone. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vertical alignment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直導向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vertical alignment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。井口控制點若移動，單一雷射可能顯示穩定卻整體偏離，因此導向需要獨立測量網與分段閉合檢核，而非只觀察機械姿態。
knowledge.textEn: Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. If a collar control point moves, one laser may appear stable while the entire alignment drifts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直導向的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical alignment mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 導向儀顯示垂直就不需要獨立測量複核。
只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。
深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。
optionsEn: A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.
Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant.
Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations.
quiz.explanation: 深井的微小方向誤差會隨深度累積為顯著偏移，影響設備間隙、襯砌厚度與後續永久設施。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small directional error accumulates into substantial offset with depth, affecting equipment clearance, lining thickness and permanent installations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical alignment mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直導向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立基準複測井口控制點，分深度比對雷射、垂線與斷面掃描，辨別基準漂移及真實偏斜。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey collar control independently and compare laser, plumb and scanned profiles by depth to distinguish datum movement from real inclination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「垂直導向的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vertical alignment mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。
排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。
每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m.
Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk.
Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：深度L=300 m、假設恆定小角誤差θ=0.001 rad，偏移δ≈Lθ=0.30 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth L=300 m and constant small angular error θ=0.001 rad, offset δ≈Lθ=0.30 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 垂直導向的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical alignment mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直導向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vertical alignment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立基準複測井口控制點，分深度比對雷射、垂線與斷面掃描，辨別基準漂移及真實偏斜。每次控制點改設均保留前後轉換及閉合誤差；測量負責人確認後，才更新施工設備的導向座標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey collar control independently and compare laser, plumb and scanned profiles by depth to distinguish datum movement from real inclination. Retain transformations and closure errors whenever control is changed; the survey lead confirms them before machine guidance coordinates are updated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次控制點改設均保留前後轉換及閉合誤差；測量負責人確認後，才更新施工設備的導向座標。小角線性式只描述固定角誤差；真實曲線偏移應沿深度積分，且不同方向的誤差可能抵銷或疊加，不能只看最後井底點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain transformations and closure errors whenever control is changed; the survey lead confirms them before machine guidance coordinates are updated. The linear approximation describes constant angular error only; real curved deviation requires integration with depth, and directional errors can cancel or accumulate, so the final bottom point is insufficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準點漂移或儀器偏心會使井道逐步偏離，直到設備與襯砌間隙不足才顯現問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Control movement or instrument eccentricity can progressively misalign the shaft until equipment-to-lining clearance becomes insufficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「垂直導向的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 支護落後距的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support lag mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護落後距」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 切削面與已完成支護之間的距離代表裸露井壁的空間與時間，不能只用每日進尺判斷穩定。節理、地下水與風化控制自立時間，支護施工慢於破岩時，落後距會逐步增加，令原先合理的工序變成新的不利暴露條件。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護落後距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The distance between excavation and completed support represents both exposed-wall length and exposure time; daily advance alone cannot establish stability. Joints, groundwater and weathering govern stand-up behaviour. When support progresses slower than cutting, lag grows and a previously acceptable sequence develops a new adverse exposure condition. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護落後距」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護落後距的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 切削面與已完成支護之間的距離代表裸露井壁的空間與時間，不能只用每日進尺判斷穩定。節理、地下水與風化控制自立時間，支護施工慢於破岩時，落後距會逐步增加，令原先合理的工序變成新的不利暴露條件。
knowledge.textEn: The distance between excavation and completed support represents both exposed-wall length and exposure time; daily advance alone cannot establish stability. Joints, groundwater and weathering govern stand-up behaviour.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護落後距的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support lag mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 切削面與已完成支護之間的距離代表裸露井壁的空間與時間，不能只用每日進尺判斷穩定。
只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。
風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。
optionsEn: The distance between excavation and completed support represents both exposed-wall length and exposure time; daily advance alone cannot establish stability.
Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant.
Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location.
quiz.explanation: 切削面與已完成支護之間的距離代表裸露井壁的空間與時間，不能只用每日進尺判斷穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The distance between excavation and completed support represents both exposed-wall length and exposure time; daily advance alone cannot establish stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護落後距的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support lag mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護落後距」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將開挖時間、支護完成深度與地質分區畫在同一圖，記錄掉塊及位移是否集中在落後段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot excavation time, completed-support depth and geology together, noting whether block falls and movements concentrate within the lag zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護落後距的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support lag mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。
原創教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m。
井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m.
A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設等速進尺v=0.4 m/h，支護完成延遲t=5 h，裸露長度L=vt=2 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: At constant advance v=0.4 m/h and support delay t=5 h, exposed length L=vt=2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護落後距的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support lag mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護落後距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support lag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將開挖時間、支護完成深度與地質分區畫在同一圖，記錄掉塊及位移是否集中在落後段。設計者應按地層訂定落後距與時間的停留點；變更進尺速度前，要同時確認支護人力、設備與材料能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot excavation time, completed-support depth and geology together, noting whether block falls and movements concentrate within the lag zone. The designer specifies lag-distance and exposure-time hold points by geology; changing advance requires simultaneous confirmation of support labour, equipment and material capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應按地層訂定落後距與時間的停留點；變更進尺速度前，要同時確認支護人力、設備與材料能力。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer specifies lag-distance and exposure-time hold points by geology; changing advance requires simultaneous confirmation of support labour, equipment and material capacity. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：落後距增加可能誘發楔塊掉落，延誤支護又會進一步擴大暴露，形成惡性循環。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing lag can trigger wedge falls; the resulting support delay further enlarges exposure and creates a reinforcing deterioration cycle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Plot excavation time, completed-support depth and geology together, noting whether block falls and movements concentrate within the lag zone. knowledge.textEn: The designer specifies lag-distance and exposure-time hold points by geology; changing advance requires simultaneous confirmation of support labour, equipment and material capacity. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護落後距的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support lag mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。
將開挖時間、支護完成深度與地質分區畫在同一圖，記錄掉塊及位移是否集中在落後段。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Hoisting speed and bucket capacity alone determine actual daily production.
Plot excavation time, completed-support depth and geology together, noting whether block falls and movements concentrate within the lag zone.
quiz.explanation: 將開挖時間、支護完成深度與地質分區畫在同一圖，記錄掉塊及位移是否集中在落後段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot excavation time, completed-support depth and geology together, noting whether block falls and movements concentrate within the lag zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護落後距的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support lag mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護落後距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 落後距增加可能誘發楔塊掉落，延誤支護又會進一步擴大暴露，形成惡性循環。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing lag can trigger wedge falls; the resulting support delay further enlarges exposure and creates a reinforcing deterioration cycle. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 落後距增加可能誘發楔塊掉落，延誤支護又會進一步擴大暴露，形成惡性循環。此算例不是允許的裸露長度，亦未包含開挖擾動；穩定評估需結合節理幾何與觀測趨勢，不可用產能公式替代岩體分析。
knowledge.textEn: Increasing lag can trigger wedge falls; the resulting support delay further enlarges exposure and creates a reinforcing deterioration cycle. This is not an allowable exposure length and excludes excavation disturbance; stability requires joint geometry and observed trends, not a production equation substituted for rock-mass analysis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護落後距的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support lag mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 落後距增加可能誘發楔塊掉落，延誤支護又會進一步擴大暴露，形成惡性循環。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。
optionsEn: Increasing lag can trigger wedge falls; the resulting support delay further enlarges exposure and creates a reinforcing deterioration cycle.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location.
quiz.explanation: 落後距增加可能誘發楔塊掉落，延誤支護又會進一步擴大暴露，形成惡性循環。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Increasing lag can trigger wedge falls; the resulting support delay further enlarges exposure and creates a reinforcing deterioration cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風流量的機理與驗證」與「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation flow mechanism and verification" and "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風流量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation flow mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風流量」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 豎井通風須把新鮮空氣送到實際作業位置，再形成可辨識的回流路徑。管內平均速度與截面積決定風量，但漏風、短路循環和局部死角會使作業區的有效換氣低於管路量測，深度增加也會增加沿程壓損。體積流量不等於污染物控制標準；還須依污染源、設備排放與當地規範核定需求，本課數值不是作業許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shaft ventilation must deliver fresh air to the actual work location and establish a recognizable return path. Mean duct velocity and area determine flow, but leakage, recirculation short circuits and stagnant pockets can reduce effective workplace exchange below the duct measurement, while greater depth increases friction losses. Volumetric flow is not a contaminant-control criterion; demand also depends on sources, equipment emissions and local requirements, and this example does not authorize operations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設平均管速v=10 m/s、有效截面A=0.8 m²，Q=vA=8 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With mean duct velocity v=10 m/s and effective area A=0.8 m², Q=vA=8 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。平均湧水量只能估算短時累積，裂隙連通或承壓層突破會使流量突然改變；泵浦曲線、排放背壓與備援供電共同決定可排出的實際水量。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「湧水緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設停泵期間恆定流入Q=0.06 m³/s、停機t=600 s，新增水量V=Qt=36 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For constant inflow Q=0.06 m³/s during an outage t=600 s, accumulated volume V=Qt=36 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以流量計、水位計及泵浦運轉紀錄建立入出水平衡，測試訊號失效與備援切換的可辨識性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「湧水緩衝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water inflow buffer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

steps.instructionEn: Use flow, level and pump logs for a water balance, checking whether signal failure and backup transfer remain detectable. Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Provide independent inflow and level alarms; drainage, geotechnical and construction leads jointly approve backup capability and operational hold points. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 湧水緩衝的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「湧水緩衝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water inflow buffer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.instructionEn: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水泵額定流量大於平均湧水量就沒有停機風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump nameplate capacity above average inflow eliminates outage risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「湧水緩衝的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water inflow buffer mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。
集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions.
quiz.explanation: 集水容積不足或備援不能啟動會使水位淹及設備，並改變井底穩定與撤離條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient sump storage or failed backup raises water over equipment and changes bottom stability and evacuation conditions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備可用率的機理與驗證」與「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment availability mechanism and verification" and "System bottleneck mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備可用率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment availability mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設備可用率」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equipment availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。預防維護可能短時降低排程可用時間，卻減少重大故障；等待支護、通風或材料則屬系統協調問題，應與設備自身故障分開編碼。此可用率式假設長期穩態且故障修復定義一致；它不包含計畫休班、施工等待或地層限制，不能直接作為工程進度保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance. Preventive maintenance can reduce scheduled available time temporarily while avoiding major failures. Waiting for support, ventilation or supplies belongs to system coordination and should be coded separately from intrinsic machinery failure. The expression assumes a long-run steady state and consistent failure-repair definitions; it excludes planned shifts, construction waiting and ground limits and therefore cannot guarantee project progress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設平均運轉至故障MTBF=80 h、平均修復MTTR=8 h，A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)=0.909。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With mean time between failures MTBF=80 h and mean repair time MTTR=8 h, A=MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)=0.909.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設備可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equipment availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備可用率的機理與驗證

knowledge.textEn: Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance. Preventive maintenance can reduce scheduled available time temporarily while avoiding major failures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備可用率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment availability mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。
設備可用率百分之九十就代表日進尺達理論值九成。
每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。
optionsEn: Mechanical availability describes the fraction of time equipment is capable of operating, not utilization or achieved advance.
Ninety-percent availability means daily advance reaches ninety percent of its theoretical value.
Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.
quiz.explanation: 機械可用率描述設備具備運轉能力的時間比例，不能與實際利用率或工地進尺混為一談。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「系統瓶頸」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System bottleneck” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯施工系統中最慢的必要工序限制穩態產量，暫存空間只能吸收短時波動，不能永久消除瓶頸。提升能力充足但支護落後時，加快切削只會增加井底堆積與裸露時間；改良一個工序後，限制也可能轉移到另一環節。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a serial construction system, the slowest required process limits steady throughput; buffers absorb short fluctuations but cannot remove a permanent bottleneck. If support lags despite adequate hoisting, faster cutting merely increases bottom accumulation and exposure. Improving one activity can transfer the constraint to another subsystem, so interventions must be assessed across the complete cycle. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System bottleneck” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：全部換成原位等值後，切削90、提升120、支護70 m³/h，理想穩態Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System bottleneck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。
knowledge.textEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
knowledge.textEn: Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System bottleneck mechanism and verification"?
options: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風管測得足夠流量就能保證每個作業點的空氣品質。
optionsEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate measured duct flow guarantees air quality at every work location.
quiz.explanation: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System bottleneck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
knowledge.textEn: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System bottleneck mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。
井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination.
A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
quiz.explanation: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
courses.summary: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。
courses.summaryEn: Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand.
courses.focus: 岩洞穹頂的節理楔塊、岩拱與複合支護
courses.focusEn: Cavern-crown joint wedges, rock arching and composite support
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設穹頂可動楔塊體積V=12 m³，岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=312 kN。若地質測繪使估計體積增加10%至13.2 m³，重量增為343.2 kN，增加31.2 kN。這個結果只修改重力項，不表示所需錨力也一定按相同比例增加，因為楔塊形狀改變可能同時影響節理接觸面、出露方向與錨索穿越位置。必須重新建立三維自由體圖，檢查水壓、摩擦及錨固，再用獨立地質觀測確認模型。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume a potentially movable crown wedge of V=12 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Its weight is W=γV=312 kN. If mapping increases the estimated volume by 10% to 13.2 m³, weight becomes 343.2 kN, an increase of 31.2 kN. This changes gravity only; required cable force need not increase by the same percentage because revised geometry may also change joint contact area, daylighting direction and cable intersections. Rebuild the three-dimensional free body, check water pressure, friction and anchorage, and corroborate the geometry with independent geological observations.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 合成教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」與「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" and "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理楔塊」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint wedge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理楔塊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone. Block weight is the basic load for a sliding or falling mechanism. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint wedge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³ and assumed wedge volume V=12 m³, W=γV=312 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理楔塊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint wedge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。楔塊是否形成取決於節理傾向、傾角及延續性，不能只從單一剖面推斷；重量則是滑移或掉落分析的基本荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. Formation depends on joint dip, direction and persistence and cannot be inferred from one section alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。
岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。
上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls.
Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong.
All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
quiz.explanation: 岩洞穹頂的節理組合可能界定一塊能向洞內移動的岩塊，即使完整岩石強度很高也不保證穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intersecting joints may define a block capable of moving into the cavern even when intact rock is strong. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理楔塊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint wedge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³、假設楔塊體積V=12 m³，W=γV=312 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理楔塊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint wedge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用掌子面與穹頂測繪建立三維節理面，對可能出露的塊體核對延續性與體積，不把所有交線當真實裂面。地質模型應保留節理可信度及未曝光區；開挖暴露新節理後，由地工設計者重核楔塊支護需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build three-dimensional joint planes from face and crown mapping, verifying persistence and volume of potentially daylighting blocks rather than treating every intersection as a real release surface. Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain joint-confidence levels and unexposed areas in the geological model; the geotechnical designer reassesses wedge support when new joints are exposed. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 節理楔塊的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint wedge mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理楔塊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint wedge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重量計算不包含節理剪力、地下水與支護反力，亦不等於所需錨力；先證明可動方向，再建立相應自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weight alone excludes joint shear, water and support reactions and is not the required anchor force; establish admissible movement before drawing the corresponding free body.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完整岩石抗壓強度很高就不會有穹頂落塊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High intact-rock compressive strength prevents cavern-crown block falls." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節理楔塊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint wedge mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。
上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating.
All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
quiz.explanation: 節理延續性低估會漏掉大楔塊，局部落石常是幾何失穩的先兆，不能以平均岩體評分忽略。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Underestimated persistence can miss a large wedge; local falls may precede geometric instability and must not be dismissed using an average rock-mass rating. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩拱應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩拱應力」如何影響地下岩洞穹頂支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock-arch stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underground cavern crown support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。上覆地層重量提供初始應力量級，實際水平應力及構造作用則可能主導局部壓碎、剝落或高側牆變形。覆岩公式不是岩拱解析解，無法單獨預測洞周集中應力；地形、節理各向異性及施工卸載都須另行納入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩拱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. Overburden weight gives an initial stress scale, while horizontal and tectonic stresses may govern local crushing, spalling or tall-wall deformation. The overburden expression is not an arch solution and cannot predict boundary stress concentrations alone; topography, joint anisotropy and staged unloading require separate treatment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rock-arch stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設均質覆岩γ=26 kN/m³、深度H=100 m，垂直應力σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For homogeneous overburden γ=26 kN/m³ and depth H=100 m, vertical stress σv=γH=2600 kPa=2.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩拱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rock-arch stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. Overburden weight gives an initial stress scale, while horizontal and tectonic stresses may govern local crushing, spalling or tall-wall deformation.

knowledge.text: 誤解：上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩拱應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rock-arch stress mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 上覆岩重全部直接落在噴凝土薄殼上。
洞室跨度變大時，只按跨度比例增加支護即可。
地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。
optionsEn: All overburden weight acts directly on the thin shotcrete shell.
Support only needs to increase linearly with cavern span.
Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement.
quiz.explanation: 地下開挖把原先穿越洞室的應力重新分配到穹頂與側牆，岩體可形成拱狀傳力，但拱腳必須有足夠拘束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation redirects stresses that previously crossed the cavern into the crown and sidewalls, allowing arch-like transfer only if the abutments retain confinement. The other options are common misconceptions.
