stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直度偏差的機理與驗證」與「槽底沉渣的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Verticality deviation mechanism and verification" and "Bottom sediment mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直度偏差的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Verticality deviation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直度偏差」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Verticality deviation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續壁槽孔偏斜會影響壁厚、鋼筋籠淨距與相鄰槽段接合。深度越大，同樣角度或比例偏差形成的底部偏移越大，兩側槽段若朝相反方向偏離，接頭處的有效重疊可能比單段誤差更不利。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直度偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trench deviation affects wall thickness, cage clearance and neighbouring-panel connection. At greater depth, the same inclination produces a larger toe offset. Adjacent panels deviating in opposite directions can reduce effective joint overlap more severely than either panel's individual tolerance suggests. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Verticality deviation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：深度H=40 m、假設偏斜比i=0.005，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=40 m and assumed inclination ratio i=0.005, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「槽口位置正確就代表整個深槽都在設計位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直度偏差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Verticality deviation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直度偏差的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 連續壁槽孔偏斜會影響壁厚、鋼筋籠淨距與相鄰槽段接合。深度越大，同樣角度或比例偏差形成的底部偏移越大，兩側槽段若朝相反方向偏離，接頭處的有效重疊可能比單段誤差更不利。
knowledge.textEn: Trench deviation affects wall thickness, cage clearance and neighbouring-panel connection. At greater depth, the same inclination produces a larger toe offset.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：槽口位置正確就代表整個深槽都在設計位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直度偏差的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Verticality deviation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 槽口位置正確就代表整個深槽都在設計位置。
清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。
連續壁槽孔偏斜會影響壁厚、鋼筋籠淨距與相鄰槽段接合。
optionsEn: A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position.
Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement.
Trench deviation affects wall thickness, cage clearance and neighbouring-panel connection.
quiz.explanation: 連續壁槽孔偏斜會影響壁厚、鋼筋籠淨距與相鄰槽段接合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Trench deviation affects wall thickness, cage clearance and neighbouring-panel connection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直度偏差的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Verticality deviation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直度偏差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Verticality deviation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：深度H=40 m、假設偏斜比i=0.005，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=40 m and assumed inclination ratio i=0.005, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用槽壁超音波量測沿深度的輪廓，核對導牆基準與設備姿態，將相鄰槽段放在同一座標比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use ultrasonic trench profiling by depth, check guide-wall datum and equipment attitude, and compare adjacent panels in one coordinate frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：深度H=40 m、假設偏斜比i=0.005，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=40 m and assumed inclination ratio i=0.005, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「垂直度偏差的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Verticality deviation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：深度H=40 m、假設偏斜比i=0.005，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。
混凝土用量超過理論值就代表連續壁一定更強。
建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=40 m and assumed inclination ratio i=0.005, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m.
Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall.
Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：深度H=40 m、假設偏斜比i=0.005，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=40 m and assumed inclination ratio i=0.005, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 垂直度偏差的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Verticality deviation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直度偏差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Verticality deviation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用槽壁超音波量測沿深度的輪廓，核對導牆基準與設備姿態，將相鄰槽段放在同一座標比較。吊放鋼筋籠前應取得全深輪廓驗收；超差位置由壁體設計者核定修正，不以強行下放解決。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use ultrasonic trench profiling by depth, check guide-wall datum and equipment attitude, and compare adjacent panels in one coordinate frame. Obtain full-depth profile acceptance before cage installation; the wall designer approves correction of deviations rather than resolving them by forced placement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊放鋼筋籠前應取得全深輪廓驗收；超差位置由壁體設計者核定修正，不以強行下放解決。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Obtain full-depth profile acceptance before cage installation; the wall designer approves correction of deviations rather than resolving them by forced placement. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏斜可能使鋼筋籠卡住或接頭形成缺口，後續即使灌足混凝土仍無法恢復原設計連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deviation can trap the cage or leave a joint gap; placing the specified concrete volume does not restore the intended continuity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用槽壁超音波量測沿深度的輪廓，核對導牆基準與設備姿態，將相鄰槽段放在同一座標比較。吊放鋼筋籠前應取得全深輪廓驗收；超差位置由壁體設計者核定修正，不以強行下放解決。
knowledge.textEn: Use ultrasonic trench profiling by depth, check guide-wall datum and equipment attitude, and compare adjacent panels in one coordinate frame. Obtain full-depth profile acceptance before cage installation; the wall designer approves correction of deviations rather than resolving them by forced placement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊放鋼筋籠前應取得全深輪廓驗收；超差位置由壁體設計者核定修正，不以強行下放解決。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain full-depth profile acceptance before cage installation; the wall designer approves correction of deviations rather than resolving them by forced placement. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.

quiz.question: 要驗證「垂直度偏差的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Verticality deviation mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用槽壁超音波量測沿深度的輪廓，核對導牆基準與設備姿態，將相鄰槽段放在同一座標比較。
穩定液黏度足夠就一定能在任何地層形成濾餅。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Use ultrasonic trench profiling by depth, check guide-wall datum and equipment attitude, and compare adjacent panels in one coordinate frame.
Adequate slurry viscosity guarantees a filter cake in every soil.
quiz.explanation: 用槽壁超音波量測沿深度的輪廓，核對導牆基準與設備姿態，將相鄰槽段放在同一座標比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use ultrasonic trench profiling by depth, check guide-wall datum and equipment attitude, and compare adjacent panels in one coordinate frame. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 垂直度偏差的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Verticality deviation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂直度偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Verticality deviation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏斜可能使鋼筋籠卡住或接頭形成缺口，後續即使灌足混凝土仍無法恢復原設計連續性。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deviation can trap the cage or leave a joint gap; placing the specified concrete volume does not restore the intended continuity. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「槽口位置正確就代表整個深槽都在設計位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏斜可能使鋼筋籠卡住或接頭形成缺口，後續即使灌足混凝土仍無法恢復原設計連續性。此式為固定偏斜的線性估算，真實彎曲孔形須用全深量測；設計接頭能力需採兩槽相對位置，不能只看各自合格率。
knowledge.textEn: Deviation can trap the cage or leave a joint gap; placing the specified concrete volume does not restore the intended continuity. This linear estimate assumes constant inclination; a curved trench requires full-depth measurement, and joint performance depends on relative panel positions rather than individual compliance rates.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「垂直度偏差的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Verticality deviation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。
偏斜可能使鋼筋籠卡住或接頭形成缺口，後續即使灌足混凝土仍無法恢復原設計連續性。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement.
Deviation can trap the cage or leave a joint gap; placing the specified concrete volume does not restore the intended continuity.
quiz.explanation: 偏斜可能使鋼筋籠卡住或接頭形成缺口，後續即使灌足混凝土仍無法恢復原設計連續性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Deviation can trap the cage or leave a joint gap; placing the specified concrete volume does not restore the intended continuity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 槽底沉渣的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bottom sediment mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「槽底沉渣」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bottom sediment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 成槽後的懸浮粒子會沉降在槽底，形成低強度、易壓縮的接面，也可能在混凝土置換時夾入壁體。沉渣厚度不是單靠穩定液密度可知，停置時間、粒徑及清底效果均有影響；壁樁承載與止水連續性需分別檢查。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「槽底沉渣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Suspended particles settle after excavation, forming a weak compressible base or becoming trapped during concrete displacement. Slurry density alone does not establish sediment thickness; waiting time, grading and cleaning effectiveness also matter. Bearing performance of barrettes and hydraulic continuity require separate assessment of the resulting interface. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bottom sediment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：槽底長L=6 m、寬B=1 m、平均沉渣厚t=0.08 m，V=L B t=0.48 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For base length L=6 m, width B=1 m and mean sediment thickness t=0.08 m, V=L B t=0.48 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「槽底沉渣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bottom sediment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 槽底沉渣的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 成槽後的懸浮粒子會沉降在槽底，形成低強度、易壓縮的接面，也可能在混凝土置換時夾入壁體。沉渣厚度不是單靠穩定液密度可知，停置時間、粒徑及清底效果均有影響；壁樁承載與止水連續性需分別檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Suspended particles settle after excavation, forming a weak compressible base or becoming trapped during concrete displacement. Slurry density alone does not establish sediment thickness; waiting time, grading and cleaning effectiveness also matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「槽底沉渣的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bottom sediment mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 成槽後的懸浮粒子會沉降在槽底，形成低強度、易壓縮的接面，也可能在混凝土置換時夾入壁體。
清底完成一次後，多久再澆置都不會重新沉積。
鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。
optionsEn: Suspended particles settle after excavation, forming a weak compressible base or becoming trapped during concrete displacement.
Once the base is cleaned, no sediment can redeposit before concrete placement.
Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction.
quiz.explanation: 成槽後的懸浮粒子會沉降在槽底，形成低強度、易壓縮的接面，也可能在混凝土置換時夾入壁體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Suspended particles settle after excavation, forming a weak compressible base or becoming trapped during concrete displacement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：槽底長L=6 m、寬B=1 m、平均沉渣厚t=0.08 m，V=L B t=0.48 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For base length L=6 m, width B=1 m and mean sediment thickness t=0.08 m, V=L B t=0.48 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同槽底位置量測沉渣，並核對清底與澆置間隔；用取樣及混凝土置換紀錄排查夾泥。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 槽底沉渣的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 在不同槽底位置量測沉渣，並核對清底與澆置間隔；用取樣及混凝土置換紀錄排查夾泥。清底驗收需記錄量測位置與時間；延誤超過核定條件時由監造要求複查，不能只沿用先前合格紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sediment at multiple base positions and verify the cleaning-to-placement interval; use sampling and concrete-displacement records to investigate entrapped slurry. Record measurement positions and time at base acceptance; delays beyond approved conditions require reinspection rather than reliance on the earlier acceptance record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：清底驗收需記錄量測位置與時間；延誤超過核定條件時由監造要求複查，不能只沿用先前合格紀錄。體積式只估算平均沉渣量，局部厚層可能更不利；沉渣允收需依端承、壁體品質及專案規範分別訂定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record measurement positions and time at base acceptance; delays beyond approved conditions require reinspection rather than reliance on the earlier acceptance record. The volume expression estimates mean sediment only; local thick pockets can be more adverse, and acceptance depends on bearing, wall quality and project specifications.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：厚沉渣會造成端部壓縮或局部夾泥，表面混凝土強度合格仍可能留下深部滲漏路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thick sediment can cause base compression or slurry inclusions; satisfactory surface concrete strength does not exclude a deep leakage path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「鋼筋籠浮力」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cage buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼筋籠浸入穩定液後，其有效吊重因排開液體而下降，但在混凝土置換時還可能受到黏滯拖曳與上舉作用。空心附件若封閉會增加排水體積，實際浮力不一定只等於鋼筋實體體積；定位系統須辨別重量、浮力與施工擾動。阿基米德式只給靜浮力，不包括混凝土流動拖曳與卡阻；排液體積需按實際封閉附件及開口狀態計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼筋籠浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cage immersed in slurry has reduced effective suspended weight, but concrete displacement can also create drag and upward force. Closed hollow attachments increase displaced volume, so buoyancy is not necessarily based on steel volume alone. Restraint design must distinguish weight, buoyancy and construction disturbances rather than treating every upward movement as one cause. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cage buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：穩定液γs=11 kN/m³、假設總排液體積V=3 m³，浮力B=γsV=33 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: With support-fluid unit weight γs=11 kN/m³ and total displaced volume V=3 m³, buoyancy B=γsV=33 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Check cage and attachment volumes and log suspended load and cage-top elevation against placement rate and fluid levels to distinguish static buoyancy from drag. The temporary-works lead approves cage restraint and monitoring before placement; any rising trend is managed under an approved hold point with retained elevation records. steps.observationEn: Site practice: The temporary-works lead approves cage restraint and monitoring before placement; any rising trend is managed under an approved hold point with retained elevation records. Archimedes' expression gives static buoyancy only, excluding concrete-flow drag and snagging; displaced volume must reflect actual closed attachments and opening conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼筋籠上浮會改變保護層及接頭鋼筋位置，固定不足可能在混凝土開始凝結後才被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「鋼筋籠浮力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.instructionEn: Differences between placed concrete and theoretical trench volume help track overbreak, loss and profiling error, but excess volume does not prove quality. An anomalous rise curve can indicate wall collapse, slurry entrapment or concrete entering voids and must be interpreted with trench shape and recovered-fluid volume. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete volume balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混凝土量平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 依「混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：理論體積Vt=180 m³、實際投入Va=210 m³，超量率(Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%。
穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。

Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For theoretical volume Vt=180 m³ and placed volume Va=210 m³, excess ratio (Va−Vt)/Vt=16.7%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土量平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete volume balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每車方量、澆置時間與混凝土面標高形成曲線，對照超音波槽形及液體回收量，標出突變深度。量平衡異常須與地質及澆置事件一起審查；壁體設計者決定補充檢測範圍，不以單一超量率放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot batch volume, placement time and concrete elevation, compare with ultrasonic trench profile and recovered-fluid volume, and identify depths where the trend changes. Review abnormal balance together with geology and placement events; the wall designer defines supplementary investigation rather than releasing work from one excess ratio. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：量平衡異常須與地質及澆置事件一起審查；壁體設計者決定補充檢測範圍，不以單一超量率放行。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Review abnormal balance together with geology and placement events; the wall designer defines supplementary investigation rather than releasing work from one excess ratio. The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土量平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete volume balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

The ratio does not distinguish overbreak, loss and measurement error and has no universal pass range; acceptance also requires independent material, geometry and integrity evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此比值不區分超挖、損失及量測誤差，也沒有通用合格範圍；驗收還需材料、幾何與完整性等獨立證據。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土用量超過理論值就代表連續壁一定更強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete volume above theory necessarily produces a stronger diaphragm wall." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土量平衡的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete volume balance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。
只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight.
Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness.
quiz.explanation: 只看總方量足夠可能掩蓋局部夾泥，過量混凝土也可能代表槽壁坍塌而非有效增加壁厚。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adequate total volume can conceal local slurry inclusions; excess concrete may indicate wall collapse rather than useful additional wall thickness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證」與「鄰房角變形的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification" and "Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭水力坡降」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint hydraulic gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。外內水頭差沿很短的缺口集中時，局部坡降會很高，可能引發滲流帶砂；因此完工水密不是只靠壁體本身的滲透係數來判斷。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭水力坡降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components. A head difference concentrated across a short defect creates a high local gradient and may transport soil. Completed-wall sealing therefore cannot be established solely from the permeability of the concrete away from its joints. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint hydraulic gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭水力坡降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint hydraulic gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證

knowledge.text: 相鄰連續壁槽段的接頭是幾何、混凝土品質及止水構件共同形成的薄弱界面。外內水頭差沿很短的缺口集中時，局部坡降會很高，可能引發滲流帶砂；因此完工水密不是只靠壁體本身的滲透係數來判斷。

knowledge.text: 誤解：連續壁混凝土本體抗滲合格，就代表每個接頭水密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Panel joints are interfaces governed jointly by geometry, concrete quality and sealing components.

steps.title: 接頭水力坡降的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭水力坡降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint hydraulic gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水頭差Δh=10 m、有效滲流路長L=0.5 m，水力坡降i=Δh/L=20，無因次。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分槽段記錄水壓與出水混濁度，將接頭位置、實際偏斜及止水構件紀錄疊合，追查短路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pressure and turbidity by panel, overlay joint positions, actual deviation and waterstop records, and investigate short seepage paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For head difference Δh=10 m and effective seepage length L=0.5 m, hydraulic gradient i=Δh/L=20, dimensionless. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

steps.titleEn: Joint hydraulic gradient mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭水力坡降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint hydraulic gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分槽段記錄水壓與出水混濁度，將接頭位置、實際偏斜及止水構件紀錄疊合，追查短路徑。接頭缺陷處理需由地工及結構設計者共同核准，監測應持續涵蓋外水頭與周邊沉陷，不能只記室內漏水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pressure and turbidity by panel, overlay joint positions, actual deviation and waterstop records, and investigate short seepage paths. Geotechnical and structural designers jointly approve joint repair; monitoring must retain external heads and adjacent settlement rather than indoor leakage alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭缺陷處理需由地工及結構設計者共同核准，監測應持續涵蓋外水頭與周邊沉陷，不能只記室內漏水量。坡降不是流量，仍需滲透性及路徑面積才能估算出水；局部集中流與侵蝕可能使達西均質模型失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Geotechnical and structural designers jointly approve joint repair; monitoring must retain external heads and adjacent settlement rather than indoor leakage alone. Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭缺口可導致帶砂滲流與周邊沉陷；內表面止漏若未查明水路，可能只把流量轉移到鄰近界面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A joint defect can cause sediment-carrying leakage and adjacent settlement; surface sealing without tracing the water path may merely divert flow to a neighbouring interface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Gradient is not flow rate; permeability and path area are still required, and concentrated flow or erosion may invalidate a homogeneous Darcy model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Impermeable wall concrete guarantees every panel joint is watertight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鄰房角變形的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鄰房角變形」如何影響連續壁槽溝穩定的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adjacent-building distortion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-trench stability for diaphragm walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深開挖壁體變形與地層流失可傳到鄰房，使基礎產生差異沉陷。結構反應與基礎型式、跨距及既有裂縫相關，不能用總沉陷一項代表損傷風險；角變形可作初步指標，但需扣除整體剛體傾斜並關注局部曲率。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鄰房角變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall movement and ground loss can transmit to neighbouring foundations as differential settlement. Structural response depends on foundation type, span and existing cracking, so total settlement alone does not describe damage potential. Angular distortion is an initial indicator, but rigid-body tilt must be separated and local curvature considered. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adjacent-building distortion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：兩測點差異沉陷Δs=4 mm、距離L=8 m=8000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For differential settlement Δs=4 mm over L=8 m=8000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鄰房角變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adjacent-building distortion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鄰房角變形的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 深開挖壁體變形與地層流失可傳到鄰房，使基礎產生差異沉陷。結構反應與基礎型式、跨距及既有裂縫相關，不能用總沉陷一項代表損傷風險；角變形可作初步指標，但需扣除整體剛體傾斜並關注局部曲率。
knowledge.textEn: Wall movement and ground loss can transmit to neighbouring foundations as differential settlement. Structural response depends on foundation type, span and existing cracking, so total settlement alone does not describe damage potential.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鄰房角變形的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。
深開挖壁體變形與地層流失可傳到鄰房，使基礎產生差異沉陷。
穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。
optionsEn: Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members.
Wall movement and ground loss can transmit to neighbouring foundations as differential settlement.
Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level.
quiz.explanation: 深開挖壁體變形與地層流失可傳到鄰房，使基礎產生差異沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall movement and ground loss can transmit to neighbouring foundations as differential settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鄰房角變形的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鄰房角變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adjacent-building distortion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：兩測點差異沉陷Δs=4 mm、距離L=8 m=8000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For differential settlement Δs=4 mm over L=8 m=8000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工前建立建物裂縫與高程基準，將精密水準、傾度及壁體位移聯合比對，檢查測點是否隨建物整體轉動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish preconstruction crack and elevation baselines, jointly compare precise levelling, tilt and wall movement, and determine whether points follow rigid-body building rotation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：兩測點差異沉陷Δs=4 mm、距離L=8 m=8000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For differential settlement Δs=4 mm over L=8 m=8000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鄰房角變形的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 槽段越長、接頭越少，就必定具有更好的整體安全性。

A correctly located trench collar guarantees the full-depth panel position.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Managing only mean settlement can miss differential foundation movement that cracks members first; an affected survey reference can also conceal actual deformation. steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工前建立建物裂縫與高程基準，將精密水準、傾度及壁體位移聯合比對，檢查測點是否隨建物整體轉動。警戒值應由建物評估者依資產能力訂定；監測異常由開挖及建物設計專業共同判讀，並保留原始讀值。
knowledge.textEn: Establish preconstruction crack and elevation baselines, jointly compare precise levelling, tilt and wall movement, and determine whether points follow rigid-body building rotation. The building assessor sets triggers from asset capacity; excavation and building specialists interpret anomalies jointly while preserving the original measurements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 警戒值應由建物評估者依資產能力訂定；監測異常由開挖及建物設計專業共同判讀，並保留原始讀值。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。
knowledge.textEn: The building assessor sets triggers from asset capacity; excavation and building specialists interpret anomalies jointly while preserving the original measurements. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鄰房角變形的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification"?
options: 施工前建立建物裂縫與高程基準，將精密水準、傾度及壁體位移聯合比對，檢查測點是否隨建物整體轉動。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼筋比穩定液重，所以施工中完全不可能上浮。
optionsEn: Establish preconstruction crack and elevation baselines, jointly compare precise levelling, tilt and wall movement, and determine whether points follow rigid-body building rotation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Steel is denser than slurry, so the cage cannot rise during construction.
quiz.explanation: 施工前建立建物裂縫與高程基準，將精密水準、傾度及壁體位移聯合比對，檢查測點是否隨建物整體轉動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish preconstruction crack and elevation baselines, jointly compare precise levelling, tilt and wall movement, and determine whether points follow rigid-body building rotation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鄰房角變形的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鄰房角變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adjacent-building distortion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以平均沉陷管理，局部基礎差異可能先造成梁柱裂縫；基準點受影響也會掩蓋真實變形。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Managing only mean settlement can miss differential foundation movement that cracks members first; an affected survey reference can also conceal actual deformation. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建物總沉陷很小就能保證任何接縫與構件都不受損。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small total building settlement guarantees no damage to joints or members." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以平均沉陷管理，局部基礎差異可能先造成梁柱裂縫；基準點受影響也會掩蓋真實變形。此兩點斜率不是通用損傷界限，也不能區分平移與彎曲；應增加測點、溫度修正及結構模型來辨識真實變形模式。
knowledge.textEn: Managing only mean settlement can miss differential foundation movement that cracks members first; an affected survey reference can also conceal actual deformation. This two-point slope is not a universal damage limit and cannot distinguish translation from bending; additional points, temperature corrections and structural modelling identify the real deformation mode.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鄰房角變形的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Adjacent-building distortion mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若只以平均沉陷管理，局部基礎差異可能先造成梁柱裂縫；基準點受影響也會掩蓋真實變形。
穩定液密度合格就不需要再監測液面高度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Managing only mean settlement can miss differential foundation movement that cracks members first.
Acceptable slurry density eliminates the need to monitor fluid level.
quiz.explanation: 若只以平均沉陷管理，局部基礎差異可能先造成梁柱裂縫；基準點受影響也會掩蓋真實變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Managing only mean settlement can miss differential foundation movement that cracks members first; an affected survey reference can also conceal actual deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 咬合樁止水壁施工
courses.summary: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。
courses.summaryEn: Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence.
courses.focus: 咬合幾何、先後樁齡期與止水連續性
courses.focusEn: Secant geometry, primary-pile age and cutoff continuity
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：相同圓樁直徑D=1.0 m，中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。若只把中心距增加10%至0.88 m，樁徑不變，咬合減為0.12 m，降低40%。這顯示接近幾何閉合條件時，小幅位置變更可消耗很大的餘量。實際還須扣除孔斜、樁徑變異及測量誤差，並用全深相鄰樁位置重建止水路徑；正的名目咬合不是接面水密或結構抗剪已獲證明。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: equal circular piles have D=1.0 m and centre spacing s=0.8 m, giving nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. Increase spacing alone by 10% to 0.88 m while holding diameter fixed: overlap becomes 0.12 m, a 40% reduction. This shows how a small positional change can consume substantial reserve near a geometric closure condition. Actual evaluation must also account for inclination, diameter variation and survey uncertainty and reconstruct the full-depth cutoff using adjacent-pile positions. Positive nominal overlap does not demonstrate either watertight contact or structural shear transfer. Verify the geometric prediction against independent survey and observed hydraulic behaviour.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 合成教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m
合成教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h
合成教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴
合成教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m
合成教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm
合成教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m

Synthetic teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h

Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m
Synthetic teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」與「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification" and "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal overlap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「設計咬合量」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal overlap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。樁位偏差及鑽孔彎曲會沿深度改變實際交疊，槽口看起來連續不代表深部也完整；止水與結構連續性須分別考慮主次樁材料及鋼筋配置。此式只給兩個等直徑平行圓柱的線性咬合尺寸，未證明接觸品質或抗剪連續性；不等徑與偏斜需按三維幾何處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設計咬合量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. Position errors and curved bores change overlap with depth, so a continuous collar does not prove deep continuity. Hydraulic and structural performance must separately account for primary-secondary materials and reinforcement arrangements. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal overlap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「設計咬合量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal overlap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。樁位偏差及鑽孔彎曲會沿深度改變實際交疊，槽口看起來連續不代表深部也完整；止水與結構連續性須分別考慮主次樁材料及鋼筋配置。
knowledge.textEn: Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. Position errors and curved bores change overlap with depth, so a continuous collar does not prove deep continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。
相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。
固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。
optionsEn: Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth.
Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap.
Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰圓樁相交形成牆體連續性，中心距與直徑共同決定名目咬合量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intersecting circular piles create wall continuity, with centre spacing and diameter defining nominal overlap. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal overlap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計咬合量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal overlap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測導牆樁位與全深孔斜，重建相鄰圓柱交集，將最小咬合位置與含水層對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equal pile diameter D=1.0 m and spacing s=0.8 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設計咬合量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal overlap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。
只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。
原創教學假設：假設相同樁徑D=1.0 m、中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。
optionsEn: A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis.
Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe.

steps.title: 設計咬合量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Survey guide-wall positions and full-depth inclinations, reconstruct adjacent cylinder intersections, and compare minimum overlap locations with aquifers. Accept overlap from full-depth relative geometry rather than single-pile tolerances alone; the geotechnical designer approves supplementary investigation of anomalies. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Accept overlap from full-depth relative geometry rather than single-pile tolerances alone; the geotechnical designer approves supplementary investigation of anomalies. This expression gives a linear overlap for equal parallel cylinders only and proves neither contact quality nor shear continuity; unequal diameters and deviations require three-dimensional geometry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：深部樁體分離會形成滲流缺口，土砂流失可能先於可見牆面裂縫出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deep separation creates seepage gaps, and soil loss may precede visible wall cracking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「先行樁切削齡期」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary-pile cutting age” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。可切削窗口受配比、溫度與養護影響，不能只用日曆天數管理；施工排程需與材料強度發展及實際切入紀錄連結。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「先行樁切削齡期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles. Material that is too soft may displace, while excessive hardness can deflect tools or impede cutting. The workable window depends on mix, temperature and curing, so calendar age alone is inadequate; sequencing must be linked to strength development and actual cutting behaviour. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Primary-pile cutting age” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For primary completion t₁=24 h and secondary cutting t₂=96 h on one clock, elapsed age Δt=72 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「先行樁切削齡期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Primary-pile cutting age”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 次樁鑽掘必須切入先行樁，先行材料太軟可能被擠移，太硬則會使刀具偏轉或難以切削。可切削窗口受配比、溫度與養護影響，不能只用日曆天數管理；施工排程需與材料強度發展及實際切入紀錄連結。
knowledge.textEn: Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles. Material that is too soft may displace, while excessive hardness can deflect tools or impede cutting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
Secondary drilling must cut into primary piles.

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設先行樁澆置完成t₁=24 h、次樁切入t₂=96 h，相對齡期Δt=t₂−t₁=72 h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
