steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。排程需保留澆置、切入及材料強度證據；延誤時由材料及成樁負責人重新核定切削窗口。
knowledge.textEn: Use companion-cured samples and temperature records to estimate cutting-age strength, then compare drilling torque, deviation and recovered material. Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 排程需保留澆置、切入及材料強度證據；延誤時由材料及成樁負責人重新核定切削窗口。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。
knowledge.textEn: Retain placement, cutting and strength evidence in the schedule; materials and piling leads reassess the cutting window after delays. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。
設計咬合量扣除平均偏差後為正，就不需其他驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use companion-cured samples and temperature records to estimate cutting-age strength, then compare drilling torque, deviation and recovered material.
Positive overlap after subtracting mean deviation needs no further verification.
quiz.explanation: 以同養護試體與溫度紀錄核對切削時強度，再比較鑽進扭矩、偏斜與回收材料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use companion-cured samples and temperature records to estimate cutting-age strength, then compare drilling torque, deviation and recovered material. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「先行樁切削齡期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary-pile cutting age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「固定等三天就能適用所有氣溫與先行樁配比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Waiting a fixed three days works for every temperature and primary-pile mix." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。時間差不是材料強度，亦沒有通用合格齡期；應以代表性試驗建立強度與可切削性的場址關係。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. Elapsed time is not material strength and has no universal acceptance age; representative tests must establish the site-specific relation between strength and cuttability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「先行樁切削齡期的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Primary-pile cutting age mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。
齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth.
quiz.explanation: 齡期超窗可能使次樁偏離先行樁，留下深部未咬合帶，即使鑽達設計深度仍無法止水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting outside the workable window can deflect the secondary pile and leave a deep unconnected strip despite reaching design depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「結構樁剛度的機理與驗證」與「冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification" and "Capping-beam transfer mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「結構樁剛度」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Structural-pile stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。圓截面慣性矩隨直徑四次方增加，但開裂、咬合切削與配筋會改變有效剛度，並影響各樁分擔的土壓。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「結構樁剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action; soft primary piles cannot automatically be treated as equally stiff reinforced concrete. Circular-section inertia increases with diameter to the fourth power, but cracking, secant cuts and reinforcement change effective stiffness and the pressure shared by individual piles. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Structural-pile stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「結構樁剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Structural-pile stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。圓截面慣性矩隨直徑四次方增加，但開裂、咬合切削與配筋會改變有效剛度，並影響各樁分擔的土壓。
knowledge.textEn: Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action; soft primary piles cannot automatically be treated as equally stiff reinforced concrete. Circular-section inertia increases with diameter to the fourth power, but cracking, secant cuts and reinforcement change effective stiffness and the pressure shared by individual piles.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「結構樁剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。
所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。
冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。
optionsEn: Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action.
All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis.
quiz.explanation: 擋土牆的彎曲剛度取決於真正承擔結構作用的樁列，不能把所有軟質先行樁都當成同樣剛度的鋼筋混凝土。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall bending stiffness depends on the piles actually assigned structural action; soft primary piles cannot automatically be treated as equally stiff reinforced concrete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「結構樁剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Structural-pile stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實際樁徑、切削輪廓及鋼筋位置輸入截面分析，以測得牆位移比較開裂與未開裂剛度範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「結構樁剛度的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。
原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。
任何一個應變計都可直接量出整根樁的彎矩。
optionsEn: Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe.
Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴.
Any single strain gauge directly measures the entire pile's bending moment.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設完整實心圓截面D=1 m，毛截面I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For a complete solid circular section D=1 m, gross second moment I=πD⁴/64=0.0491 m⁴. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「結構樁剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Structural-pile stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實際樁徑、切削輪廓及鋼筋位置輸入截面分析，以測得牆位移比較開裂與未開裂剛度範圍。計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds. Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高估先行樁剛度會低估牆位移，並錯估冠梁與支撐反力，造成鄰近資產變形超出預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstating primary-pile stiffness underestimates wall movement and misallocates cap and strut forces, increasing unexpected adjacent-asset deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds. Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 計算書應標明主次樁各自材料與開裂假設；結構設計者核准等值牆剛度後才用於整體開挖模型。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。
knowledge.textEn: Identify primary-secondary materials and cracking assumptions; the structural designer approves equivalent wall stiffness before it is used in excavation analysis. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「結構樁剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
漏水量逐年下降就一定表示牆體性能逐年改善。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Declining annual leakage necessarily indicates improving wall performance.
Insert actual diameter, cut profile and reinforcement into section analysis, comparing measured wall movement with cracked and uncracked stiffness bounds.

steps.title: 結構樁剛度的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural-pile stiffness mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「結構樁剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Structural-pile stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高估先行樁剛度會低估牆位移，並錯估冠梁與支撐反力，造成鄰近資產變形超出預期。毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overstating primary-pile stiffness underestimates wall movement and misallocates cap and strut forces, increasing unexpected adjacent-asset deformation. Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：毛截面慣性矩是幾何量而非整體牆剛度，還須乘相應模數並考慮每米樁數；裂縫及接觸滑移可能主導變形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gross inertia is geometric rather than system stiffness; the corresponding modulus and piles per metre are also needed, while cracking and interface slip may govern deformation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Capping-beam transfer mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「冠梁荷載轉移」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capping-beam transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 冠梁把不均勻樁頭反力重新分配到鄰近樁體，並為上部支撐提供連續的傳力界面。它的作用取決於樁頭嵌入、鋼筋錨定與接縫，不能只把冠梁視為整平構件；局部空樁或樁頭缺陷會增加其跨越需求。簡支點載模型只示範局部彎矩，真實冠梁常為連續梁且受扭；樁頭剛度及支撐偏心須另行納入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「冠梁荷載轉移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A capping beam redistributes unequal pile-head reactions and provides a continuous interface for upper support. Its function depends on pile embedment, reinforcement anchorage and joints, not merely surface levelling. A missing or defective pile head increases the distance over which the beam must bridge and transfer load. The simple point-load model illustrates local bending only; actual caps are often continuous and torsion-sensitive, requiring pile-head stiffness and support eccentricity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Capping-beam transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冠梁只是把樁頭連起來，不需要分析彎矩與剪力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A cap merely connects pile heads and needs no bending or shear analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「冠梁荷載轉移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Capping-beam transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冠梁荷載轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Capping-beam transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported cap span L=3 m and central force P=400 kN, Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對樁頭標高、混凝土品質與主筋錨定長度，將支撐反力位置和樁中心放在同一配筋圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify pile-head level, concrete quality and bar anchorage, placing support reactions and pile centres on one reinforcement drawing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設簡支冠梁跨L=3 m、跨中集中力P=400 kN，Mmax=PL/4=300 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

steps.title: 冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冠梁荷載轉移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對樁頭標高、混凝土品質與主筋錨定長度，將支撐反力位置和樁中心放在同一配筋圖。澆置前確認樁頭與冠梁傳力細部；支撐位置變更須由冠梁設計者重新核對，而非現場直接移座。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify pile-head level, concrete quality and bar anchorage, placing support reactions and pile centres on one reinforcement drawing. knowledge.text: 樁頭處理不足使冠梁局部失去支承，裂縫可能集中在支撐座下方並造成反力轉移。簡支點載模型只示範局部彎矩，真實冠梁常為連續梁且受扭；樁頭剛度及支撐偏心須另行納入。
knowledge.textEn: Poor pile-head preparation can remove local cap support, concentrating cracks below strut seats and redistributing reactions. The simple point-load model illustrates local bending only; actual caps are often continuous and torsion-sensitive, requiring pile-head stiffness and support eccentricity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冠梁荷載轉移的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

樁頭處理不足使冠梁局部失去支承，裂縫可能集中在支撐座下方並造成反力轉移。
四項定位誤差一律都可以用平方和開根號合成。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Poor pile-head preparation can remove local cap support, concentrating cracks below strut seats and redistributing reactions.
Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square.
quiz.explanation: 樁頭處理不足使冠梁局部失去支承，裂縫可能集中在支撐座下方並造成反力轉移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor pile-head preparation can remove local cap support, concentrating cracks below strut seats and redistributing reactions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證」與「樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closure positioning error mechanism and verification" and "Toe embedment mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure positioning error mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合定位誤差」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure positioning error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 封閉圍護牆的最後接合位置累積了前面樁位誤差，不能假設每根樁單獨合格就能自然閉合。誤差可能有共同方向的系統偏差，也可能是獨立隨機偏差；兩者需要不同組合方法，並應及早用獨立測量發現。平方和開根號只適用於指定的獨立隨機假設，最不利容差疊加須另算；標準差也不是最大可能誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合定位誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The final connection in a closed wall inherits earlier positioning errors; individually acceptable piles do not guarantee closure. Errors may share a systematic direction or be independent random deviations, requiring different combination rules. Independent survey should identify the distinction before the final opening becomes too constrained to correct. Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure positioning error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「四項定位誤差一律都可以用平方和開根號合成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合定位誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closure positioning error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Closure positioning error mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 封閉圍護牆的最後接合位置累積了前面樁位誤差，不能假設每根樁單獨合格就能自然閉合。誤差可能有共同方向的系統偏差，也可能是獨立隨機偏差；兩者需要不同組合方法，並應及早用獨立測量發現。
knowledge.textEn: The final connection in a closed wall inherits earlier positioning errors; individually acceptable piles do not guarantee closure. Errors may share a systematic direction or be independent random deviations, requiring different combination rules.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：四項定位誤差一律都可以用平方和開根號合成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Four positioning errors can always be combined by root-sum-square.
Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe.
The final connection in a closed wall inherits earlier positioning errors; individually acceptable piles do not guarantee closure.
quiz.explanation: 封閉圍護牆的最後接合位置累積了前面樁位誤差，不能假設每根樁單獨合格就能自然閉合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure positioning error mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合定位誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure positioning error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立控制網重測起終點，將誤差方向分解，檢查共同偏移後再作統計合成。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey start and closure points from independent control, resolving error directions and checking common bias before statistical combination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。
任何一個應變計都可直接量出整根樁的彎矩。
漏水量逐年下降就一定表示牆體性能逐年改善。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm.
Any single strain gauge directly measures the entire pile's bending moment.
Declining annual leakage necessarily indicates improving wall performance.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設4項獨立零均值誤差各標準差σ=15 mm，合成σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For four independent zero-mean errors each with standard deviation σ=15 mm, combined σtot=√(4σ²)=30 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閉合定位誤差的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure positioning error mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合定位誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure positioning error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立控制網重測起終點，將誤差方向分解，檢查共同偏移後再作統計合成。設置中途閉合檢核與備用修正區，測量負責人應在樁序逼近最後接頭前提交偏差分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey start and closure points from independent control, resolving error directions and checking common bias before statistical combination. Provide interim closure checks and a correction allowance; the survey lead reports deviations before the pile sequence approaches the final connection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設置中途閉合檢核與備用修正區，測量負責人應在樁序逼近最後接頭前提交偏差分析。平方和開根號只適用於指定的獨立隨機假設，最不利容差疊加須另算；標準差也不是最大可能誤差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Provide interim closure checks and a correction allowance; the survey lead reports deviations before the pile sequence approaches the final connection. Root-sum-square applies only under the stated independence assumptions; worst-case tolerance accumulation requires separate analysis, and a standard deviation is not a maximum error.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把系統偏差誤當隨機誤差會低估閉合缺口，最後一樁可能難以兼顧咬合與鋼筋籠淨距。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating systematic bias as random underestimates closure gaps and can leave the final pile unable to achieve both overlap and cage clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 開挖面以下的樁段藉由土體反力提供轉動拘束與側向平衡，嵌入深度同時影響止水路徑。土體被動反力需要位移才能動員，不能只用幾何深度宣稱固定端；深部軟弱層或滲流可能削弱原本假設的支承。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁趾嵌入」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The embedded pile below excavation provides rotational restraint and lateral equilibrium through soil reaction while also lengthening seepage paths. Passive resistance needs movement to mobilize, so embedment depth alone does not establish a fixed end. Deep weak layers or seepage can reduce the assumed support and alter wall deformation. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Toe embedment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樁趾嵌入」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Toe embedment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 開挖面以下的樁段藉由土體反力提供轉動拘束與側向平衡，嵌入深度同時影響止水路徑。土體被動反力需要位移才能動員，不能只用幾何深度宣稱固定端；深部軟弱層或滲流可能削弱原本假設的支承。
knowledge.textEn: The embedded pile below excavation provides rotational restraint and lateral equilibrium through soil reaction while also lengthening seepage paths. Passive resistance needs movement to mobilize, so embedment depth alone does not establish a fixed end.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Toe embedment mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 開挖面以下的樁段藉由土體反力提供轉動拘束與側向平衡，嵌入深度同時影響止水路徑。
只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。
小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。
optionsEn: The embedded pile below excavation provides rotational restraint and lateral equilibrium through soil reaction while also lengthening seepage paths.
Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe.
A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss.
quiz.explanation: 開挖面以下的樁段藉由土體反力提供轉動拘束與側向平衡，嵌入深度同時影響止水路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The embedded pile below excavation provides rotational restraint and lateral equilibrium through soil reaction while also lengthening seepage paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Toe embedment mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樁趾嵌入」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Toe embedment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以地層剖面、樁長與深部傾度曲線核對反力區，檢查支點是否隨開挖或水位改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check reaction zones against stratigraphy, pile length and deep inclinometer profiles, examining whether restraint changes with excavation or groundwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Toe embedment mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 設計咬合量扣除平均偏差後為正，就不需其他驗證。
原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。
樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。
optionsEn: Positive overlap after subtracting mean deviation needs no further verification.
Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m.
Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設每米牆長的反力R=500 kN/m、對開挖底的力臂z=2 m，抗力矩M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For reaction R=500 kN per metre of wall and lever arm z=2 m about excavation level, resisting moment M=Rz=1000 kN·m/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Toe embedment mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樁趾嵌入」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Toe embedment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以地層剖面、樁長與深部傾度曲線核對反力區，檢查支點是否隨開挖或水位改變。樁底地層與深度須留可追溯紀錄；地層異常由地工設計者重新核定嵌入及支撐配置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check reaction zones against stratigraphy, pile length and deep inclinometer profiles, examining whether restraint changes with excavation or groundwater. Retain traceable toe-depth and ground records; the geotechnical designer revises embedment and support layout when unexpected strata are encountered. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：樁底地層與深度須留可追溯紀錄；地層異常由地工設計者重新核定嵌入及支撐配置。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain traceable toe-depth and ground records; the geotechnical designer revises embedment and support layout when unexpected strata are encountered. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Failure to reach the intended bearing stratum allows toe rotation, potentially increasing strut force and causing base movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Retain traceable toe-depth and ground records; the geotechnical designer revises embedment and support layout when unexpected strata are encountered.

knowledge.textEn: Retain traceable toe-depth and ground records; the geotechnical designer revises embedment and support layout when unexpected strata are encountered. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Toe embedment mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
所有咬合樁都可以用相同的毛截面剛度相加。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
All secant piles can be added using identical gross-section stiffness.
Check reaction zones against stratigraphy, pile length and deep inclinometer profiles, examining whether restraint changes with excavation or groundwater.
quiz.explanation: 以地層剖面、樁長與深部傾度曲線核對反力區，檢查支點是否隨開挖或水位改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check reaction zones against stratigraphy, pile length and deep inclinometer profiles, examining whether restraint changes with excavation or groundwater. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Toe embedment mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樁趾嵌入」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Toe embedment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Failure to reach the intended bearing stratum allows toe rotation, potentially increasing strut force and causing base movement. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要樁長達到圖面數字，樁趾就一定是完全固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching the drawing's pile length guarantees a fully fixed toe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。反力乘力臂是力矩平衡，不證明土體能動員該反力；承載、變形、基底隆起及滲流穩定均須獨立檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Failure to reach the intended bearing stratum allows toe rotation, potentially increasing strut force and causing base movement. Reaction times lever arm is equilibrium, not proof that soil can mobilize the reaction; resistance, deformation, base heave and seepage stability require independent checks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樁趾嵌入的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Toe embedment mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未到達設計嵌入層會使牆趾旋轉，表面支撐力可能上升並伴隨開挖底隆起。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「缺口漏水的機理與驗證」與「彎曲應力增量的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Defect leakage mechanism and verification" and "Bending-stress increment mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Defect leakage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「缺口漏水」如何影響咬合樁止水壁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Defect leakage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Secant-pile cutoff-wall construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。流量與缺口面積及水力坡降相關，隨開挖降水增加的壓差會放大弱路徑；帶砂出水則表示地層本身可能正在流失。等效達西模型只供量級比較，開放裂縫可能屬非達西流；沒有水頭資料就不能從一次流量倒推出可靠滲透係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「缺口漏水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Secant-wall sealing is often controlled by local gaps or construction interfaces rather than average concrete permeability. Flow depends on defect area and hydraulic gradient, and drawdown increases the driving pressure along weak paths. Sediment-carrying inflow indicates that the ground itself may be escaping, not merely water leaking through a stable interface. The equivalent Darcy model provides scale only; open fractures may be non-Darcy, and one discharge measurement without head data cannot establish reliable permeability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Defect leakage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設缺口等效k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=0.5 m²、i=10，Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For equivalent defect permeability k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, area A=0.5 m² and gradient i=10, Q=kAi=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「小流量清水滲漏永遠不會演變成帶砂地層流失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「缺口漏水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Defect leakage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 缺口漏水的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 咬合牆的水密性常由局部缺口或施工接面控制，而不是整個混凝土樁的平均滲透性。流量與缺口面積及水力坡降相關，隨開挖降水增加的壓差會放大弱路徑；帶砂出水則表示地層本身可能正在流失。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護移交應包括接頭圖、集水範圍及異常回報責任；營運單位遇到水頭與流量不一致時應請設計專業判讀。短期平均流量不代表永久水密程度，也不是通用允收值；應依資產用途、地下水與地層流失風險建立專案標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes joint maps, catchments and reporting responsibilities; operators seek engineering interpretation when head and flow trends disagree. Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：無環境基準的流量比較可能漏掉排水堵塞，水壓升高後才在其他接頭出現新的滲漏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flow comparisons without environmental baselines can miss drainage blockage until higher pressure creates leakage at other joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「營運漏水趨勢的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Operational leakage trend mechanism and verification"?
options: 用固定集水區與校正容器量測流量，記錄外水位及清理事件，將趨勢和鄰房高程一起檢視。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Measure discharge with fixed catchments and calibrated containers, record external levels and cleaning events, and review trends beside neighbouring-building elevations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A small clear-water leak can never develop into sediment-carrying ground loss.
quiz.explanation: 用固定集水區與校正容器量測流量，記錄外水位及清理事件，將趨勢和鄰房高程一起檢視。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure discharge with fixed catchments and calibrated containers, record external levels and cleaning events, and review trends beside neighbouring-building elevations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 營運漏水趨勢的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Operational leakage trend mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「營運漏水趨勢」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Operational leakage trend” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 無環境基準的流量比較可能漏掉排水堵塞，水壓升高後才在其他接頭出現新的滲漏。短期平均流量不代表永久水密程度，也不是通用允收值；應依資產用途、地下水與地層流失風險建立專案標準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Flow comparisons without environmental baselines can miss drainage blockage until higher pressure creates leakage at other joints. Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：短期平均流量不代表永久水密程度，也不是通用允收值；應依資產用途、地下水與地層流失風險建立專案標準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏水量逐年下降就一定表示牆體性能逐年改善。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Declining annual leakage necessarily indicates improving wall performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Short-term mean discharge is not permanent sealing performance or a universal limit; project criteria depend on asset use, groundwater and potential ground loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「營運漏水趨勢的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Operational leakage trend mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
無環境基準的流量比較可能漏掉排水堵塞，水壓升高後才在其他接頭出現新的滲漏。
樁頂有咬合就能保證所有深度的止水連續性。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Flow comparisons without environmental baselines can miss drainage blockage until higher pressure creates leakage at other joints.
Overlap at the pile heads guarantees cutoff continuity at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 無環境基準的流量比較可能漏掉排水堵塞，水壓升高後才在其他接頭出現新的滲漏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow comparisons without environmental baselines can miss drainage blockage until higher pressure creates leakage at other joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐
courses.summary: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。
courses.summaryEn: Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile.
courses.focus: 圍堰水壓、圍檁支撐與基底滲流穩定
courses.focusEn: Cofferdam water pressure, walers, struts and base seepage
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：內側乾燥、外側水深H=6 m、γw=9.81 kN/m³，靜水壓合力P=γwH²/2=176.58 kN/m。若水深增加10%至6.6 m，P=9.81×6.6²/2=213.66 kN/m，增加21%。同時三角形合力作用點也隨水深改變，因此板樁與支撐彎矩不一定只增加21%。本例未含土壓、波流、兩側有水或基底滲流；須把每種荷載放在同一高程基準的自由體圖，再檢查整體平衡、構件與水力穩定。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: with a dry interior, external depth H=6 m and γw=9.81 kN/m³, hydrostatic resultant P=γwH²/2=176.58 kN/m. Increase depth by 10% to 6.6 m and P=9.81×6.6²/2=213.66 kN/m, a 21% rise. The triangular resultant application point also changes, so sheet and brace moments need not increase by exactly 21%. Earth pressure, waves, two-sided water and base seepage are excluded. Put all relevant loads on free bodies with a common elevation datum, then check overall equilibrium, structural members and hydraulic stability separately. Measured water levels and the installed bracing arrangement must match the stage being assessed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「靜水壓合力的機理與驗證」與「圍檁跨距的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydrostatic resultant mechanism and verification" and "Waler span mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 靜水壓合力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic resultant mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「靜水壓合力」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrostatic resultant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰抽水降低內側水位，外側靜水壓沿深度增加，合力及作用點共同決定板樁與支撐需求。水位差變化會同時改變側壓及底部滲流，不能把抽水只當作施工準備；分層水位或波動需按相應邊界逐階段更新。三角形公式假設單側靜水且內側乾燥；兩側都有水時應相減完整壓力圖，不能無條件只代水位差平方。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「靜水壓合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dewatering lowers the inside level while external hydrostatic pressure rises with depth; both resultant and application point govern sheets and braces. Water-level changes also alter base seepage, so pumping is a structural stage rather than mere preparation. Layered heads and fluctuations require stage-specific boundary updates. The triangular expression assumes one-sided static water and a dry interior; with water on both sides subtract complete pressure diagrams rather than automatically squaring the level difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrostatic resultant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：外側水深H=6 m、內側乾燥、γw=9.81 kN/m³，每米牆合力P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For external depth H=6 m, a dry inside and γw=9.81 kN/m³, force per wall metre P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling water-level difference only doubles the hydrostatic resultant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「靜水壓合力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydrostatic resultant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 靜水壓合力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 圍堰抽水降低內側水位，外側靜水壓沿深度增加，合力及作用點共同決定板樁與支撐需求。水位差變化會同時改變側壓及底部滲流，不能把抽水只當作施工準備；分層水位或波動需按相應邊界逐階段更新。
knowledge.textEn: Dewatering lowers the inside level while external hydrostatic pressure rises with depth; both resultant and application point govern sheets and braces. Water-level changes also alter base seepage, so pumping is a structural stage rather than mere preparation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling water-level difference only doubles the hydrostatic resultant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「靜水壓合力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydrostatic resultant mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。
圍堰抽水降低內側水位，外側靜水壓沿深度增加，合力及作用點共同決定板樁與支撐需求。
圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。
optionsEn: Doubling water-level difference only doubles the hydrostatic resultant.
Dewatering lowers the inside level while external hydrostatic pressure rises with depth; both resultant and application point govern sheets and braces.
A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact.
quiz.explanation: 圍堰抽水降低內側水位，外側靜水壓沿深度增加，合力及作用點共同決定板樁與支撐需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dewatering lowers the inside level while external hydrostatic pressure rises with depth; both resultant and application point govern sheets and braces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 靜水壓合力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic resultant mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「靜水壓合力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydrostatic resultant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外側水深H=6 m、內側乾燥、γw=9.81 kN/m³，每米牆合力P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For external depth H=6 m, a dry inside and γw=9.81 kN/m³, force per wall metre P=γwH²/2=176.6 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以內外水位計建立壓力圖，核對作用點與支撐標高，對照板樁位移及支撐反力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use inside and outside level gauges to build pressure diagrams, checking application points and brace elevations against sheet movement and strut reactions.

steps.title: 圍檁跨距的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Waler span mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「圍檁跨距」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Waler span” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍檁收集多片板樁的側向反力並傳給離散支撐，跨距、連續性及支撐座位置因此決定局部彎矩。荷載不一定均布，板樁接觸不良會使部分圍檁先受力；施工偏心也可能讓名義平面彎曲變成扭轉與局部腹板承壓。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「圍檁跨距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Walers collect reactions from multiple sheets and transfer them to discrete braces, making span, continuity and seating position critical to local bending. Loads need not be uniform: poor contact concentrates reactions, while construction eccentricity can add torsion and local web bearing to nominal in-plane bending. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Waler span” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported waler with w=80 kN/m and span L=3 m, M=wL²/8=90 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「圍檁跨距」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For a simply supported waler with w=80 kN/m and span L=3 m, M=wL²/8=90 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 圍檁跨距的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Waler span mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「圍檁跨距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Waler span” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對實際支點間距與板樁接觸，量測圍檁側移及支撐反力，檢查接頭是否位於高彎矩區。接觸墊塊、接頭與腹板加勁須依圖驗收；任何支撐間距變更由臨時工程設計者核准。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify actual brace spacing and sheet contact, measure waler displacement and reactions, and inspect whether splices lie in high-moment zones. Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接觸墊塊、接頭與腹板加勁須依圖驗收；任何支撐間距變更由臨時工程設計者核准。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：圍檁背後空隙會讓局部板樁超彎，未加勁腹板也可能在支撐座先壓潰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gaps behind walers can overbend individual sheets, while an unstiffened web may crush locally at a strut seat. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Verify actual brace spacing and sheet contact, measure waler displacement and reactions, and inspect whether splices lie in high-moment zones. Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing.

knowledge.textEn: Inspect contact packs, splices and web stiffeners against drawings; the temporary-works designer approves every change in brace spacing. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.

quiz.question: 要驗證「圍檁跨距的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Waler span mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對實際支點間距與板樁接觸，量測圍檁側移及支撐反力，檢查接頭是否位於高彎矩區。
水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。
