Verify actual brace spacing and sheet contact, measure waler displacement and reactions, and inspect whether splices lie in high-moment zones.
Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force.
quiz.explanation: 核對實際支點間距與板樁接觸，量測圍檁側移及支撐反力，檢查接頭是否位於高彎矩區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify actual brace spacing and sheet contact, measure waler displacement and reactions, and inspect whether splices lie in high-moment zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 圍檁跨距的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Waler span mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「圍檁跨距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Waler span” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 圍檁背後空隙會讓局部板樁超彎，未加勁腹板也可能在支撐座先壓潰。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Gaps behind walers can overbend individual sheets, while an unstiffened web may crush locally at a strut seat. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 圍檁背後空隙會讓局部板樁超彎，未加勁腹板也可能在支撐座先壓潰。簡支均布式只提供比較量級，連續梁、接頭滑移與角隅都會改變彎矩分布；構件強度與側向穩定須另查。
knowledge.textEn: Gaps behind walers can overbend individual sheets, while an unstiffened web may crush locally at a strut seat. The simple uniform-load expression is a scale comparison; continuity, splice slip and corners alter moment distribution, and member resistance and lateral stability require separate checks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「圍檁跨距的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Waler span mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。
圍檁背後空隙會讓局部板樁超彎，未加勁腹板也可能在支撐座先壓潰。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength.
Gaps behind walers can overbend individual sheets, while an unstiffened web may crush locally at a strut seat.
quiz.explanation: 圍檁背後空隙會讓局部板樁超彎，未加勁腹板也可能在支撐座先壓潰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Gaps behind walers can overbend individual sheets, while an unstiffened web may crush locally at a strut seat. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支撐挫屈的機理與驗證」與「鎖口漏水的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strut buckling mechanism and verification" and "Interlock leakage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支撐挫屈的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strut buckling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支撐挫屈」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strut buckling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受壓支撐會受整體挫屈控制，長度與端部拘束的影響可能比截面面積更大。安裝彎曲、接頭偏心與側向支承失效會降低承載，不能把理想歐拉荷重當可直接使用的設計抗力；施工期間堆料也可能增加橫向彎曲。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支撐挫屈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compression struts may be governed by global buckling, with length and end restraint more influential than area alone. Initial bow, splice eccentricity and lost lateral restraint reduce resistance. Ideal Euler load is not directly usable design resistance, and construction stockpiles may add transverse bending to the member. Euler theory assumes an elastic straight ideal member with specified ends; design resistance also includes imperfections, local buckling and code reductions rather than using this number directly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strut buckling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支撐挫屈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strut buckling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支撐挫屈的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 受壓支撐會受整體挫屈控制，長度與端部拘束的影響可能比截面面積更大。安裝彎曲、接頭偏心與側向支承失效會降低承載，不能把理想歐拉荷重當可直接使用的設計抗力；施工期間堆料也可能增加橫向彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: Compression struts may be governed by global buckling, with length and end restraint more influential than area alone. Initial bow, splice eccentricity and lost lateral restraint reduce resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支撐挫屈的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strut buckling mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 受壓支撐會受整體挫屈控制，長度與端部拘束的影響可能比截面面積更大。
支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。
鋼板樁已互鎖就表示圍堰完全不會漏水。
optionsEn: Compression struts may be governed by global buckling, with length and end restraint more influential than area alone.
A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength.
Interlocked sheet piles make the cofferdam completely watertight.
quiz.explanation: 受壓支撐會受整體挫屈控制，長度與端部拘束的影響可能比截面面積更大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compression struts may be governed by global buckling, with length and end restraint more influential than area alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支撐挫屈的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strut buckling mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支撐挫屈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strut buckling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測直線度與側向支承位置，檢查接頭轉動及偏心，將實際端部條件帶入構件穩定分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure straightness and lateral-restraint positions, inspect splice rotation and eccentricity, and use actual end conditions in member-stability analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支撐挫屈的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strut buckling mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 圖面嵌入深度不變，樁趾抗力就永遠不變。
原創教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN。
支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。
optionsEn: Toe resistance remains unchanged whenever the drawing's embedment length is unchanged.
Original teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN.
An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設鉸接有效長L=8 m、E=200 GPa、I=0.0002 m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For pinned effective length L=8 m, E=200 GPa and I=0.0002 m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=6.17 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支撐挫屈的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strut buckling mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐挫屈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strut buckling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測直線度與側向支承位置，檢查接頭轉動及偏心，將實際端部條件帶入構件穩定分析。支撐不得被當未核准的吊掛梁使用；移除側向約束前須由臨時工程設計者重新核算有效長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure straightness and lateral-restraint positions, inspect splice rotation and eccentricity, and use actual end conditions in member-stability analysis. Do not use struts as unapproved lifting beams; the temporary-works designer recalculates effective length before lateral restraint is removed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支撐不得被當未核准的吊掛梁使用；移除側向約束前須由臨時工程設計者重新核算有效長度。歐拉式假設彈性、理想直桿與指定端部條件；設計抗力還須納入缺陷、局部挫屈與規範折減，不是本算值本身。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interlock leakage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 板樁鎖口提供相互連接卻不一定天然水密，施工損傷與不連續封材可形成縱向漏水路徑。多處小漏點相加後會影響排水容量，若伴隨細砂則也涉及地層流失；鎖口幾何及實際嵌合需要與水頭一起判讀。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鎖口漏水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocks connect sheets but are not inherently watertight; driving damage and discontinuous sealant create longitudinal leakage paths. Many small leaks can consume pumping capacity, while entrained fines indicate ground loss. Interlock geometry and actual engagement must therefore be interpreted together with hydraulic head. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interlock leakage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設20處鎖口各漏q=0.3 L/min，總Q=20q=6 L/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For twenty interlocks each leaking q=0.3 L/min, total flow Q=20q=6 L/min.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「鎖口漏水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 鎖口漏水的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interlock leakage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鎖口漏水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interlock leakage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 脫扣或破損鎖口可能造成帶砂集中湧水，增加抽水量並誘發圍堰外地層沉陷。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A disengaged or damaged interlock may produce concentrated sediment-carrying inflow, increasing pumping and causing ground settlement outside the cofferdam. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼板樁已互鎖就表示圍堰完全不會漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Interlocked sheet piles make the cofferdam completely watertight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 脫扣或破損鎖口可能造成帶砂集中湧水，增加抽水量並誘發圍堰外地層沉陷。線性加總假設各漏點保持原流量，實際堵塞或壓力重分配會改變總量；流量合格仍不能證明無帶砂風險。
knowledge.textEn: A disengaged or damaged interlock may produce concentrated sediment-carrying inflow, increasing pumping and causing ground settlement outside the cofferdam. Linear summation assumes unchanged individual leakage; blockage and pressure redistribution alter totals, and acceptable flow does not establish absence of soil-transport risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鎖口漏水的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interlock leakage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
脫扣或破損鎖口可能造成帶砂集中湧水，增加抽水量並誘發圍堰外地層沉陷。
鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A disengaged or damaged interlock may produce concentrated sediment-carrying inflow, increasing pumping and causing ground settlement outside the cofferdam.
If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping.
quiz.explanation: 脫扣或破損鎖口可能造成帶砂集中湧水，增加抽水量並誘發圍堰外地層沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A disengaged or damaged interlock may produce concentrated sediment-carrying inflow, increasing pumping and causing ground settlement outside the cofferdam. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證」與「樁趾被動反力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Critical base gradient mechanism and verification" and "Toe passive resistance mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Critical base gradient mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基底臨界坡降」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical base gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 向上滲流會減少土粒有效重量，當滲透力接近浮重時，顆粒接觸力大幅降低並可能形成砂湧。基底管湧不一定與板樁彎曲超載同時發生，因此結構支撐足夠仍需獨立查滲流路徑、出口坡降及反濾保護。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基底臨界坡降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Upward seepage reduces effective grain weight; as seepage force approaches submerged weight, contact forces fall and boiling may develop. Hydraulic instability need not coincide with excessive sheet bending. Adequate structural bracing therefore still requires independent assessment of seepage paths, exit gradients and filter protection. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Critical base gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基底臨界坡降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Critical base gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Critical base gradient mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 向上滲流會減少土粒有效重量，當滲透力接近浮重時，顆粒接觸力大幅降低並可能形成砂湧。基底管湧不一定與板樁彎曲超載同時發生，因此結構支撐足夠仍需獨立查滲流路徑、出口坡降及反濾保護。
knowledge.textEn: Upward seepage reduces effective grain weight; as seepage force approaches submerged weight, contact forces fall and boiling may develop. Hydraulic instability need not coincide with excessive sheet bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical base gradient mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。
圖面嵌入深度不變，樁趾抗力就永遠不變。
向上滲流會減少土粒有效重量，當滲透力接近浮重時，顆粒接觸力大幅降低並可能形成砂湧。
optionsEn: If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping.
Toe resistance remains unchanged whenever the drawing's embedment length is unchanged.
Upward seepage reduces effective grain weight; as seepage force approaches submerged weight, contact forces fall and boiling may develop.
quiz.explanation: 向上滲流會減少土粒有效重量，當滲透力接近浮重時，顆粒接觸力大幅降低並可能形成砂湧。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Upward seepage reduces effective grain weight; as seepage force approaches submerged weight, contact forces fall and boiling may develop. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical base gradient mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基底臨界坡降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical base gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用分層水壓計估計基底水頭差，配合土樣孔隙比及出口位置，檢查坡降集中而非只取平均值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate base head differences with multilevel piezometers, combine sample void ratio and exit location, and assess gradient concentration rather than only average gradient.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Critical base gradient mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0。
支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。
最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0.
An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設土粒比重Gs=2.65、孔隙比e=0.65，理想臨界坡降icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For grain specific gravity Gs=2.65 and void ratio e=0.65, ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.0. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Critical base gradient mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基底臨界坡降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical base gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用分層水壓計估計基底水頭差，配合土樣孔隙比及出口位置，檢查坡降集中而非只取平均值。抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate base head differences with multilevel piezometers, combine sample void ratio and exit location, and assess gradient concentration rather than only average gradient. Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基底砂湧會流失土粒並削弱樁趾反力，繼而影響整體圍堰；表面出水量不大也不能忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Base boiling removes soil and weakens toe restraint, subsequently affecting the whole cofferdam; even modest visible flow can be significant. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用分層水壓計估計基底水頭差，配合土樣孔隙比及出口位置，檢查坡降集中而非只取平均值。抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate base head differences with multilevel piezometers, combine sample void ratio and exit location, and assess gradient concentration rather than only average gradient. Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 抽水計畫需設水壓及帶砂觀測停留點；地工設計者確認出口坡降與反濾條件後才改變內水位。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。
knowledge.textEn: Dewatering plans include pressure and sediment hold points; the geotechnical designer confirms exit gradients and filtration before internal levels change. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基底臨界坡降的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Critical base gradient mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用分層水壓計估計基底水頭差，配合土樣孔隙比及出口位置，檢查坡降集中而非只取平均值。
圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Estimate base head differences with multilevel piezometers, combine sample void ratio and exit location, and assess gradient concentration rather than only average gradient.
A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact.
quiz.explanation: 用分層水壓計估計基底水頭差，配合土樣孔隙比及出口位置，檢查坡降集中而非只取平均值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate base head differences with multilevel piezometers, combine sample void ratio and exit location, and assess gradient concentration rather than only average gradient. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基底砂湧會流失土粒並削弱樁趾反力，繼而影響整體圍堰；表面出水量不大也不能忽略。這是均質無黏性土的理想起浮條件，非專案安全係數；內部侵蝕可在其他條件下發生，分層與集中水路須另外分析。
knowledge.textEn: Base boiling removes soil and weakens toe restraint, subsequently affecting the whole cofferdam; even modest visible flow can be significant. This is an ideal heave condition for homogeneous cohesionless soil, not a project safety factor; internal erosion can occur under other conditions, requiring analysis of layering and concentrated paths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.title: 樁趾被動反力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Toe passive resistance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樁趾被動反力」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Toe passive resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 板樁嵌入開挖底以下，藉由前方土體被動作用提供平衡，但動員此抗力需要適當位移。開挖擾動、沖刷或砂湧會減少可用深度，若把全被動強度無條件計入，將高估支承並低估板樁轉動及支撐力。公式假設均質土、水平地面及理想被動狀態，未含折減與變形要求；實際設計需考慮水壓和土壓分開的有效應力分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁趾被動反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Embedded sheets mobilize passive soil resistance below excavation, but that resistance requires displacement. Disturbance, scour or boiling reduces usable embedment. Crediting full passive strength unconditionally overstates restraint and underestimates sheet rotation and brace force, particularly when soil and structural deformation compatibility has not been checked. The expression assumes uniform soil, level ground and an ideal passive state without reductions or movement requirements; actual design separates water and effective earth pressures. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Toe passive resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設有效單位重γ′=10 kN/m³、Kp=3、嵌深d=3 m，理想Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For effective unit weight γ′=10 kN/m³, Kp=3 and embedment d=3 m, ideal Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圖面嵌入深度不變，樁趾抗力就永遠不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Toe resistance remains unchanged whenever the drawing's embedment length is unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樁趾被動反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Toe passive resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For effective unit weight γ′=10 kN/m³, Kp=3 and embedment d=3 m, ideal Pp=0.5Kpγ′d²=135 kN/m. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 依「樁趾被動反力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。

水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。

steps.title: 樁趾被動反力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 核對實際開挖面與沖刷高程，量測深部位移並比較土體可動員反力曲線，不只查樁長。基底整平與清淤須控制實際高程，超挖應由地工設計者核准補救後才繼續下一施工階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Control actual elevations during trimming and dredging; the geotechnical designer approves remedies for overexcavation before the next stage proceeds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.explanationEn: Overexcavation or scour ahead of the toe shortens effective embedment, allowing rotation and transferring extra demand to upper braces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」與「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification" and "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抽水荷載增量」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dewatering load increment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。分析必須以固定板樁高程比較前後兩張壓力圖，不能只看水深數字；若抽水與開挖同時進行，土壓重分配也需另列。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抽水荷載增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. Compare complete pressure diagrams at fixed sheet elevations rather than depth numbers alone. When pumping and excavation occur together, earth-pressure redistribution must be accounted for separately from the hydraulic change. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dewatering load increment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「抽水荷載增量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dewatering load increment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。分析必須以固定板樁高程比較前後兩張壓力圖，不能只看水深數字；若抽水與開挖同時進行，土壓重分配也需另列。
knowledge.textEn: Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. Compare complete pressure diagrams at fixed sheet elevations rather than depth numbers alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。
內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。
支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。
optionsEn: Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily.
Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand.
An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
quiz.explanation: 內部水位下降時，原先平衡外水壓的一部分內壓被移除，支撐需求因而增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lowering internal water removes part of the pressure that previously balanced the external side, increasing brace demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「抽水荷載增量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dewatering load increment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。
圍檁截面夠大就不必檢查支撐座與板樁接觸。
原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。
optionsEn: A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant.
A large waler section removes the need to inspect seats and sheet contact.
Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：僅比較同底部的三角形水壓合力，水深H₁=6 m與H₂=4 m，ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Comparing triangular pressure resultants with one common base at depths H₁=6 m and H₂=4 m, ΔP=9.81(H₁²−H₂²)/2=98.1 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「抽水荷載增量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dewatering load increment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。每個水位與拆撐組合須有核定階段編號；臨時工程設計者確認實際順序後才放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis. Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每個水位與拆撐組合須有核定階段編號；臨時工程設計者確認實際順序後才放行。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis. Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence.

knowledge.textEn: Assign an approved stage identifier to each water-level and brace-removal combination; the temporary-works designer releases the actual sequence. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification"?
options: 同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
鋼板樁已互鎖就表示圍堰完全不會漏水。
optionsEn: Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Interlocked sheet piles make the cofferdam completely watertight.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄內外水位與支撐軸力，按固定高程積分壓力增量，檢查反力變化是否符合階段分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize water levels and strut loads, integrate pressure increments over fixed elevations, and check reactions against stage analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「抽水荷載增量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dewatering load increment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。此差值僅比較指定兩個三角形合力，作用點也會改變；若分析兩側水位差，需保留共同底高與完整壓力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available. The difference compares the specified triangular resultants only, whose application points also change; two-sided water-level analysis needs a common base and complete pressure distributions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。
支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available.
An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
quiz.explanation: 同時降低水位與移除支撐會疊加不利作用，可能讓尚未形成永久支承的板樁失去平衡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lowering water while removing braces combines adverse actions and may destabilize sheets before permanent restraint is available. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「角隅偏心」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corner eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。直線段的平面梁分析不能自動涵蓋角接件、焊接與腹板局部承壓，若支撐軸線未交會，荷載路徑需要明確的三維構件傳遞。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「角隅偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. A straight-wall planar beam analysis does not automatically cover corner fittings, welds or local web bearing. Nonintersecting strut axes require an explicit three-dimensional structural path for the forces. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corner eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「角隅偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corner eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。直線段的平面梁分析不能自動涵蓋角接件、焊接與腹板局部承壓，若支撐軸線未交會，荷載路徑需要明確的三維構件傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. A straight-wall planar beam analysis does not automatically cover corner fittings, welds or local web bearing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。
水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。
圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。
optionsEn: An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection.
Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force.
Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion.
quiz.explanation: 圍堰角隅把兩個方向的圍檁反力轉接到支撐，幾何偏心容易產生額外扭矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cofferdam corners transfer waler reactions from two directions into bracing, with geometric eccentricity producing extra torsion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角隅偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corner eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測量支撐軸線與圍檁剪力中心相對位置，核對角接件加勁及焊縫，檢查扭轉位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey strut axes relative to the waler shear centre, inspect corner stiffening and welds, and check torsional movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。
水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。
支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m.
Doubling water-level difference only doubles the hydrostatic resultant.
A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設支撐力P=500 kN、偏心距e=0.15 m，附加扭矩T=Pe=75 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For brace force P=500 kN and eccentricity e=0.15 m, additional torque T=Pe=75 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「角隅偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corner eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測量支撐軸線與圍檁剪力中心相對位置，核對角接件加勁及焊縫，檢查扭轉位移。角隅應有獨立三維詳圖及安裝容差；現場調整接件位置須由連接設計者重新檢查偏心。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey strut axes relative to the waler shear centre, inspect corner stiffening and welds, and check torsional movement. Provide dedicated three-dimensional corner details and installation tolerances; the connection designer reassesses eccentricity after field positioning changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：角隅應有獨立三維詳圖及安裝容差；現場調整接件位置須由連接設計者重新檢查偏心。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Provide dedicated three-dimensional corner details and installation tolerances; the connection designer reassesses eccentricity after field positioning changes. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Provide dedicated three-dimensional corner details and installation tolerances; the connection designer reassesses eccentricity after field positioning changes.

knowledge.textEn: Provide dedicated three-dimensional corner details and installation tolerances; the connection designer reassesses eccentricity after field positioning changes. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
測量支撐軸線與圍檁剪力中心相對位置，核對角接件加勁及焊縫，檢查扭轉位移。
鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Survey strut axes relative to the waler shear centre, inspect corner stiffening and welds, and check torsional movement.
If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping.
quiz.explanation: 測量支撐軸線與圍檁剪力中心相對位置，核對角接件加勁及焊縫，檢查扭轉位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey strut axes relative to the waler shear centre, inspect corner stiffening and welds, and check torsional movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 角隅偏心的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角隅偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corner eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐只有軸力，所以角隅接頭不可能承受扭矩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An axially loaded strut cannot introduce torsion into a corner connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。力乘偏心只是附加扭矩，不包含兩方向力的合成與接頭剛度；連接強度及圍檁扭轉穩定仍需另外驗算。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Force times eccentricity is only the added torque; combined two-direction loading and connection stiffness require further analysis, including connection resistance and waler torsional stability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「角隅偏心的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corner eccentricity mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。
偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force.
Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers.
quiz.explanation: 偏心未納入會使角接板翹曲或焊縫受額外作用，局部失效可中斷兩側圍檁的傳力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted eccentricity can distort corner plates or overload welds, interrupting load transfer from both adjoining walers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水流拖曳的機理與驗證」與「拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Current drag mechanism and verification" and "Span change after removal mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current drag mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水流拖曳」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current drag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰暴露於水流時，流速、投影面積與形狀決定拖曳作用，與靜水壓屬不同荷載來源。漂流物或局部流束會改變有效面積及阻力，洪水期間的水位與流速也可能同時增加，不能只沿用施工初期的靜水情境。阻力係數依形狀及流況而變，此式不含波浪、撞擊或渦激效應；不能把假設係數直接當通用設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水流拖曳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current drag is distinct from hydrostatic pressure and depends on velocity, projected area and shape. Debris and local jets can change effective area and resistance, while flood levels and velocities may rise together. The initial construction hydrostatic case therefore does not necessarily represent later environmental demand. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current drag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水流荷載與流速成正比，所以流速加倍只增一倍力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Current force is linear in velocity, so doubling velocity only doubles force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水流拖曳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Current drag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Current drag mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水流拖曳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Current drag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積A=10 m²、流速v=2 m/s，F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For ρ=1000 kg/m³, Cd=1.2, projected area A=10 m² and v=2 m/s, F=0.5ρCdAv²=24000 N=24 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對現場流速剖面與水位資料，檢查漂流物附著及局部沖刷，核對投影面積是否因設備改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare velocity profiles and water levels, inspect debris accumulation and local scour, and check whether equipment changes alter projected area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水流拖曳的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水流拖曳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instructionEn: Compare velocity profiles and water levels, inspect debris accumulation and local scour, and check whether equipment changes alter projected area. Flood-season inspections include current, debris and scour elevation; hydraulic and temporary-works designers jointly approve load updates and stop conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instructionEn: Debris increases exposed area and can intensify drag and scour, while reduced toe resistance further increases cofferdam movement. The drag coefficient depends on shape and flow regime; this expression excludes waves, impact and vortex effects, and the assumed coefficient is not universal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Span change after removal mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拆撐跨距變化」如何影響鋼板樁圍堰支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Span change after removal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拆除一層支撐會改變板樁及圍檁的有效跨距，原有內力隨新的邊界重新分配。永久結構必須先形成可證明的替代支承，材料強度達標並不保證連接已完成；拆撐順序常比最終狀態更容易產生不利彎曲與位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拆撐跨距變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Removing a brace changes effective sheet and waler spans and redistributes forces under new boundaries. Permanent works must first provide demonstrable replacement restraint; adequate material strength does not prove completed connections. The removal sequence may produce more adverse bending and movement than the final state. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Span change after removal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：僅比較等均布載重簡支梁，原跨L₁=3 m、拆撐後L₂=5 m，M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For equal uniform load on simple beams, changing span from L₁=3 m to L₂=5 m gives M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拆撐跨距變化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Span change after removal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equal uniform load on simple beams, changing span from L₁=3 m to L₂=5 m gives M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Span change after removal mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 支撐軸應力低於降伏強度就不可能挫屈。
鋼板樁不會彎壞就代表基底不可能發生管湧。
原創教學假設：僅比較等均布載重簡支梁，原跨L₁=3 m、拆撐後L₂=5 m，M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78。
optionsEn: A strut cannot buckle when axial stress is below yield strength.
If the sheets do not fail in bending, the base cannot suffer piping.
Original teaching assumptions: For equal uniform load on simple beams, changing span from L₁=3 m to L₂=5 m gives M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：僅比較等均布載重簡支梁，原跨L₁=3 m、拆撐後L₂=5 m，M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For equal uniform load on simple beams, changing span from L₁=3 m to L₂=5 m gives M₂/M₁=(5/3)²=2.78. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Span change after removal mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拆撐跨距變化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Span change after removal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 拆撐前檢查永久連接、實際強度與支承間隙，對比每一階段分析的位移與反力，保留卸載監測。每層拆撐設獨立停留點，臨時與永久結構設計者共同簽認替代力流及卸載監測後才放行。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before removal, inspect permanent connections, actual strength and support gaps; compare stage predictions with movement and reaction measurements and retain unloading records. Provide a separate hold point for each brace level; temporary and permanent designers jointly confirm replacement load paths and unloading monitoring before release. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每層拆撐設獨立停留點，臨時與永久結構設計者共同簽認替代力流及卸載監測後才放行。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Provide a separate hold point for each brace level; temporary and permanent designers jointly confirm replacement load paths and unloading monitoring before release. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：永久樓板尚未有效接觸牆體就拆撐，可能形成短暫長跨，導致板樁過彎或不可逆地層位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
