knowledge.textEn: Before removal, inspect permanent connections, actual strength and support gaps; compare stage predictions with movement and reaction measurements and retain unloading records. Provide a separate hold point for each brace level; temporary and permanent designers jointly confirm replacement load paths and unloading monitoring before release.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每層拆撐設獨立停留點，臨時與永久結構設計者共同簽認替代力流及卸載監測後才放行。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。
knowledge.textEn: Provide a separate hold point for each brace level; temporary and permanent designers jointly confirm replacement load paths and unloading monitoring before release. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Span change after removal mechanism and verification"?
options: 拆撐前檢查永久連接、實際強度與支承間隙，對比每一階段分析的位移與反力，保留卸載監測。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
抽水與拆撐可以分別驗算後任意同時進行。
optionsEn: Before removal, inspect permanent connections, actual strength and support gaps.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Separately checked dewatering and brace removal can be performed together arbitrarily.
quiz.explanation: 拆撐前檢查永久連接、實際強度與支承間隙，對比每一階段分析的位移與反力，保留卸載監測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before removal, inspect permanent connections, actual strength and support gaps; compare stage predictions with movement and reaction measurements and retain unloading records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Span change after removal mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拆撐跨距變化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Span change after removal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 永久樓板尚未有效接觸牆體就拆撐，可能形成短暫長跨，導致板樁過彎或不可逆地層位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最終永久結構足夠強，所以拆撐順序不影響安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A strong final permanent structure makes brace-removal sequence irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 永久樓板尚未有效接觸牆體就拆撐，可能形成短暫長跨，導致板樁過彎或不可逆地層位移。平方比只適用於假設的簡支均布系統，實際連續壁及土彈簧會改變分配；應依真實拆撐階段重新分析，而非套用倍率設計。
knowledge.textEn: Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement. The squared ratio applies only to the assumed simple uniform-load system; wall continuity and soil springs change redistribution, requiring analysis of actual removal stages rather than design by this multiplier.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拆撐跨距變化的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Span change after removal mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
永久樓板尚未有效接觸牆體就拆撐，可能形成短暫長跨，導致板樁過彎或不可逆地層位移。
水位差增加一倍，靜水壓合力只會增加一倍。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement.
Doubling water-level difference only doubles the hydrostatic resultant.
quiz.explanation: 永久樓板尚未有效接觸牆體就拆撐，可能形成短暫長跨，導致板樁過彎或不可逆地層位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing braces before permanent slabs engage the wall creates a temporary long span, causing excessive sheet bending or irreversible ground movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
courses.summary: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。
courses.summaryEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines.
courses.focus: 內支撐預壓、溫度軸力與分階段卸載
courses.focusEn: Strut preload, thermal axial force and staged unloading
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設支撐接觸後的等效剛度k=200 kN/mm，施加力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。保持剛度不變，力增量提高10%至660 kN，縮短為3.3 mm。實際千斤頂行程還包含座板間隙、圍檁、壁體及設備變形，因此不能用這個三毫米推定全部接觸已閉合。驗證應將力與兩端位移同步記錄，先辨識接觸前後剛度變化，再檢查保留預壓、溫度軸力和鄰支撐互制。這些值是原創假設，不是現場施壓指令。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume post-contact support stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, giving elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. With stiffness fixed, a 10% increase to 660 kN gives 3.3 mm. Actual jack stroke also includes seating gaps, waler deformation, wall movement and equipment compliance, so this shortening cannot establish complete contact. Verification records force and both end movements simultaneously, identifies the stiffness change at seating, then checks retained preload, thermal force and interaction with neighbouring struts. These are original assumptions rather than instructions for applying force on site.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」與「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact gap mechanism and verification" and "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸間隙」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact gap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸間隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers. The target must therefore follow overall excavation deformation and member resistance rather than a desire to maximize initial force. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact gap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接觸間隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contact gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
optionsEn: The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed.
Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支撐軸向剛度」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strut axial stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。真實系統還包括接頭及壁體柔度，串聯柔度會降低整體剛度；用單根鋼管剛度代表完整支撐線可能低估開挖位移。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支撐軸向剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness. Using the steel member alone to represent the entire support line can therefore underestimate excavation movement and misrepresent load sharing. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strut axial stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。
鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。
壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m.
Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.
Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m² and L=20 m, k=EA/L=200 MN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐軸向剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strut axial stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness. Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Identify steel, splice, waler and wall compliance in analysis; the structural designer reassesses system stiffness before a connection type changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。
累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness.
Movement rate is irrelevant while cumulative displacement remains below its trigger.
quiz.explanation: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify section and length, separating steel shortening from splice slip using displacement on both sides of joints and member strain before comparing effective stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支撐軸向剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strut axial stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。
未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports.
quiz.explanation: 未計接頭滑移會使預測支撐過硬，導致施工壁移超出模型，且力分配偏向其他較硬支撐。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted splice slip makes predicted restraint too stiff, producing larger wall movement and transferring force toward other stiffer supports. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證」與「座板局部承壓的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal axial force mechanism and verification" and "Seat bearing mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度附加軸力」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal axial force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。完全拘束給出上限尺度，但壁體與接頭柔度會釋放部分熱應變；監測若未扣除溫度，可能把可逆熱力誤判為土壓需求突然增加。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度附加軸力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained. Full restraint gives a bounding scale, while wall and connection flexibility release part of the thermal strain. Without temperature correction, monitoring may misinterpret reversible thermal force as a sudden increase in earth-pressure demand. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal axial force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：完全拘束下E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、α=12×10⁻⁶/K、ΔT=10 K，ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Under full restraint, E=200 GPa, A=0.02 m², α=12×10⁻⁶/K and ΔT=10 K give ΔP=EAαΔT=480 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度附加軸力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal axial force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification

knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐力隨白天上升就一定表示外側土壓增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal axial force mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。

optionsEn: Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained.
A daytime rise in strut force necessarily indicates increasing earth pressure.
Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat.
quiz.explanation: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度附加軸力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal axial force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在受光及背光位置量測鋼溫，對時比對軸力與壁移，分辨日循環和持續增長的土壓作用。軸力警戒應注明溫度基準與修正方式；設計者審核總力及去溫度趨勢，兩者都不可省略。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure steel temperature in exposed and shaded locations, aligning force and wall movement to distinguish daily cycles from sustained earth-pressure growth. Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Force triggers state temperature reference and correction method; the designer reviews both total force and temperature-corrected trend, retaining neither as a substitute for the other. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring thermal force can cause false alarms or underestimate total axial and buckling demand at the highest temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 座板局部承壓的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seat bearing mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「座板局部承壓」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seat bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支撐軸力須經座板、加勁肋及圍檁傳到擋土壁，局部接觸面常比構件截面更容易控制。座板翹曲或墊塊不平會縮小有效面積並增加偏心；平均承壓只有在接觸分布合理時才能用來描述局部需求。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「座板局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strut force passes through seats, stiffeners and walers into the wall, and local contact may govern before the member section. Warped plates or uneven packing reduce effective area and increase eccentricity. Mean bearing pressure describes local demand only where the assumed contact distribution is credible. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seat bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設力P=800 kN、有效接觸A=0.04 m²，平均p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For force P=800 kN over effective contact A=0.04 m², mean p=P/A=20000 kPa=20 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「座板局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.observation: 現場實務：預壓前必須驗收接觸及加勁細部；座板變形異常由連接設計者評估，不能只換更大的千斤頂。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查接觸面平整及加勁位置，量測座板轉角，對照反力是否通過設計傳力中心。預壓前必須驗收接觸及加勁細部；座板變形異常由連接設計者評估，不能只換更大的千斤頂。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect contact flatness and stiffener location, measure seat rotation, and check whether the reaction passes through the intended transfer centre. Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack.

knowledge.textEn: Accept contact and stiffening before preload; the connection designer investigates seat deformation rather than responding with a larger jack. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.

quiz.question: 要驗證「座板局部承壓的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seat bearing mechanism and verification"?
options: 檢查接觸面平整及加勁位置，量測座板轉角，對照反力是否通過設計傳力中心。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。
optionsEn: Inspect contact flatness and stiffener location, measure seat rotation, and check whether the reaction passes through the intended transfer centre.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed.
quiz.explanation: 檢查接觸面平整及加勁位置，量測座板轉角，對照反力是否通過設計傳力中心。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect contact flatness and stiffener location, measure seat rotation, and check whether the reaction passes through the intended transfer centre. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 座板局部承壓的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seat bearing mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「座板局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seat bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。平均承壓不包含邊緣峰值與局部彎曲，承壓能力又取決於基材和拘束；實際接觸面須由細部及量測確認。
knowledge.textEn: Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. Mean pressure excludes edge peaks and local bending, while bearing resistance depends on substrate and confinement; details and measurements must establish actual contact area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「座板局部承壓的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seat bearing mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。
鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity.
Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.
quiz.explanation: 小面積接觸可能導致混凝土局部壓碎或腹板屈曲，支撐本身尚有容量也無法維持整體傳力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Small contact areas can crush concrete or buckle a web, interrupting the system load path despite remaining strut capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖定損失的機理與驗證」與「多支撐互制的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lock-off loss mechanism and verification" and "Interaction between struts mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lock-off loss mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鎖定損失」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lock-off loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。鎖定前讀值不是長期保留力，且溫度變化也會干擾比較；設計上需區分施加力、移交力與後續開挖引起的力增量。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鎖定損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip. The pre-lock reading is not retained force, and temperature changes complicate comparison. Design must distinguish applied force, transferred force and increments caused by subsequent excavation. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lock-off loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鎖定損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lock-off loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。鎖定前讀值不是長期保留力，且溫度變化也會干擾比較；設計上需區分施加力、移交力與後續開挖引起的力增量。
knowledge.textEn: Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip. The pre-lock reading is not retained force, and temperature changes complicate comparison.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鎖定損失的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lock-off loss mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 鎖定前達到目標力就等於之後一直維持相同預壓。
每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。
預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。
optionsEn: Reaching the target before lock-off means the same preload remains indefinitely.
If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously.
Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip.
quiz.explanation: 預壓由液壓設備轉移至機械鎖定後，楔塊坐入、墊片壓縮及接頭滑移會造成軸力損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Transferring preload from hydraulics to mechanical locking can lose force through wedge seating, packing compression and splice slip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lock-off loss mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鎖定損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lock-off loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較鎖定前後同一量測系統的軸力與位移，記錄溫度及座板狀態，確認損失是否持續發展。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare force and displacement before and after lock-off using the same system, recording temperature and seating condition to see whether losses continue.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鎖定損失的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lock-off loss mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。
壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。
卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%.
Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設施加P₀=800 kN、同溫鎖定後P₁=680 kN，損失比(P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For applied P₀=800 kN and same-temperature retained P₁=680 kN, loss ratio (P₀−P₁)/P₀=15%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鎖定損失的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lock-off loss mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鎖定損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lock-off loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較鎖定前後同一量測系統的軸力與位移，記錄溫度及座板狀態，確認損失是否持續發展。驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare force and displacement before and after lock-off using the same system, recording temperature and seating condition to see whether losses continue. Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。比例只描述這次力轉移，不是通用允許損失；應排除溫度及儀器漂移，並確認比較期間沒有其他支撐同步受力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided. The ratio describes this transfer only, not an allowable loss; exclude temperature and sensor drift and confirm no other supports changed load during the comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只記施加峰值會高估保留預壓，後續開挖時壁體可能先移動才重新接觸支撐。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Recording only the applied peak overstates retained preload, allowing the wall to move before restraint fully re-engages during excavation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較鎖定前後同一量測系統的軸力與位移，記錄溫度及座板狀態，確認損失是否持續發展。驗收文件需列施加、鎖定及穩定後力值；超出核定損失範圍時由設計者查明原因後決定是否調整。
knowledge.textEn: Compare force and displacement before and after lock-off using the same system, recording temperature and seating condition to see whether losses continue. Acceptance records include applied, locked and stabilized forces; losses outside approved bounds require designer diagnosis before adjustment is decided.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

quiz.explanationEn: Compare force and displacement before and after lock-off using the same system, recording temperature and seating condition to see whether losses continue. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多支撐互制的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Interaction between struts mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多支撐互制」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interaction between struts” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預壓一支支撐會推動圍檁與壁體，改變鄰近支撐的長度及軸力，因此各支撐並非互相獨立。施加順序及剛度差異決定反力分配，局部達到目標力可能同時使另一支卸載；整體平衡要以同一時間的力值判定。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多支撐互制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Preloading one strut moves the waler and wall, changing neighbouring lengths and forces. Supports are therefore coupled through stiffness and sequence. Achieving a local target may unload another strut, so overall equilibrium must use simultaneous readings rather than peaks recorded at different times. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interaction between struts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設本支撐增加ΔP₁=100 kN、鄰支撐減少60 kN，兩支合計增量ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: If one strut gains ΔP₁=100 kN and its neighbour loses 60 kN, their combined increment is ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多支撐互制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: If one strut gains ΔP₁=100 kN and its neighbour loses 60 kN, their combined increment is ΔΣP=100−60=40 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。
knowledge.textEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多支撐互制的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interaction between struts mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
optionsEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」與「液壓力校正的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" and "Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「第二階偏心」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Second-order eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「第二階偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress. Local modifications can increase sensitivity of the entire support line. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Second-order eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「第二階偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Second-order eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。
knowledge.textEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。
壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。
optionsEn: Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it.
Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
quiz.explanation: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「第二階偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Second-order eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。
optionsEn: Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「第二階偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Second-order eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties. Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小偏心在高軸力下可形成顯著彎矩，局部側向支承失效會進一步放大變形並降低穩定餘裕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small eccentricity under high compression produces significant bending; lost lateral support further magnifies deformation and reduces stability margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。
knowledge.textEn: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties. Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 不直度及接頭偏心應納入安裝驗收；超差處由構件設計者確認修正，不能依外觀判斷仍可使用。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。
knowledge.textEn: Include straightness and splice eccentricity in installation acceptance; the member designer approves correction of deviations rather than judging usability by appearance. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification"?
options: 測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

quiz.explanationEn: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「第二階偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Second-order eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

quiz.question: 在「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
