quiz.question: 要驗證「新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
注漿量很多就必然得到較大且完整的黏結直徑。
量測承台轉角與代表樁軸力，核對是否等位移，將不同樁的載重試驗剛度用於比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High grout volume necessarily creates a larger continuous bond diameter.
Measure cap rotation and representative pile forces to test equal displacement, using individual load-test stiffnesses for comparison.
quiz.explanation: 量測承台轉角與代表樁軸力，核對是否等位移，將不同樁的載重試驗剛度用於比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure cap rotation and representative pile forces to test equal displacement, using individual load-test stiffnesses for comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「新舊樁群分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pile-group load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。並聯彈簧模型未含土體群效與非線性，單組剛度應對應相同荷載區間；舊樁歷史力不能直接重新平均。
knowledge.textEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. Parallel springs exclude group-soil interaction and nonlinearity; stiffnesses must correspond to the same load range, and historical force in old piles cannot simply be redistributed by averaging.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「新舊樁群分力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pile-group load sharing mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。
optionsEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length.
quiz.explanation: 把剛度不同的樁平均分力，可能讓較硬新樁提前超載，較軟支承卻尚未有效參與。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal-force allocation between unequal stiffnesses can overload the stiff new group before softer supports contribute effectively. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」與「偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification" and "Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無側限段挫屈」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unsupported-length buckling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。鋼套管的挫屈能力便成為重要限制，不能因樁很深就假設全長都有連續支承；接頭偏心與腐蝕也會放大不利影響。歐拉荷重是理想彈性上限，不是允許工作荷載；實際承載需考慮初彎、接頭、塑性與有效端部拘束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無側限段挫屈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths. Casing buckling then becomes critical; depth does not guarantee continuous support. Joint eccentricity and corrosion amplify the vulnerability and require checking the actual restrained length rather than assuming full confinement. Euler load is an ideal elastic limit, not working-load permission; actual resistance includes bow, joints, plasticity and effective end restraint. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unsupported-length buckling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：理想鉸接段L=4 m、E=200 GPa、I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For an ideal pinned unsupported segment L=4 m, E=200 GPa and I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無側限段挫屈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unsupported-length buckling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。鋼套管的挫屈能力便成為重要限制，不能因樁很深就假設全長都有連續支承；接頭偏心與腐蝕也會放大不利影響。
knowledge.textEn: Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths. Casing buckling then becomes critical; depth does not guarantee continuous support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 微型樁埋在地下，所以任何位置都不需要挫屈檢查。
微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。
柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。
optionsEn: A buried micropile never requires buckling checks anywhere along its length.
Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths.
A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension.
quiz.explanation: 微型樁通常受到周圍地層側向約束，但穿越空洞、極軟層或施工開挖區時可能形成無側限長度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground normally restrains micropiles laterally, but voids, very soft layers or excavation can create unsupported lengths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無側限段挫屈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unsupported-length buckling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：理想鉸接段L=4 m、E=200 GPa、I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For an ideal pinned unsupported segment L=4 m, E=200 GPa and I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依鑽孔與開挖紀錄界定無側限區，核對套管接頭位置與直線度，檢查橫向地層彈簧可信度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define unsupported zones from drilling and excavation records, check casing-joint locations and straightness, and assess credibility of lateral ground springs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：理想鉸接段L=4 m、E=200 GPa、I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For an ideal pinned unsupported segment L=4 m, E=200 GPa and I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。
微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。
原創教學假設：理想鉸接段L=4 m、E=200 GPa、I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN。
optionsEn: Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring.
Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks.
Original teaching assumptions: For an ideal pinned unsupported segment L=4 m, E=200 GPa and I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：理想鉸接段L=4 m、E=200 GPa、I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴，Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For an ideal pinned unsupported segment L=4 m, E=200 GPa and I=1×10⁻⁵ m⁴, Pcr=π²EI/L²=1.23 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無側限段挫屈的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unsupported-length buckling mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「無側限段挫屈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unsupported-length buckling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依鑽孔與開挖紀錄界定無側限區，核對套管接頭位置與直線度，檢查橫向地層彈簧可信度。無側限區與套管需求應明列於施工圖；地層流失或新增開挖發現後，設計者須重新核對穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric group reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 柱中心與新樁群中心不一致時，除了總軸力還會產生力矩，承台需透過不同樁反力或拉壓偶抵抗。若只把總力平均分到樁上，邊樁需求會被低估；既有基礎是否仍接觸也會改變可用的反力分布。力偶式只給兩反力線的增量，不是每樁總力；須加上平均軸力並檢查承台剛度及拉力傳遞是否成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偏心樁群反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An offset between column and new pile-group centres creates moment in addition to total axial load. The cap resists it through unequal reactions or a tension-compression couple. Averaging total force underestimates edge-pile demand, while continued contact with the original foundation changes the available reaction distribution. The couple equation gives the increment on two reaction lines, not total force per pile; add mean axial load and verify cap stiffness and tensile transfer. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric group reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設需抵抗力矩M=300 kN·m、兩反力線距s=2 m，力偶增量ΔP=M/s=150 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For moment M=300 kN·m and reaction-line spacing s=2 m, couple-force increment ΔP=M/s=150 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偏心樁群反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 要驗證「偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對柱樁中心與實際樁位，量測承台轉角及邊樁力，將接觸或離縫狀態納入模型。
新樁完工後會立刻自然承擔所有設計荷載比例。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check actual column and pile centres, measure cap rotation and edge forces, and include contact or separation in the model.
Completed new piles immediately carry every intended design load share naturally.
quiz.explanation: 核對柱樁中心與實際樁位，量測承台轉角及邊樁力，將接觸或離縫狀態納入模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check actual column and pile centres, measure cap rotation and edge forces, and include contact or separation in the model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「偏心樁群反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eccentric group reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 邊樁可能受拉而原設計只查受壓，接頭與舊承台因此可能先裂開，形成非預期荷載重分配。力偶式只給兩反力線的增量，不是每樁總力；須加上平均軸力並檢查承台剛度及拉力傳遞是否成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An edge pile may enter tension although only compression was checked, cracking connections or the old cap and redistributing load unexpectedly. The couple equation gives the increment on two reaction lines, not total force per pile; add mean axial load and verify cap stiffness and tensile transfer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：力偶式只給兩反力線的增量，不是每樁總力；須加上平均軸力並檢查承台剛度及拉力傳遞是否成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The couple equation gives the increment on two reaction lines, not total force per pile; add mean axial load and verify cap stiffness and tensile transfer.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「柱力是向下的，就不可能讓任何托底樁受到拉力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A downward column load can never put an underpinning pile in tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 邊樁可能受拉而原設計只查受壓，接頭與舊承台因此可能先裂開，形成非預期荷載重分配。力偶式只給兩反力線的增量，不是每樁總力；須加上平均軸力並檢查承台剛度及拉力傳遞是否成立。
knowledge.textEn: An edge pile may enter tension although only compression was checked, cracking connections or the old cap and redistributing load unexpectedly. The couple equation gives the increment on two reaction lines, not total force per pile; add mean axial load and verify cap stiffness and tensile transfer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偏心樁群反力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric group reactions mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。
邊樁可能受拉而原設計只查受壓，接頭與舊承台因此可能先裂開，形成非預期荷載重分配。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
More splices affect speed only and never structural quality.
An edge pile may enter tension although only compression was checked, cracking connections or the old cap and redistributing load unexpectedly.
quiz.explanation: 邊樁可能受拉而原設計只查受壓，接頭與舊承台因此可能先裂開，形成非預期荷載重分配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An edge pile may enter tension although only compression was checked, cracking connections or the old cap and redistributing load unexpectedly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」與「移交後沉陷的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification" and "Post-transfer settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低淨高接頭」如何影響微型樁托底補強的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-headroom splices” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。每個接頭必須傳遞設計軸力及可能的彎曲，螺紋有效截面與套管同軸度也影響承載；施工方便不能取代接合性能證明。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低淨高接頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces. Every splice must transfer design axial force and possible bending, while thread-root area and casing alignment affect resistance. Ease of installation cannot substitute for evidence that the connection performs under the required force combinations. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low-headroom splices” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More splices affect speed only and never structural quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低淨高接頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low-headroom splices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。每個接頭必須傳遞設計軸力及可能的彎曲，螺紋有效截面與套管同軸度也影響承載；施工方便不能取代接合性能證明。
knowledge.textEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces. Every splice must transfer design axial force and possible bending, while thread-root area and casing alignment affect resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More splices affect speed only and never structural quality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。
接頭越多只會影響速度，不會影響樁的受力品質。
載重試驗通過後，既有建物不需要再做沉陷監測。
optionsEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces.
More splices affect speed only and never structural quality.
Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring.
quiz.explanation: 受限空間的微型樁需以短節鋼材連接，接頭數增加就增加製造、安裝與檢查界面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Restricted headroom requires short steel sections, increasing fabrication, installation and inspection interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低淨高接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low-headroom splices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 微型樁平均鋼應力不高，就不用檢查接頭與局部挫屈。
原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。
微型樁試驗合格就代表與舊基礎的連接也合格。
optionsEn: Low mean steel stress removes the need for connection and local-buckling checks.
Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints.
A successful micropile load test proves the old-foundation connection is adequate.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設總長L=18 m、每節有效長l=1.5 m，需n=ceil(L/l)=12節，通常有11個節間接頭。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total length L=18 m and effective section length l=1.5 m, n=ceil(L/l)=12 sections, normally with eleven inter-section joints. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低淨高接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low-headroom splices” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts. The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts. The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接頭型式、檢驗方法及追溯編碼須由結構設計者核准；未完成接合檢查的鋼節不得以後續注漿取代驗證。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。
knowledge.textEn: The structural designer approves splice type, inspection and traceability; later grouting cannot replace verification of an unaccepted steel connection. The section count assumes effective lengths already exclude connection loss and is not a fabrication cut list; ends, overlap and equipment headroom require separate coordination.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低淨高接頭的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
同一承台下所有微型樁一定平均分擔柱力。
核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every micropile under one cap necessarily shares column load equally.
Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts.
quiz.explanation: 核對每節長度、接頭序號與安裝證據，對照實際接頭深度及高彎曲或腐蝕區，查漏裝與錯件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify section lengths, splice identifiers and installation evidence against actual depths and high-bending or corrosion zones, checking missing or mismatched parts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 低淨高接頭的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low-headroom splices mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低淨高接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low-headroom splices” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭未完全接合或軸線偏移會降低有效容量，深埋後難以直接檢查，可能成為長期薄弱點。節數計算假設有效長度已扣除接合損失，並非加工切割清單；實際端部、接頭搭接與設備淨高需另外協調。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete engagement or misalignment reduces effective resistance and can become a long-term weak point that is difficult to inspect after burial. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-transfer settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Micropile underpinning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 托底後的沉陷可能來自新樁動員、舊土層壓密或連接變形，不應只以短期試驗合格結束觀察。長期趨勢需與荷載使用、地下水及季節變化一起判讀，固定基準與測點位置則是區分真變形與量測漂移的前提。平均速率可能掩蓋階段性加速，且本數值不是通用合格值；應以資產容許差異變形及量測解析度制定判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「移交後沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-underpinning settlement may reflect new-pile mobilization, consolidation of old soils or connection movement, so short-term test acceptance should not end observation. Long-term trends require load-use, groundwater and seasonal context, with stable references and fixed measurement locations to distinguish actual deformation from instrumental drift. The mean rate can conceal episodic acceleration and is not a universal acceptance value; criteria depend on tolerable differential movement and measurement resolution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-transfer settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing a load test removes the need for further building-settlement monitoring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 移交後沉陷的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設沉陷由3 mm增至4 mm、間隔6 month，平均速率v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For settlement increasing from 3 mm to 4 mm over six months, mean rate v=(4−3)/6=0.167 mm/month. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將柱、承台及相鄰未托底基礎同步水準測量，對照使用荷載及水位，檢查差異而非只看單點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Level columns, caps and adjacent untreated foundations together, comparing loads and groundwater and examining differences rather than one isolated point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
停止追蹤可能漏掉連接逐步滑移，直到門窗卡住或新裂縫出現才發現托底尚未穩定。
新樁容量只要大於原設計柱力，就不用查目前用途。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Stopping observations can miss progressive connection slip until doors bind or new cracks reveal that underpinning performance has not stabilized.
New-pile capacity above the original column force makes current use irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 停止追蹤可能漏掉連接逐步滑移，直到門窗卡住或新裂縫出現才發現托底尚未穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stopping observations can miss progressive connection slip until doors bind or new cracks reveal that underpinning performance has not stabilized. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良
courses.summary: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。
courses.summaryEn: Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically.
courses.focus: 噴射侵蝕、改良體連續性與水力驗證
courses.focusEn: Jet erosion, treated-ground continuity and hydraulic verification
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設均質改良體滲透係數k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、水力坡降i=2，流量Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。只把k增加10%至1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s，其他量不變，Q=2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s，也增加10%。此線性敏感度只對固定幾何與達西流成立；若有貫通缺口，總流量可能由另一機制控制。驗證時要記錄上下游水頭、面積與有效流路，並結合取芯及全深幾何，不能用低流量或高強度單獨宣稱整體止水合格。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume homogeneous permeability k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and hydraulic gradient i=2. Darcy discharge is Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Increase only k by 10% to 1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s while holding other inputs fixed: Q becomes 2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s, also up 10%. This linear sensitivity requires fixed geometry and Darcy flow; a connected defect may instead control total discharge through another mechanism. Verification records upstream and downstream heads, area and effective paths, combining cores and full-depth geometry rather than inferring system sealing from low flow or high strength alone. The designer must verify that the test boundaries represent the intended permanent hydraulic condition.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 合成教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」與「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" and "Column overlap mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「改良體滲流」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Treated-ground seepage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「改良體滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses. Low average permeability therefore does not prove a sealed curtain; acceptance must address both material properties and geometry. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Treated-ground seepage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「改良體滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Treated-ground seepage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。
knowledge.textEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。
改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。
每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。
optionsEn: High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength.
Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
quiz.explanation: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改良體滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Treated-ground seepage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
optionsEn: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改良體滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Treated-ground seepage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification"?
options: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。
optionsEn: Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths.

steps.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改良體滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Treated-ground seepage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「改良體滲流的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱體交疊」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column overlap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。相鄰柱在某個深度相交，不代表全深都連續；黏土團塊、礫石或夾層可能讓截面不圓，應以試驗柱與全深證據建立保守幾何。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱體交疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity. Clay lumps, gravel and layering can create noncircular sections, requiring trial columns and full-depth evidence to define conservative geometry. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column overlap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱體交疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column overlap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱體交疊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column overlap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Column overlap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column overlap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱體交疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column overlap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head. Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

knowledge.textEn: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱體交疊的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column overlap mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for.
quiz.explanation: 局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」與「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Binder retention mechanism and verification" and "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠結材料留存」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Binder retention” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。原土含水及返漿固體濃度會影響質量平衡，若只量體積而不量密度與成分，便無法合理判定實際留存量。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠結材料留存」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. Soil water and return solids affect the mass balance. Volume alone, without density and composition, cannot reliably establish how much binder remains in the ground. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Binder retention” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠結材料留存」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Binder retention”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。原土含水及返漿固體濃度會影響質量平衡，若只量體積而不量密度與成分，便無法合理判定實際留存量。
knowledge.textEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. Soil water and return solids affect the mass balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binder retention mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。
注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
optionsEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio.
All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
quiz.explanation: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠結材料留存」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Binder retention” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Binder retention mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。
地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。
optionsEn: A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg.
Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠結材料留存」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Binder retention” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。
knowledge.textEn: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
knowledge.textEn: The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Binder retention mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。
同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres.
Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder.
quiz.explanation: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Binder retention mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠結材料留存」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Binder retention” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
