knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膠結材料留存的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Binder retention mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
optionsEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
quiz.explanation: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「直徑面積效應」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diameter-area effect” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。噴射侵蝕受地層可侵蝕性控制，粗粒或高塑性夾層可讓外形及品質不同；方案比較應把幾何面積、材料性能與有效受力區分開列示。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「直徑面積效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. Erodibility controls jet response, and coarse or highly plastic layers change shape and quality. Compare geometric area, material performance and effective loaded area separately in option studies. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diameter-area effect” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設圓截面直徑由D₁=1.0 m增至D₂=1.4 m，面積比A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For circular diameters D₁=1.0 m and D₂=1.4 m, area ratio A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「直徑面積效應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diameter-area effect”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。噴射侵蝕受地層可侵蝕性控制，粗粒或高塑性夾層可讓外形及品質不同；方案比較應把幾何面積、材料性能與有效受力區分開列示。
knowledge.textEn: Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. Erodibility controls jet response, and coarse or highly plastic layers change shape and quality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。
改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
optionsEn: A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
quiz.explanation: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「直徑面積效應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diameter-area effect” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設圓截面直徑由D₁=1.0 m增至D₂=1.4 m，面積比A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For circular diameters D₁=1.0 m and D₂=1.4 m, area ratio A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設圓截面直徑由D₁=1.0 m增至D₂=1.4 m，面積比A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。

Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant.
Original teaching assumptions: For circular diameters D₁=1.0 m and D₂=1.4 m, area ratio A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「直徑面積效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diameter-area effect” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。設計圖須區分名目直徑與有效改良直徑；地工設計者依試驗結果核定用於承載的範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone. Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計圖須區分名目直徑與有效改良直徑；地工設計者依試驗結果核定用於承載的範圍。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone. Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.textEn: Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification"?
options: 以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「直徑面積效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diameter-area effect” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「直徑面積效應的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
quiz.explanation: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證」與「強度齡期發展的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Return-volume balance mechanism and verification" and "Strength development mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Return-volume balance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「返漿體積平衡」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return-volume balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 返漿提供注入流體及被侵蝕土粒離開地盤的路徑，返漿不足可能是滯留、堵塞或側向漏失，不能直接解釋為改良效率提高。體積差需連同密度、地表隆起及孔隙水壓判讀，才能分辨材料留存與不希望的地層位移。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「返漿體積平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Returns provide an exit for injected fluid and eroded soil. Reduced returns may indicate retention, blockage or lateral loss rather than improved treatment efficiency. Interpret volume differences with density, surface heave and pore pressure to distinguish useful material retention from undesirable displacement of the surrounding ground. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Return-volume balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=4 m³、量得返出Vout=3.2 m³，未平衡體積ΔV=0.8 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For input Vin=4 m³ and measured returns Vout=3.2 m³, unbalanced volume ΔV=0.8 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「返漿體積平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 水泥土強度隨齡期及養護條件增加，但土體有機物、含水量與混合均勻度可能限制反應。早期強度與後期強度比例可比較材料發展，卻不能把單一比值套到所有土層；現場芯樣的擾動與尺寸也需和室內試體區分。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「強度齡期發展」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For comparable specimens with early qu₁=1.2 MPa and later qu₂=2.4 MPa, strength ratio qu₂/qu₁=2.0. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依地層與齡期分組試驗，保留養護溫度、尺寸與破壞型態，檢查現場取芯是否代表弱區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Group tests by stratum and age, retaining curing temperature, specimen dimensions and failure mode, and check whether field cores represent weak zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 強度齡期發展的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength development mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「強度齡期發展」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strength development” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依地層與齡期分組試驗，保留養護溫度、尺寸與破壞型態，檢查現場取芯是否代表弱區。試驗計畫應預先處理取芯失敗與異常低值；材料及地工設計者共同判讀，不能任意刪除不利資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group tests by stratum and age, retaining curing temperature, specimen dimensions and failure mode, and check whether field cores represent weak zones. The testing plan defines treatment of core loss and low results in advance; materials and geotechnical designers interpret them without arbitrary removal of adverse data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗計畫應預先處理取芯失敗與異常低值；材料及地工設計者共同判讀，不能任意刪除不利資料。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The testing plan defines treatment of core loss and low results in advance; materials and geotechnical designers interpret them without arbitrary removal of adverse data. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強度齡期發展的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.

steps.title: 強度齡期發展的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength development mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「強度齡期發展」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strength development” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。

The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強度齡期發展的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength development mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
optionsEn: Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
quiz.explanation: 只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「複合地盤分力的機理與驗證」與「鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification" and "Bore deviation mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 複合地盤分力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「複合地盤分力」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite-ground sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。等應變模型可推導柱土應力比，但需有足夠剛性上部荷載分配層；柔性載重、局部沉陷與柱端條件會使真實分力偏離簡化模型。式中n是相應應變下的剛度比，不是抗壓強度比；柱體承載、原土剪力與整體沉陷仍須分別檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合地盤分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress. Equal-strain analysis derives a column-soil stress ratio but requires sufficiently rigid load distribution. Flexible loading, local settlement and toe conditions can produce sharing that differs substantially from the simplified relation. Here n is a stiffness ratio at corresponding strain, not a strength ratio; column resistance, native-soil shear and overall settlement still require separate checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Composite-ground sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設平均q=100 kPa、面積比a=0.3、柱土剛度比n=5且等應變，σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For mean q=100 kPa, area ratio a=0.3 and stiffness ratio n=5 under equal strain, σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「複合地盤分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Composite-ground sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複合地盤分力的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。等應變模型可推導柱土應力比，但需有足夠剛性上部荷載分配層；柔性載重、局部沉陷與柱端條件會使真實分力偏離簡化模型。
knowledge.textEn: Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress. Equal-strain analysis derives a column-soil stress ratio but requires sufficiently rigid load distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「複合地盤分力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。
改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。

optionsEn: Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress.
Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
quiz.explanation: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 柱軸朝外偏移會留下改良缺口，朝資產偏移則可能改變周邊土體與既有結構接觸。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」與「水力坡降反算的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strength variability mechanism and verification" and "Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength variability mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「強度變異係數」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strength variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水泥土品質具有空間變異，平均值相同的兩個改良區可能有很不同的低強度尾端。變異係數把標準差相對平均值表達，適合初步比較均勻度，但不能指出缺陷在哪裡；取樣位置及未成芯區會強烈影響統計代表性。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「強度變異係數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails. Coefficient of variation expresses standard deviation relative to mean and helps compare uniformity, but does not locate defects. Sampling positions and uncoreable intervals strongly affect whether the statistics represent the treated ground. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strength variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「強度變異係數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strength variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails. Coefficient of variation expresses standard deviation relative to mean and helps compare uniformity, but does not locate defects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依柱號、深度與地層繪製強度分布，同時列樣本數及取芯失敗，不只提供一個平均值。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 要驗證「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strength variability mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。
依柱號、深度與地層繪製強度分布，同時列樣本數及取芯失敗，不只提供一個平均值。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
Map strength by column, depth and stratum, reporting sample count and core loss together rather than only a mean.
quiz.explanation: 依柱號、深度與地層繪製強度分布，同時列樣本數及取芯失敗，不只提供一個平均值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map strength by column, depth and stratum, reporting sample count and core loss together rather than only a mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength variability mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「強度變異係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strength variability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少量高值可能把平均拉高，掩蓋連續低強度帶；刪除取芯失敗會讓變異看似過小。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A few high values can raise the mean and hide a continuous weak band; excluding core loss makes variability appear artificially small. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 少量高值可能把平均拉高，掩蓋連續低強度帶；刪除取芯失敗會讓變異看似過小。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。
knowledge.textEn: A few high values can raise the mean and hide a continuous weak band; excluding core loss makes variability appear artificially small. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強度變異係數的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength variability mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 少量高值可能把平均拉高，掩蓋連續低強度帶；刪除取芯失敗會讓變異看似過小。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。
optionsEn: A few high values can raise the mean and hide a continuous weak band; excluding core loss makes variability appear artificially small.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres.
quiz.explanation: 少量高值可能把平均拉高，掩蓋連續低強度帶；刪除取芯失敗會讓變異看似過小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A few high values can raise the mean and hide a continuous weak band; excluding core loss makes variability appear artificially small. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水力坡降反算的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力坡降反算」如何影響噴射灌漿地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-calculated gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jet-grouting ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完工水力試驗需把流量與水頭及幾何一起解讀，否則低出水可能只因施加水頭小。若已知代表性滲透係數及面積，可由達西式反算坡降，但這是無因次量，不是水頭差；要得到水頭差仍需有效流路長度。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力坡降反算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Completion hydraulic tests require flow, head and geometry together, because low discharge may only reflect a low applied head. With representative permeability and area, Darcy flow can infer a dimensionless gradient, not a head difference. An effective flow-path length is still needed to convert that gradient into hydraulic head. Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Back-calculated gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s、k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s、A=100 m²，i=Q/(kA)=1；若另假設L=1 m才有Δh=iL=1 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s, k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s and A=100 m², i=Q/(kA)=1; only with additional L=1 m does Δh=iL=1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水力坡降反算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Back-calculated gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力坡降反算的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 完工水力試驗需把流量與水頭及幾何一起解讀，否則低出水可能只因施加水頭小。若已知代表性滲透係數及面積，可由達西式反算坡降，但這是無因次量，不是水頭差；要得到水頭差仍需有效流路長度。
knowledge.textEn: Completion hydraulic tests require flow, head and geometry together, because low discharge may only reflect a low applied head. With representative permeability and area, Darcy flow can infer a dimensionless gradient, not a head difference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力坡降反算的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。
完工水力試驗需把流量與水頭及幾何一起解讀，否則低出水可能只因施加水頭小。
噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。
optionsEn: Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres.
Completion hydraulic tests require flow, head and geometry together, because low discharge may only reflect a low applied head.
High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
quiz.explanation: 完工水力試驗需把流量與水頭及幾何一起解讀，否則低出水可能只因施加水頭小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Completion hydraulic tests require flow, head and geometry together, because low discharge may only reflect a low applied head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力坡降反算的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水力坡降反算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-calculated gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s、k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s、A=100 m²，i=Q/(kA)=1；若另假設L=1 m才有Δh=iL=1 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s, k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s and A=100 m², i=Q/(kA)=1; only with additional L=1 m does Δh=iL=1 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄試驗流量、上下游水頭及濾管位置，以不同水頭檢查線性，追查短路或邊界漏失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record flow, upstream-downstream heads and screen positions together, checking linearity at different heads and investigating bypasses or boundary losses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s、k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s、A=100 m²，i=Q/(kA)=1；若另假設L=1 m才有Δh=iL=1 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s, k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s and A=100 m², i=Q/(kA)=1; only with additional L=1 m does Δh=iL=1 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水力坡降反算的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。
返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。
原創教學假設：假設Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s、k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s、A=100 m²，i=Q/(kA)=1；若另假設L=1 m才有Δh=iL=1 m。
optionsEn: All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
Original teaching assumptions: For Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s, k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s and A=100 m², i=Q/(kA)=1; only with additional L=1 m does Δh=iL=1 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s、k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s、A=100 m²，i=Q/(kA)=1；若另假設L=1 m才有Δh=iL=1 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s, k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s and A=100 m², i=Q/(kA)=1; only with additional L=1 m does Δh=iL=1 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水力坡降反算的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水力坡降反算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Back-calculated gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄試驗流量、上下游水頭及濾管位置，以不同水頭檢查線性，追查短路或邊界漏失。交接水力報告須列公式單位、有效面積及流路假設；地工設計者確認邊界可識別後才接受反算結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record flow, upstream-downstream heads and screen positions together, checking linearity at different heads and investigating bypasses or boundary losses. Handover hydraulic reports state units, effective area and path assumptions; the geotechnical designer accepts inferred properties only after test boundaries are identifiable. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接水力報告須列公式單位、有效面積及流路假設；地工設計者確認邊界可識別後才接受反算結果。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover hydraulic reports state units, effective area and path assumptions; the geotechnical designer accepts inferred properties only after test boundaries are identifiable. Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將坡降誤寫成水頭差會漏掉流路長度，錯估止水需求；試驗邊界漏水也可能被誤判為改良體滲透。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Handover hydraulic reports state units, effective area and path assumptions; the geotechnical designer accepts inferred properties only after test boundaries are identifiable.

Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.

quiz.explanationEn: Record flow, upstream-downstream heads and screen positions together, checking linearity at different heads and investigating bypasses or boundary losses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將坡降誤寫成水頭差會漏掉流路長度，錯估止水需求；試驗邊界漏水也可能被誤判為改良體滲透。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。
knowledge.textEn: Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability. Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水力坡降反算的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將坡降誤寫成水頭差會漏掉流路長度，錯估止水需求；試驗邊界漏水也可能被誤判為改良體滲透。
噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability.
High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
quiz.explanation: 將坡降誤寫成水頭差會漏掉流路長度，錯估止水需求；試驗邊界漏水也可能被誤判為改良體滲透。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
courses.summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。
courses.summaryEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.
courses.focus: 攪拌均勻度、膠結反應與複合地盤沉陷
courses.focusEn: Mixing uniformity, binder reaction and composite-ground settlement
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：原土水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=60%。若水量增加10%至66 kg而乾土不變，含水比變成66%，增加六個百分點，也就是相對增加10%。此結果不是飽和度，也不能直接推論固化後強度減少多少。配比還需計入新增漿液水、乾膠結材及土體反應性，並以相同養護及試驗方法比較。工程師應把含水比變化帶回材料試驗矩陣，避免用固定水泥量掩蓋不同土層的差異。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: native soil contains Mw=60 kg of water and Ms=100 kg of dry soil, giving w=Mw/Ms=60%. Increasing water mass by 10% to 66 kg while dry mass remains fixed raises water content to 66%, six percentage points or a 10% relative increase. This is not saturation and does not directly predict the resulting strength reduction. Mixture assessment also includes added slurry water, dry binder and soil reactivity under comparable curing and testing. Feed the changed water content into the laboratory matrix rather than assuming a fixed cement dosage neutralizes differences between strata.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原土含水比的機理與驗證」與「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" and "Binder dosage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原土含水比」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Native-soil water content” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原土含水比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity. Organics, salinity and clay minerals further alter strength development, so depth alone cannot justify one universal mixture. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Native-soil water content” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原土含水比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Native-soil water content”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。
knowledge.textEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原土含水比的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。
原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
optionsEn: Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass.
Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
quiz.explanation: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原土含水比」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Native-soil water content” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原土含水比的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 工具名目直徑就是每個深度都已證明的成品直徑。
面積加權模數越大就表示所有失效模式都更安全。
原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
optionsEn: Nominal tool diameter proves the finished diameter at every depth.
A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode.
Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原土含水比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Native-soil water content” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。
knowledge.textEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
knowledge.textEn: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原土含水比的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification"?
options: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
將不同地層全部平均，可以更準確代表最弱位置。
optionsEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Averaging all strata gives a more accurate description of the weakest location.
quiz.explanation: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原土含水比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Native-soil water content” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
knowledge.textEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原土含水比的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
quiz.explanation: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠結材用量」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Binder dosage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。投入量只能描述供料，成品強度還受混合均勻、反應時間及土種影響；流量計與密度計誤差可能沿整根柱累積而不易被外觀發現。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠結材用量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type. Flow and density errors can accumulate along a column without producing visible surface evidence. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Binder dosage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠結材用量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Binder dosage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。投入量只能描述供料，成品強度還受混合均勻、反應時間及土種影響；流量計與密度計誤差可能沿整根柱累積而不易被外觀發現。
knowledge.textEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binder dosage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。
膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。
optionsEn: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.
Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption.
quiz.explanation: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠結材用量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Binder dosage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Binder dosage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。
相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。
固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg.
Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body.
Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠結材用量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Binder dosage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Binder dosage mechanism and verification"?

Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「每米攪拌轉數的機理與驗證」與「柱體積與連續性的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rotations per metre mechanism and verification" and "Column volume and continuity mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 每米攪拌轉數的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotations per metre mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「每米攪拌轉數」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotations per metre” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 攪拌葉片在某深度作用的程度與轉速、升降速度及重複行程有關，每米轉數可比較機械暴露量。相同轉數不代表相同能量，扭矩、葉片形狀及土體阻力會改變混合效果；材料供應時序也必須與葉片通過時間同步。每米轉數是運動學指標而非能量或品質標準，不能取代扭矩與取樣；此假設數字也不是現場設備設定建議。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「每米攪拌轉數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing exposure depends on rotation, vertical speed and repeated passes, and rotations per metre provide one process comparison. Equal counts do not imply equal energy because torque, blade geometry and soil resistance differ. Binder-delivery timing must also correspond to the interval when the blades pass through each layer. Rotations per metre are kinematic rather than an energy or quality criterion and cannot replace torque and sampling; these assumed values are not recommended machine settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotations per metre” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設轉速n=30 rev/min、升速v=0.5 m/min，每米轉數n/v=60 rev/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For rotation n=30 rev/min and vertical speed v=0.5 m/min, exposure n/v=60 rev/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「每米攪拌轉數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rotations per metre”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 每米攪拌轉數的機理與驗證：定量估算
