stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」與「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" and "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷槽形狀」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settlement-trough shape” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。補償灌漿的監測應涵蓋整個敏感資產而非只追最大值，因為槽邊坡度與曲率可能更影響建物；分層地盤或多隧道會偏離單一對稱槽。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷槽形狀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. Compensation monitoring should cover the sensitive asset rather than chase the peak alone because edge slope and curvature may govern building response. Layering and multiple tunnels can depart from one symmetric trough. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settlement-trough shape” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉陷槽形狀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Settlement-trough shape”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。補償灌漿的監測應涵蓋整個敏感資產而非只追最大值，因為槽邊坡度與曲率可能更影響建物；分層地盤或多隧道會偏離單一對稱槽。
knowledge.textEn: A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. Compensation monitoring should cover the sensitive asset rather than chase the peak alone because edge slope and curvature may govern building response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。
隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。
注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
optionsEn: Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone.
One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
quiz.explanation: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷槽形狀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settlement-trough shape” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。
原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。
optionsEn: Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces.
Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷槽形狀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Settlement-trough shape” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。
knowledge.textEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
knowledge.textEn: The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification"?
options: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。
optionsEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them.
quiz.explanation: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷槽形狀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Settlement-trough shape” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。
knowledge.textEn: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。
注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest.
One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
quiz.explanation: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「注入抬升效率」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Injection-heave efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。效率會隨既有灌漿、應力及排水改變，必須由已觀測反應校正；把所有留存量視為有效補償，可能導致過量注入與隆起。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「注入抬升效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. Efficiency changes with prior treatment, stress and drainage and must be updated from observations. Treating all retained grout as useful compensation can cause excessive injection and unintended uplift. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Injection-heave efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「注入抬升效率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Injection-heave efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。效率會隨既有灌漿、應力及排水改變，必須由已觀測反應校正；把所有留存量視為有效補償，可能導致過量注入與隆起。
knowledge.textEn: Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. Efficiency changes with prior treatment, stress and drainage and must be updated from observations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。
optionsEn: One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume.
quiz.explanation: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「注入抬升效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Injection-heave efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。
監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30.
Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「注入抬升效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Injection-heave efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation.

knowledge.text: 效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。

Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入抬升效率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。
一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.

A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
quiz.explanation: 將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「注入抬升效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Injection-heave efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「袖閥管定位的機理與驗證」與「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification" and "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 袖閥管定位的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「袖閥管定位」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sleeve-pipe location” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。只知道孔口位置不足以定位各袖閥，必須建立全長軌跡，並與地下資產資料的不確定範圍一起比較。固定角誤差式不是全孔軌跡模型，實際曲線與孔口誤差會疊加；不可把名目深度當唯一空間座標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「袖閥管定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pipe location defines the geometry between injection and assets. Small angular errors over long bores can shift the effective zone into different strata or toward existing infrastructure. Collar position alone does not locate each sleeve port; full trajectories must be compared with the uncertainty envelope of buried assets. The fixed-angle expression is not a full trajectory model; curvature and collar errors accumulate, and nominal depth is not a unique spatial coordinate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sleeve-pipe location” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「袖閥管定位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sleeve-pipe location”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 袖閥管定位的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。只知道孔口位置不足以定位各袖閥，必須建立全長軌跡，並與地下資產資料的不確定範圍一起比較。
knowledge.textEn: Pipe location defines the geometry between injection and assets. Small angular errors over long bores can shift the effective zone into different strata or toward existing infrastructure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。
泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
optionsEn: Pipe location defines the geometry between injection and assets.
Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 袖閥管定位的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「袖閥管定位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sleeve-pipe location” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用核定孔斜量測及袖閥深度紀錄建立三維位置，核對管線調查精度，檢查注入反應是否符合所在層位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build three-dimensional port positions from approved deviation surveys and depth logs, checking utility-survey accuracy and whether response matches the intended stratum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「袖閥管定位的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。
原創教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m。
兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。
optionsEn: Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces.
Original teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m.
A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「袖閥管定位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用核定孔斜量測及袖閥深度紀錄建立三維位置，核對管線調查精度，檢查注入反應是否符合所在層位。注入區與資產距離須以實測軌跡確認；接近敏感界面時由資產管理者及地工設計者共同核定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build three-dimensional port positions from approved deviation surveys and depth logs, checking utility-survey accuracy and whether response matches the intended stratum. Confirm injection-to-asset distance from measured trajectories; the asset owner and geotechnical designer jointly approve conditions near sensitive interfaces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：袖閥偏位可能把漿液送到資產下方的不利弱面，形成局部抬升或直接接觸地下設施。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「袖閥管定位的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 袖閥偏位可能把漿液送到資產下方的不利弱面，形成局部抬升或直接接觸地下設施。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
optionsEn: A misplaced port can feed an adverse plane beneath an asset, producing localized heave or direct interaction with buried infrastructure.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
quiz.explanation: 袖閥偏位可能把漿液送到資產下方的不利弱面，形成局部抬升或直接接觸地下設施。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A misplaced port can feed an adverse plane beneath an asset, producing localized heave or direct interaction with buried infrastructure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「注入與有效應力」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Injection and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌漿提高局部流體壓力時，土骨架有效應力可能下降，並觸發裂縫張開或土體位移。總應力也可能隨資產約束及灌漿反力改變，因此不能把泵端壓力直接代入孔壓；需要辨別管路損失、注入點與土中實際壓力。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「注入與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rising local fluid pressure can reduce skeleton effective stress and initiate fracture opening or movement. Total stress can also change through asset restraint and grout reaction, so pump pressure cannot be substituted directly for pore pressure. Distinguish line losses, injection-point pressure and the pressure actually measured in the soil. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Injection and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「注入與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Injection and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 灌漿提高局部流體壓力時，土骨架有效應力可能下降，並觸發裂縫張開或土體位移。總應力也可能隨資產約束及灌漿反力改變，因此不能把泵端壓力直接代入孔壓；需要辨別管路損失、注入點與土中實際壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Rising local fluid pressure can reduce skeleton effective stress and initiate fracture opening or movement. Total stress can also change through asset restraint and grout reaction, so pump pressure cannot be substituted directly for pore pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
灌漿提高局部流體壓力時，土骨架有效應力可能下降，並觸發裂縫張開或土體位移。
監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
optionsEn: Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
Rising local fluid pressure can reduce skeleton effective stress and initiate fracture opening or movement.
Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿提高局部流體壓力時，土骨架有效應力可能下降，並觸發裂縫張開或土體位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rising local fluid pressure can reduce skeleton effective stress and initiate fracture opening or movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「注入與有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Injection and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。
一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。
原創教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa。
optionsEn: One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「注入與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Injection and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together. State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together. State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。
knowledge.textEn: State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification"?
options: 對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。
optionsEn: Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
quiz.explanation: 對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「注入與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Injection and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。
knowledge.textEn: Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「注入與有效應力的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。
監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane.
Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
quiz.explanation: 把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回饋延遲的機理與驗證」與「建物角變形的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Feedback delay mechanism and verification" and "Building angular distortion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Feedback delay mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回饋延遲」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Feedback delay” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。若持續注入速度快於可觀察反應，容易超越目標；延遲應與地層本身的反應時間分開辨識。延遲相加假設環節串聯，並行處理需另建時間模型；二十秒不是允許延遲標準，也不取代資產反應分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回饋延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The control loop includes sensing, transmission, interpretation and equipment response, each delaying the movement information reaching the controller. If injection continues faster than observable response, compensation may overshoot. System delay must be distinguished from the physical response time of the ground rather than combining them into one unexplained lag. Adding delays assumes serial stages; parallel processing needs a different timing model, and twenty seconds is neither an allowable delay nor a substitute for asset-response analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Feedback delay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For sensing 5 s, transmission 3 s and interpretation-response 12 s, total delay τ=20 s.

knowledge.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。若持續注入速度快於可觀察反應，容易超越目標；延遲應與地層本身的反應時間分開辨識。
knowledge.textEn: The control loop includes sensing, transmission, interpretation and equipment response, each delaying the movement information reaching the controller. If injection continues faster than observable response, compensation may overshoot.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For sensing 5 s, transmission 3 s and interpretation-response 12 s, total delay τ=20 s. steps.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 使用共同時鐘追蹤注入事件與感測到達時間，模擬訊號中斷，確認遺失資料不會被當成零位移。控制計畫須設定資料新鮮度與失聯停留點；監測及施工負責人確認復原資料後才解除限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 補償的目標通常是限制資產差異變位，單純追求回復地表標高可能反而造成局部反曲。兩點沉陷差可估平均角變形，但建物剛度及基礎連續性會改變力流；原有裂縫與脆性接頭需有個別的變形評估。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「建物角變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 建物角變形的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Building angular distortion mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「建物角變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Building angular distortion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設差異位移Δs=3 mm、測點距L=6 m=6000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For differential movement Δs=3 mm over L=6 m=6000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測資產本體而非只量附近地表，結合傾度與裂縫計分辨剛體轉動及真實畸變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the asset itself rather than nearby ground alone, combining tilt and crack gauges to distinguish rigid-body rotation from actual distortion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 建物角變形的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「建物角變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 量測資產本體而非只量附近地表，結合傾度與裂縫計分辨剛體轉動及真實畸變。資產變形控制區需由結構評估者核定；補償決策應同時檢查相鄰測點，不能只追單點目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the asset itself rather than nearby ground alone, combining tilt and crack gauges to distinguish rigid-body rotation from actual distortion. The structural assessor approves asset-control zones; compensation decisions check neighbouring points rather than pursuing one isolated target. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural assessor approves asset-control zones; compensation decisions check neighbouring points rather than pursuing one isolated target. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 建物角變形的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Building angular distortion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「建物角變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。

Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「建物角變形的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.instructionEn: Previous grouting may fill accessible voids or alter stress, changing movement from the same later injection volume. Efficiency change signals evolving ground state rather than an automatic productivity benefit. A stronger response can mean more localized heave or a shifted injection path, requiring renewed spatial interpretation. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “History-dependent efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「效率隨歷程變化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “History-dependent efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 結構曲率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural curvature mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「結構曲率」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Structural curvature” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續建物或管線受到地盤變形時，曲率比單一斜率更直接反映彎曲需求。兩段轉角差除以距離可估局部曲率，資料解析度及測點間距卻會影響結果；把粗間距測點插值成平滑曲線，可能漏掉剛度突變處的集中彎曲。有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「結構曲率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For continuous buildings or pipes, curvature reflects bending demand more directly than one slope. Rotation difference over distance estimates local curvature, but resolution and spacing influence the result. Interpolating sparse points into a smooth curve can miss concentrated bending at stiffness transitions and produce false confidence in compatibility. Finite-difference curvature assumes smooth deformation; joints with concentrated rotation are not continuous beams, and material strain also requires distance from the neutral axis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Structural curvature” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設轉角差Δθ=0.002 rad、間距L=4 m，κ≈Δθ/L=0.0005 m⁻¹。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For rotation difference Δθ=0.002 rad over L=4 m, κ≈Δθ/L=0.0005 m⁻¹.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「結構曲率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：測點太疏可能漏掉局部彎曲，脆性管線或既有接頭先損傷，而平均沉陷仍在目標內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

quiz.question: 要驗證「結構曲率的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Structural curvature mechanism and verification"?

steps.title: 結構曲率的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural curvature mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「結構曲率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Structural curvature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 測點太疏可能漏掉局部彎曲，脆性管線或既有接頭先損傷，而平均沉陷仍在目標內。有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sparse points can miss local bending that damages brittle utilities or existing joints while mean settlement stays within target. Finite-difference curvature assumes smooth deformation; joints with concentrated rotation are not continuous beams, and material strain also requires distance from the neutral axis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「結構曲率的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Structural curvature mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
Sparse points can miss local bending that damages brittle utilities or existing joints while mean settlement stays within target.

quiz.explanationEn: Sparse points can miss local bending that damages brittle utilities or existing joints while mean settlement stays within target. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」與「停注後反應的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification" and "Post-injection response mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「小訊號反應模型」如何影響補償灌漿沉陷控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Small-signal response model” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compensation grouting for settlement control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。模型只能在相近狀態及小增量內使用，不能從一次反應直接推算大體積注入，更不能把理論控制值當作現場施作指令。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「小訊號反應模型」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The model applies only near the calibrated state and for small increments. One response cannot justify large-volume extrapolation or turn a theoretical control quantity into field instructions. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Small-signal response model” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「小訊號反應模型」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Small-signal response model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。模型只能在相近狀態及小增量內使用，不能從一次反應直接推算大體積注入，更不能把理論控制值當作現場施作指令。
knowledge.textEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The model applies only near the calibrated state and for small increments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。
一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。
停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。
optionsEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear.
A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops.
quiz.explanation: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「小訊號反應模型」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Small-signal response model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Small-signal response model mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。
原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。
泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。
optionsEn: One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm.
Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Small-signal response model mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「小訊號反應模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Small-signal response model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged. Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged. steps.instruction: 停止注入後，地盤仍可能因孔壓消散、漿材固化及隧道持續開挖而移動，因此控制不應在閥門關閉時結束。殘餘位移與時間的關係有助分辨短時回彈及長期沉陷，但需扣除其他施工事件並保持監測基準不變。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停注後反應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Movement can continue after injection through pore-pressure dissipation, curing and ongoing tunnelling, so control should not end when a valve closes. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
