steps.observation: 連結機制：四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。
knowledge.textEn: Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停注後反應的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-injection response mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。
最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves.
Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
quiz.explanation: 太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 地盤壓密灌漿
courses.summary: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。
courses.summaryEn: Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement.
courses.focus: 低流動性灌漿的擠密、孔壓與資產反應
courses.focusEn: Low-mobility grout displacement, pore pressure and asset response
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設飽和土受等向不排水總應力增量Δσ=100 kPa，Skempton係數B=0.9，超額孔壓Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。只把總應力增量提高10%至110 kPa，B維持不變，Δu=99 kPa。這表示短時間內增加的荷載大部分由水壓反應承擔，不代表土骨架已永久增強。真實壓密灌漿並非等向試驗，還含剪應力、排水與漿泡形狀；應以孔壓消散及處理前後原位阻力共同確認改善，而非把高注入壓力當成密實度證據。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume saturated soil receives an isotropic undrained total-stress increment Δσ=100 kPa with Skempton coefficient B=0.9. Excess pressure is Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. Increase only the stress increment by 10% to 110 kPa with B fixed and Δu becomes 99 kPa. Most of the short-term increment is therefore expressed in water pressure rather than demonstrated permanent skeleton strengthening. Actual compaction grouting is not an isotropic test and also involves shear, drainage and bulb geometry. Verify improvement using pressure dissipation and paired in-situ resistance tests rather than interpreting high injection pressure as density evidence.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 合成教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa
合成教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」與「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification" and "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「不排水孔壓」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undrained pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。反應取決於飽和度及應力路徑，不能因為注入壓力高就斷言地盤已變密；持續孔壓還可能暫時降低鄰近穩定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不排水孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. Response depends on saturation and stress path, so high injection pressure does not prove densification. Persistent pore pressure may temporarily reduce stability nearby. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Undrained pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「不排水孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Undrained pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。反應取決於飽和度及應力路徑，不能因為注入壓力高就斷言地盤已變密；持續孔壓還可能暫時降低鄰近穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. Response depends on saturation and stress path, so high injection pressure does not prove densification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。
低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。
漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
optionsEn: Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton.
Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening.
Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
quiz.explanation: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不排水孔壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undrained pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以孔壓計與地表位移對照注入事件，檢查消散時間，並分辨管內壓力與土中孔壓。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare piezometers and surface movement with injection events, assess dissipation time, and distinguish pipe pressure from soil pore pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 面積比超過一半就表示整個場址都改善了一半。
地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。
原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。
optionsEn: An area ratio above one half proves the entire site is half improved.
A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不排水孔壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Undrained pore pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以孔壓計與地表位移對照注入事件，檢查消散時間，並分辨管內壓力與土中孔壓。注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare piezometers and surface movement with injection events, assess dissipation time, and distinguish pipe pressure from soil pore pressure. Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔壓累積而未消散可能降低有效應力，使周邊地盤暫時軟化，補強過程反而造成位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accumulated pore pressure reduces effective stress and can temporarily soften surrounding ground, causing movement during the improvement itself. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以孔壓計與地表位移對照注入事件，檢查消散時間，並分辨管內壓力與土中孔壓。注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。
knowledge.textEn: Compare piezometers and surface movement with injection events, assess dissipation time, and distinguish pipe pressure from soil pore pressure. Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。
knowledge.textEn: Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.

steps.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不排水孔壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Undrained pore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔壓累積而未消散可能降低有效應力，使周邊地盤暫時軟化，補強過程反而造成位移。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulated pore pressure reduces effective stress and can temporarily soften surrounding ground, causing movement during the improvement itself. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不排水孔壓的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
孔壓累積而未消散可能降低有效應力，使周邊地盤暫時軟化，補強過程反而造成位移。
漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Accumulated pore pressure reduces effective stress and can temporarily soften surrounding ground, causing movement during the improvement itself.
Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
quiz.explanation: 孔壓累積而未消散可能降低有效應力，使周邊地盤暫時軟化，補強過程反而造成位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulated pore pressure reduces effective stress and can temporarily soften surrounding ground, causing movement during the improvement itself. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔隙比減少」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void-ratio reduction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。體積應變可由孔隙比變化估算，但前提是土粒體積不變且觀察的是同一土體；飽和細粒土還需要水能排出才能形成永久壓縮。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔隙比減少」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. Void-ratio change estimates volumetric strain if solid volume is fixed and the same soil mass is followed. Saturated fine soil also needs drainage for permanent compression to develop. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void-ratio reduction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔隙比減少」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Void-ratio reduction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。體積應變可由孔隙比變化估算，但前提是土粒體積不變且觀察的是同一土體；飽和細粒土還需要水能排出才能形成永久壓縮。
knowledge.textEn: Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. Void-ratio change estimates volumetric strain if solid volume is fixed and the same soil mass is followed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。
optionsEn: Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil.
quiz.explanation: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔隙比減少」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Void-ratio reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。
前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。
灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔隙比減少」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Void-ratio reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis. Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis.
A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.
quiz.explanation: 以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔隙比減少」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void-ratio reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。
knowledge.textEn: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔隙比減少的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment.
quiz.explanation: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證」與「處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification" and "Treatment coverage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漿泡等效半徑」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent grout-bulb radius” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。等效球半徑可把體積轉成直觀尺寸，僅供比較材料量與可能影響範圍；不能據此直接確定處理交疊或資產安全距離。等效半徑是體積換算，不是可測得的施工直徑或擠密半徑；流失、壓縮與裂隙注入都會改變實際幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿泡等效半徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical. Equivalent sphere radius converts volume into an intuitive size for comparison only; it cannot directly establish treatment overlap or safe separation from assets. Equivalent radius is a volume conversion, not a demonstrated installation or densification radius; loss, compression and fracture entry change actual geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent grout-bulb radius” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漿泡等效半徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equivalent grout-bulb radius”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。等效球半徑可把體積轉成直觀尺寸，僅供比較材料量與可能影響範圍；不能據此直接確定處理交疊或資產安全距離。
knowledge.textEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical. Equivalent sphere radius converts volume into an intuitive size for comparison only; it cannot directly establish treatment overlap or safe separation from assets.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。
注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。
面積比超過一半就表示整個場址都改善了一半。
optionsEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical.
Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
An area ratio above one half proves the entire site is half improved.
quiz.explanation: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漿泡等效半徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equivalent grout-bulb radius” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗區揭露、原位反應及材料平衡核對形狀假設，檢查弱層是否造成扁平擴展或側向漏失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check shape assumptions through trial-area exposure, in-situ response and material balance, examining weak-layer spreading or lateral loss.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。
原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。
資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。
optionsEn: A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m.
A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 以試驗區揭露、原位反應及材料平衡核對形狀假設，檢查弱層是否造成扁平擴展或側向漏失。試驗方案需驗證地層控制的漿體分布；地工設計者確認有效影響範圍後才安排處理網格。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Trials must verify ground-controlled grout distribution; the geotechnical designer confirms effective influence before laying out the treatment grid. Equivalent radius is a volume conversion, not a demonstrated installation or densification radius; loss, compression and fracture entry change actual geometry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿裂隙形成細長漿脈時，球形假設會高估四周擠密範圍，並低估遠處資產受影響可能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Elongated grout veins along fractures invalidate spherical influence, overstating nearby densification and understating possible effects on distant assets. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」與「地表隆起體積的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification" and "Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓消散時間」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore-pressure dissipation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。壓密理論的時間因子可估指定排水長度的尺度，但真實三維排水及土層各向異性可能主導；排程不能只由設備可用時間決定。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓消散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. Consolidation time factors estimate a scale for a specified drainage path, but three-dimensional drainage and anisotropy may govern. Equipment availability alone therefore cannot set the waiting interval. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore-pressure dissipation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓消散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore-pressure dissipation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。壓密理論的時間因子可估指定排水長度的尺度，但真實三維排水及土層各向異性可能主導；排程不能只由設備可用時間決定。
knowledge.textEn: Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. Consolidation time factors estimate a scale for a specified drainage path, but three-dimensional drainage and anisotropy may govern.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。
地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。
分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。
optionsEn: Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated.
A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress.
quiz.explanation: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓消散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore-pressure dissipation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。
資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。
表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day.
A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.
Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓消散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore-pressure dissipation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。階段放行以核定孔壓及位移條件判定，地工設計者檢查排水假設後才調整等待安排。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams. Release stages using approved pressure and movement conditions; the geotechnical designer reviews drainage assumptions before waiting intervals change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：階段放行以核定孔壓及位移條件判定，地工設計者檢查排水假設後才調整等待安排。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Release stages using approved pressure and movement conditions; the geotechnical designer reviews drainage assumptions before waiting intervals change. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：等待不足會使超額孔壓累積，注入後土體尚未增強就承受下一次擠壓，造成不利位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient waiting accumulates excess pressure and subjects ground to further displacement before strengthening, causing adverse movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。階段放行以核定孔壓及位移條件判定，地工設計者檢查排水假設後才調整等待安排。
knowledge.textEn: Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams. Release stages using approved pressure and movement conditions; the geotechnical designer reviews drainage assumptions before waiting intervals change.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 階段放行以核定孔壓及位移條件判定，地工設計者檢查排水假設後才調整等待安排。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。
knowledge.textEn: Release stages using approved pressure and movement conditions; the geotechnical designer reviews drainage assumptions before waiting intervals change. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。
漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams.
Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
quiz.explanation: 以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓消散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore-pressure dissipation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 等待不足會使超額孔壓累積，注入後土體尚未增強就承受下一次擠壓，造成不利位移。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient waiting accumulates excess pressure and subjects ground to further displacement before strengthening, causing adverse movement. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 等待不足會使超額孔壓累積，注入後土體尚未增強就承受下一次擠壓，造成不利位移。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient waiting accumulates excess pressure and subjects ground to further displacement before strengthening, causing adverse movement. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。
等待不足會使超額孔壓累積，注入後土體尚未增強就承受下一次擠壓，造成不利位移。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
Insufficient waiting accumulates excess pressure and subjects ground to further displacement before strengthening, causing adverse movement.
quiz.explanation: 等待不足會使超額孔壓累積，注入後土體尚未增強就承受下一次擠壓，造成不利位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient waiting accumulates excess pressure and subjects ground to further displacement before strengthening, causing adverse movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地表隆起體積的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地表隆起體積」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface-heave volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擠密過程若土粒重排空間不足，注入可能轉成地表隆起或資產移動。以面積乘平均隆起可估觀測到的體積，但測區之外仍可能變形；把地表反應和注入量、孔壓一起比較，有助辨別壓縮、填空與抬升的比例。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地表隆起體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When grain rearrangement has limited space, injection may become surface heave or asset movement. Area times mean heave estimates observed volume, but deformation can extend beyond the surveyed zone. Comparing this response with injected quantity and pore pressure helps separate compression, cavity filling and uplift contributions. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Surface-heave volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void filling versus densification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓密灌漿遇到舊坑洞或鬆散填土時，漿液可能先填空，對周圍密度改善有限。材料平衡需區分已知空洞填充及真正擠移土體的部分，否則高注入量會被誤當高成效；不明耗量也是需要調查的地質訊號。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「填空與擠密分辨」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur. steps.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Void filling versus densification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填空與擠密分辨」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement. The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「填空與擠密分辨」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void filling versus densification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure.
A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.

quiz.explanationEn: High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產推力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「資產推力」如何影響地盤壓密灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset reaction force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Compaction grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有管線或基礎若限制地盤擠移，位移會轉成額外作用力，剛度越高不代表受影響越小。簡化彈簧模型能說明小位移對剛性資產的力需求，但接觸開閉、土體塑性與結構接頭會造成非線性，須以實際界面分析。彈簧常數屬特定方向與邊界，不是材料模數；兩毫米也不是通用允許變位，應與資產能力及不確定度比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When an existing utility or foundation restrains displacement, movement becomes additional force; high stiffness does not mean low impact. A spring model illustrates force demand from small movement of a stiff asset, while opening contact, soil plasticity and joints introduce nonlinearity requiring actual interface analysis. The spring constant belongs to a direction and boundary condition rather than being a material modulus; two millimetres is not a universal permitted movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset reaction force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset reaction force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
