steps.title: 平板反力剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Plate response stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平板反力剛度」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plate response stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平板載重的壓力沉陷比是試驗尺度下的反力指標，受板尺寸與受力深度影響。它不是土壤楊氏模數，也不應直接外推到大型基礎的深層沉陷。假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平板反力剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A plate's pressure-settlement ratio is a test-scale response influenced by plate size and stressed depth. It is not soil Young's modulus and cannot directly predict deeper settlement under a large foundation. For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa. A surface crust can stiffen a small plate while soft material remains below. Treating its response coefficient as a material constant understates settlement under larger loads and overstates treatment success. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plate response stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平板反力剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Plate response stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 保存完整載重卸載曲線與持荷時間，核對板尺寸、基底整平及位移基準。以相同試驗條件比較前後改善，深層承載及沉陷另由地層模型檢核。同時排除以下干擾原因：表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 設備接地壓力：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 施工設備作用地盤的接觸壓力影響作業平台穩定，和改善後永久地盤能力是不同問題。平均壓力不含履帶端部集中、動態反力或偏心，平台需獨立設計。假設設備垂直荷載P=1000kN、總有效接觸A=2m²，q=P/A=500kPa；此為靜態平均值，不是平台許可壓力。接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「設備接地壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equipment contact pressure governs working-platform stability, separately from improved permanent-ground capacity. Average pressure excludes track-edge concentration, dynamic reactions and eccentricity, requiring a dedicated platform design. For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa. This is static average pressure, not allowable platform bearing pressure. Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equipment ground contact pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa. This is static average pressure, not allowable platform bearing pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

只要超額孔壓比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for energy per treatment area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa.
A nominal result for excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設設備垂直荷載P=1000kN、總有效接觸A=2m²，q=P/A=500kPa；此為靜態平均值，不是平台許可壓力。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 設備接地壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment ground contact pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設備接地壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equipment ground contact pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對實際接觸面積與設備工況，將平台厚度、排水及下伏軟層納入審查。平台驗收與日常檢查由施工及岩土責任人完成，異常沉陷應先處理再作業。同時排除以下干擾原因：接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review actual contact and equipment states alongside platform thickness, drainage and underlying soft layers. Construction and geotechnical leads approve and inspect the platform; abnormal settlement requires resolution before operation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接設備接地壓力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對實際接觸面積與設備工況，將平台厚度、排水及下伏軟層納入審查。平台驗收與日常檢查由施工及岩土責任人完成，異常沉陷應先處理再作業。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over equipment ground contact pressure, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review actual contact and equipment states alongside platform thickness, drainage and underlying soft layers. Construction and geotechnical leads approve and inspect the platform; abnormal settlement requires resolution before operation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備接地壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment ground contact pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要夯坑幾何估量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
核對實際接觸面積與設備工況，將平台厚度、排水及下伏軟層納入審查。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nominal result for crater geometry estimate removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Review actual contact and equipment states alongside platform thickness, drainage and underlying soft layers.
quiz.explanation: 核對實際接觸面積與設備工況，將平台厚度、排水及下伏軟層納入審查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review actual contact and equipment states alongside platform thickness, drainage and underlying soft layers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設備接地壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment ground contact pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設備接地壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equipment ground contact pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設備接地壓力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for equipment ground contact pressure removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 貫入阻力改善比：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Penetration resistance gain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「貫入阻力改善比」如何影響動力夯實地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Penetration resistance gain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic compaction of ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工前後貫入阻力比可顯示改變，但受有效應力、孔壓、測試位置及土層分類影響。成效判讀應檢查完整深度剖面，不能只報全場最大的改善倍率。假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貫入阻力改善比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pre- and post-treatment penetration ratios show change but depend on effective stress, pressure, location and soil type. Evaluate full depth profiles instead of reporting only the largest site-wide gain. For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2. Doubled cone resistance is not doubled bearing capacity or acceptance of all strata. If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Penetration resistance gain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要貫入阻力改善比符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for penetration resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「貫入阻力改善比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Penetration resistance gain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2. Doubled cone resistance is not doubled bearing capacity or acceptance of all strata. steps.observation: 如何核對：配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.titleEn: Penetration resistance gain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「貫入阻力改善比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Penetration resistance gain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。對低增幅區保留原始剖面與原因分析，依工程目標逐區簽認而非平均通過。同時排除以下干擾原因：前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match before-and-after locations and levels, checking dissipation time, calibration and stratigraphy. Retain raw profiles and explanations for low-gain zones, accepting against project objectives zone by zone rather than by the average. Also rule out the following competing explanation: If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接貫入阻力改善比時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。對低增幅區保留原始剖面與原因分析，依工程目標逐區簽認而非平均通過。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over penetration resistance gain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Match before-and-after locations and levels, checking dissipation time, calibration and stratigraphy. Retain raw profiles and explanations for low-gain zones, accepting against project objectives zone by zone rather than by the average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「貫入阻力改善比」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Penetration resistance gain"?
options: 配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要乾密度與含水符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Match before-and-after locations and levels, checking dissipation time, calibration and stratigraphy.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for dry density and moisture removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match before-and-after locations and levels, checking dissipation time, calibration and stratigraphy. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 貫入阻力改善比：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Penetration resistance gain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「貫入阻力改善比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Penetration resistance gain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要貫入阻力改善比符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for penetration resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「貫入阻力改善比」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Penetration resistance gain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。
只要落錘位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone.
A nominal result for drop weight energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 振動碎石樁施工
courses.summary: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
courses.focus: 連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤
courses.focusEn: Relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。方格間距固定2m，假設直徑由0.8增加10%至0.88m，置換率由0.1257增為0.1521，比例增加21%而非10%；實際直徑與深度連續性仍需證據，不能只用供料量保證。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. At fixed2m square spacing, increasing assumed diameter from0.8 to0.88m by10% raises replacement from0.1257 to0.1521, a21% rather than10% increase. Actual diameter and continuity still require evidence rather than a delivered-material guarantee. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「方格置換面積」與「粒料側向拘束」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Square grid replacement area" and "Aggregate lateral confinement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 方格置換面積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Square grid replacement area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方格置換面積」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Square grid replacement area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碎石樁和原土共同承擔荷載，樁面積占單元面積的比例是配置起點。平均直徑不一定代表每一深度的有效斷面，網格邊界與漏樁也會改變實際置換。假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方格置換面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone columns and native soil share load, making area replacement a starting descriptor. Mean diameter does not establish effective section at every depth, while boundaries and missing columns alter actual replacement. For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Square grid replacement area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要方格置換面積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for square grid replacement area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方格置換面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Square grid replacement area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 方格置換面積
knowledge.text: 碎石樁和原土共同承擔荷載，樁面積占單元面積的比例是配置起點。平均直徑不一定代表每一深度的有效斷面，網格邊界與漏樁也會改變實際置換。
knowledge.textEn: Stone columns and native soil share load, making area replacement a starting descriptor. Mean diameter does not establish effective section at every depth, while boundaries and missing columns alter actual replacement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要方格置換面積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for square grid replacement area removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「方格置換面積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Square grid replacement area" is correct?
options: 只要方格置換面積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
碎石樁和原土共同承擔荷載，樁面積占單元面積的比例是配置起點。
只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 用竣工坐標與材料記錄核對每個單元，檢查不同深度的可能縮頸。圖面列出場界、障礙及漏樁位置，不能以全場平均替代關鍵基礎下的局部配置。同時排除以下干擾原因：若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 連結機制：若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。

steps.title: 粒料側向拘束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aggregate lateral confinement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「粒料側向拘束」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aggregate lateral confinement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碎石柱不是可獨立受壓的鋼筋混凝土樁，粒料抗剪需要周圍土體提供拘束。理想摩擦材料的主應力比顯示拘束重要性，但不能直接當整根柱的承載公式。假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粒料側向拘束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A stone column is not an independently supported reinforced-concrete pile. Aggregate shear resistance needs surrounding confinement; an ideal frictional stress ratio illustrates that dependence rather than providing a whole-column capacity formula. For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aggregate lateral confinement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「粒料側向拘束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aggregate lateral confinement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「粒料側向拘束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aggregate lateral confinement", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水時間尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.
A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for drainage time scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 粒料側向拘束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aggregate lateral confinement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「粒料側向拘束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aggregate lateral confinement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。同時排除以下干擾原因：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接粒料側向拘束時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over aggregate lateral confinement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.

quiz.question: 要驗證「粒料側向拘束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aggregate lateral confinement"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。
只要邊緣柱與內柱符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones.
A nominal result for edge and interior columns removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 粒料側向拘束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aggregate lateral confinement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粒料側向拘束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aggregate lateral confinement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要粒料側向拘束符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for aggregate lateral confinement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
knowledge.textEn: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「粒料側向拘束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aggregate lateral confinement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging.
quiz.explanation: 上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「等應變荷載分配」與「柱體排水通量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equal strain load sharing" and "Column drainage flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 等應變荷載分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equal strain load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「等應變荷載分配」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equal strain load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。等應變單元可說明平衡，應力集中比必須有分析或試驗依據。假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等應變荷載分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. An equal-strain cell illustrates equilibrium, but its concentration ratio requires analytical or experimental support. For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa. Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equal strain load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「等應變荷載分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equal strain load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 等應變荷載分配
knowledge.text: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。等應變單元可說明平衡，應力集中比必須有分析或試驗依據。
knowledge.textEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. An equal-strain cell illustrates equilibrium, but its concentration ratio requires analytical or experimental support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「等應變荷載分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equal strain load sharing" is correct?
options: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。
只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area.
A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 等應變荷載分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equal strain load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「等應變荷載分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equal strain load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 等應變荷載分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equal strain load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「等應變荷載分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equal strain load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。同時排除以下干擾原因：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接等應變荷載分配時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over equal strain load sharing, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 柱體排水通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column drainage flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱體排水通量」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column drainage flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高透水柱體可提供排水路徑，但是否有效取決於連通、濾層及周圍土進水能力。達西通量只描述選定柱段，不能以柱材高透水性證明全地盤迅速消散孔壓。假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱體排水通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A permeable column provides drainage only with connectivity, filtering and inflow from the surrounding soil. Darcy flow describes a selected segment; high aggregate permeability alone does not prove rapid pressure dissipation throughout the ground. For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity. Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column drainage flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱體排水通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column drainage flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱體排水通量
knowledge.text: 高透水柱體可提供排水路徑，但是否有效取決於連通、濾層及周圍土進水能力。達西通量只描述選定柱段，不能以柱材高透水性證明全地盤迅速消散孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: A permeable column provides drainage only with connectivity, filtering and inflow from the surrounding soil. Darcy flow describes a selected segment; high aggregate permeability alone does not prove rapid pressure dissipation throughout the ground.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 柱體排水通量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column drainage flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱體排水通量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column drainage flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查粒料與周圍土的濾層相容性，並量測柱內外孔壓的時間差。核對上部排水出口是否暢通，不能只以供料場的滲透試驗替代整個排水系統驗證。同時排除以下干擾原因：細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check filter compatibility with native soil and measure pressure lag inside and outside columns. Verify outlet continuity rather than using quarry permeability tests as acceptance of the complete drainage system. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接柱體排水通量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查粒料與周圍土的濾層相容性，並量測柱內外孔壓的時間差。核對上部排水出口是否暢通，不能只以供料場的滲透試驗替代整個排水系統驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over column drainage flow, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check filter compatibility with native soil and measure pressure lag inside and outside columns. Verify outlet continuity rather than using quarry permeability tests as acceptance of the complete drainage system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 柱體排水通量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Column drainage flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱體排水通量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Column drainage flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要柱體排水通量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for column drainage flow removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。
knowledge.textEn: Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱體排水通量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Column drainage flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。
只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow.
A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「成柱材料體積」與「複合地盤壓縮」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Column material volume" and "Composite ground compression": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 成柱材料體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column material volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「成柱材料體積」如何影響振動碎石樁施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column material volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。材料超量或不足均需解釋，不能直接把卡車運送體積當竣工直徑證明。假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「成柱材料體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses. Both excess and shortage need explanation; truck volume alone does not demonstrate as-built diameter. For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery. Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column material volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「成柱材料體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Column material volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成柱材料體積
knowledge.text: 理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。材料超量或不足均需解釋，不能直接把卡車運送體積當竣工直徑證明。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses. Both excess and shortage need explanation; truck volume alone does not demonstrate as-built diameter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成柱材料體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Column material volume" is correct?
options: 只要成柱材料體積符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要複合地盤壓縮符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。
optionsEn: A nominal result for column material volume removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for composite ground compression removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses.
quiz.explanation: 理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成柱材料體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column material volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成柱材料體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column material volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分深度施工紀錄、投入量與材料體積換算核對成柱連續性，異常區配合適用檢測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile depth records, quantities and volume conversions to assess continuity, investigating anomalies with suitable tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成柱材料體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Column material volume", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。
只要柱端壓力尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水堵塞後孔壓符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.
A nominal result for column toe pressure scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for pressure after drain blockage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成柱材料體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column material volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成柱材料體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column material volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分深度施工紀錄、投入量與材料體積換算核對成柱連續性，異常區配合適用檢測。保存實際深度與平台高程，避免起算面不同導致長度差被誤認成超耗。同時排除以下干擾原因：單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile depth records, quantities and volume conversions to assess continuity, investigating anomalies with suitable tests. Preserve depth and platform datum so different starting elevations are not mistaken for excessive consumption. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite ground compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vibro-replacement stone columns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良後沉陷取決於有效複合模數與未改善下層，簡化一維估算只適用指定應力範圍。柱土分配模型和模數選定需相容，不能把石料模數直接當整片地盤模數。假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合地盤壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement depends on composite stiffness and untreated deeper layers. A one-dimensional estimate applies within a specified stress range; load sharing and modulus must agree, rather than substituting aggregate modulus for the entire ground. For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression. Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement. knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較載重試驗、分層沉陷與地層模型，確認模數代表實際應力範圍及排水條件。將改良層與下伏未改良層分項列出，不以小試區結果遮蔽深層貢獻。同時排除以下干擾原因：若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。
knowledge.textEn: Compare load tests, layer settlements and stratigraphy to verify modulus over the real stress and drainage range. List improved and untreated contributions separately instead of allowing a small trial to conceal deep compression. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接複合地盤壓縮時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較載重試驗、分層沉陷與地層模型，確認模數代表實際應力範圍及排水條件。將改良層與下伏未改良層分項列出，不以小試區結果遮蔽深層貢獻。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over composite ground compression, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare load tests, layer settlements and stratigraphy to verify modulus over the real stress and drainage range. List improved and untreated contributions separately instead of allowing a small trial to conceal deep compression.

quiz.question: 要驗證「複合地盤壓縮」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite ground compression"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要等應變荷載分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
比較載重試驗、分層沉陷與地層模型，確認模數代表實際應力範圍及排水條件。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A nominal result for equal strain load sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Compare load tests, layer settlements and stratigraphy to verify modulus over the real stress and drainage range.
quiz.explanation: 比較載重試驗、分層沉陷與地層模型，確認模數代表實際應力範圍及排水條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare load tests, layer settlements and stratigraphy to verify modulus over the real stress and drainage range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 複合地盤壓縮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite ground compression: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「複合地盤壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Composite ground compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要複合地盤壓縮符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for composite ground compression removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
