stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理出露幾何」與「孔壓扣除法向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" and "Pore pressure and normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理出露幾何」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理出露幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition. Similar dip direction, persistence, lateral release surfaces and friction also matter; the angular difference is not a stability reserve. Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理出露幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Discontinuity daylighting geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理出露幾何
knowledge.text: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。必須另外確認傾向相近、連續長度、側向釋放面與摩擦，不能把角度差當安全儲備。
knowledge.textEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. A joint flatter than the face meets only one geometric condition.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理出露幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" is correct?
options: 只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 平面滑動先受節理方向及坡面幾何控制，節理比坡面緩只是必要幾何條件之一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Planar sliding first depends on discontinuity orientation and slope geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理出露幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. The angular difference is65−40=25°. It is not a safety factor and does not test wedge sliding or toppling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理出露幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Discontinuity daylighting geometry", which statement holds?
options: 只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。
optionsEn: A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設坡面傾角65°、節理傾角40°且傾向一致，幾何角差65−40=25°；此角差不是安全係數，也未檢查楔形或傾倒機制。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Assume a65° face and40° joint with matching dip direction. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理出露幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。同時排除以下干擾原因：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接節理出露幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over discontinuity daylighting geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。同時排除以下干擾原因：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
knowledge.textEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接節理出露幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。將不可見延伸列成不確定區，由岩土工程師確認控制滑動模式。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over discontinuity daylighting geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Mark hidden extensions as uncertain and have the geotechnical engineer identify controlling mechanisms.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節理出露幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Discontinuity daylighting geometry"?
options: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 用地質羅盤或定向影像分組記錄節理傾向、傾角及延續性，對照實際坡面建立立體投影。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Group dip directions, dips and persistence using a geological compass or oriented images, then compare them with the actual face on a stereonet. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節理出露幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity daylighting geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理出露幾何」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
knowledge.textEn: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Anchors designed around the wrong plane may look orderly while failing to restrain movement across the actual discontinuity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節理出露幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 僅憑一張正面照片量角，會漏掉向側方滑動的楔體；錨索方向若建立在錯誤滑面上，外觀整齊仍不能形成有效的跨面約束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Angles from a single frontal photograph can miss a laterally sliding wedge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓扣除法向力」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure and normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓扣除法向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust. The example assumes one plane and a known resultant; crack-water thrust and seismic inertia require separate terms rather than being hidden inside one pore-pressure value. For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore pressure and normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓扣除法向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore pressure and normal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。此處假設單一平面及合力已知，張裂縫水推力與地震慣性需另加，不能混入同一孔壓數字。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓扣除法向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore pressure and normal force" is correct?

只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
岩塊重量分解到滑面後，水壓合力會減少有效接觸力。
optionsEn: A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Resolve block weight normal to the sliding plane before subtracting water thrust.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓扣除法向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore pressure and normal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. A positive result only indicates compressive contact in this model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔壓扣除法向力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore pressure and normal force", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：W=1000kN、滑面角30°、法向水壓合力U=200kN時，N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN；正值只表示此模型仍保持壓縮接觸。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For W=1000kN, plane angle30° and normal water thrust U=200kN, N′=Wcos30°−U=666.0kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓扣除法向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure and normal force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。同時排除以下干擾原因：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接孔壓扣除法向力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over pore pressure and normal force, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。同時排除以下干擾原因：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
knowledge.textEn: Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. A reading in one fracture leaves hydraulic connectivity to other fractures uncertain. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接孔壓扣除法向力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。若量測僅在單一裂隙，應保留其他裂隙水力連通的不確定性。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over pore pressure and normal force, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram. quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓扣除法向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore pressure and normal force"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將孔壓測點與滑面交會高程一起標示，沿面積分取得水壓合力，再與自由體圖逐項核對。
只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Plot piezometer positions with their intersections on the plane, integrate pressure over area and reconcile the resultant with the free-body diagram.
A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 孔壓扣除法向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and normal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓扣除法向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure and normal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
knowledge.textEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓扣除法向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore pressure and normal force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force.
quiz.explanation: 把坡腳排水孔讀值當作全滑面水壓可高估有效正向力；降雨後上部裂隙仍蓄水時，摩擦抗力可能下降而監測畫面顯示正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a toe-drain reading for the whole plane can overestimate effective normal force; upper fractures may retain storm water and reduce friction while the monitoring display appears normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objective: 說明「節理摩擦抗力」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discontinuity friction resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。模型先忽略黏聚及幾何咬合，以了解有效正向力對摩擦的作用。取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理摩擦抗力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The model omits cohesion and interlocking to isolate how effective normal force contributes to friction. With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces. Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discontinuity friction resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理摩擦抗力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Discontinuity friction resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理摩擦抗力
knowledge.text: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。模型先忽略黏聚及幾何咬合，以了解有效正向力對摩擦的作用。
knowledge.textEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The model omits cohesion and interlocking to isolate how effective normal force contributes to friction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理摩擦抗力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Discontinuity friction resistance" is correct?
options: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。
只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement.
A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 清潔接觸、充填物與表面粗糙度決定節理的剪切行為，峰值強度不一定能在大位移後維持。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Clean contact, infill and roughness govern discontinuity shear response, and peak strength may not persist after displacement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity friction resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理摩擦抗力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discontinuity friction resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. This is one plane's friction term, excluding anchors and other forces.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理摩擦抗力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Discontinuity friction resistance", which statement holds?
options: 只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取N′=666kN、摩擦角φ=30°且c=0，R=N′tanφ=384.5kN，約385kN；此為單一滑面摩擦項，不含錨索與其他外力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With N′=666kN, friction angle φ=30° and c=0, R=N′tanφ=384.5kN, about385kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity friction resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理摩擦抗力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discontinuity friction resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。同時排除以下干擾原因：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接節理摩擦抗力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over discontinuity friction resistance, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。同時排除以下干擾原因：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。
knowledge.textEn: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接節理摩擦抗力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。設計審查需明列採用峰值或殘餘值的理由，並和可能位移機制相容。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over discontinuity friction resistance, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. The design review must explain the choice of peak or residual strength and demonstrate compatibility with the anticipated movement mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節理摩擦抗力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Discontinuity friction resistance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions.
quiz.explanation: 對代表性節理材料做適用的剪切試驗，記錄含水狀態、正向應力及位移範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test representative joint material under relevant moisture, normal stress and displacement conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節理摩擦抗力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Discontinuity friction resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理摩擦抗力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Discontinuity friction resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要節理摩擦抗力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for discontinuity friction resistance removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。
knowledge.textEn: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Initial stability does not establish persistent peak strength, and repeated wet seasons may accumulate displacement after softening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節理摩擦抗力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Discontinuity friction resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 試體若避開軟弱充填而只取完整岩面，會高估現場摩擦；初期穩定不能保證剪切後仍保有峰值，滑動可能在雨季反覆累積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Samples excluding weak infill can overestimate field friction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錨索方向分量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchor force projection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨索方向分量」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor force projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨索拉力必須相對於滑動方向分解，不能把整支拉力全部當直接抗滑。與滑面法向的分量可能改變摩擦，這項效應應獨立計算並避免和直接分量重複。T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨索方向分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resolve anchor tension relative to the sliding direction instead of crediting the full force as direct resistance. Its normal component may alter friction, but that contribution must be calculated separately and not double counted with the direct component. For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term. A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anchor force projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨索方向分量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anchor force projection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨索方向分量
knowledge.text: 錨索拉力必須相對於滑動方向分解，不能把整支拉力全部當直接抗滑。與滑面法向的分量可能改變摩擦，這項效應應獨立計算並避免和直接分量重複。
knowledge.textEn: Resolve anchor tension relative to the sliding direction instead of crediting the full force as direct resistance. Its normal component may alter friction, but that contribution must be calculated separately and not double counted with the direct component.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨索方向分量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anchor force projection" is correct?
options: 只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
錨索拉力必須相對於滑動方向分解，不能把整支拉力全部當直接抗滑。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Resolve anchor tension relative to the sliding direction instead of crediting the full force as direct resistance.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 錨索拉力必須相對於滑動方向分解，不能把整支拉力全部當直接抗滑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Resolve anchor tension relative to the sliding direction instead of crediting the full force as direct resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨索方向分量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchor force projection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨索方向分量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor force projection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. This expression excludes any additional friction term.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨索方向分量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anchor force projection", which statement holds?
options: 只要排水恢復摩擦符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要位移速率與時窗符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。
optionsEn: A nominal result for drainage and friction recovery removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for movement rate and time window removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：T=200kN與反滑動方向夾角20°時，直接分量Tcos20°=187.9kN，約188kN；額外摩擦項在本式未計。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For T=200kN at20° to the direction opposing sliding, direct resistance Tcos20°=187.9kN, about188kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨索方向分量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchor force projection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨索方向分量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor force projection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。同時排除以下干擾原因：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接錨索方向分量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over anchor force projection, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。同時排除以下干擾原因：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接錨索方向分量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。用荷載量測比對實際張力，偏斜過大時由設計者重算錨頭彎曲與可用分量。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over anchor force projection, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Compare measured tension and have the designer reassess head bending and usable components if alignment differs significantly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨索方向分量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Anchor force projection"?
options: 查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要節理出露幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for discontinuity daylighting geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 查驗鑽孔方位、錨頭偏角及滑面幾何，將竣工方向代入向量平衡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check drilling azimuth, head deviation and plane geometry, then insert as-built directions into vector equilibrium. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨索方向分量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchor force projection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨索方向分量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchor force projection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要錨索方向分量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for anchor force projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
knowledge.textEn: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Verifying force magnitude alone leaves a hidden support deficiency.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨索方向分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchor force projection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。
只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance.
A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 鑽孔偏向使拉力大多沿錯誤方向作用，可能提高局部岩體應力卻未有效抗滑；只驗張力大小而不驗方位，會留下隱藏的支護缺口。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A deviated borehole may apply most tension in an ineffective direction, raising local stress without sufficient sliding resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穩定區錨固長度」與「落石位能尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bond beyond the moving zone" and "Rockfall energy scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩定區錨固長度」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bond beyond the moving zone” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。實際黏結長度仍受裂隙、灌漿品質與鄰近錨索互制限制，自由段不得誤算成有效固定段。假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩定區錨固長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. Crossing the plane is only a geometric requirement; fractures, grout quality and anchor interaction limit usable bond length, and the free length is not an effective bond zone. If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity. A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bond beyond the moving zone” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩定區錨固長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bond beyond the moving zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穩定區錨固長度
knowledge.text: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。實際黏結長度仍受裂隙、灌漿品質與鄰近錨索互制限制，自由段不得誤算成有效固定段。
knowledge.textEn: The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. Crossing the plane is only a geometric requirement; fractures, grout quality and anchor interaction limit usable bond length, and the free length is not an effective bond zone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩定區錨固長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bond beyond the moving zone" is correct?
options: 只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。
optionsEn: A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction.
quiz.explanation: 固定段必須進入可承受反力的岩體，穿過滑面只是第一個幾何條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bond zone must enter rock capable of providing reaction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穩定區錨固長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bond beyond the moving zone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m. This is available geometry, not demonstrated bond capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿錨孔量得總長18m、至不穩定區末端12m，候選穩定區長度18−12=6m；這6m只是可供檢核的長度，不是已證明的黏結容量。
只要位移量測投影符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要錨索長期損失符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If total bore length is18m and the moving zone ends at12m along that bore, the candidate stable-zone length is18−12=6m.
A nominal result for displacement measurement projection removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for long term anchor loss removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穩定區錨固長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bond beyond the moving zone” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。發現新滑面時必須重新定位固定段，而非延用原圖。同時排除以下干擾原因：固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum. Representative tests must examine load, movement and time effects; a newly identified sliding plane requires relocating the bond zone rather than relying on old drawings. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接穩定區錨固長度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。發現新滑面時必須重新定位固定段，而非延用原圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over bond beyond the moving zone, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum. Representative tests must examine load, movement and time effects; a newly identified sliding plane requires relocating the bond zone rather than relying on old drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穩定區錨固長度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bond beyond the moving zone"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
對照定向鑽探與灌漿紀錄檢查固定段所在岩層，並以代表性試驗核對荷載、位移及時間效應。
只要孔壓扣除法向力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

Reconcile oriented bore logs and grouting records with the proposed bond stratum.
A nominal result for pore pressure and normal force removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

steps.title: 穩定區錨固長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bond beyond the moving zone: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穩定區錨固長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bond beyond the moving zone” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A short-term satisfactory load test does not demonstrate a dependable reaction beyond the deep failure surface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要穩定區錨固長度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for bond beyond the moving zone removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「穩定區錨固長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
固定段若仍位於可移動岩塊中，錨索只是把不穩定塊體互相拉住；表面荷載試驗短期正常也不能證明深部滑面已有可靠反力來源。

A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself.

quiz.explanationEn: A bond zone inside the moving block merely connects unstable rock to itself. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 落石位能尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rockfall energy scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落石位能尺度」如何影響岩石邊坡錨固與監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rockfall energy scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-slope anchoring and monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 邊坡錨固與落石防護處理不同機制，不能用整體抗滑通過取代局部塊石控制。位能估算只描述能量來源，碰撞角度、轉動、彈跳及攔截距離決定防護系統需求。岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。把位能直接除以任意短距離作為合格衝擊力，會忽略系統變形與局部穿透；攔網即使標稱能量足夠，位置不對仍可能被彈跳越過。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落石位能尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Anchoring and rockfall protection address different mechanisms. Passing a global sliding check does not control local blocks. Potential energy describes only the energy source; impact angle, rotation, rebound and interception distance determine protective-system demand. For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ. The estimate omits energy loss along the path and does not give peak impact force. Dividing energy by an arbitrary short distance ignores deformation and local penetration. Even a nominally adequate barrier can be bypassed by a rebound if its location is unsuitable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rockfall energy scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：岩塊質量m=1000kg、落差h=20m，Ep=mgh=1000×9.81×20=196200J=196.2kJ；未扣除沿途能量損失，也未算衝擊峰值力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=1000kg and drop h=20m, Ep=mgh=196200J=196.2kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要落石位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for rockfall energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「落石位能尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rockfall energy scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
