quiz.explanationEn: Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期模數折減：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期模數折減」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long term modulus reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期模數折減」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for bypass storage demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50.
A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 長期模數折減：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期模數折減」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long term modulus reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接長期模數折減時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over long term modulus reduction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。同時排除以下干擾原因：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Material and design engineers must reassess any environment outside the evidence range. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接長期模數折減時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查長期試驗溫度、載入方式與外推期間是否涵蓋使用情境，並保存原始曲線及批次識別。若使用環境超出試驗範圍，須由材料與設計工程師重新評估。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over long term modulus reduction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. quiz.question: 要驗證「長期模數折減」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long term modulus reduction"?

quiz.explanationEn: Check whether test temperature, loading mode and extrapolated duration cover service conditions, retaining curves and batch identities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期模數折減：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long term modulus reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期模數折減」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long term modulus reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.titleEn: Hydraulic capacity comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水理容量比較」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic capacity comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。滿流圓管的曼寧比值只適用坡度相同且均勻流，局部瓶頸、支管及淤積會使實際系統不同。固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水理容量比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter. A full circular-pipe Manning ratio assumes equal slope and uniform flow; bottlenecks, laterals and deposits can make system behaviour different. For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35. Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic capacity comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水理容量比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic capacity comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水理容量比較
knowledge.text: 內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。滿流圓管的曼寧比值只適用坡度相同且均勻流，局部瓶頸、支管及淤積會使實際系統不同。
knowledge.textEn: Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter. A full circular-pipe Manning ratio assumes equal slope and uniform flow; bottlenecks, laterals and deposits can make system behaviour different.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水理容量比較」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic capacity comparison" is correct?
options: 只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。
只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter.
A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水理容量比較：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic capacity comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水理容量比較」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic capacity comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水理容量比較」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic capacity comparison", which statement holds?
options: 只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要理想薄環屈曲符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)。
optionsEn: A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for ideal thin ring buckling removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3).
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水理容量比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic capacity comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水理容量比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic capacity comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。不能把理想容量增加直接宣稱為暴雨排水保證，還需檢查下游控制及入流。同時排除以下干擾原因：粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. An ideal capacity increase is not a storm-drainage guarantee; downstream controls and inflow also require review. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接水理容量比較時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。不能把理想容量增加直接宣稱為暴雨排水保證，還需檢查下游控制及入流。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over hydraulic capacity comparison, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. An ideal capacity increase is not a storm-drainage guarantee; downstream controls and inflow also require review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。不能把理想容量增加直接宣稱為暴雨排水保證，還需檢查下游控制及入流。同時排除以下干擾原因：粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。
knowledge.textEn: Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. An ideal capacity increase is not a storm-drainage guarantee; downstream controls and inflow also require review. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接水理容量比較時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。不能把理想容量增加直接宣稱為暴雨排水保證，還需檢查下游控制及入流。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over hydraulic capacity comparison, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. An ideal capacity increase is not a storm-drainage guarantee; downstream controls and inflow also require review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水理容量比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic capacity comparison"?
options: 比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要厚度立方敏感度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for cubic thickness sensitivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 比較清理前後實際斷面、縱坡與阻塞位置，以合適流量資料檢查系統水位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare actual sections, slope and obstructions before and after cleaning, using appropriate flow data to check levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水理容量比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic capacity comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水理容量比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic capacity comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。
knowledge.textEn: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水理容量比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic capacity comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。
只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow.
A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支管開口幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral opening geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支管開口幾何」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral opening geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重新開通支管必須辨識真實接入口，切除內襯的範圍同時關係水流、密封與剩餘結構。面積只是幾何量，接頭邊緣缺口及未密封環隙仍需獨立檢核。假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支管開口幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restoring laterals requires identifying the actual connection. Removing liner affects flow, sealing and remaining structure. Area is only a geometric quantity; edge notches and an unsealed annular gap require independent evaluation. For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area. A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral opening geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要支管開口幾何符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for lateral opening geometry removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 支管開口幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral opening geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支管開口幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral opening geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 支管開口幾何：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral opening geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支管開口幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral opening geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。任何開口修整由合格施工與檢驗人員按核准方法執行，避免依影像猜測盲切。同時排除以下干擾原因：錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral. Qualified personnel follow approved restoration and inspection methods rather than blindly cutting from an uncertain image. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接支管開口幾何時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照施工前支管位置與施工後影像，記錄每個接頭的邊緣、密封及可見缺陷。任何開口修整由合格施工與檢驗人員按核准方法執行，避免依影像猜測盲切。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over lateral opening geometry, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile prelining connection locations with postlining images, recording edges, seals and defects for every lateral. Qualified personnel follow approved restoration and inspection methods rather than blindly cutting from an uncertain image.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 支管開口幾何：失效診斷

steps.title: 旁通儲量需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bypass storage demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旁通儲量需求」如何影響管道原位固化內襯的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bypass storage demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cured-in-place pipe lining”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工期間旁通系統需要面對持續入流與設備中斷，儲量與抽送能力不能互相替代。簡單累積量適合辨識停機後果，實際應變仍受尖峰流量、上游容積及允許水位控制。假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旁通儲量需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary bypassing must handle continuing inflow and equipment interruptions. Storage and pumping capacity are not interchangeable. A simple accumulation estimate illustrates outage consequences, while peak flow, upstream volume and permitted levels govern the response plan. For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³. This is accumulated demand, not an allowable shutdown or evacuation time. Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bypass storage demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 由歷史與當期流量建立尖峰情境，核對可用儲量、備援、警報與回應程序。任何切換或隔離須依業主核准方案，並確認排放路徑與周邊環境限制。同時排除以下干擾原因：將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 材料批次可追溯性：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 內襯交接應連結樹脂批次、施工記錄、取樣位置與試驗結果，讓後續缺陷能回溯到特定區段。可追溯比例只是文件完整性，不能代替材料與水理驗收。假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料批次可追溯性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handover links resin batches, process records, sample positions and test results so later defects can be traced to a specific segment. A traceability fraction measures documentation completeness, not material or hydraulic acceptance. If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements. Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material batch traceability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料批次可追溯性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.observation: 如何核對：隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「材料批次可追溯性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material batch traceability", which statement holds?
options: 只要內壓環向應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要固化反應證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。
optionsEn: A nominal result for internal pressure hoop stress removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for evidence of cure reaction removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 材料批次可追溯性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material batch traceability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料批次可追溯性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Material batch traceability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。同時排除以下干擾原因：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接材料批次可追溯性時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over material batch traceability, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。同時排除以下干擾原因：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。
knowledge.textEn: Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接材料批次可追溯性時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。缺失資料列入交接責任表，主管工程師決定需要補驗的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over material batch traceability, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Assign missing evidence in the handover record and have the engineer determine necessary supplementary verification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「材料批次可追溯性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Material batch traceability"?
options: 隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要水理容量比較符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A nominal result for hydraulic capacity comparison removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 隨機選取管段從竣工圖回查批次、固化曲線、試片及驗收簽認，再反向由試片找到位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Select segments and trace from as-built drawings to batches, cure curves, samples and approvals, then trace samples back to locations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 材料批次可追溯性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Material batch traceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「材料批次可追溯性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Material batch traceability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要材料批次可追溯性符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for material batch traceability removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。
knowledge.textEn: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料批次可追溯性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Material batch traceability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。
只要剩餘厚度判讀符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch.
A nominal result for remaining thickness interpretation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 地下結構陰極防蝕
courses.summary: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
courses.focus: 辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈
courses.focusEn: Distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。假設有效電壓由2V增加10%至2.2V且R固定10Ω，電流由0.20升為0.22A，增加0.02A；現地極化、含水與接觸阻抗可能改變R，故不能據此授權提高電源設定。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. Increasing assumed effective voltage from2V to2.2V by10% at fixed R=10Ω raises current from0.20 to0.22A, a0.02A increase. Field polarization, moisture and contact impedance may alter R, so this does not authorize changing supply settings. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。
教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設直流輸出V=12V、I=3A，P=VI=36W；這是輸出端電功率，不含整流器效率或交流輸入功率因數。
教學假設，非現場設定值：若量測路徑電流I=0.20A、等效土壤路徑R=2Ω，IRdrop=0.40V；此項不是金屬極化電位，也不是可通用扣除的常數。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With M=20kg, Ceff=780Ah/kg already including electrochemical efficiency, material utilization u=0.85 and I=0.20A, L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For DC output V=12V and I=3A, P=VI=36W. This is terminal output power, excluding rectifier efficiency and AC input power factor.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For path current I=0.20A and equivalent soil-path R=2Ω, IRdrop=0.40V. This is not metal polarization potential or a universally removable constant.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合電流迴路」與「塗層缺陷電流需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closed current circuit" and "Current demand at coating defects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合電流迴路」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closed current circuit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。歐姆模型只說明等效迴路，電極極化與接觸阻抗會使現場偏離常數電阻。假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合電流迴路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. Supply voltage alone does not establish current reaching the protected metal. An Ohmic model describes an equivalent circuit; polarization and contact impedance can make field resistance variable. For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closed current circuit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合電流迴路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closed current circuit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. Supply voltage alone does not establish current reaching the protected metal.

quiz.question: 關於「閉合電流迴路」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closed current circuit" is correct?
options: 只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。
只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit.
A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 陰極防蝕需要金屬連接與電解質路徑共同閉合，電源有電壓不代表被保護金屬收到所需電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cathodic protection needs both metallic and electrolyte paths to close the circuit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合電流迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closed current circuit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設有效驅動電壓V=2V、等效電阻R=10Ω，I=V/R=0.20A；R在此工況固定，不能當不同土壤或時間的通用值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A. Resistance is fixed for this scenario, not universal across soil or time.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閉合電流迴路」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

只要電阻壓降與極化符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

optionsEn: A nominal result for sacrificial anode life removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for ohmic drop and polarization removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For effective driving voltage V=2V and equivalent R=10Ω, I=V/R=0.20A.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合電流迴路」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closed current circuit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。同時排除以下干擾原因：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接閉合電流迴路時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over closed current circuit, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。同時排除以下干擾原因：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接閉合電流迴路時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。確認測試不改變相鄰設施的保護狀態，操作由合格防蝕人員執行。

Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Qualified corrosion personnel must verify that testing does not compromise neighbouring protection systems.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閉合電流迴路」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closed current circuit"?
options: 以經校正的電流量測與接線圖核對迴路連續性，分別記錄電源輸出、測點電位及環境條件。

quiz.explanationEn: Check continuity against wiring diagrams and calibrated current measurements, recording output, test-point potential and environmental conditions separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 閉合電流迴路：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closed current circuit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合電流迴路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closed current circuit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short or broken connection can show plausible supply output while diverting current. Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance based only on voltage can leave local metal corroding without timely detection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要閉合電流迴路符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for closed current circuit removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。

quiz.question: 在「閉合電流迴路」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

接地短路或斷線可讓儀表顯示合理輸出卻把電流送往錯誤路徑；若只看電源電壓就判定合格，局部金屬可能持續腐蝕而沒有及時被發現。

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「塗層缺陷電流需求」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Current demand at coating defects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整塗層減少與土壤接觸的面積，保護電流主要流向缺陷及裸露部位。缺陷面積比例與所需電流密度均需有證據，不能只用總金屬面積推估相同的需求。假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「塗層缺陷電流需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces. Both defect fraction and required current density need evidence rather than assuming identical demand over the entire metal surface. For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded. Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Current demand at coating defects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求
knowledge.text: 完整塗層減少與土壤接觸的面積，保護電流主要流向缺陷及裸露部位。缺陷面積比例與所需電流密度均需有證據，不能只用總金屬面積推估相同的需求。

quiz.question: 關於「塗層缺陷電流需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces.

quiz.explanationEn: Sound coating reduces soil-exposed area, concentrating protection current at holidays and bare surfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塗層缺陷電流需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Current demand at coating defects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For bare-surface density i=0.02A/m², total A=1000m² and dimensionless defect fraction fd=0.01, I=iAfd=0.20A. Shielding and uneven distribution are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設裸露電流密度i=0.02A/m²、總面積A=1000m²、缺陷比例fd=0.01無因次，I=iAfd=0.20A；未考慮屏蔽及電流不均。

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塗層缺陷電流需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current demand at coating defects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。用多測點電位判斷分布，電流總量相符不能代替每個控制位置的驗證。同時排除以下干擾原因：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Multiple potential readings establish distribution; matching total current does not verify every controlling location. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over current demand at coating defects, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Multiple potential readings establish distribution; matching total current does not verify every controlling location.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

quiz.question: 要驗證「塗層缺陷電流需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current demand at coating defects"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對塗層檢查、施工損傷與接頭修補紀錄，將估計缺陷面積和現地電流需求比較。
只要需求變化趨勢符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand.
A nominal result for current demand trend removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Review coating inspections, installation damage and joint repairs, comparing estimated defect area with measured demand. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塗層缺陷電流需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current demand at coating defects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塗層缺陷電流需求」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current demand at coating defects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要塗層缺陷電流需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for current demand at coating defects removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output. Treating increased current as automatically beneficial may overpolarize other regions and damage coating without protecting the shielded area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塗層缺陷電流需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current demand at coating defects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要土壤視電阻率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Disbonded coating can shield underlying metal despite higher total output.
quiz.explanation: 剝離但未脫落的塗層可屏蔽電流，增加總輸出也未必保護其下金屬；若把較大電流當絕對改善，可能同時造成其他區域過度極化與塗層損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「土壤視電阻率」與「犧牲陽極壽命」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Apparent soil resistivity" and "Sacrificial anode life": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 土壤視電阻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Apparent soil resistivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「土壤視電阻率」如何影響地下結構陰極防蝕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Apparent soil resistivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cathodic protection of underground structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土壤電阻率影響電流分布，但與含水、鹽分及分層共同變化，單一數字不能直接換成腐蝕速率。Wenner模型需均質半空間與等間距，測得結果應依幾何稱為視電阻率。等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。地下管線或接地網可改變電流路徑，使視電阻率偏離原狀土壤；若直接用此值決定陽極配置，可能形成不均勻保護而且難以解釋後續量測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「土壤視電阻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Soil resistivity influences current distribution but varies with moisture, salts and layering, so one value is not a corrosion rate. The Wenner model assumes a homogeneous half-space and equal spacing; field results are apparent resistivity for the measurement geometry. For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction. Buried pipes or grounding grids can distort current paths and apparent resistivity. Designing anode distribution directly from that value may create uneven protection and confusing later measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Apparent soil resistivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要土壤視電阻率符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for apparent soil resistivity removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 土壤視電阻率
knowledge.text: 土壤電阻率影響電流分布，但與含水、鹽分及分層共同變化，單一數字不能直接換成腐蝕速率。Wenner模型需均質半空間與等間距，測得結果應依幾何稱為視電阻率。
knowledge.textEn: Soil resistivity influences current distribution but varies with moisture, salts and layering, so one value is not a corrosion rate. The Wenner model assumes a homogeneous half-space and equal spacing; field results are apparent resistivity for the measurement geometry.

steps.title: 土壤視電阻率：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：等間距a=1m、量得V/I=R=20Ω且電極埋深遠小於a時，ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m；分層或深埋電極需要修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For spacing a=1m, measured V/I=R=20Ω and electrode depth much smaller than a, ρa=2πaR=125.7Ω·m. Layering or deep electrodes requires correction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 使用合適電阻率儀器記錄間距、埋深、地表狀態及附近金屬，改變方向與尺度檢查一致性。若差異顯著，應用分層解釋與補充調查而非挑最有利讀值。同時排除以下干擾原因：地下管線或接地網可改變電流路徑，使視電阻率偏離原狀土壤；若直接用此值決定陽極配置，可能形成不均勻保護而且難以解釋後續量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record spacing, electrode depth, surface conditions and nearby metal using suitable instrumentation. steps.instruction: 犧牲陽極可提供的總電量受材料質量與有效電容量限制，還要保留不能完全利用的殘餘部分。有效電容量若已包含電化學效率，不可再次乘同一效率而重複折減。假設M=20kg、Ceff=780Ah/kg已含電化學效率、材料利用率u=0.85、I=0.20A，L=MCeffu/(I×8760h/year)=7.57years。若塗層老化增加需求或陽極連接失效，名義質量仍存在卻無法提供預期保護；只按日曆年限巡檢，會漏掉電流分配或消耗加速的異常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「犧牲陽極壽命」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
