history.title: 挪威里菲爾克隧道
history.text: 2019 年公開記錄：里菲爾克隧道於12月30日開放通車。挪威公路管理局2019年開通紀錄列里菲爾克隧道14.4公里、最低點在海面下292公尺。本課把幾何深度與測壓水頭分開，再研究裂隙封水、支護、低點集水、供電、坡道行車與跨孔撤離；不把海面下深度直接當成所有岩體孔壓或襯砌設計壓力。本課把「深海低點、水壓與抽排韌性」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。
history.textEn: Public record for 2019: Ryfylke Tunnel opens to traffic on 30 December. The Norwegian road authority records Ryfylke opening in 2019, at 14.4 km with a low point 292 m below sea level. This course distinguishes geometric depth from piezometric head, then examines fracture sealing, support, low-point drainage, power, road gradients and cross-bore evacuation without treating depth as universal pore or lining pressure. The course treats deep subsea low point, water pressure and drainage resilience as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.

history.title: 首都圈外郭放水路
history.titleEn: Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel
history.text: 2002 年公開記錄：第3立坑至泵站3.3公里區間於6月先行運用。首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。本課把「洪水調蓄、跌水豎井與水位控制」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。
history.textEn: Public record for 2002: The 3.3 km reach from shaft 3 to the pumping station begins interim use in June. The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing. The course treats flood storage, drop shafts and level control as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 新加坡裕廊岩洞
history.text: 2014 年公開記錄：裕廊岩洞儲存設施於9月正式開幕。JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。本課把「岩洞楔體、水力封存與產品庫存」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。
history.textEn: Public record for 2014: Jurong Rock Caverns storage facility officially opens in September. JTC describes 1.47 million cubic metres of liquid-hydrocarbon storage and distinguishes depth below ground from depth beneath the seabed; the PMO records the 2014 opening. The course moves from land interfaces and jointed rock to support, hydraulic containment, inventory and monitoring. Geometric area, local pressure difference and hypothetical inventory are not actual land savings or operating limits. The course treats cavern wedges, hydraulic containment and product inventory as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道超前探測鑽孔
history.titleEn: Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 孔內電視與裂隙判釋
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.

history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.

history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.

history.text: 國際隧協以反力作用於岩壁或已組襯砌來區分雙護盾的工作路徑，海瑞克公開產品摘要則說明前後盾與伸縮構造。二〇〇九年美國公路隧道手冊提供土建背景，二〇一四年Stepney Green論文可作不同支護序列的對照，二〇一六年營運的聖哥達基線隧道提供深埋岩體環境背景。此處未聲稱這些案例均採雙護盾，學習重點是反力路徑如何改變檢查責任。
history.textEn: ITA distinguishes double-shield reaction through rock walls or installed lining, while the public Herrenknecht summary identifies the shield and telescopic arrangement. The 2009 FHWA manual provides civil-engineering context. The 2014 Stepney Green paper supplies a contrasting support sequence, and Gotthard entering operation in 2016 provides a deep-rock setting. These examples are not all presented as double-shield projects. The historical comparison asks how a changed reaction path changes the evidence and responsibility needed for approval.

history.text: 國際隧協以切削與重新撐緊兩階段解釋撐靴掘進，公開設備介紹則呈現硬岩機型與支護工作的介面。二〇〇九年公路隧道手冊提供系統性土建背景；二〇一四年的Stepney Green案例提醒學員，軟土分部襯砌的力流不能直接套在硬岩裸露頂拱。聖哥達基線隧道二〇一六年營運提供長隧道環境對照，本課不把其實際設備配置推廣為所有敞開機的共同細節。
history.textEn: ITA explains gripper advance through cutting and regripping phases, while public equipment descriptions identify hard-rock machines and their support interfaces. The 2009 road-tunnel manual supplies broader civil context. Stepney Green’s 2014 case is a contrast: soft-ground sequential lining behavior cannot simply be transferred to an exposed rock crown. Gotthard entering operation in 2016 supplies a long-tunnel setting, without turning that project’s equipment arrangements into universal details for every open machine.

history.title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
history.text: Crossrail的公開論文把噴凝土襯砌與地層互制及施工序列放在同一設計問題中，並回顧一九九二年Heathrow Express試驗隧道的軟土地下施工。二〇〇九年FHWA土建手冊提供另一套工程背景，二〇一四年公開的Stepney Green論文呈現側導坑序列與量測比較。這些文獻並不支持把某個縮短步距或增加厚度當成萬用解法；本課追蹤的是每一次邊界改變如何影響可觀測的力流。
history.textEn: Crossrail authors treat sprayed lining, ground interaction and construction sequence as one design problem, and discuss the 1992 Heathrow Express soft-ground trial tunnel. The 2009 FHWA civil manual provides another engineering reference, while the 2014 Stepney Green paper presents side-drift sequencing with monitoring comparisons. None makes a shorter advance or thicker lining a universal solution. This course instead follows how each changed boundary alters the load path and the observations needed to test it.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道台階法施工
history.text: 台階並不只是一種出碴方便的幾何安排，而是讓支護在不同時間和支承條件下工作的施工系統。Crossrail二〇一四年公開的設計論文回顧一九九二年Heathrow Express試驗隧道，Stepney Green原作者資料則展示上半斷面、台階和仰拱的分割背景。二〇〇九年FHWA手冊提供土建方法參照。本課使用這些公開脈絡比較施工邊界，並未把任何案例的實際尺寸或開挖許可移植給學員。
history.textEn: A bench is more than a convenient shape for muck removal; it is a system in which support operates at changing times and boundary conditions. Crossrail’s 2014 design paper reviews the 1992 Heathrow Express trial, while the Stepney Green authors describe upper, bench and invert subdivisions. The 2009 FHWA manual provides civil-method context. These public examples frame comparisons of construction boundaries; no actual project dimensions or excavation permissions are transferred to learners.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法
history.text: Stepney Green原作者在二〇一四年公開側壁導坑與襯砌表現的研究，可用來辨識暫時構件如何改變大型地下斷面的分析。另一篇Crossrail設計論文回顧一九九二年Heathrow Express試驗背景，二〇〇九年FHWA手冊則提供土建參考。這些資料顯示施工序列需與地層互制一起考慮；本課特別把側導坑形成期間、中央區開挖與中隔牆移除視為不同結構狀態，不把完工模型倒套所有階段。
history.textEn: The Stepney Green authors published their side-drift and lining-performance study in 2014, providing a context for how temporary members change large-section analysis. A companion Crossrail paper reviews the 1992 Heathrow Express trial, and the 2009 FHWA manual supplies civil context. These references place construction sequence alongside ground interaction. This course treats side-drift formation, central excavation and wall removal as distinct structural states instead of applying the completed-system model retrospectively to every stage.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護
history.text: 本課討論的以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.text: 本課討論的以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.text: 本課討論的辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架
history.text: 本課討論的把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context

history.text: 本課討論的用縱向跨距、搭接與鑽孔幾何檢核管棚超前支護，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on check pipe umbrellas through longitudinal spans, overlap and bore geometry reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿
history.text: 本課討論的以掌子面擠出、玻纖筋黏結與開挖保留長度控制面補強，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on control face reinforcement through extrusion, fibre-bar bond and retained length reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. history.text: 本課討論的區分膨脹礦物、水源與受限變形的隧道設計，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工
history.text: 本課討論的整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。大開挖公開資料列有明挖、沉管與頂進；帕丁頓專案團隊則說明永久樓板支撐連續壁的逆打選擇理由，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Big Dig public information lists cut-and-cover, immersed and jacked works; the Paddington project team explains choosing top-down construction with permanent slabs bracing diaphragm walls. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 逆打工法地下結構
history.text: 本課討論的追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。大開挖公開資料列有明挖、沉管與頂進；帕丁頓專案團隊則說明永久樓板支撐連續壁的逆打選擇理由，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Big Dig public information lists cut-and-cover, immersed and jacked works; the Paddington project team explains choosing top-down construction with permanent slabs bracing diaphragm walls. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 箱涵頂進施工
history.text: 本課討論的箱涵頂進的力鏈、地層損失與營運界面，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。矩形箱涵需按框架與施工階段分析；簡支條帶、摩擦與體積模型只分離個別機制，不代替完整設計。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，PJA 資料提供管列荷載與公差的閱讀脈絡；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on box-jacking load paths, ground loss and operating interfaces reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Rectangular boxes require frame and construction-stage analysis; simple strips, friction and volume models isolate mechanisms rather than constitute a complete design. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling; PJA provides reading context for pipe loads and tolerances. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.text: 本課討論的頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，PJA 資料提供管列荷載與公差的閱讀脈絡；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。

history.text: 本課討論的定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，並說明導向感測與磁場干擾；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling and describes guidance sensing and magnetic interference. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 豎井沉井施工
history.text: 本課討論的沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。Heathwall 2013 規劃提出沉井後轉托換，並非竣工證明；Cremorne 2020 紀錄採樁加噴凝土，特列為非沉井對照，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. The Heathwall 2013 proposal combines caisson sinking and underpinning and is not as-built evidence. The Cremorne 2020 account describes piles plus sprayed lining and is expressly a non-caisson comparison. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 深豎井襯砌施工
history.text: 深豎井襯砌同時受到地層卸載、地下水、施工分段與長期材料變形影響。本課從有效應力及環向受壓開始，逐步區分厚壁分析、垂直承載、止水細部及背填空隙造成的彎曲，最後建立水位回復與裂縫變化的交接證據。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1997年：美國陸軍工兵署發布岩石隧道與豎井工程手冊，建立公開工程參考；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2018年：香港發布岩洞工程指南第二版，整理岩洞規劃設計及施工實務。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Deep-shaft linings respond to ground unloading, groundwater, construction lifts and long-term material deformation. The course separates effective stress and ring compression from thick-wall analysis, vertical load transfer, waterstop behaviour and bending over backfill voids, then builds evidence for groundwater recovery and crack monitoring. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1997: USACE publishes its rock-tunnel and shaft manual as a public engineering reference; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2018: CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井
history.text: 大直徑豎井的進度由完整作業循環決定，不能只看切削機額定功率。本課把幾何開挖量、切削能、提升循環、工作盤反力與通風排水聯成系統，利用量測分辨設備瓶頸與地層限制，並以故障停機及永久襯砌介面建立可追溯的施工交接。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2026年：本教材核對公開來源及其技術適用範圍，日期不是工程完工年份。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Large-shaft progress depends on the complete operating cycle rather than rated cutting power. The course links excavation volume, cutting energy, hoisting cycles, working-platform reactions, ventilation and drainage, uses measurements to separate equipment bottlenecks from ground constraints, and develops traceable handover through downtime and permanent-lining interfaces. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2026: This curriculum verifies public sources and technical scope; this is not a project completion date. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地下岩洞穹頂支護
history.text: 大跨度岩洞的穩定同時受到節理幾何、開挖卸載、支護剛度及三維交叉口影響。本課分開討論可脫落楔塊與整體岩體拱效應，讓學徒用力學模型、應變監測及反算辨別真正的荷載路徑，再檢查地震與排水退化如何改變既有支護的需求。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1997年：美國陸軍工兵署發布岩石隧道與豎井工程手冊，建立公開工程參考；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2018年：香港發布岩洞工程指南第二版，整理岩洞規劃設計及施工實務。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Large-span cavern stability depends on joints, excavation unloading, support stiffness and three-dimensional intersections. This course distinguishes detachable wedges from rock-mass arching, uses force models, strain monitoring and back-analysis to identify load paths, and evaluates how seismic action and drainage deterioration change support demand. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1997: USACE publishes its rock-tunnel and shaft manual as a public engineering reference; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2018: CEDD publishes the second cavern-engineering guide covering planning, design and construction. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 交叉隧道人工地盤凍結
history.text: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2016年：Crossrail發布聯絡通道工法與地質資料，明確說明所列通道未採凍結；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Artificial ground freezing temporarily strengthens ground and restricts seepage through cooling and phase change, while introducing thermal, heave and thaw-deformation concerns. The course separately examines pipe geometry, advective heat, creep and cooling reserves, then builds evidence and hold points for transferring support from frozen soil to the permanent lining. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2016: Crossrail publishes its passage-method dataset, explicitly identifying nonuse of freezing in the listed passages; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 連續壁槽溝穩定
history.text: 連續壁成槽時，穩定液必須與地下水、土層滲透性及地面載重共同維持槽壁穩定。本課從壓差與濾餅機理出發，連結槽段幾何、垂直度、沉渣與鋼筋籠浮力，再用混凝土量平衡與接頭水力坡降建立施工品質及鄰房變形的驗證鏈。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: During diaphragm-wall excavation, support fluid interacts with groundwater, permeability and surface loading to maintain trench stability. The course connects pressure balance and filter cake to panel geometry, verticality, sediment and cage buoyancy, then uses concrete-volume balance and joint hydraulic gradients to verify construction quality and adjacent-asset movement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 咬合樁止水壁施工
history.text: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐
history.text: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1994年：美國陸軍工兵署發布鋼板樁牆設計手冊，涵蓋土體結構互制；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1994: USACE publishes its sheet-pile wall manual including soil-structure interaction; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
history.text: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.titleEn: Verification of ground-anchor free and bond lengths
history.text: 地錨試驗的位移同時包含自由段伸長、錨碇段變形與座頭滑移，不能由單一荷重或總位移推定錨固品質。本課把穩定錨碇區、拉力分量、潛變、腐蝕與群體作用逐一拆開，最後以座入損失及完整試驗證據確認地錨的長期功能。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Anchor-test movement combines free-length extension, bond-zone deformation and head slip, so one load or displacement does not establish anchorage quality. The course separates stable anchorage, force components, creep, corrosion and group action, then uses seating losses and complete test evidence to assess long-term anchor function. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 微型樁托底補強
history.text: 微型樁托底的關鍵不只是把樁打到深處，而是建立既有柱、承台、連接件與地層之間可驗證的新力流。本課逐步檢查鋼材與黏結承載、預載移交、樁群剛度、無側限段挫屈與低淨高接頭，最後用長期沉陷判讀新舊基礎是否確實共同工作。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2005年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布微型樁設計施工參考手冊，整合檢驗與載重試驗；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Micropile underpinning requires a verified new load path from existing columns through caps and connectors into ground. The course examines steel and bond resistance, preloaded transfer, group stiffness, buckling in unsupported zones and low-headroom joints, then interprets long-term settlement to establish interaction between old and new foundations. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2005: FHWA publishes the micropile design and construction reference including inspection and load testing; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良
history.text: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
history.text: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.title: 補償灌漿沉陷控制
history.text: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地盤壓密灌漿
history.text: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.titleEn: Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains
history.text: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定的背景。寶珊於一九八〇年代設置水平排水改善水位（1980s）。美國聯邦公路管理局出版地錨系統手冊（1999）。香港場地勘察指南列出更新版本（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums. Horizontal drainage is installed at Po Shan during the1980s (1980s). FHWA publishes its ground-anchor systems manual (1999). Hong Kong lists an updated site-investigation guide (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.

related.title: 英法海底隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「破碎帶連通與預報更新」與「控制網與貫通誤差」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；英法海底隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" and "Control network and breakthrough error" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Channel Tunnel must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦破碎帶水壓、長距離探勘與雙孔道路防災；英法海底隧道則以主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fault-zone water pressure, long-distance investigation and twin-bore road resilience; Channel Tunnel centres on running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「破碎帶連通性」與「測壓水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到英法海底隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疏散時間與分區可用性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fault-zone connectivity” and “Piezometric head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Channel Tunnel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Evacuation time and zone availability", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 哥達基線隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「破碎帶連通與預報更新」與「控制網與貫通誤差」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；哥達基線隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" and "Control network and breakthrough error" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Gotthard Base Tunnel must be respecified.

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「破碎帶連通性」與「坡度阻力功率」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到哥達基線隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fault-zone connectivity” and “Grade-resistance power”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Gotthard Base Tunnel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Control network and breakthrough error", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 英法海底隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「服務邊界與路線代價」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；英法海底隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Ring force and joint flexibility" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Channel Tunnel must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦高山入口、雙向交通與雙控制室協調；英法海底隧道則以主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on alpine portals, bidirectional traffic and control-room coordination; Channel Tunnel centres on running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「路線里程與端點」與「測壓水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到英法海底隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疏散時間與分區可用性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and “Piezometric head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Channel Tunnel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Evacuation time and zone availability", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 哥達基線隧道

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and “Grade-resistance power”.

related.title: 英法海底隧道
related.transfer: 可遷移「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；英法海底隧道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Ring force and joint flexibility" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Channel Tunnel must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦洪水調蓄、跌水豎井與水位控制；英法海底隧道則以主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on flood storage, drop shafts and level control; Channel Tunnel centres on running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水體平流時間」與「測壓水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到英法海底隧道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疏散時間與分區可用性」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Water advection time” and “Piezometric head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Channel Tunnel, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Evacuation time and zone availability", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 哥達基線隧道

related.title: 隧道震波地質探測

related.difference: 本課聚焦以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型；隧道震波地質探測則以分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence; Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation centres on distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「探測目標與盲區」與「阻抗反差與反射」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Targets and blind zones” and “Impedance contrast and reflection”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Velocity and elastic assumptions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 潛盾機刀具磨耗管理
related.transfer: 可遷移「全環與局部荷載」與「推進千斤頂局部承壓」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ring and local load cases" and "Local jack bearing" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of TBM cutter-wear management must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈；潛盾機刀具磨耗管理則以以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads; TBM cutter-wear management centres on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「全環與局部荷載」與「刀具半徑與行程」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到潛盾機刀具磨耗管理，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「衝擊與混合面循環」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ring and local load cases” and “Cutter radius and travel”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to TBM cutter-wear management, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Impact and mixed-face cycling", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 潛盾掘進導向控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「伸縮行程與循環約束」與「姿態差與推力偏心」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；潛盾掘進導向控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" and "Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of TBM alignment guidance and control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度；潛盾掘進導向控制則以把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability; TBM alignment guidance and control centres on link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「伸縮行程與循環約束」與「控制網與坐標基準」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到潛盾掘進導向控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” and “Control networks and coordinate datum”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to TBM alignment guidance and control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Relative machine-ring clearance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
related.transfer: 可遷移「上半斷面與反力位置」與「閉合追趕與相對速度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道分部開挖與支撐的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Upper section and reaction locations" and "Closure catch-up and relative speed" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sequential excavation and support must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦台階開挖的拱腳承載、核心保留與仰拱閉合時序；隧道分部開挖與支撐則以分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bench excavation, arch-foot bearing, retained core and invert-closure timing; Sequential excavation and support centres on ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上半斷面與反力位置」與「地層支護曲線交點」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道分部開挖與支撐，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「收斂曲線與外推界線」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Upper section and reaction locations” and “Ground-support curve intersection”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sequential excavation and support, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法
related.transfer: 可遷移「上半斷面與反力位置」與「閉合追趕與相對速度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Upper section and reaction locations" and "Closure catch-up and relative speed" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Side-drift excavation for large tunnels must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦台階開挖的拱腳承載、核心保留與仰拱閉合時序；大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法則以雙側導坑的暫時中隔牆、非對稱受力與拆除荷載轉移為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bench excavation, arch-foot bearing, retained core and invert-closure timing; Side-drift excavation for large tunnels centres on temporary walls, asymmetry and removal load transfer in side-drift excavation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上半斷面與反力位置」與「分割跨度與梁式比較」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「共同基準與相關誤差」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Upper section and reaction locations” and “Subdivided span and beam comparison”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Side-drift excavation for large tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Shared reference and correlated uncertainty", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「芯樣方向與強度換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell action and rock contact" and "Core orientation and strength interpretation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護；纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗則以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness; Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing centres on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「荷重位移同步與零點」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shell action and rock contact” and “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Force-displacement synchronization and zero", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「芯樣方向與強度換算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shell action and rock contact" and "Core orientation and strength interpretation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證則以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness; Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification centres on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道岩栓拉拔驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「持載位移與時間效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Shell action and rock contact” and “Wedge weight and bolt direction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hold movement and time effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運
related.transfer: 可遷移「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；沉管隧道預製與浮運的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Permanent slabs as early braces" and "Groundwater unloading and ground rebound" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載；沉管隧道預製與浮運則以整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls; Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation centres on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「預製體積與結構質量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到沉管隧道預製與浮運，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「預製溫度與節段變形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Permanent slabs as early braces” and “Fabrication volume and structural mass”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fabrication temperature and segment deformation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 沉管基床整平
related.transfer: 可遷移「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；沉管基床整平的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

以「高點接觸與局部壓力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Permanent slabs as early braces” and “Trench section and dredging volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Immersed-tunnel foundation-bed leveling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 管道原位固化內襯
related.transfer: 可遷移「閉合電流迴路」與「雜散電流電量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；管道原位固化內襯的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Closed current circuit" and "Stray current charge" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Cured-in-place pipe lining must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈；管道原位固化內襯則以連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion; Cured-in-place pipe lining centres on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閉合電流迴路」與「剩餘厚度判讀」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到管道原位固化內襯，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水理容量比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Closed current circuit” and “Remaining thickness interpretation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Cured-in-place pipe lining, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hydraulic capacity comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道耐震接頭設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「閉合電流迴路」與「雜散電流電量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道耐震接頭設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Closed current circuit" and "Stray current charge" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic tunnel-joint design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦辨別保護電流、電位量測與地下金屬腐蝕的證據鏈；隧道耐震接頭設計則以以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on distinguish protective current, potential measurements and evidence of underground metal corrosion; Seismic tunnel-joint design centres on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閉合電流迴路」與「波傳軸向應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道耐震接頭設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「斷層變形帶需求」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Closed current circuit” and “Wave induced axial strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic tunnel-joint design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fault deformation band demand", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
